name: cubic_subfield_prime_ramification_data
statement:
theorem cubic_subfield_prime_ramification_data (r : ℕ) (hr : r.Prime) (hr3 : r % 3 = 1)
    (L : IntermediateField ℚ (CyclotomicField r ℚ))
    [IsGalois ℚ L] [IsTotallyReal L]
    (hcubic : Module.finrank ℚ L = 3) :
    ∃ P : Ideal (𝓞 L),
      P ∈ (Ideal.span {(r : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 L) ∧
      ((Ideal.span {(r : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 L)).ncard = 1 ∧
      Ideal.ramificationIdx (Ideal.span {(r : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) P = 3 ∧
      Ideal.inertiaDeg (Ideal.span {(r : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) P = 1 ∧
      (∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ≠ r →
        ∀ Q ∈ (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 L),
          Ideal.ramificationIdx (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) Q = 1)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fact r.Prime := ⟨hr⟩
  let p : Ideal ℤ := Ideal.span {(r : ℤ)}
  let E := CyclotomicField r ℚ
  letI : IsCyclotomicExtension {r} ℚ E :=
    CyclotomicField.instIsCyclotomicExtensionSingletonNatSetOfCharZero (n := r) (K := ℚ)
  haveI : IsGalois ℚ E := IsCyclotomicExtension.isGalois {r} ℚ E
  have hp0 : p ≠ ⊥ := by
    simp [p, hr.ne_zero]
  have hEcard : (p.primesOver (𝓞 E)).ncard = 1 := by
    simpa [p, E] using (IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.ncard_primesOver_of_prime (p := r)
      (K := E))
  have hEinertia : p.inertiaDegIn (𝓞 E) = 1 := by
    simpa [p, E] using (IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.inertiaDegIn_eq_of_prime (p := r)
      (K := E))
  obtain ⟨⟨P, hPprime, hPover⟩⟩ := (show Nonempty (p.primesOver (𝓞 L)) from Ideal.nonempty_primesOver p)
  letI : P.IsMaximal := hPprime.isMaximal (Ideal.ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot hp0 P)
  have hcount := Ideal.ncard_primesOver_mul_ncard_primesOver (P := P) (p := p) (G := Gal(L/ℚ))
    (C := 𝓞 E) (GAC := Gal(E/ℚ)) (GBC := Gal(E/L)) hp0
  have hLcard : (p.primesOver (𝓞 L)).ncard = 1 := by
    rw [hEcard] at hcount
    exact Nat.eq_one_of_mul_eq_one_right hcount
  have hcardL : Nat.card Gal(L/ℚ) = 3 := by
    rw [IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank (F := ℚ) (E := L), hcubic]
  have hfund := Ideal.ncard_primesOver_mul_ramificationIdxIn_mul_inertiaDegIn (p := p)
    (B := 𝓞 L) hp0 Gal(L/ℚ)
  have hprod : p.ramificationIdxIn (𝓞 L) * p.inertiaDegIn (𝓞 L) = 3 := by
    rw [hLcard, one_mul, hcardL] at hfund
    exact hfund
  have hmulIn := Ideal.inertiaDegIn_mul_inertiaDegIn (p := p) (P := P) (G := Gal(L/ℚ))
    (C := 𝓞 E) (GAC := Gal(E/ℚ)) (GBC := Gal(E/L))
  have hInertiaL : p.inertiaDegIn (𝓞 L) = 1 := by
    rw [hEinertia] at hmulIn
    exact Nat.eq_one_of_mul_eq_one_right hmulIn
  have hRamL : p.ramificationIdxIn (𝓞 L) = 3 := by
    rw [hInertiaL, mul_one] at hprod
    exact hprod
  have hP_ram : Ideal.ramificationIdx p P = 3 := by
    rw [← Ideal.ramificationIdxIn_eq_ramificationIdx (p := p) (P := P) Gal(L/ℚ), hRamL]
  have hP_inertia : Ideal.inertiaDeg p P = 1 := by
    rw [← Ideal.inertiaDegIn_eq_inertiaDeg (p := p) (P := P) Gal(L/ℚ), hInertiaL]
  refine ⟨P, ?_, hLcard, hP_ram, hP_inertia, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨hPprime, hPover⟩
  · intro q hq hqr Q hQ
    let pq : Ideal ℤ := Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)}
    have hpq0 : pq ≠ ⊥ := by
      simp [pq, hq.ne_zero]
    have hqnr : ¬ q ∣ r := by
      intro hdiv
      exact hqr ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hq hr).mp hdiv)
    have hQprime : Q.IsPrime := hQ.1
    have hQover : Q.LiesOver pq := hQ.2
    letI : Q.IsPrime := hQprime
    letI : Q.IsMaximal := hQprime.isMaximal (Ideal.ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot hpq0 Q)
    obtain ⟨⟨Q', hQ'prime, hQ'overQ⟩⟩ :=
      (show Nonempty (Q.primesOver (𝓞 E)) from Ideal.nonempty_primesOver Q)
    have hQ'overpq : Q'.LiesOver pq := Ideal.LiesOver.trans (𝔓 := Q') (P := Q) (p := pq)
    letI : Q'.IsPrime := hQ'prime
    letI : Q'.LiesOver pq := hQ'overpq
    have hQ'ram : Ideal.ramificationIdx pq Q' = 1 := by
      letI : Fact q.Prime := ⟨hq⟩
      simpa [pq, E] using
        (IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.ramificationIdx_eq_of_not_dvd (p := q) (m := r)
          (K := E) (P := Q') hqnr)
    have hmapQ : Ideal.map (algebraMap (𝓞 L) (𝓞 E)) Q ≠ ⊥ := by
      exact Ideal.map_ne_bot_of_ne_bot (Ideal.ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot hpq0 Q)
    have hmappq : Ideal.map (algebraMap ℤ (𝓞 E)) pq ≠ ⊥ := by
      exact Ideal.map_ne_bot_of_ne_bot hpq0
    have hle : Ideal.map (algebraMap (𝓞 L) (𝓞 E)) Q ≤ Q' := by
      exact Q'.over_def Q ▸ Ideal.map_comap_le
    have htower := Ideal.ramificationIdx_algebra_tower (p := pq) (P := Q) (Q := Q') hmapQ hmappq hle
    rw [hQ'ram] at htower
    exact Nat.eq_one_of_mul_eq_one_right htower.symm

name: cyclotomicField_prime_discr_natAbs
statement:
theorem cyclotomicField_prime_discr_natAbs (r : ℕ) (hr : r.Prime) (hodd : r ≠ 2) :
    (NumberField.discr (CyclotomicField r ℚ)).natAbs = r ^ (r - 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fact r.Prime := ⟨hr⟩
  letI : NeZero (r : ℚ) := ⟨by
    exact_mod_cast hr.ne_zero⟩
  letI : IsCyclotomicExtension {r} ℚ (CyclotomicField r ℚ) :=
    CyclotomicField.isCyclotomicExtension (n := r) (K := ℚ)
  rw [IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.discr_prime (p := r) (K := CyclotomicField r ℚ)]
  rw [Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_pow, Int.natAbs_neg, Int.natAbs_one, one_pow, one_mul]
  simpa using (Int.natAbs_pow (r : ℤ) (r - 2))

name: differentIdeal_cubic_subfield_eq_prime_sq
statement:
theorem differentIdeal_cubic_subfield_eq_prime_sq (r : ℕ) (hr : r.Prime) (hr3 : r % 3 = 1)
    (L : IntermediateField ℚ (CyclotomicField r ℚ))
    [IsGalois ℚ L] [IsTotallyReal L]
    (hcubic : Module.finrank ℚ L = 3) :
    ∃ P : Ideal (𝓞 L),
      P ∈ (Ideal.span {(r : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 L) ∧
      differentIdeal ℤ (𝓞 L) = P ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let p : Ideal ℤ := Ideal.span {(r : ℤ)}
  letI : Fact r.Prime := ⟨hr⟩
  letI : NeZero r := ⟨hr.ne_zero⟩
  letI : NeZero (r : ℚ) := ⟨by exact_mod_cast hr.ne_zero⟩
  letI : IsCyclotomicExtension {r} ℚ (CyclotomicField r ℚ) :=
    CyclotomicField.isCyclotomicExtension (n := r) (K := ℚ)
  have hr0 : (r : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast hr.ne_zero
  have hp0 : p ≠ ⊥ := by
    simpa [p, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot] using hr0
  letI : p.IsMaximal := by
    simpa [p] using (Int.ideal_span_isMaximal_of_prime r)
  rcases cubic_subfield_prime_ramification_data r hr hr3 L hcubic with
    ⟨P, hPover, hunique, hram, hinert, hunram⟩
  letI : P.LiesOver p := hPover.2
  have hPmax : P.IsMaximal := Ideal.isMaximal_of_mem_primesOver (p := p) hPover
  have hPprime : P.IsPrime := Ideal.IsMaximal.isPrime hPmax
  have hPne : P ≠ ⊥ := Ideal.ne_bot_of_mem_primesOver hp0 hPover
  letI : P.IsPrime := hPprime
  have hP2div : P ^ 2 ∣ differentIdeal ℤ (𝓞 L) := by
    have hP3 : P ^ 3 ∣ Ideal.map (algebraMap ℤ (𝓞 L)) p := by
      rw [Ideal.dvd_iff_le]
      simpa [p, hram] using
        (show Ideal.map (algebraMap ℤ (𝓞 L)) p ≤ P ^ (Ideal.ramificationIdx p P) from
          Ideal.le_pow_ramificationIdx)
    simpa [p] using (pow_sub_one_dvd_differentIdeal ℤ P 3 hp0 hP3)
  have hsetP : p.primesOver (𝓞 L) = {P} := by
    rcases Set.ncard_eq_one.mp hunique with ⟨P0, hP0⟩
    have hPP0 : P = P0 := by
      simpa [hP0] using hPover
    have hP0P : P0 = P := hPP0.symm
    simpa [hP0P] using hP0
  have hsetP' : (Ideal.span {(r : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 L) = {P} := by
    simpa [p] using hsetP
  have hDne : differentIdeal ℤ (𝓞 L) ≠ ⊥ := differentIdeal_ne_bot (A := ℤ) (B := 𝓞 L)
  have hfactor_eq_P : ∀ {M : Ideal (𝓞 L)}, M ∈ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors (differentIdeal ℤ (𝓞 L)) → M = P := by
    intro M hM
    have hMprime : M.IsPrime := (Ideal.mem_normalizedFactors_iff (I := differentIdeal ℤ (𝓞 L)) hDne).mp hM |>.1
    have hDleM : differentIdeal ℤ (𝓞 L) ≤ M :=
      (Ideal.mem_normalizedFactors_iff (I := differentIdeal ℤ (𝓞 L)) hDne).mp hM |>.2
    letI : M.IsPrime := hMprime
    have hMne : M ≠ ⊥ := by
      intro hMb
      have hDbot : differentIdeal ℤ (𝓞 L) ≤ ⊥ := by
        simpa [hMb] using hDleM
      exact hDne (le_bot_iff.mp hDbot)
    letI : NeZero M := ⟨hMne⟩
    let q : ℕ := Ideal.absNorm (Ideal.under ℤ M)
    have hqprime : q.Prime := by
      simpa [q] using (Nat.absNorm_under_prime M)
    have hunder : Ideal.under ℤ M = Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} := by
      simpa [q] using (Ideal.span_singleton_absNorm (I := Ideal.under ℤ M) hqprime).symm
    have hMliesq : M.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) := by
      simpa [hunder] using (Ideal.over_under (A := ℤ) (P := M))
    have hMmemq : M ∈ (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 L) := ⟨hMprime, hMliesq⟩
    by_cases hqr : q = r
    · have hMmemr : M ∈ (Ideal.span {(r : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 L) := by
        simpa [hqr] using hMmemq
      rw [hsetP'] at hMmemr
      simpa using hMmemr
    · exfalso
      have hram1 : Ideal.ramificationIdx (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) M = 1 :=
        hunram q hqprime hqr M hMmemq
      have hram1' : Ideal.ramificationIdx (Ideal.under ℤ M) M = 1 := by
        simpa [hunder] using hram1
      have hMunram : Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt ℤ M := by
        exact (Algebra.isUnramifiedAt_iff_of_isDedekindDomain (R := ℤ) (S := 𝓞 L) (p := M) hMne).2 hram1'
      have hMvd : M ∣ differentIdeal ℤ (𝓞 L) := by
        exact Ideal.dvd_iff_le.mpr hDleM
      exact ((dvd_differentIdeal_iff (A := ℤ) (B := 𝓞 L) (P := M)).1 hMvd) hMunram
  rcases UniqueFactorizationMonoid.exists_associated_prime_pow_of_unique_normalized_factor
      (p := P) (r := differentIdeal ℤ (𝓞 L))
      (h := by
        intro m hm
        exact hfactor_eq_P hm) hDne with ⟨n, hnassoc⟩
  have hDpow : differentIdeal ℤ (𝓞 L) = P ^ n := by
    simpa [eq_comm] using (associated_iff_eq.mp hnassoc)
  have htwo_le_n : 2 ≤ n := by
    rw [hDpow] at hP2div
    exact (pow_dvd_pow_iff hPne (by
      rw [Ideal.isUnit_iff]
      exact hPmax.ne_top)).mp hP2div
  have hPinert : Ideal.inertiaDeg p P = 1 := by
    simpa [p] using hinert
  have hAbsNormP0 := Ideal.absNorm_eq_pow_inertiaDeg' P hr
  have hAbsNormP : Ideal.absNorm P = r := by
    rw [hPinert, pow_one] at hAbsNormP0
    exact hAbsNormP0
  obtain ⟨⟨Q, hQprime, hQoverP⟩⟩ := Ideal.nonempty_primesOver (S := 𝓞 (CyclotomicField r ℚ)) P
  letI : Q.IsPrime := hQprime
  letI : Q.LiesOver P := hQoverP
  letI : Q.LiesOver p := Ideal.LiesOver.trans Q P p
  let m : ℕ := (r - 1) / 3
  have hQe_total : Ideal.ramificationIdx p Q = r - 1 := by
    simpa [p] using
      (IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.ramificationIdx_eq_of_prime (p := r) (K := CyclotomicField r ℚ)
        (P := Q))
  have hQf_total : Ideal.inertiaDeg p Q = 1 := by
    simpa [p] using
      (IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.inertiaDeg_eq_of_prime (p := r) (K := CyclotomicField r ℚ)
        (P := Q))
  have hPmap_ne : Ideal.map (algebraMap (𝓞 L) (𝓞 (CyclotomicField r ℚ))) P ≠ ⊥ := by
    exact (Ideal.map_eq_bot_iff_of_injective
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective (𝓞 L) (𝓞 (CyclotomicField r ℚ)))).not.mpr hPne
  have hpmapE_ne : Ideal.map (algebraMap ℤ (𝓞 (CyclotomicField r ℚ))) p ≠ ⊥ := by
    exact (Ideal.map_eq_bot_iff_of_injective
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective ℤ (𝓞 (CyclotomicField r ℚ)))).not.mpr hp0
  have hmapPQ : Ideal.map (algebraMap (𝓞 L) (𝓞 (CyclotomicField r ℚ))) P ≤ Q := by
    exact Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr Ideal.LiesOver.over.le
  have hQe_tower :=
    Ideal.ramificationIdx_algebra_tower (p := p) (P := P) (Q := Q) hPmap_ne hpmapE_ne hmapPQ
  have hQe_rel : Ideal.ramificationIdx P Q = m := by
    dsimp [m]
    rw [hQe_total, hram] at hQe_tower
    omega
  have hQf_tower := Ideal.inertiaDeg_algebra_tower p P Q
  have hQf_rel : Ideal.inertiaDeg P Q = 1 := by
    rw [hQf_total, hinert] at hQf_tower
    omega
  have hAbsNormQ0 := Ideal.absNorm_eq_pow_inertiaDeg_of_liesOver Q P hPprime hPne
  have hAbsNormQ : Ideal.absNorm Q = r := by
    rw [hAbsNormP, hQf_rel, pow_one] at hAbsNormQ0
    exact hAbsNormQ0
  let Drel : Ideal (𝓞 (CyclotomicField r ℚ)) := differentIdeal (𝓞 L) (𝓞 (CyclotomicField r ℚ))
  have hQpow : Q ^ m ∣ Ideal.map (algebraMap (𝓞 L) (𝓞 (CyclotomicField r ℚ))) P := by
    rw [Ideal.dvd_iff_le]
    simpa [hQe_rel] using
      (show Ideal.map (algebraMap (𝓞 L) (𝓞 (CyclotomicField r ℚ))) P ≤ Q ^ (Ideal.ramificationIdx P Q) from
        Ideal.le_pow_ramificationIdx)
  have hQdivDrel : Q ^ (m - 1) ∣ Drel := by
    simpa [Drel, m] using
      (pow_sub_one_dvd_differentIdeal (A := 𝓞 L) (B := 𝓞 (CyclotomicField r ℚ)) (p := P) Q
        m hPne hQpow)
  have hDrel_norm_dvd : r ^ (m - 1) ∣ Ideal.absNorm Drel := by
    have h := map_dvd Ideal.absNorm hQdivDrel
    simpa [Drel, hAbsNormQ] using h
  have hdiscrL_natAbs : (NumberField.discr L).natAbs = r ^ n := by
    rw [← NumberField.absNorm_differentIdeal (K := L) (𝒪 := 𝓞 L), hDpow]
    simp [hAbsNormP]
  have hirr : Irreducible (Polynomial.cyclotomic r ℚ) :=
    Polynomial.cyclotomic.irreducible_rat (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hr.ne_zero)
  have hfinrankE : Module.finrank ℚ (CyclotomicField r ℚ) = r - 1 := by
    simpa [Nat.totient_prime hr] using
      (IsCyclotomicExtension.finrank (n := r) (K := ℚ) (L := CyclotomicField r ℚ) hirr)
  have hfinrankLE : Module.finrank L (CyclotomicField r ℚ) = m := by
    dsimp [m]
    have hmul := Module.finrank_mul_finrank (F := ℚ) (K := L) (A := CyclotomicField r ℚ)
    rw [hcubic, hfinrankE] at hmul
    omega
  have hodd : r ≠ 2 := by
    intro hr2
    rw [hr2] at hr3
    norm_num at hr3
  have hdiscE : (NumberField.discr (CyclotomicField r ℚ)).natAbs = r ^ (r - 2) :=
    cyclotomicField_prime_discr_natAbs r hr hodd
  have htower_rhs : Ideal.absNorm Drel * (r ^ n) ^ m = r ^ (r - 2) := by
    have htower0 :=
      NumberField.natAbs_discr_eq_absNorm_differentIdeal_mul_natAbs_discr_pow
        (K := L) (𝒪 := 𝓞 L) (CyclotomicField r ℚ) (𝓞 (CyclotomicField r ℚ))
    rw [hdiscE, hdiscrL_natAbs, hfinrankLE] at htower0
    simpa [Drel] using htower0.symm
  have hdiv_total : r ^ ((m - 1) + n * m) ∣ r ^ (r - 2) := by
    have hmuldiv : r ^ (m - 1) * (r ^ n) ^ m ∣ Ideal.absNorm Drel * (r ^ n) ^ m := by
      exact mul_dvd_mul hDrel_norm_dvd (dvd_rfl)
    rw [htower_rhs] at hmuldiv
    simpa [pow_mul, pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hmuldiv
  have hr_nonunit : ¬ IsUnit r := by
    rw [Nat.isUnit_iff]
    exact hr.ne_one
  have hupper : (m - 1) + n * m ≤ r - 2 := by
    exact (pow_dvd_pow_iff hr.ne_zero hr_nonunit).mp hdiv_total
  have hr_div : r = 3 * m + 1 := by
    dsimp [m]
    omega
  have hm_ne_zero : m ≠ 0 := by
    intro hm0
    rw [hm0] at hr_div
    exact hr.ne_one hr_div
  have hm_pos : 0 < m := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm_ne_zero
  have hupper' : (m - 1) + n * m ≤ 3 * m - 1 := by
    rw [hr_div] at hupper
    simpa using hupper
  have hnm_le : n * m ≤ 2 * m := by
    omega
  have hn_le_two : n ≤ 2 := by
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right hnm_le hm_pos
  have hn_eq : n = 2 := le_antisymm hn_le_two htwo_le_n
  refine ⟨P, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hPover
  · simpa [hn_eq] using hDpow

name: discr_cubic_subfield_of_prime_cyclotomic
statement:
theorem discr_cubic_subfield_of_prime_cyclotomic (r : ℕ) (hr : r.Prime) (hr3 : r % 3 = 1)
    (L : IntermediateField ℚ (CyclotomicField r ℚ))
    [IsGalois ℚ L] [IsTotallyReal L]
    (hcubic : Module.finrank ℚ L = 3) :
    (NumberField.discr L).natAbs = r ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let p : Ideal ℤ := Ideal.span {(r : ℤ)}
  obtain ⟨P, hPmem, hcount, hram, hfin, h_unram⟩ :=
    cubic_subfield_prime_ramification_data r hr hr3 L hcubic
  obtain ⟨P', hP'mem, hdiff⟩ :=
    differentIdeal_cubic_subfield_eq_prime_sq r hr hr3 L hcubic
  have hcount' : (p.primesOver (𝓞 L)).ncard = 1 := by
    simpa [p] using hcount
  have hPmem' : P ∈ p.primesOver (𝓞 L) := by
    simpa [p] using hPmem
  have hP'mem' : P' ∈ p.primesOver (𝓞 L) := by
    simpa [p] using hP'mem
  obtain ⟨Q, hQsingle⟩ := Set.ncard_eq_one.mp hcount'
  have hP_eq_Q : P = Q := by
    rw [hQsingle] at hPmem'
    simpa using hPmem'
  have hP'_eq_Q : P' = Q := by
    rw [hQsingle] at hP'mem'
    simpa using hP'mem'
  have hP'eqP : P' = P := hP'_eq_Q.trans hP_eq_Q.symm
  set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
  have hnormP : Ideal.absNorm P = r := by
    let PP : p.primesOver (𝓞 L) := ⟨P, hPmem'⟩
    letI : P.LiesOver p := by
      simpa using (Ideal.primesOver.liesOver p PP)
    rw [Ideal.absNorm_eq_pow_inertiaDeg' P hr, hfin, pow_one]
  calc
    (NumberField.discr L).natAbs = Ideal.absNorm (differentIdeal ℤ (𝓞 L)) := by
      rw [← NumberField.absNorm_differentIdeal (K := L) (𝒪 := 𝓞 L)]
    _ = Ideal.absNorm (P' ^ 2) := by rw [hdiff]
    _ = Ideal.absNorm P' ^ 2 := by
      simpa using (map_pow Ideal.absNorm P' 2)
    _ = Ideal.absNorm P ^ 2 := by rw [hP'eqP]
    _ = r ^ 2 := by rw [hnormP]

name: cyclic_cubic_subfield_exists
statement:
theorem cyclic_cubic_subfield_exists (r : ℕ) (hr : r.Prime) (hr3 : r % 3 = 1) :
    ∃ (L : Type) (_ : Field L) (_ : CharZero L) (_ : NumberField L)
      (_ : IsTotallyReal L) (_ : IsGalois ℚ L)
      (_ : Algebra L (CyclotomicField r ℚ)),
      Module.finrank ℚ L = 3 ∧
      (NumberField.discr L).natAbs = r ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let E := CyclotomicField r ℚ
  letI : Fact r.Prime := ⟨hr⟩
  have hne : r ≠ 0 := hr.ne_zero
  letI : NeZero (r : ℚ) := ⟨Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hne⟩
  letI : IsCyclotomicExtension ({r} : Set ℕ) ℚ E := CyclotomicField.isCyclotomicExtension (n := r) (K := ℚ)
  letI : IsAbelianGalois ℚ E := IsCyclotomicExtension.isAbelianGalois (S := ({r} : Set ℕ)) (K := ℚ) (L := E)
  letI : IsGalois ℚ E := IsCyclotomicExtension.isGalois (S := ({r} : Set ℕ)) (K := ℚ) (L := E)
  have hirr : Irreducible (Polynomial.cyclotomic r ℚ) :=
    Polynomial.cyclotomic.irreducible_rat hr.pos
  let e : (E ≃ₐ[ℚ] E) ≃* (ZMod r)ˣ := by
    simpa [E] using (galCyclotomicEquivUnitsZMod (n := r) (K := ℚ) (L := E) hirr)
  let H' : Subgroup ((ZMod r)ˣ) := (powMonoidHom 3).range
  let H : Subgroup (E ≃ₐ[ℚ] E) := H'.map e.symm.toMonoidHom
  let L : IntermediateField ℚ E := IntermediateField.fixedField H
  have hindexH' : H'.index = 3 := by
    have hidx : H'.index = Nat.gcd (Nat.card ((ZMod r)ˣ)) 3 := by
      simpa [H'] using (IsCyclic.index_powMonoidHom_range (G := (ZMod r)ˣ) 3)
    have hcard : Nat.card ((ZMod r)ˣ) = r - 1 := by
      rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ZMod.card_units r]
    have h3dvd : 3 ∣ r - 1 := by
      omega
    have hgcd : Nat.gcd (Nat.card ((ZMod r)ˣ)) 3 = 3 := by
      rw [hcard, Nat.gcd_eq_right_iff_dvd]
      exact h3dvd
    rw [hidx, hgcd]
  have hindexH : H.index = 3 := by
    have hm : (H'.map e.symm.toMonoidHom).index = H'.index := by
      simpa using (Subgroup.index_map_equiv (H := H') e.symm)
    rw [show H = H'.map e.symm.toMonoidHom by rfl, hm, hindexH']
  have hfix : L.fixingSubgroup = H := by
    simpa [L] using (IntermediateField.fixingSubgroup_fixedField (F := ℚ) (E := E) H)
  have hfinrankL : Module.finrank ℚ L = 3 := by
    rw [IntermediateField.finrank_eq_fixingSubgroup_index (k := ℚ) (K := E) L, hfix, hindexH]
  have hgalL : IsGalois ℚ L := by
    letI : H.Normal := Subgroup.normal_of_comm H
    exact IsGalois.of_fixedField_normal_subgroup (K := ℚ) (L := E) H
  have htrL : IsTotallyReal L := by
    letI : IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces ℚ L := by
      apply IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces_of_odd_finrank (k := ℚ) (K := L)
      simpa [hfinrankL] using (show Odd (3 : ℕ) by decide)
    refine ⟨fun w => ?_⟩
    have hwunr : w.IsUnramified ℚ := NumberField.InfinitePlace.isUnramified (k := ℚ) w
    have hwq : w.comap (algebraMap ℚ L) = Rat.infinitePlace := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    have hbaseReal : (w.comap (algebraMap ℚ L)).IsReal := by
      simpa [hwq] using (Rat.isReal_infinitePlace : Rat.infinitePlace.IsReal)
    exact (NumberField.InfinitePlace.isUnramified_iff (k := ℚ) (w := w)).mp hwunr |>.resolve_right
      ((NumberField.InfinitePlace.not_isComplex_iff_isReal).2 hbaseReal)
  letI : IsGalois ℚ L := hgalL
  letI : IsTotallyReal L := htrL
  refine ⟨L, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, htrL, hgalL, inferInstance, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨hfinrankL, discr_cubic_subfield_of_prime_cyclotomic r hr hr3 L hfinrankL⟩

name: elementaryAbelian_mulEquiv
statement:
theorem elementaryAbelian_mulEquiv (G : Type) [Group G] [Finite G]
    (p k : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
    (_hcard : Nat.card G = p ^ k)
    (_hexp : ∀ g : G, g ^ p = 1)
    (_habel : ∀ g h : G, g * h = h * g) :
    Nonempty (G ≃* Multiplicative (Fin k → ZMod p))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : CommGroup G :=
    { ‹Group G› with
      mul_comm := _habel }
  have hsmul_zero : ∀ a : Additive G, p • a = 0 := by
    intro a
    simpa using congrArg Additive.ofMul (_hexp a.toMul)
  haveI : Module (ZMod p) (Additive G) := AddCommGroup.zmodModule hsmul_zero
  haveI : Finite (Additive G) := inferInstance
  haveI : Module.Finite (ZMod p) (Additive G) :=
    Module.Finite.of_finite (R := ZMod p) (M := Additive G)
  haveI : Module.Free (ZMod p) (Additive G) :=
    Module.Free.of_divisionRing (K := ZMod p) (V := Additive G)
  have hpow : p ^ Module.finrank (ZMod p) (Additive G) = Nat.card (Additive G) := by
    simpa using (FiniteField.pow_finrank_eq_natCard p (Additive G))
  have hpow' : p ^ Module.finrank (ZMod p) (Additive G) = p ^ k := by
    calc
      p ^ Module.finrank (ZMod p) (Additive G) = Nat.card (Additive G) := hpow
      _ = Nat.card G := Nat.card_congr Additive.toMul
      _ = p ^ k := _hcard
  have hfinrank : Module.finrank (ZMod p) (Additive G) = k := by
    exact Nat.pow_right_injective (a := p) (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p).two_le hpow'
  let b : Module.Basis (Fin k) (ZMod p) (Additive G) :=
    Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq (R := ZMod p) (M := Additive G) (n := k) hfinrank
  refine ⟨AddEquiv.toMultiplicativeRight
    (show Additive G ≃+ (Fin k → ZMod p) from b.equivFun.toAddEquiv)⟩

name: minpoly_iK_eq_X_sq_add_one
statement:
theorem minpoly_iK_eq_X_sq_add_one (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) :
    minpoly 𝒟.L 𝒟.i_K = (Polynomial.X ^ 2 + 1 : Polynomial 𝒟.L)
proof:
:= by
  let p : Polynomial 𝒟.L := Polynomial.X ^ 2 + 1
  have hp_monic : p.Monic := by
    dsimp [p]
    simpa using (Polynomial.monic_X_pow_add_C (a := (1 : 𝒟.L)) (n := 2) (by decide))
  have hp_aeval : Polynomial.aeval 𝒟.i_K p = 0 := by
    dsimp [p]
    simp [pow_two, 𝒟.i_K_sq]
  have hi : IsIntegral 𝒟.L 𝒟.i_K := ⟨p, hp_monic, hp_aeval⟩
  let pb : PowerBasis 𝒟.L 𝒟.K := PowerBasis.ofAdjoinEqTop hi 𝒟.adjoin_i_K_eq_top
  have hdim : pb.dim = 2 := by
    rw [← PowerBasis.finrank pb]
    exact Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension.finrank_eq_two 𝒟.L 𝒟.K
  have hdeg : (minpoly 𝒟.L 𝒟.i_K).natDegree = 2 := by
    rw [← PowerBasis.ofAdjoinEqTop_dim hi 𝒟.adjoin_i_K_eq_top]
    simpa [pb] using hdim
  have hnat_p : p.natDegree = 2 := by
    dsimp [p]
    simpa using (Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow_add_C (n := 2) (r := (1 : 𝒟.L)))
  have hpdeg : p.degree = 2 := by
    simpa using
      (Polynomial.MonicDegreeEq.degree (Polynomial.MonicDegreeEq.mk p hp_monic hnat_p))
  have hmdeg : (minpoly 𝒟.L 𝒟.i_K).degree = 2 := by
    simpa using
      (Polynomial.MonicDegreeEq.degree
        (Polynomial.MonicDegreeEq.mk (minpoly 𝒟.L 𝒟.i_K) (minpoly.monic hi) hdeg))
  have hp_le : p.degree ≤ (minpoly 𝒟.L 𝒟.i_K).degree := by
    rw [hpdeg, hmdeg]
  have hEq : p = minpoly 𝒟.L 𝒟.i_K := by
    exact minpoly.unique_of_degree_le_degree_minpoly (A := 𝒟.L) (x := 𝒟.i_K) hp_monic hp_aeval hp_le
  simpa [p] using hEq.symm

name: minpoly_iO_map_eq_X_sq_add_one
statement:
theorem minpoly_iO_map_eq_X_sq_add_one (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) :
    (minpoly (𝓞 𝒟.L) (admissibleDatum_iO 𝒟)).map
      (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) 𝒟.L) = (Polynomial.X ^ 2 + 1 : Polynomial 𝒟.L)
proof:
:= by
  let iO := admissibleDatum_iO 𝒟
  have hIntExt : Algebra.IsIntegral (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K) :=
    NumberField.RingOfIntegers.extension_algebra_isIntegral (K := 𝒟.L) (L := 𝒟.K)
  have hiOint : IsIntegral (𝓞 𝒟.L) iO :=
    (Algebra.isIntegral_def.mp hIntExt) iO
  rw [← minpoly.isIntegrallyClosed_eq_field_fractions (K := 𝒟.L) (L := 𝒟.K) hiOint]
  simpa [iO, admissibleDatum_iO, minpoly_iK_eq_X_sq_add_one 𝒟]

name: q_mod4_exists_sq_eq_neg_one
statement:
theorem q_mod4_exists_sq_eq_neg_one (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (b : Fin 𝒟.t) :
    ∃ a : ZMod (𝒟.q b), a ^ 2 = (-1 : ZMod (𝒟.q b))
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fact (Nat.Prime (𝒟.q b)) := ⟨𝒟.q_prime b⟩
  have hsquare : IsSquare (-1 : ZMod (𝒟.q b)) := by
    rw [ZMod.exists_sq_eq_neg_one_iff]
    have hmod : 𝒟.q b % 4 ≠ 3 := by
      rw [𝒟.q_mod4 b]
      decide
    exact hmod
  rcases hsquare with ⟨a, ha⟩
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  simpa [sq] using ha.symm

name: exists_sq_eq_neg_one_residueField_of_prime_over_q
statement:
theorem exists_sq_eq_neg_one_residueField_of_prime_over_q (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (b : Fin 𝒟.t)
    (𝔮 : Ideal (𝓞 𝒟.L)) (h𝔮p : 𝔮.IsPrime) (h𝔮ne : 𝔮 ≠ ⊥)
    (h𝔮over : 𝔮 ∈ (Ideal.span {((𝒟.q b : ℤ))} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 𝒟.L)) :
    ∃ a : 𝓞 𝒟.L ⧸ 𝔮, a ^ 2 = (-1 : 𝓞 𝒟.L ⧸ 𝔮)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let p : Ideal ℤ := Ideal.span {((𝒟.q b : ℤ))}
  have hpPrime : p.IsPrime := by
    rw [show p = Ideal.span {((𝒟.q b : ℤ))} by rfl]
    exact (Ideal.span_singleton_prime (show ((𝒟.q b : ℤ)) ≠ 0 by exact_mod_cast (𝒟.q_prime b).ne_zero)).2
      ((Nat.prime_iff_prime_int).mp (𝒟.q_prime b))
  have hp0 : p ≠ ⊥ := by
    rw [show p = Ideal.span {((𝒟.q b : ℤ))} by rfl, ne_eq, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]
    exact_mod_cast (𝒟.q_prime b).ne_zero
  letI : p.IsMaximal := hpPrime.isMaximal hp0
  let Q : p.primesOver (𝓞 𝒟.L) := ⟨𝔮, h𝔮over⟩
  letI : 𝔮.LiesOver p := by
    simpa using (Ideal.primesOver.liesOver (p := p) Q)
  letI : 𝔮.IsMaximal := Ideal.isMaximal_of_mem_primesOver h𝔮over
  have hinertia : Ideal.inertiaDeg p 𝔮 = 1 := by
    simpa [p] using ((𝒟.q_splits_in_L b).1 𝔮 h𝔮over).2
  have hcard_nat : Nat.card (𝓞 𝒟.L ⧸ 𝔮) = 𝒟.q b := by
    calc
      Nat.card (𝓞 𝒟.L ⧸ 𝔮) = 𝔮.cardQuot := by
        symm
        exact Submodule.cardQuot_apply 𝔮
      _ = Ideal.absNorm 𝔮 := by
        symm
        exact Ideal.absNorm_apply 𝔮
      _ = (𝒟.q b) ^ (Ideal.inertiaDeg p 𝔮) := by
        exact Ideal.absNorm_eq_pow_inertiaDeg' 𝔮 (𝒟.q_prime b)
      _ = 𝒟.q b := by rw [hinertia, pow_one]
  letI : Finite (𝓞 𝒟.L ⧸ 𝔮) := Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero (by
    rw [hcard_nat]
    exact (𝒟.q_prime b).ne_zero)
  letI : Fintype (𝓞 𝒟.L ⧸ 𝔮) := Fintype.ofFinite (𝓞 𝒟.L ⧸ 𝔮)
  have hcard : Fintype.card (𝓞 𝒟.L ⧸ 𝔮) = 𝒟.q b := by
    rw [Fintype.card_eq_nat_card, hcard_nat]
  let e : ZMod (𝒟.q b) ≃+* (𝓞 𝒟.L ⧸ 𝔮) :=
    ZMod.ringEquivOfPrime (R := 𝓞 𝒟.L ⧸ 𝔮) (𝒟.q_prime b) hcard
  rcases q_mod4_exists_sq_eq_neg_one 𝒟 b with ⟨a, ha⟩
  refine ⟨e a, ?_⟩
  simpa [map_pow, map_neg, map_one] using congrArg e ha

name: q_two_not_mem_prime_over_q
statement:
theorem q_two_not_mem_prime_over_q (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (b : Fin 𝒟.t)
    (𝔮 : Ideal (𝓞 𝒟.L)) (h𝔮p : 𝔮.IsPrime) (h𝔮ne : 𝔮 ≠ ⊥)
    (h𝔮over : 𝔮 ∈ (Ideal.span {((𝒟.q b : ℤ))} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 𝒟.L)) :
    (2 : 𝓞 𝒟.L) ∉ 𝔮
proof:
:= by
  let p : Ideal ℤ := Ideal.span {((𝒟.q b : ℤ))}
  intro h2
  have h_lies' : 𝔮.LiesOver (Ideal.span {((𝒟.q b : ℤ))}) := by
    exact h𝔮over.2
  letI : 𝔮.LiesOver p := by
    simpa [p] using h_lies'
  have h2int : (2 : ℤ) ∈ p := by
    exact (Ideal.mem_of_liesOver 𝔮 p 2).2 (by simpa using h2)
  have h2int' : (2 : ℤ) ∈ Ideal.span {((𝒟.q b : ℤ))} := by
    simpa [p] using h2int
  have hdivz : ((𝒟.q b : ℤ)) ∣ (2 : ℤ) := by
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp h2int'
  have hdivn : 𝒟.q b ∣ 2 := by
    exact Int.ofNat_dvd_natCast.mp hdivz
  have hqeq : 𝒟.q b = 2 := by
    exact (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq (𝒟.q_prime b) Nat.prime_two).mp hdivn
  have hmod : (2 : ℕ) % 4 = 1 := by
    simpa [hqeq] using 𝒟.q_mod4 b
  norm_num at hmod

name: conductor_iO_sup_prime_over_q_eq_top
statement:
theorem conductor_iO_sup_prime_over_q_eq_top (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (b : Fin 𝒟.t)
    (𝔮 : Ideal (𝓞 𝒟.L)) (h𝔮p : 𝔮.IsPrime) (h𝔮ne : 𝔮 ≠ ⊥)
    (h𝔮over : 𝔮 ∈ (Ideal.span {((𝒟.q b : ℤ))} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 𝒟.L)) :
    (conductor (𝓞 𝒟.L) (admissibleDatum_iO 𝒟)).comap
      (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)) ⊔ 𝔮 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let iO := admissibleDatum_iO 𝒟
  have hcoe_iO : (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.K) 𝒟.K) iO = 𝒟.i_K := by
    rfl
  have hmap2 : (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)) (2 : 𝓞 𝒟.L) = (2 : 𝓞 𝒟.K) := by
    simpa using map_natCast (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)) 2
  have hmul :
      conductor (𝓞 𝒟.L) iO * differentIdeal (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)
        = Ideal.span
            {(Polynomial.aeval iO (Polynomial.derivative (minpoly (𝓞 𝒟.L) iO)))} := by
    simpa [iO] using
      (conductor_mul_differentIdeal (A := 𝓞 𝒟.L) (K := 𝒟.L) (L := 𝒟.K) (x := iO)
        (by simpa [iO] using 𝒟.adjoin_i_K_eq_top))
  have hiO_sq : iO * iO = (-1 : 𝓞 𝒟.K) := by
    ext
    simp [iO, admissibleDatum_iO, 𝒟.i_K_sq]
  have hiO_unit : IsUnit iO := by
    refine ⟨⟨iO, -iO, ?_, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    · calc
        iO * (-iO) = -(iO * iO) := by ring
        _ = -(-1 : 𝓞 𝒟.K) := by rw [hiO_sq]
        _ = 1 := by ring
    · calc
        (-iO) * iO = -(iO * iO) := by ring
        _ = -(-1 : 𝓞 𝒟.K) := by rw [hiO_sq]
        _ = 1 := by ring
  have hcomm :
      (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K).comp (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) 𝒟.L) =
        (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.K) 𝒟.K).comp (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)) := by
    ext x
    rfl
  have haeval_map :
      (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.K) 𝒟.K)
        (Polynomial.aeval iO (Polynomial.derivative (minpoly (𝓞 𝒟.L) iO)))
        = (2 : 𝒟.K) * 𝒟.i_K := by
    rw [Polynomial.map_aeval_eq_aeval_map hcomm]
    rw [← Polynomial.derivative_map]
    rw [minpoly_iO_map_eq_X_sq_add_one]
    norm_num [pow_two, 𝒟.i_K_sq]
    rw [hcoe_iO, two_mul]
  have haeval :
      Polynomial.aeval iO (Polynomial.derivative (minpoly (𝓞 𝒟.L) iO)) = 2 * iO := by
    ext
    simpa [iO] using haeval_map
  have hspan :
      Ideal.span ({(2 : 𝓞 𝒟.K)} : Set (𝓞 𝒟.K)) =
        conductor (𝓞 𝒟.L) iO * differentIdeal (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K) := by
    calc
      Ideal.span ({(2 : 𝓞 𝒟.K)} : Set (𝓞 𝒟.K))
          = Ideal.span
              {(Polynomial.aeval iO (Polynomial.derivative (minpoly (𝓞 𝒟.L) iO)))} := by
            rw [haeval]
            symm
            exact Ideal.span_singleton_mul_right_unit hiO_unit (2 : 𝓞 𝒟.K)
      _ = conductor (𝓞 𝒟.L) iO * differentIdeal (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K) := by
          symm
          exact hmul
  have hspan_le : Ideal.span ({(2 : 𝓞 𝒟.K)} : Set (𝓞 𝒟.K)) ≤ conductor (𝓞 𝒟.L) iO := by
    rw [hspan]
    exact Ideal.mul_le_right
  have h2_mem_cond : (2 : 𝓞 𝒟.K) ∈ conductor (𝓞 𝒟.L) iO := by
    exact hspan_le (Ideal.subset_span (by simp))
  have h2_mem_comap :
      (2 : 𝓞 𝒟.L) ∈ (conductor (𝓞 𝒟.L) (admissibleDatum_iO 𝒟)).comap
        (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)) := by
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, hmap2]
    simpa [iO] using h2_mem_cond
  have h𝔮max : 𝔮.IsMaximal := Ideal.IsPrime.isMaximal h𝔮p h𝔮ne
  rw [Ideal.isMaximal_iff] at h𝔮max
  have hone_mem : (1 : 𝓞 𝒟.L) ∈
      (conductor (𝓞 𝒟.L) (admissibleDatum_iO 𝒟)).comap
        (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)) ⊔ 𝔮 := by
    exact h𝔮max.2 _ _ le_sup_right
      (q_two_not_mem_prime_over_q 𝒟 b 𝔮 h𝔮p h𝔮ne h𝔮over)
      (Ideal.mem_sup_left h2_mem_comap)
  exact top_unique (by
    intro x hx
    exact Ideal.mem_of_one_mem hone_mem x)

name: q_splits_in_K_local
statement:
theorem q_splits_in_K_local (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (b : Fin 𝒟.t)
    (𝔮 : Ideal (𝓞 𝒟.L)) (_h𝔮p : 𝔮.IsPrime) (_h𝔮ne : 𝔮 ≠ ⊥)
    (_h𝔮over : 𝔮 ∈ (Ideal.span {((𝒟.q b : ℤ))} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 𝒟.L)) :
    ∃ 𝔓 𝔓' : Ideal (𝓞 𝒟.K),
      𝔓 ≠ 𝔓' ∧ 𝔓.IsPrime ∧ 𝔓'.IsPrime ∧ 𝔓 ≠ ⊥ ∧ 𝔓' ≠ ⊥ ∧
      𝔮.map (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)) = 𝔓 * 𝔓'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let iO : 𝓞 𝒟.K := admissibleDatum_iO 𝒟
  have hiOint : IsIntegral (𝓞 𝒟.L) iO := by
    have hInt : Algebra.IsIntegral (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K) :=
      NumberField.RingOfIntegers.extension_algebra_isIntegral (K := 𝒟.L) (L := 𝒟.K)
    rw [Algebra.isIntegral_def] at hInt
    exact hInt iO
  have hminO_eq : minpoly (𝓞 𝒟.L) iO = (Polynomial.X ^ 2 + 1 : Polynomial (𝓞 𝒟.L)) := by
    apply (Polynomial.map_injective (f := algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) 𝒟.L)
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective (𝓞 𝒟.L) 𝒟.L))
    simpa [iO] using minpoly_iO_map_eq_X_sq_add_one 𝒟
  letI : 𝔮.IsMaximal := Ideal.IsPrime.isMaximal _h𝔮p _h𝔮ne
  letI := Ideal.Quotient.field 𝔮
  have hcond_sup : (conductor (𝓞 𝒟.L) iO).comap (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)) ⊔ 𝔮 = ⊤ := by
    simpa [iO] using conductor_iO_sup_prime_over_q_eq_top 𝒟 b 𝔮 _h𝔮p _h𝔮ne _h𝔮over
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_sq_eq_neg_one_residueField_of_prime_over_q 𝒟 b 𝔮 _h𝔮p _h𝔮ne _h𝔮over
  let Q : Polynomial (𝓞 𝒟.L ⧸ 𝔮) := Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a
  let Q' : Polynomial (𝓞 𝒟.L ⧸ 𝔮) := Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C a
  have hred : Polynomial.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔮) (minpoly (𝓞 𝒟.L) iO) = Q * Q' := by
    rw [hminO_eq]
    simp [Q, Q']
    ring_nf
    have hC : Polynomial.C a ^ 2 = Polynomial.C (a ^ 2) := by simp [pow_two]
    rw [hC, ha]
    simpa [add_comm]
  have htwo_ne_zero : (2 : 𝓞 𝒟.L ⧸ 𝔮) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hmem : (2 : 𝓞 𝒟.L) ∈ 𝔮 := by
      simpa using (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (p := 𝔮) (x := (2 : 𝓞 𝒟.L))).mp hzero
    exact q_two_not_mem_prime_over_q 𝒟 b 𝔮 _h𝔮p _h𝔮ne _h𝔮over hmem
  have ha_ne_zero : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro ha0
    have hneg : (-1 : 𝓞 𝒟.L ⧸ 𝔮) = 0 := by simpa [ha0] using ha
    have hone : (1 : 𝓞 𝒟.L ⧸ 𝔮) = 0 := by simpa using congrArg Neg.neg hneg
    exact one_ne_zero hone
  have hQ_ne_Q' : Q ≠ Q' := by
    intro hQQ
    have hcoeff := congrArg (fun p : Polynomial (𝓞 𝒟.L ⧸ 𝔮) => p.coeff 0) hQQ
    have haeq : -a = a := by
      simpa [Q, Q'] using hcoeff
    have haeq' : a = -a := by simpa using haeq.symm
    have h2a : (2 : 𝓞 𝒟.L ⧸ 𝔮) * a = 0 := by
      calc
        (2 : 𝓞 𝒟.L ⧸ 𝔮) * a = a + a := by simpa [two_mul]
        _ = a + (-a) := by
          exact congrArg (fun x => a + x) haeq'
        _ = 0 := by simp
    have h2zero : (2 : 𝓞 𝒟.L ⧸ 𝔮) = 0 := by
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h2a).resolve_right ha_ne_zero
    exact htwo_ne_zero h2zero
  have hQ_irreducible : Irreducible Q := by
    simpa [Q] using (Polynomial.irreducible_X_sub_C a)
  have hQ'_irreducible : Irreducible Q' := by
    simpa [Q', sub_eq_add_neg] using (Polynomial.irreducible_X_sub_C (-a))
  have hQ_monic : Q.Monic := by
    simpa [Q] using (Polynomial.monic_X_sub_C a)
  have hQ'_monic : Q'.Monic := by
    simpa [Q'] using (Polynomial.monic_X_add_C a)
  have hQ_ne_zero : Q ≠ 0 := hQ_monic.ne_zero
  have hQ'_ne_zero : Q' ≠ 0 := hQ'_monic.ne_zero
  have hred_ne_zero : Polynomial.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔮) (minpoly (𝓞 𝒟.L) iO) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hred]
    exact mul_ne_zero hQ_ne_zero hQ'_ne_zero
  have hQ_mem : Q ∈ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors (Polynomial.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔮) (minpoly (𝓞 𝒟.L) iO)) := by
    rw [Polynomial.mem_normalizedFactors_iff hred_ne_zero]
    refine ⟨hQ_irreducible, hQ_monic, ?_⟩
    rw [hred]
    exact ⟨Q', by simp⟩
  have hQ'_mem : Q' ∈ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors (Polynomial.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔮) (minpoly (𝓞 𝒟.L) iO)) := by
    rw [Polynomial.mem_normalizedFactors_iff hred_ne_zero]
    refine ⟨hQ'_irreducible, hQ'_monic, ?_⟩
    rw [hred]
    exact ⟨Q, by simp [mul_comm]⟩
  have hqmap_ne : 𝔮.map (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)) ≠ ⊥ :=
    Ideal.map_ne_bot_of_ne_bot _h𝔮ne
  let e := KummerDedekind.normalizedFactorsMapEquivNormalizedFactorsMinPolyMk
    (R := 𝓞 𝒟.L) (S := 𝓞 𝒟.K) (I := 𝔮) (x := iO) (show 𝔮.IsMaximal from inferInstance)
    _h𝔮ne hcond_sup hiOint
  let Pf := (e.symm ⟨Q, hQ_mem⟩ : {J : Ideal (𝓞 𝒟.K) | J ∈ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors (𝔮.map (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)))})
  let Pf' := (e.symm ⟨Q', hQ'_mem⟩ : {J : Ideal (𝓞 𝒟.K) | J ∈ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors (𝔮.map (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)))})
  let 𝔓 : Ideal (𝓞 𝒟.K) := Pf
  let 𝔓' : Ideal (𝓞 𝒟.K) := Pf'
  have h𝔓_mem : 𝔓 ∈ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors (𝔮.map (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K))) := by
    change (↑Pf) ∈ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors (𝔮.map (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)))
    exact Pf.prop
  have h𝔓'_mem : 𝔓' ∈ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors (𝔮.map (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K))) := by
    change (↑Pf') ∈ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors (𝔮.map (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)))
    exact Pf'.prop
  have hnorm_red :
      UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors (Polynomial.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔮) (minpoly (𝓞 𝒟.L) iO)) =
        {Q} + {Q'} := by
    rw [hred, UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors_mul hQ_ne_zero hQ'_ne_zero,
      UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors_irreducible hQ_irreducible,
      UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors_irreducible hQ'_irreducible,
      Polynomial.Monic.normalize_eq_self hQ_monic,
      Polynomial.Monic.normalize_eq_self hQ'_monic]
  have hattach_red :
      (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors
        (Polynomial.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔮) (minpoly (𝓞 𝒟.L) iO))).attach =
        ({⟨Q, hQ_mem⟩} + {⟨Q', hQ'_mem⟩} :
          Multiset {d : Polynomial (𝓞 𝒟.L ⧸ 𝔮) |
            d ∈ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors
              (Polynomial.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔮) (minpoly (𝓞 𝒟.L) iO))}) := by
    apply (Multiset.map_injective (f := fun x :
      {d : Polynomial (𝓞 𝒟.L ⧸ 𝔮) |
        d ∈ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors
          (Polynomial.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔮) (minpoly (𝓞 𝒟.L) iO))} => x.1)
      Subtype.val_injective)
    change Multiset.map Subtype.val
        ((UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors
          (Polynomial.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔮) (minpoly (𝓞 𝒟.L) iO))).attach) =
      Multiset.map Subtype.val ({⟨Q, hQ_mem⟩} + {⟨Q', hQ'_mem⟩})
    simpa [Multiset.attach_map_val, Multiset.map_add, Multiset.map_singleton] using hnorm_red
  have hnorm_map :
      UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors (𝔮.map (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K))) =
        {𝔓} + {𝔓'} := by
    rw [KummerDedekind.normalizedFactors_ideal_map_eq_normalizedFactors_min_poly_mk_map
      (R := 𝓞 𝒟.L) (S := 𝓞 𝒟.K) (I := 𝔮) (x := iO)
      (show 𝔮.IsMaximal from inferInstance) _h𝔮ne hcond_sup hiOint,
      hattach_red,
      Multiset.map_add,
      Multiset.map_singleton,
      Multiset.map_singleton]
  have h𝔓_isPrime : 𝔓.IsPrime := (Ideal.mem_normalizedFactors_iff hqmap_ne).mp h𝔓_mem |>.1
  have h𝔓'_isPrime : 𝔓'.IsPrime := (Ideal.mem_normalizedFactors_iff hqmap_ne).mp h𝔓'_mem |>.1
  have hqmap_le_𝔓 : 𝔮.map (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)) ≤ 𝔓 :=
    (Ideal.mem_normalizedFactors_iff hqmap_ne).mp h𝔓_mem |>.2
  have hqmap_le_𝔓' : 𝔮.map (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)) ≤ 𝔓' :=
    (Ideal.mem_normalizedFactors_iff hqmap_ne).mp h𝔓'_mem |>.2
  have h𝔓_ne_bot : 𝔓 ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro h𝔓0
    have hle : 𝔮.map (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)) ≤ (⊥ : Ideal (𝓞 𝒟.K)) := by
      simpa [h𝔓0] using hqmap_le_𝔓
    exact hqmap_ne (le_antisymm hle bot_le)
  have h𝔓'_ne_bot : 𝔓' ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro h𝔓0
    have hle : 𝔮.map (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)) ≤ (⊥ : Ideal (𝓞 𝒟.K)) := by
      simpa [h𝔓0] using hqmap_le_𝔓'
    exact hqmap_ne (le_antisymm hle bot_le)
  have h𝔓_ne_𝔓' : 𝔓 ≠ 𝔓' := by
    intro hPP
    have hPf_eq : Pf = Pf' := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simpa [𝔓, 𝔓'] using hPP
    have hQQ' :
        (⟨Q, hQ_mem⟩ :
          {d : Polynomial (𝓞 𝒟.L ⧸ 𝔮) |
            d ∈ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors
              (Polynomial.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔮) (minpoly (𝓞 𝒟.L) iO))}) =
        ⟨Q', hQ'_mem⟩ := by
      simpa [Pf, Pf'] using congrArg e hPf_eq
    exact hQ_ne_Q' (congrArg Subtype.val hQQ')
  have hfac :
      𝔮.map (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)) = 𝔓 * 𝔓' := by
    calc
      𝔮.map (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)) =
          (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors
            (𝔮.map (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)))).prod := by
            symm
            exact prod_normalizedFactors_eq_self hqmap_ne
      _ = ({𝔓} + {𝔓'} : Multiset (Ideal (𝓞 𝒟.K))).prod := by
        rw [hnorm_map]
      _ = 𝔓 * 𝔓' := by simp
  exact ⟨𝔓, 𝔓', h𝔓_ne_𝔓', h𝔓_isPrime, h𝔓'_isPrime, h𝔓_ne_bot, h𝔓'_ne_bot, hfac⟩

name: q_splits_in_K_of_split_in_L_and_mod4
statement:
theorem q_splits_in_K_of_split_in_L_and_mod4 (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (b : Fin 𝒟.t) :
    (∀ 𝔓 ∈ (Ideal.span {((𝒟.q b : ℤ))} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 𝒟.K),
        Ideal.ramificationIdx
          (Ideal.span {((𝒟.q b : ℤ))} : Ideal ℤ) 𝔓 = 1 ∧
        Ideal.inertiaDeg
          (Ideal.span {((𝒟.q b : ℤ))} : Ideal ℤ) 𝔓 = 1) ∧
      ((Ideal.span {((𝒟.q b : ℤ))} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 𝒟.K)).ncard =
        Module.finrank ℚ 𝒟.K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let p : Ideal ℤ := Ideal.span {((𝒟.q b : ℤ))}
  have hqprime : Nat.Prime (𝒟.q b) := 𝒟.q_prime b
  have hqne0 : ((𝒟.q b : ℤ)) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast hqprime.ne_zero
  have hp0 : p ≠ ⊥ := by
    dsimp [p]
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]
    exact hqne0
  letI : Fact (Nat.Prime (𝒟.q b)) := ⟨hqprime⟩
  letI : p.IsMaximal := by
    dsimp [p]
    simpa using (Int.ideal_span_isMaximal_of_prime (𝒟.q b))
  rcases 𝒟.q_splits_in_L b with ⟨hLsplit, hLcard⟩
  have hsplitK : ∀ 𝔓 ∈ p.primesOver (𝓞 𝒟.K),
      Ideal.ramificationIdx p 𝔓 = 1 ∧ Ideal.inertiaDeg p 𝔓 = 1 := by
    intro 𝔓 h𝔓
    have h𝔓p : 𝔓.IsPrime := h𝔓.1
    have h𝔓over : 𝔓.LiesOver p := h𝔓.2
    let 𝔮 : Ideal (𝓞 𝒟.L) := 𝔓.under (𝓞 𝒟.L)
    have h𝔮p : 𝔮.IsPrime := by
      dsimp [𝔮]
      letI : 𝔓.IsPrime := h𝔓p
      exact Ideal.IsPrime.comap (f := algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K))
    have h𝔮_lies : 𝔮.LiesOver p := by
      dsimp [𝔮]
      letI : 𝔓.LiesOver p := h𝔓over
      exact Ideal.under_liesOver_of_liesOver (B := 𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝔓 := 𝔓) (p := p)
    have h𝔮over : 𝔮 ∈ p.primesOver (𝓞 𝒟.L) := by
      exact ⟨h𝔮p, h𝔮_lies⟩
    have h𝔮ne : 𝔮 ≠ ⊥ := by
      have h𝔮max : 𝔮.IsMaximal := Ideal.isMaximal_of_mem_primesOver h𝔮over
      exact Ring.ne_bot_of_isMaximal_of_not_isField h𝔮max
        (NumberField.RingOfIntegers.not_isField (K := 𝒟.L))
    have h𝔮e : Ideal.ramificationIdx p 𝔮 = 1 := (hLsplit 𝔮 h𝔮over).1
    have h𝔮f : Ideal.inertiaDeg p 𝔮 = 1 := (hLsplit 𝔮 h𝔮over).2
    letI : 𝔮.IsMaximal := Ideal.IsPrime.isMaximal h𝔮p h𝔮ne
    rcases q_splits_in_K_local 𝒟 b 𝔮 h𝔮p h𝔮ne h𝔮over with
      ⟨𝔓₁, 𝔓₂, hne, h𝔓₁p, h𝔓₂p, h𝔓₁ne, h𝔓₂ne, hmul⟩
    have h𝔓₁lies : 𝔓₁.LiesOver 𝔮 := by
      have hdiv : 𝔓₁ ∣ Ideal.map (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)) 𝔮 := by
        refine ⟨𝔓₂, ?_⟩
        simpa [hmul, Ideal.mul_comm]
      exact (Ideal.liesOver_iff_dvd_map (p := 𝔮) (P := 𝔓₁)
        (Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top h𝔓₁p)).2 hdiv
    have h𝔓₂lies : 𝔓₂.LiesOver 𝔮 := by
      have hdiv : 𝔓₂ ∣ Ideal.map (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)) 𝔮 := by
        refine ⟨𝔓₁, ?_⟩
        simpa [hmul, Ideal.mul_comm]
      exact (Ideal.liesOver_iff_dvd_map (p := 𝔮) (P := 𝔓₂)
        (Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top h𝔓₂p)).2 hdiv
    have h𝔓₁over : 𝔓₁ ∈ 𝔮.primesOver (𝓞 𝒟.K) := by
      exact ⟨h𝔓₁p, h𝔓₁lies⟩
    have h𝔓₂over : 𝔓₂ ∈ 𝔮.primesOver (𝓞 𝒟.K) := by
      exact ⟨h𝔓₂p, h𝔓₂lies⟩
    have h_nontriv : (𝔮.primesOver (𝓞 𝒟.K)).Nontrivial := by
      exact ⟨𝔓₁, h𝔓₁over, 𝔓₂, h𝔓₂over, hne⟩
    have h_two_le : 2 ≤ (𝔮.primesOver (𝓞 𝒟.K)).ncard := by
      have h_one_lt : 1 < (𝔮.primesOver (𝓞 𝒟.K)).ncard := by
        exact (Set.one_lt_ncard_iff_nontrivial).2 h_nontriv
      omega
    letI : IsGalois 𝒟.L 𝒟.K :=
      Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension.isGalois (F := 𝒟.L) (K := 𝒟.K)
    have hcount_mul :
        (𝔮.primesOver (𝓞 𝒟.K)).ncard *
            (Ideal.ramificationIdxIn 𝔮 (𝓞 𝒟.K) * Ideal.inertiaDegIn 𝔮 (𝓞 𝒟.K)) =
          Nat.card (𝒟.K ≃ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K) := by
      exact Ideal.ncard_primesOver_mul_ramificationIdxIn_mul_inertiaDegIn
        (p := 𝔮) (B := 𝓞 𝒟.K) (G := 𝒟.K ≃ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K) h𝔮ne
    have hcard_gal : Nat.card (𝒟.K ≃ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K) = Module.finrank 𝒟.L 𝒟.K := by
      simpa using (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank (F := 𝒟.L) (E := 𝒟.K))
    have hcount_mul' :
        (𝔮.primesOver (𝓞 𝒟.K)).ncard *
            (Ideal.ramificationIdxIn 𝔮 (𝓞 𝒟.K) * Ideal.inertiaDegIn 𝔮 (𝓞 𝒟.K)) = 2 := by
      rw [hcard_gal, Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension.finrank_eq_two] at hcount_mul
      exact hcount_mul
    have hram_in_ne : Ideal.ramificationIdxIn 𝔮 (𝓞 𝒟.K) ≠ 0 := by
      exact Ideal.ramificationIdxIn_ne_zero
        (G := 𝒟.K ≃ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K) (p := 𝔮) (B := 𝓞 𝒟.K) h𝔮ne
    have hiner_in_ne : Ideal.inertiaDegIn 𝔮 (𝓞 𝒟.K) ≠ 0 := by
      exact Ideal.inertiaDegIn_ne_zero
        (G := 𝒟.K ≃ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K) (p := 𝔮) (B := 𝓞 𝒟.K)
    set m : ℕ :=
      Ideal.ramificationIdxIn 𝔮 (𝓞 𝒟.K) * Ideal.inertiaDegIn 𝔮 (𝓞 𝒟.K)
    have hm_pos : 0 < m := by
      dsimp [m]
      exact Nat.mul_pos (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hram_in_ne) (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hiner_in_ne)
    have hm_le_one : m ≤ 1 := by
      have hmul_le : 2 * m ≤ (𝔮.primesOver (𝓞 𝒟.K)).ncard * m := by
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right m h_two_le
      rw [hcount_mul'] at hmul_le
      omega
    have hm_eq_one : m = 1 := by
      omega
    have hram_in_eq : Ideal.ramificationIdxIn 𝔮 (𝓞 𝒟.K) = 1 := by
      apply Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_one
      rw [← hm_eq_one]
      dsimp [m]
      exact dvd_mul_right _ _
    have hiner_in_eq : Ideal.inertiaDegIn 𝔮 (𝓞 𝒟.K) = 1 := by
      apply Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_one
      rw [← hm_eq_one]
      dsimp [m]
      exact dvd_mul_left _ _
    have h𝔓over𝔮 : 𝔓.LiesOver 𝔮 := by
      dsimp [𝔮]
      exact Ideal.over_under (A := 𝓞 𝒟.L) (P := 𝔓)
    have hrel_e : Ideal.ramificationIdx 𝔮 𝔓 = 1 := by
      letI : 𝔓.IsPrime := h𝔓p
      letI : 𝔓.LiesOver 𝔮 := h𝔓over𝔮
      calc
        Ideal.ramificationIdx 𝔮 𝔓 = Ideal.ramificationIdxIn 𝔮 (𝓞 𝒟.K) := by
          symm
          exact Ideal.ramificationIdxIn_eq_ramificationIdx
            (p := 𝔮) (P := 𝔓) (G := 𝒟.K ≃ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K)
        _ = 1 := hram_in_eq
    have hrel_f : Ideal.inertiaDeg 𝔮 𝔓 = 1 := by
      letI : 𝔓.IsPrime := h𝔓p
      letI : 𝔓.LiesOver 𝔮 := h𝔓over𝔮
      calc
        Ideal.inertiaDeg 𝔮 𝔓 = Ideal.inertiaDegIn 𝔮 (𝓞 𝒟.K) := by
          symm
          exact Ideal.inertiaDegIn_eq_inertiaDeg
            (p := 𝔮) (P := 𝔓) (G := 𝒟.K ≃ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K)
        _ = 1 := hiner_in_eq
    have hmap𝔮_ne : Ideal.map (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)) 𝔮 ≠ ⊥ := by
      exact Ideal.map_ne_bot_of_ne_bot (I := 𝔮) h𝔮ne
    have hpmap_ne : Ideal.map (algebraMap ℤ (𝓞 𝒟.K)) p ≠ ⊥ := by
      exact Ideal.map_ne_bot_of_ne_bot (I := p) hp0
    have hmap_le : Ideal.map (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)) 𝔮 ≤ 𝔓 := by
      have hdivP : 𝔓 ∣ Ideal.map (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.L) (𝓞 𝒟.K)) 𝔮 :=
        (Ideal.liesOver_iff_dvd_map (p := 𝔮) (P := 𝔓) (Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top h𝔓p)).1
          h𝔓over𝔮
      rcases hdivP with ⟨I, hI⟩
      rw [hI]
      simpa [Ideal.mul_comm] using (Ideal.mul_le_left : I * 𝔓 ≤ 𝔓)
    have habs_e : Ideal.ramificationIdx p 𝔓 = 1 := by
      letI : 𝔓.IsPrime := h𝔓p
      calc
        Ideal.ramificationIdx p 𝔓 =
            Ideal.ramificationIdx p 𝔮 * Ideal.ramificationIdx 𝔮 𝔓 := by
          exact Ideal.ramificationIdx_algebra_tower
            (R := ℤ) (S := 𝓞 𝒟.L) (T := 𝓞 𝒟.K)
            (p := p) (P := 𝔮) (Q := 𝔓) hmap𝔮_ne hpmap_ne hmap_le
        _ = 1 := by rw [h𝔮e, hrel_e]
    have habs_f : Ideal.inertiaDeg p 𝔓 = 1 := by
      letI : 𝔓.LiesOver 𝔮 := h𝔓over𝔮
      calc
        Ideal.inertiaDeg p 𝔓 = Ideal.inertiaDeg p 𝔮 * Ideal.inertiaDeg 𝔮 𝔓 := by
          exact Ideal.inertiaDeg_algebra_tower
            (R := ℤ) (S := 𝓞 𝒟.L) (T := 𝓞 𝒟.K) p 𝔮 𝔓
        _ = 1 := by rw [h𝔮f, hrel_f]
    exact ⟨habs_e, habs_f⟩
  refine ⟨hsplitK, ?_⟩
  have hsummand : ∀ 𝔓 ∈ primesOverFinset p (𝓞 𝒟.K),
      Ideal.ramificationIdx p 𝔓 * Ideal.inertiaDeg p 𝔓 = 1 := by
    intro 𝔓 h𝔓
    have h𝔓set : 𝔓 ∈ ((primesOverFinset p (𝓞 𝒟.K) : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 𝒟.K))) : Set (Ideal (𝓞 𝒟.K))) := by
      exact h𝔓
    rw [coe_primesOverFinset (p := p) hp0 (B := 𝓞 𝒟.K)] at h𝔓set
    rcases hsplitK 𝔓 h𝔓set with ⟨h𝔓e, h𝔓f⟩
    rw [h𝔓e, h𝔓f]
  have hsum :
      ∑ 𝔓 ∈ primesOverFinset p (𝓞 𝒟.K),
        Ideal.ramificationIdx p 𝔓 * Ideal.inertiaDeg p 𝔓 = Module.finrank ℚ 𝒟.K := by
    exact Ideal.sum_ramification_inertia (S := 𝓞 𝒟.K) (K := ℚ) (L := 𝒟.K) (p := p) hp0
  have hcard_finset : (primesOverFinset p (𝓞 𝒟.K)).card = Module.finrank ℚ 𝒟.K := by
    calc
      (primesOverFinset p (𝓞 𝒟.K)).card =
          ∑ 𝔓 ∈ primesOverFinset p (𝓞 𝒟.K), 1 := by
        exact Finset.card_eq_sum_ones _
      _ = ∑ 𝔓 ∈ primesOverFinset p (𝓞 𝒟.K),
            Ideal.ramificationIdx p 𝔓 * Ideal.inertiaDeg p 𝔓 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
        intro 𝔓 h𝔓
        symm
        exact hsummand 𝔓 h𝔓
      _ = Module.finrank ℚ 𝒟.K := hsum
  calc
    (p.primesOver (𝓞 𝒟.K)).ncard = ((primesOverFinset p (𝓞 𝒟.K) : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 𝒟.K))) : Set (Ideal (𝓞 𝒟.K))).ncard := by
      rw [← coe_primesOverFinset (p := p) hp0 (B := 𝓞 𝒟.K)]
    _ = (primesOverFinset p (𝓞 𝒟.K)).card := Set.ncard_coe_finset _
    _ = Module.finrank ℚ 𝒟.K := hcard_finset

name: rootDiscr_eq_of_everywhereUnramified
statement:
theorem rootDiscr_eq_of_everywhereUnramified (F L : Type) [Field F] [Field L] [NumberField F] [NumberField L]
    [Algebra F L] (_hunr : IsEverywhereUnramified F L) :
    NumberField.rootDiscr L = NumberField.rootDiscr F
proof:
:= by
  have hdisc_nat := IsEverywhereUnramified.discr_eq _hunr
  have hdisc : ((|NumberField.discr L| : ℤ) : ℝ) = (((|NumberField.discr F| : ℤ) : ℝ) ^ Module.finrank F L) := by
    calc
      ((|NumberField.discr L| : ℤ) : ℝ) = ((NumberField.discr L).natAbs : ℝ) := by
        rw [Nat.cast_natAbs]
      _ = (((NumberField.discr F).natAbs : ℝ) ^ Module.finrank F L) := by
        exact_mod_cast hdisc_nat
      _ = (((|NumberField.discr F| : ℤ) : ℝ) ^ Module.finrank F L) := by
        rw [Nat.cast_natAbs]
  rw [NumberField.rootDiscr_def, NumberField.rootDiscr_def, hdisc]
  rw [← Real.rpow_natCast_mul (by positivity : 0 ≤ ((|NumberField.discr F| : ℤ) : ℝ))]
  congr 1
  have hmul : (Module.finrank ℚ F : ℝ) * Module.finrank F L = Module.finrank ℚ L := by
    exact_mod_cast Module.finrank_mul_finrank ℚ F L
  have hF : (Module.finrank ℚ F : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (Module.finrank_pos : 0 < Module.finrank ℚ F))
  have hFL : (Module.finrank F L : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (Module.finrank_pos : 0 < Module.finrank F L))
  calc
    (Module.finrank F L : ℝ) * (Module.finrank ℚ L : ℝ)⁻¹ = (Module.finrank F L : ℝ) / Module.finrank ℚ L := by
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    _ = (Module.finrank F L : ℝ) / ((Module.finrank ℚ F : ℝ) * Module.finrank F L) := by
      rw [← hmul]
    _ = (Module.finrank ℚ F : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      field_simp [hF, hFL]

name: totallyReal_of_odd_p_unramified
statement:
theorem totallyReal_of_odd_p_unramified (F L : Type) [Field F] [Field L] [NumberField F] [NumberField L]
    [IsTotallyReal F] [Algebra F L] [IsGalois F L]
    (p : ℕ) (_hp : p.Prime) (_hp_odd : p ≠ 2)
    (_hunr : IsEverywhereUnramified F L)
    (_hPGroup : IsPGroup p (L ≃ₐ[F] L)) :
    IsTotallyReal L
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  intro w
  let v : NumberField.InfinitePlace F := w.comap (algebraMap F L)
  have hv : v.IsReal := IsTotallyReal.isReal v
  exact IsEverywhereUnramified.real_lifts_real _hunr v hv w rfl

name: rootDiscr_log_eq
statement:
theorem rootDiscr_log_eq (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] :
    Real.log (NumberField.rootDiscr K) =
      Real.log ((NumberField.discr K).natAbs : ℝ) / Module.finrank ℚ K
proof:
:= by
  rw [NumberField.rootDiscr_def, Nat.cast_natAbs]
  have hdiscr : 0 < (↑|NumberField.discr K| : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (abs_pos.mpr (NumberField.discr_ne_zero (K := K)))
  rw [Real.log_rpow hdiscr]
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

name: main_theorem_proved
statement:
theorem main_theorem_proved
    (hFG : Hyp_FiniteTopologicalRank)
    (hGSI : Hyp_GolodShafarevichInequality)
    (hSRR : Hyp_ShafarevichRelationRankBound)
    (h5term : Hyp_FiveTermRelationBound)
    (hBurnside : Hyp_NormallyGenH1InvariantBound) :
    ∃ δ > (0 : ℝ),
      {n : ℕ | 0 < n ∧ (νn n : ℝ) ≥ (n : ℝ) ^ (1 + δ)}.Infinite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ℓ₀, _C_rd, _C_H, _hC_rd, _hC_H, h⟩ :=
    proposition_3_8 hFG hGSI hSRR h5term hBurnside
  obtain ⟨T, _, _, _⟩ := h ℓ₀ le_rfl
  have ht_pos : 0 < T.t := by
    have := (T.𝒟 0).t_pos
    rw [T.sameT 0] at this
    exact this
  have hdegs : ∀ N, ∃ j, N ≤ (T.𝒟 j).f := by
    intro N
    have := (Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop.mp T.deg_tendsto_atTop) N
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := this
    exact ⟨i, hi i le_rfl⟩
  exact theorem_2_3 T.t ht_pos T.q T.𝒟 T.sameT T.sameQ T.H
    (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one T.H_pos) T.class_bound hdegs T.γ_pos

name: f_pos
statement: theorem f_pos : 0 < 𝒟.f
proof: := Module.finrank_pos

name: nontrivial_aut_exists
statement:
private theorem nontrivial_aut_exists :
    ∃ σ : 𝒟.K ≃ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K, σ ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : Nat.card (𝒟.K ≃ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K) = 2 := by
    rw [IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank,
      Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension.finrank_eq_two]
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  have hsub : Subsingleton (𝒟.K ≃ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K) :=
    ⟨fun a b => by rw [h a, h b]⟩
  have hone : Nat.card (𝒟.K ≃ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K) = 1 :=
    Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.mpr ⟨hsub, ⟨1⟩⟩
  omega

name: c_ne_one
statement: theorem c_ne_one : 𝒟.c ≠ 1
proof:
:=
  (nontrivial_aut_exists 𝒟).choose_spec

name: i_K_notMem_range
statement:
theorem i_K_notMem_range :
    𝒟.i_K ∉ (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K).range
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨a, ha⟩

  have ha2 : a * a = -1 := by
    have h : (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K) (a * a) = (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K) (-1) := by
      rw [map_mul, ha, 𝒟.i_K_sq, map_neg, map_one]
    exact FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective 𝒟.L 𝒟.K h

  obtain ⟨φ⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (𝒟.L →+* ℂ))
  have hφ : ComplexEmbedding.IsReal φ :=
    NumberField.IsTotallyReal.complexEmbedding_isReal φ
  let ψ : 𝒟.L →+* ℝ := hφ.embedding
  have hψ : (ψ a) * (ψ a) = -1 := by
    have h := congrArg ψ ha2
    simpa [map_mul, map_neg, map_one] using h

  have hnn : 0 ≤ ψ a * ψ a := mul_self_nonneg _
  linarith

name: adjoin_i_K_eq_top
statement:
theorem adjoin_i_K_eq_top :
    Algebra.adjoin 𝒟.L ({𝒟.i_K} : Set 𝒟.K) = ⊤
proof:
:= by

  have hprime : (Module.finrank 𝒟.L 𝒟.K).Prime := by
    rw [Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension.finrank_eq_two]
    exact Nat.prime_two
  have hsimple : IsSimpleOrder (Subalgebra 𝒟.L 𝒟.K) :=
    Subalgebra.isSimpleOrder_of_finrank_prime 𝒟.L 𝒟.K hprime
  rcases hsimple.eq_bot_or_eq_top (Algebra.adjoin 𝒟.L ({𝒟.i_K} : Set 𝒟.K))
    with hbot | htop
  · exfalso
    apply 𝒟.i_K_notMem_range
    have hmem : 𝒟.i_K ∈ (⊥ : Subalgebra 𝒟.L 𝒟.K) := by
      rw [← hbot]
      exact Algebra.self_mem_adjoin_singleton 𝒟.L 𝒟.i_K
    exact Algebra.mem_bot.mp hmem
  · exact htop

name: c_i_K
statement: theorem c_i_K : 𝒟.c 𝒟.i_K = -𝒟.i_K
proof:
:= by

  have h_sq : 𝒟.c 𝒟.i_K * 𝒟.c 𝒟.i_K = -1 := by
    have h1 : 𝒟.c (𝒟.i_K * 𝒟.i_K) = 𝒟.c (-1) := by rw [𝒟.i_K_sq]
    rw [map_mul, map_neg, map_one] at h1
    exact h1

  have hprod : (𝒟.c 𝒟.i_K - 𝒟.i_K) * (𝒟.c 𝒟.i_K + 𝒟.i_K) = 0 := by
    have : (𝒟.c 𝒟.i_K - 𝒟.i_K) * (𝒟.c 𝒟.i_K + 𝒟.i_K)
        = 𝒟.c 𝒟.i_K * 𝒟.c 𝒟.i_K - 𝒟.i_K * 𝒟.i_K := by ring
    rw [this, h_sq, 𝒟.i_K_sq, sub_self]

  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hprod with h | h
  ·

    exfalso
    apply 𝒟.c_ne_one
    have hfix : 𝒟.c 𝒟.i_K = 𝒟.i_K := sub_eq_zero.mp h

    have hext : (𝒟.c : 𝒟.K →ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K) = AlgHom.id 𝒟.L 𝒟.K := by
      refine AlgHom.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top (𝒟.adjoin_i_K_eq_top) ?_
      intro y hy
      simp [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hy, hfix]

    ext x
    have hx := AlgHom.congr_fun hext x
    simpa using hx
  · exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h

name: c_sq_eq_id
statement: theorem c_sq_eq_id (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (x : 𝒟.K) : 𝒟.c (𝒟.c x) = x
proof:
:= by

  have hext : (𝒟.c : 𝒟.K →ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K).comp (𝒟.c : 𝒟.K →ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K)
      = AlgHom.id 𝒟.L 𝒟.K := by
    refine AlgHom.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top (𝒟.adjoin_i_K_eq_top) ?_
    intro y hy
    have hy_eq : y = 𝒟.i_K := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hy
    subst hy_eq
    simp [𝒟.c_i_K, map_neg]
  have := AlgHom.congr_fun hext x
  simpa using this

name: complex_embedding_conjugation_compat
statement:
theorem complex_embedding_conjugation_compat
    (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (σ : 𝒟.K →+* ℂ) (x : 𝒟.K) :
    σ (𝒟.c x) = star (σ x)
proof:
:= by
  let ψ : 𝒟.L →+* ℂ := σ.comp (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K)
  have hψ_real : ComplexEmbedding.IsReal ψ :=
    NumberField.IsTotallyReal.complexEmbedding_isReal ψ
  letI : Algebra 𝒟.L ℂ := ψ.toAlgebra
  let σcA : 𝒟.K →ₐ[𝒟.L] ℂ :=
    { σ.comp (𝒟.c : 𝒟.K →+* 𝒟.K) with
      commutes' := fun r => by
        change σ ((𝒟.c : 𝒟.K →+* 𝒟.K) (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K r)) = ψ r
        rw [show (𝒟.c : 𝒟.K →+* 𝒟.K) (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K r)
              = algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K r from AlgEquiv.commutes _ _]
        rfl }
  let σstarA : 𝒟.K →ₐ[𝒟.L] ℂ :=
    { (starRingEnd ℂ).comp σ with
      commutes' := fun r => by
        change star (ψ r) = ψ r
        exact RingHom.congr_fun hψ_real r }
  suffices h : σcA = σstarA by
    have := AlgHom.congr_fun h x
    change σ (𝒟.c x) = star (σ x)
    exact this
  refine AlgHom.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top 𝒟.adjoin_i_K_eq_top ?_
  intro y hy
  rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
  subst hy
  change σ (𝒟.c 𝒟.i_K) = star (σ 𝒟.i_K)
  rw [𝒟.c_i_K, map_neg]
  have hsq : σ 𝒟.i_K * σ 𝒟.i_K = -1 := by
    have := congrArg σ 𝒟.i_K_sq
    rw [map_mul, map_neg, map_one] at this
    exact this
  have hre : (σ 𝒟.i_K).re = 0 := by
    have hreal : (σ 𝒟.i_K * σ 𝒟.i_K).im = 0 := by rw [hsq]; simp
    have hreal' : (σ 𝒟.i_K * σ 𝒟.i_K).re = -1 := by rw [hsq]; simp
    have him_eq : (σ 𝒟.i_K * σ 𝒟.i_K).im = 2 * (σ 𝒟.i_K).re * (σ 𝒟.i_K).im := by
      simp [Complex.mul_im]; ring
    rw [him_eq] at hreal
    have h2 : (σ 𝒟.i_K).re * (σ 𝒟.i_K).im = 0 := by linarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h2 with hre0 | him0
    · exact hre0
    · exfalso
      have hreal_re : (σ 𝒟.i_K * σ 𝒟.i_K).re =
          (σ 𝒟.i_K).re * (σ 𝒟.i_K).re - (σ 𝒟.i_K).im * (σ 𝒟.i_K).im := by
        simp [Complex.mul_re]
      rw [hreal_re, him0] at hreal'
      have : (σ 𝒟.i_K).re * (σ 𝒟.i_K).re = -1 := by linarith
      have hnn : 0 ≤ (σ 𝒟.i_K).re * (σ 𝒟.i_K).re := mul_self_nonneg _
      linarith
  apply Complex.ext
  · simp [hre]
  · simp

name: relNorm_mem_L
statement:
theorem relNorm_mem_L (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (u : 𝒟.K) :
    𝒟.relNorm u ∈ (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K).range
proof:
:= by

  have hc_sq : ∀ x : 𝒟.K, 𝒟.c (𝒟.c x) = x := by
    have hext : (𝒟.c : 𝒟.K →ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K).comp (𝒟.c : 𝒟.K →ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K)
        = AlgHom.id 𝒟.L 𝒟.K := by
      refine AlgHom.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top (𝒟.adjoin_i_K_eq_top) ?_
      intro y hy
      have hy_eq : y = 𝒟.i_K := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hy
      subst hy_eq
      simp [𝒟.c_i_K, map_neg]
    intro x
    have hx := AlgHom.congr_fun hext x
    simpa using hx

  have hfix_c : 𝒟.c (𝒟.relNorm u) = 𝒟.relNorm u := by
    unfold AdmissibleDatum.relNorm
    rw [map_mul, hc_sq u, mul_comm]

  have hfix : ∀ σ : 𝒟.K ≃ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K, σ (𝒟.relNorm u) = 𝒟.relNorm u := by
    intro σ
    have hσ_sq : σ 𝒟.i_K * σ 𝒟.i_K = -1 := by
      have h1 : σ (𝒟.i_K * 𝒟.i_K) = σ (-1) := by rw [𝒟.i_K_sq]
      rw [map_mul, map_neg, map_one] at h1; exact h1
    have hprod : (σ 𝒟.i_K - 𝒟.i_K) * (σ 𝒟.i_K + 𝒟.i_K) = 0 := by
      have : (σ 𝒟.i_K - 𝒟.i_K) * (σ 𝒟.i_K + 𝒟.i_K) =
          σ 𝒟.i_K * σ 𝒟.i_K - 𝒟.i_K * 𝒟.i_K := by ring
      rw [this, hσ_sq, 𝒟.i_K_sq, sub_self]
    have hσ_cases : σ 𝒟.i_K = 𝒟.i_K ∨ σ 𝒟.i_K = -𝒟.i_K := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hprod with h | h
      · exact Or.inl (sub_eq_zero.mp h)
      · exact Or.inr (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h)

    have hσ_eq : σ = 1 ∨ σ = 𝒟.c := by
      rcases hσ_cases with hid | hc
      · left
        have hext : (σ : 𝒟.K →ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K) = AlgHom.id 𝒟.L 𝒟.K := by
          refine AlgHom.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top (𝒟.adjoin_i_K_eq_top) ?_
          intro y hy
          have : y = 𝒟.i_K := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hy
          subst this; simpa using hid
        ext x
        have := AlgHom.congr_fun hext x
        simpa using this
      · right
        have hext : (σ : 𝒟.K →ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K) = (𝒟.c : 𝒟.K →ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K) := by
          refine AlgHom.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top (𝒟.adjoin_i_K_eq_top) ?_
          intro y hy
          have hy_eq : y = 𝒟.i_K := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hy
          subst hy_eq
          change σ 𝒟.i_K = 𝒟.c 𝒟.i_K
          rw [hc, 𝒟.c_i_K]
        ext x
        have := AlgHom.congr_fun hext x
        simpa using this
    rcases hσ_eq with h1 | hc
    · rw [h1]; rfl
    · rw [hc]; exact hfix_c

  rw [RingHom.mem_range]
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (IsGalois.mem_range_algebraMap_iff_fixed
    (F := 𝒟.L) (E := 𝒟.K) (𝒟.relNorm u)).mpr hfix
  exact ⟨a, ha⟩

name: adm_real_embedding_injective
statement: theorem adm_real_embedding_injective (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) : Function.Injective (adm_real_embedding 𝒟)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h
  let e : Fin (Module.finrank ℚ 𝒟.L) ≃ NumberField.InfinitePlace 𝒟.L :=
    Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq
      (by
        classical
        have hfr := (NumberField.IsTotallyReal.finrank (K := 𝒟.L)).symm
        have hreal : ∀ w : NumberField.InfinitePlace 𝒟.L,
            NumberField.InfinitePlace.IsReal w :=
          fun w => NumberField.IsTotallyReal.isReal w
        have hcard : Fintype.card (NumberField.InfinitePlace 𝒟.L) =
            NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrRealPlaces 𝒟.L :=
          Fintype.card_congr
            (Equiv.subtypeUnivEquiv hreal).symm
        rw [hcard, ← hfr]) |>.symm
  change (e i).embedding = (e j).embedding at h
  exact e.injective (NumberField.InfinitePlace.embedding_inj.mp h)

name: adm_
statement: theorem adm_σ_comp_algebraMap (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (i : Fin 𝒟.f) : (adm_σ 𝒟 i).comp (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K) = adm_real_embedding 𝒟 i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa [adm_σ, adm_real_embedding, NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.lift] using
    (NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.lift_comp_algebraMap (K := 𝒟.K) (k := 𝒟.L)
      (φ := adm_real_embedding 𝒟 i))

name: adm_
statement:
theorem adm_σ_restrict_distinct (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) :
    ∀ i j : Fin 𝒟.f, i ≠ j →
      (adm_σ 𝒟 i).comp (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K) ≠
      (adm_σ 𝒟 j).comp (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij hEq
  rw [adm_σ_comp_algebraMap (𝒟 := 𝒟) i, adm_σ_comp_algebraMap (𝒟 := 𝒟) j] at hEq
  exact hij ((adm_real_embedding_injective 𝒟) hEq)

name: LambdaIntegral_discreteTopology
statement: theorem LambdaIntegral_discreteTopology (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) : DiscreteTopology 𝒟.LambdaIntegral
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hall_nonreal : ∀ φ : 𝒟.K →+* ℂ, ¬ NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.IsReal φ := by
    intro φ hreal
    let ψ : 𝒟.K →+* ℝ := hreal.embedding
    have hψ : ψ 𝒟.i_K * ψ 𝒟.i_K = -1 := by
      have h := congrArg ψ 𝒟.i_K_sq
      simpa [map_mul, map_neg, map_one] using h
    have hnn : 0 ≤ ψ 𝒟.i_K * ψ 𝒟.i_K := mul_self_nonneg _
    linarith
  have hno_real : IsEmpty {w : NumberField.InfinitePlace 𝒟.K // w.IsReal} := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    intro w
    exact hall_nonreal w.1.embedding ((NumberField.InfinitePlace.isReal_iff).mp w.2)
  have hcard_complex : Fintype.card {w : NumberField.InfinitePlace 𝒟.K // w.IsComplex} = 𝒟.f := by
    letI : IsEmpty {w : NumberField.InfinitePlace 𝒟.K // w.IsReal} := hno_real
    letI : Algebra ℚ 𝒟.K := DivisionRing.toRatAlgebra
    have hnrreal : NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrRealPlaces 𝒟.K = 0 := by
      simp [NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrRealPlaces]
    have hfinrank : Module.finrank ℚ 𝒟.K = 2 * 𝒟.f := by
      calc
        Module.finrank ℚ 𝒟.K = Module.finrank ℚ 𝒟.L * Module.finrank 𝒟.L 𝒟.K := by
          symm
          exact Module.finrank_mul_finrank ℚ 𝒟.L 𝒟.K
        _ = 𝒟.f * 2 := by rw [AdmissibleDatum.f, Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension.finrank_eq_two 𝒟.L 𝒟.K]
        _ = 2 * 𝒟.f := by ring
    have hsig := NumberField.InfinitePlace.card_add_two_mul_card_eq_rank (K := 𝒟.K)
    have hsig0 : 2 * Fintype.card {w : NumberField.InfinitePlace 𝒟.K // w.IsComplex} = Module.finrank ℚ 𝒟.K := by
      simpa [hnrreal, NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces] using hsig
    rw [hfinrank] at hsig0
    omega
  let σToPlace : Fin 𝒟.f → {w : NumberField.InfinitePlace 𝒟.K // w.IsComplex} :=
    fun i => NumberField.InfinitePlace.mkComplex ⟨adm_σ 𝒟 i, hall_nonreal (adm_σ 𝒟 i)⟩
  have hσinj : Function.Injective σToPlace := by
    intro i j hij
    by_contra hne
    have hij' : (σToPlace i : NumberField.InfinitePlace 𝒟.K) = σToPlace j := congrArg Subtype.val hij
    simp only [σToPlace, NumberField.InfinitePlace.mkComplex_coe] at hij'
    rw [NumberField.InfinitePlace.mk_eq_iff] at hij'
    have hrext :
        (adm_σ 𝒟 i).comp (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K) =
          (adm_σ 𝒟 j).comp (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K) := by
      rcases hij' with h | h
      · exact congrArg (fun φ => φ.comp (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K)) h
      · have hreal_restrict : NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.IsReal ((adm_σ 𝒟 i).comp (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K)) :=
          NumberField.IsTotallyReal.complexEmbedding_isReal _
        have hconj_restrict :
            NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.conjugate ((adm_σ 𝒟 i).comp (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K)) =
              (adm_σ 𝒟 i).comp (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K) :=
          (NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.isReal_iff).mp hreal_restrict
        have hconjcomp :
            NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.conjugate ((adm_σ 𝒟 i).comp (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K)) =
              (adm_σ 𝒟 j).comp (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K) := by
          calc
            NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.conjugate ((adm_σ 𝒟 i).comp (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K)) =
                (NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.conjugate (adm_σ 𝒟 i)).comp (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K) := by
                  symm
                  exact NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.conjugate_comp (adm_σ 𝒟 i) (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K)
            _ = (adm_σ 𝒟 j).comp (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K) := by rw [h]
        exact hconj_restrict.symm.trans hconjcomp
    exact (𝒟.adm_σ_restrict_distinct i j hne) hrext
  let eσ : Fin 𝒟.f ≃ {w : NumberField.InfinitePlace 𝒟.K // w.IsComplex} :=
    Equiv.ofBijective σToPlace ((Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card σToPlace).2 ⟨hσinj, by simpa using hcard_complex.symm⟩)
  let coordEquiv : {w : NumberField.InfinitePlace 𝒟.K // w.IsComplex} → ℂ ≃L[ℝ] ℂ := fun w =>
    if h : w.1.embedding = adm_σ 𝒟 (eσ.symm w) then ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ ℂ else Complex.conjCLE
  let complexReindex : 𝒟.V ≃L[ℝ] ({w : NumberField.InfinitePlace 𝒟.K // w.IsComplex} → ℂ) :=
    (ContinuousLinearEquiv.piCongrLeft ℝ (fun _ : {w : NumberField.InfinitePlace 𝒟.K // w.IsComplex} => ℂ) eσ).trans
      (ContinuousLinearEquiv.piCongrRight coordEquiv)
  letI : IsEmpty {w : NumberField.InfinitePlace 𝒟.K // w.IsReal} := hno_real
  let reindexComplex : 𝒟.V ≃L[ℝ] NumberField.mixedEmbedding.mixedSpace 𝒟.K :=
    complexReindex.trans
      (ContinuousLinearEquiv.uniqueProd ℝ ({w : NumberField.InfinitePlace 𝒟.K // w.IsComplex} → ℂ)
        ({w : NumberField.InfinitePlace 𝒟.K // w.IsReal} → ℝ)).symm
  have hreindex_apply (x : 𝒟.K) : reindexComplex (𝒟.Φ x) = NumberField.mixedEmbedding 𝒟.K x := by
    ext w
    · cases hno_real.false w
    · simp [reindexComplex, complexReindex]
      have hpi := Equiv.piCongrLeft_apply (P := fun _ : {w : NumberField.InfinitePlace 𝒟.K // w.IsComplex} => ℂ) eσ (𝒟.Φ x) w
      have hpi' :
          ((ContinuousLinearEquiv.piCongrLeft ℝ (fun _ : {w : NumberField.InfinitePlace 𝒟.K // w.IsComplex} => ℂ) eσ)
            (𝒟.Φ x) w) = (𝒟.Φ x) (eσ.symm w) := by
        simpa [ContinuousLinearEquiv.piCongrLeft] using hpi
      rw [hpi']
      have hwplace_sub : σToPlace (eσ.symm w) = w := by
        exact eσ.apply_symm_apply w
      have hwplace :
          (NumberField.InfinitePlace.mkComplex ⟨adm_σ 𝒟 (eσ.symm w), hall_nonreal (adm_σ 𝒟 (eσ.symm w))⟩ :
            NumberField.InfinitePlace 𝒟.K) = w.1 := by
        exact congrArg Subtype.val hwplace_sub
      have hwemb : adm_σ 𝒟 (eσ.symm w) = w.1.embedding ∨
          NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.conjugate (adm_σ 𝒟 (eσ.symm w)) = w.1.embedding := by
        have hwplace' : NumberField.InfinitePlace.mk (adm_σ 𝒟 (eσ.symm w)) = NumberField.InfinitePlace.mk w.1.embedding := by
          simpa [σToPlace, NumberField.InfinitePlace.mkComplex_coe, NumberField.InfinitePlace.mk_embedding] using hwplace
        simpa using (NumberField.InfinitePlace.mk_eq_iff.mp hwplace')
      rcases hwemb with h | h
      · simp [coordEquiv, h, AdmissibleDatum.Φ]
      · have hne : ¬ w.1.embedding = adm_σ 𝒟 (eσ.symm w) := by
          intro hw
          have hreal : NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.IsReal (adm_σ 𝒟 (eσ.symm w)) := by
            rw [NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.isReal_iff]
            exact h.trans hw
          exact hall_nonreal (adm_σ 𝒟 (eσ.symm w)) hreal
        have hx : NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.conjugate (adm_σ 𝒟 (eσ.symm w)) x = w.1.embedding x := by
          exact RingHom.congr_fun h x
        simpa [coordEquiv, hne, AdmissibleDatum.Φ, NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.conjugate, Complex.conjCLE_apply] using hx
  have hLambda :
      𝒟.LambdaIntegral =
        ZLattice.comap ℝ (NumberField.mixedEmbedding.integerLattice 𝒟.K) reindexComplex.toLinearMap := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      change reindexComplex (𝒟.Φ (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.K) 𝒟.K x)) ∈ NumberField.mixedEmbedding.integerLattice 𝒟.K
      rw [hreindex_apply]
      change NumberField.mixedEmbedding 𝒟.K (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.K) 𝒟.K x) ∈
        LinearMap.range (((NumberField.mixedEmbedding 𝒟.K).comp (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.K) 𝒟.K)).toIntAlgHom.toLinearMap)
      exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
    · intro hz
      change reindexComplex z ∈ NumberField.mixedEmbedding.integerLattice 𝒟.K at hz
      change reindexComplex z ∈
        LinearMap.range (((NumberField.mixedEmbedding 𝒟.K).comp (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.K) 𝒟.K)).toIntAlgHom.toLinearMap) at hz
      rcases hz with ⟨x, hx⟩
      refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
      apply reindexComplex.injective
      rw [hreindex_apply]
      simpa using hx
  rw [hLambda]
  infer_instance

name: Lambda_eq_comap_LambdaIntegral
statement:
theorem Lambda_eq_comap_LambdaIntegral (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) :
    𝒟.Λ =
      ZLattice.comap ℝ 𝒟.LambdaIntegral
        (((𝒟.Q : ℝ) ^ 2) • (1 : 𝒟.V →ₗ[ℝ] 𝒟.V))
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    change ((((𝒟.Q : ℝ) ^ 2) • (1 : 𝒟.V →ₗ[ℝ] 𝒟.V)) z ∈ 𝒟.LambdaIntegral)
    change ((𝒟.Q : ℝ) ^ 2) • z ∈ 𝒟.LambdaIntegral
    rcases hz with ⟨u, ⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
    funext i
    have hxi : (adm_σ 𝒟 i) (((𝒟.Q : 𝒟.K) ^ 2) * u) = (adm_σ 𝒟 i) (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.K) 𝒟.K x) :=
      congrArg (adm_σ 𝒟 i) hx
    simpa [AdmissibleDatum.Φ, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_mul, map_natCast] using hxi.symm
  · intro hz
    change ((((𝒟.Q : ℝ) ^ 2) • (1 : 𝒟.V →ₗ[ℝ] 𝒟.V)) z ∈ 𝒟.LambdaIntegral) at hz
    change ((𝒟.Q : ℝ) ^ 2) • z ∈ 𝒟.LambdaIntegral at hz
    rcases hz with ⟨x, hx⟩
    let u : 𝒟.K := ((𝒟.Q : 𝒟.K) ^ 2)⁻¹ * algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.K) 𝒟.K x
    have hQK_ne : ((𝒟.Q : 𝒟.K) ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by
      exact pow_ne_zero 2 (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt 𝒟.Q_pos))
    have hu : ((𝒟.Q : 𝒟.K) ^ 2) * u = algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.K) 𝒟.K x := by
      simp [u, hQK_ne, mul_assoc]
    have huΦ : ((𝒟.Q : ℝ) ^ 2) • 𝒟.Φ u = 𝒟.Φ (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.K) 𝒟.K x) := by
      funext i
      have hxi : (adm_σ 𝒟 i) (((𝒟.Q : 𝒟.K) ^ 2) * u) = (adm_σ 𝒟 i) (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.K) 𝒟.K x) :=
        congrArg (adm_σ 𝒟 i) hu
      simpa [AdmissibleDatum.Φ, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_mul, map_natCast] using hxi
    have hQ2_ne : ((𝒟.Q : ℝ) ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by
      exact pow_ne_zero 2 (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt 𝒟.Q_pos))
    have huz : 𝒟.Φ u = z := by
      apply (MulAction.injective₀ hQ2_ne)
      calc
        ((𝒟.Q : ℝ) ^ 2) • 𝒟.Φ u = 𝒟.Φ (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.K) 𝒟.K x) := huΦ
        _ = ((𝒟.Q : ℝ) ^ 2) • z := hx
    exact ⟨u, ⟨x, hu⟩, huz⟩

name: L_integralBasis_embedding_linearIndependent
statement: theorem L_integralBasis_embedding_linearIndependent: LinearIndependent ℂ (fun j : Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex ℤ (𝓞 𝒟.L) => fun i : Fin 𝒟.f => ((adm_σ 𝒟 i).comp (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K)) (NumberField.integralBasis 𝒟.L j))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let τ : Fin 𝒟.f → 𝒟.L →+* ℂ := fun i => (adm_σ 𝒟 i).comp (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K)
  have hτinj : Function.Injective τ := by
    intro i j hij
    by_contra hne
    exact (adm_σ_restrict_distinct 𝒟 i j hne) hij
  have hτbij : Function.Bijective τ := by
    rw [Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card]
    refine ⟨hτinj, ?_⟩
    rw [Fintype.card_fin, f, NumberField.Embeddings.card]
  let eτ : Fin 𝒟.f ≃ (𝒟.L →+* ℂ) := Equiv.ofBijective τ hτbij
  have hbasis' :
      LinearIndependent ℂ
        (fun j : Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex ℤ (𝓞 𝒟.L) =>
          NumberField.canonicalEmbedding 𝒟.L (NumberField.integralBasis 𝒟.L j)) := by
    convert (NumberField.canonicalEmbedding.latticeBasis 𝒟.L).linearIndependent using 1
    ext j σ
    rw [NumberField.canonicalEmbedding.latticeBasis_apply, NumberField.canonicalEmbedding.apply_at]
  have hbasis :
      LinearIndependent ℂ
        (fun j : Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex ℤ (𝓞 𝒟.L) =>
          fun σ : 𝒟.L →+* ℂ => σ (NumberField.integralBasis 𝒟.L j)) := by
    simpa [NumberField.canonicalEmbedding.apply_at] using hbasis'
  have hmap :
      LinearIndependent ℂ
        (fun j : Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex ℤ (𝓞 𝒟.L) =>
          (LinearEquiv.funCongrLeft ℂ ℂ eτ)
            (fun σ : 𝒟.L →+* ℂ => σ (NumberField.integralBasis 𝒟.L j))) := by
    exact hbasis.map'
      (LinearEquiv.funCongrLeft ℂ ℂ eτ).toLinearMap
      (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr (LinearEquiv.injective _))
  simpa [τ, eτ, LinearEquiv.funCongrLeft_apply, LinearMap.funLeft_apply] using hmap

name: adm_
statement: theorem adm_σ_iK_eq_I_or_neg_I: ∀ i : Fin 𝒟.f, adm_σ 𝒟 i 𝒟.i_K = Complex.I ∨ adm_σ 𝒟 i 𝒟.i_K = -Complex.I
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  let z : ℂ := adm_σ 𝒟 i 𝒟.i_K
  have hconj : -z = star z := by
    dsimp [z]
    simpa [𝒟.c_i_K, map_neg] using
      (complex_embedding_conjugation_compat 𝒟 (adm_σ 𝒟 i) 𝒟.i_K)
  have hsq : z * z = (-1 : ℂ) := by
    dsimp [z]
    simpa using congrArg (adm_σ 𝒟 i) 𝒟.i_K_sq
  have hre_eq : -z.re = z.re := by
    simpa using congrArg Complex.re hconj
  have hre0 : z.re = 0 := by
    linarith
  have hmulre : z.re * z.re - z.im * z.im = (-1 : ℝ) := by
    have h := congrArg Complex.re hsq
    simpa [Complex.mul_re] using h
  have himsq' : z.im * z.im = (1 : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith [hmulre, hre0]
  have himsq : z.im ^ 2 = (1 : ℝ) := by
    simpa [pow_two] using himsq'
  have hz_cases : z = Complex.I ∨ z = -Complex.I := by
    rcases sq_eq_one_iff.mp himsq with him1 | him1
    · left
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hre0, him1]
    · right
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hre0, him1]
  simpa [z] using hz_cases

name: scaled_L_integralBasis_left_linearIndependent
statement: theorem scaled_L_integralBasis_left_linearIndependent: LinearIndependent ℝ (fun j : Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex ℤ (𝓞 𝒟.L) => 𝒟.Φ ((((𝒟.Q : 𝒟.K) ^ 2)⁻¹) * algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K (NumberField.integralBasis 𝒟.L j)))
proof:
:= by
  let ι := Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex ℤ (𝓞 𝒟.L)
  let b : ι → 𝒟.V := fun j => fun i =>
    ((adm_σ 𝒟 i).comp (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K)) (NumberField.integralBasis 𝒟.L j)
  let cR : ℝ := (((𝒟.Q : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹)
  have hb : LinearIndependent ℂ b := by
    simpa [b, AdmissibleDatum.V] using L_integralBasis_embedding_linearIndependent (𝒟 := 𝒟)
  have hbR : LinearIndependent ℝ b :=
    LinearIndependent.restrict_scalars' (R := ℝ) hb
  have hQ : (𝒟.Q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt 𝒟.Q_pos)
  have hcR : cR ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [cR]
    exact inv_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 hQ)
  have hfamily :
      (fun j : ι => 𝒟.Φ ((((𝒟.Q : 𝒟.K) ^ 2)⁻¹) * algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K (NumberField.integralBasis 𝒟.L j))) =
      (((fun _ : ι => Units.mk0 cR hcR) • b : ι → 𝒟.V)) := by
    funext j
    ext i
    simp [b, cR, AdmissibleDatum.Φ, Complex.real_smul, mul_assoc]
  rw [hfamily]
  exact LinearIndependent.units_smul hbR (fun _ : ι => Units.mk0 cR hcR)

name: scaled_L_integralBasis_pair_linearIndependent
statement: theorem scaled_L_integralBasis_pair_linearIndependent: LinearIndependent ℝ (fun ij : Sum (Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex ℤ (𝓞 𝒟.L)) (Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex ℤ (𝓞 𝒟.L)) => Sum.elim (fun j => 𝒟.Φ ((((𝒟.Q : 𝒟.K) ^ 2)⁻¹) * algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K (NumberField.integralBasis 𝒟.L j))) (fun j => 𝒟.Φ ((((𝒟.Q : 𝒟.K) ^ 2)⁻¹) * (𝒟.i_K * algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K (NumberField.integralBasis 𝒟.L j)))) ij)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let ι := Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex ℤ (𝓞 𝒟.L)
  let v : ι → Fin 𝒟.f → ℂ := fun j =>
    𝒟.Φ ((((𝒟.Q : 𝒟.K) ^ 2)⁻¹) * algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K (NumberField.integralBasis 𝒟.L j))
  let w : ι → Fin 𝒟.f → ℂ := fun j =>
    𝒟.Φ ((((𝒟.Q : 𝒟.K) ^ 2)⁻¹) * (𝒟.i_K * algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K (NumberField.integralBasis 𝒟.L j)))
  change LinearIndependent ℝ (Sum.elim v w)
  have hv : LinearIndependent ℝ v := by
    simpa [v] using scaled_L_integralBasis_left_linearIndependent (𝒟 := 𝒟)
  let r : ι → Fin 𝒟.f → ℝ := fun j i => (v j i).re
  have hvim : ∀ j i, (v j i).im = 0 := by
    intro j i
    dsimp [v, AdmissibleDatum.Φ]
    let φ : 𝒟.L →+* ℂ := (adm_σ 𝒟 i).comp (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K)
    have hφ : NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.IsReal φ := by
      exact NumberField.IsTotallyReal.complexEmbedding_isReal φ
    let y : 𝒟.L := ((𝒟.Q : 𝒟.L) ^ 2)⁻¹ * NumberField.integralBasis 𝒟.L j
    have hy : (adm_σ 𝒟 i) ((((𝒟.Q : 𝒟.K) ^ 2)⁻¹) * algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K (NumberField.integralBasis 𝒟.L j)) = φ y := by
      simp [φ, y, map_mul, mul_assoc]
    rw [hy]
    rw [← NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.IsReal.coe_embedding_apply (hφ := hφ) y]
    simpa using Complex.ofReal_im (hφ.embedding y)
  have hvofReal : ∀ j i, v j i = (r j i : ℂ) := by
    intro j i
    apply Complex.ext
    · simp [r]
    · simpa [r] using hvim j i
  let ofRealPi : (Fin 𝒟.f → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin 𝒟.f → ℂ) :=
    LinearMap.pi fun i => (Complex.ofRealLI.toLinearMap).comp (LinearMap.proj i)
  have hofReal_r : ofRealPi ∘ r = v := by
    funext j
    ext i
    simpa [ofRealPi] using (hvofReal j i).symm
  have hr : LinearIndependent ℝ r := by
    apply LinearIndependent.of_comp ofRealPi
    rw [hofReal_r]
    exact hv
  have hwcoord : ∀ j i, w j i = adm_σ 𝒟 i 𝒟.i_K * v j i := by
    intro j i
    dsimp [w, v, AdmissibleDatum.Φ]
    simp [map_mul, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]
  have hrew : ∀ j i, (w j i).re = 0 := by
    intro j i
    rcases adm_σ_iK_eq_I_or_neg_I (𝒟 := 𝒟) i with hI | hI
    · rw [hwcoord j i, hI, hvofReal j i]
      simp
    · rw [hwcoord j i, hI, hvofReal j i]
      simp
  let ε : Fin 𝒟.f → ℝ := fun i => if adm_σ 𝒟 i 𝒟.i_K = Complex.I then 1 else -1
  have hεnz : ∀ i, ε i ≠ 0 := by
    intro i
    by_cases hI : adm_σ 𝒟 i 𝒟.i_K = Complex.I
    · simp [ε, hI]
    · simp [ε, hI]
  have himw : ∀ j i, (w j i).im = ε i * r j i := by
    intro j i
    rcases adm_σ_iK_eq_I_or_neg_I (𝒟 := 𝒟) i with hI | hI
    · rw [hwcoord j i, hI, hvofReal j i]
      simp [ε, hI, r]
    · have hne : ¬ adm_σ 𝒟 i 𝒟.i_K = Complex.I := by
        intro h
        rw [h] at hI
        have him : (Complex.I : ℂ).im = (-Complex.I).im := congrArg Complex.im hI
        norm_num at him
      rw [hwcoord j i, hI, hvofReal j i]
      simp [ε, hne, r]
  let diag : (Fin 𝒟.f → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin 𝒟.f → ℝ) :=
    { toFun := fun x i => ε i * x i
      map_add' := by
        intro x y
        ext i
        simp [mul_add]
      map_smul' := by
        intro a x
        ext i
        simp [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] }
  have hdiag_ker : LinearMap.ker diag = ⊥ := by
    rw [LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
    intro x hx
    ext i
    have hxi : ε i * x i = 0 := by
      have := congrFun hx i
      simpa [diag] using this
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hxi with hε | hx0
    · exact (hεnz i hε).elim
    · exact hx0
  let twisted : ι → Fin 𝒟.f → ℝ := fun j i => ε i * r j i
  have htwisted : LinearIndependent ℝ twisted := by
    have hdiag : LinearIndependent ℝ (diag ∘ r) := by
      exact LinearIndependent.map' hr diag hdiag_ker
    simpa [diag, twisted] using hdiag
  let imPi : (Fin 𝒟.f → ℂ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin 𝒟.f → ℝ) :=
    LinearMap.pi fun i => (Complex.imCLM.toLinearMap).comp (LinearMap.proj i)
  have himPi_w : imPi ∘ w = twisted := by
    funext j
    ext i
    simp [imPi, twisted, himw]
  have hw : LinearIndependent ℝ w := by
    apply LinearIndependent.of_comp imPi
    rw [himPi_w]
    exact htwisted
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v)) (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range w)) := by
    rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
    intro x hxv hxw
    rw [Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun] at hxv
    rw [Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun] at hxw
    rcases hxv with ⟨a, ha⟩
    rcases hxw with ⟨b, hb⟩
    have hab : ∑ j, a j • v j = ∑ j, b j • w j := ha.trans hb.symm
    have hre : ∑ j, a j • r j = 0 := by
      ext i
      have hi := congrArg Complex.re (congrFun hab i)
      simpa [r, hrew, Complex.re_sum, Complex.real_smul] using hi
    have ha0 : ∀ j, a j = 0 := (Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp hr) a hre
    have hx0 : x = 0 := by
      rw [← ha]
      ext i
      simp [ha0]
    exact hx0
  exact LinearIndependent.sum_type hv hw hdisj

name: supNorm_eq_norm
statement: theorem supNorm_eq_norm (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (z : 𝒟.V) : 𝒟.supNorm z = ‖z‖
proof:
:= by
  unfold AdmissibleDatum.supNorm
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (Finset.sup'_le_iff (H := ⟨⟨0, 𝒟.f_pos⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩)
      (f := fun r : Fin 𝒟.f => ‖z r‖)).2 (fun b hb => by
        simpa using norm_le_pi_norm z b)
  · apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg ?_).2
    · intro i
