          = ∑' l : 𝒟.Λ, T.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) l := by
            refine tsum_congr ?_
            intro l
            change S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) ((l : 𝒟.V) + a) = _
            by_cases hl : l ∈ T
            · have hs : (l : 𝒟.V) + a ∈ S := by
                simpa [T, S, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using hl
              simp [hl, hs]
            · have hs : (l : 𝒟.V) + a ∉ S := by
                simpa [T, S, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using hl
              simp [hl, hs]
      _ = ∑' l : T, (1 : ENNReal) := by
            symm
            exact tsum_subtype T (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal))
      _ = T.encard := ENNReal.tsum_set_one T
      _ = (((𝒟.X_finset a R).filter (fun x => x + 𝒟.Φ u ∈ 𝒟.X_finset a R)).card : ENNReal) := by
            exact_mod_cast (lemma_2_4_shift_count_eq_lattice_encard 𝒟 a R u hΛu)
  have hlin0 :
      ∫⁻ x, S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) x ∂MeasureTheory.volume =
        ∑' l : 𝒟.Λ, ∫⁻ x in F, S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) (l +ᵥ x) ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
    simpa [F] using
      (@MeasureTheory.IsAddFundamentalDomain.lintegral_eq_tsum'' (↥𝒟.Λ) (𝒟.V)
        inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance (lemma_2_4_FD 𝒟) MeasureTheory.volume
        hmcv hvinv inferInstance (lemma_2_4_isAddFundamentalDomain 𝒟)
        (S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal))))
  have hmeas_indicator : Measurable (S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal))) := by
    exact Measurable.indicator measurable_const hS
  have hmeas_l (l : 𝒟.Λ) :
      Measurable (fun a : 𝒟.V => S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) (l +ᵥ a)) := by
    exact hmeas_indicator.comp (measurable_const_vadd l)
  have hlin :
      ∫⁻ a in F, ∑' l : 𝒟.Λ, S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) (l +ᵥ a) ∂MeasureTheory.volume =
        ∑' l : 𝒟.Λ, ∫⁻ a in F, S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) (l +ᵥ a) ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
    exact MeasureTheory.lintegral_tsum (fun l => (hmeas_l l).aemeasurable)
  have hlin_count :
      ∫⁻ a in F, (((𝒟.X_finset a R).filter (fun x => x + 𝒟.Φ u ∈ 𝒟.X_finset a R)).card : ENNReal) ∂MeasureTheory.volume =
        ∑' l : 𝒟.Λ, ∫⁻ a in F, S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) (l +ᵥ a) ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
    calc
      ∫⁻ a in F, (((𝒟.X_finset a R).filter (fun x => x + 𝒟.Φ u ∈ 𝒟.X_finset a R)).card : ENNReal) ∂MeasureTheory.volume
          = ∫⁻ a in F, ∑' l : 𝒟.Λ, S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) (l +ᵥ a) ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
              refine MeasureTheory.lintegral_congr_ae ?_
              exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun a => (hcount a).symm)
      _ = ∑' l : 𝒟.Λ, ∫⁻ a in F, S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) (l +ᵥ a) ∂MeasureTheory.volume := hlin
  have hmeas_count :
      AEMeasurable
        (fun a : 𝒟.V => (((𝒟.X_finset a R).filter (fun x => x + 𝒟.Φ u ∈ 𝒟.X_finset a R)).card : ENNReal))
        (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict F) := by
    simpa [hcount] using (Measurable.ennreal_tsum (fun l : 𝒟.Λ => hmeas_l l)).aemeasurable
  have hfinite_count :
      ∀ᵐ a ∂(MeasureTheory.volume.restrict F),
        (((𝒟.X_finset a R).filter (fun x => x + 𝒟.Φ u ∈ 𝒟.X_finset a R)).card : ENNReal) < ⊤ := by
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun a => by simp)
  have hfinite_indicator :
      ∀ᵐ a ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
        S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) a < ⊤ := by
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun a => by
      by_cases ha : a ∈ S <;> simp [ha])
  have hreal :
      (∫⁻ a, S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) a ∂MeasureTheory.volume).toReal =
        MeasureTheory.volume.real S := by
    calc
      (∫⁻ a, S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) a ∂MeasureTheory.volume).toReal
          = ∫ a, (S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) a).toReal ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
              symm
              exact MeasureTheory.integral_toReal hmeas_indicator.aemeasurable hfinite_indicator
      _ = ∫ a, S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) a ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
            refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae ?_
            exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun a => by
              by_cases ha : a ∈ S <;> simp [ha])
      _ = MeasureTheory.volume.real S := by
            simpa using (MeasureTheory.integral_indicator_one (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (s := S) hS)
  calc
    ∫ a in F, (((𝒟.X_finset a R).filter (fun x => x + 𝒟.Φ u ∈ 𝒟.X_finset a R)).card : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume
        = (∫⁻ a in F, (((𝒟.X_finset a R).filter (fun x => x + 𝒟.Φ u ∈ 𝒟.X_finset a R)).card : ENNReal) ∂MeasureTheory.volume).toReal := by
            simpa using
              (MeasureTheory.integral_toReal (μ := MeasureTheory.volume.restrict F) hmeas_count hfinite_count)
    _ = (∫⁻ a, S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) a ∂MeasureTheory.volume).toReal := by
          rw [hlin_count, hlin0.symm]
    _ = MeasureTheory.volume.real S := hreal
    _ = MeasureTheory.volume.real { a : 𝒟.V | a ∈ 𝒟.closedPolydisc R ∧ a + 𝒟.Φ u ∈ 𝒟.closedPolydisc R } := by
          rfl

name: lemma_2_4_volume_closedPolydisc
statement: theorem lemma_2_4_volume_closedPolydisc (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) : MeasureTheory.volume.real (𝒟.closedPolydisc R) = (𝒟.b R) ^ 𝒟.f
proof:
:= by
  have hEq : 𝒟.closedPolydisc R = Metric.closedBall (0 : 𝒟.V) R := by
    ext z
    simp [AdmissibleDatum.closedPolydisc, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, supNorm_eq_norm]
  rw [hEq, MeasureTheory.measureReal_def]
  rw [MeasureTheory.volume_pi_closedBall (x := (0 : 𝒟.V)) hR]
  simp [Complex.volume_closedBall, AdmissibleDatum.b, hR, Fin.prod_const, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]

name: lemma_2_4_integral_N_count
statement: theorem lemma_2_4_integral_N_count (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) : ∫ a in lemma_2_4_FD 𝒟, (𝒟.N_count a R : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume = MeasureTheory.volume.real (𝒟.closedPolydisc R)
proof:
:= by
  let F := lemma_2_4_FD 𝒟
  let B := 𝒟.closedPolydisc R
  let hmcv : MeasurableConstVAdd (↥𝒟.Λ) 𝒟.V :=
    ⟨fun l => by
      change Measurable ((l : 𝒟.V) + · : 𝒟.V → 𝒟.V)
      simpa [vadd_eq_add] using (measurable_const_add (l : 𝒟.V))⟩
  let hvim : MeasureTheory.VAddInvariantMeasure (↥𝒟.Λ) 𝒟.V MeasureTheory.volume :=
    ⟨fun c s hs => by
      change MeasureTheory.volume (((fun x : 𝒟.V => (c : 𝒟.V) + x) ⁻¹' s)) = MeasureTheory.volume s
      simpa [vadd_eq_add] using
        (MeasureTheory.VAddInvariantMeasure.measure_preimage_vadd
          (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (c := (c : 𝒟.V)) (s := s) hs)⟩
  have hF := lemma_2_4_isAddFundamentalDomain 𝒟
  have hB_eq : B = Metric.closedBall (0 : 𝒟.V) R := by
    ext z
    simp [B, AdmissibleDatum.closedPolydisc, supNorm_eq_norm, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, hR]
  have hB_meas : MeasurableSet B := by
    rw [hB_eq]
    exact measurableSet_closedBall
  have hcount (a : 𝒟.V) :
      (∑' l : 𝒟.Λ, Set.indicator B (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) (l +ᵥ a)) = (𝒟.N_count a R : ENNReal) := by
    let s : Set 𝒟.Λ := {l | (l : 𝒟.V) + a ∈ B}
    have hs : s = {l : 𝒟.Λ | a + (l : 𝒟.V) ∈ B} := by
      ext l
      change (((l : 𝒟.V) + a ∈ B) ↔ a + (l : 𝒟.V) ∈ B)
      rw [add_comm]
    calc
      ∑' l : 𝒟.Λ, Set.indicator B (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) (l +ᵥ a)
          = ∑' l : 𝒟.Λ, s.indicator (fun _ : 𝒟.Λ => (1 : ENNReal)) l := by
              refine tsum_congr ?_
              intro l
              by_cases hl : (l : 𝒟.V) + a ∈ B
              · have hl' : l +ᵥ a ∈ B := by
                  simpa [vadd_eq_add] using hl
                simp [s, hl, hl']
              · have hl' : l +ᵥ a ∉ B := by
                  simpa [vadd_eq_add] using hl
                simp [s, hl, hl']
      _ = ∑' l : s, (1 : ENNReal) := by
            symm
            exact tsum_subtype (s := s) (f := fun _ : 𝒟.Λ => (1 : ENNReal))
      _ = (s.encard : ENNReal) := by
            simpa using ENNReal.tsum_set_one (s := s)
      _ = (((𝒟.N_count a R : ℕ∞)) : ENNReal) := by
            rw [hs, lemma_2_4_N_count_eq_lattice_encard]
      _ = (𝒟.N_count a R : ENNReal) := by
            rfl
  have hlin :
      ∫⁻ x, Set.indicator B (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) x ∂MeasureTheory.volume =
        ∑' l : 𝒟.Λ, ∫⁻ x in F, Set.indicator B (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) (l +ᵥ x) ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
    simpa [F, B] using
      (@MeasureTheory.IsAddFundamentalDomain.lintegral_eq_tsum''
        (↥𝒟.Λ) 𝒟.V _ _ _ F MeasureTheory.volume hmcv hvim inferInstance hF
        (Set.indicator B (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal))))
  have hmeas_indicator : Measurable (Set.indicator B (fun _ : 𝒟.V => (1 : ENNReal))) := by
    exact Measurable.indicator measurable_const hB_meas
  have hmeas_l (l : 𝒟.Λ) : AEMeasurable (fun x : 𝒟.V => Set.indicator B (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) (l +ᵥ x)) (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict F) := by
    exact (hmeas_indicator.comp (measurable_const_vadd l)).aemeasurable
  have hlin_count : ∫⁻ x in F, (𝒟.N_count x R : ENNReal) ∂MeasureTheory.volume = MeasureTheory.volume B := by
    calc
      ∫⁻ x in F, (𝒟.N_count x R : ENNReal) ∂MeasureTheory.volume
          = ∫⁻ x in F, ∑' l : 𝒟.Λ, Set.indicator B (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) (l +ᵥ x) ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
              refine MeasureTheory.lintegral_congr_ae ?_
              exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => (hcount x).symm)
      _ = ∑' l : 𝒟.Λ, ∫⁻ x in F, Set.indicator B (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) (l +ᵥ x) ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
            simpa using (MeasureTheory.lintegral_tsum (μ := MeasureTheory.volume.restrict F)
              (f := fun l : 𝒟.Λ => fun x : 𝒟.V => Set.indicator B (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) (l +ᵥ x)) hmeas_l)
      _ = ∫⁻ x, Set.indicator B (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) x ∂MeasureTheory.volume := hlin.symm
      _ = MeasureTheory.volume B := by
            simp [hB_meas]
  have hmeas_tsum : AEMeasurable
      (fun x : 𝒟.V => ∑' l : 𝒟.Λ, Set.indicator B (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) (l +ᵥ x))
      (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict F) := by
    exact AEMeasurable.ennreal_tsum (fun l => hmeas_l l)
  have hmeas_count : AEMeasurable (fun x : 𝒟.V => (𝒟.N_count x R : ENNReal)) (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict F) := by
    exact hmeas_tsum.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hcount)
  have hfinite_count : ∀ᵐ x ∂MeasureTheory.volume.restrict F, (𝒟.N_count x R : ENNReal) < ⊤ := by
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by simp)
  have hreal :
      ∫ x in F, (𝒟.N_count x R : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume =
        (∫⁻ x in F, (𝒟.N_count x R : ENNReal) ∂MeasureTheory.volume).toReal := by
    simpa using (MeasureTheory.integral_toReal (μ := MeasureTheory.volume.restrict F)
      (f := fun x : 𝒟.V => (𝒟.N_count x R : ENNReal)) hmeas_count hfinite_count)
  rw [hreal, hlin_count]
  rfl

name: lemma_2_4_average_N_count
statement: theorem lemma_2_4_average_N_count (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) : ⨍ a in lemma_2_4_FD 𝒟, (𝒟.N_count a R : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume = (𝒟.b R) ^ 𝒟.f / ZLattice.covolume (L := 𝒟.Λ) (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
proof:
:= by
  rw [MeasureTheory.setAverage_eq]
  rw [lemma_2_4_integral_N_count 𝒟 R hR]
  rw [lemma_2_4_volume_closedPolydisc 𝒟 R hR]
  have hcov :
      ZLattice.covolume (L := 𝒟.Λ) (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) =
        MeasureTheory.volume.real (lemma_2_4_FD 𝒟) := by
    simpa using
      (ZLattice.covolume_eq_measure_fundamentalDomain
        (L := 𝒟.Λ) (F := lemma_2_4_FD 𝒟) (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
        (h := lemma_2_4_isAddFundamentalDomain 𝒟))
  rw [← hcov]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv]
  ring

name: lemma_2_4_volume_overlap_set
statement: theorem lemma_2_4_volume_overlap_set (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (u : 𝒟.K) (hu : ∀ σ : 𝒟.K →+* ℂ, ‖σ u‖ = 1) : MeasureTheory.volume.real { a : 𝒟.V | a ∈ 𝒟.closedPolydisc R ∧ a + 𝒟.Φ u ∈ 𝒟.closedPolydisc R } = overlapArea R ^ 𝒟.f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s : Fin 𝒟.f → Set ℂ :=
    fun i => Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R ∩ Metric.closedBall (-(adm_σ 𝒟 i u)) R
  have hset :
      { a : 𝒟.V | a ∈ 𝒟.closedPolydisc R ∧ a + 𝒟.Φ u ∈ 𝒟.closedPolydisc R }
        = Set.univ.pi s := by
    ext a
    constructor
    · intro ha
      rw [Set.mem_univ_pi]
      intro i
      rcases ha with ⟨ha1, ha2⟩
      have ha1' : a ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : 𝒟.V) R := by
        simpa [AdmissibleDatum.closedPolydisc, supNorm_eq_norm, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
          using ha1
      have ha2' : a + 𝒟.Φ u ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : 𝒟.V) R := by
        simpa [AdmissibleDatum.closedPolydisc, supNorm_eq_norm, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
          using ha2
      have ha1pi : a ∈ Set.univ.pi (fun j : Fin 𝒟.f => Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R) := by
        simpa [closedBall_pi (x := (0 : 𝒟.V)) hR] using ha1'
      have ha2pi : a + 𝒟.Φ u ∈ Set.univ.pi (fun j : Fin 𝒟.f => Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R) := by
        simpa [closedBall_pi (x := (0 : 𝒟.V)) hR] using ha2'
      refine ⟨(Set.mem_univ_pi.mp ha1pi i), ?_⟩
      have hi : a i + 𝒟.Φ u i ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R :=
        Set.mem_univ_pi.mp ha2pi i
      simpa [s, AdmissibleDatum.Φ, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, sub_eq_add_neg,
        add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using hi
    · intro ha
      rw [Set.mem_univ_pi] at ha
      have ha1pi : a ∈ Set.univ.pi (fun i : Fin 𝒟.f => Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R) := by
        rw [Set.mem_univ_pi]
        intro i
        exact (ha i).1
      have ha1' : a ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : 𝒟.V) R := by
        simpa [closedBall_pi (x := (0 : 𝒟.V)) hR] using ha1pi
      have ha1poly : a ∈ 𝒟.closedPolydisc R := by
        simpa [AdmissibleDatum.closedPolydisc, supNorm_eq_norm, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
          using ha1'
      have ha2pi : a + 𝒟.Φ u ∈ Set.univ.pi (fun i : Fin 𝒟.f => Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R) := by
        rw [Set.mem_univ_pi]
        intro i
        have hi : a i ∈ Metric.closedBall (-(adm_σ 𝒟 i u)) R := (ha i).2
        simpa [AdmissibleDatum.Φ, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, sub_eq_add_neg,
          add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using hi
      have ha2' : a + 𝒟.Φ u ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : 𝒟.V) R := by
        simpa [closedBall_pi (x := (0 : 𝒟.V)) hR] using ha2pi
      have ha2poly : a + 𝒟.Φ u ∈ 𝒟.closedPolydisc R := by
        simpa [AdmissibleDatum.closedPolydisc, supNorm_eq_norm, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
          using ha2'
      exact ⟨ha1poly, ha2poly⟩
  rw [hset, MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, MeasureTheory.volume_pi_pi]
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_prod]
  have hfac : ∀ i : Fin 𝒟.f, (MeasureTheory.volume (s i)).toReal = overlapArea R := by
    intro i
    have hσ : ‖adm_σ 𝒟 i u‖ = 1 := hu (adm_σ 𝒟 i)
    simpa [s] using lemma_2_4_closedBall_overlap_volume R (adm_σ 𝒟 i u) hσ
  simp_rw [hfac]
  simpa using (Finset.prod_const (s := Finset.univ) (x := overlapArea R))

name: lemma_2_4_average_E_count
statement: theorem lemma_2_4_average_E_count (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (U : Finset 𝒟.K) (hU_norm : ∀ u ∈ U, 𝒟.IsNormOneIntegral u) : ⨍ a in lemma_2_4_FD 𝒟, (𝒟.E_count a R U : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume = ((U.card : ℝ) * overlapArea R ^ 𝒟.f) / ZLattice.covolume (L := 𝒟.Λ) (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [MeasureTheory.setAverage_eq]
  simp_rw [AdmissibleDatum.E_count, Nat.cast_sum]
  have hsum :
      ∫ a in lemma_2_4_FD 𝒟,
          ∑ u ∈ U,
            (((𝒟.X_finset a R).filter
              (fun x => x + 𝒟.Φ u ∈ 𝒟.X_finset a R)).card : ℝ)
            ∂MeasureTheory.volume
        =
      ∑ u ∈ U,
        ∫ a in lemma_2_4_FD 𝒟,
          (((𝒟.X_finset a R).filter
            (fun x => x + 𝒟.Φ u ∈ 𝒟.X_finset a R)).card : ℝ)
            ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
    simpa using
      (MeasureTheory.integral_finset_sum
        (μ := MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (lemma_2_4_FD 𝒟)) U
        (fun u hu =>
          lemma_2_4_integrable_shift_count 𝒟 R u
            (by exact ⟨u, (hU_norm u hu).2.2, rfl⟩)))
  rw [hsum]
  have hsum2 :
      ∑ u ∈ U,
        ∫ a in lemma_2_4_FD 𝒟,
          (((𝒟.X_finset a R).filter
            (fun x => x + 𝒟.Φ u ∈ 𝒟.X_finset a R)).card : ℝ)
            ∂MeasureTheory.volume
      = ∑ u ∈ U, overlapArea R ^ 𝒟.f := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    intro u hu
    have hΛu : 𝒟.Φ u ∈ (𝒟.Λ : Set 𝒟.V) := by
      exact ⟨u, (hU_norm u hu).2.2, rfl⟩
    rw [lemma_2_4_integral_shift_count 𝒟 R hR u hΛu]
    rw [lemma_2_4_volume_overlap_set 𝒟 R hR u ((hU_norm u hu).2.1)]
  rw [hsum2]
  rw [← ZLattice.covolume_eq_measure_fundamentalDomain
    (L := 𝒟.Λ) (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (h := lemma_2_4_isAddFundamentalDomain 𝒟)]
  simp [Finset.sum_const_nat, smul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv]
  ring

name: lemma_2_4_gap_average_pos
statement: theorem lemma_2_4_gap_average_pos (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (H : ℝ) (hH : 0 < H) (R : ℝ) (hR : 1 / 2 < R) (U : Finset 𝒟.K) (hU_norm : ∀ u ∈ U, 𝒟.IsNormOneIntegral u) (hU_size : (U.card : ℝ) ≥ Real.exp ((𝒟.t * Real.log 2 - Real.log H) * 𝒟.f)) (_hρ_pos : 0 < 𝒟.ρ R) (_hρ : -((𝒟.t * Real.log 2 - Real.log H) / 2) < Real.log (𝒟.ρ R)) : 0 < ⨍ a in lemma_2_4_FD 𝒟, lemma_2_4_gap 𝒟 H R U a ∂MeasureTheory.volume
proof:
:= by
  set γ : ℝ := (𝒟.t : ℝ) * Real.log 2 - Real.log H
  let s : Set 𝒟.V := lemma_2_4_FD 𝒟
  let ν : MeasureTheory.Measure 𝒟.V := (MeasureTheory.volume s)⁻¹ • MeasureTheory.volume.restrict s
  have hcov_pos : 0 < ZLattice.covolume (L := 𝒟.Λ) (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) := by
    simpa using ZLattice.covolume_pos (L := 𝒟.Λ) (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
  have hR_pos : 0 < R := by linarith
  have hb_pos : 0 < 𝒟.b R := by
    unfold AdmissibleDatum.b
    positivity
  have hoverlap_eq : overlapArea R = 𝒟.ρ R * 𝒟.b R := by
    calc
      overlapArea R = (overlapArea R / 𝒟.b R) * 𝒟.b R := by
        field_simp [hb_pos.ne']
      _ = 𝒟.ρ R * 𝒟.b R := by rw [AdmissibleDatum.ρ]
  have hoverlap_pos : 0 < overlapArea R := by
    rw [hoverlap_eq]
    exact mul_pos _hρ_pos hb_pos
  have hU_card_pos : 0 < (U.card : ℝ) := by
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos (γ * 𝒟.f)) hU_size
  have havgE := lemma_2_4_average_E_count 𝒟 R hR_pos.le U hU_norm
  have havgN := lemma_2_4_average_N_count 𝒟 R hR_pos.le
  rw [MeasureTheory.setAverage_eq'] at havgE havgN
  have hE_rhs_pos :
      0 < ((U.card : ℝ) * overlapArea R ^ 𝒟.f) /
        ZLattice.covolume (L := 𝒟.Λ) (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) := by
    exact div_pos (mul_pos hU_card_pos (pow_pos hoverlap_pos _)) hcov_pos
  have hN_rhs_pos :
      0 < (𝒟.b R) ^ 𝒟.f /
        ZLattice.covolume (L := 𝒟.Λ) (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) := by
    exact div_pos (pow_pos hb_pos _) hcov_pos
  have hE_int_ne_zero :
      ∫ a, (𝒟.E_count a R U : ℝ) ∂ν ≠ 0 := by
    rw [havgE]
    exact hE_rhs_pos.ne'
  have hN_int_ne_zero :
      ∫ a, (𝒟.N_count a R : ℝ) ∂ν ≠ 0 := by
    rw [havgN]
    exact hN_rhs_pos.ne'
  have hE_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun a => (𝒟.E_count a R U : ℝ)) ν := by
    by_contra hnot
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_undef hnot] at hE_int_ne_zero
    exact hE_int_ne_zero rfl
  have hN_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun a => (𝒟.N_count a R : ℝ)) ν := by
    by_contra hnot
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_undef hnot] at hN_int_ne_zero
    exact hN_int_ne_zero rfl
  have hf_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 𝒟.f := by
    exact_mod_cast 𝒟.f_pos
  have hrho_pow_pos : 0 < (𝒟.ρ R) ^ 𝒟.f := by
    exact pow_pos _hρ_pos _
  have hlogstep : γ / 2 < γ + Real.log (𝒟.ρ R) := by
    linarith [_hρ]
  have hmulstep : (γ / 2) * (𝒟.f : ℝ) < (γ + Real.log (𝒟.ρ R)) * (𝒟.f : ℝ) := by
    exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hlogstep hf_pos
  have hlt_exp : Real.exp (γ * 𝒟.f / 2) < Real.exp (γ * 𝒟.f) * (𝒟.ρ R) ^ 𝒟.f := by
    have htemp : Real.exp ((γ / 2) * (𝒟.f : ℝ)) < Real.exp ((γ + Real.log (𝒟.ρ R)) * (𝒟.f : ℝ)) := by
      exact Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hmulstep
    have hright :
        Real.exp ((γ + Real.log (𝒟.ρ R)) * (𝒟.f : ℝ)) =
          Real.exp (γ * (𝒟.f : ℝ)) * (𝒟.ρ R) ^ 𝒟.f := by
      calc
        Real.exp ((γ + Real.log (𝒟.ρ R)) * (𝒟.f : ℝ))
            = Real.exp (γ * (𝒟.f : ℝ) + Real.log (𝒟.ρ R) * (𝒟.f : ℝ)) := by
                congr 1
                ring
        _ = Real.exp (γ * (𝒟.f : ℝ)) * Real.exp (Real.log (𝒟.ρ R) * (𝒟.f : ℝ)) := by
              rw [Real.exp_add]
        _ = Real.exp (γ * (𝒟.f : ℝ)) * (𝒟.ρ R) ^ 𝒟.f := by
              congr 1
              calc
                Real.exp (Real.log (𝒟.ρ R) * (𝒟.f : ℝ))
                    = Real.exp (Real.log (𝒟.ρ R)) ^ (𝒟.f : ℝ) := by
                        rw [Real.exp_mul]
                _ = (𝒟.ρ R) ^ (𝒟.f : ℝ) := by rw [Real.exp_log _hρ_pos]
                _ = (𝒟.ρ R) ^ 𝒟.f := by rw [Real.rpow_natCast]
    have hleft : Real.exp ((γ / 2) * (𝒟.f : ℝ)) = Real.exp (γ * 𝒟.f / 2) := by
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [hleft, hright] at htemp
    exact htemp
  have hmul_u : Real.exp (γ * 𝒟.f) * (𝒟.ρ R) ^ 𝒟.f ≤ (U.card : ℝ) * (𝒟.ρ R) ^ 𝒟.f := by
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hU_size hrho_pow_pos.le
  have hC_lt : Real.exp (γ * 𝒟.f / 2) < (U.card : ℝ) * (𝒟.ρ R) ^ 𝒟.f := by
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hlt_exp hmul_u
  rw [MeasureTheory.setAverage_eq']
  change 0 < ∫ a, lemma_2_4_gap 𝒟 H R U a ∂ν
  dsimp [lemma_2_4_gap]
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_sub hE_int (hN_int.const_mul _)]
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
  rw [havgE, havgN]
  have hfinal_eq :
      ((U.card : ℝ) * overlapArea R ^ 𝒟.f) /
            ZLattice.covolume (L := 𝒟.Λ) (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) -
          Real.exp (γ * 𝒟.f / 2) *
            ((𝒟.b R) ^ 𝒟.f /
              ZLattice.covolume (L := 𝒟.Λ) (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)) =
        (((U.card : ℝ) * (𝒟.ρ R) ^ 𝒟.f) - Real.exp (γ * 𝒟.f / 2)) *
          ((𝒟.b R) ^ 𝒟.f /
            ZLattice.covolume (L := 𝒟.Λ) (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)) := by
    rw [hoverlap_eq, mul_pow]
    ring
  rw [hfinal_eq]
  exact mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hC_lt) hN_rhs_pos

name: lemma_2_4
statement:
theorem lemma_2_4 (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (H : ℝ) (hH : 0 < H)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 1 / 2 < R)
    (U : Finset 𝒟.K)
    (hU_norm : ∀ u ∈ U, 𝒟.IsNormOneIntegral u)
    (hU_size : (U.card : ℝ) ≥
      Real.exp ((𝒟.t * Real.log 2 - Real.log H) * 𝒟.f))

    (_hρ_pos : 0 < 𝒟.ρ R)
    (_hρ : -((𝒟.t * Real.log 2 - Real.log H) / 2) < Real.log (𝒟.ρ R)) :
    ∃ a : 𝒟.V,
      0 < 𝒟.N_count a R ∧
      (𝒟.E_count a R U : ℝ) ≥
        Real.exp ((𝒟.t * Real.log 2 - Real.log H) * 𝒟.f / 2) *
          𝒟.N_count a R
proof:
:= by
  have havg :
      0 < ⨍ a in lemma_2_4_FD 𝒟, lemma_2_4_gap 𝒟 H R U a ∂MeasureTheory.volume :=
    lemma_2_4_gap_average_pos 𝒟 H hH R hR U hU_norm hU_size _hρ_pos _hρ
  rcases lemma_2_4_exists_gap_positive 𝒟 H R U havg with ⟨a, _haFD, hgap⟩
  have hNpos : 0 < 𝒟.N_count a R := by
    by_contra hNnonpos
    have hNzero : 𝒟.N_count a R = 0 := by
      linarith
    have hEzero : 𝒟.E_count a R U = 0 :=
      lemma_2_4_E_count_eq_zero_of_N_count_eq_zero 𝒟 a R U hNzero
    unfold lemma_2_4_gap at hgap
    rw [hNzero, hEzero] at hgap
    norm_num at hgap
  refine ⟨a, hNpos, ?_⟩
  have hgap' := hgap
  unfold lemma_2_4_gap at hgap'
  linarith

name: complexPoint_dist
statement: theorem complexPoint_dist (z w : ℂ) : dist (complexPoint z) (complexPoint w) = ‖z - w‖
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : dist (complexPoint z) (complexPoint w) ^ 2 = ‖z - w‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc
      dist (complexPoint z) (complexPoint w) ^ 2
          = ∑ i : Fin 2, dist ((complexPoint z) i) ((complexPoint w) i) ^ 2 := by
            rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq]
      _ = (z.re - w.re) ^ 2 + (z.im - w.im) ^ 2 := by
        simp [complexPoint, Real.dist_eq, sq_abs]
      _ = ‖z - w‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [RCLike.norm_sq_eq_def]
        simp
        ring
  have hnonneg1 : 0 ≤ dist (complexPoint z) (complexPoint w) := dist_nonneg
  have hnonneg2 : 0 ≤ ‖z - w‖ := norm_nonneg _
  nlinarith

name: complexPoint_injective
statement: theorem complexPoint_injective: Function.Injective complexPoint
proof:
:= by
  intro z w h
  have h' := congrArg (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ) h
  apply Complex.ext
  · simpa [complexPoint] using congrFun h' 0
  · simpa [complexPoint] using congrFun h' 1

name: lemma_2_5_pi1_injOn
statement: theorem lemma_2_5_pi1_injOn (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (a : 𝒟.V) (R : ℝ) : Set.InjOn 𝒟.π1 (𝒟.X a R)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  rcases hx with ⟨hx, _⟩
  rcases hy with ⟨hy, _⟩
  rcases hx with ⟨lx, rfl⟩
  rcases hy with ⟨ly, rfl⟩
  have hlx : ((lx : 𝒟.V) ∈ 𝒟.Λ) := lx.2
  change ∃ u : 𝒟.K,
      (∃ x : 𝓞 𝒟.K, ((𝒟.Q : 𝒟.K) ^ 2) * u = (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.K) 𝒟.K) x) ∧
        𝒟.Φ u = (lx : 𝒟.V) at hlx
  have hly : ((ly : 𝒟.V) ∈ 𝒟.Λ) := ly.2
  change ∃ u : 𝒟.K,
      (∃ x : 𝓞 𝒟.K, ((𝒟.Q : 𝒟.K) ^ 2) * u = (algebraMap (𝓞 𝒟.K) 𝒟.K) x) ∧
        𝒟.Φ u = (ly : 𝒟.V) at hly
  rcases hlx with ⟨u₁, _, hu₁⟩
  rcases hly with ⟨u₂, _, hu₂⟩
  have hxy' :
      a ⟨0, 𝒟.f_pos⟩ + (lx : 𝒟.V) ⟨0, 𝒟.f_pos⟩ =
        a ⟨0, 𝒟.f_pos⟩ + (ly : 𝒟.V) ⟨0, 𝒟.f_pos⟩ := by
    simpa [AdmissibleDatum.π1] using hxy
  have hxy0 : (lx : 𝒟.V) ⟨0, 𝒟.f_pos⟩ = (ly : 𝒟.V) ⟨0, 𝒟.f_pos⟩ :=
    add_left_cancel hxy'
  have hu : u₁ = u₂ := by
    apply (adm_σ 𝒟 ⟨0, 𝒟.f_pos⟩).injective
    rw [← hu₁, ← hu₂] at hxy0
    simpa [AdmissibleDatum.Φ] using hxy0
  have hl : (lx : 𝒟.V) = (ly : 𝒟.V) := by
    rw [← hu₁, ← hu₂, hu]
  simpa [hl]

name: lemma_2_5_E_count_le_orderedUnitPairs
statement:
theorem lemma_2_5_E_count_le_orderedUnitPairs (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (U : Finset 𝒟.K)
    (hU_norm : ∀ u ∈ U, 𝒟.IsNormOneIntegral u)
    (a : 𝒟.V) (R : ℝ)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn 𝒟.π1 (𝒟.X a R)) :
    𝒟.E_count a R U ≤ (orderedUnitPairs (𝒟.P_set a R)).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold AdmissibleDatum.E_count
  rw [show ∑ u ∈ U, ((𝒟.X_finset a R).filter
        (fun x => x + 𝒟.Φ u ∈ 𝒟.X_finset a R)).card
      = (U.sigma (fun u => (𝒟.X_finset a R).filter
          (fun x => x + 𝒟.Φ u ∈ 𝒟.X_finset a R))).card from
      (Finset.card_sigma _ _).symm]
  set src := U.sigma (fun u => (𝒟.X_finset a R).filter
    (fun x => x + 𝒟.Φ u ∈ 𝒟.X_finset a R))
  let g : (Σ _ : 𝒟.K, 𝒟.V) → Point × Point := fun p =>
    (complexPoint (𝒟.π1 (p.2 + 𝒟.Φ p.1)), complexPoint (𝒟.π1 p.2))
  have hmap : ∀ p ∈ src, g p ∈ orderedUnitPairs (𝒟.P_set a R) := by
    intro ⟨u, x⟩ hp
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_filter, src] at hp
    rcases hp with ⟨hu, hx, hx'⟩
    have hxP : complexPoint (𝒟.π1 x) ∈ 𝒟.P_set a R := by
      unfold AdmissibleDatum.P_set
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x, hx, by simp [complexPoint]⟩
    have hyP : complexPoint (𝒟.π1 (x + 𝒟.Φ u)) ∈ 𝒟.P_set a R := by
      unfold AdmissibleDatum.P_set
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x + 𝒟.Φ u, hx', by simp [complexPoint]⟩
    have hdist : dist (complexPoint (𝒟.π1 (x + 𝒟.Φ u))) (complexPoint (𝒟.π1 x)) = 1 := by
      rw [complexPoint_dist]
      have hnorm : ‖adm_σ 𝒟 ⟨0, 𝒟.f_pos⟩ u‖ = 1 :=
        (hU_norm u hu).2.1 (adm_σ 𝒟 ⟨0, 𝒟.f_pos⟩)
      simpa [AdmissibleDatum.π1, AdmissibleDatum.Φ] using hnorm
    refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ?_
    refine ⟨?_, hdist⟩
    rw [Finset.mem_offDiag]
    refine ⟨hyP, hxP, ?_⟩
    intro hEq
    have hEq' : complexPoint (𝒟.π1 (x + 𝒟.Φ u)) = complexPoint (𝒟.π1 x) := by
      simpa [g] using hEq
    have hzero : dist (complexPoint (𝒟.π1 (x + 𝒟.Φ u))) (complexPoint (𝒟.π1 x)) = 0 := by
      rw [hEq']
      exact dist_self _
    rw [hzero] at hdist
    norm_num at hdist
  have hinjg : Set.InjOn g src := by
    intro ⟨u, x⟩ hp ⟨v, y⟩ hq heq
    change Sigma.mk u x ∈ src at hp
    change Sigma.mk v y ∈ src at hq
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_filter, src] at hp hq
    rcases hp with ⟨hu, hx, hx'⟩
    rcases hq with ⟨hv, hy, hy'⟩
    simp only [g, Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
    rcases heq with ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have hπ1 : 𝒟.π1 x = 𝒟.π1 y := complexPoint_injective h2
    have hxy : x = y := hinj
      (by simpa [AdmissibleDatum.X_finset] using hx)
      (by simpa [AdmissibleDatum.X_finset] using hy)
      hπ1
    have hπ2 : 𝒟.π1 (x + 𝒟.Φ u) = 𝒟.π1 (y + 𝒟.Φ v) := complexPoint_injective h1
    have hxy' : x + 𝒟.Φ u = y + 𝒟.Φ v := hinj
      (by simpa [AdmissibleDatum.X_finset] using hx')
      (by simpa [AdmissibleDatum.X_finset] using hy')
      hπ2
    have hΦ : 𝒟.Φ u = 𝒟.Φ v := by
      rw [hxy] at hxy'
      exact add_left_cancel hxy'
    have huv : u = v := AdmissibleDatum.Φ_injective 𝒟 hΦ
    cases huv
    cases hxy
    rfl
  exact Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn g hmap hinjg

name: orderedUnitPairs_card_le_two_mul_nu
statement: theorem orderedUnitPairs_card_le_two_mul_nu (P : Finset Point) : (orderedUnitPairs P).card ≤ 2 * ν P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T : Finset (Point × Point) := orderedUnitPairs P
  let f : Point × Point → Sym2 Point := fun xy => Sym2.mk xy.1 xy.2
  let unitDistSymm : {g : Point → Point → Prop // ∀ a b, g a b = g b a} :=
    ⟨fun a b => dist a b = 1, by
      intro a b
      simp [dist_comm]⟩
  change T.card ≤ 2 * ν P
  have hfiber_le_two : ∀ z ∈ T.image f, ({a ∈ T | f a = z}).card ≤ 2 := by
    intro z hz
    have hnotdiag : ¬ z.IsDiag := by
      rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hz with ⟨xy, hxyT, rfl⟩
      have hxyT' : xy ∈ P.offDiag ∧ dist xy.1 xy.2 = 1 := by
        simpa [T, orderedUnitPairs] using hxyT
      simpa [f] using Finset.not_isDiag_mk_of_mem_offDiag hxyT'.1
    have hcard_le : ({a ∈ T | f a = z}).card ≤ (z.toFinset.offDiag).card := by
      let g : {a // a ∈ {a ∈ T | f a = z}} → {a // a ∈ z.toFinset.offDiag} := by
        intro p
        refine ⟨p.1, ?_⟩
        rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp p.2 with ⟨hpT, hpz⟩
        have hpT' : p.1 ∈ P.offDiag ∧ dist p.1.1 p.1.2 = 1 := by
          simpa [T, orderedUnitPairs] using hpT
        rcases Finset.mem_offDiag.mp hpT'.1 with ⟨_, _, hne⟩
        refine Finset.mem_offDiag.mpr ?_
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, hne⟩
        · have hx : p.1.1 ∈ f p.1 := by
            simpa [f] using Sym2.mem_mk_left p.1.1 p.1.2
          exact (Sym2.mem_toFinset).2 (by
            simpa [hpz] using hx)
        · have hy : p.1.2 ∈ f p.1 := by
            simpa [f] using Sym2.mem_mk_right p.1.1 p.1.2
          exact (Sym2.mem_toFinset).2 (by
            simpa [hpz] using hy)
      have hg_inj : Function.Injective g := by
        intro a b h
        cases a
        cases b
        cases h
        rfl
      exact Finset.card_le_card_of_injective (f := g) hg_inj
    have hz_card : z.toFinset.card = 2 := Sym2.card_toFinset_of_not_isDiag z hnotdiag
    calc
      ({a ∈ T | f a = z}).card ≤ (z.toFinset.offDiag).card := hcard_le
      _ = z.toFinset.card * z.toFinset.card - z.toFinset.card := by
        simpa using (Finset.offDiag_card z.toFinset)
      _ = 2 := by
        rw [hz_card]
  have hT_le : T.card ≤ 2 * (T.image f).card := by
    calc
      T.card = ∑ z ∈ T.image f, ({a ∈ T | f a = z}).card :=
        Finset.card_eq_sum_card_image f T
      _ ≤ ∑ z ∈ T.image f, 2 := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
        intro z hz
        exact hfiber_le_two z hz
      _ = 2 * (T.image f).card := by
        simp [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
  have himage_subset :
      T.image f ⊆ P.sym2.filter (fun z : Sym2 Point => ¬ z.IsDiag ∧ Sym2.lift unitDistSymm z) := by
    intro z hz
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hz with ⟨xy, hxyT, rfl⟩
    have hxyT' : xy ∈ P.offDiag ∧ dist xy.1 xy.2 = 1 := by
      simpa [T, orderedUnitPairs] using hxyT
    rcases Finset.mem_offDiag.mp hxyT'.1 with ⟨hxP, hyP, _⟩
    refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ?_
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [f] using (Finset.mk_mem_sym2_iff).2 ⟨hxP, hyP⟩
    · refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa [f] using Finset.not_isDiag_mk_of_mem_offDiag hxyT'.1
      · simpa [f, unitDistSymm] using hxyT'.2
  have himage_le : (T.image f).card ≤ ν P := by
    simpa [ν, unitDistSymm] using Finset.card_le_card himage_subset
  exact le_trans hT_le (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 himage_le)

name: lemma_2_5
statement:
theorem lemma_2_5 (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (U : Finset 𝒟.K)
    (_hU_norm : ∀ u ∈ U, 𝒟.IsNormOneIntegral u)
    (a : 𝒟.V) (R : ℝ) :
    Set.InjOn 𝒟.π1 (𝒟.X a R) ∧
      2 * ν (𝒟.P_set a R) ≥ 𝒟.E_count a R U
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact lemma_2_5_pi1_injOn 𝒟 a R
  · let hinj : Set.InjOn 𝒟.π1 (𝒟.X a R) := lemma_2_5_pi1_injOn 𝒟 a R
    have hE : 𝒟.E_count a R U ≤ (orderedUnitPairs (𝒟.P_set a R)).card :=
      lemma_2_5_E_count_le_orderedUnitPairs 𝒟 U _hU_norm a R hinj
    have hord : (orderedUnitPairs (𝒟.P_set a R)).card ≤ 2 * ν (𝒟.P_set a R) :=
      orderedUnitPairs_card_le_two_mul_nu (𝒟.P_set a R)
    exact le_trans hE hord

name: P_set_card_eq_N_count
statement:
theorem P_set_card_eq_N_count (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (a : 𝒟.V) (R : ℝ)
    (_hinj : Set.InjOn 𝒟.π1 (𝒟.X a R)) :
    (𝒟.P_set a R).card = 𝒟.N_count a R
proof:
:= by
  classical

  have hinj_comp : Set.InjOn
      (fun z : 𝒟.V =>
        (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![(𝒟.π1 z).re, (𝒟.π1 z).im])
      (𝒟.X a R) := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    have hzw' : (![(𝒟.π1 x).re, (𝒟.π1 x).im] : Fin 2 → ℝ) =
        ![(𝒟.π1 y).re, (𝒟.π1 y).im] :=
      (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm.injective hxy
    have h0 : (𝒟.π1 x).re = (𝒟.π1 y).re :=
      congrArg (fun v : Fin 2 → ℝ => v 0) hzw'
    have h1 : (𝒟.π1 x).im = (𝒟.π1 y).im :=
      congrArg (fun v : Fin 2 → ℝ => v 1) hzw'
    exact _hinj hx hy (Complex.ext h0 h1)

  have hcoe : (𝒟.X_finset a R : Set 𝒟.V) = 𝒟.X a R := by
    simp [AdmissibleDatum.X_finset]

  unfold AdmissibleDatum.P_set AdmissibleDatum.N_count
  apply Finset.card_image_of_injOn
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  exact hinj_comp (by simp [AdmissibleDatum.X_finset] at hx; exact hx)
                  (by simp [AdmissibleDatum.X_finset] at hy; exact hy)
                  hxy

name: complex_ball_packing
statement: theorem complex_ball_packing (n : ℕ) (s : Finset (Fin n → ℂ)) (R δ : ℝ) : 0 ≤ R → 0 < δ → (∀ z ∈ s, ‖z‖ ≤ R) → (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, x ≠ y → δ ≤ dist x y) → (s.card : ℝ) ≤ (2 * R / δ + 1) ^ (2 * n)
proof:
:= by
  intro hR hδ hs hsep
  let r : ℝ := δ / 2
  let μ : MeasureTheory.Measure (Fin n → ℂ) := by
    volume_tac
  have hr : 0 < r := by
    dsimp [r]
    linarith
  have hbigr : 0 < R + r := by linarith
  have hpair : Set.PairwiseDisjoint (s : Set (Fin n → ℂ)) (fun x => Metric.ball x r) := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    apply Metric.ball_disjoint_ball
    dsimp [r]
    have h := hsep x hx y hy hxy
    linarith
  have hsubset : (⋃ x ∈ s, Metric.ball x r) ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : Fin n → ℂ) (R + r) := by
    intro y hy
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hy ⊢
    rcases hy with ⟨x, hx, hy⟩
    have hxR := hs x hx
    have hyx : dist y x < r := hy
    have hy_norm : ‖y - x‖ < r := by
      simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hyx
    have hy_lt : ‖y‖ < R + r := by
      calc
        ‖y‖ = ‖(y - x) + x‖ := by
          congr 1
          abel_nf
        _ ≤ ‖y - x‖ + ‖x‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ < r + R := add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le hy_norm hxR
        _ = R + r := by ring
    simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hy_lt
  have hsum : ∑ x ∈ s, μ (Metric.ball x r) ≤ μ (Metric.ball (0 : Fin n → ℂ) (R + r)) := by
    have hmono : μ (⋃ x ∈ s, Metric.ball x r) ≤ μ (Metric.ball (0 : Fin n → ℂ) (R + r)) := by
      exact MeasureTheory.measure_mono hsubset
    rw [MeasureTheory.measure_biUnion_finset hpair] at hmono
    · exact hmono
    · intro x hx
      exact Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet
  have hvol_small : ∀ x : Fin n → ℂ, μ (Metric.ball x r) = (ENNReal.ofReal r ^ 2 * NNReal.pi) ^ n := by
    intro x
    simpa [μ] using (MeasureTheory.volume_pi_ball x hr)
  have hvol_big : μ (Metric.ball (0 : Fin n → ℂ) (R + r)) = (ENNReal.ofReal (R + r) ^ 2 * NNReal.pi) ^ n := by
    simpa [μ] using (MeasureTheory.volume_pi_ball (0 : Fin n → ℂ) hbigr)
  rw [hvol_big] at hsum
  simp [hvol_small] at hsum
  have hcsmall0 : ENNReal.ofReal r ^ 2 * (NNReal.pi : ENNReal) = ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ 2 * Real.pi) := by
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_pow hr.le, ENNReal.coe_nnreal_eq, NNReal.coe_real_pi, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul]
    positivity
  have hcbig0 : ENNReal.ofReal (R + r) ^ 2 * (NNReal.pi : ENNReal) = ENNReal.ofReal ((R + r) ^ 2 * Real.pi) := by
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_pow (show 0 ≤ R + r by linarith), ENNReal.coe_nnreal_eq, NNReal.coe_real_pi, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul]
    positivity
  have hcsmall : (ENNReal.ofReal r ^ 2 * (NNReal.pi : ENNReal)) ^ n = ENNReal.ofReal ((r ^ 2 * Real.pi) ^ n) := by
    rw [hcsmall0, ← ENNReal.ofReal_pow]
    positivity
  have hcbig : (ENNReal.ofReal (R + r) ^ 2 * (NNReal.pi : ENNReal)) ^ n = ENNReal.ofReal (((R + r) ^ 2 * Real.pi) ^ n) := by
    rw [hcbig0, ← ENNReal.ofReal_pow]
    positivity
  rw [hcsmall, hcbig] at hsum
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_natCast s.card, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (show 0 ≤ (s.card : ℝ) by positivity)] at hsum
  have hsum' : (s.card : ℝ) * ((r ^ 2 * Real.pi) ^ n) ≤ (((R + r) ^ 2 * Real.pi) ^ n) := by
    exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (by positivity)).mp hsum
  have hratio : (s.card : ℝ) ≤ ((((R + r) ^ 2 * Real.pi) / (r ^ 2 * Real.pi)) ^ n) := by
    have hApos : 0 < (r ^ 2 * Real.pi) ^ n := by positivity
    have := (le_div_iff₀ hApos).2 hsum'
    simpa [div_pow] using this
  have hratio' : (s.card : ℝ) ≤ (((R + r) / r) ^ (2 * n)) := by
    have hdiv : (((R + r) ^ 2 * Real.pi) / (r ^ 2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) = ((R + r) / r) ^ 2 := by
      field_simp [Real.pi_pos.ne', hr.ne']
    rw [hdiv] at hratio
    simpa [pow_mul] using hratio
  have hrw : (R + r) / r = 2 * R / δ + 1 := by
    dsimp [r]
    field_simp [hδ.ne']
  simpa [hrw] using hratio'

name: lattice_nonzero_norm_ge_inv_denom
statement: theorem lattice_nonzero_norm_ge_inv_denom (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) {z : 𝒟.V} : z ∈ (𝒟.Λ : Set 𝒟.V) → z ≠ 0 → (1 / 𝒟.denom : ℝ) ≤ ‖z‖
proof:
:= by
  intro hz hne
  rcases hz with ⟨u, ⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩
  have hu : u ≠ 0 := by
    intro hu0
    apply hne
    ext i
    simp [AdmissibleDatum.Φ, hu0]
  have hxK_ne : (x : 𝒟.K) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hxzero
    have hmul0 : ((𝒟.Q : 𝒟.K) ^ 2) * u = 0 := by
      simpa [hxzero] using hx
    have hQ0 : ((𝒟.Q : 𝒟.K) ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by
      exact pow_ne_zero 2 (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt 𝒟.Q_pos))
    exact hu ((mul_eq_zero.mp hmul0).resolve_left hQ0)
  have hx_ne : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hxzero
    exact hxK_ne (by simpa using hxzero)
  by_contra hlt
  have hlt' : ‖𝒟.Φ u‖ < (1 / 𝒟.denom : ℝ) := by
    simpa using not_le.mp hlt
  have hsupu : 𝒟.supNorm (𝒟.Φ u) < (1 / 𝒟.denom : ℝ) := by
    simpa [supNorm_eq_norm] using hlt'
  have hcoord_le : ∀ i : Fin 𝒟.f, ‖adm_σ 𝒟 i u‖ ≤ 𝒟.supNorm (𝒟.Φ u) := by
    intro i
    unfold AdmissibleDatum.supNorm
    simpa [AdmissibleDatum.Φ] using
      (Finset.le_sup' (s := Finset.univ) (f := fun r : Fin 𝒟.f => ‖𝒟.Φ u r‖)
        (b := i) (by simp))
  have hcoord : ∀ i : Fin 𝒟.f, ‖adm_σ 𝒟 i u‖ < (1 / 𝒟.denom : ℝ) := by
    intro i
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hcoord_le i) hsupu
  have hmap : ∀ i : Fin 𝒟.f, (𝒟.denom : ℂ) * adm_σ 𝒟 i u = adm_σ 𝒟 i (x : 𝒟.K) := by
    intro i
    simpa [AdmissibleDatum.denom, map_mul, map_pow, AdmissibleDatum.Q, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using congrArg (adm_σ 𝒟 i) hx
  have hnorm : ∀ i : Fin 𝒟.f, ‖adm_σ 𝒟 i (x : 𝒟.K)‖ = (𝒟.denom : ℝ) * ‖adm_σ 𝒟 i u‖ := by
    intro i
    rw [← hmap i, norm_mul]
    simp
  have hxcoord : ∀ i : Fin 𝒟.f, ‖adm_σ 𝒟 i (x : 𝒟.K)‖ < 1 := by
    intro i
    have hdpos : (0 : ℝ) < 𝒟.denom := by exact_mod_cast 𝒟.denom_pos
    have hmul : (𝒟.denom : ℝ) * ‖adm_σ 𝒟 i u‖ < (𝒟.denom : ℝ) * (1 / 𝒟.denom : ℝ) :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (hcoord i) hdpos
    rw [hnorm i]
    have hdenom0 : (𝒟.denom : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt 𝒟.denom_pos)
    simpa [hdenom0] using hmul
  have hc_sq : ∀ x : 𝒟.K, 𝒟.c (𝒟.c x) = x := by
    have hext : (𝒟.c : 𝒟.K →ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K).comp (𝒟.c : 𝒟.K →ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K)
        = AlgHom.id 𝒟.L 𝒟.K := by
      refine AlgHom.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top (𝒟.adjoin_i_K_eq_top) ?_
      intro y hy
      have hy_eq : y = 𝒟.i_K := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hy
      subst hy_eq
      simp [𝒟.c_i_K, map_neg]
    intro x
    have hx := AlgHom.congr_fun hext x
    simpa using hx
  have hc_symm : (𝒟.c).symm = 𝒟.c := by
    ext x
    have := hc_sq ((𝒟.c).symm x)
    simpa using this.symm
  have haut : ∀ σ : 𝒟.K ≃ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K, σ = 1 ∨ σ = 𝒟.c := by
    intro σ
    have hσ_sq : σ 𝒟.i_K * σ 𝒟.i_K = -1 := by
      have h1 : σ (𝒟.i_K * 𝒟.i_K) = σ (-1) := by rw [𝒟.i_K_sq]
      rw [map_mul, map_neg, map_one] at h1
      exact h1
    have hprod : (σ 𝒟.i_K - 𝒟.i_K) * (σ 𝒟.i_K + 𝒟.i_K) = 0 := by
      have : (σ 𝒟.i_K - 𝒟.i_K) * (σ 𝒟.i_K + 𝒟.i_K)
          = σ 𝒟.i_K * σ 𝒟.i_K - 𝒟.i_K * 𝒟.i_K := by ring
      rw [this, hσ_sq, 𝒟.i_K_sq, sub_self]
    have hσ_cases : σ 𝒟.i_K = 𝒟.i_K ∨ σ 𝒟.i_K = -𝒟.i_K := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hprod with h | h
      · exact Or.inl (sub_eq_zero.mp h)
      · exact Or.inr (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h)
    rcases hσ_cases with hid | hc
    · left
      have hext : (σ : 𝒟.K →ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K) = AlgHom.id 𝒟.L 𝒟.K := by
        refine AlgHom.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top (𝒟.adjoin_i_K_eq_top) ?_
        intro y hy
        have : y = 𝒟.i_K := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hy
        subst this
        simpa using hid
      ext x
      have := AlgHom.congr_fun hext x
      simpa using this
    · right
      have hext : (σ : 𝒟.K →ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K) = (𝒟.c : 𝒟.K →ₐ[𝒟.L] 𝒟.K) := by
        refine AlgHom.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top (𝒟.adjoin_i_K_eq_top) ?_
        intro y hy
        have hy_eq : y = 𝒟.i_K := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hy
        subst hy_eq
        change σ 𝒟.i_K = 𝒟.c 𝒟.i_K
        rw [hc, 𝒟.c_i_K]
      ext x
      have := AlgHom.congr_fun hext x
      simpa using this
  let restr : Fin 𝒟.f → (𝒟.L →+* ℂ) := fun i => (adm_σ 𝒟 i).comp (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K)
  have hrestr_inj : Function.Injective restr := by
    intro i j hij
    by_contra hneij
    exact 𝒟.adm_σ_restrict_distinct i j hneij hij
  have hrestr_bij : Function.Bijective restr := by
    refine (Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card restr).2 ?_
    constructor
    · exact hrestr_inj
    · rw [Fintype.card_fin, NumberField.Embeddings.card (K := 𝒟.L) (A := ℂ)]
      rfl
  have hrestr_surj : Function.Surjective restr := hrestr_bij.surjective
  have hall : ∀ σ : 𝒟.K →+* ℂ, ‖σ (x : 𝒟.K)‖ < 1 := by
    intro σ
    let ψ : 𝒟.L →+* ℂ := σ.comp (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K)
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hrestr_surj ψ
    have hcomp : (adm_σ 𝒟 i).comp (algebraMap 𝒟.L 𝒟.K) = ψ := hi
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.exists_comp_symm_eq_of_comp_eq
      (adm_σ 𝒟 i) σ (by simpa [ψ] using hcomp)
    rcases haut τ with hτ1 | hτc
    · rw [hτ1] at hτ
      have hEq : adm_σ 𝒟 i = σ := by simpa using hτ
      simpa [hEq] using hxcoord i
    · rw [hτc] at hτ
      have hEq : (adm_σ 𝒟 i).comp 𝒟.c = σ := by simpa [hc_symm] using hτ
      have hEval : σ (x : 𝒟.K) = star ((adm_σ 𝒟 i) (x : 𝒟.K)) := by
        have hEval' := congrArg (fun φ : 𝒟.K →+* ℂ => φ (x : 𝒟.K)) hEq
        change (adm_σ 𝒟 i) (𝒟.c (x : 𝒟.K)) = σ (x : 𝒟.K) at hEval'
        rw [complex_embedding_conjugation_compat 𝒟 (adm_σ 𝒟 i) (x : 𝒟.K)] at hEval'
        simpa using hEval'.symm
      simpa [hEval] using hxcoord i
  have hint : IsIntegral ℤ (x : 𝒟.K) := NumberField.RingOfIntegers.isIntegral_coe x
  have hle : ∀ σ : 𝒟.K →+* ℂ, ‖σ (x : 𝒟.K)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro σ
    exact le_of_lt (hall σ)
  rcases NumberField.Embeddings.pow_eq_one_of_norm_le_one (K := 𝒟.K) (A := ℂ) hxK_ne hint hle with ⟨n, hnpos, hpow⟩
  have hpow0 := congrArg (adm_σ 𝒟 ⟨0, 𝒟.f_pos⟩) hpow
  have hx0lt := hxcoord ⟨0, 𝒟.f_pos⟩
  have hpow_eq_one : ‖adm_σ 𝒟 ⟨0, 𝒟.f_pos⟩ (x : 𝒟.K)‖ ^ n = 1 := by
    have := congrArg (fun z : ℂ => ‖z‖) hpow0
    simpa [map_pow, norm_pow] using this
  have hpowlt : ‖adm_σ 𝒟 ⟨0, 𝒟.f_pos⟩ (x : 𝒟.K)‖ ^ n < 1 := by
    exact pow_lt_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hx0lt (Nat.ne_of_gt hnpos)
  rw [hpow_eq_one] at hpowlt
  linarith

name: X_separated
statement: theorem X_separated (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (a : 𝒟.V) (R : ℝ) {x y : 𝒟.V} : x ∈ 𝒟.X a R → y ∈ 𝒟.X a R → x ≠ y → (1 / 𝒟.denom : ℝ) ≤ dist x y
proof:
:= by
  intro hx hy hxy
  rcases hx with ⟨hx, _⟩
  rcases hy with ⟨hy, _⟩
  rcases hx with ⟨l₁, rfl⟩
  rcases hy with ⟨l₂, rfl⟩
  have hmem : ((l₁ - l₂ : 𝒟.Λ) : 𝒟.V) ∈ (𝒟.Λ : Set 𝒟.V) := by
    exact (l₁ - l₂).property
  have hne : ((l₁ - l₂ : 𝒟.Λ) : 𝒟.V) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hxy
    have h' : ((l₁ : 𝒟.V) - (l₂ : 𝒟.V)) = 0 := by
      simpa using h
    have heq : (l₁ : 𝒟.V) = (l₂ : 𝒟.V) := sub_eq_zero.mp h'
    simpa [heq]
  have hsep := lattice_nonzero_norm_ge_inv_denom 𝒟 hmem hne
  simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hsep

name: lemma_2_6
statement:
theorem lemma_2_6 (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (a : 𝒟.V) (R : ℝ)
    (hR : 1 / 2 < R) :
    (𝒟.N_count a R : ℝ) ≤ (4 * R * 𝒟.denom) ^ (2 * 𝒟.f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold AdmissibleDatum.N_count
  have hR_nonneg : 0 ≤ R := by
    linarith
  have hdenom_posR : (0 : ℝ) < 𝒟.denom := by
    exact_mod_cast 𝒟.denom_pos
  have hdelta : 0 < (1 / 𝒟.denom : ℝ) := by
    exact one_div_pos.mpr hdenom_posR
  have hnorm : ∀ z ∈ 𝒟.X_finset a R, ‖z‖ ≤ R := by
    intro z hz
    have hzX : z ∈ 𝒟.X a R := by
      simpa [AdmissibleDatum.X_finset] using hz
    have hzB : z ∈ 𝒟.closedPolydisc R := hzX.2
    simpa [AdmissibleDatum.closedPolydisc, supNorm_eq_norm] using hzB
  have hsep : ∀ x ∈ 𝒟.X_finset a R, ∀ y ∈ 𝒟.X_finset a R, x ≠ y → (1 / 𝒟.denom : ℝ) ≤ dist x y := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    have hxX : x ∈ 𝒟.X a R := by
      simpa [AdmissibleDatum.X_finset] using hx
    have hyX : y ∈ 𝒟.X a R := by
      simpa [AdmissibleDatum.X_finset] using hy
    exact X_separated 𝒟 a R hxX hyX hxy
  have hpack : ((𝒟.X_finset a R).card : ℝ) ≤ (2 * R / (1 / 𝒟.denom : ℝ) + 1) ^ (2 * 𝒟.f) := by
    exact complex_ball_packing 𝒟.f (𝒟.X_finset a R) R (1 / 𝒟.denom) hR_nonneg hdelta hnorm hsep
  refine le_trans hpack ?_
  have hdenom_ne : (𝒟.denom : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hdenom_posR
  have hbase_eq : 2 * R / (1 / 𝒟.denom : ℝ) + 1 = 2 * R * 𝒟.denom + 1 := by
    field_simp [hdenom_ne]
  rw [hbase_eq]
  have hdenom_ge : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 𝒟.denom := by
    exact_mod_cast 𝒟.one_le_denom
  have hbase_ge_one : 1 ≤ 2 * R * 𝒟.denom := by
    nlinarith
  have hbase_nonneg : 0 ≤ 2 * R * 𝒟.denom + 1 := by
    linarith
  have hbase_le : 2 * R * 𝒟.denom + 1 ≤ 4 * R * 𝒟.denom := by
    linarith
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hbase_nonneg hbase_le (2 * 𝒟.f)

name: E_count_le_N_count_sq
statement:
theorem E_count_le_N_count_sq (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (a : 𝒟.V) (R : ℝ)
    (U : Finset 𝒟.K) :
    𝒟.E_count a R U ≤ 𝒟.N_count a R ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold AdmissibleDatum.E_count AdmissibleDatum.N_count

  rw [show ∑ u ∈ U, ((𝒟.X_finset a R).filter
        (fun x => x + 𝒟.Φ u ∈ 𝒟.X_finset a R)).card
      = (U.sigma (fun u => (𝒟.X_finset a R).filter
          (fun x => x + 𝒟.Φ u ∈ 𝒟.X_finset a R))).card from
      (Finset.card_sigma _ _).symm]
  set src := U.sigma (fun u => (𝒟.X_finset a R).filter
    (fun x => x + 𝒟.Φ u ∈ 𝒟.X_finset a R))
  set tgt := (𝒟.X_finset a R) ×ˢ (𝒟.X_finset a R)

  let g : (Σ _ : 𝒟.K, 𝒟.V) → 𝒟.V × 𝒟.V := fun p => (p.2, p.2 + 𝒟.Φ p.1)
  have hmap : ∀ p ∈ src, g p ∈ tgt := by
    intro ⟨u, x⟩ hp
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_filter, src] at hp
    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hp.2.1, hp.2.2⟩
  have hinj : Set.InjOn g src := by
    intro ⟨u, x⟩ _ ⟨v, y⟩ _ heq
    simp only [g, Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
    obtain ⟨hxy, hΦ⟩ := heq
    have huv : 𝒟.Φ u = 𝒟.Φ v := by
      have : x + 𝒟.Φ u = y + 𝒟.Φ v := hΦ
      rw [hxy] at this
      exact add_left_cancel this
    have huv' : u = v := AdmissibleDatum.Φ_injective 𝒟 huv
    subst hxy; subst huv'; rfl
  calc src.card
      ≤ tgt.card := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn g hmap hinj
    _ = (𝒟.X_finset a R).card * (𝒟.X_finset a R).card := by
        simp [tgt, Finset.card_product]
    _ = (𝒟.X_finset a R).card ^ 2 := by ring

name: theorem_2_3_absorb_factor_two
statement:
theorem theorem_2_3_absorb_factor_two (n A δ : ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (hδpos : 0 < δ)
    (hA : (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / δ) ≤ A) (hAn : A ≤ n) :
    (2 : ℝ) * n ^ (1 + δ) ≤ n ^ (1 + 2 * δ)
proof:
:= by
  have hδnonneg : 0 ≤ δ := le_of_lt hδpos
  have htwo_nonneg : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / δ) := by
    positivity
  have htwo_le_nδ : (2 : ℝ) ≤ n ^ δ := by
    have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow htwo_nonneg (le_trans hA hAn) hδnonneg
    have htwo : ((2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / δ)) ^ δ = (2 : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ))]
      have hδmul : (1 / δ) * δ = 1 := by
        field_simp [hδpos.ne']
      rw [hδmul, Real.rpow_one]
    rw [htwo] at h
    exact h
  have hn_pow_nonneg : 0 ≤ n ^ (1 + δ) := by
    positivity
  have hmul : (2 : ℝ) * n ^ (1 + δ) ≤ n ^ δ * n ^ (1 + δ) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htwo_le_nδ hn_pow_nonneg
  have hrewrite : n ^ δ * n ^ (1 + δ) = n ^ (1 + 2 * δ) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hn δ (1 + δ)]
    have hexp : δ + (1 + δ) = 1 + 2 * δ := by ring
    rw [hexp]
  calc
    (2 : ℝ) * n ^ (1 + δ) ≤ n ^ δ * n ^ (1 + δ) := hmul
    _ = n ^ (1 + 2 * δ) := hrewrite

name: theorem_2_3_choose_radius
statement:
theorem theorem_2_3_choose_radius (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 1 / 2 < R ∧ 0 < 𝒟.ρ R ∧ -(γ / 2) < Real.log (𝒟.ρ R)
proof:
:= by
  let hρ : Filter.Tendsto 𝒟.ρ Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := ρ_tends_to_one 𝒟
  have hpos : ∀ᶠ R : ℝ in Filter.atTop, 0 < 𝒟.ρ R := by
    exact hρ.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num))
  have hlog : Filter.Tendsto (fun R : ℝ => Real.log (𝒟.ρ R)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using Filter.Tendsto.log hρ one_ne_zero
  have hloglb : ∀ᶠ R : ℝ in Filter.atTop, -(γ / 2) < Real.log (𝒟.ρ R) := by
    exact hlog.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds (by nlinarith : -(γ / 2) < (0 : ℝ)))
  have hgt : ∀ᶠ R : ℝ in Filter.atTop, 1 / 2 < R := by
    exact Filter.eventually_gt_atTop (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  have hall : ∀ᶠ R : ℝ in Filter.atTop, 1 / 2 < R ∧ 0 < 𝒟.ρ R ∧ -(γ / 2) < Real.log (𝒟.ρ R) := by
    filter_upwards [hgt, hpos, hloglb] with R hgtR hposR hlogR
    exact ⟨hgtR, hposR, hlogR⟩
  rw [Filter.eventually_atTop] at hall
  rcases hall with ⟨R0, hR0⟩
  exact ⟨R0, hR0 R0 le_rfl⟩

name: theorem_2_3_denom_eq
statement:
theorem theorem_2_3_denom_eq (t : ℕ) (q : Fin t → ℕ) (𝒟 : ℕ → AdmissibleDatum)
    (sameT : ∀ j, (𝒟 j).t = t)
    (sameQ : ∀ j (b : Fin t),
      (𝒟 j).q (Fin.cast (sameT j).symm b) = q b)
    (j : ℕ) :
    ((𝒟 j).denom : ℝ) = theorem_2_3_denConst t q
proof:
:= by
  unfold AdmissibleDatum.denom AdmissibleDatum.Q theorem_2_3_denConst
  have hprod : ∏ b : Fin ((𝒟 j).t), (𝒟 j).q b = ∏ b : Fin t, q b := by
    simpa [sameQ] using
      (Fin.prod_congr' (h := (sameT j).symm) (f := (𝒟 j).q)).symm
  rw [hprod]

name: theorem_2_3_denConst_one_le
statement:
theorem theorem_2_3_denConst_one_le (t : ℕ) (q : Fin t → ℕ) (𝒟 : ℕ → AdmissibleDatum)
    (sameT : ∀ j, (𝒟 j).t = t)
    (sameQ : ∀ j (b : Fin t),
      (𝒟 j).q (Fin.cast (sameT j).symm b) = q b) :
    1 ≤ theorem_2_3_denConst t q
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((𝒟 0).denom : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (𝒟 0).one_le_denom
  rw [theorem_2_3_denom_eq t q 𝒟 sameT sameQ 0] at h0
  exact h0

name: theorem_2_3_example_bounds
statement:
theorem theorem_2_3_example_bounds (t : ℕ) (q : Fin t → ℕ)
    (𝒟 : ℕ → AdmissibleDatum)
    (sameT : ∀ j, (𝒟 j).t = t)
    (sameQ : ∀ j (b : Fin t),
      (𝒟 j).q (Fin.cast (sameT j).symm b) = q b)
    (H : ℝ) (hH : 0 < H)
    (hClass : ∀ j, (NumberField.classNumber (𝒟 j).K : ℝ) ≤ H ^ (𝒟 j).f)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 1 / 2 < R)
    (hρ0_pos : 0 < (𝒟 0).ρ R)
    (hρ0 : -(theorem_2_3_gamma t H / 2) < Real.log ((𝒟 0).ρ R))
    (j : ℕ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧
      Real.exp ((theorem_2_3_gamma t H / 2) * (𝒟 j).f) ≤ (n : ℝ) ∧
      (n : ℝ) ≤ (4 * R * theorem_2_3_denConst t q) ^ (2 * (𝒟 j).f) ∧
      (2 : ℝ) * (νn n : ℝ) ≥
        Real.exp ((theorem_2_3_gamma t H / 2) * (𝒟 j).f) * n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hρj_pos : 0 < (𝒟 j).ρ R := by
    simpa [AdmissibleDatum.ρ, AdmissibleDatum.b] using hρ0_pos
  have hρj :
      -(((𝒟 j).t * Real.log 2 - Real.log H) / 2) < Real.log ((𝒟 j).ρ R) := by
    simpa [theorem_2_3_gamma, sameT j, AdmissibleDatum.ρ, AdmissibleDatum.b] using hρ0
  rcases proposition_2_2 (𝒟 j) H hH (hClass j) with ⟨U, hUcard, hUnorm⟩
  rcases lemma_2_4 (𝒟 j) H hH R hR U hUnorm hUcard hρj_pos hρj with ⟨a, hNpos, hE⟩
  refine ⟨(𝒟 j).N_count a R, hNpos, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hnR : 0 < ((𝒟 j).N_count a R : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hNpos
    have hE' :
        ((𝒟 j).E_count a R U : ℝ) ≥
          Real.exp ((theorem_2_3_gamma t H / 2) * (𝒟 j).f) *
            ((𝒟 j).N_count a R : ℝ) := by
      simpa [theorem_2_3_gamma, sameT j, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm,
        div_eq_mul_inv] using hE
    have hEsqR : ((𝒟 j).E_count a R U : ℝ) ≤ ((𝒟 j).N_count a R : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      exact_mod_cast E_count_le_N_count_sq (𝒟 j) a R U
    have hEN :
        Real.exp ((theorem_2_3_gamma t H / 2) * (𝒟 j).f) *
            ((𝒟 j).N_count a R : ℝ) ≤
          ((𝒟 j).N_count a R : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      linarith
    by_contra hlt
    have hlt' :
        ((𝒟 j).N_count a R : ℝ) < Real.exp ((theorem_2_3_gamma t H / 2) * (𝒟 j).f) := by
      linarith
    have hsq_lt :
        ((𝒟 j).N_count a R : ℝ) ^ 2 <
          Real.exp ((theorem_2_3_gamma t H / 2) * (𝒟 j).f) *
            ((𝒟 j).N_count a R : ℝ) := by
      have hmul :
          ((𝒟 j).N_count a R : ℝ) * ((𝒟 j).N_count a R : ℝ) <
            Real.exp ((theorem_2_3_gamma t H / 2) * (𝒟 j).f) *
              ((𝒟 j).N_count a R : ℝ) := by
        exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hlt' hnR
      simpa [pow_two, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using hmul
    linarith
  · have hNle := lemma_2_6 (𝒟 j) a R hR
    rw [theorem_2_3_denom_eq t q 𝒟 sameT sameQ j] at hNle
    simpa using hNle
  · have hν := lemma_2_5 (𝒟 j) U hUnorm a R
    have hcard : ((𝒟 j).P_set a R).card = (𝒟 j).N_count a R :=
      P_set_card_eq_N_count (𝒟 j) a R hν.1
    have hνn_nat0 : ν ((𝒟 j).P_set a R) ≤ νn ((𝒟 j).N_count a R) := by
      simpa [hcard] using (νn_ge_ν ((𝒟 j).P_set a R))
    have hνn_nat : 2 * ν ((𝒟 j).P_set a R) ≤ 2 * νn ((𝒟 j).N_count a R) := by
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hνn_nat0
    have hEν_nat : (𝒟 j).E_count a R U ≤ 2 * νn ((𝒟 j).N_count a R) := by
      exact le_trans hν.2 hνn_nat
    have hEν : ((𝒟 j).E_count a R U : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) * (νn ((𝒟 j).N_count a R) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hEν_nat
    have hE' :
        ((𝒟 j).E_count a R U : ℝ) ≥
          Real.exp ((theorem_2_3_gamma t H / 2) * (𝒟 j).f) *
            ((𝒟 j).N_count a R : ℝ) := by
      simpa [theorem_2_3_gamma, sameT j, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm,
        div_eq_mul_inv] using hE
    linarith

name: theorem_2_3_rpow_control
statement:
theorem theorem_2_3_rpow_control (C γ δ n : ℝ) (f : ℕ)
    (hC : 1 < C) (hn : 0 < n) (hδpos : 0 < δ)
    (hδ : δ = γ / (8 * Real.log C))
    (hn_upper : n ≤ C ^ (2 * f)) :
    n ^ (2 * δ) ≤ Real.exp ((γ / 2) * f)
proof:
:= by
  have hCpos : 0 < C := lt_trans zero_lt_one hC
  have hlogCpos : 0 < Real.log C := Real.log_pos hC
  have hδ_nonneg : 0 ≤ 2 * δ := by
    positivity
  have hlogn : Real.log n ≤ Real.log (C ^ (2 * f)) := by
    exact Real.log_le_log hn hn_upper
  rw [← Real.rpow_natCast C (2 * f), Real.log_rpow hCpos ((2 * f : ℕ) : ℝ)] at hlogn
  norm_num [Nat.cast_mul] at hlogn
  have hmul : (2 * δ) * Real.log n ≤ (2 * δ) * (((2 : ℝ) * f) * Real.log C) := by
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogn hδ_nonneg
  apply (Real.rpow_le_iff_le_log hn (Real.exp_pos _)).2
  rw [Real.log_exp]
  have hcoeff : (2 * δ) * (((2 : ℝ) * f) * Real.log C) = (γ / 2) * f := by
    rw [hδ]
    field_simp [hlogCpos.ne']
    ring
  calc
    (2 * δ) * Real.log n ≤ (2 * δ) * (((2 : ℝ) * f) * Real.log C) := hmul
    _ = (γ / 2) * f := hcoeff

name: theorem_2_3_large_example
statement:
theorem theorem_2_3_large_example (t : ℕ) (q : Fin t → ℕ)
    (𝒟 : ℕ → AdmissibleDatum)
    (sameT : ∀ j, (𝒟 j).t = t)
    (sameQ : ∀ j (b : Fin t),
      (𝒟 j).q (Fin.cast (sameT j).symm b) = q b)
    (H : ℝ) (hH : 0 < H)
    (hClass : ∀ j, (NumberField.classNumber (𝒟 j).K : ℝ) ≤ H ^ (𝒟 j).f)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 1 / 2 < R)
    (hρ0_pos : 0 < (𝒟 0).ρ R)
    (hρ0 : -(theorem_2_3_gamma t H / 2) < Real.log ((𝒟 0).ρ R))
    (δ : ℝ) (hδpos : 0 < δ)
    (hδ :
      δ = theorem_2_3_gamma t H /
        (8 * Real.log (4 * R * theorem_2_3_denConst t q)))
    (A : ℝ)
    (hA : (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / δ) ≤ A)
    (j : ℕ)
    (hlarge : A ≤ Real.exp ((theorem_2_3_gamma t H / 2) * (𝒟 j).f)) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ A ≤ (n : ℝ) ∧ (νn n : ℝ) ≥ (n : ℝ) ^ (1 + δ)
proof:
:= by
  set γ : ℝ := theorem_2_3_gamma t H
  set D : ℝ := theorem_2_3_denConst t q
  set C : ℝ := 4 * R * D
  rcases theorem_2_3_example_bounds t q 𝒟 sameT sameQ H hH hClass R hR hρ0_pos hρ0 j with
    ⟨n, hnpos, hExpLe, hn_upper, hν⟩
  have hδ' : δ = γ / (8 * Real.log C) := by
    simpa [γ, D, C] using hδ
  have hlarge' : A ≤ Real.exp ((γ / 2) * (𝒟 j).f) := by
    simpa [γ] using hlarge
  have hExpLe' : Real.exp ((γ / 2) * (𝒟 j).f) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by
    simpa [γ] using hExpLe
  have hn_upper' : (n : ℝ) ≤ C ^ (2 * (𝒟 j).f) := by
    simpa [C, D] using hn_upper
  have hν' : (2 : ℝ) * (νn n : ℝ) ≥ Real.exp ((γ / 2) * (𝒟 j).f) * (n : ℝ) := by
    simpa [γ] using hν
  have hA_le_n : A ≤ (n : ℝ) := le_trans hlarge' hExpLe'
  have hD_one : 1 ≤ D := by
    simpa [D] using theorem_2_3_denConst_one_le t q 𝒟 sameT sameQ
  have hC_gt_one : 1 < C := by
    nlinarith
  have hn_pos_real : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hnpos
  have hn_rpow_le : (n : ℝ) ^ (2 * δ) ≤ Real.exp ((γ / 2) * (𝒟 j).f) := by
    exact theorem_2_3_rpow_control C γ δ (n : ℝ) (𝒟 j).f hC_gt_one hn_pos_real hδpos hδ' hn_upper'
  have hexp1 : (1 + 2 * δ : ℝ) = (2 * δ) + 1 := by
    ring
  have hν_ge_pow : (n : ℝ) ^ (1 + 2 * δ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) * (νn n : ℝ) := by
    have hmul : (n : ℝ) ^ (2 * δ) * (n : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp ((γ / 2) * (𝒟 j).f) * (n : ℝ) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hn_rpow_le (by positivity)
    calc
      (n : ℝ) ^ (1 + 2 * δ) = (n : ℝ) ^ ((2 * δ) + 1) := by rw [hexp1]
      _ = (n : ℝ) ^ (2 * δ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_add hn_pos_real]
      _ = (n : ℝ) ^ (2 * δ) * (n : ℝ) := by rw [Real.rpow_one]
      _ ≤ Real.exp ((γ / 2) * (𝒟 j).f) * (n : ℝ) := hmul
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) * (νn n : ℝ) := by linarith [hν']
  have htwo_mul_pow_le : (2 : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (1 + δ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ (1 + 2 * δ) := by
    exact theorem_2_3_absorb_factor_two (n : ℝ) A δ hn_pos_real hδpos hA hA_le_n
  refine ⟨n, hnpos, hA_le_n, ?_⟩
  have htwo_mul_pow_le_nu : (2 : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (1 + δ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) * (νn n : ℝ) :=
    le_trans htwo_mul_pow_le hν_ge_pow
  linarith

name: theorem_2_3
statement:
theorem theorem_2_3 (t : ℕ) (_ht_pos : 0 < t) (q : Fin t → ℕ)
    (𝒟 : ℕ → AdmissibleDatum)
    (sameT : ∀ j, (𝒟 j).t = t)
    (_sameQ : ∀ j (b : Fin t),
        (𝒟 j).q (Fin.cast (sameT j).symm b) = q b)
    (H : ℝ) (hH : 0 < H)
    (_hClass : ∀ j, (NumberField.classNumber (𝒟 j).K : ℝ) ≤ H ^ (𝒟 j).f)
    (_degsUnbounded : ∀ N, ∃ j, N ≤ (𝒟 j).f)
    (_hγ : 0 < (t : ℝ) * Real.log 2 - Real.log H) :
    ∃ δ > (0 : ℝ),
      {n : ℕ | 0 < n ∧ (νn n : ℝ) ≥ (n : ℝ) ^ (1 + δ)}.Infinite
proof:
:= by
  let γ : ℝ := theorem_2_3_gamma t H
  have hγ : 0 < γ := by
    simpa [γ, theorem_2_3_gamma] using _hγ
  rcases theorem_2_3_choose_radius (𝒟 0) γ hγ with ⟨R, hR, hρ0_pos, hρ0⟩
  let D : ℝ := theorem_2_3_denConst t q
  have hD_eq : ((𝒟 0).denom : ℝ) = D := by
    simpa [D] using theorem_2_3_denom_eq t q 𝒟 sameT _sameQ 0
  have hD_pos : 0 < D := by
    have h : 0 < ((𝒟 0).denom : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (𝒟 0).denom_pos
    simpa [hD_eq] using h
  have hD_one : 1 ≤ D := by
    have h : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((𝒟 0).denom : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (𝒟 0).denom_pos)
    simpa [hD_eq] using h
  have h4R : 2 < 4 * R := by
    nlinarith [hR]
  have h4R_nonneg : 0 ≤ 4 * R := by
    nlinarith [hR]
  have hmul : 4 * R ≤ 4 * R * D := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hD_one h4R_nonneg
    simpa [mul_assoc] using this
  have h4RD_gt_two : 2 < 4 * R * D := by
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le h4R hmul
  have h4RD_gt_one : 1 < 4 * R * D := by
    have : (1 : ℝ) < 2 := by norm_num
    exact lt_trans this h4RD_gt_two
  have hlog_pos : 0 < Real.log (4 * R * D) := by
    exact Real.log_pos h4RD_gt_one
  let δ : ℝ := γ / (8 * Real.log (4 * R * D))
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := by
    have hden : 0 < 8 * Real.log (4 * R * D) := by
      nlinarith [hlog_pos]
    have : 0 < γ / (8 * Real.log (4 * R * D)) := by
      exact div_pos hγ hden
    simpa [δ] using this
  refine ⟨δ, hδpos, ?_⟩
  refine Set.infinite_of_forall_exists_gt ?_
  intro M
  let A : ℝ := max ((M + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ((2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / δ))
  have hA : (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / δ) ≤ A := by
    exact le_max_right _ _
  have hγhalf : 0 < γ / 2 := by
    nlinarith [hγ]
  have h_tendsto1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (γ / 2) * (N : ℝ)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
    exact Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop hγhalf tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have h_tendsto2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => Real.exp ((γ / 2) * (N : ℝ))) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
    exact (Real.tendsto_exp_comp_atTop).2 h_tendsto1
  have hAevent : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in Filter.atTop, A ≤ Real.exp ((γ / 2) * (N : ℝ)) := by
    exact h_tendsto2.eventually_ge_atTop A
  rcases Filter.eventually_atTop.1 hAevent with ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩
  rcases _degsUnbounded N₀ with ⟨j, hj⟩
  have hlarge' : A ≤ Real.exp ((γ / 2) * ((𝒟 j).f : ℝ)) := by
    exact hN₀ _ hj
  have hlarge : A ≤ Real.exp ((theorem_2_3_gamma t H / 2) * (𝒟 j).f) := by
    simpa [γ] using hlarge'
  rcases theorem_2_3_large_example t q 𝒟 sameT _sameQ H hH _hClass R hR hρ0_pos (by simpa [γ] using hρ0) δ hδpos (by simp [δ, γ, D]) A hA j hlarge with ⟨n, hn_pos, hAn, hν⟩
  refine ⟨n, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨hn_pos, hν⟩
  · have hM1 : ((M + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by
      exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hAn
    have hM1' : M + 1 ≤ n := by
      exact_mod_cast hM1
    omega

name: IsEverywhereUnramified_of_discr_eq_and_totally_real_local
statement:
theorem IsEverywhereUnramified_of_discr_eq_and_totally_real_local
    (F M : Type) [Field F] [Field M] [NumberField F] [NumberField M]
    [Algebra F M] [FiniteDimensional F M] [IsScalarTower ℚ F M]
    [IsTotallyReal F] [IsTotallyReal M]
    (_h_odd : Odd (Module.finrank F M))
    (_h_disc : (NumberField.discr M).natAbs =
        (NumberField.discr F).natAbs ^ Module.finrank F M) :
    IsEverywhereUnramified F M
proof:
:= by
  simpa using
    ErdosUnitDistance.IsEverywhereUnramified.of_discr_eq_and_totally_real
      F M _h_odd _h_disc

name: cube_subgroup_fixedField_rel_finrank
statement:
theorem cube_subgroup_fixedField_rel_finrank (r : ℕ) (hr : r.Prime) (hr3 : r % 3 = 1) :
    Module.finrank (cube_subgroup_fixedField r hr) (CyclotomicField r ℚ) = (r - 1) / 3
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let E := CyclotomicField r ℚ
  letI : Fact r.Prime := ⟨hr⟩
  letI : NeZero r := ⟨hr.ne_zero⟩
  letI : IsCyclotomicExtension {r} ℚ E :=
    CyclotomicField.instIsCyclotomicExtensionSingletonNatSetOfCharZero (n := r) (K := ℚ)
  letI : IsGalois ℚ E := IsCyclotomicExtension.isGalois (S := {r}) (K := ℚ) (L := E)
  let hirr : Irreducible (Polynomial.cyclotomic r ℚ) :=
    Polynomial.cyclotomic.irreducible_rat hr.pos
  let e : (E ≃ₐ[ℚ] E) ≃* (ZMod r)ˣ :=
    IsCyclotomicExtension.autEquivPow (L := E) hirr
  let H0 : Subgroup (ZMod r)ˣ :=
    (powMonoidHom 3 : (ZMod r)ˣ →* (ZMod r)ˣ).range
  let H : Subgroup (E ≃ₐ[ℚ] E) := H0.map e.symm.toMonoidHom
  change Module.finrank (IntermediateField.fixedField H) E = (r - 1) / 3
  rw [IntermediateField.finrank_fixedField_eq_card]
  have hcardH : Nat.card H = Nat.card H0 := by
    simpa [H] using
      (Nat.card_congr
        (Subgroup.equivMapOfInjective H0 e.symm.toMonoidHom e.symm.injective).toEquiv).symm
  rw [hcardH]
  rw [IsCyclic.card_powMonoidHom_range (G := (ZMod r)ˣ) (d := 3)]
  have hmod : (r - 1) % 3 = 0 := by
    omega
  have hgcd : (Nat.card (ZMod r)ˣ).gcd 3 = 3 := by
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ZMod.card_units]
    exact Tactic.NormNum.nat_gcd_helper_dvd_right (r - 1) 3 hmod
  rw [hgcd]
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ZMod.card_units]

name: cube_subgroup_fixedField_abs_finrank
statement:
theorem cube_subgroup_fixedField_abs_finrank (r : ℕ) (hr : r.Prime) (hr3 : r % 3 = 1) :
    Module.finrank ℚ (cube_subgroup_fixedField r hr) = 3
proof:
:= by
  let L := cube_subgroup_fixedField r hr
  let E := CyclotomicField r ℚ
  have hrel : Module.finrank L E = (r - 1) / 3 := by
    simpa [L, E] using cube_subgroup_fixedField_rel_finrank r hr hr3
  letI : Fact r.Prime := ⟨hr⟩
  letI : NeZero r := ⟨hr.ne_zero⟩
  letI : IsCyclotomicExtension {r} ℚ E :=
    CyclotomicField.instIsCyclotomicExtensionSingletonNatSetOfCharZero (n := r) (K := ℚ)
  let hirr : Irreducible (Polynomial.cyclotomic r ℚ) :=
    Polynomial.cyclotomic.irreducible_rat hr.pos
  have hE : Module.finrank ℚ E = r - 1 := by
    simpa [Nat.totient_prime hr, E] using
      (IsCyclotomicExtension.finrank (K := ℚ) (L := E) hirr)
  have hmul := Module.finrank_mul_finrank ℚ L E
  rw [hrel, hE] at hmul
  have hrewrite : r - 1 = 3 * ((r - 1) / 3) := by
    omega
  have hmul' : Module.finrank ℚ L * ((r - 1) / 3) = 3 * ((r - 1) / 3) := by
    exact hmul.trans hrewrite
  have htwo : 2 ≤ r := hr.two_le
  have hq : (r - 1) / 3 ≠ 0 := by
    intro hq0
    rw [hq0, mul_zero] at hmul
    omega
  exact (mul_eq_mul_right_iff.mp hmul').resolve_right hq

name: cyclotomicField_natAbs_discr_prime
statement:
theorem cyclotomicField_natAbs_discr_prime (r : ℕ) (hr : r.Prime) (hr3 : r % 3 = 1) :
    (NumberField.discr (CyclotomicField r ℚ)).natAbs = r ^ (r - 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fact r.Prime := ⟨hr⟩
  letI : NeZero r := ⟨hr.ne_zero⟩
  letI : NumberField (CyclotomicField r ℚ) := by infer_instance
  letI : IsCyclotomicExtension {r} ℚ (CyclotomicField r ℚ) :=
    CyclotomicField.instIsCyclotomicExtensionSingletonNatSetOfCharZero (n := r) (K := ℚ)
  let ζ := IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta r ℚ (CyclotomicField r ℚ)
  have hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ r := IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta_spec r ℚ (CyclotomicField r ℚ)
  have hirr : Irreducible (Polynomial.cyclotomic r ℚ) :=
    Polynomial.cyclotomic.irreducible_rat hr.pos
  have hodd : r ≠ 2 := by
    intro h2
    subst h2
    norm_num at hr3
  let B := hζ.subOnePowerBasis ℚ
  have hBint : IsIntegral ℤ B.gen := by
    simpa [B] using (hζ.isIntegral hr.pos).sub isIntegral_one
  have hpow : Algebra.discr ℚ (hζ.powerBasis ℚ).basis = (-1) ^ ((r - 1) / 2) * r ^ (r - 2) := by
    simpa using
      (IsCyclotomicExtension.discr_odd_prime (K := ℚ) (L := CyclotomicField r ℚ) (ζ := ζ) hζ hirr hodd)
  have hBdiscr : Algebra.discr ℚ B.basis = (-1) ^ ((r - 1) / 2) * r ^ (r - 2) := by
    calc
      Algebra.discr ℚ B.basis = Algebra.discr ℚ (hζ.powerBasis ℚ).basis := by
        symm
        set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
        exact hζ.discr_zeta_eq_discr_zeta_sub_one
      _ = (-1) ^ ((r - 1) / 2) * r ^ (r - 2) := hpow
  have hminrat : minpoly ℚ B.gen = (Polynomial.cyclotomic r ℚ).comp (Polynomial.X + 1) := by
    simpa [B] using hζ.minpoly_sub_one_eq_cyclotomic_comp hirr
  have hminfrac : minpoly ℚ B.gen = (minpoly ℤ B.gen).map (algebraMap ℤ ℚ) := by
    exact @minpoly.isIntegrallyClosed_eq_field_fractions'
      ℤ (CyclotomicField r ℚ) _ _ _ _ ℚ _ _ _ _ _ _
      (instIsScalarTowerCyclotomicField r ℚ) (s := B.gen) hBint
  have hminint : minpoly ℤ B.gen = (Polynomial.cyclotomic r ℤ).comp (Polynomial.X + 1) := by
    apply Polynomial.map_injective (f := Int.castRingHom ℚ)
    exact RingHom.injective_int (Int.castRingHom ℚ)
    calc
      (minpoly ℤ B.gen).map (algebraMap ℤ ℚ) = minpoly ℚ B.gen := hminfrac.symm
      _ = (Polynomial.cyclotomic r ℚ).comp (Polynomial.X + 1) := hminrat
      _ = ((Polynomial.cyclotomic r ℤ).comp (Polynomial.X + 1)).map (algebraMap ℤ ℚ) := by
        rw [Polynomial.map_comp]
        simp [Polynomial.map_cyclotomic_int]
  have hei : (minpoly ℤ B.gen).IsEisensteinAt (Submodule.span ℤ ({(r : ℤ)} : Set ℤ)) := by
    rw [hminint]
    simpa using cyclotomic_comp_X_add_one_isEisensteinAt r
  have hpowint (n : ℕ) (j : Fin B.dim) : IsIntegral ℤ (B.basis.repr (B.gen ^ n) j) := by
    exact @PowerBasis.repr_gen_pow_isIntegral
      ℚ _ ℤ _ _ (CyclotomicField r ℚ) _ _ _
      (instIsScalarTowerCyclotomicField r ℚ) (B := B) hBint hminfrac n j
  have hreprmul (Q : Polynomial ℤ) (n : ℕ) (j : Fin B.dim) :
      (B.basis.repr (↑(Q.coeff n) * B.gen ^ n) j) = (Q.coeff n : ℚ) * B.basis.repr (B.gen ^ n) j := by
    simpa [Algebra.smul_def] using congrArg (fun f => f j) (B.basis.repr.map_smul (Q.coeff n : ℚ) (B.gen ^ n))
  have hBI : ∀ i j, IsIntegral ℤ (B.basis.toMatrix (NumberField.integralBasis (CyclotomicField r ℚ)) i j) := by
    intro i j
    rw [Module.Basis.toMatrix_apply]
    have hxint : IsIntegral ℤ ((NumberField.integralBasis (CyclotomicField r ℚ)) j) := by
      simpa [NumberField.integralBasis_apply] using
        (NumberField.RingOfIntegers.isIntegral_coe (K := CyclotomicField r ℚ)
          (NumberField.RingOfIntegers.basis (CyclotomicField r ℚ) j))
    have hz0 : Algebra.discr ℚ B.basis • (NumberField.integralBasis (CyclotomicField r ℚ) j) ∈
        Algebra.adjoin ℤ ({B.gen} : Set (CyclotomicField r ℚ)) := by
      exact @Algebra.discr_mul_isIntegral_mem_adjoin
        ℚ (CyclotomicField r ℚ) _ _ _ _ ℤ _ _ _
        (instIsScalarTowerCyclotomicField r ℚ) _ _ _ (B := B) hBint
        (z := NumberField.integralBasis (CyclotomicField r ℚ) j) hxint
    have hz1q : ((r : ℚ) ^ (r - 2)) • (NumberField.integralBasis (CyclotomicField r ℚ) j) ∈
        Algebra.adjoin ℤ ({B.gen} : Set (CyclotomicField r ℚ)) := by
      rw [hBdiscr] at hz0
      by_cases hEven : Even ((r - 1) / 2)
      · rw [hEven.neg_one_pow] at hz0
        simpa [Algebra.smul_def] using hz0
      · rw [(Nat.not_even_iff_odd.1 hEven).neg_one_pow] at hz0
        have hzneg : -(((r : ℚ) ^ (r - 2)) • (NumberField.integralBasis (CyclotomicField r ℚ) j)) ∈
            Algebra.adjoin ℤ ({B.gen} : Set (CyclotomicField r ℚ)) := by
          simpa [Algebra.smul_def] using hz0
        simpa using (Subalgebra.neg_mem _ hzneg)
    have hz1z : ((r : ℤ) ^ (r - 2)) • (NumberField.integralBasis (CyclotomicField r ℚ) j) ∈
        Algebra.adjoin ℤ ({B.gen} : Set (CyclotomicField r ℚ)) := by
      simpa [Algebra.smul_def] using hz1q
    have hxadjoin : (NumberField.integralBasis (CyclotomicField r ℚ) j) ∈
        Algebra.adjoin ℤ ({B.gen} : Set (CyclotomicField r ℚ)) := by
      exact @mem_adjoin_of_smul_prime_pow_smul_of_minpoly_isEisensteinAt
        ℤ ℚ (CyclotomicField r ℚ) (r : ℤ) _ _ _ _ _ _
        (instIsScalarTowerCyclotomicField r ℚ) _ _ _ (B := B)
        (Nat.prime_iff_prime_int.1 hr) hBint (n := r - 2)
        (z := NumberField.integralBasis (CyclotomicField r ℚ) j) hxint hz1z hei
    rw [Algebra.adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval] at hxadjoin
    rcases hxadjoin with ⟨Q, hQ⟩
    rw [← hQ]
    change IsIntegral ℤ (B.basis.repr (Polynomial.aeval B.gen Q) i)
    rw [Polynomial.aeval_eq_sum_range, map_sum, Finset.sum_apply']
    refine IsIntegral.sum (R := ℤ) (A := ℚ) (s := Finset.range (Q.natDegree + 1))
      (f := fun n => ((B.basis.repr (Q.coeff n • B.gen ^ n)) i)) ?_
    intro n hn
    have hterm' : IsIntegral ℤ ((Q.coeff n : ℚ) * B.basis.repr (B.gen ^ n) i) :=
      (isIntegral_algebraMap : IsIntegral ℤ (Q.coeff n : ℚ)).mul (hpowint n i)
    simpa [Algebra.smul_def, hreprmul Q n i] using hterm'
  have hIB : ∀ i j, IsIntegral ℤ ((NumberField.integralBasis (CyclotomicField r ℚ)).toMatrix B.basis i j) := by
    intro i j
    rw [Module.Basis.toMatrix_apply]
    have hx : B.basis j ∈ (algebraMap (𝓞 (CyclotomicField r ℚ)) (CyclotomicField r ℚ)).range := by
      refine ⟨⟨B.basis j, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
      simpa [B.basis_eq_pow] using hBint.pow j.1
    have hx' : B.basis j ∈ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range (NumberField.integralBasis (CyclotomicField r ℚ))) := by
      exact (NumberField.mem_span_integralBasis (K := CyclotomicField r ℚ)).2 hx
    have hrepr := (Module.Basis.mem_span_iff_repr_mem (R := ℤ) (S := ℚ)
      (b := NumberField.integralBasis (CyclotomicField r ℚ)) (m := B.basis j)).1 hx'
    rcases hrepr i with ⟨n, hn⟩
    rw [← hn]
    exact isIntegral_algebraMap
  have hcomp : Algebra.discr ℚ B.basis = Algebra.discr ℚ (NumberField.integralBasis (CyclotomicField r ℚ)) := by
    exact Algebra.discr_eq_discr_of_toMatrix_coeff_isIntegral (K := CyclotomicField r ℚ) hBI hIB
  have hcoe : (((NumberField.discr (CyclotomicField r ℚ)) : ℤ) : ℚ) = Algebra.discr ℚ B.basis := by
    calc
      (((NumberField.discr (CyclotomicField r ℚ)) : ℤ) : ℚ) =
          Algebra.discr ℚ (NumberField.integralBasis (CyclotomicField r ℚ)) := NumberField.coe_discr (K := CyclotomicField r ℚ)
      _ = Algebra.discr ℚ B.basis := hcomp.symm
  have hdiscr_int : NumberField.discr (CyclotomicField r ℚ) =
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ ((r - 1) / 2) * (r : ℤ) ^ (r - 2) := by
    apply Int.cast_injective (α := ℚ)
    calc
      (((NumberField.discr (CyclotomicField r ℚ)) : ℤ) : ℚ) = Algebra.discr ℚ B.basis := hcoe
      _ = (-1) ^ ((r - 1) / 2) * r ^ (r - 2) := hBdiscr
      _ = ((((-1 : ℤ) ^ ((r - 1) / 2) * (r : ℤ) ^ (r - 2)) : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
        simp
  rw [hdiscr_int]
  by_cases hEven : Even ((r - 1) / 2)
  · rw [hEven.neg_one_pow]
    simp
  · rw [(Nat.not_even_iff_odd.1 hEven).neg_one_pow]
    simp

name: cube_subgroup_fixedField_discr_lower_bound
statement:
theorem cube_subgroup_fixedField_discr_lower_bound (r : ℕ) (hr : r.Prime) (hr3 : r % 3 = 1) :
    r ^ 2 ∣ (NumberField.discr (cube_subgroup_fixedField r hr)).natAbs
proof:
:= by
  let L := cube_subgroup_fixedField r hr
  let E := CyclotomicField r ℚ
  letI : Fact r.Prime := ⟨hr⟩
  have hdeg : Module.finrank ℚ L = 3 := cube_subgroup_fixedField_abs_finrank r hr hr3
  have hgal : IsGalois ℚ L := by
    change IsGalois ℚ (cube_subgroup_fixedField r hr)
    unfold cube_subgroup_fixedField
    classical
    let E := CyclotomicField r ℚ
    letI : Fact r.Prime := ⟨hr⟩
    letI : NeZero r := ⟨hr.ne_zero⟩
    letI : IsCyclotomicExtension {r} ℚ E :=
      CyclotomicField.instIsCyclotomicExtensionSingletonNatSetOfCharZero (n := r) (K := ℚ)
    letI : IsGalois ℚ E := IsCyclotomicExtension.isGalois (S := {r}) (K := ℚ) (L := E)
    let hirr : Irreducible (Polynomial.cyclotomic r ℚ) :=
      Polynomial.cyclotomic.irreducible_rat hr.pos
    let e : (E ≃ₐ[ℚ] E) ≃* (ZMod r)ˣ :=
      IsCyclotomicExtension.autEquivPow (L := E) hirr
    let H : Subgroup (E ≃ₐ[ℚ] E) :=
      ((powMonoidHom 3 : (ZMod r)ˣ →* (ZMod r)ˣ).range).map e.symm.toMonoidHom
    letI : H.Normal := by
      refine (Subgroup.normal_of_comm ((powMonoidHom 3 : (ZMod r)ˣ →* (ZMod r)ˣ).range)).map e.symm.toMonoidHom ?_
      exact e.symm.surjective
    simpa [H] using (IsGalois.of_fixedField_normal_subgroup (K := ℚ) (L := E) H)
  letI : IsGalois ℚ L := hgal
  let pI : Ideal ℤ := Ideal.span ({(r : ℤ)} : Set ℤ)
  letI : pI.IsMaximal := by
    dsimp [pI]
    exact Int.ideal_span_isMaximal_of_prime r
  letI : pI.IsPrime := Ideal.IsMaximal.isPrime (show pI.IsMaximal from inferInstance)
  have hp0 : pI ≠ ⊥ := by
    dsimp [pI]
    simp [hr.ne_zero]
  let D : Ideal (𝓞 L) := differentIdeal ℤ (𝓞 L)
  have hdiscr_dvd : (NumberField.discr L).natAbs ∣ r ^ (r - 2) := by
    have hdiv : NumberField.discr L ∣ NumberField.discr E :=
      NumberField.discr_dvd_discr (K := L) (L := E)
    have hdiv' : ((NumberField.discr L).natAbs : ℤ) ∣ NumberField.discr E := by
      rw [Int.natCast_natAbs, abs_dvd]
      simpa [E] using hdiv
    have hnat : (NumberField.discr L).natAbs ∣ (NumberField.discr E).natAbs :=
      Int.natCast_dvd.mp hdiv'
    simpa [E, cyclotomicField_natAbs_discr_prime r hr hr3] using hnat
  rcases (Nat.dvd_prime_pow hr).mp hdiscr_dvd with ⟨k, hk_le, hk_eq⟩
  have hdiscr_nat_gt_two : 2 < (NumberField.discr L).natAbs := by
    have h := NumberField.abs_discr_gt_two (K := L) (by omega)
    rw [Int.abs_eq_natAbs] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  have hD_ne_top : D ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro hD
    have : Ideal.absNorm D = 1 := by simpa [hD]
    rw [NumberField.absNorm_differentIdeal (K := L) (𝒪 := 𝓞 L)] at this
    omega
  obtain ⟨P, hPmax, hDP⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal D hD_ne_top
  letI : P.IsPrime := hPmax.isPrime
  have hP_under_max : (P.under ℤ).IsMaximal := Ideal.IsMaximal.under (A := ℤ) P
  have hrpow_mem_P : (algebraMap ℤ (𝓞 L) (r : ℤ)) ^ k ∈ P := by
    have hmemD : ((Ideal.absNorm D : ℕ) : 𝓞 L) ∈ D := Ideal.absNorm_mem D
    have hmemP : ((Ideal.absNorm D : ℕ) : 𝓞 L) ∈ P := hDP hmemD
    rw [NumberField.absNorm_differentIdeal (K := L) (𝒪 := 𝓞 L), hk_eq] at hmemP
    simpa using hmemP
  have hr_mem_P : algebraMap ℤ (𝓞 L) (r : ℤ) ∈ P := by
    exact hPmax.isPrime.mem_of_pow_mem k hrpow_mem_P
  have hp_le_under : pI ≤ P.under ℤ := by
    dsimp [pI]
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
    simpa [Ideal.under_def] using hr_mem_P
  have hunder_eq : P.under ℤ = pI := by
    rcases (Ideal.isMaximal_def.mp (show pI.IsMaximal from inferInstance)) with ⟨_, hpI_coatom⟩
    by_contra hne
    have hlt : pI < P.under ℤ := lt_of_le_of_ne hp_le_under (by simpa [eq_comm] using hne)
    exact hP_under_max.ne_top (hpI_coatom _ hlt)
  letI : P.LiesOver pI := by
    simpa [hunder_eq] using (Ideal.over_under (A := ℤ) (P := P))
  have hP0 : P ≠ ⊥ := Ideal.ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot hp0 P
  have hP_dvd_D : P ∣ D := Ideal.dvd_iff_le.mpr hDP
  have hnot_unram : ¬ Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt ℤ P := by
    exact (dvd_differentIdeal_iff (A := ℤ) (B := 𝓞 L) (P := P)).mp hP_dvd_D
  have hramP_ne_one : pI.ramificationIdx P ≠ 1 := by
    intro hram
    have hunram : Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt ℤ P := by
      have hiff := Algebra.isUnramifiedAt_iff_of_isDedekindDomain (R := ℤ) (S := 𝓞 L) (p := P) hP0
      rw [hunder_eq] at hiff
      exact hiff.2 hram
    exact hnot_unram hunram
  have hfund0 : (pI.primesOver (𝓞 L)).ncard * (pI.ramificationIdxIn (𝓞 L) * pI.inertiaDegIn (𝓞 L)) = 3 := by
    have h := Ideal.ncard_primesOver_mul_ramificationIdxIn_mul_inertiaDegIn (p := pI) hp0 (B := 𝓞 L) (G := Gal(L/ℚ))
    rw [IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank (F := ℚ) (E := L), hdeg] at h
    simpa using h
  set g : ℕ := (pI.primesOver (𝓞 L)).ncard
  set eIn : ℕ := pI.ramificationIdxIn (𝓞 L)
  set fIn : ℕ := pI.inertiaDegIn (𝓞 L)
  have hfund : g * (eIn * fIn) = 3 := by
    simpa [g, eIn, fIn] using hfund0
  have hramIn_ne_one0 : pI.ramificationIdxIn (𝓞 L) ≠ 1 := by
    rw [Ideal.ramificationIdxIn_eq_ramificationIdx (p := pI) (P := P) (B := 𝓞 L) (G := Gal(L/ℚ))]
    exact hramP_ne_one
  have hramIn_ne_one : eIn ≠ 1 := by
    simpa [eIn] using hramIn_ne_one0
  have he_dvd_three : eIn ∣ 3 := by
    refine ⟨g * fIn, ?_⟩
    calc
      3 = g * (eIn * fIn) := hfund.symm
      _ = eIn * (g * fIn) := by ring
  have he_three : eIn = 3 := by
    rcases (Nat.dvd_prime (by decide : Nat.Prime 3)).mp he_dvd_three with h1 | h3
    · exact (hramIn_ne_one h1).elim
    · exact h3
  have hmul : 3 * (g * fIn) = 3 := by
    calc
      3 * (g * fIn) = g * (eIn * fIn) := by rw [he_three]; ring
      _ = 3 := hfund
  have hgf_one : g * fIn = 1 := by
    exact (mul_eq_left₀ (a := 3) (b := g * fIn) (ha := by decide)).mp hmul
  have hg_one : g = 1 := (mul_eq_one.mp hgf_one).1
  have hf_one0 : fIn = 1 := (mul_eq_one.mp hgf_one).2
  have hramIn_three : pI.ramificationIdxIn (𝓞 L) = 3 := by
    simpa [eIn] using he_three
  have hramP_three : pI.ramificationIdx P = 3 := by
    rw [← Ideal.ramificationIdxIn_eq_ramificationIdx (p := pI) (P := P) (B := 𝓞 L) (G := Gal(L/ℚ))]
    exact hramIn_three
  have hP3 : P ^ 3 ∣ Ideal.map (algebraMap ℤ (𝓞 L)) pI := by
    refine Ideal.dvd_iff_le.mpr ?_
    have hle : Ideal.map (algebraMap ℤ (𝓞 L)) pI ≤ P ^ pI.ramificationIdx P := by
      exact Ideal.le_pow_ramificationIdx
    simpa [hramP_three] using hle
  have hP2dvdD : P ^ 2 ∣ D := by
    simpa [D] using (pow_sub_one_dvd_differentIdeal (A := ℤ) (B := 𝓞 L) (P := P) (e := 3) hp0 hP3)
  have hinertiaIn_one : pI.inertiaDegIn (𝓞 L) = 1 := by
    simpa [fIn] using hf_one0
  have hinertiaP_one : pI.inertiaDeg P = 1 := by
    rw [← Ideal.inertiaDegIn_eq_inertiaDeg (p := pI) (P := P) (B := 𝓞 L) (G := Gal(L/ℚ))]
    exact hinertiaIn_one
  have hnormP' : Ideal.absNorm P = r ^ (pI.inertiaDeg P) := by
    simpa [pI] using (Ideal.absNorm_eq_pow_inertiaDeg' (R := 𝓞 L) (P := P) (p := r) hr)
  have hnormP : Ideal.absNorm P = r := by
    rw [hnormP', hinertiaP_one]
    simp
  have hnormP2 : Ideal.absNorm (P ^ 2) = r ^ 2 := by
    rw [map_pow, hnormP]
  have hnorm_dvd : Ideal.absNorm (P ^ 2) ∣ Ideal.absNorm D :=
    Ideal.absNorm_dvd_absNorm_of_le (Ideal.dvd_iff_le.mp hP2dvdD)
  rw [hnormP2, NumberField.absNorm_differentIdeal (K := L) (𝒪 := 𝓞 L)] at hnorm_dvd
  simpa [D] using hnorm_dvd

name: cube_subgroup_fixedField_discr_upper_bound
statement:
theorem cube_subgroup_fixedField_discr_upper_bound (r : ℕ) (hr : r.Prime) (hr3 : r % 3 = 1) :
    (NumberField.discr (cube_subgroup_fixedField r hr)).natAbs ∣ r ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let L := cube_subgroup_fixedField r hr
  let E := CyclotomicField r ℚ
  let m := (r - 1) / 3
  have hrel : Module.finrank ↥L E = m := by
    simpa [L, E, m] using cube_subgroup_fixedField_rel_finrank r hr hr3
  have hdiscrE : (NumberField.discr E).natAbs = r ^ (r - 2) := by
    simpa [E] using cyclotomicField_natAbs_discr_prime r hr hr3
