name: proposition_3_8_base_fields
statement:
theorem proposition_3_8_base_fields (hFG : Hyp_FiniteTopologicalRank) : ∃ C_rd : ℝ, 0 < C_rd ∧
    ∀ ℓ : ℕ, 0 < ℓ →
      ∃ (F : Type) (_ : Field F) (_ : CharZero F) (_ : NumberField F)
        (_ : IsTotallyReal F) (_ : IsGalois ℚ F),
        Module.finrank ℚ F = 3 ∧
        Nonempty ((F ≃ₐ[ℚ] F) ≃* Multiplicative (ZMod 3)) ∧
        ℓ - 1 ≤ generatorRank (MaxUnramifiedProPGaloisGroup F 3) ∧
        Real.log (NumberField.rootDiscr F) ≤ C_rd * (ℓ : ℝ) * Real.log (max 2 ℓ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fact (Nat.Prime 3) := ⟨by decide⟩
  obtain ⟨C_rd, hC_rd_pos, hC_rd⟩ := primesCongOneMod3_log_sum_bound
  refine ⟨C_rd, hC_rd_pos, ?_⟩
  intro ℓ hℓ
  let r : Fin ℓ → ℕ := fun i => primesCongOneMod3 i
  have hr_prime : ∀ i : Fin ℓ, (r i).Prime := by
    intro i
    simpa [r] using primesCongOneMod3_prime i
  have hr_mod3 : ∀ i : Fin ℓ, r i % 3 = 1 := by
    intro i
    simpa [r] using primesCongOneMod3_mod i
  have hr_inj : Function.Injective r := by
    intro i j hij
    exact Fin.ext (primesCongOneMod3_strictMono.injective hij)
  obtain ⟨F, M, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, hcubic, hFMdeg, hdiscrF, hdiscrM,
      hFexp, hQexp, hFabel, hQabel, hcard, hmul, hpgroup, hunr⟩ :=
    proposition_3_2 ℓ hℓ r hr_prime hr_inj hr_mod3
  refine ⟨F, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    hcubic, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hFcard : Nat.card (F ≃ₐ[ℚ] F) = 3 := by
      simpa [hcubic] using (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank (F := ℚ) (E := F))
    have hZ3card : Nat.card (Multiplicative (ZMod 3)) = 3 := by
      simpa using (Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := Multiplicative (ZMod 3)))
    exact ⟨mulEquivOfPrimeCardEq (G := F ≃ₐ[ℚ] F) (G' := Multiplicative (ZMod 3)) (p := 3) hFcard hZ3card⟩
  · let G := MaxUnramifiedProPGaloisGroup F 3
    let Q := Fin (ℓ - 1) → ZMod 3
    have hGfg : IsFinitelyGeneratedProPGroup 3 G := by
      simpa [G] using (MaxUnramifiedProPGaloisGroup.isFinitelyGeneratedProPGroup hFG (F := F) (p := 3))
    have hQrank : Module.finrank (ZMod 3) Q = ℓ - 1 := by
      simpa [Q] using (Module.finrank_fin_fun (R := ZMod 3) (n := ℓ - 1))
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := hmul
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψ_surj, hψ_cont⟩ :=
      prop38_universal_property (F := F) (p := 3) (M := M) hunr hpgroup
    letI : DiscreteTopology (M ≃ₐ[F] M) := inferInstance
    let φ : G →* Multiplicative Q := e.toMonoidHom.comp ψ
    have hφ_surj : Function.Surjective φ := by
      intro q
      rcases e.surjective q with ⟨g, rfl⟩
      rcases hψ_surj g with ⟨x, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
    have hφ_cont : Continuous φ := by
      change Continuous fun x => e (ψ x)
      exact (continuous_of_discreteTopology : Continuous e).comp hψ_cont
    exact prop38_burnside_basis (G := G) (p := 3) hGfg (k := ℓ - 1) (Q := Q)
      hQrank φ hφ_surj hφ_cont
  · have hprod_nonzero : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range ℓ, (primesCongOneMod3 i : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro i hi
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (primesCongOneMod3_prime i))
    have hsum_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ℓ, Real.log (primesCongOneMod3 i : ℝ) := by
      refine Finset.sum_nonneg ?_
      intro i hi
      have htwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (primesCongOneMod3 i : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast (Nat.Prime.two_le (primesCongOneMod3_prime i))
      have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (primesCongOneMod3 i : ℝ) := by linarith
      exact Real.log_nonneg hone
    calc
      Real.log (NumberField.rootDiscr F)
          = Real.log ((∏ i ∈ Finset.range ℓ, (primesCongOneMod3 i : ℝ)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) / 3 := by
              rw [rootDiscr_log_eq, hdiscrF, hcubic, Nat.cast_pow]
              simp [r, Fin.prod_univ_eq_prod_range, Nat.cast_prod]
      _ = (2 / 3 : ℝ) * Real.log (∏ i ∈ Finset.range ℓ, (primesCongOneMod3 i : ℝ)) := by
            rw [Real.log_pow]
            ring_nf
      _ = (2 / 3 : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ℓ, Real.log (primesCongOneMod3 i : ℝ) := by
            rw [Real.log_prod hprod_nonzero]
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ℓ, Real.log (primesCongOneMod3 i : ℝ) := by
            nlinarith
      _ ≤ C_rd * (ℓ : ℝ) * Real.log (max 2 ℓ) := by
            simpa using hC_rd ℓ

name: proposition_3_8_numeric_constants
statement:
theorem proposition_3_8_numeric_constants (C_rd : ℝ) (hC_rd : 0 < C_rd) :
    ∃ (ℓ₁ : ℕ) (C_H : ℝ), 0 < C_H ∧
      ∀ ℓ ≥ ℓ₁, ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →
        Real.log x ≤ C_rd * (ℓ : ℝ) * Real.log (max 2 ℓ) →
        let H : ℝ
proof:
:= 2 * (max 1 (2 * x)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant)
        Real.log H ≤ C_H * (ℓ : ℝ) * Real.log (max 2 ℓ) ∧
        0 < ((((ℓ - 1) ^ 2 / 100 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2 - Real.log H) := by
  set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
  let c : ℝ := classNumberConstant
  let C_H : ℝ := 1 + 2 * c + 2 * c * C_rd
  let eps : ℝ := Real.log 2 / (2000 * C_H)
  have hc_pos : 0 < c := by
    dsimp [c]
    exact classNumberConstant_pos
  have hC_H : 0 < C_H := by
    dsimp [C_H, c]
    nlinarith [classNumberConstant_pos, hC_rd]
  have hlog2_pos : 0 < Real.log 2 := by
    have htwo : (1 : ℝ) < 2 := by norm_num
    exact Real.log_pos htwo
  have heps_pos : 0 < eps := by
    dsimp [eps]
    have hden_pos : 0 < 2000 * C_H := by positivity
    exact div_pos hlog2_pos hden_pos
  have hsmall_nat : (fun n : ℕ => Real.log (n : ℝ)) =o[Filter.atTop] fun n => (n : ℝ) := by
    simpa using (Asymptotics.IsLittleO.natCast_atTop (R := ℝ) Real.isLittleO_log_id_atTop)
  have hsmall_eps : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, Real.log (n : ℝ) ≤ eps * (n : ℝ) := by
    filter_upwards [Asymptotics.IsLittleO.def hsmall_nat heps_pos] with n hn
    have hn_nonneg : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) := by positivity
    have habs : |Real.log (n : ℝ)| ≤ eps * (n : ℝ) := by
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hn_nonneg] using hn
    linarith [le_abs_self (Real.log (n : ℝ))]
  obtain ⟨Nlog, hNlog⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hsmall_eps
  refine ⟨max 50 Nlog, C_H, hC_H, ?_⟩
  intro ℓ hℓ x hx hlog
  dsimp [C_H, c, eps]
  set L : ℝ := (ℓ : ℝ) * Real.log (max 2 ℓ)
  have h50ℓ : 50 ≤ ℓ := by
    exact le_trans (le_max_left 50 Nlog) hℓ
  have hNlogℓ : Nlog ≤ ℓ := by
    exact le_trans (le_max_right 50 Nlog) hℓ
  have h2ℓ : 2 ≤ ℓ := by linarith
  have hℓ1 : 1 ≤ ℓ := by linarith
  have hmax1_nat : (1 : ℕ) ≤ max 2 ℓ := by
    exact le_trans (by decide) (le_max_left 2 ℓ)
  have hlogmax_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log (max 2 ℓ) := by
    apply Real.log_nonneg
    exact_mod_cast hmax1_nat
  have hL_nonneg : 0 ≤ L := by
    dsimp [L]
    positivity
  have hmaxlogx : max 0 (Real.log x) ≤ C_rd * L := by
    have hCrdL_nonneg : 0 ≤ C_rd * L := by positivity
    exact max_le_iff.mpr ⟨hCrdL_nonneg, by simpa [L, mul_assoc] using hlog⟩
  have hbase_pos : 0 < max 1 (2 * x) := by
    have htmp : (1 : ℝ) ≤ max 1 (2 * x) := le_max_left 1 (2 * x)
    linarith
  have hlog_max_le : Real.log (max 1 (2 * x)) ≤ Real.log 2 + max 0 (Real.log x) := by
    by_cases hx1 : x ≤ 1
    · have hmax_le_two : max 1 (2 * x) ≤ 2 := by
        have h2x_le_two : 2 * x ≤ 2 := by nlinarith
        exact max_le (by norm_num) h2x_le_two
      have hlog_le_log2 : Real.log (max 1 (2 * x)) ≤ Real.log 2 := by
        apply Real.log_le_log hbase_pos
        linarith
      have hlogx_nonpos : Real.log x ≤ 0 := by
        exact Real.log_nonpos (le_of_lt hx) hx1
      have hmax0_logx_eq : max 0 (Real.log x) = 0 := by
        exact max_eq_left hlogx_nonpos
      simpa [hmax0_logx_eq] using hlog_le_log2
    · have hx1' : 1 < x := by linarith
      have hmax_eq : max 1 (2 * x) = 2 * x := by
        apply max_eq_right
        nlinarith
      have hlogx_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log x := by
        exact Real.log_nonneg hx1'.le
      have hmax0_logx_eq : max 0 (Real.log x) = Real.log x := by
        exact max_eq_right hlogx_nonneg
      rw [hmax_eq, hmax0_logx_eq, Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (ne_of_gt hx)]
  have hpow_pos : 0 < (max 1 (2 * x)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant) := by
    exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hbase_pos (2 * classNumberConstant)
  have hlogH_eq :
      Real.log (2 * (max 1 (2 * x)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant)) =
        Real.log 2 + (2 * classNumberConstant) * Real.log (max 1 (2 * x)) := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (ne_of_gt hpow_pos), Real.log_rpow hbase_pos]
  have hlog2_le_logmax : Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (max 2 ℓ) := by
    apply Real.log_le_log (by norm_num)
    exact_mod_cast (le_max_left 2 ℓ)
  have hlog2_le_L : Real.log 2 ≤ L := by
    have hℓ_ge_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ℓ := by exact_mod_cast hℓ1
    dsimp [L]
    nlinarith [hlog2_le_logmax, hlogmax_nonneg, hℓ_ge_one]
  have hcoef_nonneg : 0 ≤ 1 + 2 * classNumberConstant := by
    nlinarith [classNumberConstant_pos]
  have hlogH_le :
      Real.log (2 * (max 1 (2 * x)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant)) ≤
        (1 + 2 * classNumberConstant + 2 * classNumberConstant * C_rd) * L := by
    calc
      Real.log (2 * (max 1 (2 * x)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant))
          = Real.log 2 + (2 * classNumberConstant) * Real.log (max 1 (2 * x)) := hlogH_eq
      _ ≤ Real.log 2 + (2 * classNumberConstant) * (Real.log 2 + max 0 (Real.log x)) := by
        have htwo_c_nonneg : 0 ≤ 2 * classNumberConstant := by positivity
        nlinarith [hlog_max_le]
      _ ≤ Real.log 2 + (2 * classNumberConstant) * (Real.log 2 + C_rd * L) := by
        have htwo_c_nonneg : 0 ≤ 2 * classNumberConstant := by positivity
        nlinarith [hmaxlogx]
      _ = (1 + 2 * classNumberConstant) * Real.log 2 + (2 * classNumberConstant * C_rd) * L := by
        ring
      _ ≤ (1 + 2 * classNumberConstant) * L + (2 * classNumberConstant * C_rd) * L := by
        nlinarith [hlog2_le_L, hcoef_nonneg]
      _ = (1 + 2 * classNumberConstant + 2 * classNumberConstant * C_rd) * L := by
        ring
  have hCHeps : C_H * eps = Real.log 2 / 2000 := by
    dsimp [eps]
    field_simp [hC_H.ne']
  constructor
  · simpa [L, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using hlogH_le
  · have hlogℓ_small : Real.log (ℓ : ℝ) ≤ eps * (ℓ : ℝ) := by
      exact hNlog ℓ hNlogℓ
    have hmax_eq_real : max (2 : ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) = (ℓ : ℝ) := by
      apply max_eq_right
      exact_mod_cast h2ℓ
    have hL_small : L ≤ eps * (ℓ : ℝ)^2 := by
      dsimp [L]
      rw [hmax_eq_real]
      nlinarith [hlogℓ_small]
    have hlogH_le' :
        Real.log (2 * (max 1 (2 * x)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant)) ≤ C_H * L := by
      simpa [C_H, c] using hlogH_le
    have hCHL_small : C_H * L ≤ (Real.log 2 / 2000) * (ℓ : ℝ)^2 := by
      have htmp : C_H * L ≤ C_H * (eps * (ℓ : ℝ)^2) := by
        have hC_H_nonneg : 0 ≤ C_H := le_of_lt hC_H
        nlinarith [hL_small]
      calc
        C_H * L ≤ C_H * (eps * (ℓ : ℝ)^2) := htmp
        _ = (C_H * eps) * (ℓ : ℝ)^2 := by ring
        _ = (Real.log 2 / 2000) * (ℓ : ℝ)^2 := by rw [hCHeps]
    have hlogH_quad :
        Real.log (2 * (max 1 (2 * x)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant)) ≤
          (Real.log 2 / 2000) * (ℓ : ℝ)^2 := by
      exact le_trans hlogH_le' hCHL_small
    let m : ℕ := (ℓ - 1) ^ 2
    have hm_nonneg : 0 ≤ (m : ℝ) / 100 := by positivity
    have hfloor_eq_nat : ⌊((m : ℝ) / 100)⌋₊ = m / 100 := by
      apply (Nat.floor_eq_iff hm_nonneg).2
      constructor
      · exact Nat.cast_div_le
      · have hmod_lt : m % 100 < 100 := by
          exact Nat.mod_lt m (by norm_num)
        have hmod_lt_real : ((m % 100 : ℕ) : ℝ) < 100 := by
          exact_mod_cast hmod_lt
        have hdivmod : ((100 : ℝ) * ((m / 100 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((m % 100 : ℕ) : ℝ)) = (m : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast (Nat.div_add_mod m 100)
        linarith
    have hfloor_lower : (m : ℝ) / 100 - 1 < ((m / 100 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      have htmp : (m : ℝ) / 100 < (⌊((m : ℝ) / 100)⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 := by
        simpa using (Nat.lt_floor_add_one ((m : ℝ) / 100))
      rw [hfloor_eq_nat] at htmp
      linarith
    have hcast_sub : ((ℓ - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (ℓ : ℝ) - 1 := by
      simpa using (Nat.cast_sub hℓ1 : ((ℓ - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (ℓ : ℝ) - ((1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
    have hm_real : (m : ℝ) = ((ℓ : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [m]
      rw [Nat.cast_pow, hcast_sub]
    have h50ℓ_real : (50 : ℝ) ≤ ℓ := by
      exact_mod_cast h50ℓ
    have hfloor_lower' : ((ℓ : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 / 100 - 1 < ((m / 100 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      simpa [hm_real] using hfloor_lower
    have h2ℓ_real : (2 : ℝ) ≤ ℓ := by
      exact_mod_cast h2ℓ
    have hhalf_le : (ℓ : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (ℓ : ℝ) - 1 := by
      linarith
    have hhalf_nonneg : 0 ≤ (ℓ : ℝ) / 2 := by positivity
    have hsq_half : ((ℓ : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ ((ℓ : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 := by
      simpa [pow_two] using (mul_self_le_mul_self hhalf_nonneg hhalf_le)
    have hsquare_lower : (ℓ : ℝ)^2 / 400 ≤ ((ℓ : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 / 100 := by
      linarith [hsq_half]
    have h50_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 50 := by norm_num
    have hsq50 : (50 : ℝ)^2 ≤ (ℓ : ℝ)^2 := by
      simpa [pow_two] using (mul_self_le_mul_self h50_nonneg h50ℓ_real)
    have hquarter_to_fifth : (ℓ : ℝ)^2 / 500 ≤ (ℓ : ℝ)^2 / 400 - 1 := by
      linarith [hsq50]
    have hdiv_lower : (ℓ : ℝ)^2 / 500 < ((m / 100 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      have htmp : (ℓ : ℝ)^2 / 400 - 1 < ((m / 100 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        have htmp' : (ℓ : ℝ)^2 / 400 - 1 ≤ ((ℓ : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 / 100 - 1 := by
          linarith [hsquare_lower]
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt htmp' hfloor_lower'
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hquarter_to_fifth htmp
    have hℓ_pos_real : 0 < (ℓ : ℝ) := by
      linarith [h50ℓ_real]
    have hsq_pos : 0 < (ℓ : ℝ)^2 := by
      have htmp := mul_pos hℓ_pos_real hℓ_pos_real
      simpa [pow_two] using htmp
    have hfirst_gt : ((ℓ : ℝ)^2 / 500) * Real.log 2 < ((m / 100 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2 := by
      exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hdiv_lower hlog2_pos
    have hfrac_lt : (1 / 2000 : ℝ) < 1 / 500 := by norm_num
    have hcoef_lt : Real.log 2 / 2000 < Real.log 2 / 500 := by
      have htmp := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hfrac_lt hlog2_pos
      simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using htmp
    have hmid : (Real.log 2 / 2000) * (ℓ : ℝ)^2 < (Real.log 2 / 500) * (ℓ : ℝ)^2 := by
      exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hcoef_lt hsq_pos
    have hlogH_lt_mid :
        Real.log (2 * (max 1 (2 * x)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant)) <
          (Real.log 2 / 500) * (ℓ : ℝ)^2 := by
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hlogH_quad hmid
    have hfirst_gt' : (Real.log 2 / 500) * (ℓ : ℝ)^2 < ((m / 100 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2 := by
      simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using hfirst_gt
    have hlogH_lt :
        Real.log (2 * (max 1 (2 * x)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant)) <
          ((m / 100 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2 := by
      exact lt_trans hlogH_lt_mid hfirst_gt'
    have hfinal :
        0 < ((m / 100 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2 -
          Real.log (2 * (max 1 (2 * x)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant)) := by
      exact sub_pos.mpr hlogH_lt
    simpa [m] using hfinal

name: proposition_3_8_package_tower
statement:
theorem proposition_3_8_package_tower (ℓ : ℕ)
    (F : Type) [Field F] [CharZero F] [NumberField F] [IsTotallyReal F] [IsGalois ℚ F]
    (hcubic : Module.finrank ℚ F = 3)
    (isCyclic_F : Nonempty ((F ≃ₐ[ℚ] F) ≃* Multiplicative (ZMod 3)))
    (Q : ProPQuotient 3 (MaxUnramifiedProPGaloisGroup F 3))
    (T0 : ProPTowerFromQuotient F 3 Q)
    (hstep_comp : ∀ j, (T0.step j).comp (algebraMap F (T0.L j)) = algebraMap F (T0.L (j + 1)))
    (q : Fin ((ℓ - 1) ^ 2 / 100) → ℕ)
    (hq_inj : Function.Injective q)
    (hq_prime : ∀ b, (q b).Prime)
    (hq_mod4 : ∀ b, q b % 4 = 1)
    (hq_split_layers :
      ∀ j b,
        (∀ 𝔭 ∈ (Ideal.span {(q b : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 (T0.L j)),
            Ideal.ramificationIdx (Ideal.span {(q b : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) 𝔭 = 1 ∧
            Ideal.inertiaDeg (Ideal.span {(q b : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) 𝔭 = 1) ∧
          ((Ideal.span {(q b : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 (T0.L j))).ncard =
            Module.finrank ℚ (T0.L j))
    (hγ : 0 <
      ((((ℓ - 1) ^ 2 / 100 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2 -
        Real.log (2 * (max 1 (2 * NumberField.rootDiscr F)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant)))) :
    ∃ T : FieldTower ℓ,
      T.t = (ℓ - 1) ^ 2 / 100 ∧
      (letI : Field T.F := T.field_F
       letI : NumberField T.F := T.numberField_F
       Real.log (NumberField.rootDiscr T.F) = Real.log (NumberField.rootDiscr F)) ∧
      Real.log T.H ≤
        Real.log (2 * (max 1 (2 * NumberField.rootDiscr F)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let t : ℕ := (ℓ - 1) ^ 2 / 100
  let H : ℝ := 2 * (max 1 (2 * NumberField.rootDiscr F)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant)
  have hH_pos : 1 ≤ H := by
    dsimp [H]
    have hmax : (1 : ℝ) ≤ max 1 (2 * NumberField.rootDiscr F) := le_max_left _ _
    have hC_nonneg : 0 ≤ 2 * classNumberConstant := by
      nlinarith [classNumberConstant_pos]
    have hpow : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (max 1 (2 * NumberField.rootDiscr F)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant) := by
      exact Real.one_le_rpow hmax hC_nonneg
    nlinarith
  have hγ' : 0 < (t : ℝ) * Real.log 2 - Real.log H := by
    simpa [t, H] using hγ
  have ht : 0 < t := by
    by_contra hnot
    have ht0 : t = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hnot
    have hlogH : 0 ≤ Real.log H := Real.log_nonneg hH_pos
    rw [ht0, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul] at hγ'
    linarith
  let mkDatum : ∀ j : ℕ,
      ∃ 𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum,
        Nonempty (𝒟.L ≃ₐ[ℚ] T0.L j) ∧
        ∃ ht_eq : 𝒟.t = t,
          ∀ b : Fin t, 𝒟.q (Fin.cast ht_eq.symm b) = q b := by
    intro j
    letI : IsTotallyReal (T0.L j) :=
      prop38_totallyReal_odd_unramified F (T0.L j) 3 (by decide) (by decide)
        (T0.unramified j) (T0.pgroup_gal j)
    exact prop38_mkAdmissibleDatum (L := T0.L j) t ht q hq_prime hq_inj hq_mod4
      (hq_split_layers j)
  let 𝒟 : ℕ → AdmissibleDatum := fun j => Classical.choose (mkDatum j)
  let eQ : ∀ j, (𝒟 j).L ≃ₐ[ℚ] T0.L j :=
    fun j => Classical.choice ((Classical.choose_spec (mkDatum j)).1)
  let sameT : ∀ j, (𝒟 j).t = t :=
    fun j => Classical.choose ((Classical.choose_spec (mkDatum j)).2)
  let sameQ : ∀ j (b : Fin t), (𝒟 j).q (Fin.cast (sameT j).symm b) = q b :=
    fun j => Classical.choose_spec ((Classical.choose_spec (mkDatum j)).2)
  let algebraMap_F : ∀ j, F →+* (𝒟 j).L :=
    fun j => (eQ j).symm.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap F (T0.L j))
  let eF : ∀ j,
      letI : Algebra F (𝒟 j).L := (algebraMap_F j).toAlgebra
      (𝒟 j).L ≃ₐ[F] T0.L j := by
    intro j
    letI : Algebra F (𝒟 j).L := (algebraMap_F j).toAlgebra
    refine { (eQ j) with commutes' := ?_ }
    intro x
    change (eQ j) ((eQ j).symm ((algebraMap F (T0.L j)) x)) = (algebraMap F (T0.L j)) x
    exact (eQ j).apply_symm_apply ((algebraMap F (T0.L j)) x)
  have hGaloisD : ∀ j,
      letI : Algebra F (𝒟 j).L := (algebraMap_F j).toAlgebra
      IsGalois F (𝒟 j).L := by
    intro j
    letI : Algebra F (𝒟 j).L := (algebraMap_F j).toAlgebra
    exact IsGalois.of_algEquiv (eF j).symm
  have hUnrD : ∀ j,
      letI : Algebra F (𝒟 j).L := (algebraMap_F j).toAlgebra
      IsEverywhereUnramified F (𝒟 j).L := by
    intro j
    letI : Algebra F (𝒟 j).L := (algebraMap_F j).toAlgebra
    exact IsEverywhereUnramified.transport (eF j).symm (T0.unramified j)
  have hPGroupD : ∀ j,
      letI : Algebra F (𝒟 j).L := (algebraMap_F j).toAlgebra
      IsPGroup 3 ((𝒟 j).L ≃ₐ[F] (𝒟 j).L) := by
    intro j
    letI : Algebra F (𝒟 j).L := (algebraMap_F j).toAlgebra
    exact IsPGroup.of_equiv (T0.pgroup_gal j) ((AlgEquiv.autCongr (eF j)).symm)
  have hRdEq : ∀ j, NumberField.rootDiscr (𝒟 j).L = NumberField.rootDiscr F := by
    intro j
    letI : Algebra F (𝒟 j).L := (algebraMap_F j).toAlgebra
    exact prop38_rootDiscr_eq_unramified F ((𝒟 j).L) (hUnrD j)
  have hRdKBound : ∀ j, NumberField.rootDiscr (𝒟 j).K ≤ 2 * NumberField.rootDiscr F := by
    intro j
    calc
      NumberField.rootDiscr (𝒟 j).K ≤ 2 * NumberField.rootDiscr (𝒟 j).L := prop38_rootDiscr_adjoin_i (𝒟 j)
      _ = 2 * NumberField.rootDiscr F := by rw [hRdEq j]
  have hRdF_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ NumberField.rootDiscr F := by
    rw [NumberField.rootDiscr_def]
    have hdiscr_ge_nat : 1 ≤ (NumberField.discr F).natAbs := by
      exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Int.natAbs_pos.mpr (NumberField.discr_ne_zero (K := F)))
    have hdiscr_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (((NumberField.discr F).natAbs : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hdiscr_ge_nat
    have hexp_nonneg : 0 ≤ (((Module.finrank ℚ F : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) := by positivity
    simpa using Real.one_le_rpow hdiscr_ge1 hexp_nonneg
  refine ⟨
    { t := t
      q := q
      𝒟 := 𝒟
      sameT := sameT
      sameQ := sameQ
      H := H
      H_pos := hH_pos
      class_bound := by
        intro j
        have hfinK : Module.finrank ℚ (𝒟 j).K = 2 * (𝒟 j).f := by
          simpa [AdmissibleDatum.f] using prop38_adm_finrankK (𝒟 j)
        have hMink :
            (NumberField.classNumber (𝒟 j).K : ℝ) ≤
              (max 2 (NumberField.rootDiscr (𝒟 j).K)) ^
                (classNumberConstant * Module.finrank ℚ (𝒟 j).K) := by
          let M1 : Module ℚ (𝒟 j).K := @Algebra.toModule ℚ (𝒟 j).K _ _ DivisionRing.toRatAlgebra
          have hMink0 :
              (NumberField.classNumber (𝒟 j).K : ℝ) ≤
                (max 2 (NumberField.rootDiscr (𝒟 j).K)) ^
                  (classNumberConstant * (letI : Module ℚ (𝒟 j).K := M1; Module.finrank ℚ (𝒟 j).K)) := by
            letI : Algebra ℚ (𝒟 j).K := DivisionRing.toRatAlgebra
            letI : Module ℚ (𝒟 j).K := M1

            simpa using proposition_3_7 ((𝒟 j).K)
          have hfinrat :
              @Module.finrank ℚ (𝒟 j).K _ _ M1 =
                @Module.finrank ℚ (𝒟 j).K _ _ (@Algebra.toModule ℚ (𝒟 j).K _ _ (𝒟 j).algebra_ℚK) := by
            have hM : M1 = @Algebra.toModule ℚ (𝒟 j).K _ _ (𝒟 j).algebra_ℚK := by
              exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
            rw [hM]
          rw [hfinrat] at hMink0
          exact hMink0
        have hC_nonneg : 0 ≤ 2 * classNumberConstant := by
          nlinarith [classNumberConstant_pos]
        have hM_ge : (2 : ℝ) ≤ max 1 (2 * NumberField.rootDiscr F) := by
          have htwo_le : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * NumberField.rootDiscr F := by nlinarith
          exact le_trans htwo_le (le_max_right _ _)
        have hR_le : NumberField.rootDiscr (𝒟 j).K ≤ max 1 (2 * NumberField.rootDiscr F) := by
          exact le_trans (hRdKBound j) (le_max_right _ _)
        have hmax_le : max 2 (NumberField.rootDiscr (𝒟 j).K) ≤ max 1 (2 * NumberField.rootDiscr F) := by
          rw [max_le_iff]
          exact ⟨hM_ge, hR_le⟩
        have hM_nonneg : 0 ≤ max 1 (2 * NumberField.rootDiscr F) := by
          exact le_trans (by norm_num) (le_max_left _ _)
        have hbase_nonneg : 0 ≤ max 2 (NumberField.rootDiscr (𝒟 j).K) := by
          exact le_trans (by norm_num) (le_max_left _ _)
        have hpow_le :
            (max 2 (NumberField.rootDiscr (𝒟 j).K)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant) ≤
              (max 1 (2 * NumberField.rootDiscr F)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant) := by
          exact Real.rpow_le_rpow hbase_nonneg hmax_le hC_nonneg
        have hpow_nat :
            ((max 2 (NumberField.rootDiscr (𝒟 j).K)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant)) ^ (𝒟 j).f ≤
              ((max 1 (2 * NumberField.rootDiscr F)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant)) ^ (𝒟 j).f := by
          have hbase2_nonneg : 0 ≤ (max 2 (NumberField.rootDiscr (𝒟 j).K)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant) := by
            exact Real.rpow_nonneg hbase_nonneg _
          exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hbase2_nonneg hpow_le _
        have hHbase_nonneg : 0 ≤ (max 1 (2 * NumberField.rootDiscr F)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant) := by
          exact Real.rpow_nonneg hM_nonneg _
        have hHbase_le :
            (max 1 (2 * NumberField.rootDiscr F)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant) ≤ H := by
          dsimp [H]
          nlinarith
        have hHpow :
            ((max 1 (2 * NumberField.rootDiscr F)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant)) ^ (𝒟 j).f ≤ H ^ (𝒟 j).f := by
          exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hHbase_nonneg hHbase_le _
        have hrewrite :
            (max 2 (NumberField.rootDiscr (𝒟 j).K)) ^
              (classNumberConstant * Module.finrank ℚ (𝒟 j).K) =
              ((max 2 (NumberField.rootDiscr (𝒟 j).K)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant)) ^ (𝒟 j).f := by
          rw [hfinK]
          have hexp : classNumberConstant * (((2 * (𝒟 j).f : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
              (2 * classNumberConstant) * ((𝒟 j).f : ℝ) := by
            rw [Nat.cast_mul]
            ring
          rw [hexp]
          simpa using (Real.rpow_mul_natCast hbase_nonneg (2 * classNumberConstant) ((𝒟 j).f))
        calc
          (NumberField.classNumber (𝒟 j).K : ℝ)
              ≤ (max 2 (NumberField.rootDiscr (𝒟 j).K)) ^
                  (classNumberConstant * Module.finrank ℚ (𝒟 j).K) := hMink
          _ = ((max 2 (NumberField.rootDiscr (𝒟 j).K)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant)) ^ (𝒟 j).f := hrewrite
          _ ≤ ((max 1 (2 * NumberField.rootDiscr F)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant)) ^ (𝒟 j).f := hpow_nat
          _ ≤ H ^ (𝒟 j).f := hHpow
      deg_tendsto_atTop := by
        convert T0.degree_tendsto using 1
        funext j
        simpa [AdmissibleDatum.f] using (eQ j).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq
      γ_pos := hγ'
      F := F
      hcubic := hcubic
      isCyclic_F := isCyclic_F
      algebraMap_F := algebraMap_F
      base_iso := (Classical.choice T0.base_iso).symm.trans (eQ 0).symm
      layer_step := fun j => (eQ (j + 1)).symm.toRingHom.comp ((T0.step j).comp (eQ j).toRingHom)
      layer_step_comp := by
        intro j
        ext x
        simp only [algebraMap_F, RingHom.comp_apply]
        have hx0 :
            (eQ j).toRingHom ((eQ j).symm.toRingHom ((algebraMap F (T0.L j)) x)) =
              (algebraMap F (T0.L j)) x := by
          exact (eQ j).apply_symm_apply ((algebraMap F (T0.L j)) x)
        rw [hx0]
        exact congrArg (fun y => (eQ (j + 1)).symm.toRingHom y) (RingHom.congr_fun (hstep_comp j) x)
      isGalois_FL := hGaloisD
      isPGroup_gal := hPGroupD
      unramified_FL := hUnrD
      rd_eq := hRdEq
      rd_K_bound := hRdKBound }, ?_⟩
  constructor
  · rfl
  constructor
  · rfl
  · exact le_rfl

name: proposition_3_8
statement:
theorem proposition_3_8
    (hFG : Hyp_FiniteTopologicalRank)
    (hGSI : Hyp_GolodShafarevichInequality)
    (hSRR : Hyp_ShafarevichRelationRankBound)
    (h5term : Hyp_FiveTermRelationBound)
    (hBurnside : Hyp_NormallyGenH1InvariantBound) :
    ∃ (ℓ₀ : ℕ) (C_rd C_H : ℝ), 0 < C_rd ∧ 0 < C_H ∧
      ∀ ℓ ≥ ℓ₀, ∃ T : FieldTower ℓ,
        T.t = (ℓ - 1) ^ 2 / 100 ∧
        (letI : Field T.F := T.field_F
         letI : NumberField T.F := T.numberField_F
         Real.log (NumberField.rootDiscr T.F) ≤ C_rd * (ℓ : ℝ) * Real.log ℓ) ∧
        Real.log T.H ≤ C_H * (ℓ : ℝ) * Real.log (max 2 ℓ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases proposition_3_8_base_fields hFG with ⟨C_rd, hC_rd, hbase⟩
  rcases proposition_3_8_numeric_constants C_rd hC_rd with ⟨ℓH, C_H, hC_H, hnum⟩
  rcases hyp_GS_of_textbook hFG hGSI hSRR h5term hBurnside with ⟨ℓQ, hfrob⟩
  refine ⟨max 2 (max ℓH ℓQ), C_rd, C_H, hC_rd, hC_H, ?_⟩
  intro ℓ hℓ
  letI : Fact (Nat.Prime 3) := Nat.fact_prime_three
  have hℓ2 : 2 ≤ ℓ := by
    exact le_trans (le_max_left 2 (max ℓH ℓQ)) hℓ
  have hℓpos : 0 < ℓ := by
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < (2 : ℕ)) hℓ2
  have hℓmax : max ℓH ℓQ ≤ ℓ := by
    exact le_trans (le_max_right 2 (max ℓH ℓQ)) hℓ
  have hℓH : ℓH ≤ ℓ := by
    exact le_trans (le_max_left ℓH ℓQ) hℓmax
  have hℓQ : ℓQ ≤ ℓ := by
    exact le_trans (le_max_right ℓH ℓQ) hℓmax
  rcases hbase ℓ hℓpos with
    ⟨F, hFieldF, hCharZeroF, hNumberFieldF, hTotallyRealF, hIsGaloisF,
      hcubic, hcyclic, hgrank, hrd⟩
  letI : Field F := hFieldF
  letI : CharZero F := hCharZeroF
  letI : NumberField F := hNumberFieldF
  letI : IsTotallyReal F := hTotallyRealF
  letI : IsGalois ℚ F := hIsGaloisF
  rcases hfrob ℓ hℓQ F hcubic hgrank with
    ⟨q, hq_inj, hq_prime, hq_mod4, hq_split_F, Q, hQinf, hkill⟩
  rcases prop38_infinite_quotient_tower (F := F) (p := 3) Q hQinf (by decide : (3 : ℕ) ≠ 2) with ⟨T0, hstep_comp⟩
  have hq_split_layers :
      ∀ j b,
        (∀ 𝔭 ∈ (Ideal.span {(q b : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 (T0.L j)),
            Ideal.ramificationIdx (Ideal.span {(q b : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) 𝔭 = 1 ∧
            Ideal.inertiaDeg (Ideal.span {(q b : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) 𝔭 = 1) ∧
          ((Ideal.span {(q b : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 (T0.L j))).ncard =
            Module.finrank ℚ (T0.L j) := by
    intro j b
    exact
      prop38_killed_frobenius_splits F 3 Q T0 (q b) (hq_prime b) (hq_split_F b)
        (fun 𝔭 hp hne hmem => hkill b 𝔭 hp hne hmem) j
  have hroot_pos : 0 < NumberField.rootDiscr F := by
    rw [NumberField.rootDiscr_def]
    have hdiscr : 0 < (↑|NumberField.discr F| : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (abs_pos.mpr (NumberField.discr_ne_zero (K := F)))
    exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hdiscr _
  have hnumF :
      Real.log (2 * (max 1 (2 * NumberField.rootDiscr F)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant)) ≤
        C_H * (ℓ : ℝ) * Real.log (max 2 ℓ) ∧
      0 < ((((ℓ - 1) ^ 2 / 100 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2 -
        Real.log (2 * (max 1 (2 * NumberField.rootDiscr F)) ^ (2 * classNumberConstant))) := by
    simpa using hnum ℓ hℓH (NumberField.rootDiscr F) hroot_pos hrd
  rcases hnumF with ⟨hHbound, hγ⟩
  rcases proposition_3_8_package_tower ℓ F hcubic hcyclic Q T0 hstep_comp q hq_inj hq_prime hq_mod4 hq_split_layers hγ with
    ⟨T, hTt, hTrd_eq, hTHbase⟩
  have hmax : max (2 : ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) = (ℓ : ℝ) := by
    apply max_eq_right
    exact_mod_cast hℓ2
  have hrd_final : Real.log (NumberField.rootDiscr F) ≤ C_rd * (ℓ : ℝ) * Real.log ℓ := by
    simpa [hmax] using hrd
  refine ⟨T, hTt, ?_, ?_⟩
  · letI : Field T.F := T.field_F
    letI : NumberField T.F := T.numberField_F
    calc
      Real.log (NumberField.rootDiscr T.F) = Real.log (NumberField.rootDiscr F) := hTrd_eq
      _ ≤ C_rd * (ℓ : ℝ) * Real.log ℓ := hrd_final
  · exact le_trans hTHbase hHbound

name: multiIndMap_d
statement:
lemma multiIndMap_d (n : ℕ) (X : Action (TopModuleCat R) H) :
    (Action.res _ f).map ((MultiInd.d R H n).app X) ≫ multiIndMap R f hf (n + 1) X =
      multiIndMap R f hf n X ≫ (MultiInd.d R G n).app ((Action.res _ f).obj X)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>

    rw [MultiInd.d_zero, MultiInd.d_zero]
    simp only [multiIndMap_succ, multiIndMap_zero, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id,
      Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    exact iobjMap_const_app R f hf X
  | succ n ih =>

    have hnat : ∀ {A B : Action (TopModuleCat R) H} (φ : A ⟶ B),
        (Action.res _ f).map ((I R H).map φ) ≫ iobjMap R f hf B =
          iobjMap R f hf A ≫ (I R G).map ((Action.res _ f).map φ) := by
      intro A B φ
      apply Action.Hom.ext
      ext (c' : C(H, A.V)) (x' : G)
      rfl

    have hConst :
        (Action.res _ f).map ((const R H).app ((MultiInd.functor R H (n + 1)).obj X))
            ≫ multiIndMap R f hf ((n + 1) + 1) X
          = multiIndMap R f hf (n + 1) X ≫
              (const R G).app ((MultiInd.functor R G (n + 1)).obj
                ((Action.res _ f).obj X)) := by
      show _ ≫ (iobjMap R f hf _ ≫ (I R G).map _) = _
      simp only [← Category.assoc, iobjMap_const_app R f hf]
      exact ((const R G).naturality (multiIndMap R f hf (n + 1) X)).symm
    have hWhisk :
        (Action.res _ f).map ((I R H).map ((MultiInd.d R H n).app X))
            ≫ multiIndMap R f hf ((n + 1) + 1) X
          = multiIndMap R f hf (n + 1) X ≫
              (I R G).map ((MultiInd.d R G n).app ((Action.res _ f).obj X)) := by

      have step1 := congr_arg ((I R G).map) ih

      simp only [Functor.map_comp] at step1

      have h1 : (Action.res _ f).map ((I R H).map ((MultiInd.d R H n).app X))
            ≫ multiIndMap R f hf ((n + 1) + 1) X
          = iobjMap R f hf ((MultiInd.functor R H n).obj X) ≫
              ((I R G).map ((Action.res _ f).map ((MultiInd.d R H n).app X)) ≫
                (I R G).map (multiIndMap R f hf (n + 1) X)) := by

        show _ ≫ (iobjMap R f hf ((MultiInd.functor R H (n + 1)).obj X) ≫
            (I R G).map (multiIndMap R f hf (n + 1) X)) = _

        have specialized : (Action.res (TopModuleCat R) f).map ((I R H).map ((MultiInd.d R H n).app X)) ≫
              iobjMap R f hf ((MultiInd.functor R H (n + 1)).obj X) =
            iobjMap R f hf ((MultiInd.functor R H n).obj X) ≫
              (I R G).map ((Action.res (TopModuleCat R) f).map ((MultiInd.d R H n).app X)) :=
          hnat _
        calc (Action.res (TopModuleCat R) f).map ((I R H).map ((MultiInd.d R H n).app X)) ≫
              (iobjMap R f hf ((MultiInd.functor R H (n + 1)).obj X) ≫
                (I R G).map (multiIndMap R f hf (n + 1) X))
            = ((Action.res (TopModuleCat R) f).map ((I R H).map ((MultiInd.d R H n).app X)) ≫
                iobjMap R f hf ((MultiInd.functor R H (n + 1)).obj X)) ≫
                (I R G).map (multiIndMap R f hf (n + 1) X) :=
              (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
          _ = (iobjMap R f hf ((MultiInd.functor R H n).obj X) ≫
                (I R G).map ((Action.res (TopModuleCat R) f).map ((MultiInd.d R H n).app X))) ≫
                (I R G).map (multiIndMap R f hf (n + 1) X) := by rw [specialized]; rfl
          _ = iobjMap R f hf ((MultiInd.functor R H n).obj X) ≫
                ((I R G).map ((Action.res (TopModuleCat R) f).map ((MultiInd.d R H n).app X)) ≫
                  (I R G).map (multiIndMap R f hf (n + 1) X)) :=
              Category.assoc _ _ _
      rw [h1]

      refine Eq.trans ?_ rfl

      have : iobjMap R f hf ((MultiInd.functor R H n).obj X) ≫
            ((I R G).map ((Action.res (TopModuleCat R) f).map ((MultiInd.d R H n).app X)) ≫
              (I R G).map (multiIndMap R f hf (n + 1) X)) =
          iobjMap R f hf ((MultiInd.functor R H n).obj X) ≫
            ((I R G).map (multiIndMap R f hf n X) ≫
              (I R G).map ((MultiInd.d R G n).app ((Action.res _ f).obj X))) :=
        congr_arg (iobjMap R f hf ((MultiInd.functor R H n).obj X) ≫ ·) step1
      exact this.trans (by rw [← Category.assoc]; rfl)

    apply Action.Hom.ext
    apply ConcreteCategory.coe_ext

    funext c

    show (((Action.res _ f).map ((MultiInd.d R H (n + 1)).app X) ≫
          multiIndMap R f hf ((n + 1) + 1) X).hom.hom c :
        ((MultiInd.functor R G (n + 1 + 1)).obj ((Action.res _ f).obj X)).V) =
      ((multiIndMap R f hf (n + 1) X ≫
          (MultiInd.d R G (n + 1)).app ((Action.res _ f).obj X)).hom.hom c :
        ((MultiInd.functor R G (n + 1 + 1)).obj ((Action.res _ f).obj X)).V)

    apply ContinuousMap.ext
    intro x

    have hC := congr_arg (fun (u : (Action.res _ f).obj ((MultiInd.functor R H (n + 1)).obj X) ⟶
              (MultiInd.functor R G (n + 1 + 1)).obj ((Action.res _ f).obj X)) =>
            (show C(G, _) from u.hom.hom c) x) hConst
    have hW := congr_arg (fun (u : (Action.res _ f).obj ((MultiInd.functor R H (n + 1)).obj X) ⟶
              (MultiInd.functor R G (n + 1 + 1)).obj ((Action.res _ f).obj X)) =>
            (show C(G, _) from u.hom.hom c) x) hWhisk
    show (show C(G, _) from ((Action.res _ f).map ((MultiInd.d R H (n + 1)).app X) ≫
          multiIndMap R f hf ((n + 1) + 1) X).hom.hom c) x =
      (show C(G, _) from (multiIndMap R f hf (n + 1) X ≫
          (MultiInd.d R G (n + 1)).app ((Action.res _ f).obj X)).hom.hom c) x

    have hd_H_app : (MultiInd.d R H (n + 1)).app X =
        ((by exact (const R H).app ((MultiInd.functor R H (n + 1)).obj X) :
            (MultiInd.functor R H (n + 1)).obj X ⟶
              (MultiInd.functor R H (n + 1 + 1)).obj X) -
          (by exact (I R H).map ((MultiInd.d R H n).app X) :
            (MultiInd.functor R H (n + 1)).obj X ⟶
              (MultiInd.functor R H (n + 1 + 1)).obj X)) := by
      rw [MultiInd.d_succ]; rfl
    have hd_G_app : (MultiInd.d R G (n + 1)).app ((Action.res _ f).obj X) =
        ((by exact (const R G).app
              ((MultiInd.functor R G (n + 1)).obj ((Action.res _ f).obj X)) :
            (MultiInd.functor R G (n + 1)).obj ((Action.res _ f).obj X) ⟶
              (MultiInd.functor R G (n + 1 + 1)).obj ((Action.res _ f).obj X)) -
          (by exact (I R G).map ((MultiInd.d R G n).app ((Action.res _ f).obj X)) :
            (MultiInd.functor R G (n + 1)).obj ((Action.res _ f).obj X) ⟶
              (MultiInd.functor R G (n + 1 + 1)).obj ((Action.res _ f).obj X))) := by
      rw [MultiInd.d_succ]; rfl
    rw [hd_H_app, hd_G_app]

    simp only [Functor.map_sub, Preadditive.sub_comp, Preadditive.comp_sub,
      TopModuleCat.hom_comp, TopModuleCat.hom_sub, Action.sub_hom,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_sub',
      Function.comp_apply, Pi.sub_apply,
      ContinuousMap.coe_sub, ContinuousMap.sub_apply]
    simp only [TopModuleCat.hom_comp, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp',
      Function.comp_apply] at hC hW

    refine congrArg (fun (m : C(G, _)) => m x) ?_
    show (((Action.res _ f).map ((const R H).app ((MultiInd.functor R H (n + 1)).obj X)) ≫
          multiIndMap R f hf (n + 1 + 1) X).hom.hom c -
        ((Action.res _ f).map ((I R H).map ((MultiInd.d R H n).app X)) ≫
          multiIndMap R f hf (n + 1 + 1) X).hom.hom c : C(G, _)) =
      ((multiIndMap R f hf (n + 1) X ≫
          (const R G).app ((MultiInd.functor R G (n + 1)).obj ((Action.res _ f).obj X))).hom.hom c -
        (multiIndMap R f hf (n + 1) X ≫
          (I R G).map ((MultiInd.d R G n).app ((Action.res _ f).obj X))).hom.hom c : C(G, _))
    have hC_c : ((Action.res _ f).map ((const R H).app ((MultiInd.functor R H (n + 1)).obj X)) ≫
          multiIndMap R f hf (n + 1 + 1) X).hom.hom c =
        ((multiIndMap R f hf (n + 1) X ≫
            (const R G).app ((MultiInd.functor R G (n + 1)).obj ((Action.res _ f).obj X))).hom.hom c
            : C(G, _)) :=
      congr_arg (fun (u : (Action.res _ f).obj ((MultiInd.functor R H (n + 1)).obj X) ⟶
              (MultiInd.functor R G (n + 1 + 1)).obj ((Action.res _ f).obj X)) =>
            show C(G, _) from u.hom.hom c) hConst
    have hW_c : ((Action.res _ f).map ((I R H).map ((MultiInd.d R H n).app X)) ≫
          multiIndMap R f hf (n + 1 + 1) X).hom.hom c =
        ((multiIndMap R f hf (n + 1) X ≫
            (I R G).map ((MultiInd.d R G n).app ((Action.res _ f).obj X))).hom.hom c
            : C(G, _)) :=
      congr_arg (fun (u : (Action.res _ f).obj ((MultiInd.functor R H (n + 1)).obj X) ⟶
              (MultiInd.functor R G (n + 1 + 1)).obj ((Action.res _ f).obj X)) =>
            show C(G, _) from u.hom.hom c) hWhisk
    rw [hC_c, hW_c]; rfl

name: MaxUnramifiedProPGaloisGroup.maximalUnramifiedProPF_eq_iSup_index
statement:
theorem MaxUnramifiedProPGaloisGroup.maximalUnramifiedProPF_eq_iSup_index
    (F : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] :
    maximalUnramifiedProPF F p = ⨆ i : maximalUnramifiedProPFIndex F p, i.M
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · unfold maximalUnramifiedProPF
    refine iSup_le ?_; intro M
    refine iSup_le ?_; intro hfd
    refine iSup_le ?_; intro hg
    refine iSup_le ?_; intro hpG
    refine iSup_le ?_; intro hnf
    refine iSup_le ?_; intro hunr
    exact le_iSup (fun i : maximalUnramifiedProPFIndex F p => i.M)
      ⟨M, hfd, hg, hpG, hnf, hunr⟩
  · refine iSup_le ?_; intro i
    rcases i with ⟨M, hfd, hg, hpG, hnf, hunr⟩
    unfold maximalUnramifiedProPF
    exact le_iSup_of_le M <| le_iSup_of_le hfd <| le_iSup_of_le hg
      <| le_iSup_of_le hpG <| le_iSup_of_le hnf <| le_iSup_of_le hunr le_rfl

proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [MaxUnramifiedProPGaloisGroup.maximalUnramifiedProPF_eq_iSup_index (F := F) (p := p)]
  let t : maximalUnramifiedProPFIndex F p → IntermediateField F (AlgebraicClosure F) :=
    fun i => i.M
  letI : ∀ i : maximalUnramifiedProPFIndex F p, Normal F (t i) := fun i => i.hg.to_normal
  simpa [t] using (IntermediateField.normal_iSup (F := F) (t := t))

name: finite_isArithFrobAt_eq_one_iff_inertiaDeg_eq_one
statement:
theorem finite_isArithFrobAt_eq_one_iff_inertiaDeg_eq_one (F M : Type) [Field F] [Field M] [NumberField F] [NumberField M] [Algebra F M]
    [FiniteDimensional F M] [IsGalois F M]
    (𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 F)) (hp : 𝔭.IsPrime) (hne : 𝔭 ≠ ⊥)
    (𝔓 : Ideal (𝓞 M)) (h𝔓 : 𝔓 ∈ 𝔭.primesOver (𝓞 M))
    (h_unr : Ideal.ramificationIdx 𝔭 𝔓 = 1)
    (τ : M ≃ₐ[F] M)
    (hτ : AlgHom.IsArithFrobAt (R := 𝓞 F)
      ((NumberField.RingOfIntegers.mapAlgEquiv τ).toAlgHom) 𝔓) :
    τ = 1 ↔ Ideal.inertiaDeg 𝔭 𝔓 = 1
proof:
:= by
  letI : 𝔭.IsMaximal := hp.isMaximal hne
  have h𝔓_prime : 𝔓.IsPrime := h𝔓.1
  have h𝔓_lies : 𝔓.LiesOver 𝔭 := h𝔓.2
  have h𝔓_ne : 𝔓 ≠ ⊥ := Ideal.ne_bot_of_mem_primesOver hne h𝔓
  letI : 𝔓.IsPrime := h𝔓_prime
  letI : 𝔓.LiesOver 𝔭 := h𝔓_lies
  letI : 𝔓.IsMaximal := h𝔓_prime.isMaximal h𝔓_ne
  have h_under_eq : Ideal.under (𝓞 F) 𝔓 = 𝔭 := (Ideal.over_def 𝔓 𝔭).symm
  letI : (Ideal.under (𝓞 F) 𝔓).IsMaximal := by
    simpa [h_under_eq] using (show 𝔭.IsMaximal from inferInstance)
  letI : Field ((𝓞 F) ⧸ Ideal.under (𝓞 F) 𝔓) := Ideal.Quotient.field _
  letI : Finite ((𝓞 F) ⧸ Ideal.under (𝓞 F) 𝔓) := hτ.finite_quotient
  letI : Fintype ((𝓞 F) ⧸ Ideal.under (𝓞 F) 𝔓) := Fintype.ofFinite ((𝓞 F) ⧸ Ideal.under (𝓞 F) 𝔓)
  letI : Field ((𝓞 M) ⧸ 𝔓) := Ideal.Quotient.field 𝔓
  letI : Finite ((𝓞 M) ⧸ 𝔓) := Ideal.finiteQuotientOfFreeOfNeBot (S := 𝓞 M) 𝔓 h𝔓_ne
  letI : Fintype ((𝓞 M) ⧸ 𝔓) := Fintype.ofFinite ((𝓞 M) ⧸ 𝔓)
  have _ := (Ideal.quotientAlgebra : Algebra ((𝓞 F) ⧸ Ideal.under (𝓞 F) 𝔓) ((𝓞 M) ⧸ 𝔓))
  letI : Algebra ((𝓞 F) ⧸ Ideal.under (𝓞 F) 𝔓) ((𝓞 M) ⧸ 𝔓) := Ideal.quotientAlgebra
  have hrestrict_frob : hτ.restrict =
      FiniteField.frobeniusAlgHom ((𝓞 F) ⧸ Ideal.under (𝓞 F) 𝔓) ((𝓞 M) ⧸ 𝔓) := by
    ext x
    rw [hτ.restrict_apply, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, FiniteField.coe_frobeniusAlgHom]
  have hfieldEq (τ : M ≃ₐ[F] M) :
      IsFractionRing.fieldEquivOfAlgEquiv F M M (NumberField.RingOfIntegers.mapAlgEquiv τ) = τ := by
    ext x
    obtain ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (𝓞 M) x
    rw [map_div₀, IsFractionRing.fieldEquivOfAlgEquiv_algebraMap,
      IsFractionRing.fieldEquivOfAlgEquiv_algebraMap,
      show algebraMap (𝓞 M) M ((NumberField.RingOfIntegers.mapAlgEquiv τ) a) =
          τ (algebraMap (𝓞 M) M a) by rfl,
      show algebraMap (𝓞 M) M ((NumberField.RingOfIntegers.mapAlgEquiv τ) b) =
          τ (algebraMap (𝓞 M) M b) by rfl,
      map_div₀]
  have hfinrank_cast : Module.finrank ((𝓞 F) ⧸ Ideal.under (𝓞 F) 𝔓) ((𝓞 M) ⧸ 𝔓) =
      Module.finrank ((𝓞 F) ⧸ 𝔭) ((𝓞 M) ⧸ 𝔓) := by
    cases h_under_eq
    rfl
  constructor
  · intro hτ_one
    subst hτ_one
    have hrestrict_id : hτ.restrict = 1 := by
      ext x
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
      simpa using hτ.restrict_mk x
    have horder_frob : orderOf (FiniteField.frobeniusAlgHom ((𝓞 F) ⧸ Ideal.under (𝓞 F) 𝔓) ((𝓞 M) ⧸ 𝔓)) =
        Module.finrank ((𝓞 F) ⧸ Ideal.under (𝓞 F) 𝔓) ((𝓞 M) ⧸ 𝔓) :=
      FiniteField.orderOf_frobeniusAlgHom _ _
    have hfinrank : Module.finrank ((𝓞 F) ⧸ Ideal.under (𝓞 F) 𝔓) ((𝓞 M) ⧸ 𝔓) = Ideal.inertiaDeg 𝔭 𝔓 := by
      rw [hfinrank_cast]
      symm
      exact Ideal.inertiaDeg_algebraMap (R := 𝓞 F) (S := 𝓞 M) (p := 𝔭) (P := 𝔓)
    have horder : orderOf hτ.restrict = Ideal.inertiaDeg 𝔭 𝔓 := by
      rw [hrestrict_frob, horder_frob, hfinrank]
    rw [hrestrict_id] at horder
    simpa using horder.symm
  · intro hfin
    have hfinrank' : Module.finrank ((𝓞 F) ⧸ 𝔭) ((𝓞 M) ⧸ 𝔓) = 1 := by
      simpa [Ideal.inertiaDeg_algebraMap (R := 𝓞 F) (S := 𝓞 M) (p := 𝔭) (P := 𝔓)] using hfin
    have hfinrank : Module.finrank ((𝓞 F) ⧸ Ideal.under (𝓞 F) 𝔓) ((𝓞 M) ⧸ 𝔓) = 1 := by
      rw [hfinrank_cast]
      exact hfinrank'
    have horder_frob : orderOf (FiniteField.frobeniusAlgHom ((𝓞 F) ⧸ Ideal.under (𝓞 F) 𝔓) ((𝓞 M) ⧸ 𝔓)) = 1 := by
      rw [FiniteField.orderOf_frobeniusAlgHom]
      exact hfinrank
    have hfrob_id : FiniteField.frobeniusAlgHom ((𝓞 F) ⧸ Ideal.under (𝓞 F) 𝔓) ((𝓞 M) ⧸ 𝔓) = 1 := by
      simpa [horder_frob] using pow_orderOf_eq_one (FiniteField.frobeniusAlgHom ((𝓞 F) ⧸ Ideal.under (𝓞 F) 𝔓) ((𝓞 M) ⧸ 𝔓))
    have h_id_arith : AlgHom.IsArithFrobAt (R := 𝓞 F) (S := 𝓞 M) (1 : (𝓞 M) →ₐ[𝓞 F] (𝓞 M)) 𝔓 := by
      intro x
      rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, map_sub, AlgHom.one_apply, map_pow, sub_eq_zero]
      have hx := DFunLike.congr_fun hfrob_id (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔓 x)
      simpa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hx.symm
    have hUnrAt : Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt (𝓞 F) 𝔓 := by
      exact (Algebra.isUnramifiedAt_iff_of_isDedekindDomain (R := 𝓞 F) (S := 𝓞 M) (p := 𝔓) h𝔓_ne).2 (by
        simpa [h_under_eq] using h_unr)
    letI : Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt (𝓞 F) 𝔓 := hUnrAt
    have hmap_eq : ((NumberField.RingOfIntegers.mapAlgEquiv τ).toAlgHom : (𝓞 M) →ₐ[𝓞 F] (𝓞 M)) = 1 := by
      exact hτ.eq_of_isUnramifiedAt h_id_arith 𝔓.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors
    have hRO_eq : NumberField.RingOfIntegers.mapAlgEquiv τ = 1 := by
      apply AlgEquiv.coe_algHom_injective
      simpa using hmap_eq
    have hfield_map_eq :
        IsFractionRing.fieldEquivOfAlgEquiv F M M (NumberField.RingOfIntegers.mapAlgEquiv τ) =
          IsFractionRing.fieldEquivOfAlgEquiv F M M (1 : (𝓞 M) ≃ₐ[𝓞 F] (𝓞 M)) := by
      exact congrArg (IsFractionRing.fieldEquivOfAlgEquiv F M M) hRO_eq
    have hfield_id : IsFractionRing.fieldEquivOfAlgEquiv F M M (1 : (𝓞 M) ≃ₐ[𝓞 F] (𝓞 M)) = 1 := by
      change IsFractionRing.fieldEquivOfAlgEquiv F M M (AlgEquiv.refl : (𝓞 M) ≃ₐ[𝓞 F] (𝓞 M)) = AlgEquiv.refl
      exact IsFractionRing.fieldEquivOfAlgEquiv_refl (A := 𝓞 F) (B := 𝓞 M) (FA := F) (FB := M)
    rw [hfieldEq τ, hfield_id] at hfield_map_eq
    exact hfield_map_eq

name: isArithFrobAt_restrictNormal
statement:
theorem isArithFrobAt_restrictNormal (F M N : Type) [Field F] [Field M] [Field N]
    [NumberField F] [NumberField M] [NumberField N]
    [Algebra F M] [Algebra F N] [Algebra M N] [IsScalarTower F M N]
    [FiniteDimensional F M] [FiniteDimensional F N] [Normal F M] [IsGalois F N]
    (𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 F))
    (𝔔 : Ideal (𝓞 N)) (h𝔔 : 𝔔 ∈ 𝔭.primesOver (𝓞 N))
    (τ : N ≃ₐ[F] N)
    (hτ : AlgHom.IsArithFrobAt (R := 𝓞 F)
      ((NumberField.RingOfIntegers.mapAlgEquiv τ).toAlgHom) 𝔔) :
    AlgHom.IsArithFrobAt (R := 𝓞 F)
      ((NumberField.RingOfIntegers.mapAlgEquiv (((AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := F) (K₁ := N) M) τ))).toAlgHom)
      (Ideal.comap (algebraMap (𝓞 M) (𝓞 N)) 𝔔)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  have hcomm :
      algebraMap (𝓞 M) (𝓞 N)
          (((NumberField.RingOfIntegers.mapAlgEquiv
            (((AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := F) (K₁ := N) M) τ))).toAlgHom) x)
        =
      ((NumberField.RingOfIntegers.mapAlgEquiv τ).toAlgHom) (algebraMap (𝓞 M) (𝓞 N) x) := by
    apply NumberField.RingOfIntegers.ext
    change
      algebraMap M N ((((AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := F) (K₁ := N) M) τ) : M ≃ₐ[F] M) (x : M)) =
        τ (algebraMap M N (x : M))
    exact AlgEquiv.restrictNormal_commutes (χ := τ) (E := M) (x := (x : M))
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap]
  rw [map_sub, map_pow, hcomm]
  simpa only [Ideal.under_def, Ideal.under_under] using hτ (algebraMap (𝓞 M) (𝓞 N) x)

name: local_unramified_descends_in_tower
statement:
theorem local_unramified_descends_in_tower (F K L : Type) [Field F] [Field K] [Field L]
    [NumberField F] [NumberField K] [NumberField L]
    [Algebra F K] [Algebra F L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower F K L]
    [FiniteDimensional F K] [FiniteDimensional F L]
    (𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 F)) (hp : 𝔭.IsPrime) (hne : 𝔭 ≠ ⊥)
    (hL_unr : ∀ 𝔔 ∈ 𝔭.primesOver (𝓞 L), Ideal.ramificationIdx 𝔭 𝔔 = 1) :
    ∀ 𝔓 ∈ 𝔭.primesOver (𝓞 K), Ideal.ramificationIdx 𝔭 𝔓 = 1
proof:
:= by
  intro 𝔓 h𝔓
  let 𝔓' : Ideal.primesOver 𝔭 (𝓞 K) := ⟨𝔓, h𝔓⟩
  haveI : 𝔓.IsPrime := Ideal.primesOver.isPrime 𝔭 𝔓'
  haveI : 𝔓.LiesOver 𝔭 := Ideal.primesOver.liesOver 𝔭 𝔓'
  obtain ⟨𝔔'⟩ := Ideal.nonempty_primesOver (R := 𝓞 K) (S := 𝓞 L) 𝔓
  haveI : (𝔔' : Ideal (𝓞 L)).IsPrime := Ideal.primesOver.isPrime 𝔓 𝔔'
  haveI : (𝔔' : Ideal (𝓞 L)).LiesOver 𝔓 := Ideal.primesOver.liesOver 𝔓 𝔔'
  haveI : (𝔔' : Ideal (𝓞 L)).LiesOver 𝔭 := Ideal.LiesOver.trans (𝔔' : Ideal (𝓞 L)) 𝔓 𝔭
  have h𝔔_over_p : (𝔔' : Ideal (𝓞 L)) ∈ 𝔭.primesOver (𝓞 L) :=
    (Ideal.primesOver.mk 𝔭 (𝔔' : Ideal (𝓞 L))).property
  have hQne : (𝔔' : Ideal (𝓞 L)) ≠ ⊥ := Ideal.ne_bot_of_mem_primesOver hne h𝔔_over_p
  have hQunr : Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt (𝓞 F) (𝔔' : Ideal (𝓞 L)) := by
    exact
      (Algebra.isUnramifiedAt_iff_of_isDedekindDomain
          (R := 𝓞 F) (S := 𝓞 L) (p := (𝔔' : Ideal (𝓞 L))) hQne).2
        (by
          simpa [Ideal.over_def (A := 𝓞 F) (P := (𝔔' : Ideal (𝓞 L))) (p := 𝔭)] using
            hL_unr (𝔔' : Ideal (𝓞 L)) h𝔔_over_p)
  have hPunr : Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt (𝓞 F) 𝔓 := by
    letI : Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt (𝓞 F) (𝔔' : Ideal (𝓞 L)) := hQunr
    exact Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt.of_liesOver (R := 𝓞 F) (p := 𝔓) (P := (𝔔' : Ideal (𝓞 L)))
  have hPne : 𝔓 ≠ ⊥ := Ideal.ne_bot_of_mem_primesOver hne h𝔓
  exact
    by
      simpa [Ideal.over_def (A := 𝓞 F) (P := 𝔓) (p := 𝔭)] using
        (Algebra.isUnramifiedAt_iff_of_isDedekindDomain
            (R := 𝓞 F) (S := 𝓞 K) (p := 𝔓) hPne).1 hPunr

name: maximalUnramified_restrictNormalHom_surjective
statement:
theorem maximalUnramified_restrictNormalHom_surjective (F : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
    (M : IntermediateField F (maximalUnramifiedProPF F p)) [Normal F M] :
    Function.Surjective ((AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := F)
      (K₁ := maximalUnramifiedProPF F p) M) :
      MaxUnramifiedProPGaloisGroup F p →* (M ≃ₐ[F] M))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Normal F (maximalUnramifiedProPF F p) :=
    MaxUnramifiedProPGaloisGroup.normal_maximalUnramifiedProPF F p
  simpa [MaxUnramifiedProPGaloisGroup] using
    (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_surjective (F := F)
      (K₁ := M) (E := maximalUnramifiedProPF F p))

name: normal_numberField_intermediate_fg
statement:
theorem normal_numberField_intermediate_fg {F K : Type*} [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K]
    (M : IntermediateField F K) [FiniteDimensional F M] [Normal F M] [NumberField M] :
    M.FG
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra.FiniteType F M := Module.Finite.finiteType M
  letI : Algebra.EssFiniteType F M := Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_finiteType F M
  exact (IntermediateField.essFiniteType_iff (F := F) (E := K) (K := M)).1 inferInstance

name: restrictNormal_mem_inertia_comap
statement:
theorem restrictNormal_mem_inertia_comap (F : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F]
    (E K : IntermediateField F (AlgebraicClosure F))
    [NumberField ↥E] [NumberField ↥K]
    [Algebra ↥K ↥E] [IsScalarTower F ↥K ↥E]
    [Normal F ↥K]
    (𝔖 : Ideal (𝓞 ↥E))
    {σ : ↥E ≃ₐ[F] ↥E} :
    σ ∈ 𝔖.inertia (↥E ≃ₐ[F] ↥E) →
      (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := F) (K₁ := ↥E) ↥K σ) ∈
        (Ideal.comap
          (NumberField.RingOfIntegers.mapAlgHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F ↥K ↥E))
          𝔖).inertia (↥K ≃ₐ[F] ↥K)
proof:
:= by
  intro hσ
  rw [AddSubgroup.mem_inertia] at hσ ⊢
  intro x
  let f : 𝓞 ↥K →ₐ[𝓞 F] 𝓞 ↥E :=
    NumberField.RingOfIntegers.mapAlgHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F ↥K ↥E)
  change ((AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := F) (K₁ := ↥E) ↥K σ) • x - x : 𝓞 ↥K) ∈ Ideal.comap f 𝔖
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap]
  rw [show f (((AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := F) (K₁ := ↥E) ↥K σ) • x - x : 𝓞 ↥K)) =
      f ((AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := F) (K₁ := ↥E) ↥K σ) • x) - f x by
    simp]
  have hcomm :
      f ((AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := F) (K₁ := ↥E) ↥K σ) • x) = σ • f x := by
    apply NumberField.RingOfIntegers.ext
    change algebraMap ↥K ↥E (((AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := F) (K₁ := ↥E) ↥K σ) x : ↥K)) =
      σ (algebraMap ↥K ↥E (x : ↥K))
    simpa only [f] using
      (AlgEquiv.restrictNormal_commutes (χ := σ) (E := ↥K) (x := (x : ↥K)))
  have hσx := hσ (f x)
  simpa [hcomm] using hσx

name: restrict_eq_one_of_eq_one_on_sup_left_right
statement:
theorem restrict_eq_one_of_eq_one_on_sup_left_right (F : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F]
    (K L : IntermediateField F (AlgebraicClosure F))
    [Normal F ↥K] [Normal F ↥L] [Normal F ↥(K ⊔ L)]
    [Algebra ↥K ↥(K ⊔ L)] [Algebra ↥L ↥(K ⊔ L)]
    [IsScalarTower F ↥K ↥(K ⊔ L)] [IsScalarTower F ↥L ↥(K ⊔ L)]
    (σ : ↥(K ⊔ L) ≃ₐ[F] ↥(K ⊔ L))
    (hAlgK : ∀ x : ↥K,
      algebraMap ↥K ↥(K ⊔ L) x = IntermediateField.inclusion le_sup_left x)
    (hAlgL : ∀ x : ↥L,
      algebraMap ↥L ↥(K ⊔ L) x = IntermediateField.inclusion le_sup_right x)
    (hK : (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := F) (K₁ := ↥(K ⊔ L)) ↥K σ) = 1)
    (hL : (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := F) (K₁ := ↥(K ⊔ L)) ↥L σ) = 1) :
    σ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hKx : ∀ x : ↥K, (σ.restrictNormal ↥K) x = x := by
    intro x
    have hx := congrArg (fun e : ↥K ≃ₐ[F] ↥K => e x) hK
    simpa using hx
  have hLx : ∀ x : ↥L, (σ.restrictNormal ↥L) x = x := by
    intro x
    have hx := congrArg (fun e : ↥L ≃ₐ[F] ↥L => e x) hL
    simpa using hx
  have hfixK : ∀ x : ↥K, σ (algebraMap ↥K ↥(K ⊔ L) x) = algebraMap ↥K ↥(K ⊔ L) x := by
    intro x
    have hcomm := AlgEquiv.restrictNormal_commutes (χ := σ) (E := ↥K) (x := x)
    rw [hKx x] at hcomm
    simpa using hcomm.symm
  have hfixL : ∀ x : ↥L, σ (algebraMap ↥L ↥(K ⊔ L) x) = algebraMap ↥L ↥(K ⊔ L) x := by
    intro x
    have hcomm := AlgEquiv.restrictNormal_commutes (χ := σ) (E := ↥L) (x := x)
    rw [hLx x] at hcomm
    simpa using hcomm.symm
  have hS :
      (K ⊔ L : IntermediateField F (AlgebraicClosure F)) =
        IntermediateField.adjoin F ((K : Set (AlgebraicClosure F)) ∪ L) := by
    simpa using (IntermediateField.sup_def K L)
  have hσ_alg : (σ : ↥(K ⊔ L) →ₐ[F] ↥(K ⊔ L)) = 1 := by
    refine IntermediateField.algHom_ext_of_eq_adjoin (F := F) (S := K ⊔ L) hS ?_
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · let xE : ↥(K ⊔ L) :=
        ⟨x,
          hS.ge
            (IntermediateField.subset_adjoin F ((K : Set (AlgebraicClosure F)) ∪ L)
              (Or.inl hx))⟩
      let e : ↥K := ⟨x, hx⟩
      have hxE : xE = algebraMap ↥K ↥(K ⊔ L) e := by
        ext
        rw [hAlgK e]
        simpa [xE, e] using
          (IntermediateField.coe_inclusion (hEF := le_sup_left) (e := e)).symm
      calc
        σ xE = σ (algebraMap ↥K ↥(K ⊔ L) e) := by rw [hxE]
        _ = algebraMap ↥K ↥(K ⊔ L) e := hfixK _
        _ = (1 : ↥(K ⊔ L) →ₐ[F] ↥(K ⊔ L)) xE := by rw [hxE]; rfl
    · let xE : ↥(K ⊔ L) :=
        ⟨x,
          hS.ge
            (IntermediateField.subset_adjoin F ((K : Set (AlgebraicClosure F)) ∪ L)
              (Or.inr hx))⟩
      let e : ↥L := ⟨x, hx⟩
      have hxE : xE = algebraMap ↥L ↥(K ⊔ L) e := by
        ext
        rw [hAlgL e]
        simpa [xE, e] using
          (IntermediateField.coe_inclusion (hEF := le_sup_right) (e := e)).symm
      calc
        σ xE = σ (algebraMap ↥L ↥(K ⊔ L) e) := by rw [hxE]
        _ = algebraMap ↥L ↥(K ⊔ L) e := hfixL _
        _ = (1 : ↥(K ⊔ L) →ₐ[F] ↥(K ⊔ L)) xE := by rw [hxE]; rfl
  ext x
  simpa using congrArg (fun f : ↥(K ⊔ L) →ₐ[F] ↥(K ⊔ L) => f x) hσ_alg

name: two_field_sup_locally_unramified
statement:
theorem two_field_sup_locally_unramified (F : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F]
    (𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 F)) (hp : 𝔭.IsPrime) (hne : 𝔭 ≠ ⊥)
    (K L : IntermediateField F (AlgebraicClosure F))
    [FiniteDimensional F ↥K] [FiniteDimensional F ↥L] [FiniteDimensional F ↥(K ⊔ L)]
    [IsGalois F ↥K] [IsGalois F ↥L] [IsGalois F ↥(K ⊔ L)]
    [NumberField ↥K] [NumberField ↥L] [NumberField ↥(K ⊔ L)]
    (hK : ∀ 𝔓 ∈ 𝔭.primesOver (𝓞 ↥K), Ideal.ramificationIdx 𝔭 𝔓 = 1)
    (hL : ∀ 𝔔 ∈ 𝔭.primesOver (𝓞 ↥L), Ideal.ramificationIdx 𝔭 𝔔 = 1) :
    ∀ 𝔖 ∈ 𝔭.primesOver (𝓞 ↥(K ⊔ L)), Ideal.ramificationIdx 𝔭 𝔖 = 1
proof:
:= by
  intro 𝔖 h𝔖
  letI : Algebra ↥K ↥(K ⊔ L) :=
    RingHom.toAlgebra ((IntermediateField.inclusion le_sup_left).toRingHom)
  letI : IsScalarTower F ↥K ↥(K ⊔ L) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algHom (IntermediateField.inclusion le_sup_left)
  letI : Algebra ↥L ↥(K ⊔ L) :=
    RingHom.toAlgebra ((IntermediateField.inclusion le_sup_right).toRingHom)
  letI : IsScalarTower F ↥L ↥(K ⊔ L) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algHom (IntermediateField.inclusion le_sup_right)
  letI : Normal F ↥K :=
    (isGalois_iff.mp (show IsGalois F ↥K from inferInstance)).2
  letI : Normal F ↥L :=
    (isGalois_iff.mp (show IsGalois F ↥L from inferInstance)).2
  letI : Normal F ↥(K ⊔ L) :=
    (isGalois_iff.mp (show IsGalois F ↥(K ⊔ L) from inferInstance)).2
  let fK : (𝓞 ↥K) →ₐ[𝓞 F] (𝓞 ↥(K ⊔ L)) :=
    NumberField.RingOfIntegers.mapAlgHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F ↥K ↥(K ⊔ L))
  let fL : (𝓞 ↥L) →ₐ[𝓞 F] (𝓞 ↥(K ⊔ L)) :=
    NumberField.RingOfIntegers.mapAlgHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F ↥L ↥(K ⊔ L))
  let 𝔓 : Ideal (𝓞 ↥K) := Ideal.comap fK 𝔖
  let 𝔔 : Ideal (𝓞 ↥L) := Ideal.comap fL 𝔖
  have hSprime : 𝔖.IsPrime := h𝔖.1
  have hSlies : 𝔖.LiesOver 𝔭 := h𝔖.2
  have hPprime : 𝔓.IsPrime := by
    dsimp [𝔓]
    letI : 𝔖.IsPrime := hSprime
    simpa using (Ideal.comap_isPrime fK.toRingHom 𝔖)
  have hQprime : 𝔔.IsPrime := by
    dsimp [𝔔]
    letI : 𝔖.IsPrime := hSprime
    simpa using (Ideal.comap_isPrime fL.toRingHom 𝔖)
  have hPlies : 𝔓.LiesOver 𝔭 := by
    dsimp [𝔓]
    letI : 𝔖.LiesOver 𝔭 := hSlies
    simpa using (Ideal.comap_liesOver 𝔖 𝔭 fK)
  have hQlies : 𝔔.LiesOver 𝔭 := by
    dsimp [𝔔]
    letI : 𝔖.LiesOver 𝔭 := hSlies
    simpa using (Ideal.comap_liesOver 𝔖 𝔭 fL)
  have hPmem : 𝔓 ∈ 𝔭.primesOver (𝓞 ↥K) := ⟨hPprime, hPlies⟩
  have hQmem : 𝔔 ∈ 𝔭.primesOver (𝓞 ↥L) := ⟨hQprime, hQlies⟩
  letI : 𝔭.IsMaximal := hp.isMaximal hne
  letI : 𝔓.IsMaximal := hPprime.isMaximal (Ideal.ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot hne 𝔓)
  letI : 𝔔.IsMaximal := hQprime.isMaximal (Ideal.ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot hne 𝔔)
  letI : 𝔖.IsMaximal := hSprime.isMaximal (Ideal.ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot hne 𝔖)
  letI : Field ((𝓞 F) ⧸ 𝔭) := Ideal.Quotient.field 𝔭
  letI : Field ((𝓞 ↥K) ⧸ 𝔓) := Ideal.Quotient.field 𝔓
  letI : Field ((𝓞 ↥L) ⧸ 𝔔) := Ideal.Quotient.field 𝔔
  letI : Field ((𝓞 ↥(K ⊔ L)) ⧸ 𝔖) := Ideal.Quotient.field 𝔖
  let p0 : Ideal ℤ := Ideal.under ℤ 𝔭
  have habsNorm_p_ne_zero : Ideal.absNorm 𝔭 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    exact hne ((Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff (I := 𝔭)).mp h0)
  have hp0ne : p0 ≠ ⊥ := by
    letI : 𝔭.LiesOver p0 := by
      dsimp [p0]
      simpa using (Ideal.over_under (A := ℤ) 𝔭)
    intro hp0bot
    have hmem0 : (((Ideal.absNorm 𝔭 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∈ p0 := by
      exact (Ideal.mem_of_liesOver (P := 𝔭) (p := p0) (((Ideal.absNorm 𝔭 : ℕ) : ℤ))).2
        (by simpa using (Ideal.absNorm_mem 𝔭))
    have hz0 : (((Ideal.absNorm 𝔭 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 0 := by
      simpa [hp0bot] using hmem0
    exact habsNorm_p_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast hz0)
  have hp0abs_ne_zero : Ideal.absNorm p0 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    exact hp0ne ((Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff (I := p0)).mp h0)
  have hp0eq : Ideal.span ({(Ideal.absNorm p0 : ℤ)} : Set ℤ) = p0 := by
    simpa [p0] using (Int.ideal_span_absNorm_eq_self p0)
  let e : ℤ ⧸ p0 ≃+* ZMod (Ideal.absNorm p0) :=
    (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hp0eq.symm).trans (Int.quotientSpanNatEquivZMod (Ideal.absNorm p0))
  letI : NeZero (Ideal.absNorm p0) := ⟨hp0abs_ne_zero⟩
  letI : Fintype (ZMod (Ideal.absNorm p0)) := ZMod.fintype (Ideal.absNorm p0)
  have hfinZ : Finite (ℤ ⧸ p0) := Finite.of_equiv _ e.symm.toEquiv
  letI : Finite (ℤ ⧸ p0) := hfinZ
  have hmf : Module.Finite (ℤ ⧸ p0) ((𝓞 F) ⧸ 𝔭) := by
    letI : 𝔭.LiesOver p0 := by
      dsimp [p0]
      simpa using (Ideal.over_under (A := ℤ) 𝔭)
    exact module_finite_of_liesOver (P := 𝔭) (p := p0)
  letI : Module.Finite (ℤ ⧸ p0) ((𝓞 F) ⧸ 𝔭) := hmf
  letI : Finite ((𝓞 F) ⧸ 𝔭) := Module.finite_of_finite (R := ℤ ⧸ p0)
  letI : PerfectField ((𝓞 F) ⧸ 𝔭) := PerfectField.ofFinite
  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic ((𝓞 F) ⧸ 𝔭) ((𝓞 ↥K) ⧸ 𝔓) := by infer_instance
  letI : Algebra.IsSeparable ((𝓞 F) ⧸ 𝔭) ((𝓞 ↥K) ⧸ 𝔓) :=
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isSeparable_of_perfectField
  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic ((𝓞 F) ⧸ 𝔭) ((𝓞 ↥L) ⧸ 𝔔) := by infer_instance
  letI : Algebra.IsSeparable ((𝓞 F) ⧸ 𝔭) ((𝓞 ↥L) ⧸ 𝔔) :=
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isSeparable_of_perfectField
  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic ((𝓞 F) ⧸ 𝔭) ((𝓞 ↥(K ⊔ L)) ⧸ 𝔖) := by infer_instance
  letI : Algebra.IsSeparable ((𝓞 F) ⧸ 𝔭) ((𝓞 ↥(K ⊔ L)) ⧸ 𝔖) :=
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isSeparable_of_perfectField
  have hramK : Ideal.ramificationIdx 𝔭 𝔓 = 1 := hK 𝔓 hPmem
  have hramL : Ideal.ramificationIdx 𝔭 𝔔 = 1 := hL 𝔔 hQmem
  have hcardK : Nat.card (𝔓.inertia (↥K ≃ₐ[F] ↥K)) = 1 := by
    letI : 𝔓.LiesOver 𝔭 := hPlies
    letI : 𝔓.IsPrime := hPprime
    rw [Ideal.card_inertia_eq_ramificationIdxIn (G := ↥K ≃ₐ[F] ↥K) 𝔭 hne 𝔓,
      Ideal.ramificationIdxIn_eq_ramificationIdx (G := ↥K ≃ₐ[F] ↥K) (p := 𝔭) (P := 𝔓)]
    exact hramK
  have hcardL : Nat.card (𝔔.inertia (↥L ≃ₐ[F] ↥L)) = 1 := by
    letI : 𝔔.LiesOver 𝔭 := hQlies
    letI : 𝔔.IsPrime := hQprime
    rw [Ideal.card_inertia_eq_ramificationIdxIn (G := ↥L ≃ₐ[F] ↥L) 𝔭 hne 𝔔,
      Ideal.ramificationIdxIn_eq_ramificationIdx (G := ↥L ≃ₐ[F] ↥L) (p := 𝔭) (P := 𝔔)]
    exact hramL
  have hInertiaK_bot : 𝔓.inertia (↥K ≃ₐ[F] ↥K) = ⊥ :=
    (Subgroup.card_eq_one).mp hcardK
  have hInertiaL_bot : 𝔔.inertia (↥L ≃ₐ[F] ↥L) = ⊥ :=
    (Subgroup.card_eq_one).mp hcardL
  have hSinertia_bot : 𝔖.inertia (↥(K ⊔ L) ≃ₐ[F] ↥(K ⊔ L)) = ⊥ := by
    refine Subgroup.ext ?_
    intro σ
    constructor
    · intro hσ
      have hresK_mem :
          (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := F) (K₁ := ↥(K ⊔ L)) ↥K σ) ∈
            𝔓.inertia (↥K ≃ₐ[F] ↥K) := by
        simpa [fK, 𝔓] using
          (restrictNormal_mem_inertia_comap F (K ⊔ L) K 𝔖 (σ := σ) hσ)
      have hresL_mem :
          (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := F) (K₁ := ↥(K ⊔ L)) ↥L σ) ∈
            𝔔.inertia (↥L ≃ₐ[F] ↥L) := by
        simpa [fL, 𝔔] using
          (restrictNormal_mem_inertia_comap F (K ⊔ L) L 𝔖 (σ := σ) hσ)
      have hresK : (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := F) (K₁ := ↥(K ⊔ L)) ↥K σ) = 1 := by
        rw [hInertiaK_bot] at hresK_mem
        simpa [Subgroup.mem_bot] using hresK_mem
      have hresL : (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := F) (K₁ := ↥(K ⊔ L)) ↥L σ) = 1 := by
        rw [hInertiaL_bot] at hresL_mem
        simpa [Subgroup.mem_bot] using hresL_mem
      have hAlgK : ∀ x : ↥K,
          algebraMap ↥K ↥(K ⊔ L) x = IntermediateField.inclusion le_sup_left x := by
        intro x
        rfl
      have hAlgL : ∀ x : ↥L,
          algebraMap ↥L ↥(K ⊔ L) x = IntermediateField.inclusion le_sup_right x := by
        intro x
        rfl
      have hσ1 : σ = 1 :=
        restrict_eq_one_of_eq_one_on_sup_left_right F K L σ hAlgK hAlgL hresK hresL
      simpa [Subgroup.mem_bot] using hσ1
    · intro hσ
      have hσ1 : σ = 1 := by
        simpa [Subgroup.mem_bot] using hσ
      rw [hσ1]
      exact (𝔖.inertia (↥(K ⊔ L) ≃ₐ[F] ↥(K ⊔ L))).one_mem
  have hramIn : Ideal.ramificationIdxIn 𝔭 (𝓞 ↥(K ⊔ L)) = 1 := by
    letI : 𝔖.LiesOver 𝔭 := hSlies
    rw [← Ideal.card_inertia_eq_ramificationIdxIn
      (G := ↥(K ⊔ L) ≃ₐ[F] ↥(K ⊔ L)) 𝔭 hne 𝔖, hSinertia_bot, Subgroup.card_bot]
  letI : 𝔖.LiesOver 𝔭 := hSlies
  letI : 𝔖.IsPrime := hSprime
  rw [← Ideal.ramificationIdxIn_eq_ramificationIdx
    (G := ↥(K ⊔ L) ≃ₐ[F] ↥(K ⊔ L)) (p := 𝔭) (P := 𝔖)]
  exact hramIn

name: maximalUnramifiedFiniteStage_locally_unramified
statement:
theorem maximalUnramifiedFiniteStage_locally_unramified (F : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
    (𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 F)) (hp : 𝔭.IsPrime) (hne : 𝔭 ≠ ⊥)
    (s : Finset (maximalUnramifiedProPFIndex F p))
    [NumberField (maximalUnramifiedFiniteStage F p s)] :
    ∀ 𝔓 ∈ 𝔭.primesOver (𝓞 (maximalUnramifiedFiniteStage F p s)),
      Ideal.ramificationIdx 𝔭 𝔓 = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      intro 𝔓 h𝔓
      simp [maximalUnramifiedFiniteStage, iSup_false] at h𝔓 ⊢
      have hPrime : 𝔓.IsPrime := h𝔓.1
      have hOver : 𝔓.LiesOver 𝔭 := h𝔓.2
      have hempty : maximalUnramifiedFiniteStage F p (∅ : Finset (maximalUnramifiedProPFIndex F p)) =
          (⊥ : IntermediateField F (AlgebraicClosure F)) := by
        simp [maximalUnramifiedFiniteStage, iSup_false]
      let eStage : ↥(maximalUnramifiedFiniteStage F p (∅ : Finset (maximalUnramifiedProPFIndex F p))) ≃ₐ[F] F :=
        (IntermediateField.equivOfEq (F := F) (E := AlgebraicClosure F) hempty).trans
          (IntermediateField.botEquiv F (AlgebraicClosure F))
      let e : (𝓞 ↥(maximalUnramifiedFiniteStage F p (∅ : Finset (maximalUnramifiedProPFIndex F p)))) ≃ₐ[𝓞 F] (𝓞 F) :=
        NumberField.RingOfIntegers.mapAlgEquiv eStage
      let Q : Ideal (𝓞 F) := Ideal.map e 𝔓
      have hQOver : Q.LiesOver 𝔭 := by
        dsimp [Q]
        infer_instance
      have hQeq : Q = 𝔭 := by
        simpa [Q] using (Ideal.over_def (P := Q) (p := 𝔭)).symm
      have hramQ : Ideal.ramificationIdx 𝔭 Q = 1 := by
        simpa [hQeq] using
          (Ideal.ramificationIdx_map_self_eq_one (R := 𝓞 F) (S := 𝓞 F)
            (h₁ := by simpa using hp.ne_top)
            (h₂ := by simpa using hne))
      have hmap : Ideal.ramificationIdx 𝔭 Q = Ideal.ramificationIdx 𝔭 𝔓 := by
        simpa [Q] using
          (Ideal.ramificationIdx_map_eq (R := 𝓞 F) (S := 𝓞 ↥(maximalUnramifiedFiniteStage F p ∅))
            (S₁ := 𝓞 F) (p := 𝔭) (P := 𝔓) e)
      exact hmap.symm.trans hramQ
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
      let S := maximalUnramifiedFiniteStage F p s
      letI : FiniteDimensional F ↥i.M := i.hfd
      letI : IsGalois F ↥i.M := i.hg
      letI : NumberField ↥i.M := i.hnf
      letI : ∀ j : maximalUnramifiedProPFIndex F p, FiniteDimensional F ↥(j.M) := fun j => j.hfd
      letI : FiniteDimensional F ↥S := by
        simpa [S, maximalUnramifiedFiniteStage] using
          (IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_iSup_of_finset
            (K := F) (L := AlgebraicClosure F)
            (t := fun j : maximalUnramifiedProPFIndex F p => j.M) (s := s))
      letI : NumberField ↥S := NumberField.of_module_finite F S
      have hS_eq : S = ⨆ j : {j // j ∈ s}, j.1.M := by
        dsimp [S, maximalUnramifiedFiniteStage]
        rw [← Finset.iSup_coe (s := s) (f := fun j : maximalUnramifiedProPFIndex F p => j.M)]
        symm
        exact iSup_subtype
      have hS_normal' : Normal F ↥(⨆ j : {j // j ∈ s}, j.1.M) := by
        letI : ∀ j : {j // j ∈ s}, Normal F ↥(j.1.M) := fun j => j.1.hg.to_normal
        exact IntermediateField.normal_iSup (F := F) (t := fun j : {j // j ∈ s} => j.1.M)
      have hS_normal : Normal F ↥S := by
        rw [hS_eq]
        exact hS_normal'
      letI : IsGalois F ↥S := by
        rw [isGalois_iff]
        exact ⟨inferInstance, hS_normal⟩
      have hstage : maximalUnramifiedFiniteStage F p (insert i s) = i.M ⊔ S := by
        simpa [S, maximalUnramifiedFiniteStage] using
          (Finset.iSup_insert i s (fun j : maximalUnramifiedProPFIndex F p => j.M))
      letI : FiniteDimensional F ↥(i.M ⊔ S) := IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_sup (K := F) (E1 := i.M) (E2 := S)
      have hsup_normal : Normal F ↥(i.M ⊔ S) := IntermediateField.normal_sup (E := i.M) (E' := S)
      letI : IsGalois F ↥(i.M ⊔ S) := by
        rw [isGalois_iff]
        exact ⟨inferInstance, hsup_normal⟩
      letI : NumberField ↥(i.M ⊔ S) := NumberField.of_module_finite F ↥(i.M ⊔ S)
      rw [hstage]
      simpa [S] using
        two_field_sup_locally_unramified F 𝔭 hp hne i.M S
          (fun 𝔔 h𝔔 => i.hunr.unramified_at_finite 𝔭 𝔔 hp hne h𝔔)
          (fun 𝔔 h𝔔 => ih 𝔔 h𝔔)

name: finite_galois_subextension_of_maximalUnramified_locally_unramified
statement:
theorem finite_galois_subextension_of_maximalUnramified_locally_unramified (F : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
    (𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 F)) (hp : 𝔭.IsPrime) (hne : 𝔭 ≠ ⊥)
    (M : IntermediateField F (maximalUnramifiedProPF F p))
    [FiniteDimensional F M] [Normal F M] [NumberField M] :
    ∀ 𝔓 ∈ 𝔭.primesOver (𝓞 M), Ideal.ramificationIdx 𝔭 𝔓 = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro 𝔓 h𝔓
  let E : IntermediateField F (AlgebraicClosure F) := maximalUnramifiedProPF F p
  let M' : IntermediateField F (AlgebraicClosure F) := IntermediateField.lift M
  have hM_fg0 : M.FG := normal_numberField_intermediate_fg M
  have hM_fg : M'.FG := by
    rcases hM_fg0 with ⟨s0, hs0⟩
    refine ⟨s0.image (fun x : maximalUnramifiedProPF F p => (x : AlgebraicClosure F)), ?_⟩
    have hs0' : IntermediateField.lift (IntermediateField.adjoin F (↑s0 : Set (maximalUnramifiedProPF F p))) = M' := by
      simpa [M'] using congrArg (fun S : IntermediateField F (maximalUnramifiedProPF F p) => IntermediateField.lift S) hs0
    simpa [IntermediateField.lift, IntermediateField.adjoin_map, Finset.coe_image] using hs0'
  let t : maximalUnramifiedProPFIndex F p → IntermediateField F (AlgebraicClosure F) := fun i => i.M
  have hEq : maximalUnramifiedProPF F p = ⨆ i : maximalUnramifiedProPFIndex F p, t i := by
    simpa [t] using MaxUnramifiedProPGaloisGroup.maximalUnramifiedProPF_eq_iSup_index (F := F) (p := p)
  have hMle0 : M' ≤ maximalUnramifiedProPF F p := by
    simpa [M', E] using (show IntermediateField.lift M ≤ maximalUnramifiedProPF F p from IntermediateField.lift_le M)
  have hMle1 : M' ≤ ⨆ i : maximalUnramifiedProPFIndex F p, t i := by
    simpa [hEq] using hMle0
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := fg_intermediateField_le_iSup_finset (M := M') hM_fg (t := t) hMle1
  let S : IntermediateField F (AlgebraicClosure F) := maximalUnramifiedFiniteStage F p s
  have hMleS : M' ≤ S := by
    simpa [S, maximalUnramifiedFiniteStage, t] using hs
  letI : ∀ i : maximalUnramifiedProPFIndex F p, FiniteDimensional F (t i) := fun i => i.hfd
  letI : FiniteDimensional F S := by
    simpa [S, maximalUnramifiedFiniteStage, t] using
      (IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_iSup_of_finset (K := F) (L := AlgebraicClosure F) (t := t) (s := s))
  letI : NumberField S := NumberField.of_module_finite F S
  have hS_unr : ∀ 𝔔 ∈ 𝔭.primesOver (𝓞 S), Ideal.ramificationIdx 𝔭 𝔔 = 1 :=
    maximalUnramifiedFiniteStage_locally_unramified F p 𝔭 hp hne s
  let f : M →ₐ[F] S :=
    (IntermediateField.inclusion hMleS).comp (IntermediateField.liftAlgEquiv M).toAlgHom
  let instMS : Algebra M S := f.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let instTower : @IsScalarTower F M S _ instMS.toSMul _ := IsScalarTower.of_algHom f
  exact @local_unramified_descends_in_tower F M S _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ instMS instTower _ _ 𝔭 hp hne hS_unr 𝔓 h𝔓

name: exists_splittingDetectorAt
statement:
theorem exists_splittingDetectorAt (F : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
    (𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 F)) (_hp : 𝔭.IsPrime) (_hne : 𝔭 ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ σ : MaxUnramifiedProPGaloisGroup F p, IsSplittingDetectorAt F p 𝔭 σ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : 𝔭.IsPrime := _hp
  let K := maximalUnramifiedProPF F p
  let A : SplittingDetectorTestField F p → Set (MaxUnramifiedProPGaloisGroup F p) := fun i => by
    letI : FiniteDimensional F i.M := i.hfd
    letI : Normal F i.M := i.hnorm
    letI : NumberField i.M := i.hnf
    letI : IsPGroup p (i.M ≃ₐ[F] i.M) := i.hpG
    exact {σ | ((AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := F) (K₁ := K) i.M) σ : i.M ≃ₐ[F] i.M) = 1 ↔
      ∀ 𝔓 ∈ 𝔭.primesOver (𝓞 i.M), Ideal.inertiaDeg 𝔭 𝔓 = 1}
  have hclosed : ∀ i, IsClosed (A i) := by
    intro i
    dsimp [A]
    letI : FiniteDimensional F i.M := i.hfd
    letI : Normal F i.M := i.hnorm
    letI : NumberField i.M := i.hnf
    letI : IsPGroup p (i.M ≃ₐ[F] i.M) := i.hpG
    let res : MaxUnramifiedProPGaloisGroup F p → (i.M ≃ₐ[F] i.M) :=
      AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := F) (K₁ := K) i.M
    have hres : Continuous res := by
      simpa [res, K] using
        (InfiniteGalois.restrictNormalHom_continuous (k := F) (K := K) i.M)
    letI : DiscreteTopology (i.M ≃ₐ[F] i.M) :=
      krullTopology_discreteTopology_of_finiteDimensional F i.M
    by_cases hsplit : ∀ 𝔓 ∈ 𝔭.primesOver (𝓞 i.M), Ideal.inertiaDeg 𝔭 𝔓 = 1
    · let S : Set (i.M ≃ₐ[F] i.M) := {(1 : i.M ≃ₐ[F] i.M)}
      have hS : IsClosed S := isClosed_discrete S
      have hA : {σ : MaxUnramifiedProPGaloisGroup F p |
          (res σ = 1 ↔ ∀ 𝔓 ∈ 𝔭.primesOver (𝓞 i.M), Ideal.inertiaDeg 𝔭 𝔓 = 1)} = res ⁻¹' S := by
        ext σ
        constructor
        · intro h
          exact h.mpr hsplit
        · intro hσ
          constructor
          · intro _
            exact hsplit
          · intro _
            exact hσ
      rw [hA]
      exact IsClosed.preimage hres hS
    · let S : Set (i.M ≃ₐ[F] i.M) := ({(1 : i.M ≃ₐ[F] i.M)} : Set (i.M ≃ₐ[F] i.M))ᶜ
      have hS : IsClosed S := isClosed_discrete S
      have hA : {σ : MaxUnramifiedProPGaloisGroup F p |
          (res σ = 1 ↔ ∀ 𝔓 ∈ 𝔭.primesOver (𝓞 i.M), Ideal.inertiaDeg 𝔭 𝔓 = 1)} = res ⁻¹' S := by
        ext σ
        constructor
        · intro h hσ
          exact hsplit (h.mp hσ)
        · intro hσ
          constructor
          · intro hEq
            exact False.elim (hσ hEq)
          · intro hsplit'
            exact False.elim (hsplit hsplit')
      rw [hA]
      exact IsClosed.preimage hres hS
  have hFIP : ∀ s : Finset (SplittingDetectorTestField F p), (⋂ i ∈ s, A i).Nonempty := by
    intro s
    let ιs : Type := {i : SplittingDetectorTestField F p // i ∈ (↑s : Set (SplittingDetectorTestField F p))}
    let N : IntermediateField F K := ⨆ i : ιs, i.1.M
    have hle : ∀ {i : SplittingDetectorTestField F p}, i ∈ s → i.M ≤ N := by
      intro i hi
      exact le_iSup (fun j : ιs => j.1.M) ⟨i, by simpa using hi⟩
    letI : Finite ιs := by infer_instance
    letI : ∀ i : ιs, FiniteDimensional F i.1.M := fun i => i.1.hfd
    letI : FiniteDimensional F N := by
      simpa [N] using
        (IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_iSup_of_finite
          (K := F) (L := K) (t := fun i : ιs => i.1.M))
    letI : ∀ i : ιs, Normal F i.1.M := fun i => i.1.hnorm
    letI : Normal F N := by
      simpa [N] using
        (IntermediateField.normal_iSup (F := F) (K := K) (t := fun i : ιs => i.1.M))
    letI : IsGalois F N := by
      rw [isGalois_iff]
      exact ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
    letI : NumberField N := NumberField.of_module_finite F N
    letI : 𝔭.IsMaximal := Ideal.IsPrime.isMaximal _hp _hne
    have hQnonempty : Nonempty (𝔭.primesOver (𝓞 N)) := by
      simpa using (Ideal.nonempty_primesOver (R := 𝓞 F) (S := 𝓞 N) 𝔭)
    let Qs : 𝔭.primesOver (𝓞 N) := Classical.choice hQnonempty
    let 𝔔 : Ideal (𝓞 N) := Qs.1
    have h𝔔 : 𝔔 ∈ 𝔭.primesOver (𝓞 N) := Qs.2
    letI : 𝔔.IsPrime := Qs.2.1
    letI : 𝔔.LiesOver 𝔭 := Qs.2.2
    letI : 𝔔.IsMaximal := by
      change Qs.1.IsMaximal
      exact Ideal.primesOver.isMaximal Qs
    have hQne : 𝔔 ≠ ⊥ := by
      exact Ring.ne_bot_of_isMaximal_of_not_isField inferInstance (NumberField.RingOfIntegers.not_isField N)
    haveI : Module.Finite ℤ (𝓞 N) := by infer_instance
    letI : Finite (𝓞 N ⧸ 𝔔) := Ideal.finiteQuotientOfFreeOfNeBot 𝔔 hQne
    have hramN :=
      finite_galois_subextension_of_maximalUnramified_locally_unramified
        F p 𝔭 _hp _hne N
    have hramQ : Ideal.ramificationIdx 𝔭 𝔔 = 1 := hramN 𝔔 h𝔔
    let τ : N ≃ₐ[F] N := arithFrobAt (R := 𝓞 F) (G := N ≃ₐ[F] N) 𝔔
    have hτ : AlgHom.IsArithFrobAt (R := 𝓞 F)
        ((NumberField.RingOfIntegers.mapAlgEquiv τ).toAlgHom) 𝔔 := by
      change IsArithFrobAt (R := 𝓞 F) τ 𝔔
      simpa [τ] using (IsArithFrobAt.arithFrobAt (R := 𝓞 F) (G := N ≃ₐ[F] N) (Q := 𝔔))
    have hsurj := maximalUnramified_restrictNormalHom_surjective (F := F) (p := p) N
    obtain ⟨σ, hσN⟩ := hsurj τ
    refine ⟨σ, ?_⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_iInter]
    intro i hi
    letI : FiniteDimensional F i.M := i.hfd
    letI : Normal F i.M := i.hnorm
    letI : NumberField i.M := i.hnf
    letI : IsPGroup p (i.M ≃ₐ[F] i.M) := i.hpG
    letI : IsGalois F i.M := by
      rw [isGalois_iff]
      exact ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
    let f_incl : i.M →ₐ[F] N := IntermediateField.inclusion (hle hi)
    let instMN : Algebra i.M N := f_incl.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra i.M N := instMN
    letI : SMul i.M N := instMN.toSMul
    letI : IsScalarTower F i.M N := IsScalarTower.of_algHom f_incl
    let f : (𝓞 i.M) →ₐ[𝓞 F] (𝓞 N) := NumberField.RingOfIntegers.mapAlgHom f_incl
    let 𝔓0 : Ideal (𝓞 i.M) := Ideal.comap f 𝔔
    have h𝔓0 : 𝔓0 ∈ 𝔭.primesOver (𝓞 i.M) := by
      letI : 𝔓0.IsPrime := Ideal.comap_isPrime f.toRingHom 𝔔
      letI : 𝔓0.LiesOver 𝔭 := Ideal.comap_liesOver (Q := 𝔔) (p := 𝔭) f
      exact (Ideal.primesOver.mk (p := 𝔭) 𝔓0).2
    have hrami :=
      finite_galois_subextension_of_maximalUnramified_locally_unramified
        F p 𝔭 _hp _hne i.M
    have hram𝔓0 : Ideal.ramificationIdx 𝔭 𝔓0 = 1 := hrami 𝔓0 h𝔓0
    have hτi : AlgHom.IsArithFrobAt (R := 𝓞 F)
        ((NumberField.RingOfIntegers.mapAlgEquiv
          (((AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := F) (K₁ := N) i.M) τ))).toAlgHom) 𝔓0 := by
      simpa [𝔓0, f] using (isArithFrobAt_restrictNormal F i.M N 𝔭 𝔔 h𝔔 τ hτ)
    let valN : N →ₐ[i.M] K :=
      { toRingHom := (IntermediateField.val N).toRingHom
        commutes' := by
          intro x
          rfl }
    letI : IsScalarTower i.M N K := IsScalarTower.of_algHom valN
    have hresσ :
        (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := F) (K₁ := K) i.M) σ =
          (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := F) (K₁ := N) i.M) τ := by
      rw [IsScalarTower.AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_comp_apply (F := F) (K₁ := i.M) (K₂ := N) (f := σ)]
      rw [hσN]
    have hiff0 :
        ((AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := F) (K₁ := N) i.M) τ : i.M ≃ₐ[F] i.M) = 1 ↔
          Ideal.inertiaDeg 𝔭 𝔓0 = 1 := by
      exact finite_isArithFrobAt_eq_one_iff_inertiaDeg_eq_one F i.M 𝔭 _hp _hne 𝔓0 h𝔓0 hram𝔓0 _ hτi
    have hsplit0 : Ideal.inertiaDeg 𝔭 𝔓0 = 1 ↔
        ∀ 𝔓 ∈ 𝔭.primesOver (𝓞 i.M), Ideal.inertiaDeg 𝔭 𝔓 = 1 := by
      constructor
      · intro hdeg 𝔓 h𝔓
        rcases h𝔓 with ⟨h𝔓_prime, h𝔓_lies⟩
        letI : 𝔓.IsPrime := h𝔓_prime
        letI : 𝔓.LiesOver 𝔭 := h𝔓_lies
        letI : Finite (i.M ≃ₐ[F] i.M) := by infer_instance
        have hEq : Ideal.inertiaDeg 𝔭 𝔓0 = Ideal.inertiaDeg 𝔭 𝔓 := by
          simpa using (Ideal.inertiaDeg_eq_of_isGaloisGroup (p := 𝔭) (P := 𝔓0) (Q := 𝔓) (G := i.M ≃ₐ[F] i.M))
        exact hEq.symm ▸ hdeg
      · intro hsplit
        exact hsplit 𝔓0 h𝔓0
    dsimp [A]
    rw [hresσ]
    exact hiff0.trans hsplit0
  rcases CompactSpace.iInter_nonempty hclosed hFIP with ⟨σ, hσ⟩
  refine ⟨σ, ?_⟩
  intro M
  intro _instFD _instNorm _instNF _instP
  let i : SplittingDetectorTestField F p :=
    { M := M, hfd := _instFD, hnorm := _instNorm, hnf := _instNF, hpG := _instP }
  have hσ' : ∀ j, σ ∈ A j := by
    simpa [Set.mem_iInter] using hσ
  simpa [A, K, i] using hσ' i

name: splittingDetectorAt_spec
statement:
theorem splittingDetectorAt_spec
    (F : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
    (𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 F)) (hp : 𝔭.IsPrime) (hne : 𝔭 ≠ ⊥) :
    IsSplittingDetectorAt F p 𝔭 (splittingDetectorAt F p 𝔭 hp hne)
proof:
:=
  (exists_splittingDetectorAt F p 𝔭 hp hne).choose_spec

name: multiIndMap_id
statement:
lemma multiIndMap_id (X : Action (TopModuleCat R) G) (n : ℕ) :
    multiIndMap R (MonoidHom.id G) continuous_id n X = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [multiIndMap_succ, ih]

    apply Action.Hom.ext
    apply ConcreteCategory.coe_ext
    funext (c : C(G, _))
    apply ContinuousMap.ext
    intro x
    rfl

name: cochainsMap_id
statement:
lemma cochainsMap_id (X : Action (TopModuleCat R) G) :
    cochainsMap R (MonoidHom.id G) continuous_id X =
      𝟙 ((homogeneousCochains R G).obj X)
proof:
:= by

  apply HomologicalComplex.hom_ext
  intro n
  apply ConcreteCategory.ext
  ext (z : (invariants R G).obj ((MultiInd.functor R G (n + 1)).obj X))
  apply Subtype.ext

  show (multiIndMap R (MonoidHom.id G) continuous_id (n + 1) X).hom.hom z.val = z.val
  rw [multiIndMap_id]
  rfl

name: multiIndMap_comp
statement:
lemma multiIndMap_comp (X : Action (TopModuleCat R) K) (n : ℕ) :
    multiIndMap R (g.comp f) (hg.comp hf) n X =
      (Action.res _ f).map (multiIndMap R g hg n X) ≫
        multiIndMap R f hf n ((Action.res _ g).obj X)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [multiIndMap_zero, multiIndMap_zero, multiIndMap_zero]

    apply Action.Hom.ext; rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [multiIndMap_succ, multiIndMap_succ, multiIndMap_succ]

    rw [ih]

    apply Action.Hom.ext
    apply ConcreteCategory.coe_ext
    funext (c : C(K, _))
    apply ContinuousMap.ext
    intro x
    rfl

name: multiIndComplexMap_comp
statement:
lemma multiIndComplexMap_comp (X : Action (TopModuleCat R) K) :
    multiIndComplexMap R (g.comp f) (hg.comp hf) X =
      ((Action.res _ f).mapHomologicalComplex _).map (multiIndComplexMap R g hg X) ≫
        multiIndComplexMap R f hf ((Action.res _ g).obj X)
proof:
:= by
  apply HomologicalComplex.hom_ext
  intro n
  show multiIndMap R (g.comp f) (hg.comp hf) n X =
    (Action.res _ f).map (multiIndMap R g hg n X) ≫
      multiIndMap R f hf n ((Action.res _ g).obj X)
  exact multiIndMap_comp R f g hf hg X n

name: cochainsMap_comp
statement:
lemma cochainsMap_comp (X : Action (TopModuleCat R) K) :
    cochainsMap R (g.comp f) (hg.comp hf) X =
      cochainsMap R g hg X ≫ cochainsMap R f hf ((Action.res _ g).obj X)
proof:
:= by

  rw [show cochainsMap R g hg X ≫ cochainsMap R f hf ((Action.res _ g).obj X) =
