          (MeasureTheory.integral_sub (μ := MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)))
            hShift hOrig)
      _ = ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
            ((((logRescalePartialSum f (x + δ) - b) - (logRescalePartialSum f x - b) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
              Complex.exp (-z * x)) := by
        congr with x
        simp [U, sub_mul]
  · simp [F, J, U]

name: boundary_extension_translate_difference_real_bounded_near_zero
statement:
theorem boundary_extension_translate_difference_real_bounded_near_zero {f : ℕ → ℝ} {b δ : ℝ} :
  HasBoundaryLaplaceExtension f b → 0 < δ →
  ∃ ε M : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
    ∀ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ → σ < ε →
      Complex.re (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
        ((((logRescalePartialSum f (x + δ) - b) - (logRescalePartialSum f x - b) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          Complex.exp (-(σ : ℂ) * x))) ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  intro hExt hδ
  rcases boundary_extension_translate_difference_damped_eq hExt hδ with ⟨F, hFcont, hFeq, hF0⟩
  have h0mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ {z : ℂ | 0 ≤ z.re} := by
    simp
  have hcont0 : ContinuousWithinAt F {z : ℂ | 0 ≤ z.re} 0 := hFcont 0 h0mem
  rcases Metric.continuousWithinAt_iff.mp hcont0 1 zero_lt_one with ⟨ε, hεpos, hε⟩
  refine ⟨ε, ‖F 0‖ + 1, hεpos, ?_⟩
  intro σ hσpos hσlt
  have hσmem : ((σ : ℂ) ∈ {z : ℂ | 0 ≤ z.re}) := by
    simp [le_of_lt hσpos]
  have hdist : dist ((σ : ℂ)) 0 < ε := by
    simpa [dist_eq_norm, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hσpos] using hσlt
  have hFclose : dist (F (σ : ℂ)) (F 0) < 1 := by
    exact hε hσmem hdist
  have hFnorm : ‖F (σ : ℂ)‖ < ‖F 0‖ + 1 := by
    have hdist' : ‖F (σ : ℂ) - F 0‖ < 1 := by
      simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hFclose
    have htriangle : ‖F (σ : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖F (σ : ℂ) - F 0‖ + ‖F 0‖ := by
      have := norm_add_le (F (σ : ℂ) - F 0) (F 0)
      simpa [sub_add_cancel] using this
    linarith
  have hEq : F (σ : ℂ) = ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
      ((((logRescalePartialSum f (x + δ) - b) - (logRescalePartialSum f x - b) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp (-(σ : ℂ) * x)) := by
    have hσre : 0 < ((σ : ℂ)).re := by simpa using hσpos
    exact hFeq hσre
  rw [← hEq]
  have hre : Complex.re (F (σ : ℂ)) ≤ ‖F (σ : ℂ)‖ := by
    simpa using (RCLike.re_le_norm (F (σ : ℂ)))
  linarith

name: interval_average_eq_sub_translate_difference
statement:
theorem interval_average_eq_sub_translate_difference {f : ℕ → ℝ} {b δ x y : ℝ} :
  ∫ t in x..y,
      ((logRescalePartialSum f (t + δ) - b) - (logRescalePartialSum f t - b))
    =
      (∫ t in y..(y + δ), (logRescalePartialSum f t - b)) -
        ∫ t in x..(x + δ), (logRescalePartialSum f t - b)
proof:
:= by
  let U : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => logRescalePartialSum f t - b
  have hxy : IntervalIntegrable U MeasureTheory.volume x y := by
    simpa [U] using logRescalePartialSum_intervalIntegrable f b x y
  have hx : IntervalIntegrable U MeasureTheory.volume x (x + δ) := by
    simpa [U] using logRescalePartialSum_intervalIntegrable f b x (x + δ)
  have hshift : IntervalIntegrable U MeasureTheory.volume (x + δ) (y + δ) := by
    simpa [U] using logRescalePartialSum_intervalIntegrable f b (x + δ) (y + δ)
  have hxy_shift : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => U (t + δ)) MeasureTheory.volume x y := by
    simpa using
      (IntervalIntegrable.comp_add_right_iff (f := U) (a := x) (b := y) (c := δ)).2 hshift
  calc
    ∫ t in x..y,
        ((logRescalePartialSum f (t + δ) - b) - (logRescalePartialSum f t - b))
        = ∫ t in x..y, (U (t + δ) - U t) := by
            simp [U]
    _ = (∫ t in x..y, U (t + δ)) - ∫ t in x..y, U t := by
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hxy_shift hxy]
    _ = (∫ t in (x + δ)..(y + δ), U t) - ∫ t in x..y, U t := by
          congr 1
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right (f := U) (a := x) (b := y) (d := δ)]
    _ = (∫ t in y..(y + δ), U t) - ∫ t in x..(x + δ), U t := by
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_interval_comm' hshift hxy hx.symm]
    _ = (∫ t in y..(y + δ), (logRescalePartialSum f t - b)) -
          ∫ t in x..(x + δ), (logRescalePartialSum f t - b) := by
          simp [U]

name: interval_average_lower_bound_of_quasi_monotone
statement:
theorem interval_average_lower_bound_of_quasi_monotone {f : ℕ → ℝ} {b X δ η : ℝ} :
  (∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) →
  0 ≤ X →
  0 ≤ δ →
  0 ≤ η →
  (∫ y in (X + η)..(X + η + δ), (logRescalePartialSum f y - b))
    ≥ Real.exp (-η) * (∫ y in X..(X + δ), (logRescalePartialSum f y - b))
      - (1 - Real.exp (-η)) * b * δ
proof:
:= by
  intro hnonneg hX hδ hη
  let L : ℝ → ℝ := logRescalePartialSum f
  have hXδ : X ≤ X + δ := by linarith
  have hbaseInt : IntervalIntegrable (fun y : ℝ => L y - b) MeasureTheory.volume X (X + δ) :=
    logRescalePartialSum_intervalIntegrable f b X (X + δ)
  have hshiftInt : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => L (t + η) - b) MeasureTheory.volume X (X + δ) := by
    convert (logRescalePartialSum_intervalIntegrable f b (X + η) (X + η + δ)).comp_add_right η using 1 <;> ring_nf
  have hpoint : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc X (X + δ),
      Real.exp (-η) * (L t - b) - (1 - Real.exp (-η)) * b ≤ L (t + η) - b := by
    intro t ht
    have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := le_trans hX ht.1
    have hmono : L t ≤ Real.exp η * L (t + η) := by
      simpa [L] using (logRescalePartialSum_quasi_monotone hnonneg (x := t) (y := η) ht0 hη)
    have hexp : Real.exp (-η) * Real.exp η = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      ring_nf
      simp
    have hscaled : Real.exp (-η) * L t ≤ L (t + η) := by
      calc
        Real.exp (-η) * L t ≤ Real.exp (-η) * (Real.exp η * L (t + η)) := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono (by positivity)
        _ = (Real.exp (-η) * Real.exp η) * L (t + η) := by ring
        _ = L (t + η) := by rw [hexp, one_mul]
    have hrew : Real.exp (-η) * (L t - b) - (1 - Real.exp (-η)) * b = Real.exp (-η) * L t - b := by
      ring
    rw [hrew]
    linarith
  have hshift :
      (∫ y in (X + η)..(X + η + δ), (L y - b)) = ∫ t in X..(X + δ), (L (t + η) - b) := by
    symm
    convert (intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right (f := fun y : ℝ => L y - b) (a := X) (b := X + δ) (d := η)) using 1 <;> ring_nf
  have hconst : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => (1 - Real.exp (-η)) * b) MeasureTheory.volume X (X + δ) := by
    simpa using (intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_const :
      IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => (1 - Real.exp (-η)) * b) MeasureTheory.volume X (X + δ))
  have hlowerInt :
      IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-η) * (L t - b) - (1 - Real.exp (-η)) * b) MeasureTheory.volume X (X + δ) := by
    exact (hbaseInt.const_mul (Real.exp (-η))).sub hconst
  have hmono_int :
      ∫ t in X..(X + δ), (Real.exp (-η) * (L t - b) - (1 - Real.exp (-η)) * b)
        ≤ ∫ t in X..(X + δ), (L (t + η) - b) := by
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hXδ hlowerInt hshiftInt hpoint
  have hsmul : δ • ((1 - Real.exp (-η)) * b) = (1 - Real.exp (-η)) * b * δ := by
    change δ * ((1 - Real.exp (-η)) * b) = (1 - Real.exp (-η)) * b * δ
    ring
  have hcalc :
      ∫ t in X..(X + δ), (Real.exp (-η) * (L t - b) - (1 - Real.exp (-η)) * b)
        = Real.exp (-η) * (∫ t in X..(X + δ), (L t - b)) - (1 - Real.exp (-η)) * b * δ := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hbaseInt.const_mul (Real.exp (-η))) hconst]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul (Real.exp (-η))]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const]
    have hlen : X + δ - X = δ := by ring
    rw [hlen, hsmul]
  rw [hshift]
  linarith

name: overshoot_intervals
statement:
theorem overshoot_intervals {f : ℕ → ℝ} {b A : ℝ} :
  (∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) →
  0 < A →
  ∃ δ c : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ 0 < c ∧
    ∀ {x : ℝ}, 0 ≤ x → A < logRescalePartialSum f x - b →
      ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc x (x + δ), c ≤ logRescalePartialSum f y - b
proof:
:= by
  intro hnonneg hA
  by_cases hb : 0 ≤ b
  · refine ⟨Real.log ((A + b) / (A / 2 + b)), A / 2, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hden : 0 < A / 2 + b := by linarith
      have hr_one : 1 < (A + b) / (A / 2 + b) := by
        have hlt : A / 2 + b < A + b := by linarith
        have hEq : (1 : ℝ) = (A / 2 + b) / (A / 2 + b) := by
          field_simp [hden.ne']
        rw [hEq]
        exact div_lt_div_of_pos_right hlt hden
      exact Real.log_pos hr_one
    · linarith
    · intro x hx hovers y hy
      have hxy : x ≤ y := hy.1
      have hy_upper : y ≤ x + Real.log ((A + b) / (A / 2 + b)) := hy.2
      have hyx_nonneg : 0 ≤ y - x := by linarith
      have hy_eq : x + (y - x) = y := by ring
      have hUxy := logRescalePartialSum_quasi_monotone (f := f) hnonneg (x := x) (y := y - x) hx hyx_nonneg
      rw [hy_eq] at hUxy
      have hAxb : A + b < logRescalePartialSum f x := by linarith
      have hden : 0 < A / 2 + b := by linarith
      have hyx_le : y - x ≤ Real.log ((A + b) / (A / 2 + b)) := by
        linarith
      have hr_pos : 0 < (A + b) / (A / 2 + b) := by
        have hnum : 0 < A + b := by linarith
        positivity
      have hr : Real.exp (y - x) ≤ (A + b) / (A / 2 + b) := by
        have htmp := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hyx_le
        simpa [Real.exp_log hr_pos] using htmp
      have hy_nonneg : 0 ≤ logRescalePartialSum f y := logRescalePartialSum_nonneg hnonneg y
      have hmul : logRescalePartialSum f x ≤ ((A + b) / (A / 2 + b)) * logRescalePartialSum f y := by
        calc
          logRescalePartialSum f x ≤ Real.exp (y - x) * logRescalePartialSum f y := hUxy
          _ ≤ ((A + b) / (A / 2 + b)) * logRescalePartialSum f y := by
            gcongr
      have hlt : A + b < ((A + b) / (A / 2 + b)) * logRescalePartialSum f y := by
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hAxb hmul
      have hAy : A / 2 + b < logRescalePartialSum f y := by
        by_contra hcontra
        have hy_le : logRescalePartialSum f y ≤ A / 2 + b := by linarith
        have hmul_le : ((A + b) / (A / 2 + b)) * logRescalePartialSum f y ≤ ((A + b) / (A / 2 + b)) * (A / 2 + b) := by
          gcongr
        have hEq : ((A + b) / (A / 2 + b)) * (A / 2 + b) = A + b := by
          field_simp [hden.ne']
        linarith
      linarith
  · have hbneg : b < 0 := by linarith
    refine ⟨1, min (A / 2) (-b / 2), by norm_num, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h1 : 0 < A / 2 := by linarith
      have h2 : 0 < -b / 2 := by linarith
      exact lt_min h1 h2
    · intro x hx hovers y hy
      have hy_nonneg : 0 ≤ logRescalePartialSum f y := logRescalePartialSum_nonneg hnonneg y
      have hmain : -b ≤ logRescalePartialSum f y - b := by linarith
      have hmin : min (A / 2) (-b / 2) ≤ -b := by
        have h2 : -b / 2 ≤ -b := by linarith
        exact le_trans (min_le_right _ _) h2
      exact le_trans hmin hmain

name: frequently_small_partialSumIcc_of_linearGrowthInf_nonpos
statement:
theorem frequently_small_partialSumIcc_of_linearGrowthInf_nonpos {f : ℕ → ℝ} :
    LinearGrowth.linearGrowthInf (partialSumIccEReal f) ≤ 0 →
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      ∃ᶠ N : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f k ≤ ε * (N : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  intro h ε hε
  have hεE : (0 : EReal) < (ε : EReal) := by
    exact_mod_cast hε
  have hlt : LinearGrowth.linearGrowthInf (partialSumIccEReal f) < (ε : EReal) := by
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt h hεE
  have hfreq : ∃ᶠ N : ℕ in Filter.atTop, partialSumIccEReal f N ≤ (ε : EReal) * N := by
    exact LinearGrowth.frequently_le_mul hlt
  refine hfreq.mono ?_
  intro N hN
  have hN' : ((∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f n : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ (((ε * (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal)) := by
    simpa [partialSumIccEReal] using hN
  exact_mod_cast hN'

name: partialSum_Icc_le_const_mul_rpow_of_LSeriesSummable_nonneg
statement:
theorem partialSum_Icc_le_const_mul_rpow_of_LSeriesSummable_nonneg {f : ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℝ} :
    1 < r →
    (∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) →
    LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (r : ℂ) →
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ N : ℕ,
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f k ≤ C * (N : ℝ) ^ r
proof:
:= by
  intro hr h_nonneg hL
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := le_trans zero_le_one hr.le
  let g : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => ‖LSeries.term (fun m => (f m : ℂ)) (r : ℂ) n‖
  have hsum : Summable g := hL.norm
  have hsum_le (N : ℕ) : ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, g k ≤ ∑' n, g n := by
    refine Summable.sum_le_tsum (Finset.Icc 1 N) ?_ hsum
    intro k hk
    exact norm_nonneg _
  refine ⟨∑' n, g n, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact tsum_nonneg (fun n => norm_nonneg _)
  · intro N
    have hpowN_nonneg : 0 ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ r := Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg N) _
    calc
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f k ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (N : ℝ) ^ r * g k := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
        intro k hk
        have hk_mem : k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N := hk
        have hk_nat_pos : 0 < k := Nat.succ_le_iff.mp (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk_mem).1
        have hk_nat_ne : k ≠ 0 := hk_nat_pos.ne'
        have hk_pos : 0 < (k : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hk_nat_pos
        have hk_nonneg : 0 ≤ (k : ℝ) := hk_pos.le
        have hk_le_N : (k : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk_mem).2
        have hpow_le : (k : ℝ) ^ r ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ r := by
          exact Real.rpow_le_rpow hk_nonneg hk_le_N hr0
        have hkr_pos : 0 < (k : ℝ) ^ r := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hk_pos _
        have hratio_nonneg : 0 ≤ f k / (k : ℝ) ^ r := by
          exact div_nonneg (h_nonneg k) (Real.rpow_nonneg hk_nonneg _)
        have hgk : g k = f k / (k : ℝ) ^ r := by
          dsimp [g]
          rw [LSeries.norm_term_eq]
          simp [hk_nat_ne]
          rw [abs_of_nonneg (h_nonneg k)]
        calc
          f k = (f k / (k : ℝ) ^ r) * (k : ℝ) ^ r := by
            rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hkr_pos.ne', mul_one]
          _ ≤ (f k / (k : ℝ) ^ r) * (N : ℝ) ^ r := by
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow_le hratio_nonneg
          _ = (N : ℝ) ^ r * g k := by rw [hgk, mul_comm]
      _ = (N : ℝ) ^ r * ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, g k := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ r * ∑' n, g n := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hsum_le N) hpowN_nonneg
      _ = (∑' n, g n) * (N : ℝ) ^ r := by ring

name: icc_growth_family_of_LSeriesSummable_nonneg
statement:
theorem icc_growth_family_of_LSeriesSummable_nonneg {f : ℕ → ℝ} :
    (∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) →
    (∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s) →
    ∀ r : ℝ, 1 < r → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ N : ℕ,
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f k ≤ C * (N : ℝ) ^ r
proof:
:= by
  intro hnonneg hsumm_family r hr
  have hsumm : LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (r : ℂ) := by
    simpa using hsumm_family (r : ℂ) hr
  simpa using
    partialSum_Icc_le_const_mul_rpow_of_LSeriesSummable_nonneg (r := r) hr hnonneg hsumm

name: icc_growth_family_sub_const
statement:
theorem icc_growth_family_sub_const {f : ℕ → ℝ} :
    (∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) →
    (∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s) →
    ∀ B r : ℝ, 1 < r →
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ N : ℕ,
        |∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (f k - B)| ≤ C * (N : ℝ) ^ r
proof:
:= by
  intro hnonneg hsumm B r hr
  rcases icc_growth_family_of_LSeriesSummable_nonneg hnonneg hsumm r hr with ⟨C1, hC1_nonneg, hC1⟩
  refine ⟨C1 + |B|, add_nonneg hC1_nonneg (abs_nonneg B), ?_⟩
  intro N
  cases N with
  | zero =>
      have hpow_nonneg : 0 ≤ (((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ r) := by
        positivity
      have hmul_nonneg : 0 ≤ (C1 + |B|) * (((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ r) := by
        exact mul_nonneg (add_nonneg hC1_nonneg (abs_nonneg B)) hpow_nonneg
      simpa using hmul_nonneg
  | succ n =>
      have hsum_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.succ n), f k := by
        exact Finset.sum_nonneg (by
          intro k hk
          exact hnonneg k)
      have hbase : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((Nat.succ n : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n)
      have hN_le_pow : ((Nat.succ n : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((Nat.succ n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ r := by
        exact Real.self_le_rpow_of_one_le hbase hr.le
      have hBmul : |B| * ((Nat.succ n : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ |B| * ((Nat.succ n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ r := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hN_le_pow (abs_nonneg B)
      have hconst : ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.succ n), B = B * ((Nat.succ n : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        calc
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.succ n), B = ((Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.succ n)).card : ℝ) * B := by
            simp [nsmul_eq_mul]
          _ = B * ((Nat.succ n : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
            rw [Nat.card_Icc]
            norm_num
            ring
      have hsum_eq :
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.succ n), (f k - B)
            = (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.succ n), f k) - B * ((Nat.succ n : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hconst]
      rw [hsum_eq]
      calc
        |(∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.succ n), f k) - B * ((Nat.succ n : ℕ) : ℝ)|
            ≤ |∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.succ n), f k| + |B * ((Nat.succ n : ℕ) : ℝ)| := by
              simpa using (AbsoluteValue.sub_le_add (abv := AbsoluteValue.abs)
                (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.succ n), f k) (B * ((Nat.succ n : ℕ) : ℝ)))
        _ = (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.succ n), f k) + |B| * ((Nat.succ n : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
              rw [abs_of_nonneg hsum_nonneg, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ ((Nat.succ n : ℕ) : ℝ) by positivity)]
        _ ≤ C1 * ((Nat.succ n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ r + |B| * ((Nat.succ n : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
              gcongr
              exact hC1 (Nat.succ n)
        _ ≤ C1 * ((Nat.succ n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ r + |B| * ((Nat.succ n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ r := by
              gcongr
        _ = (C1 + |B|) * ((Nat.succ n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ r := by ring

name: integrableOn_logRescalePartialSum_kernel
statement:
theorem integrableOn_logRescalePartialSum_kernel {f : ℕ → ℝ} :
    (hnonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) →
    (hsumm : ∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s) →
    ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.re →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun x : ℝ => (((logRescalePartialSum f x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)))
        (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  intro hnonneg hsumm z hz
  have hr_pos : 0 < z.re / 2 := by linarith
  let r : ℝ := 1 + z.re / 2
  have hr1 : 1 < r := by
    dsimp [r]
    linarith
  have hr_nonneg : 0 ≤ r := by linarith
  obtain ⟨C, hCnonneg, hC⟩ := icc_growth_family_of_LSeriesSummable_nonneg hnonneg hsumm r hr1
  let a : ℝ := (-(z + 1 + 1)).re
  have hkernel :
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun t : ℝ =>
          (t : ℂ) ^ (-(z + 1 + 1)) * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊, (f k : ℂ)))
        (Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ)) := by
    have hlocal :
        MeasureTheory.LocallyIntegrableOn
          (fun t : ℝ =>
            (t : ℂ) ^ (-(z + 1 + 1)) * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊, (f k : ℂ)))
          (Set.Ici (1 : ℝ)) := by
      refine locallyIntegrableOn_mul_sum_Icc (c := fun n ↦ (f n : ℂ)) (m := 1) zero_le_one ?_
      refine ContinuousOn.locallyIntegrableOn (fun t ht ↦ ?_) measurableSet_Ici
      exact
        (Complex.continuousAt_ofReal_cpow_const t (-(z + 1 + 1))
          (Or.inr ((zero_lt_one.trans_le ht).ne'))).continuousWithinAt
    have hbigO :
        (fun t : ℝ =>
          (t : ℂ) ^ (-(z + 1 + 1)) * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊, (f k : ℂ))) =O[Filter.atTop]
          (fun t : ℝ => t ^ (a + r)) := by
      refine Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound C ?_
      filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with t ht
      have ht0 : 0 < t := zero_lt_one.trans ht
      have hsum_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊, f k := by
        exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun n _ ↦ hnonneg n
      have hfloor_le : ((⌊t⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ t := Nat.floor_le ht0.le
      have hfloorpow_le : ((⌊t⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ r ≤ t ^ r := by
        exact (Real.monotoneOn_rpow_Ici_of_exponent_nonneg hr_nonneg)
          (show 0 ≤ ((⌊t⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) by exact Nat.cast_nonneg _)
          ht0.le hfloor_le
      have hpow_nonneg : 0 ≤ t ^ a := Real.rpow_nonneg ht0.le _
      have hnorm_sum :
          ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊, (f k : ℂ)‖ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊, f k := by
        simpa [abs_of_nonneg hsum_nonneg] using
          (RCLike.norm_ofReal (K := ℂ) (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊, f k))
      have hnorm_cpow : ‖(t : ℂ) ^ (-(z + 1 + 1))‖ = t ^ a := by
        simpa [a] using Complex.norm_cpow_eq_rpow_re_of_pos ht0 (-(z + 1 + 1))
      calc
        ‖(t : ℂ) ^ (-(z + 1 + 1)) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊, (f k : ℂ)‖
            = ‖(t : ℂ) ^ (-(z + 1 + 1))‖ * ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊, (f k : ℂ)‖ := by
                rw [norm_mul]
        _ = t ^ a * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊, f k) := by rw [hnorm_cpow, hnorm_sum]
        _ ≤ t ^ a * (C * (((⌊t⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ r)) := by
              gcongr
              exact hC _
        _ ≤ t ^ a * (C * (t ^ r)) := by
              gcongr
        _ = C * (t ^ a * t ^ r) := by ring
        _ = C * t ^ (a + r) := by
              rw [← Real.rpow_add ht0]
        _ = C * ‖t ^ (a + r)‖ := by
              rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg ht0.le _)]
    have hexp : a + r < -1 := by
      dsimp [a, r]
      linarith
    have hIci :
        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
          (fun t : ℝ =>
            (t : ℂ) ^ (-(z + 1 + 1)) * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊, (f k : ℂ)))
          (Set.Ici (1 : ℝ)) := by
      refine hlocal.integrableOn_of_isBigO_atTop hbigO ?_
      exact (integrableAtFilter_rpow_atTop_iff).2 hexp
    exact hIci.mono_set Set.Ioi_subset_Ici_self
  have hexp_deriv : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), HasDerivWithinAt Real.exp (Real.exp x) (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) x := by
    intro x hx
    exact (Real.hasDerivAt_exp x).hasDerivWithinAt
  have hexp_mono : MonotoneOn Real.exp (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hxy
  have himage : Real.exp '' Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) = Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ) := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      simpa using (Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hx)
    · intro hy
      refine ⟨Real.log y, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have hy' : 1 < y := hy
        exact (Real.log_pos_iff (show 0 ≤ y by linarith)).2 hy'
      · exact Real.exp_log (lt_trans zero_lt_one hy)
  have htarget_aux :
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun x : ℝ =>
          Real.exp x •
            ((Real.exp x : ℂ) ^ (-(z + 1 + 1)) *
              (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.exp x⌋₊, (f k : ℂ))))
        (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) := by
    have hchange :=
      (MeasureTheory.integrableOn_image_iff_integrableOn_deriv_smul_of_monotoneOn
        measurableSet_Ioi hexp_deriv hexp_mono
        (fun t : ℝ =>
          (t : ℂ) ^ (-(z + 1 + 1)) * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊, (f k : ℂ))))
    have hkernel' :
        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
          (fun t : ℝ =>
            (t : ℂ) ^ (-(z + 1 + 1)) * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊, (f k : ℂ)))
          (Real.exp '' Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) := by
      simpa [himage] using hkernel
    exact (hchange.mp hkernel')
  have h_eq :
      Set.EqOn
        (fun x : ℝ =>
          Real.exp x •
            ((Real.exp x : ℂ) ^ (-(z + 1 + 1)) *
              (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.exp x⌋₊, (f k : ℂ))))
        (fun x : ℝ => (((logRescalePartialSum f x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)))
        (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) := by
    intro x hx
    have hx0 : 0 < x := hx
    have hexpx_ne : ((Real.exp x : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
      exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (Real.exp_pos x).ne'
    have h_ofReal_exp : ((Real.exp x : ℝ) : ℂ) = Complex.exp x := by
      simpa [Real.exp_eq_exp_ℝ, Complex.exp_eq_exp_ℂ] using NormedSpace.ofReal_exp_ℝ_ℝ x
    have h_ofReal_exp_neg : ((Real.exp (-x) : ℝ) : ℂ) = Complex.exp (-x) := by
      simpa [Real.exp_eq_exp_ℝ, Complex.exp_eq_exp_ℂ] using NormedSpace.ofReal_exp_ℝ_ℝ (-x)
    simp [logRescalePartialSum, hx0.le, Complex.real_smul, Complex.cpow_def_of_ne_zero hexpx_ne,
      ← Complex.ofReal_log (Real.exp_nonneg x), Real.log_exp, h_ofReal_exp, h_ofReal_exp_neg]
    set S : ℂ := ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.exp x⌋₊, (f k : ℂ)
    change Complex.exp x * (Complex.exp x ^ (-1 + (-1 + -z)) * S) = (Complex.exp (-x) * S) * Complex.exp (-(z * x))
    have hcpow : Complex.exp x ^ (-1 + (-1 + -z)) = Complex.exp ((x : ℂ) * (-1 + (-1 + -z))) := by
      rw [Complex.cpow_def_of_ne_zero (Complex.exp_ne_zero _),
        Complex.log_exp (by simpa using neg_lt_zero.mpr Real.pi_pos) (by simpa using Real.pi_pos.le)]
    rw [hcpow]
    calc
      Complex.exp x * (Complex.exp ((x : ℂ) * (-1 + (-1 + -z))) * S)
          = S * (Complex.exp x * Complex.exp ((x : ℂ) * (-1 + (-1 + -z)))) := by ac_rfl
      _ = S * (Complex.exp (-x) * Complex.exp (-(z * x))) := by
          congr 1
          rw [← Complex.exp_add, ← Complex.exp_add]
          congr 1
          ring
      _ = (Complex.exp (-x) * S) * Complex.exp (-(z * x)) := by ac_rfl
  exact htarget_aux.congr_fun h_eq measurableSet_Ioi

name: integrableOn_centered_logRescalePartialSum_kernel
statement:
theorem integrableOn_centered_logRescalePartialSum_kernel {f : ℕ → ℝ} {b : ℝ} :
  (hnonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) →
  (hsumm : ∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s) →
  ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.re →
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun x : ℝ => (((logRescalePartialSum f x - b : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)))
      (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  intro hnonneg hsumm z hz
  have h1 :
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun x : ℝ => (((logRescalePartialSum f x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)))
        (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) :=
    integrableOn_logRescalePartialSum_kernel hnonneg hsumm z hz
  have h2 :
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun x : ℝ => (((b : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)))
        (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) := by
    have hz' : (-z).re < 0 := by
      have : -z.re < 0 := by linarith
      simpa using this
    have h_exp :
        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
          (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp ((-z) * x))
          (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) :=
      integrableOn_exp_mul_complex_Ioi hz' 0
    simpa using h_exp.const_mul (((b : ℝ) : ℂ))
  convert h1.sub h2 using 1
  ext x
  simp [sub_mul]

name: lseries_eq_logRescalePartialSum_laplace
statement:
theorem lseries_eq_logRescalePartialSum_laplace {f : ℕ → ℝ} :
    (hnonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) →
    (hsumm : ∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s) →
    ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.re →
      LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (1 + z) =
        (1 + z) * ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
          (((logRescalePartialSum f x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x))
proof:
:= by
  intro hnonneg hsumm z hz
  let r : ℝ := 1 + z.re / 2
  have hr1 : 1 < r := by
    dsimp [r]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨C, hCnonneg, hC⟩ :=
    icc_growth_family_of_LSeriesSummable_nonneg hnonneg hsumm r hr1
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := by
    dsimp [r]
    linarith
  have hrs : r < (1 + z).re := by
    dsimp [r]
    simp
    linarith
  have hO : (fun n ↦ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, f k) =O[Filter.atTop] fun n ↦ (n : ℝ) ^ r := by
    refine Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound C ?_
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun N => by
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun k hk => hnonneg k),
        Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (show 0 ≤ (N : ℝ) by positivity) _)]
      exact hC N
  have hexp_image : Real.exp '' Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) = Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ) := by
    ext t
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      have hnonnegexp : 0 ≤ Real.exp x := le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos x)
      exact (Real.log_pos_iff hnonnegexp).mp (by simpa using hx)
    · intro ht
      refine ⟨Real.log t, Real.log_pos ht, ?_⟩
      exact Real.exp_log (lt_trans zero_lt_one ht)
  have hmono : MonotoneOn Real.exp (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) := by
    exact (strictMono_of_deriv_pos (f := Real.exp) fun x => by
      simpa [Real.deriv_exp] using (Real.exp_pos x)).monotone.monotoneOn (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ))
  let g : ℝ → ℂ :=
    fun t => (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊, (f k : ℂ)) * t ^ (-(1 + z + 1))
  have hsub :=
    MeasureTheory.integral_image_eq_integral_deriv_smul_of_monotoneOn
      (F := ℂ) (s := Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) (f := Real.exp) (f' := Real.exp)
      measurableSet_Ioi
      (fun x hx => (Real.hasDerivAt_exp x).hasDerivWithinAt)
      hmono
      g
  rw [hexp_image] at hsub
  have hInt :
      ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp x • g (Real.exp x) =
        ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (((logRescalePartialSum f x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)) := by
    refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_ae measurableSet_Ioi ?_
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x hx => by
      rw [logRescalePartialSum, if_pos hx.le]
      set S : ℝ := ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.exp x⌋₊, f k
      have hxexp_ne : ((Real.exp x : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
        exact_mod_cast (Real.exp_ne_zero x)
      have hpow : ((Real.exp x : ℂ) ^ (-(1 + z + 1))) =
          Complex.exp ((x : ℂ) * (-(1 + z + 1))) := by
        rw [Complex.cpow_def_of_ne_zero hxexp_ne]
        rw [← Complex.ofReal_log (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos x)), Real.log_exp]
      have hExp : ((Real.exp x : ℂ)) = Complex.exp (x : ℂ) := by
        simpa [Real.exp_eq_exp_ℝ, Complex.exp_eq_exp_ℂ] using (NormedSpace.ofReal_exp_ℝ_ℝ x)
      have hExpNeg : ((Real.exp (-x) : ℂ)) = Complex.exp (-x : ℂ) := by
        simpa [Real.exp_eq_exp_ℝ, Complex.exp_eq_exp_ℂ] using (NormedSpace.ofReal_exp_ℝ_ℝ (-x))
      have hpow' : Complex.exp (x : ℂ) ^ (-(1 + z + 1)) =
          Complex.exp ((x : ℂ) * (-(1 + z + 1))) := by
        rw [← hExp, hpow]
      have hcore : Complex.exp (x : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((x : ℂ) * (-(1 + z + 1))) =
          ((Real.exp (-x) : ℂ)) * Complex.exp (-z * x) := by
        calc
          Complex.exp (x : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((x : ℂ) * (-(1 + z + 1))) =
              Complex.exp ((x : ℂ) + (x : ℂ) * (-(1 + z + 1))) := by
                rw [← Complex.exp_add]
          _ = Complex.exp ((-x : ℂ) + (-z * x)) := by
                congr 1
                ring
          _ = Complex.exp (-x : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x) := by
                rw [Complex.exp_add]
          _ = ((Real.exp (-x) : ℂ)) * Complex.exp (-z * x) := by
                rw [← hExpNeg]
      calc
        Real.exp x • g (Real.exp x)
            = Complex.exp (x : ℂ) * ((S : ℂ) * Complex.exp (x : ℂ) ^ (-(1 + z + 1))) := by
                simp [g, S, smul_eq_mul, hExp]
        _ = Complex.exp (x : ℂ) * ((S : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((x : ℂ) * (-(1 + z + 1)))) := by
                rw [hpow']
        _ = (S : ℂ) * (Complex.exp (x : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((x : ℂ) * (-(1 + z + 1)))) := by
                ac_rfl
        _ = (S : ℂ) * (((Real.exp (-x) : ℂ)) * Complex.exp (-z * x)) := by
                rw [hcore]
        _ = (((Real.exp (-x) * S : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)) := by
                simp [S, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]
  calc
    LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (1 + z)
        = (1 + z) * ∫ t in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ), g t := by
          simpa [g, add_assoc] using
            (LSeries_eq_mul_integral_of_nonneg (f := f) hr0 hrs hO hnonneg)
    _ = (1 + z) * ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp x • g (Real.exp x) := by
      rw [hsub]
      rfl
    _ = (1 + z) * ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
          (((logRescalePartialSum f x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)) := by
      rw [hInt]

name: centered_logRescalePartialSum_laplace_eq_shift_sub_const_div
statement:
theorem centered_logRescalePartialSum_laplace_eq_shift_sub_const_div {f : ℕ → ℝ} {a : ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ} :
    (haim : a.im = 0) →
    (hnonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) →
    (hsumm : ∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s) →
    (heq : Set.EqOn g
      (fun s : ℂ => LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s - a / (s - 1))
      {s : ℂ | 1 < s.re}) →
    Set.EqOn
      (fun z : ℂ => (g (1 + z) - ((a.re : ℝ) : ℂ)) / (1 + z))
      (fun z : ℂ => ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
        (((logRescalePartialSum f x - a.re : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)))
      {z : ℂ | 0 < z.re}
proof:
:= by
  intro haim hnonneg hsumm heq z hz
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hz
  have hz1 : 1 < (1 + z).re := by
    simpa [Complex.add_re] using add_lt_add_left hz 1
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have : (0 : ℝ) < 0 := by simpa [h] using hz
    linarith
  have h1z0 : 1 + z ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have : (1 : ℝ) < 0 := by simpa [h] using hz1
    linarith
  have ha_re : a = ((a.re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [haim]
  have hEq : g (1 + z) = LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (1 + z) - a / z := by
    have hEq0 := heq (show (1 + z) ∈ {s : ℂ | 1 < s.re} by
      simpa [Complex.add_re] using add_lt_add_left hz 1)
    simpa using hEq0
  have hL := lseries_eq_logRescalePartialSum_laplace hnonneg hsumm z hz
  have hmain :
      (g (1 + z) - ((a.re : ℝ) : ℂ)) / (1 + z) =
        (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (((logRescalePartialSum f x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x))) -
          ((a.re : ℝ) : ℂ) / z := by
    rw [hEq, hL, ha_re]
    field_simp [hz0, h1z0]
    ring_nf
    simp
  have hlog_int :
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun x : ℝ => (((logRescalePartialSum f x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)))
        (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) :=
    integrableOn_logRescalePartialSum_kernel hnonneg hsumm z hz
  have hconst_int :
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun x : ℝ => (((a.re : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)))
        (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) := by
    have hneg : (-z).re < 0 := by
      have : -(z.re) < 0 := by linarith
      simpa [Complex.neg_re] using this
    have hexp : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp ((-z) * x)) (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) := by
      simpa using (integrableOn_exp_mul_complex_Ioi (a := -z) (c := 0) hneg)
    simpa using hexp.const_mul (((a.re : ℝ) : ℂ))
  calc
    (fun z : ℂ => (g (1 + z) - ((a.re : ℝ) : ℂ)) / (1 + z)) z
        = (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (((logRescalePartialSum f x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x))) -
            ((a.re : ℝ) : ℂ) / z := by
          simpa using hmain
    _ = (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (((logRescalePartialSum f x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x))) -
          ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (((a.re : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)) := by
          rw [integral_const_mul_cexp_neg_Ioi (b := a.re) hz]
    _ = ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
          ((((logRescalePartialSum f x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)) -
            (((a.re : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x))) := by
          rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_sub hlog_int hconst_int]
    _ = ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (((logRescalePartialSum f x - a.re : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)) := by
          congr with x
          rw [Complex.ofReal_sub]
          ring_nf

name: boundary_extension_real_axis_identity
statement:
theorem boundary_extension_real_axis_identity {f : ℕ → ℝ} {b : ℝ} {G : ℂ → ℂ} :
  (hGeq : Set.EqOn G
    (fun z : ℂ => ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
      (((logRescalePartialSum f x - b : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)))
    {z : ℂ | 0 < z.re}) →
  (hsumm : ∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun n ↦ (f n : ℂ)) s) →
  (hnonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) →
  ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
    G z = LSeries (fun n ↦ (f n : ℂ)) (1 + z) / (1 + z) - (b : ℂ) / z
proof:
:= by
  intro hGeq hsumm hnonneg z hz
  have hcenter :=
    centered_logRescalePartialSum_laplace_eq_shift_sub_const_div
      (a := (b : ℂ))
      (g := fun s : ℂ => LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s - (b : ℂ) / (s - 1))
      (by simp)
      hnonneg
      hsumm
      (by
        intro s hs
        rfl)
  have hzC : (0 : ℝ) < (z : ℂ).re := by
    simpa using hz
  have hG := hGeq hzC
  have hcenterz := hcenter hzC
  have hcenterz' :
      (fun z : ℂ =>
        ((fun s : ℂ => LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s - (b : ℂ) / (s - 1)) (1 + z) - (b : ℂ)) /
          (1 + z)) z =
      (fun z : ℂ =>
        ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
          (((logRescalePartialSum f x - b : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x))) z := by
    simpa using hcenterz
  rw [hG, ← hcenterz']
  have hz0 : (z : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast hz.ne'
  have hz1 : (1 + (z : ℂ)) ≠ 0 := by
    have hz1r : (1 + z : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      linarith
    exact_mod_cast hz1r
  field_simp [hz0, hz1]
  ring

name: continuousOn_centered_logRescalePartialSum_laplace_of_eqOn
statement:
theorem continuousOn_centered_logRescalePartialSum_laplace_of_eqOn {f : ℕ → ℝ} {a : ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ} :
    (haim : a.im = 0) →
    (hnonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) →
    (hsumm : ∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s) →
    (hcont : ContinuousOn g {s : ℂ | 1 ≤ s.re}) →
    (heq : Set.EqOn g
      (fun s : ℂ => LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s - a / (s - 1))
      {s : ℂ | 1 < s.re}) →
    ∃ G : ℂ → ℂ,
      ContinuousOn G {z : ℂ | 0 ≤ z.re} ∧
      Set.EqOn G
        (fun z : ℂ => ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
          (((logRescalePartialSum f x - a.re : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)))
        {z : ℂ | 0 < z.re}
proof:
:= by
  intro haim hnonneg hsumm hcont heq
  refine ⟨fun z : ℂ => (g (1 + z) - ((a.re : ℝ) : ℂ)) / (1 + z), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact continuousOn_shift_sub_const_div_one_add (g := g) (c := ((a.re : ℝ) : ℂ)) hcont
  · exact centered_logRescalePartialSum_laplace_eq_shift_sub_const_div (f := f) (a := a) (g := g) haim hnonneg hsumm heq

name: hasBoundaryLaplaceExtension_of_eqOn
statement:
theorem hasBoundaryLaplaceExtension_of_eqOn {f : ℕ → ℝ} {a : ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ} :
  (haim : a.im = 0) →
  (hnonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) →
  (hsumm : ∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s) →
  (hcont : ContinuousOn g {s : ℂ | 1 ≤ s.re}) →
  (heq : Set.EqOn g
    (fun s : ℂ => LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s - a / (s - 1))
    {s : ℂ | 1 < s.re}) →
  HasBoundaryLaplaceExtension f a.re
proof:
:= by
  intro haim hnonneg hsumm hcont heq
  rcases
      continuousOn_centered_logRescalePartialSum_laplace_of_eqOn haim hnonneg hsumm hcont heq with
    ⟨G, hGcont, hGeq⟩

name: pow_two_partial_sum_avg_succ_lower_bound
statement:
theorem pow_two_partial_sum_avg_succ_lower_bound {f : ℕ → ℝ} :
    (∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) →
    ∀ n : ℕ,
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 ^ n), f k) / (2 ^ (n + 1) : ℝ) ≤
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 ^ (n + 1)), f k) / (2 ^ (n + 1) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  intro hnonneg n
  have hsum : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 ^ n), f k ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 ^ (n + 1)), f k := by
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?hsub ?hnonneg
    · intro k hk
      exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (by
        have hk' : k < 2 ^ n := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
        have hpow : 2 ^ n ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1) := by
          exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (Nat.le_add_right n 1)
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hk' hpow)
    · intro k hk hknmem
      exact hnonneg k
  have hpos : 0 < (2 ^ (n + 1) : ℝ) := by
    positivity
  simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsum (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hpos))

name: pow_two_partial_sum_avg_le_of_le
statement:
theorem pow_two_partial_sum_avg_le_of_le {f : ℕ → ℝ} :
    (∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) →
    ∀ {j n : ℕ}, j ≤ n →
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 ^ j), f k) / (2 ^ j : ℝ) ≤
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (n - j) * (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 ^ n), f k) / (2 ^ n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  intro hnonneg j n hjn
  let A : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 ^ m), f k) / (2 ^ m : ℝ)
  have hEq : ∀ m : ℕ, A m = (2 : ℝ) * ((∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 ^ m), f k) / (2 ^ (m + 1) : ℝ)) := by
    intro m
    dsimp [A]
    rw [pow_succ]
    field_simp
  have hstep : ∀ m : ℕ, A m ≤ (2 : ℝ) * A (m + 1) := by
    intro m
    calc
      A m = (2 : ℝ) * ((∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 ^ m), f k) / (2 ^ (m + 1) : ℝ)) := hEq m
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) * ((∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 ^ (m + 1)), f k) / (2 ^ (m + 1) : ℝ)) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_two_partial_sum_avg_succ_lower_bound hnonneg m) (by positivity)
      _ = (2 : ℝ) * A (m + 1) := by rfl
  have hpow : ∀ d : ℕ, A j ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ d * A (j + d) := by
    intro d
    induction d with
    | zero =>
        simpa only [pow_zero, Nat.add_zero, one_mul] using (le_rfl : A j ≤ A j)
    | succ d ih =>
        have hmul : (2 : ℝ) ^ d * A (j + d) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ d * ((2 : ℝ) * A (j + d + 1)) := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hstep (j + d)) (by positivity)
        calc
          A j ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ d * A (j + d) := ih
          _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ d * ((2 : ℝ) * A (j + d + 1)) := hmul
          _ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ d * (2 : ℝ)) * A (j + d + 1) := by rw [mul_assoc]
          _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (d + 1) * A (j + d + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]
  have hmain := hpow (n - j)
  have hadd : j + (n - j) = n := Nat.add_sub_of_le hjn
  calc
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 ^ j), f k) / (2 ^ j : ℝ) = A j := by rfl
    _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (n - j) * A (j + (n - j)) := hmain
    _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (n - j) * A n := by rw [hadd]
    _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (n - j) * ((∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 ^ n), f k) / (2 ^ n : ℝ)) := by rfl
    _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (n - j) * (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 ^ n), f k) / (2 ^ n : ℝ) := by
      rw [mul_div_assoc]

name: primesCongOneMod3_residueClass_nonprime_partial_sum_sublinear
statement:
theorem primesCongOneMod3_residueClass_nonprime_partial_sum_sublinear (ε : ℝ) : 0 < ε → ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, X₀ ≤ X →
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.range X,
      (if n.Prime then 0 else primesCongOneMod3_residueClass n) ≤ ε * X
proof:
:= by
  intro hε
  let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => if n.Prime then 0 else primesCongOneMod3_residueClass n
  let g : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => a n / n
  let G : ℕ → ℝ := fun X => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range X, g n
  let W : ℕ → ℝ := fun X => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range X, (n : ℝ) * g n
  have hg : Summable g := by
    simpa [g, a] using primesCongOneMod3_residueClass_nonprime_div_summable
  have ha0 : a 0 = 0 := by
    simp [a, primesCongOneMod3_residueClass]
  have hg0 : g 0 = 0 := by
    simp [g, a]
  have ha_mul (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) : a n = (n : ℝ) * g n := by
    have hnr : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn
    by_cases hp : n.Prime
    · simp [a, g, hp]
    · dsimp [g, a]
      simp [hp]
      field_simp [hnr]
  have hA_eq_W (X : ℕ) : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range X, a n) = W X := by
    unfold W
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    intro n hn
    by_cases hzero : n = 0
    · subst hzero
      simp [ha0, hg0]
    · simpa [hzero] using ha_mul n hzero
  let L : ℝ := ∑' n, g n
  have hG : Filter.Tendsto G Filter.atTop (nhds L) := by
    simpa [G, L] using hg.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat
  have hGsucc : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => G (n + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds L) := by
    exact (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).2 hG
  have hcesaro : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, G (i + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds L) := by
    exact Filter.Tendsto.cesaro hGsucc
  have hden_nat : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
    simpa [Nat.add_comm] using (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).2 (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop : Filter.Tendsto ((↑) : ℕ → ℝ) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  have hden : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) + 1) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
    simpa [Nat.cast_add, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hden_nat
  have hterm_div : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => G (n + 1) / (n + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    exact Filter.Tendsto.div_atTop hGsucc hden
  have hpaux : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) / (n + 1)) * G (n + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds L) := by
    have hEq : (fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) / (n + 1)) * G (n + 1)) = fun n : ℕ => G (n + 1) - G (n + 1) / (n + 1) := by
      funext n
      have hne : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp [hne]
      ring
    rw [hEq]
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using hGsucc.sub hterm_div
  have hcesaro_shift : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), G (i + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds L) := by
    exact (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).2 hcesaro
  have hqaux : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, G (i + 1)) / (n + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds L) := by
    have hEq : (fun n : ℕ => (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, G (i + 1)) / (n + 1)) = fun n : ℕ =>
      (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), G (i + 1)) - G (n + 1) / (n + 1) := by
      funext n
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      have hne : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp [hne]
      norm_num [Nat.cast_add]
      ring
    rw [hEq]
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using hcesaro_shift.sub hterm_div
  have hparts (X : ℕ) : W X = ((X - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * G X - ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (X - 1), G (i + 1) := by
    simpa [W, G] using (Finset.sum_range_by_parts (fun n => (n : ℝ)) g X)
  have hWaux : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => W (n + 1) / (n + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hEq : (fun n : ℕ => W (n + 1) / (n + 1)) = fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) / (n + 1)) * G (n + 1) - (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, G (i + 1)) / (n + 1) := by
      funext n
      rw [hparts (n + 1)]
      have hne : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp [hne]
      norm_num [Nat.cast_add]
      ring
    rw [hEq]
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using hpaux.sub hqaux
  have hWdiv : Filter.Tendsto (fun X : ℕ => W X / X) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    exact (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).1 (by simpa using hWaux)
  have h_event : ∀ᶠ X : ℕ in Filter.atTop, W X / X < ε := by
    exact hWdiv (Iio_mem_nhds hε)
  rcases Filter.eventually_atTop.1 h_event with ⟨X₀, hX₀⟩
  refine ⟨X₀, ?_⟩
  intro X hX
  have hlt : W X / X < ε := hX₀ X hX
  by_cases hzero : X = 0
  · subst hzero
    simp [hA_eq_W]
  · have hXpos : (0 : ℝ) < X := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hzero
    have hmul : W X < ε * X := (div_lt_iff₀ hXpos).1 hlt
    have : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range X, a n < ε * X := by
      simpa [hA_eq_W X] using hmul
    exact le_of_lt this

name: primesCongOneMod3_prime_series_lower_bound
statement:
theorem primesCongOneMod3_prime_series_lower_bound: ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ {x : ℝ}, x ∈ Set.Ioc 1 2 →
    ((Nat.totient 3 : ℝ)⁻¹ / (x - 1) - C) ≤
      ∑' n : ℕ, (if n.Prime ∧ n % 3 = 1 then Real.log (n : ℝ) else 0) / (n : ℝ) ^ x
proof:
:= by
  rcases primesCongOneMod3_residueClass_lower_bound with ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩
  let B : ℝ := ∑' n : ℕ, (if n.Prime then 0 else primesCongOneMod3_residueClass n) / n
  refine ⟨C₀ + B, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => primesCongOneMod3_residueClass n / (n : ℝ) ^ x
  let fPrime : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (if n.Prime then primesCongOneMod3_residueClass n else 0) / (n : ℝ) ^ x
  let fNonprime : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (if n.Prime then 0 else primesCongOneMod3_residueClass n) / (n : ℝ) ^ x
  let target : ℕ → ℝ := fun n =>
    (if n.Prime ∧ n % 3 = 1 then Real.log (n : ℝ) else 0) / (n : ℝ) ^ x
  have hfull : ((Nat.totient 3 : ℝ)⁻¹ / (x - 1) - C₀) ≤ ∑' n, f n := by
    simpa [f] using hC₀ hx
  have hfullsumm : Summable f := by
    dsimp [f, primesCongOneMod3_residueClass]
    have hx' : (1 : EReal) < x := by
      exact_mod_cast hx.1
    exact LSeries.summable_real_of_abscissaOfAbsConv_lt <|
      (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt.abscissaOfAbsConv_residueClass_le_one (a := (1 : ZMod 3))).trans_lt hx'
  have hNonprime_nonneg (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ fNonprime n := by
    dsimp [fNonprime]
    by_cases hn : n.Prime
    · simp [hn]
    · simp [hn]
      exact div_nonneg
        (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt.residueClass_nonneg (a := (1 : ZMod 3)) n)
        (Real.rpow_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le n) x)
  have hNonprime_le (n : ℕ) : fNonprime n ≤ (if n.Prime then 0 else primesCongOneMod3_residueClass n) / n := by
    rcases n.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | hn
    · simp [fNonprime, primesCongOneMod3_residueClass, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt.residueClass_apply_zero]
    · refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by exact_mod_cast hn) ?_
      · dsimp [fNonprime]
        split_ifs
        · exact le_rfl
        · exact ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt.residueClass_nonneg (a := (1 : ZMod 3)) n
      · conv_lhs => rw [← Real.rpow_one n]
        exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt hn) hx.1.le
  have hNonprime_summ : Summable fNonprime := by
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le hNonprime_nonneg hNonprime_le ?_
    exact primesCongOneMod3_residueClass_nonprime_div_summable
  have hNonprime_tsum_le : ∑' n, fNonprime n ≤ B := by
    simpa [B] using Summable.tsum_le_tsum hNonprime_le hNonprime_summ primesCongOneMod3_residueClass_nonprime_div_summable
  have hPrime_fun : fPrime = fun n : ℕ => f n - fNonprime n := by
    ext n
    by_cases hn : n.Prime <;> simp [f, fPrime, fNonprime, hn]
  have hPrime_summ : Summable fPrime := by
    simpa [hPrime_fun] using hfullsumm.sub hNonprime_summ
  have hsplit_fun : f = fun n : ℕ => fPrime n + fNonprime n := by
    ext n
    by_cases hn : n.Prime <;> simp [f, fPrime, fNonprime, hn]
  have hsplit : ∑' n, f n = ∑' n, fPrime n + ∑' n, fNonprime n := by
    have hsumPrime := hPrime_summ.hasSum
    have hsumNonprime := hNonprime_summ.hasSum
    have hsumAdd : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => fPrime n + fNonprime n) (∑' n, fPrime n + ∑' n, fNonprime n) :=
      hsumPrime.add hsumNonprime
    have hsumF : HasSum f (∑' n, fPrime n + ∑' n, fNonprime n) := by
      simpa [hsplit_fun] using hsumAdd
    exact hsumF.tsum_eq
  have hPrime_eq (n : ℕ) : fPrime n = target n := by
    by_cases hn : n.Prime
    · by_cases hmod : n % 3 = 1
      · simp [fPrime, target, hn, hmod, primesCongOneMod3_residueClass_prime_eq_log n hn hmod]
      · have hzmod : ¬ ((n : ZMod 3) = (1 : ZMod 3)) := by
          intro hz
          apply hmod
          simpa using (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff' n 1 3).mp hz
        have hzero : primesCongOneMod3_residueClass n = 0 := by
          unfold primesCongOneMod3_residueClass ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt.residueClass
          simp [hzmod]
        simp [fPrime, target, hn, hmod, hzero]
    · simp [fPrime, target, hn]
  have hPrime_tsum : ∑' n, fPrime n = ∑' n, target n := by
    refine tsum_congr ?_
    intro n
    exact hPrime_eq n
  have hbound : ∑' n, f n ≤ ∑' n, target n + B := by
    calc
      ∑' n, f n = ∑' n, fPrime n + ∑' n, fNonprime n := hsplit
      _ ≤ ∑' n, fPrime n + B := by
        simpa [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using add_le_add_left hNonprime_tsum_le (∑' n, fPrime n)
      _ = ∑' n, target n + B := by rw [hPrime_tsum]
  have hfinal : ((Nat.totient 3 : ℝ)⁻¹ / (x - 1) - (C₀ + B)) ≤ ∑' n, target n := by
    linarith
  simpa [target, B] using hfinal

name: primesCongOneMod3_weighted_prime_series_avg_lower_bound
statement:
theorem primesCongOneMod3_weighted_prime_series_avg_lower_bound: ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M : ℕ, M₀ ≤ M →
    c * (M : ℝ) ≤
      ∑' n : ℕ,
        (if n.Prime ∧ n % 3 = 1 then Real.log (n : ℝ) else 0) /
          (n : ℝ) ^ (1 + (M : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  rcases primesCongOneMod3_prime_series_lower_bound with ⟨C, hC⟩
  refine ⟨(1 : ℝ) / 4, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  let M₀ : ℕ := max 1 (Nat.ceil (4 * max C 0))
  refine ⟨M₀, ?_⟩
  intro M hM
  have hM' : max 1 (Nat.ceil (4 * max C 0)) ≤ M := by
    simpa [M₀] using hM
  let x : ℝ := 1 + (M : ℝ)⁻¹
  have hM1 : 1 ≤ M := le_trans (le_max_left 1 (Nat.ceil (4 * max C 0))) hM'
  have hM0_nat : 0 < M := lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 1) hM1
  have hMpos : 0 < (M : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hM0_nat
  have hMinv_le_one : (M : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := by
    have hMge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (M : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hM1
    simpa [one_div] using
      (one_div_le_one_div_of_le (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num) hMge1)
  have hx_mem : x ∈ Set.Ioc 1 2 := by
    constructor
    · dsimp [x]
      have hInvPos : 0 < (M : ℝ)⁻¹ := by positivity
      linarith
    · dsimp [x]
      linarith
  have hmain := hC hx_mem
  have htot_nat : Nat.totient 3 = 2 := by
    simpa using Nat.totient_prime (by norm_num : Nat.Prime 3)
  have htot : (Nat.totient 3 : ℝ) = 2 := by
    exact_mod_cast htot_nat
  have hxsub : x - 1 = (M : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    dsimp [x]
    ring
  rw [htot, hxsub] at hmain
  have hEq : ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ / (M : ℝ)⁻¹ - C) = ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * (M : ℝ) - C := by
    have hMne : (M : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp [hMne, two_ne_zero]
  rw [hEq] at hmain
  have hceil_nat_le_M : Nat.ceil (4 * max C 0) ≤ M :=
    le_trans (le_max_right 1 (Nat.ceil (4 * max C 0))) hM'
  have hceil : 4 * max C 0 ≤ (Nat.ceil (4 * max C 0) : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
  have hceil_le_M : (Nat.ceil (4 * max C 0) : ℝ) ≤ (M : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hceil_nat_le_M
  have h4max_le_M : 4 * max C 0 ≤ (M : ℝ) := le_trans hceil hceil_le_M
  have hC_le_quarterM : C ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 4 * (M : ℝ) := by
    have hC_le_max : C ≤ max C 0 := le_max_left _ _
    have hmax_le_quarterM : max C 0 ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 4 * (M : ℝ) := by
      nlinarith
    exact le_trans hC_le_max hmax_le_quarterM
  have hquarterM_le : (1 : ℝ) / 4 * (M : ℝ) ≤ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * (M : ℝ) - C := by
    nlinarith
  have hfinal : (1 : ℝ) / 4 * (M : ℝ) ≤
      ∑' n : ℕ, (if n.Prime ∧ n % 3 = 1 then Real.log (n : ℝ) else 0) / (n : ℝ) ^ x := by
    exact le_trans hquarterM_le hmain
  simpa [x, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hfinal

name: residue_im_eq_zero_of_continuous_eqOn
statement:
theorem residue_im_eq_zero_of_continuous_eqOn {f : ℕ → ℝ} {a : ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ} :
    (∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s) →
    ContinuousOn g {s : ℂ | 1 ≤ s.re} →
    Set.EqOn g
      (fun s : ℂ => LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s - a / (s - 1))
      {s : ℂ | 1 < s.re} →
    a.im = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hsumm hcont heq
  have hL_real_im : ∀ y : ℝ, 1 < y → (LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) y).im = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have hs : LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) y := hsumm y (by simpa using hy)
    rw [LSeries, Complex.im_tsum hs]
    have hterm : (fun n => (LSeries.term (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) y n).im) = 0 := by
      funext n
      rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn
      · simp
      · rw [LSeries.term_of_ne_zero hn]
        have hpow : (n : ℂ) ^ (y : ℂ) = (((n : ℝ) ^ y : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          simpa using (Complex.ofReal_cpow n.cast_nonneg y).symm
        rw [hpow]
        simp
    rw [hterm]
    exact tsum_zero
  let x : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1 + 1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)
  let u : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => (x n : ℂ)
  have hu_mem : ∀ n, u n ∈ {s : ℂ | 1 ≤ s.re} := by
    intro n
    change 1 ≤ x n
    dsimp [x]
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ 1 / (n + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
    linarith
  have hu_gt : ∀ n, 1 < (u n).re := by
    intro n
    change 1 < x n
    dsimp [x]
    have hpos : 0 < 1 / (n + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
    linarith
  have hzero : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  have hx_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
    simpa [x] using (tendsto_const_nhds.add hzero)
  have hu_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop (nhds (1 : ℂ)) := by
    simpa [u] using Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hx_tendsto
  have hu_tendsto_within : Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin (1 : ℂ) {s : ℂ | 1 ≤ s.re}) := by
    simpa [nhdsWithin] using (Filter.tendsto_inf.2 ⟨hu_tendsto, Filter.tendsto_principal.2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hu_mem)⟩)
  have hprod_cont : ContinuousWithinAt (fun z : ℂ => (z - 1) * g z) {s : ℂ | 1 ≤ s.re} 1 := by
    refine ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt).mul ?_
    exact hcont 1 (by simp)
  have hprod_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (u n - 1) * g (u n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa [u] using hprod_cont.tendsto.comp hu_tendsto_within
  have him_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Complex.im ((u n - 1) * g (u n))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    exact Complex.continuous_im.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hprod_tendsto
  have him_const : ∀ n, Complex.im ((u n - 1) * g (u n)) = -a.im := by
    intro n
    have hEq : g (u n) = LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (u n) - a / (u n - 1) := by
      exact heq (by simpa using hu_gt n)
    have hx_gt_n : 1 < x n := by
      change 1 < (1 + 1 / (n + 1 : ℝ))
      have hpos : 0 < 1 / (n + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
      linarith
    have hx_ne_one : x n ≠ 1 := by linarith
    have hu_ne : u n - 1 ≠ 0 := by
      apply sub_ne_zero.mpr
      change (x n : ℂ) ≠ (1 : ℂ)
      exact_mod_cast hx_ne_one
    have hImL : (LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (u n)).im = 0 := by
      simpa [u] using hL_real_im (x n) hx_gt_n
    have hu_im : (u n - 1).im = 0 := by
      simp [u]
    have hmul : (u n - 1) * (LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (u n) - a / (u n - 1)) =
        (u n - 1) * LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (u n) - a := by
      rw [mul_sub]
      congr 1
      field_simp [hu_ne]
    calc
      Complex.im ((u n - 1) * g (u n))
          = Complex.im ((u n - 1) * (LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (u n) - a / (u n - 1))) := by rw [hEq]
      _ = Complex.im (((u n - 1) * LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (u n)) - a) := by rw [hmul]
      _ = -a.im := by
            rw [Complex.sub_im]
            have hprod_im_zero : (((u n - 1) * LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (u n)).im) = 0 := by
              rw [Complex.mul_im, hu_im, hImL]
              simp
            simp [hprod_im_zero]
  have hconst_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Complex.im ((u n - 1) * g (u n))) Filter.atTop (nhds (-a.im)) := by
    have hfun : (fun n => Complex.im ((u n - 1) * g (u n))) = fun _ : ℕ => -a.im := by
      funext n
      exact him_const n
    rw [hfun]
    exact tendsto_const_nhds
  have hlim : (-a.im : ℝ) = 0 := by
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique hconst_tendsto him_tendsto
  linarith

name: integrableOn_logRescalePartialSum_kernel_of_boundary_extension
statement: theorem integrableOn_logRescalePartialSum_kernel_of_boundary_extension {f : ℕ → ℝ} {b : ℝ} : HasBoundaryLaplaceExtension f b → ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.re → MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => (((logRescalePartialSum f x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x))) (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  intro hExt z hz
  rcases hExt with ⟨G, hGcont, hGint, hGeq⟩
  have hcenter :
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun x : ℝ => (((logRescalePartialSum f x - b : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)))
        (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) :=
    hGint z hz
  have hzneg : (-z).re < 0 := by
    simpa [Complex.neg_re] using (neg_lt_zero.mpr hz)
  have hexp :
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp ((-z) * x))
        (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa using integrableOn_exp_mul_complex_Ioi (a := -z) hzneg 0
  have hconst :
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun x : ℝ => ((b : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)))
        (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) := by
    have hconst' := hexp.integrable.const_mul (b : ℂ)
    change MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun x : ℝ => (b : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x))
      (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)))
    simpa [neg_mul] using hconst'
  have hsum :
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun x : ℝ =>
          ((((logRescalePartialSum f x - b : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)) +
            ((b : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x))))
        (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) := by
    change MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun x : ℝ =>
        ((((logRescalePartialSum f x - b : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)) +
          ((b : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x))))
      (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)))
    exact hcenter.integrable.add hconst.integrable
  simpa [sub_mul, add_mul, sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm]
    using hsum

name: logRescalePartialSum_tendsto_of_tendsto_sum_Icc_div
statement: theorem logRescalePartialSum_tendsto_of_tendsto_sum_Icc_div {f : ℕ → ℝ} {b : ℝ} : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 m, f k) / (m : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds b) → Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => logRescalePartialSum f x) Filter.atTop (nhds b)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => ((∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.exp x⌋₊, f k) / ((⌊Real.exp x⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ))) Filter.atTop (nhds b) := by
    simpa using h.comp (tendsto_nat_floor_atTop.comp Real.tendsto_exp_atTop)
  have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (((⌊Real.exp x⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) / Real.exp x)) Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
    simpa using tendsto_nat_floor_div_atTop.comp Real.tendsto_exp_atTop
  have hmul : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (((∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.exp x⌋₊, f k) / ((⌊Real.exp x⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (((⌊Real.exp x⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) / Real.exp x))) Filter.atTop (nhds (b * 1)) :=
    h1.mul h2
  have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => logRescalePartialSum f x) =ᶠ[Filter.atTop]
      (fun x : ℝ => (((∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.exp x⌋₊, f k) / ((⌊Real.exp x⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (((⌊Real.exp x⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) / Real.exp x)) ) := by
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with x hx
    have hxexp : 1 ≤ Real.exp x := by
      have := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hx
      simpa using this
    have hfloor_one : (1 : ℕ) ≤ ⌊Real.exp x⌋₊ := (Nat.one_le_floor_iff (Real.exp x)).2 hxexp
    have hfloor_ne : (⌊Real.exp x⌋₊ : ℕ) ≠ 0 := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mp hfloor_one
    have hfloor_ne' : (((⌊Real.exp x⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast hfloor_ne
    rw [logRescalePartialSum, if_pos hx, Real.exp_neg]
    field_simp [hfloor_ne', Real.exp_ne_zero x]
  have hmul' : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (((∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.exp x⌋₊, f k) / ((⌊Real.exp x⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (((⌊Real.exp x⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) / Real.exp x))) Filter.atTop (nhds b) := by
    simpa using hmul
  exact Filter.Tendsto.congr' h_eq.symm hmul'

name: boundary_extension_complex_identity
statement:
theorem boundary_extension_complex_identity {f : ℕ → ℝ} {b : ℝ} {G : ℂ → ℂ} :
    (hGint : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.re →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun x : ℝ => (((logRescalePartialSum f x - b : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)))
        (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ))) →
    (hGeq : Set.EqOn G
      (fun z : ℂ => ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
        (((logRescalePartialSum f x - b : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)))
      {z : ℂ | 0 < z.re}) →
    (hnonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) →
    (hsumm : ∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s) →
    ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.re →
      G z =
        LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (1 + z) / (1 + z) -
          Complex.ofReal b / z
proof:
:= by
  intro hGint hGeq hnonneg hsumm z hz
  have hG :
      G z = ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (((logRescalePartialSum f x - b : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)) := by
    exact hGeq (by simpa using hz)
  have hL := lseries_eq_logRescalePartialSum_laplace hnonneg hsumm z hz
  have h1z_ne : 1 + z ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hre : (1 + z).re = 0 := by simpa [h]
    have : 1 + z.re = 0 := by simpa using hre
    linarith
  have hL' :
      ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (((logRescalePartialSum f x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x))
        = LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (1 + z) / (1 + z) := by
    apply (eq_div_iff h1z_ne).2
    simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hL.symm
  have hzneg : (-z).re < 0 := by
    have : -z.re < 0 := by linarith
    simpa using this
  have hconst_int :
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun x : ℝ => Complex.ofReal b * Complex.exp (-z * x))
        (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa using
      (integrableOn_exp_mul_complex_Ioi (a := -z) hzneg (0 : ℝ)).const_mul (Complex.ofReal b)
  have hadd :
      ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
          ((((logRescalePartialSum f x - b : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)) +
            (Complex.ofReal b * Complex.exp (-z * x)))
        =
          (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
            (((logRescalePartialSum f x - b : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x))) +
          (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (Complex.ofReal b * Complex.exp (-z * x))) := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_add (hGint z hz) hconst_int]
  have hsum :
      ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (((logRescalePartialSum f x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x))
        =
          (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
            (((logRescalePartialSum f x - b : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x))) +
          (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (Complex.ofReal b * Complex.exp (-z * x))) := by
    calc
      ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (((logRescalePartialSum f x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x))
          =
            ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
              ((((logRescalePartialSum f x - b : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)) +
                (Complex.ofReal b * Complex.exp (-z * x))) := by
            congr with x
            simp [Complex.ofReal_sub, sub_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
      _ =
          (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
            (((logRescalePartialSum f x - b : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x))) +
          (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (Complex.ofReal b * Complex.exp (-z * x))) := hadd
  have hcentered :
      ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (((logRescalePartialSum f x - b : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x))
        =
          (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (((logRescalePartialSum f x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x))) -
          (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (Complex.ofReal b * Complex.exp (-z * x))) := by
    calc
      ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (((logRescalePartialSum f x - b : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x))
          =
            ((∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
                (((logRescalePartialSum f x - b : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x))) +
              (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (Complex.ofReal b * Complex.exp (-z * x)))) -
            (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (Complex.ofReal b * Complex.exp (-z * x))) := by
            ring
      _ =
          (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (((logRescalePartialSum f x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x))) -
          (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (Complex.ofReal b * Complex.exp (-z * x))) := by
            rw [← hsum]
  calc
    G z = ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (((logRescalePartialSum f x - b : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)) := hG
    _ =
        (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (((logRescalePartialSum f x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x))) -
        (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (Complex.ofReal b * Complex.exp (-z * x))) := hcentered
    _ = LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (1 + z) / (1 + z) - Complex.ofReal b / z := by
      rw [hL', integral_const_mul_cexp_neg_Ioi (b := b) (z := z) hz]

name: lseries_summable_complex_of_nterm
statement: theorem lseries_summable_complex_of_nterm {f : ℕ → ℝ} : (∀ σ' : ℝ, 1 < σ' → Summable (nterm (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) σ')) → ∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s
proof:
:= by
  intro hf s hs
  rw [LSeriesSummable]
  exact (summable_norm_iff).1 (by
    simpa [norm_term_eq_nterm_re] using hf s.re hs)

name: nat_le_floor_exp_of_log_lt
statement: theorem nat_le_floor_exp_of_log_lt {n : ℕ} {x : ℝ} : 1 ≤ n → Real.log (n : ℝ) < x → n ≤ ⌊Real.exp x⌋₊
proof:
:= by
  intro hn hx
  have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < n := by
    exact_mod_cast hn
  have hlt : (n : ℝ) < Real.exp x := by
    exact (Real.log_lt_iff_lt_exp hnpos).mp hx
  exact Nat.le_floor (le_of_lt hlt)

name: sum_filter_log_lt_le_sum_Icc_floor_exp
statement: theorem sum_filter_log_lt_le_sum_Icc_floor_exp {f : ℕ → ℝ} {N : ℕ} {x : ℝ} : (hnonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) → 0 < x → ∑ n ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 N).filter (fun n : ℕ => Real.log (n : ℝ) < x), f n ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.exp x⌋₊, f n
proof:
:= by
  intro hnonneg hx
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?hsub ?hnonneg
  · intro n hn
    rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hn with ⟨hnIcc, hlog⟩
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hnIcc ⊢
    exact ⟨hnIcc.1, nat_le_floor_exp_of_log_lt hnIcc.1 hlog⟩
  · intro n hn hnot
    exact hnonneg n

name: partial_sum_div_rpow_le_logRescale_kernel_integral
statement: theorem partial_sum_div_rpow_le_logRescale_kernel_integral {f : ℕ → ℝ} {σ' : ℝ} : (hnonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) → 1 < σ' → MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => logRescalePartialSum f x * Real.exp (-(σ' - 1) * x)) (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) → ∀ N : ℕ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f n / (n : ℝ) ^ σ' ≤ σ' * ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), logRescalePartialSum f x * Real.exp (-(σ' - 1) * x)
proof:
:= by
  intro hnonneg hσ hint N
  have hσ0 : 0 < σ' := by linarith
  have hrew (x S : ℝ) :
      S * Real.exp (-σ' * x) = (Real.exp (-x) * S) * Real.exp (-(σ' - 1) * x) := by
    have hExp : Real.exp (-σ' * x) = Real.exp (-x) * Real.exp (-(σ' - 1) * x) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [hExp]
    ring
  have hleftExp (x : ℝ) :
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, Set.indicator (Set.Ioi (Real.log n)) (fun x : ℝ => f n * Real.exp (-σ' * x)) x
        = (∑ n ∈ Finset.filter (fun n : ℕ => Real.log n < x) (Finset.Icc 1 N), f n) * Real.exp (-σ' * x) := by
    have hEq :
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, Set.indicator (Set.Ioi (Real.log n)) (fun x : ℝ => f n * Real.exp (-σ' * x)) x)
          = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (if Real.log n < x then f n else 0) * Real.exp (-σ' * x) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
      intro n hn
      by_cases hnx : Real.log n < x
      · simp [Set.indicator, Set.mem_Ioi, hnx]
      · simp [Set.indicator, Set.mem_Ioi, hnx]
    rw [hEq, Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_mul]
  have hsubset (x : ℝ) :
      Finset.filter (fun n : ℕ => Real.log n < x) (Finset.Icc 1 N) ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.exp x⌋₊ := by
    intro n hn
    rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hn with ⟨hnIcc, hlog⟩
    have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hnIcc).1
    have hn0 : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le (show 0 < (1:ℕ) by decide) hn1)
    have hle : (n : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp x := (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp hn0).mp (le_of_lt hlog)
    exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hn1, Nat.le_floor hle⟩
  have hbase (n : ℕ) : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => f n * Real.exp (-σ' * x)) (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa [mul_comm] using (integrableOn_exp_mul_Ioi (show -σ' < 0 by linarith) (0 : ℝ)).const_mul (f n)
  have htermInt (n : ℕ) (hn : n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N) :
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (Set.indicator (Set.Ioi (Real.log n)) (fun x : ℝ => f n * Real.exp (-σ' * x)))
        (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) := by
    exact (hbase n).indicator measurableSet_Ioi
  have hsumInt :
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun x : ℝ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
          Set.indicator (Set.Ioi (Real.log n)) (fun x : ℝ => f n * Real.exp (-σ' * x)) x)
        (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa [MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn] using
      (MeasureTheory.integrable_finset_sum (μ := MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict MeasureTheory.volume (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)))
        (Finset.Icc 1 N) (fun n hn => htermInt n hn))
  have hpoint (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) :
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
          Set.indicator (Set.Ioi (Real.log n)) (fun x : ℝ => f n * Real.exp (-σ' * x)) x)
        ≤ logRescalePartialSum f x * Real.exp (-(σ' - 1) * x) := by
    rw [hleftExp x]
    have hsumle :
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.filter (fun n : ℕ => Real.log n < x) (Finset.Icc 1 N), f n
          ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.exp x⌋₊, f n := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (hsubset x) (by intro i hi his; exact hnonneg i)
    have hexp_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-σ' * x) := by positivity
    calc
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.filter (fun n : ℕ => Real.log n < x) (Finset.Icc 1 N), f n) * Real.exp (-σ' * x)
          ≤ (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.exp x⌋₊, f n) * Real.exp (-σ' * x) := by
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsumle hexp_nonneg
      _ = logRescalePartialSum f x * Real.exp (-(σ' - 1) * x) := by
            rw [logRescalePartialSum, if_pos (le_of_lt hx)]
            simpa using (hrew x (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.exp x⌋₊, f n))
  have hmono :
      ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
            Set.indicator (Set.Ioi (Real.log n)) (fun x : ℝ => f n * Real.exp (-σ' * x)) x
        ≤ ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), logRescalePartialSum f x * Real.exp (-(σ' - 1) * x) := by
    exact MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_on_ae hsumInt hint measurableSet_Ioi (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpoint)
  have htermEvalRaw (n : ℕ) (hn : n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N) :
      ∫ x in Set.Ioi (Real.log n), f n * Real.exp (-σ' * x)
        = f n * ((n : ℝ) ^ (-σ')) / σ' := by
    have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).1
    have hn0 : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le (show 0 < (1:ℕ) by decide) hn1)
    rw [show (∫ x in Set.Ioi (Real.log n), f n * Real.exp (-σ' * x))
          = f n * ∫ x in Set.Ioi (Real.log n), Real.exp (-σ' * x) by
          simpa using (MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul (μ := MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict MeasureTheory.volume (Set.Ioi (Real.log n))) (f n) (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (-σ' * x)))]
    rw [integral_exp_mul_Ioi (show -σ' < 0 by linarith) (Real.log n)]
    have hExp : Real.exp (-σ' * Real.log n) = (n : ℝ) ^ (-σ') := by
      rw [mul_comm, Real.exp_mul, Real.exp_log hn0]
    rw [neg_div_neg_eq, hExp]
    ring
  have htermEval (n : ℕ) (hn : n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N) :
      ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
          Set.indicator (Set.Ioi (Real.log n)) (fun x : ℝ => f n * Real.exp (-σ' * x)) x
        = f n * ((n : ℝ) ^ (-σ')) / σ' := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_indicator (s := Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) (t := Set.Ioi (Real.log n))
          (f := fun x : ℝ => f n * Real.exp (-σ' * x)) measurableSet_Ioi]
    have hinter : Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) ∩ Set.Ioi (Real.log n) = Set.Ioi (Real.log n) := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        exact hx.2
      · intro hx
        exact ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt (Real.log_natCast_nonneg n) hx, hx⟩
    rw [hinter]
    exact htermEvalRaw n hn
  have hsumEval :
      ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
            Set.indicator (Set.Ioi (Real.log n)) (fun x : ℝ => f n * Real.exp (-σ' * x)) x
        = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f n * ((n : ℝ) ^ (-σ')) / σ' := by
    calc
      ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
            Set.indicator (Set.Ioi (Real.log n)) (fun x : ℝ => f n * Real.exp (-σ' * x)) x
          = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
              ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
                Set.indicator (Set.Ioi (Real.log n)) (fun x : ℝ => f n * Real.exp (-σ' * x)) x := by
            simpa using
              (MeasureTheory.integral_finset_sum (μ := MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict MeasureTheory.volume (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)))
                (Finset.Icc 1 N) (fun n hn => htermInt n hn))
      _ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f n * ((n : ℝ) ^ (-σ')) / σ' := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
            intro n hn
            exact htermEval n hn
  have hscaled :
      σ' * ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
            Set.indicator (Set.Ioi (Real.log n)) (fun x : ℝ => f n * Real.exp (-σ' * x)) x
        = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f n / (n : ℝ) ^ σ' := by
    rw [hsumEval, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    intro n hn
    have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).1
    have hn0 : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le (show 0 < (1:ℕ) by decide) hn1)
    have hpow0 : (n : ℝ) ^ σ' ≠ 0 := by
      exact (Real.rpow_ne_zero (show 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) by positivity) hσ0.ne').2 hn0.ne'
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (show 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) by positivity)]
    field_simp [hσ0.ne', hpow0]
  have hmain := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono (le_of_lt hσ0)
  rw [hscaled] at hmain
  exact hmain

name: summable_div_rpow_of_logRescale_kernel_integrable
statement: theorem summable_div_rpow_of_logRescale_kernel_integrable {f : ℕ → ℝ} {σ' : ℝ} : (hnonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) → 1 < σ' → MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => logRescalePartialSum f x * Real.exp (-(σ' - 1) * x)) (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) → Summable (fun n : ℕ => if n = 0 then 0 else f n / (n : ℝ) ^ σ')
proof:
:= by
  intro hnonneg hσ h_int
  let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => if n = 0 then 0 else f n / (n : ℝ) ^ σ'
  have ha_nonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n := by
    intro n
    by_cases h0 : n = 0
    · simp [a, h0]
    · simp only [a, h0, if_false]
      exact div_nonneg (hnonneg n) (le_of_lt (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h0) _))
  let C : ℝ := σ' * ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), logRescalePartialSum f x * Real.exp (-(σ' - 1) * x)
  have hsum_le : ∀ N : ℕ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f n / (n : ℝ) ^ σ' ≤ C := by
    intro N
    simpa only [C] using partial_sum_div_rpow_le_logRescale_kernel_integral hnonneg hσ h_int N
  have hsum_range_eq : ∀ N : ℕ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), a n = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f n / (n : ℝ) ^ σ' := by
    intro N
    rw [Nat.range_succ_eq_Icc_zero]
    have hinsert : insert 0 (Finset.Icc 1 N) = Finset.Icc 0 N := by
      simpa using (Finset.insert_Icc_succ_left_eq_Icc (a := 0) (b := N) (Nat.zero_le N))
    rw [← hinsert, Finset.sum_insert]
    · simp only [a, if_pos rfl, zero_add]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
      intro n hn
      have hnpos : 0 < n := by
        exact Nat.succ_le_iff.mp (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).1
      have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt hnpos
      simp only [a, hn0, if_false]
    · simp
  have hsum_range_le : ∀ N : ℕ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, a n ≤ C := by
    intro N
    cases N with
    | zero =>
        have h0 := hsum_le 0
        simpa using h0
    | succ N =>
        rw [hsum_range_eq N]
        exact hsum_le N
  simpa only [a] using (summable_of_sum_range_le ha_nonneg hsum_range_le)

name: summable_nterm_of_boundary_extension
statement: theorem summable_nterm_of_boundary_extension {f : ℕ → ℝ} {b : ℝ} : (hnonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) → HasBoundaryLaplaceExtension f b → ∀ σ' : ℝ, 1 < σ' → Summable (nterm (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) σ')
proof:
:= by
  intro hnonneg hbound σ' hσ'
  have hIntC :=
    integrableOn_logRescalePartialSum_kernel_of_boundary_extension hbound
      (((σ' - 1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) (by
        simpa using hσ')
  have hIntR' :
      MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun x : ℝ => logRescalePartialSum f x * Real.exp (-(σ' - 1) * x))
        (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ))) := by
    convert (MeasureTheory.Integrable.re hIntC) using 1
    ext x
    simp [Complex.exp_re, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]
  have hIntR :
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun x : ℝ => logRescalePartialSum f x * Real.exp (-(σ' - 1) * x))
        (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) := hIntR'
  have hsum :=
    summable_div_rpow_of_logRescale_kernel_integrable hnonneg hσ' hIntR
  refine hsum.congr ?_
  intro n
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · simp [nterm, hn]
  · simp [nterm, hn, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_of_nonneg (hnonneg n)]

name: tendsto_sum_Icc_div_of_tendsto_cumsum_div
statement: theorem tendsto_sum_Icc_div_of_tendsto_cumsum_div {f : ℕ → ℝ} {b : ℝ} : Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => cumsum f N / (N : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds b) → Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 m, f k) / (m : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds b)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h_shift : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => cumsum f (m + 1) / (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) Filter.atTop (nhds b) := by
    simpa [Nat.cast_add] using (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat (f := fun N : ℕ => cumsum f N / (N : ℝ)) (l := nhds b) 1).2 h
  have hratio : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (m : ℝ))) Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
    simpa [Nat.cast_add, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using
      (tendsto_add_mul_div_add_mul_atTop_nhds (a := (1 : ℝ)) (b := 0) (c := (1 : ℝ)) (d := (1 : ℝ)) one_ne_zero)
  have h0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => f 0 / (m : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using tendsto_const_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (f 0)
  have hsum : ∀ m : ℕ, cumsum f (m + 1) = f 0 + ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 m, f k := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
        simp [cumsum]
    | succ m ihm =>
        rw [cumsum_succ, ihm, Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top]
        · ring
        · omega
  have hmain : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun m : ℕ => (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (m : ℝ)) * (cumsum f (m + 1) / (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)))- f 0 / (m : ℝ))
      Filter.atTop (nhds b) := by
    simpa [one_mul] using (hratio.mul h_shift).sub h0
  refine Filter.Tendsto.congr' ?_ hmain
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with m hm
  have hmR : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hm)
  have hm1R : (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≠ 0 := by
    positivity
  rw [hsum m]
  field_simp [hmR, hm1R]
  ring

name: logRescalePartialSum_tendsto_of_tendsto_cumsum_div
statement: theorem logRescalePartialSum_tendsto_of_tendsto_cumsum_div {f : ℕ → ℝ} {b : ℝ} : Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => cumsum f N / (N : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds b) → Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => logRescalePartialSum f x) Filter.atTop (nhds b)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact logRescalePartialSum_tendsto_of_tendsto_sum_Icc_div (tendsto_sum_Icc_div_of_tendsto_cumsum_div h)

name: wiener_boundary_function_eqOn
statement:
theorem wiener_boundary_function_eqOn {f : ℕ → ℝ} {b : ℝ} {G : ℂ → ℂ} :
    (hGint : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.re →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun x : ℝ => (((logRescalePartialSum f x - b : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)))
        (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ))) →
    (hGeq : Set.EqOn G
      (fun z : ℂ => ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
        (((logRescalePartialSum f x - b : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * x)))
      {z : ℂ | 0 < z.re}) →
    (hnonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) →
    (hsumm : ∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s) →
    Set.EqOn (wiener_boundary_function G b)
      (fun s : ℂ => LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s - Complex.ofReal b / (s - 1))
      {s : ℂ | 1 < s.re}
proof:
:= by
  intro hGint hGeq hnonneg hsumm s hs
  have hsre : 1 < s.re := hs
  have hz : 0 < (s - (1 : ℂ)).re := by
    simpa [Complex.sub_re] using sub_pos.mpr hsre
  have hG := boundary_extension_complex_identity hGint hGeq hnonneg hsumm (s - (1 : ℂ)) hz
  dsimp [wiener_boundary_function]
  rw [hG]
  have h_one_add_sub : (1 : ℂ) + (s - 1) = s := by ring
  rw [h_one_add_sub]
  have hs_ne : s ≠ 0 := by
    intro hs0
    have hspos : 0 < s.re := lt_trans zero_lt_one hsre
    simpa [hs0] using hspos
  have hsub_ne : s - (1 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have : 0 < (s - (1 : ℂ)).re := hz
    simpa [hzero] using this
  field_simp [hs_ne, hsub_ne]
  ring_nf

name: logRescalePartialSum_tendsto_of_boundary_extension
