statement: theorem logRescalePartialSum_tendsto_of_boundary_extension {f : ℕ → ℝ} {b : ℝ} (hF : HasBoundaryLaplaceExtension f b) (hnonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => logRescalePartialSum f x) Filter.atTop (nhds b)
proof:
:= by
  have hf : ∀ σ' : ℝ, 1 < σ' → Summable (nterm (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) σ') :=
    summable_nterm_of_boundary_extension hnonneg hF
  rcases hF with ⟨G, hGcont, hGint, hGeq⟩
  have hsumm : ∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s :=
    lseries_summable_complex_of_nterm hf
  let W : ℂ → ℂ := wiener_boundary_function G b
  have hWcont : ContinuousOn W {s : ℂ | 1 ≤ s.re} := by
    have hshift : ContinuousOn (fun s : ℂ => s - (1 : ℂ)) {s : ℂ | 1 ≤ s.re} := by
      simpa using (continuous_id.sub continuous_const).continuousOn
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun s : ℂ => s - (1 : ℂ)) {s : ℂ | 1 ≤ s.re} {z : ℂ | 0 ≤ z.re} := by
      intro s hs
      simpa using hs
    have hGshift : ContinuousOn (fun s : ℂ => G (s - (1 : ℂ))) {s : ℂ | 1 ≤ s.re} := by
      simpa [Function.comp] using hGcont.comp hshift hmaps
    have hmul : ContinuousOn (fun s : ℂ => s * G (s - (1 : ℂ))) {s : ℂ | 1 ≤ s.re} :=
      continuousOn_id.mul hGshift
    simpa [W, wiener_boundary_function] using hmul.add continuousOn_const
  have hWeq : Set.EqOn W
      (fun s : ℂ => LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s - Complex.ofReal b / (s - 1))
      {s : ℂ | 1 < s.re} := by
    exact wiener_boundary_function_eqOn hGint hGeq hnonneg hsumm
  have hcum : Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => cumsum f N / (N : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds b) := by
    exact WienerIkeharaTheorem'' hnonneg hf hWcont hWeq
  exact logRescalePartialSum_tendsto_of_tendsto_cumsum_div hcum

name: liminf_logRescalePartialSum_pos_of_boundary_extension
statement:
theorem liminf_logRescalePartialSum_pos_of_boundary_extension {f : ℕ → ℝ} {b : ℝ} :
    (hb : 0 < b) →
    (hnonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) →
    (hF : HasBoundaryLaplaceExtension f b) →
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ x₀ : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, x₀ ≤ x → c ≤ logRescalePartialSum f x
proof:
:= by
  intro hb hnonneg hF
  refine ⟨b / 2, by linarith, ?_⟩
  have htend := logRescalePartialSum_tendsto_of_boundary_extension hF hnonneg
  have hhalf : b / 2 < b := by linarith
  have hIoi : Set.Ioi (b / 2) ∈ nhds b := Ioi_mem_nhds hhalf
  have hev : ∀ᶠ x in Filter.atTop, logRescalePartialSum f x ∈ Set.Ioi (b / 2) :=
    htend hIoi
  rcases (Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hev) with ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩
  exact ⟨x₀, fun x hx => le_of_lt (hx₀ x hx)⟩

name: liminf_logRescalePartialSum_pos_of_LSeries_pole
statement:
theorem liminf_logRescalePartialSum_pos_of_LSeries_pole {f : ℕ → ℝ} {a : ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ} :
    0 < a.re →
    (∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) →
    (∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s) →
    ContinuousOn g {s : ℂ | 1 ≤ s.re} →
    Set.EqOn g
      (fun s : ℂ => LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s - a / (s - 1))
      {s : ℂ | 1 < s.re} →
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ x₀ : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, x₀ ≤ x → c ≤ logRescalePartialSum f x
proof:
:= by
  intro ha hnonneg hsumm hcont heq
  have haim : a.im = 0 :=
    residue_im_eq_zero_of_continuous_eqOn hsumm hcont heq
  have hF : HasBoundaryLaplaceExtension f a.re :=
    hasBoundaryLaplaceExtension_of_eqOn haim hnonneg hsumm hcont heq
  exact liminf_logRescalePartialSum_pos_of_boundary_extension ha hnonneg hF

name: tendsto_lSeries_eval_one_add_inv_floor_pow_of_real_pole_bound
statement:
theorem tendsto_lSeries_eval_one_add_inv_floor_pow_of_real_pole_bound {f : ℕ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} :
    (∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ {x : ℝ}, x ∈ Set.Ioc 1 2 →
      abs ((∑' n, f n / (n : ℝ) ^ x) - a / (x - 1)) ≤ C) →
    ∀ c : ℝ, 1 < c →
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ =>
          (∑' k, f k / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (⌊c ^ n⌋₊ : ℝ)⁻¹)) / (⌊c ^ n⌋₊ : ℝ))
        Filter.atTop (nhds a)
proof:
:= by
  intro h c hc
  rcases h with ⟨C, hC_nonneg, hC⟩
  let m : ℕ → ℕ := fun n => ⌊c ^ n⌋₊
  let x : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1 + (m n : ℝ)⁻¹
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => ∑' k, f k / (k : ℝ) ^ s
  let seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => F (x n) / (m n : ℝ)
  have hm_pos : ∀ n, 0 < m n := by
    intro n
    dsimp [m]
    exact Nat.floor_pos.2 (by
      simpa using (one_le_pow₀ (show 1 ≤ c by linarith) : 1 ≤ c ^ n))
  have hx_mem : ∀ n, x n ∈ Set.Ioc 1 2 := by
    intro n
    constructor
    · have hm_real_pos : 0 < (m n : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hm_pos n
      have hinv_pos : 0 < ((m n : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
        exact inv_pos.2 hm_real_pos
      dsimp [x]
      linarith
    · dsimp [x]
      have hm_ge_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ m n := by
        exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (hm_pos n))
      have hinv_le_one : ((m n : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hm_ge_one
      linarith
  have hbound : ∀ n, abs (seq n - a) ≤ C / (m n : ℝ) := by
    intro n
    have h0 : abs (F (x n) - a * (m n : ℝ)) ≤ C := by
      have h0' := hC (hx_mem n)
      dsimp [F, x] at h0'
      rw [show (1 + (m n : ℝ)⁻¹) - 1 = (m n : ℝ)⁻¹ by ring] at h0'
      simpa [div_inv_eq_mul] using h0'
    have hm_real_pos : 0 < (m n : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hm_pos n
    have hm_real_ne : (m n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hm_real_pos
    have hdiv : abs (F (x n) - a * (m n : ℝ)) / (m n : ℝ) ≤ C / (m n : ℝ) := by
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h0 (le_of_lt hm_real_pos)
    have hEq : seq n - a = (F (x n) - a * (m n : ℝ)) / (m n : ℝ) := by
      dsimp [seq]
      field_simp [hm_real_ne]
    calc
      abs (seq n - a)
          = abs ((F (x n) - a * (m n : ℝ)) / (m n : ℝ)) := by rw [hEq]
      _ = abs (F (x n) - a * (m n : ℝ)) / (m n : ℝ) := by
            rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hm_real_pos]
      _ ≤ C / (m n : ℝ) := hdiv
  have hm_atTop : Filter.Tendsto m Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
    simpa [m] using (tendsto_nat_floor_atTop.comp (tendsto_pow_atTop_atTop_of_one_lt hc))
  have hm_real_atTop : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (m n : ℝ)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
    exact (tendsto_natCast_atTop_iff.2 hm_atTop)
  have hCdiv : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => C / (m n : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    exact Filter.Tendsto.const_div_atTop hm_real_atTop C
  have habs : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => abs (seq n - a)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    exact squeeze_zero (fun n => abs_nonneg _) hbound hCdiv
  have hdist : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => dist (seq n) a) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa [Real.dist_eq] using habs
  have hseq : Filter.Tendsto seq Filter.atTop (nhds a) :=
    (tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero.2 hdist)
  simpa [seq, F, x, m] using hseq

name: tendsto_sum_range_div_of_tendsto_sum_Icc_div
statement:
theorem tendsto_sum_range_div_of_tendsto_sum_Icc_div {f : ℕ → ℝ} {l : ℝ} :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun m : ℕ => (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 m, f k) / (m : ℝ))
      Filter.atTop (nhds l) →
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun m : ℕ => (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, f k) / (m : ℝ))
      Filter.atTop (nhds l)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  let g : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 m, f k) / (m : ℝ)
  have hg : Filter.Tendsto g Filter.atTop (nhds l) := h
  have hcomp : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => g (m - 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds l) := by
    simpa using hg.comp (Filter.tendsto_sub_atTop_nat 1)
  have hzero : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => f 0 / (m : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using tendsto_const_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (f 0)
  have hratio_aux : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
    simpa using (tendsto_natCast_div_add_atTop (1 : ℝ))
  have hu : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (((m - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((((m - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) + 1))) Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
    simpa using hratio_aux.comp (Filter.tendsto_sub_atTop_nat 1)
  have hratio : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (((m - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (m : ℝ))) Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
    refine Filter.Tendsto.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_) hu
    intro m
    cases m with
    | zero => norm_num
    | succ n =>
        simp [Nat.cast_sub (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n))]
  have hmul : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (((m - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (m : ℝ)) * g (m - 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds (1 * l)) := by
    exact hratio.mul hcomp
  have hadd : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => f 0 / (m : ℝ) + (((m - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (m : ℝ)) * g (m - 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds (0 + 1 * l)) := by
    exact hzero.add hmul
  have hadd' : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => f 0 / (m : ℝ) + (((m - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (m : ℝ)) * g (m - 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds l) := by
    simpa using hadd
  have hEq :
      (fun m : ℕ => f 0 / (m : ℝ) + (((m - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (m : ℝ)) * g (m - 1)) =ᶠ[Filter.atTop]
        (fun m : ℕ => (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, f k) / (m : ℝ)) := by
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with m hm
    rcases Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hm) with ⟨n, rfl⟩
    have hsum : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), f k) = f 0 + ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, f k := by
      rw [Nat.range_succ_eq_Icc_zero]
      rw [← Finset.insert_Icc_succ_left_eq_Icc (a := 0) (b := n) (Nat.zero_le n)]
      rw [Finset.sum_insert]
      · simp
      · simp
    rw [hsum, add_div]
    congr 1
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · simp [hn, g]
    · have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
        exact_mod_cast hn
      simpa [g] using (div_mul_div_cancel₀' hn0 (↑n + 1) (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, f k))
  exact Filter.Tendsto.congr' hEq hadd'

name: tendsto_weighted_average_floor_pow_of_LSeries_pole
statement:
theorem tendsto_weighted_average_floor_pow_of_LSeries_pole {f : ℕ → ℝ} {a : ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ} :
    (∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s) →
    ContinuousOn g {s : ℂ | 1 ≤ s.re} →
    Set.EqOn g
      (fun s : ℂ => LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s - a / (s - 1))
      {s : ℂ | 1 < s.re} →
    ∀ c : ℝ, 1 < c →
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ =>
          (∑' k, f k / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (⌊c ^ n⌋₊ : ℝ)⁻¹)) / (⌊c ^ n⌋₊ : ℝ))
        Filter.atTop (nhds a.re)
proof:
:= by
  intro hsumm hcont heq c hc
  exact tendsto_lSeries_eval_one_add_inv_floor_pow_of_real_pole_bound
    (lSeries_real_sub_pole_abs_le_of_continuous_eqOn hsumm hcont heq) c hc

name: unitIntervalAverage_tendsto_of_tendsto_sum_div
statement:
theorem unitIntervalAverage_tendsto_of_tendsto_sum_div {f : ℕ → ℝ} {b : ℝ} :
  (hsumdiv : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, f k) / (n : ℝ))
      Filter.atTop (nhds b)) →
  Filter.Tendsto (fun X : ℝ => ∫ t in X - 1..X, logRescalePartialSum f t)
    Filter.atTop (nhds b)
proof:
:= by
  intro hsumdiv
  have hsumdiv_floor :
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun x : ℝ => (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.exp x⌋₊, f k) / (⌊Real.exp x⌋₊ : ℝ))
        Filter.atTop (nhds b) := by
    exact hsumdiv.comp (tendsto_nat_floor_atTop.comp Real.tendsto_exp_atTop)
  have hfloor_div :
      Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (⌊Real.exp x⌋₊ : ℝ) / Real.exp x) Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
    exact tendsto_nat_floor_div_atTop.comp Real.tendsto_exp_atTop
  have hprod :
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun x : ℝ =>
          ((∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.exp x⌋₊, f k) / (⌊Real.exp x⌋₊ : ℝ)) *
            ((⌊Real.exp x⌋₊ : ℝ) / Real.exp x))
        Filter.atTop (nhds b) := by
    simpa using hsumdiv_floor.mul hfloor_div
  have hlog : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => logRescalePartialSum f x) Filter.atTop (nhds b) := by
    refine Filter.Tendsto.congr' ?_ hprod
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with x hx
    rw [logRescalePartialSum, if_pos hx, Real.exp_neg]
    have hxexp : 1 ≤ Real.exp x := by
      rw [← Real.exp_zero]
      exact (Real.exp_le_exp).2 hx
    have hfloor_pos : 0 < ⌊Real.exp x⌋₊ := Nat.floor_pos.2 hxexp
    have hfloor_ne : (⌊Real.exp x⌋₊ : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hfloor_pos)
    field_simp [hfloor_ne, Real.exp_ne_zero]
  have hA : Measurable (fun n : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, f k) := measurable_from_nat
  have hsum_meas :
      Measurable fun x : ℝ => ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.exp x⌋₊, f k := by
    exact hA.comp ((Real.measurable_exp).nat_floor)
  have hmeas : Measurable (logRescalePartialSum f) := by
    unfold logRescalePartialSum
    refine Measurable.ite measurableSet_Ici ?_ measurable_const
    exact (Real.measurable_exp.comp measurable_id.neg).mul hsum_meas
  refine Metric.tendsto_atTop.2 ?_
  intro ε hε
  have hε2 : 0 < ε / 2 := by positivity
  rcases (Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 hlog) (ε / 2) hε2 with ⟨R, hR⟩
  refine ⟨R + 1, ?_⟩
  intro X hX
  have hXle : X - 1 ≤ X := by linarith
  have hXR : R ≤ X - 1 := by linarith
  have hbound_Ioc : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioc (X - 1) X, ‖logRescalePartialSum f t - b‖ ≤ ε / 2 := by
    intro t ht
    have htR : R ≤ t := by linarith [ht.1, hXR]
    have htε : dist (logRescalePartialSum f t) b < ε / 2 := hR t htR
    simpa [dist_eq_norm] using le_of_lt htε
  have hbound_uIoc : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIoc (X - 1) X, ‖logRescalePartialSum f t - b‖ ≤ ε / 2 := by
    intro t ht
    have ht' : t ∈ Set.Ioc (X - 1) X := by
      simpa [Set.uIoc_of_le hXle] using ht
    exact hbound_Ioc t ht'
  have hbound_norm : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioc (X - 1) X, ‖logRescalePartialSum f t‖ ≤ ε / 2 + ‖b‖ := by
    intro t ht
    calc
      ‖logRescalePartialSum f t‖ = ‖(logRescalePartialSum f t - b) + b‖ := by ring_nf
      _ ≤ ‖logRescalePartialSum f t - b‖ + ‖b‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ε / 2 + ‖b‖ := add_le_add (hbound_Ioc t ht) le_rfl
  have hlog_int_on :
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (logRescalePartialSum f) (Set.Ioc (X - 1) X)
        MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume := by
    refine MeasureTheory.Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded
      (μ := MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume) (s := Set.Ioc (X - 1) X)
      (M := ε / 2 + ‖b‖) ?_ hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    · simp [Real.volume_Ioc]
    · rw [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioc]
      filter_upwards with t ht
      exact hbound_norm t ht
  have hlog_int :
      IntervalIntegrable (logRescalePartialSum f) MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume (X - 1) X := by
    exact (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hXle).2 hlog_int_on
  have hconst : ∫ t in X - 1..X, b = b := by
    simpa using (integral_const_on_unit_interval (a := X - 1) (b := b))
  have hsub :
      (∫ t in X - 1..X, logRescalePartialSum f t) - b =
        ∫ t in X - 1..X, (logRescalePartialSum f t - b) := by
    calc
      (∫ t in X - 1..X, logRescalePartialSum f t) - b
          = (∫ t in X - 1..X, logRescalePartialSum f t) - ∫ t in X - 1..X, b := by rw [hconst]
      _ = ∫ t in X - 1..X, (logRescalePartialSum f t - b) := by
        symm
        exact intervalIntegral.integral_sub hlog_int intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_const
  have hlen' : X - (X - 1) = 1 := by ring
  have hlen : |X - (X - 1)| = 1 := by
    rw [hlen']
    norm_num
  have hnorm : ‖(∫ t in X - 1..X, logRescalePartialSum f t) - b‖ ≤ ε / 2 := by
    rw [hsub]
    have htmp :=
      intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
        (a := X - 1) (b := X) (C := ε / 2)
        (f := fun t : ℝ => logRescalePartialSum f t - b) hbound_uIoc
    simpa [hlen] using htmp
  have hlt : ε / 2 < ε := by linarith
  simpa [dist_eq_norm] using lt_of_le_of_lt hnorm hlt

name: weighted_dirichlet_series_monotone
statement:
theorem weighted_dirichlet_series_monotone {f : ℕ → ℝ} :
    (∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) →
    (∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s) →
    Monotone (fun m : ℕ =>
      if m = 0 then 0 else ∑' k, f k / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  intro hf hsum
  intro m n hmn
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · subst hm
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · simp [hn]
    · simp [hn]
      have hq_pos : 0 < (1 + (n : ℝ)⁻¹ : ℝ) := by
        have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
        have hinv : 0 < (n : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hnpos
        linarith
      have h_eq :
          (∑' k, f k / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (n : ℝ)⁻¹)) =
            ∑' k, (if k = 0 then 0 else f k / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (n : ℝ)⁻¹)) := by
        apply tsum_congr
        intro k
        by_cases hk : k = 0
        · subst hk
          simp [Real.zero_rpow (ne_of_gt hq_pos)]
        · simp [hk]
      rw [h_eq]
      exact tsum_nonneg (fun k => by
        by_cases hk : k = 0
        · simp [hk]
        · simp [hk]
          have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) := by
            exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk
          exact div_nonneg (hf k) (le_of_lt (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hkpos _)))
  · have hn : n ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hm
      exact Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (by simpa [h0] using hmn)
    have hmpos : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm
    have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
    let qm : ℝ := 1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹
    let qn : ℝ := 1 + (n : ℝ)⁻¹
    have hqm_pos : 0 < qm := by
      dsimp [qm]
      have h : 0 < (m : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hmpos
      linarith
    have hqn_pos : 0 < qn := by
      dsimp [qn]
      have h : 0 < (n : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hnpos
      linarith
    have hqn_gt1 : 1 < qn := by
      dsimp [qn]
      have h : 0 < (n : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hnpos
      linarith
    have hqle : qn ≤ qm := by
      dsimp [qn, qm]
      have hmn' : (m : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hmn
      have hinv : (n : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ (m : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        simpa [one_div] using one_div_le_one_div_of_le hmpos hmn'
      linarith
    let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => if k = 0 then 0 else f k / (k : ℝ) ^ qm
    let b : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => if k = 0 then 0 else f k / (k : ℝ) ^ qn
    have ha_nonneg : ∀ k, 0 ≤ a k := by
      intro k
      by_cases hk : k = 0
      · simp [a, hk]
      · simp [a, hk]
        have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk
        exact div_nonneg (hf k) (le_of_lt (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hkpos _))
    have hb_nonneg : ∀ k, 0 ≤ b k := by
      intro k
      by_cases hk : k = 0
      · simp [b, hk]
      · simp [b, hk]
        have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk
        exact div_nonneg (hf k) (le_of_lt (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hkpos _))
    have hab : ∀ k, a k ≤ b k := by
      intro k
      by_cases hk : k = 0
      · simp [a, b, hk]
      · simp [a, b, hk]
        have hkpos_nat : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk
        have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast hkpos_nat
        have hkone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt hkpos_nat
        have hpow : (k : ℝ) ^ qn ≤ (k : ℝ) ^ qm := by
          exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hkone hqle
        have hpowpos : 0 < (k : ℝ) ^ qn := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hkpos _
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (hf k) hpowpos hpow
    have hls : LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (qn : ℂ) := by
      exact hsum (qn : ℂ) (by simpa using hqn_gt1)
    have hsummable_b_norm : Summable (fun k => ‖LSeries.term (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (qn : ℂ) k‖) := by
      rw [LSeriesSummable, ← summable_norm_iff] at hls
      exact hls
    have hsummable_b : Summable b := by
      simpa [b, qn, LSeries.norm_term_eq, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg, hf] using hsummable_b_norm
    have htsum_a :
        (∑' k, f k / (k : ℝ) ^ qm) = ∑' k, a k := by
      apply tsum_congr
      intro k
      by_cases hk : k = 0
      · subst hk
        simp [a, Real.zero_rpow (ne_of_gt hqm_pos)]
      · simp [a, hk]
    have htsum_b :
        (∑' k, f k / (k : ℝ) ^ qn) = ∑' k, b k := by
      apply tsum_congr
      intro k
      by_cases hk : k = 0
      · subst hk
        simp [b, Real.zero_rpow (ne_of_gt hqn_pos)]
      · simp [b, hk]
    simp [hm, hn]
    change (∑' k, f k / (k : ℝ) ^ qm) ≤ ∑' k, f k / (k : ℝ) ^ qn
    rw [htsum_a, htsum_b]
    exact Real.tsum_le_of_sum_range_le ha_nonneg (fun N => by
      refine (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => hab i).trans ?_
      exact hsummable_b.sum_le_tsum (Finset.range N) (fun i hi => hb_nonneg i))

name: tendsto_dirichlet_weighted_average_atTop_of_LSeries_pole
statement:
theorem tendsto_dirichlet_weighted_average_atTop_of_LSeries_pole {f : ℕ → ℝ} {a : ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ} :
    (∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) →
    (∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s) →
    ContinuousOn g {s : ℂ | 1 ≤ s.re} →
    Set.EqOn g
      (fun s : ℂ => LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s - a / (s - 1))
      {s : ℂ | 1 < s.re} →
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun m : ℕ =>
        (∑' k, f k / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹)) / (m : ℝ))
      Filter.atTop (nhds a.re)
proof:
:= by
  intro hf_nonneg hsumm hcont hEq
  let u : ℕ → ℝ := fun m =>
    if m = 0 then 0 else ∑' k, f k / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹)
  have hu_mono : Monotone u := by
    simpa [u] using weighted_dirichlet_series_monotone hf_nonneg hsumm
  let d : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => 1 + 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)
  have hd_gt_one : ∀ k, 1 < d k := by
    intro k
    dsimp [d]
    have hk : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) := by
      positivity
    linarith
  have hd_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto d Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
      (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat :
        Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
    simpa [d] using tendsto_const_nhds.add h1
  have hdk : ∀ k,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => u ⌊d k ^ n⌋₊ / (⌊d k ^ n⌋₊ : ℝ))
        Filter.atTop (nhds a.re) := by
    intro k
    have hk :=
      tendsto_weighted_average_floor_pow_of_LSeries_pole hsumm hcont hEq (d k) (hd_gt_one k)
    have hfloor : ∀ n : ℕ, (⌊d k ^ n⌋₊ : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro n
      have hpow : (1 : ℝ) ≤ d k ^ n := by
        exact one_le_pow₀ (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ d k by linarith [hd_gt_one k])
      exact ne_of_gt ((Nat.floor_pos).2 hpow)
    simpa [u, hfloor] using hk
  have hmain :
      Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => u m / (m : ℝ))
        Filter.atTop (nhds a.re) := by
    simpa using
      (tendsto_div_of_monotone_of_tendsto_div_floor_pow u a.re hu_mono d hd_gt_one hd_tendsto hdk)
  have h_eq :
      (fun m : ℕ => u m / (m : ℝ)) =ᶠ[Filter.atTop]
        (fun m : ℕ =>
          (∑' k, f k / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹)) / (m : ℝ)) := by
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_
    intro m
    by_cases hm : m = 0 <;> simp [u, hm]
  exact Filter.Tendsto.congr' h_eq hmain

name: tendsto_dirichlet_weighted_average_atTop_of_real_pole_bound
statement:
theorem tendsto_dirichlet_weighted_average_atTop_of_real_pole_bound {f : ℕ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} :
    (∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) →
    (∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ {x : ℝ}, x ∈ Set.Ioc 1 2 →
      abs ((∑' n, f n / (n : ℝ) ^ x) - a / (x - 1)) ≤ C) →
    (∀ r : ℝ, 1 < r → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ N : ℕ,
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f k ≤ C * (N : ℝ) ^ r) →
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun m : ℕ =>
        (∑' k, f k / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹)) / (m : ℝ))
      Filter.atTop (nhds a)
proof:
:= by
  intro hnonneg hpole hgrowth
  let u : ℕ → ℝ := fun m =>
    if m = 0 then 0 else ∑' k, f k / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹)
  have hsumm : ∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s :=
    lSeriesSummable_of_Icc_growth_family (f := f) hnonneg hgrowth
  have hu_mono : Monotone u := by
    simpa [u] using weighted_dirichlet_series_monotone hnonneg hsumm
  let d : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => 1 + 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)
  have hd_gt_one : ∀ k, 1 < d k := by
    intro k
    dsimp [d]
    have hpos : 0 < (1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) := by
      positivity
    linarith
  have hd_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto d Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
      (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat :
        Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
    simpa [d] using tendsto_const_nhds.add h1
  have hdk : ∀ k,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => u ⌊d k ^ n⌋₊ / (⌊d k ^ n⌋₊ : ℝ))
        Filter.atTop (nhds a) := by
    intro k
    have hk :=
      tendsto_lSeries_eval_one_add_inv_floor_pow_of_real_pole_bound
        (f := f) (a := a) hpole (d k) (hd_gt_one k)
    have hfloor : ∀ n : ℕ, (⌊d k ^ n⌋₊ : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro n
      have hpow : (1 : ℝ) ≤ d k ^ n := by
        exact one_le_pow₀ (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ d k by linarith [hd_gt_one k])
      exact ne_of_gt ((Nat.floor_pos).2 hpow)
    simpa [u, hfloor] using hk
  have hmain :
      Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => u m / (m : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds a) := by
    simpa using
      (tendsto_div_of_monotone_of_tendsto_div_floor_pow u a hu_mono d hd_gt_one hd_tendsto hdk)
  have h_eq :
      (fun m : ℕ => u m / (m : ℝ)) =ᶠ[Filter.atTop]
        (fun m : ℕ =>
          (∑' k, f k / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹)) / (m : ℝ)) := by
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_
    intro m
    by_cases hm : m = 0 <;> simp [u, hm]
  exact Filter.Tendsto.congr' h_eq hmain

name: tendsto_weighted_average_of_LSeries_pole
statement:
theorem tendsto_weighted_average_of_LSeries_pole {f : ℕ → ℝ} {a : ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ} :
    (∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) →
    (∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s) →
    ContinuousOn g {s : ℂ | 1 ≤ s.re} →
    Set.EqOn g
      (fun s : ℂ => LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s - a / (s - 1))
      {s : ℂ | 1 < s.re} →
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun N : ℕ =>
        (∑' k, f k / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (N : ℝ)⁻¹)) / (N : ℝ))
      Filter.atTop (nhds a.re)
proof:
:= by
  intro hf hs hcont heq
  let u : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => if m = 0 then 0 else ∑' k, f k / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹)
  have hmono : Monotone u := weighted_dirichlet_series_monotone hf hs
  let c : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => 1 + 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)
  have hcone : ∀ k, 1 < c k := by
    intro k
    dsimp [c]
    have hpos : 0 < 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) := by
      positivity
    linarith
  have hclim : Filter.Tendsto c Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
    have h0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using
        (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat :
          Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
    simpa [c, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using h0.const_add (1 : ℝ)
  have hfloor : ∀ k : ℕ,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => u ⌊c k ^ n⌋₊ / (⌊c k ^ n⌋₊ : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds a.re) := by
    intro k
    have hEq :
        (fun n : ℕ => u ⌊c k ^ n⌋₊ / (⌊c k ^ n⌋₊ : ℝ)) =
          (fun n : ℕ =>
            (∑' j, f j / (j : ℝ) ^ (1 + (⌊c k ^ n⌋₊ : ℝ)⁻¹)) / (⌊c k ^ n⌋₊ : ℝ)) := by
      funext n
      have hpow : ¬ c k ^ n < 1 := by
        exact not_lt.mpr (one_le_pow₀ (a := c k) (n := n) (le_of_lt (hcone k)))
      simp [u, hpow]
    rw [hEq]
    exact tendsto_weighted_average_floor_pow_of_LSeries_pole hs hcont heq (c k) (hcone k)
  have hmain : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => u n / (n : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds a.re) :=
    tendsto_div_of_monotone_of_tendsto_div_floor_pow u a.re hmono c hcone hclim hfloor
  have hEqMain :
      (fun N : ℕ => u N / (N : ℝ)) =
        (fun N : ℕ => (∑' k, f k / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (N : ℝ)⁻¹)) / (N : ℝ)) := by
    funext N
    by_cases hN : N = 0
    · subst N
      simp [u]
    · simp [u, hN]
  rw [← hEqMain]
  exact hmain

name: tendsto_weighted_average_sub_const_of_LSeries_pole
statement:
theorem tendsto_weighted_average_sub_const_of_LSeries_pole {f : ℕ → ℝ} {a : ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ} :
    (∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) →
    (∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s) →
    ContinuousOn g {s : ℂ | 1 ≤ s.re} →
    Set.EqOn g
      (fun s : ℂ => LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s - a / (s - 1))
      {s : ℂ | 1 < s.re} →
    ∀ B : ℝ,
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun m : ℕ =>
          (∑' k, (f k - B) / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹)) / (m : ℝ))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (a.re - B))
proof:
:= by
  intro hnonneg hsumm hcont heq B
  let Wf : ℕ → ℝ := fun m =>
    (∑' k : ℕ, f k / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹)) / (m : ℝ)
  let V : ℕ → ℝ := fun m =>
    B * (((1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹) - 1) * ∑' k : ℕ, 1 / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹))
  have hWf : Filter.Tendsto Wf Filter.atTop (nhds a.re) := by
    simpa [Wf] using
      tendsto_dirichlet_weighted_average_atTop_of_LSeries_pole hnonneg hsumm hcont heq
  have hinv : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => ((m : ℝ))⁻¹) Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) := by
    exact tendsto_inv_atTop_nhdsGT_zero.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hseq : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => 1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹) Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin (1 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 1)) := by
    have hadd : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => 1 + x) (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhdsWithin (1 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 1)) := by
      simpa using
        (show ContinuousWithinAt (fun x : ℝ => 1 + x) (Set.Ioi 0) 0 from
          (continuous_const.add continuous_id).continuousWithinAt).tendsto_nhdsWithin (t := Set.Ioi 1) (by
            intro x hx
            have hx' : 0 < x := by simpa using hx
            change 1 < 1 + x
            linarith)
    simpa using hadd.comp hinv
  have hV : Filter.Tendsto V Filter.atTop (nhds B) := by
    simpa [V, one_div, mul_assoc] using (tendsto_sub_mul_tsum_nat_rpow.comp hseq).const_mul B
  have hsumf (s : ℝ) (hs : 1 < s) : Summable (fun k : ℕ => f k / (k : ℝ) ^ s) := by
    have hsumc : LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (s : ℂ) := hsumm s hs
    rw [LSeriesSummable] at hsumc
    have hs0r : s ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have hs0 : (s : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hs0r
    have hsumc' : Summable (fun k : ℕ => ((f k / (k : ℝ) ^ s : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
      refine hsumc.congr ?_
      intro n
      rw [LSeries.term_of_ne_zero' hs0]
      simp [Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_cpow (Nat.cast_nonneg n)]
    exact (Complex.summable_ofReal).mp hsumc'
  have hsum1 (s : ℝ) (hs : 1 < s) : Summable (fun k : ℕ => B / (k : ℝ) ^ s) := by
    have h : Summable (fun k : ℕ => 1 / (k : ℝ) ^ s) := (Real.summable_one_div_nat_rpow).2 hs
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using h.mul_left B
  have htsum (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
      (∑' k : ℕ, (f k - B) / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹))
        = (∑' k : ℕ, f k / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹))
          - ∑' k : ℕ, B / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    have hs : 1 < 1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      have hm' : (0 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
      have hminv : 0 < (m : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hm'
      linarith
    have hf := hsumf (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹) hs
    have hB := hsum1 (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹) hs
    calc
      (∑' k : ℕ, (f k - B) / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹))
          = ∑' k : ℕ, (f k / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹) - B / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹)) := by
              congr with k
              ring
      _ = (∑' k : ℕ, f k / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹)) - ∑' k : ℕ, B / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
            simpa using hf.tsum_sub hB
  have hVeq :
      (fun m : ℕ =>
        ((∑' k : ℕ, B / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹)) / (m : ℝ))) = V := by
    funext m
    have hmul :
        (∑' k : ℕ, B * ((k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹))⁻¹)
          = B * ∑' k : ℕ, ((k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹))⁻¹ := by
      simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using (tsum_mul_left :
        (∑' k : ℕ, B * (1 / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹)))
          = B * ∑' k : ℕ, 1 / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹))
    simp only [V, div_eq_mul_inv]
    rw [hmul]
    ring_nf
  have hsplit :
      (fun m : ℕ =>
        (∑' k : ℕ, (f k - B) / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹)) / (m : ℝ))
        =ᶠ[Filter.atTop] fun m => Wf m - V m := by
    refine Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ?_
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    intro m hm
    have hmpos : 0 < m := Nat.succ_le_iff.mp hm
    have hVm := congrFun hVeq m
    calc
      (∑' k : ℕ, (f k - B) / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹)) / (m : ℝ)
          = (((∑' k : ℕ, f k / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹))
              - ∑' k : ℕ, B / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹)) / (m : ℝ)) := by
                rw [htsum m hmpos]
      _ = ((∑' k : ℕ, f k / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹)) / (m : ℝ))
            - ((∑' k : ℕ, B / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹)) / (m : ℝ)) := by
              ring
      _ = Wf m - ((∑' k : ℕ, B / (k : ℝ) ^ (1 + (m : ℝ)⁻¹)) / (m : ℝ)) := by
            rfl
      _ = Wf m - V m := by rw [hVm]
  exact (hWf.sub hV).congr' hsplit.symm

name: wiener_ikehara_lower_bound_lseries_nonneg
statement:
theorem wiener_ikehara_lower_bound_lseries_nonneg {f : ℕ → ℝ} {a : ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ} :
    0 < a.re →
    (∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) →
    (∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s) →
    ContinuousOn g {s : ℂ | 1 ≤ s.re} →
    Set.EqOn g
      (fun s : ℂ => LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s - a / (s - 1))
      {s : ℂ | 1 < s.re} →
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, X₀ ≤ X →
      c * X ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range X, f n
proof:
:= by
  intro ha hnonneg hsumm hcont heq
  obtain ⟨c, hc, x0, hx0⟩ :=
    liminf_logRescalePartialSum_pos_of_LSeries_pole ha hnonneg hsumm hcont heq
  refine ⟨c / 2, by linarith, Nat.ceil (Real.exp x0) + 2, ?_⟩
  intro X hX
  have hX1 : 1 < X := by
    have : 2 ≤ X := by omega
    omega
  have hXge : 1 ≤ X := by omega
  have hX' : Nat.ceil (Real.exp x0) + 1 ≤ X - 1 := by
    omega
  have hXm1pos_nat : 0 < X - 1 := by omega
  have hXm1pos : 0 < ((X - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hXm1pos_nat
  have hXm1one : 1 ≤ ((X - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt hXm1pos_nat
  have hX'r : ((Nat.ceil (Real.exp x0) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((X - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hX'
  have hx_le_log : x0 ≤ Real.log ((X - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hXm1pos]
    have hceil : Real.exp x0 ≤ Nat.ceil (Real.exp x0) := Nat.le_ceil _
    have hceil' : (Nat.ceil (Real.exp x0) : ℝ) ≤ ((Nat.ceil (Real.exp x0) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.le_succ (Nat.ceil (Real.exp x0)))
    exact hceil.trans (hceil'.trans hX'r)
  have hc_log : c ≤ logRescalePartialSum f (Real.log ((X - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := hx0 _ hx_le_log
  have hsum_Icc : c * ((X - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (X - 1), f n := by
    have hnonneglog : 0 ≤ Real.log ((X - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact Real.log_nonneg hXm1one
    rw [logRescalePartialSum, if_pos hnonneglog] at hc_log
    rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log hXm1pos, Nat.floor_natCast] at hc_log
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc_log hXm1pos.le
    simpa [hXm1pos.ne', mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, inv_mul_cancel₀] using hmul
  have hsum_range : c * ((X - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range X, f n := by
    rw [Nat.range_eq_Icc_zero_sub_one X (by omega)]
    have hsplit : Finset.Icc 0 (X - 1) = insert 0 (Finset.Icc 1 (X - 1)) := by
      simpa using (Finset.insert_Icc_add_one_left_eq_Icc (a := 0) (b := X - 1) (by omega)).symm
    rw [hsplit, Finset.sum_insert]
    · have hf0 : 0 ≤ f 0 := hnonneg 0
      linarith
    · simp
  have hlin : c / 2 * (X : ℝ) ≤ c * ((X - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have h2X : (2 : ℝ) ≤ X := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 2 ≤ X)
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hXge]
    nlinarith [hc, h2X]
  exact le_trans hlin hsum_range

name: primesCongOneMod3_residueClass_partial_sum_range_lower_bound
statement:
theorem primesCongOneMod3_residueClass_partial_sum_range_lower_bound: ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, X₀ ≤ X →
    c * X ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range X, primesCongOneMod3_residueClass n
proof:
:= by
  have htotient : (Nat.totient 3 : ℕ) = 2 := by
    decide
  have ha : 0 < (((Nat.totient 3 : ℂ)⁻¹).re) := by
    rw [htotient]
    norm_num
  have hS : ∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun n ↦ (primesCongOneMod3_residueClass n : ℂ)) s := by
    intro s hs
    exact LSeriesSummable_of_abscissaOfAbsConv_lt_re <| by
      simpa [primesCongOneMod3_residueClass] using
        (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt.abscissaOfAbsConv_residueClass_le_one (a := (1 : ZMod 3))).trans_lt (mod_cast hs)
  exact wiener_ikehara_lower_bound_lseries_nonneg
    ha
    (fun n ↦ by
      simpa [primesCongOneMod3_residueClass] using
        (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt.residueClass_nonneg (a := (1 : ZMod 3)) n))
    hS
    primesCongOneMod3_residueClassAux_continuous
    primesCongOneMod3_residueClassAux_eq_LSeries_sub_pole

name: primesCongOneMod3_partial_sum_range_lower_bound
statement:
theorem primesCongOneMod3_partial_sum_range_lower_bound: ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, X₀ ≤ X →
    c * X ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range X, (if n.Prime ∧ n % 3 = 1 then Real.log (n : ℝ) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit (X : ℕ) :
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range X, (if n.Prime ∧ n % 3 = 1 then Real.log (n : ℝ) else 0) =
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range X, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt.residueClass (1 : ZMod 3) n) -
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.range X,
            (if n.Prime then 0 else ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt.residueClass (1 : ZMod 3) n) := by
    trans
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range X,
        (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt.residueClass (1 : ZMod 3) n -
          (if n.Prime then 0 else ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt.residueClass (1 : ZMod 3) n))
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
      intro n hn
      by_cases hp : n.Prime
      · by_cases hmod : n % 3 = 1
        · have hz : (n : ZMod 3) = (1 : ZMod 3) :=
              (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff' n 1 3).2 hmod
          simp [ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt.residueClass, hp, hz, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_apply_prime hp, hmod]
        · have hz : ¬((n : ZMod 3) = (1 : ZMod 3)) := by
              intro hz
              exact hmod ((ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff' n 1 3).1 hz)
          have hres : ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt.residueClass (1 : ZMod 3) n = 0 := by
            simp [ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt.residueClass, hz]
          simp [hp, hmod, hres]
      · simp [ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt.residueClass, hp]
    · rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rcases primesCongOneMod3_residueClass_partial_sum_range_lower_bound with ⟨c, hc, X₀, hX₀⟩
  rcases primesCongOneMod3_residueClass_nonprime_partial_sum_sublinear (c / 2) (by positivity) with ⟨Y₀, hY₀⟩
  refine ⟨c / 2, by positivity, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨max X₀ Y₀, ?_⟩
  intro X hX
  have hfull :
      c * X ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range X, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt.residueClass (1 : ZMod 3) n := by
    simpa [primesCongOneMod3_residueClass] using hX₀ X (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hX)
  have herr :
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range X,
        (if n.Prime then 0 else ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt.residueClass (1 : ZMod 3) n) ≤
          (c / 2) * X := by
    simpa [primesCongOneMod3_residueClass] using hY₀ X (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hX)
  rw [hsplit X]
  linarith

name: primesCongOneMod3_count_power_lower_bound
statement:
theorem primesCongOneMod3_count_power_lower_bound: ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, X₀ ≤ X →
    (X : ℝ) ^ δ ≤ (Nat.count (fun n => n.Prime ∧ n % 3 = 1) X : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let P : ℕ → Prop := fun n => n.Prime ∧ n % 3 = 1
  let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => if P n then Real.log (n : ℝ) else 0
  obtain ⟨c, hc, X₀, hX₀⟩ := primesCongOneMod3_partial_sum_range_lower_bound
  have hsum_le :
      ∀ X : ℕ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range X, a n ≤ (Nat.count P X : ℝ) * Real.log (max 2 X : ℝ) := by
    intro X
    have hrewrite :
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range X, a n = ∑ n ∈ (Finset.range X).filter P, Real.log (n : ℝ) := by
      simp [a, P, Finset.sum_filter]
    rw [hrewrite]
    calc
      ∑ n ∈ (Finset.range X).filter P, Real.log (n : ℝ)
          ≤ ∑ n ∈ (Finset.range X).filter P, Real.log (max 2 X : ℝ) := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
            intro n hn
            rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hn with ⟨hnrange, hPn⟩
            have hnlt : n < X := Finset.mem_range.mp hnrange
            have hpos : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by
              exact_mod_cast hPn.1.pos
            have hnle : (n : ℝ) ≤ (max 2 X : ℝ) := by
              exact_mod_cast le_trans (Nat.le_of_lt hnlt) (le_max_right 2 X)
            exact Real.log_le_log hpos hnle
      _ = (((Finset.range X).filter P).card : ℝ) * Real.log (max 2 X : ℝ) := by
          simp
      _ = (Nat.count P X : ℝ) * Real.log (max 2 X : ℝ) := by
          simp [Nat.count_eq_card_filter_range]
  have hlogsqrt : ∀ X : ℕ, Real.log (X : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt X := by
    intro X
    have h := Real.log_natCast_le_rpow_div X (ε := (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (by norm_num)
    simpa [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using h
  have hcount_sqrt :
      ∀ X : ℕ, max X₀ 2 ≤ X → (c / 2) * Real.sqrt X ≤ (Nat.count P X : ℝ) := by
    intro X hX
    have hX₀le : X₀ ≤ X := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hX
    have hX2 : 2 ≤ X := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hX
    have hX2r : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (X : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hX2
    have hmain : c * (X : ℝ) ≤ (Nat.count P X : ℝ) * Real.log (X : ℝ) := by
      have hmain0 : c * (X : ℝ) ≤ (Nat.count P X : ℝ) * Real.log (max 2 X : ℝ) :=
        (hX₀ X hX₀le).trans (hsum_le X)
      simpa [max_eq_right hX2r] using hmain0
    have hmain' : c * (X : ℝ) ≤ (Nat.count P X : ℝ) * (2 * Real.sqrt X) := by
      exact hmain.trans <| by
        gcongr
        exact hlogsqrt X
    have hdenpos : 0 < 2 * Real.sqrt X := by
      have hsqrtpos : 0 < Real.sqrt X := by
        apply Real.sqrt_pos.2
        exact_mod_cast lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℕ) < 2) hX2
      positivity
    have hdiv : c * (X : ℝ) / (2 * Real.sqrt X) ≤ (Nat.count P X : ℝ) := by
      exact (div_le_iff₀ hdenpos).2 (by simpa [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using hmain')
    have hsim : c * (X : ℝ) / (2 * Real.sqrt X) = (c / 2) * Real.sqrt X := by
      have hXnonneg : 0 ≤ (X : ℝ) := by positivity
      have hXpos : 0 < (X : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℕ) < 2) hX2
      field_simp [Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.2 hXpos, two_ne_zero]
      ring_nf
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt hXnonneg]
    rwa [hsim] at hdiv
  have hc2 : 0 < c / 2 := by positivity
  have ht_cast : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have ht_quarter : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
    exact (tendsto_rpow_atTop (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < (1 : ℝ) / 4)).comp ht_cast
  have ht_const : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (c / 2) * (n : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
    exact Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop hc2 ht_quarter
  have hlarge : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, 1 ≤ (c / 2) * (n : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4) := by
    exact ht_const.eventually_ge_atTop 1
  rw [Filter.eventually_atTop] at hlarge
  rcases hlarge with ⟨X₁, hXlarge⟩
  refine ⟨(1 : ℝ) / 4, by norm_num, max (max X₀ 2) X₁, ?_⟩
  intro X hX
  have hXge : max X₀ 2 ≤ X := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hX
  have hX1 : X₁ ≤ X := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hX
  have hX2 : 2 ≤ X := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hXge
  have hcount := hcount_sqrt X hXge
  have hconst : 1 ≤ (c / 2) * (X : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4) := hXlarge X hX1
  have hXpos : 0 < (X : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℕ) < 2) hX2
  have hpow : (X : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4) ≤ (c / 2) * Real.sqrt X := by
    calc
      (X : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4) = 1 * (X : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4) := by ring
      _ ≤ ((c / 2) * (X : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4)) * (X : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4) := by
        gcongr
      _ = (c / 2) * ((X : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4) * (X : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4)) := by ring
      _ = (c / 2) * (X : ℝ) ^ (((1 : ℝ) / 4) + ((1 : ℝ) / 4)) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hXpos]
      _ = (c / 2) * (X : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) := by norm_num
      _ = (c / 2) * Real.sqrt X := by rw [← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  exact hpow.trans hcount

name: primesCongOneMod3_dyadic_count_lower_bound
statement:
theorem primesCongOneMod3_dyadic_count_lower_bound: ∃ B : ℕ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ K₀ : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, K₀ ≤ k →
    2 ^ k ≤ Nat.count (fun n => n.Prime ∧ n % 3 = 1) (2 ^ (B * k))
proof:
:= by
  rcases primesCongOneMod3_count_power_lower_bound with ⟨δ, hδpos, X₀, hX⟩
  let B : ℕ := Nat.ceil (1 / δ)
  have hBpos : 0 < B := by
    have hpos : 0 < 1 / δ := by positivity
    exact Nat.ceil_pos.mpr hpos
  have hBδ : 1 ≤ (B : ℝ) * δ := by
    have hceil : 1 / δ ≤ (B : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil (1 / δ)
    have hmul : (1 / δ) * δ ≤ (B : ℝ) * δ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hceil (le_of_lt hδpos)
    have hδne : δ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hδpos
    simpa [B, one_div, hδne, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hmul
  refine ⟨B, hBpos, Nat.clog 2 X₀, ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  have hclog : X₀ ≤ 2 ^ Nat.clog 2 X₀ := Nat.le_pow_clog (by decide : 1 < 2) X₀
  have hk' : Nat.clog 2 X₀ ≤ B * k := by
    have h1 : k ≤ B * k := by
      calc
        k = 1 * k := by rw [one_mul]
        _ ≤ B * k := Nat.mul_le_mul_right k (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hBpos)
    exact le_trans hk h1
  have hX0le : X₀ ≤ 2 ^ (B * k) := by
    exact le_trans hclog (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by decide : 1 ≤ 2) hk')
  have hcount : (((2 ^ (B * k) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ δ) ≤
      (Nat.count (fun n => n.Prime ∧ n % 3 = 1) (2 ^ (B * k)) : ℝ) := by
    exact hX (2 ^ (B * k)) hX0le
  have hbase : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt (pow_pos (by decide : 0 < 2) k)
  have hpowmono : ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ ((B : ℝ) * δ) := by
    exact (Real.monotone_rpow_of_base_ge_one hbase) hBδ
  have hcount' : ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ ((B : ℝ) * δ) ≤
      (Nat.count (fun n => n.Prime ∧ n % 3 = 1) (2 ^ (B * k)) : ℝ) := by
    calc
      ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ ((B : ℝ) * δ)
          = ((((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ B) : ℝ) ^ δ := by
              rw [Real.rpow_natCast_mul (by positivity)]
      _ = ((((2 ^ k : ℕ) ^ B : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ δ := by
            rw [← Nat.cast_pow]
      _ = (((2 ^ (k * B) : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ δ := by
            rw [← pow_mul]
      _ = (((2 ^ (B * k) : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ δ := by rw [Nat.mul_comm]
      _ ≤ (Nat.count (fun n => n.Prime ∧ n % 3 = 1) (2 ^ (B * k)) : ℝ) := hcount
  have hfinal_real : ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      (Nat.count (fun n => n.Prime ∧ n % 3 = 1) (2 ^ (B * k)) : ℝ) := by
    calc
      ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) = ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) := by rw [Real.rpow_one]
      _ ≤ ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ ((B : ℝ) * δ) := hpowmono
      _ ≤ (Nat.count (fun n => n.Prime ∧ n % 3 = 1) (2 ^ (B * k)) : ℝ) := hcount'
  exact_mod_cast hfinal_real

name: primesCongOneMod3_nth_poly_bound
statement: theorem primesCongOneMod3_nth_poly_bound: ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∀ i : ℕ, (primesCongOneMod3 i : ℝ) ≤ (max 2 i : ℝ) ^ A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hBpos, K₀, hcount⟩ := primesCongOneMod3_dyadic_count_lower_bound
  let A : ℕ := B * (K₀ + 2)
  refine ⟨(A : ℝ), ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp [A]
    positivity
  · intro i
    let m : ℕ := max 2 i
    let l : ℕ := Nat.log 2 m
    let k : ℕ := max K₀ l.succ
    have hm_ge_two : 2 ≤ m := by
      dsimp [m]
      exact le_max_left 2 i
    have hi_le_m : i ≤ m := by
      dsimp [m]
      exact le_max_right 2 i
    have hm_ne_zero : m ≠ 0 := by
      omega
    have hk_ge_K₀ : K₀ ≤ k := by
      dsimp [k]
      exact le_max_left K₀ l.succ
    have hk_ge_lsucc : l.succ ≤ k := by
      dsimp [k]
      exact le_max_right K₀ l.succ
    have hi_lt_two_pow_lsucc : i < 2 ^ l.succ := by
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hi_le_m (Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by decide) m)
    have hi_lt_two_pow_k : i < 2 ^ k := by
      have hmono := pow_right_monotone (show (1 : ℕ) ≤ 2 by decide)
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hi_lt_two_pow_lsucc (hmono hk_ge_lsucc)
    have hi_lt_count : i < Nat.count (fun n => n.Prime ∧ n % 3 = 1) (2 ^ (B * k)) := by
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hi_lt_two_pow_k (hcount k hk_ge_K₀)
    have hnth_lt : primesCongOneMod3 i < 2 ^ (B * k) := by
      simpa [primesCongOneMod3] using
        (Nat.nth_lt_of_lt_count (p := fun n => n.Prime ∧ n % 3 = 1) hi_lt_count)
    have hk_le : k ≤ K₀ + l.succ := by
      have h1 : K₀ ≤ K₀ + l.succ := by omega
      have h2 : l.succ ≤ K₀ + l.succ := by omega
      exact max_le h1 h2
    have hpow_log_le : 2 ^ l ≤ m := by
      exact Nat.pow_le_of_le_log hm_ne_zero le_rfl
    have hsucc_le : 2 ^ l.succ ≤ m ^ 2 := by
      calc
        2 ^ l.succ = 2 ^ l * 2 := by rw [pow_succ]
        _ ≤ m * 2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right 2 hpow_log_le
        _ ≤ m * m := Nat.mul_le_mul_left m hm_ge_two
        _ = m ^ 2 := by rw [pow_two]
    have hbase : 2 ^ (K₀ + l.succ) ≤ m ^ (K₀ + 2) := by
      calc
        2 ^ (K₀ + l.succ) = 2 ^ K₀ * 2 ^ l.succ := by rw [pow_add]
        _ ≤ m ^ K₀ * m ^ 2 := by
          gcongr
        _ = m ^ (K₀ + 2) := by rw [← pow_add]
    have hpow_bound_nat : 2 ^ (B * k) ≤ m ^ A := by
      have hmono := pow_right_monotone (show (1 : ℕ) ≤ 2 by decide)
      calc
        2 ^ (B * k) ≤ 2 ^ (B * (K₀ + l.succ)) := by
          exact hmono (Nat.mul_le_mul_left B hk_le)
        _ = (2 ^ (K₀ + l.succ)) ^ B := by rw [Nat.mul_comm, pow_mul]
        _ ≤ (m ^ (K₀ + 2)) ^ B := by
          exact pow_le_pow_left' hbase B
        _ = m ^ ((K₀ + 2) * B) := by rw [← pow_mul]
        _ = m ^ A := by
          dsimp [A]
          rw [Nat.mul_comm]
    have hnat : primesCongOneMod3 i ≤ m ^ A := by
      exact le_trans (Nat.le_of_lt hnth_lt) hpow_bound_nat
    have hreal_nat : (primesCongOneMod3 i : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) ^ A := by
      exact_mod_cast hnat
    have hcast_max : (m : ℝ) = (max 2 i : ℝ) := by
      dsimp [m]
      simpa using (Nat.cast_max (α := ℝ) 2 i)
    have hreal_nat' : (primesCongOneMod3 i : ℝ) ≤ (max 2 i : ℝ) ^ A := by
      simpa [hcast_max] using hreal_nat
    simpa only [Real.rpow_natCast] using hreal_nat'

name: primesCongOneMod3_log_pointwise_bound
statement: theorem primesCongOneMod3_log_pointwise_bound: ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∀ i : ℕ, Real.log (primesCongOneMod3 i : ℝ) ≤ A * Real.log (max 2 i : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases primesCongOneMod3_nth_poly_bound with ⟨A, hApos, hpoly⟩
  refine ⟨A, hApos, ?_⟩
  intro i
  have hpi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < primesCongOneMod3 i := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.Prime.pos (primesCongOneMod3_prime i))
  have hbase_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (max 2 i : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 2) (le_max_left 2 i))
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log hpi_pos (hpoly i)
  simpa [Real.log_rpow, hbase_pos.le] using hlog

name: primesCongOneMod3_log_sum_bound
statement:
theorem primesCongOneMod3_log_sum_bound: ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ ℓ : ℕ, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ℓ, Real.log (primesCongOneMod3 i : ℝ)
        ≤ C * ℓ * Real.log (max 2 ℓ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases primesCongOneMod3_log_pointwise_bound with ⟨A, hApos, hA⟩
  refine ⟨A, hApos, ?_⟩
  intro ℓ
  calc
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ℓ, Real.log (primesCongOneMod3 i : ℝ)
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ℓ, A * Real.log (max 2 i : ℝ) := by
          exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi => hA i)
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ℓ, A * Real.log (max 2 ℓ : ℝ) := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
          intro i hi
          have hiℓ : i ≤ ℓ := Nat.le_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          have hmax : max 2 i ≤ max 2 ℓ := max_le_max le_rfl hiℓ
          have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (max 2 i : ℝ) := by
            have hpos_nat : 0 < max 2 i := lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 2) (le_max_left 2 i)
            exact_mod_cast hpos_nat
          have hlog : Real.log (max 2 i : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (max 2 ℓ : ℝ) := by
            exact Real.log_le_log hpos (by exact_mod_cast hmax)
          nlinarith
    _ = A * ℓ * Real.log (max 2 ℓ : ℝ) := by
          simp [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]

name: closedFrattini_quotient_finite
statement:
theorem closedFrattini_quotient_finite (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
    (hG : ErdosUnitDistance.IsFinitelyGeneratedProPGroup p G) :
    Finite (G ⧸ ErdosUnitDistance.closedFrattini p G)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let N : Subgroup G := ErdosUnitDistance.closedFrattini p G
  haveI : N.Normal := by
    simpa [N] using (ErdosUnitDistance.closedFrattini_normal (G := G) p)
  let π : G →* G ⧸ N := QuotientGroup.mk' N
  obtain ⟨S, hS_top⟩ := hG.1
  let T : Finset (G ⧸ N) := S.image π
  let H : Subgroup (G ⧸ N) := Subgroup.closure (T : Set (G ⧸ N))
  have hH_top : H.topologicalClosure = ⊤ := by
    have htop : ((Subgroup.closure (S : Set G)).map π).topologicalClosure =
        (⊤ : Subgroup (G ⧸ N)) := by
      simpa using
        (DenseRange.topologicalClosure_map_subgroup (f := π)
          continuous_quotient_mk' (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective N).denseRange hS_top :
          ((Subgroup.closure (S : Set G)).map π).topologicalClosure =
            (⊤ : Subgroup (G ⧸ N)))
    rw [MonoidHom.map_closure] at htop
    simpa [H, T, π, Finset.coe_image] using htop
  have hcomm_le : commutator G ≤ N := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ Subgroup.closure ((Set.range (fun g : G => g ^ p)) ∪ (commutator G : Set G)) :=
      Subgroup.subset_closure (Or.inr hx)
    have hx'' : x ∈
        (Subgroup.closure ((Set.range (fun g : G => g ^ p)) ∪ (commutator G : Set G))).topologicalClosure :=
      Subgroup.le_topologicalClosure _ hx'
    simpa [N, ErdosUnitDistance.closedFrattini] using hx''
  letI : IsMulCommutative (G ⧸ N) :=
    ⟨(Subgroup.Normal.quotient_commutative_iff_commutator_le (N := N)).2 hcomm_le⟩
  letI : CommGroup (G ⧸ N) := CommGroup.ofIsMulCommutative
  have hpow_mem : ∀ g : G, g ^ p ∈ N := by
    intro g
    have hg' : g ^ p ∈ Subgroup.closure ((Set.range (fun x : G => x ^ p)) ∪ (commutator G : Set G)) :=
      Subgroup.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨g, rfl⟩)
    have hg'' : g ^ p ∈
        (Subgroup.closure ((Set.range (fun x : G => x ^ p)) ∪ (commutator G : Set G))).topologicalClosure :=
      Subgroup.le_topologicalClosure _ hg'
    simpa [N, ErdosUnitDistance.closedFrattini] using hg''
  have hp : Nat.Prime p := Fact.out
  have hExp : Monoid.ExponentExists (G ⧸ N) := by
    refine ⟨p, hp.pos, ?_⟩
    intro x
    rcases QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective N x with ⟨g, rfl⟩
    change ((g ^ p : G) : G ⧸ N) = 1
    exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff _).2 (hpow_mem g)
  have htor : Monoid.IsTorsion (G ⧸ N) := ExponentExists.isTorsion hExp
  haveI : Group.FG H := by
    simpa [H] using (Group.closure_finset_fg T)
  haveI : Finite H := CommGroup.finite_of_fg_torsion H (IsTorsion.subgroup htor H)
  haveI : IsClosed (N : Set G) := by
    simpa [N, ErdosUnitDistance.closedFrattini] using
      (Subgroup.isClosed_topologicalClosure
        (Subgroup.closure ((Set.range (fun g : G => g ^ p)) ∪ (commutator G : Set G))))
  haveI : T1Space (G ⧸ N) := QuotientGroup.instT1Space
  haveI : T3Space (G ⧸ N) := inferInstance
  haveI : T2Space (G ⧸ N) := inferInstance
  have hHclosed : IsClosed (H : Set (G ⧸ N)) := (Set.toFinite (H : Set (G ⧸ N))).isClosed
  have hH_eq_top : H = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    rw [← hH_top]
    exact Subgroup.topologicalClosure_minimal H le_rfl hHclosed
  have hQfin : Finite (G ⧸ N) :=
    Finite.of_equiv H ((MulEquiv.subgroupCongr hH_eq_top).trans Subgroup.topEquiv)
  simpa [N] using hQfin

name: closedFrattini_isOpen
statement:
theorem closedFrattini_isOpen (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
    (hG : ErdosUnitDistance.IsFinitelyGeneratedProPGroup p G) :
    IsOpen (ErdosUnitDistance.closedFrattini p G : Set G)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H : Subgroup G := ErdosUnitDistance.closedFrattini p G
  have hfin : Finite (G ⧸ H) := closedFrattini_quotient_finite G p hG
  letI : Finite (G ⧸ H) := hfin
  letI : H.FiniteIndex := Subgroup.finiteIndex_of_finite_quotient (H := H)
  have hclosed : IsClosed (H : Set G) := by
    dsimp [H, ErdosUnitDistance.closedFrattini]
    exact Subgroup.isClosed_topologicalClosure _
  exact Subgroup.isOpen_of_isClosed_of_finiteIndex H hclosed

name: exists_injective_fin_away_of_infinite_pred
statement:
theorem exists_injective_fin_away_of_infinite_pred (P : ℕ → Prop) (hP : {n : ℕ | P n}.Infinite) (t : ℕ) (badPrimes : Finset ℕ) :
    ∃ q : Fin t → ℕ,
      Function.Injective q ∧
      (∀ b, P (q b)) ∧
      (∀ b, q b ∉ badPrimes)
proof:
:= by
  let P' : ℕ → Prop := fun n => P n ∧ n ∉ badPrimes
  have hP' : {n : ℕ | P' n}.Infinite := by
    simpa [P', Set.setOf_and] using hP.diff badPrimes.finite_toSet
  refine ⟨fun b => Nat.nth P' b.1, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro b₁ b₂ hq
    apply Fin.ext
    exact Nat.nth_injective hP' hq
  · intro b
    exact (Nat.nth_mem_of_infinite hP' b.1).1
  · intro b
    exact (Nat.nth_mem_of_infinite hP' b.1).2

name: finiteGaloisIntermediateField_contains_two_subfields
statement:
theorem finiteGaloisIntermediateField_contains_two_subfields (K₁ K₂ : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ))
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ K₁] [FiniteDimensional ℚ K₂] :
    ∃ L : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ), K₁ ≤ L ∧ K₂ ≤ L
proof:
:= by
  let E : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) := K₁ ⊔ K₂
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℚ E := by
    change FiniteDimensional ℚ ↥(K₁ ⊔ K₂ : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ))
    infer_instance
  letI : IsAlgClosure ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) := AlgebraicClosure.instIsAlgClosure ℚ
  letI : IsGalois ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) := IsAlgClosure.isGalois ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)
  let L : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) := {
    IntermediateField.normalClosure ℚ E (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) with
    finiteDimensional := normalClosure.is_finiteDimensional ℚ E (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)
    isGalois := IsGalois.normalClosure ℚ E (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)
  }
  refine ⟨L, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact le_trans le_sup_left (IntermediateField.le_normalClosure E)
  · exact le_trans le_sup_right (IntermediateField.le_normalClosure E)

name: galois_primewise_split_of_exists_ef_one
statement:
theorem galois_primewise_split_of_exists_ef_one (L : Type) [Field L] [NumberField L] [Algebra ℚ L]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ L] [IsGalois ℚ L]
    (q : ℕ) (_hq : q.Prime)
    (hex : ∃ 𝔓 ∈ (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 L),
      Ideal.ramificationIdx (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) 𝔓 = 1 ∧
      Ideal.inertiaDeg (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) 𝔓 = 1) :
    ∀ 𝔔 ∈ (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 L),
      Ideal.ramificationIdx (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) 𝔔 = 1 ∧
      Ideal.inertiaDeg (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) 𝔔 = 1
proof:
:= by
  let p : Ideal ℤ := Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)}
  letI : Fact q.Prime := ⟨_hq⟩
  letI : p.IsMaximal := by
    simpa [p] using (Int.ideal_span_isMaximal_of_prime q)
  rcases hex with ⟨𝔓₀, h𝔓₀mem, h𝔓₀e, h𝔓₀f⟩
  intro 𝔔 h𝔔mem
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := Ideal.exists_comap_galRestrict_eq ℤ ℚ L (𝓞 L) (p := p) h𝔓₀mem h𝔔mem
  constructor
  · have hramEq : Ideal.ramificationIdx p 𝔔 = Ideal.ramificationIdx p 𝔓₀ := by
      simpa [hσ] using
        (Ideal.ramificationIdx_comap_eq p (galRestrict ℤ ℚ L (𝓞 L) σ) 𝔓₀)
    exact hramEq.trans h𝔓₀e
  · have hfinEq : Ideal.inertiaDeg p 𝔔 = Ideal.inertiaDeg p 𝔓₀ := by
      simpa [hσ] using
        (Ideal.inertiaDeg_comap_eq p (galRestrict ℤ ℚ L (𝓞 L) σ) 𝔓₀)
    exact hfinEq.trans h𝔓₀f

name: infinite_of_exists_outside_finset
statement:
theorem infinite_of_exists_outside_finset (P : ℕ → Prop)
    (hP : ∀ bad : Finset ℕ, ∃ n : ℕ, P n ∧ n ∉ bad) :
    {n : ℕ | P n}.Infinite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hinf
  have hfin : ({n : ℕ | P n}).Finite := Set.not_infinite.mp hinf
  let bad : Finset ℕ := hfin.toFinset
  rcases hP bad with ⟨n, hnP, hnbad⟩
  have hnmem : n ∈ bad := by
    change n ∈ hfin.toFinset
    exact (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset hfin).2 hnP
  exact hnbad hnmem

name: intPolynomial_exists_prime_dvd_eval_outside
statement:
theorem intPolynomial_exists_prime_dvd_eval_outside (f : Polynomial ℤ) (hf : f.natDegree ≠ 0) (badPrimes : Finset ℕ) :
    ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ q ∉ badPrimes ∧ ∃ n : ℤ, (q : ℤ) ∣ Polynomial.eval n f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hspecial : ∀ {f : Polynomial ℤ}, f.natDegree ≠ 0 → f.eval 0 ≠ 0 →
      ∀ badPrimes : Finset ℕ,
        ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ q ∉ badPrimes ∧ ∃ n : ℤ, (q : ℤ) ∣ Polynomial.eval n f := by
    intro g hg h0 badPrimes
    let a : ℤ := Polynomial.eval 0 g
    let M : ℤ := ∏ p ∈ badPrimes.filter Nat.Prime, (p : ℤ)
    have ha : a ≠ 0 := h0
    have hM : M ≠ 0 := by
      classical
      dsimp [M]
      refine Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr ?_
      intro p hp
      exact_mod_cast (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2.ne_zero
    have hdivX_ne : g.divX ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      apply hg
      rw [Polynomial.natDegree_eq_zero]
      exact ⟨g.coeff 0, (Polynomial.divX_eq_zero_iff.mp hzero).symm⟩
    have hAM_nz : a * M ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero ha hM
    have hcomp_ne : g.divX.comp (Polynomial.C (a * M) * Polynomial.X) ≠ 0 := by
      exact fun h => hdivX_ne ((Polynomial.comp_C_mul_X_eq_zero_iff (by
        simpa [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero] using hAM_nz)).mp h)
    let G : Polynomial ℤ :=
      Polynomial.C 1 + Polynomial.C M * Polynomial.X * (g.divX.comp (Polynomial.C (a * M) * Polynomial.X))
    have hA_ne : Polynomial.C M * Polynomial.X * (g.divX.comp (Polynomial.C (a * M) * Polynomial.X)) ≠ 0 := by
      exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by simpa using hM) Polynomial.X_ne_zero) hcomp_ne
    have hGsub_ne : G - Polynomial.C 1 ≠ 0 := by
      simpa [G, sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using hA_ne
    have hGadd_ne : G + Polynomial.C 1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      have hz := congrArg (Polynomial.eval 0) hzero
      simp [G] at hz
    have hGeval (m : ℤ) :
        Polynomial.eval m G = 1 + M * (m * Polynomial.eval ((a * M) * m) g.divX) := by
      simp [G, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm]
    have hRootsFinite :
        ({x : ℤ | Polynomial.IsRoot (G - Polynomial.C 1) x} ∪
          {x : ℤ | Polynomial.IsRoot (G + Polynomial.C 1) x}).Finite := by
      exact (Polynomial.finite_setOf_isRoot hGsub_ne).union (Polynomial.finite_setOf_isRoot hGadd_ne)
    rcases hRootsFinite.exists_notMem with ⟨m, hm⟩
    have hm1 : ¬ Polynomial.IsRoot (G - Polynomial.C 1) m := by
      exact fun hroot => hm (Or.inl hroot)
    have hm2 : ¬ Polynomial.IsRoot (G + Polynomial.C 1) m := by
      exact fun hroot => hm (Or.inr hroot)
    have hm_ne_one : Polynomial.eval m G ≠ 1 := by
      intro hEq
      apply hm1
      simp [Polynomial.IsRoot, hEq]
    have hm_ne_neg_one : Polynomial.eval m G ≠ -1 := by
      intro hEq
      apply hm2
      simp [Polynomial.IsRoot, hEq]
    have hnatAbs_ne_one : (Polynomial.eval m G).natAbs ≠ 1 := by
      intro hna
      have hu : IsUnit (Polynomial.eval m G) := (Int.isUnit_iff_natAbs_eq).2 hna
      rcases (Int.isUnit_iff.mp hu) with hEq | hEq
      · exact hm_ne_one hEq
      · exact hm_ne_neg_one hEq
    rcases Int.exists_prime_and_dvd hnatAbs_ne_one with ⟨p, hp_prime, hp_dvd⟩
    have hqprime : p.natAbs.Prime := (Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime).mp hp_prime
    have hq_dvd_G : ((p.natAbs : ℤ) ∣ Polynomial.eval m G) := by
      exact (Associated.dvd_iff_dvd_left (Int.associated_natAbs p)).mp hp_dvd
    have hq_not_mem : p.natAbs ∉ badPrimes := by
      intro hp_mem
      have hp_mem' : p.natAbs ∈ badPrimes.filter Nat.Prime := by
        simp [hp_mem, hqprime]
      have hq_dvd_M : ((p.natAbs : ℤ) ∣ M) := by
        change ((p.natAbs : ℤ) ∣ ∏ r ∈ badPrimes.filter Nat.Prime, ((r : ℕ) : ℤ))
        exact Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem (s := badPrimes.filter Nat.Prime) (a := p.natAbs)
          (fun r : ℕ => (r : ℤ)) hp_mem'
      have hq_dvd_term : ((p.natAbs : ℤ) ∣ M * (m * Polynomial.eval ((a * M) * m) g.divX)) := by
        exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left hq_dvd_M (m * Polynomial.eval ((a * M) * m) g.divX)
      have hq_dvd_one : ((p.natAbs : ℤ) ∣ 1) := by
        have hsub : ((p.natAbs : ℤ) ∣ Polynomial.eval m G - M * (m * Polynomial.eval ((a * M) * m) g.divX)) := by
          exact dvd_sub hq_dvd_G hq_dvd_term
        simpa [hGeval, sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm, mul_assoc] using hsub
      have hnat_dvd_one : p.natAbs ∣ (1 : ℕ) := by
        simpa using (Int.natCast_dvd.mp hq_dvd_one)
      exact hqprime.ne_one (Nat.dvd_one.mp hnat_dvd_one)
    have hmain_eval (m : ℤ) : Polynomial.eval ((a * M) * m) g = a * Polynomial.eval m G := by
      have hdecomp0 := congrArg (Polynomial.eval ((a * M) * m)) (Polynomial.X_mul_divX_add g)
      have hdecomp : Polynomial.eval ((a * M) * m) g = ((a * M) * m) * Polynomial.eval ((a * M) * m) g.divX + a := by
        simpa [a, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm,
          Polynomial.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero] using hdecomp0.symm
      calc
        Polynomial.eval ((a * M) * m) g
            = ((a * M) * m) * Polynomial.eval ((a * M) * m) g.divX + a := hdecomp
        _ = a * (1 + M * (m * Polynomial.eval ((a * M) * m) g.divX)) := by ring
        _ = a * Polynomial.eval m G := by rw [hGeval]
    refine ⟨p.natAbs, hqprime, hq_not_mem, (a * M) * m, ?_⟩
    rw [hmain_eval]
    exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right hq_dvd_G a
  have hf_ne_zero : f ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hf
    simp [hzero]
  have hRootsFinite : ({x : ℤ | Polynomial.IsRoot f x}).Finite :=
    Polynomial.finite_setOf_isRoot hf_ne_zero
  rcases hRootsFinite.exists_notMem with ⟨c, hc⟩
  have hc0 : Polynomial.eval c f ≠ 0 := by
    exact fun hroot => hc hroot
  have hshift_lin : (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C c).natDegree ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_X_add_C]
    decide
  have hshift_deg : (f.comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C c)).natDegree ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [Polynomial.natDegree_comp] using And.intro hf hshift_lin
  have hshift0 : Polynomial.eval 0 (f.comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C c)) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [Polynomial.eval_comp, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hc0
  rcases hspecial hshift_deg hshift0 badPrimes with ⟨q, hqprime, hqnotmem, n, hn⟩
  refine ⟨q, hqprime, hqnotmem, n + c, ?_⟩
  simpa [Polynomial.eval_comp, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hn

name: minpoly_discr_ne_zero
statement:
theorem minpoly_discr_ne_zero (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] {θ : NumberField.RingOfIntegers K} :
    Polynomial.discr (minpoly ℤ θ) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : Polynomial ℤ := minpoly ℤ θ
  let φ : ℤ →+* ℚ := Int.castRingHom ℚ
  let fQ : Polynomial ℚ := f.map φ
  have hθintO : IsIntegral ℤ θ := by
    let hAI : Algebra.IsIntegral ℤ (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) := inferInstance
    exact (Algebra.isIntegral_def.mp hAI) θ
  have hθint : IsIntegral ℤ ((θ : K)) := NumberField.RingOfIntegers.isIntegral_coe θ
  have hfQ_eq : fQ = minpoly ℚ ((θ : K)) := by
    dsimp [fQ, f]
    symm
    simpa [NumberField.RingOfIntegers.minpoly_coe θ] using
      (minpoly.isIntegrallyClosed_eq_field_fractions' (R := ℤ) (K := ℚ) (S := K) hθint)
  have hsepQ : fQ.Separable := by
    rw [hfQ_eq]
    exact (show (minpoly ℚ ((θ : K))).Separable from IsSeparable.of_integral ℚ ((θ : K)))
  have hf_monic : f.Monic := by
    dsimp [f]
    exact minpoly.monic hθintO
  have hfQ_monic : fQ.Monic := by
    dsimp [fQ]
    exact hf_monic.map φ
  have hf_deg : 0 < f.degree := by
    dsimp [f]
    simpa using minpoly.degree_pos hθintO
  have hfQ_natDegree : fQ.natDegree = f.natDegree := by
    dsimp [fQ]
    simpa using hf_monic.natDegree_map φ
  have hcopQ : IsCoprime fQ fQ.derivative := (Polynomial.separable_def _).mp hsepQ
  have hresQ0 : fQ.resultant fQ.derivative ≠ 0 :=
    Polynomial.resultant_ne_zero _ _ hcopQ
  have hresQ_eq : fQ.resultant fQ.derivative fQ.natDegree (fQ.natDegree - 1) = fQ.resultant fQ.derivative := by
    let k : ℕ := (fQ.natDegree - 1) - fQ.derivative.natDegree
    have hkdeg : fQ.derivative.natDegree ≤ fQ.natDegree - 1 := Polynomial.natDegree_derivative_le fQ
    have htmp :=
      Polynomial.resultant_add_right_deg (f := fQ) (g := fQ.derivative)
        (m := fQ.natDegree) (n := fQ.derivative.natDegree) k (by exact le_rfl)
    dsimp [k] at htmp
    rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le hkdeg] at htmp
    simpa [hfQ_monic.leadingCoeff] using htmp
  have hresQ : fQ.resultant fQ.derivative fQ.natDegree (fQ.natDegree - 1) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hresQ_eq]
    exact hresQ0
  have hderiv_map : fQ.derivative = f.derivative.map φ := by
    dsimp [fQ]
    simpa using (Polynomial.derivative_map f φ)
  have hres_map :
      fQ.resultant fQ.derivative fQ.natDegree (fQ.natDegree - 1) =
        φ (f.resultant f.derivative f.natDegree (f.natDegree - 1)) := by
    rw [hderiv_map, hfQ_natDegree]
    simpa [fQ] using (Polynomial.resultant_map_map f f.derivative f.natDegree (f.natDegree - 1) φ)
  have hformulaQ :
      fQ.resultant fQ.derivative fQ.natDegree (fQ.natDegree - 1) =
        ((-1 : ℚ) ^ (f.natDegree * (f.natDegree - 1) / 2)) * φ f.discr := by
    rw [hres_map, Polynomial.resultant_deriv (f := f) hf_deg]
    simp [hf_monic.leadingCoeff]
  have hcast_discr_ne_zero : φ f.discr ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hresQ' := hresQ
    rw [hformulaQ, hzero] at hresQ'
    simpa using hresQ'
  intro hzero
  apply hcast_discr_ne_zero
  simpa [hzero]

name: minpoly_mod_separable_of_not_dvd_discr
statement:
theorem minpoly_mod_separable_of_not_dvd_discr (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] {θ : NumberField.RingOfIntegers K}
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (hdisc : ¬ p ∣ (Polynomial.discr (minpoly ℤ θ)).natAbs) :
    (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod p)) (minpoly ℤ θ)).Separable
proof:
:= by
  set φ : ℤ →+* ZMod p := Int.castRingHom (ZMod p)
  set f : Polynomial ℤ := minpoly ℤ θ
  set fbar : Polynomial (ZMod p) := Polynomial.map φ f
  have hf_monic : f.Monic := by
    simpa [f] using minpoly.monic θ.isIntegral
  have hfbar_monic : fbar.Monic := by
    simpa [fbar] using Polynomial.Monic.map φ hf_monic
  have hdegmap : fbar.natDegree = f.natDegree := by
    simpa [fbar] using hf_monic.natDegree_map φ
  have hdisc_zmod_ne : ((Polynomial.discr f : ℤ) : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hdisc
    exact Int.natCast_dvd.mp <| (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd (Polynomial.discr f) p).mp hzero
  have hres0 :
      fbar.resultant fbar.derivative fbar.natDegree (fbar.natDegree - 1) =
        (-1 : ZMod p) ^ (fbar.natDegree * (fbar.natDegree - 1) / 2) *
          ((Polynomial.discr f : ℤ) : ZMod p) := by
    have hres0' := congrArg φ (Polynomial.resultant_deriv (f := f) (by simpa [f] using minpoly.degree_pos θ.isIntegral))
    rw [← Polynomial.resultant_map_map (φ := φ) (f := f) (g := f.derivative)
      (m := f.natDegree) (n := f.natDegree - 1), ← Polynomial.derivative_map] at hres0'
    simpa [fbar, hdegmap, hf_monic.leadingCoeff] using hres0'
  have hres0_ne : fbar.resultant fbar.derivative fbar.natDegree (fbar.natDegree - 1) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hres0]
    exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (by simp)) hdisc_zmod_ne
  have hres_eq :
      fbar.resultant fbar.derivative fbar.natDegree (fbar.natDegree - 1) =
        fbar.resultant fbar.derivative := by
    have h :=
      Polynomial.resultant_add_right_deg (f := fbar) (g := fbar.derivative) (m := fbar.natDegree)
        (n := fbar.derivative.natDegree)
        (k := fbar.natDegree - 1 - fbar.derivative.natDegree) le_rfl
    rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le (Polynomial.natDegree_derivative_le fbar), hfbar_monic.coeff_natDegree,
      one_pow, one_mul] at h
    simpa using h
  have hres_ne : fbar.resultant fbar.derivative ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hres_eq]
    exact hres0_ne
  rw [Polynomial.separable_def]
  exact (Polynomial.isUnit_resultant_iff_isCoprime hfbar_monic).mp (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hres_ne)

name: numberField_exists_integral_primitive_element
statement:
theorem numberField_exists_integral_primitive_element (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] :
    ∃ θ : NumberField.RingOfIntegers K,
      IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ ({(θ : K)} : Set K) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := Field.exists_primitive_element ℚ K
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyα⟩ := exists_integral_multiples ℤ ℚ ({α} : Finset K)
  let θ : NumberField.RingOfIntegers K := ⟨y • α, hyα α (by simp)⟩
  refine ⟨θ, ?_⟩
  set L : IntermediateField ℚ K := IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ ({(θ : K)} : Set K)
  have hy_mem : algebraMap ℚ K (y : ℚ) ∈ L :=
    IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem L (y : ℚ)
  have hy_inv_mem : (algebraMap ℚ K (y : ℚ))⁻¹ ∈ L :=
    IntermediateField.inv_mem L hy_mem
  have hθ_mem : (θ : K) ∈ L := by
    change (θ : K) ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ ({(θ : K)} : Set K)
    exact IntermediateField.subset_adjoin ℚ ({(θ : K)} : Set K) (by simp)
  have hmem : α ∈ L := by
    have hmul_mem : (algebraMap ℚ K (y : ℚ))⁻¹ * (θ : K) ∈ L :=
      IntermediateField.mul_mem L hy_inv_mem hθ_mem
    have hEq : (algebraMap ℚ K (y : ℚ))⁻¹ * (θ : K) = α := by
      change (algebraMap ℚ K (y : ℚ))⁻¹ * (y • α) = α
      simp [smul_eq_mul, hy, mul_assoc]
    exact hEq ▸ hmul_mem
  have hle := (IntermediateField.adjoin_simple_le_iff (F := ℚ) (α := α) (K := L)).2 hmem
  have htop_le : (⊤ : IntermediateField ℚ K) ≤ L := by
    simpa [hα] using hle
  have hL_top : L = ⊤ := le_antisymm le_top htop_le
  simpa [L] using hL_top

name: prime_above_ef_one_of_not_dvd_exponent_discr_and_eval
statement:
theorem prime_above_ef_one_of_not_dvd_exponent_discr_and_eval (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] {θ : NumberField.RingOfIntegers K}
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (hexp : ¬ p ∣ RingOfIntegers.exponent θ)
    (hdisc : ¬ p ∣ (Polynomial.discr (minpoly ℤ θ)).natAbs)
    {n : ℤ} (hn : (p : ℤ) ∣ Polynomial.eval n (minpoly ℤ θ)) :
    ∃ 𝔓 ∈ (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 K),
      Ideal.ramificationIdx (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) 𝔓 = 1 ∧
      Ideal.inertiaDeg (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) 𝔓 = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : Polynomial ℤ := minpoly ℤ θ
  let fbar : Polynomial (ZMod p) := Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod p)) f
  let a : ZMod p := n
  have hfbar_ne : fbar ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [fbar, f]
    exact Polynomial.map_monic_ne_zero (minpoly.monic θ.isIntegral)
  have hroot_eval : Polynomial.eval a fbar = 0 := by
    dsimp [fbar, a, f]
    rw [Polynomial.eval_intCast_map]
    exact (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd (Polynomial.eval n (minpoly ℤ θ)) p).2 hn
  have hisroot : Polynomial.IsRoot fbar a := hroot_eval
  have hdvd : Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a ∣ fbar := by
    exact (Polynomial.dvd_iff_isRoot).2 hisroot
  have hmem : Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a ∈ RingOfIntegers.monicFactorsMod θ p := by
    rw [RingOfIntegers.monicFactorsMod, Multiset.mem_toFinset]
    exact (Polynomial.mem_normalizedFactors_iff hfbar_ne).2
      ⟨Polynomial.irreducible_X_sub_C a, Polynomial.monic_X_sub_C a, hdvd⟩
  let Q : RingOfIntegers.monicFactorsMod θ p := ⟨Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a, hmem⟩
  let P : (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 K) :=
    (NumberField.Ideal.primesOverSpanEquivMonicFactorsMod (θ := θ) (p := p) hexp).symm Q
  refine ⟨P, P.2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hsep : fbar.Separable := by
      simpa [fbar, f] using minpoly_mod_separable_of_not_dvd_discr K p hdisc
    have hpos : 0 < Polynomial.rootMultiplicity a fbar :=
      (Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_pos hfbar_ne).2 hisroot
    have hle : Polynomial.rootMultiplicity a fbar ≤ 1 :=
      Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_le_one_of_separable hsep a
    have hrootmult : Polynomial.rootMultiplicity a fbar = 1 := by
      omega
    have hmult : multiplicity (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) fbar = 1 := by
      rw [← hrootmult]
      rw [Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_eq_multiplicity fbar a]
      simp [hfbar_ne]
    simpa [P, Q, fbar] using
      (NumberField.Ideal.ramificationIdx_primesOverSpanEquivMonicFactorsMod_symm_apply'
        (θ := θ) (p := p) hexp hmem).trans hmult
  · simpa [P, Q] using
      (NumberField.Ideal.inertiaDeg_primesOverSpanEquivMonicFactorsMod_symm_apply'
        (θ := θ) (p := p) hexp hmem).trans (Polynomial.natDegree_X_sub_C a)

name: primewise_split_descends_of_tower
statement:
theorem primewise_split_descends_of_tower (K L : Type) [Field K] [Field L] [NumberField K] [NumberField L]
    [Algebra ℚ K] [Algebra ℚ L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower ℚ K L]
    (q : ℕ) (_hq : q.Prime)
    (hL :
      ∀ 𝔓 ∈ (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 L),
        Ideal.ramificationIdx (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) 𝔓 = 1 ∧
        Ideal.inertiaDeg (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) 𝔓 = 1) :
    ∀ 𝔭 ∈ (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 K),
      Ideal.ramificationIdx (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) 𝔭 = 1 ∧
      Ideal.inertiaDeg (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) 𝔭 = 1
proof:
:= by
  intro 𝔭 h𝔭
  let p : Ideal ℤ := Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)}
  letI : Fact q.Prime := ⟨_hq⟩
  letI : p.IsMaximal := by
    dsimp [p]
    simpa using (Int.ideal_span_isMaximal_of_prime q)
  let pK : p.primesOver (𝓞 K) := ⟨𝔭, by simpa [p] using h𝔭⟩
  letI : 𝔭.IsPrime := Ideal.primesOver.isPrime p pK
  letI : 𝔭.LiesOver p := Ideal.primesOver.liesOver p pK
  letI : 𝔭.IsMaximal := Ideal.isMaximal_of_mem_primesOver (by simpa [p] using h𝔭)
  obtain ⟨Psub⟩ := Ideal.nonempty_primesOver (R := 𝓞 K) (S := 𝓞 L) 𝔭
  let 𝔓 : Ideal (𝓞 L) := Psub
  letI : 𝔓.IsPrime := Ideal.primesOver.isPrime 𝔭 Psub
  letI : 𝔓.LiesOver 𝔭 := Ideal.primesOver.liesOver 𝔭 Psub
  letI : 𝔓.LiesOver p := Ideal.LiesOver.trans 𝔓 𝔭 p
  have h𝔓 : 𝔓 ∈ p.primesOver (𝓞 L) := by
    exact (Ideal.primesOver.mk p 𝔓).2
  rcases hL 𝔓 (by simpa [p] using h𝔓) with ⟨he𝔓, hf𝔓⟩
  have hp_ne_bot : p ≠ ⊥ := by
    dsimp [p]
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]
    exact_mod_cast _hq.ne_zero
  have h𝔭_ne_bot : 𝔭 ≠ ⊥ := Ideal.ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot hp_ne_bot 𝔭
  have hmap_𝔭_ne_bot : Ideal.map (algebraMap (𝓞 K) (𝓞 L)) 𝔭 ≠ ⊥ :=
    Ideal.map_ne_bot_of_ne_bot h𝔭_ne_bot
  have hmap_p_ne_bot : Ideal.map (algebraMap ℤ (𝓞 L)) p ≠ ⊥ :=
    Ideal.map_ne_bot_of_ne_bot hp_ne_bot
  have hmap_𝔭_le : Ideal.map (algebraMap (𝓞 K) (𝓞 L)) 𝔭 ≤ 𝔓 := by
    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    exact le_of_eq (by simpa [Ideal.under_def] using (Ideal.over_def (A := 𝓞 K) (P := 𝔓) (p := 𝔭)))
  have hram_tower :=
    Ideal.ramificationIdx_algebra_tower (R := ℤ) (S := 𝓞 K) (T := 𝓞 L)
      (p := p) (P := 𝔭) (Q := 𝔓) hmap_𝔭_ne_bot hmap_p_ne_bot hmap_𝔭_le
  have hmul_e : Ideal.ramificationIdx p 𝔭 * Ideal.ramificationIdx 𝔭 𝔓 = 1 := by
    calc
      Ideal.ramificationIdx p 𝔭 * Ideal.ramificationIdx 𝔭 𝔓
          = Ideal.ramificationIdx p 𝔓 := by simpa [p] using hram_tower.symm
      _ = 1 := by simpa [p] using he𝔓
  have he𝔭 : Ideal.ramificationIdx p 𝔭 = 1 := (mul_eq_one.mp hmul_e).1
  have hmul_f : Ideal.inertiaDeg p 𝔭 * Ideal.inertiaDeg 𝔭 𝔓 = 1 := by
    calc
      Ideal.inertiaDeg p 𝔭 * Ideal.inertiaDeg 𝔭 𝔓
          = Ideal.inertiaDeg p 𝔓 := by
              simpa [p] using (Ideal.inertiaDeg_algebra_tower (R := ℤ) (S := 𝓞 K) (T := 𝓞 L) p 𝔭 𝔓).symm
      _ = 1 := by simpa [p] using hf𝔓
  have hf𝔭 : Ideal.inertiaDeg p 𝔭 = 1 := (mul_eq_one.mp hmul_f).1
  exact ⟨by simpa [p] using he𝔭, by simpa [p] using hf𝔭⟩

name: primewise_split_in_cyclotomic4_implies_mod4
statement:
theorem primewise_split_in_cyclotomic4_implies_mod4 (C : Type) [Field C] [NumberField C] [Algebra ℚ C] [IsCyclotomicExtension {4} ℚ C]
    (q : ℕ) (_hq : q.Prime)
    (hC :
      ∀ 𝔓 ∈ (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 C),
        Ideal.ramificationIdx (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) 𝔓 = 1 ∧
        Ideal.inertiaDeg (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) 𝔓 = 1) :
    q % 4 = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let alg : Algebra ℚ C := inferInstance
  have hCyclo_old : @IsCyclotomicExtension ({4} : Set ℕ) ℚ C _ _ alg := inferInstance
  letI : Algebra ℚ C := DivisionRing.toRatAlgebra
  have hAlg : alg = (inferInstance : Algebra ℚ C) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hCyclo : IsCyclotomicExtension ({4} : Set ℕ) ℚ C := by
    have hCyclo_old' := hCyclo_old
    rw [hAlg] at hCyclo_old'
    exact hCyclo_old'
  letI : IsCyclotomicExtension ({4} : Set ℕ) ℚ C := hCyclo
  letI : Fact q.Prime := ⟨_hq⟩
  letI : (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).IsMaximal := Int.ideal_span_isMaximal_of_prime q
  obtain ⟨⟨𝔓, h𝔓prime, h𝔓over⟩⟩ := (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).nonempty_primesOver (S := 𝓞 C)
  letI : 𝔓.IsPrime := h𝔓prime
  letI : 𝔓.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) := h𝔓over
  rcases hC 𝔓 ⟨h𝔓prime, h𝔓over⟩ with ⟨hRam, hIner⟩
  by_cases hq2 : q = 2
  · subst hq2
    letI : IsCyclotomicExtension ({2 ^ (1 + 1)} : Set ℕ) ℚ C := by
      simpa using (inferInstance : IsCyclotomicExtension ({4} : Set ℕ) ℚ C)
    have hramP : Ideal.ramificationIdx (Ideal.span {(2 : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) 𝔓 = 2 := by
      simpa using
        (IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.ramificationIdx_eq_of_prime_pow (p := 2) (k := 1)
          (K := C) (P := 𝔓))
    have : (1 : ℕ) = 2 := by
      calc
        1 = Ideal.ramificationIdx (Ideal.span {(2 : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) 𝔓 := hRam.symm
        _ = 2 := hramP
    omega
  · have hq4 : ¬ q ∣ 4 := by
      intro hdiv
      have hdiv' : q ∣ 2 ^ 2 := by simpa using hdiv
      have hdiv2 : q ∣ 2 := _hq.dvd_of_dvd_pow hdiv'
      have hqle : q ≤ 2 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hdiv2
      have hqge : 2 ≤ q := _hq.two_le
      omega
    have horder : orderOf (q : ZMod 4) = 1 := by
      have hcalc : Ideal.inertiaDeg (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) 𝔓 = orderOf (q : ZMod 4) := by
        simpa using
          (IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.inertiaDeg_eq_of_not_dvd (p := q) (m := 4)
            (K := C) (P := 𝔓) hq4)
      calc
        orderOf (q : ZMod 4) = Ideal.inertiaDeg (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) 𝔓 := hcalc.symm
        _ = 1 := hIner
    have hz : (q : ZMod 4) = 1 := (orderOf_eq_one_iff.mp horder)
    simpa [ZMod.val_natCast] using congrArg ZMod.val hz

name: primewise_split_transport_of_algEquiv
statement:
theorem primewise_split_transport_of_algEquiv (K L : Type) [Field K] [Field L] [NumberField K] [NumberField L]
    [Algebra ℚ K] [Algebra ℚ L]
    (e : K ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (q : ℕ) (_hq : q.Prime)
    (hL :
      ∀ 𝔓 ∈ (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 L),
        Ideal.ramificationIdx (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) 𝔓 = 1 ∧
