name: bk_BKContsHom_cycle_source
statement:
theorem bk_BKContsHom_cycle_source (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]
    (f : BKContsHomSubmodule p G N) :
    ∃ c : (BKHomogeneousComplex p G N).X 1,
      ((BKHomogeneousComplex p G N).d 1 2).hom c = 0 ∧
      (let c' : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) := c.1
       ∀ x y : ↥N,
         c' x y =
           (f.1) ⟨(x : G)⁻¹ * y, by
             simpa using N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem x.2) y.2⟩)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let rep := Action.trivial ↥N (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))
  let φ : C(↥N, ZMod p) := ⟨f.1, f.2.2.2⟩
  let c0 : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) :=
    (((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d (ZMod p) ↥N 1).app rep).hom φ)
  let d2c0 : C(↥N, C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p))) :=
    (((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d (ZMod p) ↥N 2).app rep).hom c0)
  have hc0_eval : ∀ x y : ↥N, c0 x y = f.1 y - f.1 x := by
    intro x y
    dsimp [c0, φ, ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d, ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.functor,
      ContinuousCohomology.const, ContinuousCohomology.I, ContinuousCohomology.Iobj,
      CategoryTheory.Functor.whiskerLeft, CategoryTheory.Functor.whiskerRight]
    rfl
  have hpt (a b d : ↥N) : d2c0 a b d = 0 := by
    have h := CategoryTheory.NatTrans.congr_app
      (ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d_comp_d (R := ZMod p) (G := ↥N) 1) rep
    have h' := congrArg (fun m => ((((m.hom φ : C(↥N, C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)))) a) b) d)) h
    exact h'
  refine ⟨⟨c0, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro g
    change ((ContinuousCohomology.Iobj (ContinuousCohomology.Iobj rep)).ρ g).hom c0 = c0
    apply ContinuousMap.ext
    intro x
    apply ContinuousMap.ext
    intro y
    rw [ContinuousCohomology.Iobj_ρ_apply, ContinuousCohomology.Iobj_ρ_apply]
    change (c0 (g⁻¹ * x)) (g⁻¹ * y) = (c0 x) y
    rw [hc0_eval, hc0_eval]
    have hgy : f.1 (g⁻¹ * y) = f.1 (g⁻¹) + f.1 y := by
      simpa [rep] using f.2.1 g⁻¹ y
    have hgx : f.1 (g⁻¹ * x) = f.1 (g⁻¹) + f.1 x := by
      simpa [rep] using f.2.1 g⁻¹ x
    rw [hgy, hgx]
    ring
  · apply Subtype.ext
    apply ContinuousMap.ext
    intro a
    apply ContinuousMap.ext
    intro b
    apply ContinuousMap.ext
    intro d
    change d2c0 a b d = 0
    exact hpt a b d
  · change ∀ x y : ↥N, c0 x y =
        f.1 ⟨(x : G)⁻¹ * y, by simpa using N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem x.2) y.2⟩
    intro x y
    rw [hc0_eval]
    have hxy : f.1 y = f.1 x + f.1 ⟨(x : G)⁻¹ * y, by simpa using N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem x.2) y.2⟩ := by
      have hm : x * ⟨(x : G)⁻¹ * y, by simpa using N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem x.2) y.2⟩ = y := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        simp [mul_assoc]
      simpa [hm] using f.2.1 x ⟨(x : G)⁻¹ * y, by simpa using N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem x.2) y.2⟩
    have hxy' := congrArg (fun z => z - f.1 x) hxy
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using hxy'

name: bk_cycles1_cochain_injective
statement:
theorem bk_cycles1_cochain_injective (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] :
    Function.Injective (bk_cycles1_cochain p G N)
proof:
:= by
  intro z z' h
  let K := BKHomogeneousComplex p G N
  let fM : (CategoryTheory.forget₂ (TopModuleCat (ZMod p)) (ModuleCat (ZMod p))).obj (K.cycles 1) ⟶
      (CategoryTheory.forget₂ (TopModuleCat (ZMod p)) (ModuleCat (ZMod p))).obj (K.X 1) :=
    (CategoryTheory.forget₂ (TopModuleCat (ZMod p)) (ModuleCat (ZMod p))).map (K.iCycles 1)
  have hf : Function.Injective fM := by
    exact (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective fM).1 inferInstance
  apply hf
  apply Subtype.ext
  simpa [fM, K, bk_cycles1_cochain] using h

name: bk_BKContsHom_to_cycles1
statement:
theorem bk_BKContsHom_to_cycles1 (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] :
    ∃ invFun : BKContsHomSubmodule p G N →ₗ[ZMod p] (BKHomogeneousComplex p G N).cycles 1,
      ∀ (f : BKContsHomSubmodule p G N) (x y : ↥N),
        bk_cycles1_cochain p G N (invFun f) x y =
          (f.1) ⟨(x : G)⁻¹ * y, by
            simpa using N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem x.2) y.2⟩
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K := BKHomogeneousComplex p G N
  let chooseC : BKContsHomSubmodule p G N → K.X 1 :=
    fun f => Classical.choose (bk_BKContsHom_cycle_source p G N f)
  let chooseHzero : ∀ f : BKContsHomSubmodule p G N, ((K.d 1 2).hom (chooseC f)) = 0 :=
    fun f => (Classical.choose_spec (bk_BKContsHom_cycle_source p G N f)).1
  let S := K.sc' 0 1 2
  have hi : (ComplexShape.up ℕ).prev 1 = 0 := by
    simpa using CochainComplex.prev_nat_succ 0
  have hk : (ComplexShape.up ℕ).next 1 = 2 := by
    simpa using CochainComplex.next ℕ 1
  let kf : CategoryTheory.Limits.KernelFork S.g :=
    CategoryTheory.Limits.KernelFork.ofι (TopModuleCat.kerι (K.d 1 2))
      (TopModuleCat.kerι_comp (K.d 1 2))
  let iso1 : kf.pt ≅ S.cycles :=
    S.isoCyclesOfIsLimit (kf := kf) (TopModuleCat.isLimitKer (K.d 1 2))
  let iso2 : K.cycles 1 ≅ S.cycles :=
    K.cyclesIsoSc' 0 1 2 hi hk
  let φ := CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp iso1.hom iso2.inv
  have hassoc :
      CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp iso1.hom iso2.inv)
        (K.iCycles 1) =
      CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp iso1.hom
        (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp iso2.inv (K.iCycles 1)) := by
    simpa using
      (CategoryTheory.Category.assoc' (f := K.iCycles 1) (g := iso2.inv) (h := iso1.hom)).symm
  have hφi : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp φ (K.iCycles 1) = TopModuleCat.kerι (K.d 1 2) := by
    dsimp [φ]
    rw [hassoc]
    rw [HomologicalComplex.cyclesIsoSc'_inv_iCycles]
    simpa [kf, iso1, S] using
      (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.isoCyclesOfIsLimit_hom_iCycles
        (S := S) (kf := kf) (hkf := TopModuleCat.isLimitKer (K.d 1 2)))
  let invFunToFun : BKContsHomSubmodule p G N → K.cycles 1 :=
    fun f => φ.hom ⟨chooseC f, chooseHzero f⟩
  have hιelem : ∀ f : BKContsHomSubmodule p G N,
      ((K.iCycles 1).hom (invFunToFun f)) = chooseC f := by
    intro f
    let zker : kf.pt := ⟨chooseC f, chooseHzero f⟩
    have h := congrArg (fun η => η.hom zker) hφi
    simpa [invFunToFun, zker, TopModuleCat.kerι] using h
  have h_invFun :
      ∀ (f : BKContsHomSubmodule p G N) (x y : ↥N),
        bk_cycles1_cochain p G N (invFunToFun f) x y =
          (f.1) ⟨(x : G)⁻¹ * y, by
            simpa using N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem x.2) y.2⟩ := by
    intro f x y
    have hchoose := (Classical.choose_spec (bk_BKContsHom_cycle_source p G N f)).2
    dsimp [chooseC] at hchoose
    rw [bk_cycles1_cochain, hιelem f]
    exact hchoose x y
  let invFun : BKContsHomSubmodule p G N →ₗ[ZMod p] K.cycles 1 :=
    { toFun := invFunToFun
      map_add' := by
        intro f g
        apply bk_cycles1_cochain_injective p G N
        ext x y
        calc
          bk_cycles1_cochain p G N (invFunToFun (f + g)) x y
              = ((f + g).1) ⟨(x : G)⁻¹ * y, by
                  simpa using N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem x.2) y.2⟩ :=
                h_invFun (f + g) x y
          _ = (f.1) ⟨(x : G)⁻¹ * y, by
                simpa using N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem x.2) y.2⟩ +
              (g.1) ⟨(x : G)⁻¹ * y, by
                simpa using N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem x.2) y.2⟩ := rfl
          _ = bk_cycles1_cochain p G N (invFunToFun f) x y +
              bk_cycles1_cochain p G N (invFunToFun g) x y := by
                rw [h_invFun f x y, h_invFun g x y]
          _ = bk_cycles1_cochain p G N (invFunToFun f + invFunToFun g) x y := by
                unfold bk_cycles1_cochain
                rw [map_add]
                rfl
      map_smul' := by
        intro c f
        apply bk_cycles1_cochain_injective p G N
        ext x y
        calc
          bk_cycles1_cochain p G N (invFunToFun (c • f)) x y
              = ((c • f).1) ⟨(x : G)⁻¹ * y, by
                  simpa using N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem x.2) y.2⟩ :=
                h_invFun (c • f) x y
          _ = c • (f.1) ⟨(x : G)⁻¹ * y, by
                simpa using N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem x.2) y.2⟩ := rfl
          _ = c • bk_cycles1_cochain p G N (invFunToFun f) x y := by
                rw [h_invFun f x y]
          _ = bk_cycles1_cochain p G N (c • invFunToFun f) x y := by
                unfold bk_cycles1_cochain
                rw [map_smul]
                rfl }
  refine ⟨invFun, ?_⟩
  intro f x y
  exact h_invFun f x y

name: bk_cycles1_eval_add
statement:

name: bk_cycles1_eval_smul
statement:
theorem bk_cycles1_eval_smul (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]

name: bk_cycles1_reconstruct
statement:
theorem bk_cycles1_reconstruct (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]
    (z : (BKHomogeneousComplex p G N).cycles 1) (x y : ↥N) :
    bk_cycles1_cochain p G N z x y =
      bk_cycles1_cochain p G N z 1
        ⟨(x : G)⁻¹ * y, by
          simpa using N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem x.2) y.2⟩
proof:
:= by
  let c := bk_cycles1_cochain p G N z
  have hz := (((BKHomogeneousComplex p G N).iCycles 1).hom z).2 x
  have hz' := congrArg (fun f : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) => f x y) hz
  change
    ((((ContinuousCohomology.Iobj
        (ContinuousCohomology.Iobj
          (Action.trivial ↥N (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))))).ρ x).hom c) x) y = c x y at hz'
  rw [ContinuousCohomology.Iobj_ρ_apply, ContinuousCohomology.Iobj_ρ_apply] at hz'
  simpa [Action.trivial] using hz'.symm

name: bk_cycles1_eval_mem_BKContsHom
statement:
theorem bk_cycles1_eval_mem_BKContsHom (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]
    (z : (BKHomogeneousComplex p G N).cycles 1) :
    bk_cycles1_eval p G N z ∈ BKContsHomSubmodule p G N
proof:
:= by
  let K := BKHomogeneousComplex p G N
  let rep := Action.trivial ↥N (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))
  let cz : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) := bk_cycles1_cochain p G N z
  have hhom : ∀ x y : ↥N, bk_cycles1_eval p G N z (x * y) = bk_cycles1_eval p G N z x + bk_cycles1_eval p G N z y := by
    intro x y
    let w : C(↥N, C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p))) := ((K.d 1 2).hom ((K.iCycles 1).hom z)).1
    have hz := congrArg (fun f => f.hom z) (K.iCycles_d 1 2)
    change (K.d 1 2).hom ((K.iCycles 1).hom z) = 0 at hz
    have hw : w = 0 := by
      simpa [w] using congrArg (fun t => (t.1 : C(↥N, C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p))))) hz
    have hw1 : w 1 = 0 := by
      exact congrArg (fun f : C(↥N, C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p))) => f 1) hw
    have hw2 : w 1 x = 0 := by
      exact congrArg (fun f : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) => f x) hw1
    have hw3 : w 1 x (x * y) = 0 := by
      exact congrArg (fun f : C(↥N, ZMod p) => f (x * y)) hw2
    let t1 : C(↥N, C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p))) :=
      (((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.functor (ZMod p) ↥N 2).whiskerLeft
        (ContinuousCohomology.const (ZMod p) ↥N)).app rep).hom cz
    let t2 : C(↥N, C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p))) :=
      ((CategoryTheory.Functor.whiskerRight (ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d (ZMod p) ↥N 1)
        (ContinuousCohomology.I (ZMod p) ↥N)).app rep).hom cz
    have hw_split : w 1 x (x * y) = t1 1 x (x * y) - t2 1 x (x * y) := by
      dsimp [w, t1, t2, K, rep, cz, BKHomogeneousComplex, bk_cycles1_cochain,
        ContinuousCohomology.homogeneousCochains, ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.complex,
        CochainComplex.of, ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d_succ]
      rfl
    have h1 : t1 1 x (x * y) = bk_cycles1_cochain p G N z x (x * y) := by
      rfl
    have h2 : t2 1 x (x * y) =
        bk_cycles1_cochain p G N z 1 (x * y) - bk_cycles1_cochain p G N z 1 x := by
      dsimp [t2, cz, rep, bk_cycles1_cochain, ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d_succ,
        ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d_zero]
      rfl
    have hzero :
        bk_cycles1_cochain p G N z x (x * y) -
          (bk_cycles1_cochain p G N z 1 (x * y) - bk_cycles1_cochain p G N z 1 x) = 0 := by
      rw [hw_split, h1, h2] at hw3
      exact hw3
    have hrec : bk_cycles1_cochain p G N z x (x * y) = bk_cycles1_cochain p G N z 1 y := by
      simpa [mul_assoc] using bk_cycles1_reconstruct p G N z x (x * y)
    have hsum :
        bk_cycles1_cochain p G N z 1 x + bk_cycles1_cochain p G N z 1 y -
          bk_cycles1_cochain p G N z 1 (x * y) = 0 := by
      simpa [hrec, sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using hzero
    rw [sub_eq_zero] at hsum
    simpa [bk_cycles1_eval, add_comm] using hsum.symm
  refine ⟨hhom, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h11 := hhom 1 1
    have h11' : bk_cycles1_eval p G N z 1 + bk_cycles1_eval p G N z 1 = bk_cycles1_eval p G N z 1 + 0 := by
      simpa using h11.symm
    exact add_left_cancel h11'
  · change Continuous (fun y => bk_cycles1_cochain p G N z 1 y)
    exact (bk_cycles1_cochain p G N z 1).continuous

name: bk_eval_zero_of_normal_generators
statement:
theorem bk_eval_zero_of_normal_generators (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    {k : ℕ} (g : Fin k → G)
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]
    (_hN : N = (Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g)).topologicalClosure)
    (χ : BKGInvariantHom p G N)
    (hχ_zero : ∀ i : Fin k,
      ∃ (hmem : (g i : G) ∈ N),
        χ.hom ⟨g i, hmem⟩ = 1) :
    ∀ x : ↥N, χ.hom x = 1
proof:
:= by
  set K : Subgroup ↥N := χ.hom.ker with hK_def
  set K' : Subgroup G := K.map N.subtype with hK'_def
  have hK'_iff : ∀ x : G, x ∈ K' ↔
      ∃ (hmem : x ∈ N), χ.hom ⟨x, hmem⟩ = 1 := by
    intro x
    simp only [hK'_def, hK_def, Subgroup.mem_map, MonoidHom.mem_ker, Subgroup.coe_subtype]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨y.2, hy⟩
    · rintro ⟨hmem, hχ⟩
      exact ⟨⟨x, hmem⟩, hχ, rfl⟩
  have hK'_normal : K'.Normal := by
    refine ⟨fun n hn h => ?_⟩
    rcases (hK'_iff n).mp hn with ⟨hn_mem, hχn⟩
    refine (hK'_iff _).mpr ?_
    refine ⟨‹N.Normal›.conj_mem n hn_mem h, ?_⟩
    rw [χ.ginv h ⟨n, hn_mem⟩]
    exact hχn
  have h_gen_le : Set.range g ⊆ (K' : Set G) := by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rcases hχ_zero i with ⟨hmem, hχ⟩
    exact (hK'_iff (g i)).mpr ⟨hmem, hχ⟩
  have h_normalClosure_le : Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g) ≤ K' :=
    Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal h_gen_le
  have hN_closed : IsClosed (N : Set G) := by
    rw [_hN]
    exact Subgroup.isClosed_topologicalClosure _
  have hK_closed : IsClosed (K : Set ↥N) := by
    have : (K : Set ↥N) = χ.hom ⁻¹' {1} := rfl
    rw [this]
    exact (isClosed_singleton).preimage χ.continuous
  have hN_closedMap : IsClosedMap ((↑) : ↥N → G) :=
    hN_closed.isClosedMap_subtype_val
  have hK'_closed : IsClosed (K' : Set G) := by
    have h_eq : (K' : Set G) = ((↑) : ↥N → G) '' (K : Set ↥N) := by
      simp [hK'_def, Subgroup.coe_map]
    rw [h_eq]
    exact hN_closedMap _ hK_closed
  have h_topClosure_le : (Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g)).topologicalClosure ≤ K' :=
    Subgroup.topologicalClosure_minimal _ h_normalClosure_le hK'_closed
  have hN_le_K' : N ≤ K' := by
    rw [_hN]
    exact h_topClosure_le
  intro x
  have hxG : (x : G) ∈ K' := hN_le_K' x.2
  rcases (hK'_iff (x : G)).mp hxG with ⟨_, hχ⟩
  exact hχ

name: bk_evalLinearMap_injective_of_normal_generators
statement:
theorem bk_evalLinearMap_injective_of_normal_generators (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    {k : ℕ} (g : Fin k → G)
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]
    (_hN : N = (Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g)).topologicalClosure) :
    ∃ eval : BKGInvariantContsHomSubmodule p G N →ₗ[ZMod p] (Fin k → ZMod p),
      Function.Injective eval
proof:
:= by
  have hg_mem : ∀ i : Fin k, (g i : G) ∈ N := by
    intro i
    rw [_hN]
    have hmem_nc : (g i : G) ∈ Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g) :=
      Subgroup.subset_normalClosure (show (g i : G) ∈ Set.range g from ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    exact (Subgroup.le_topologicalClosure (Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g))) hmem_nc
  let eval : BKGInvariantContsHomSubmodule p G N →ₗ[ZMod p] (Fin k → ZMod p) :=
    { toFun := fun f i => (f : ↥N → ZMod p) ⟨g i, hg_mem i⟩
      map_add' := by
        intro f f'
        ext i
        rfl
      map_smul' := by
        intro c f
        ext i
        rfl }
  refine ⟨eval, ?_⟩
  intro f f' hff'
  rcases f.2 with ⟨hf_hom, hf_one, hf_c, hf_g⟩
  rcases f'.2 with ⟨hf'_hom, hf'_one, hf'_c, hf'_g⟩
  let d : ↥N → ZMod p := fun x => (f : ↥N → ZMod p) x - (f' : ↥N → ZMod p) x
  have hd_hom : ∀ x y : ↥N, d (x * y) = d x + d y := by
    intro x y
    dsimp [d]
    rw [hf_hom x y, hf'_hom x y]
    ring
  have hd_one : d 1 = 0 := by
    dsimp [d]
    simp [hf_one, hf'_one]
  have hd_c : Continuous d := by
    simpa [d] using hf_c.sub hf'_c
  have hd_g : ∀ (h : G) (x : ↥N),
      d ⟨h * (x : G) * h⁻¹, ‹N.Normal›.conj_mem (x : G) x.2 h⟩ = d x := by
    intro h x
    simpa [d, hf_g h x, hf'_g h x]
  let χ : BKGInvariantHom p G N :=
    { hom :=
        { toFun := fun x => Multiplicative.ofAdd (d x)
          map_one' := by
            simpa using congrArg Multiplicative.ofAdd hd_one
          map_mul' := by
            intro x y
            simpa using congrArg Multiplicative.ofAdd (hd_hom x y) }
      continuous := by
        change Continuous d
        exact hd_c
      ginv := by
        intro h x
        simpa using congrArg Multiplicative.ofAdd (hd_g h x) }
  have hχ_zero : ∀ i : Fin k,
      ∃ hmem : (g i : G) ∈ N,
        χ.hom ⟨g i, hmem⟩ = 1 := by
    intro i
    refine ⟨hg_mem i, ?_⟩
    have hi : d ⟨g i, hg_mem i⟩ = 0 := by
      dsimp [d]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (by
        have hi := congrFun hff' i
        simpa [eval] using hi)
    dsimp [χ]
    change Multiplicative.ofAdd (d ⟨g i, hg_mem i⟩) = Multiplicative.ofAdd 0
    rw [hi]
  have hχ_all : ∀ x : ↥N, χ.hom x = 1 :=
    bk_eval_zero_of_normal_generators p G g N _hN χ hχ_zero
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext x
  have hx := hχ_all x
  dsimp [χ, d] at hx
  change (f : ↥N → ZMod p) x - (f' : ↥N → ZMod p) x = 0 at hx
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hx

name: bk_GInvariantContsHom_finite_and_rank_le
statement:
theorem bk_GInvariantContsHom_finite_and_rank_le (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    {k : ℕ} (g : Fin k → G)
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]
    (_hN : N = (Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g)).topologicalClosure) :
    FiniteDimensional (ZMod p) (BKGInvariantContsHomSubmodule p G N) ∧
      Module.finrank (ZMod p) (BKGInvariantContsHomSubmodule p G N) ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  rcases bk_evalLinearMap_injective_of_normal_generators p G g N _hN with ⟨eval, heval⟩
  constructor
  · exact FiniteDimensional.of_injective eval heval
  · letI := FiniteDimensional.of_injective eval heval
    simpa using (LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective (f := eval) heval)

name: bk_homogeneousComplex_d01_zero
statement:
theorem bk_homogeneousComplex_d01_zero (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) :
    (BKHomogeneousComplex p G N).d 0 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.ext
  ext x
  obtain ⟨x : C(N, ZMod p), hx⟩ := x
  change ∀ g : N,
      (((ContinuousCohomology.Iobj (Action.trivial N (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)))).ρ g).hom x = x) at hx
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro a
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro b
  have hxa_aux : ((Action.trivial N (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))).ρ a).hom (x 1) = x a := by
    have h0 := congr(DFunLike.coe (F := C(N, _)) $(hx a) a)
    have hI := ContinuousCohomology.Iobj_ρ_apply (R := ZMod p) (G := N)
      (rep := Action.trivial N (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))) a x a
    simpa using hI.symm.trans h0
  have hxa_id : ((Action.trivial N (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))).ρ a).hom (x 1) = x 1 := by
    rfl
  have hxa : x a = x 1 := by
    exact hxa_aux.symm.trans hxa_id
  have hxb_aux : ((Action.trivial N (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))).ρ b).hom (x 1) = x b := by
    have h0 := congr(DFunLike.coe (F := C(N, _)) $(hx b) b)
    have hI := ContinuousCohomology.Iobj_ρ_apply (R := ZMod p) (G := N)
      (rep := Action.trivial N (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))) b x b
    simpa using hI.symm.trans h0
  have hxb_id : ((Action.trivial N (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))).ρ b).hom (x 1) = x 1 := by
    rfl
  have hxb : x b = x 1 := by
    exact hxb_aux.symm.trans hxb_id
  unfold BKHomogeneousComplex
  simp only [ContinuousCohomology.homogeneousCochains, ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d_succ,
    ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d_zero, ContinuousCohomology.Iobj_ρ_apply,
    CategoryTheory.Functor.comp_obj, CategoryTheory.Functor.mapHomologicalComplex_obj_d,
    CategoryTheory.Functor.mapHomologicalComplex_obj_X, TopModuleCat.ofHom, TopModuleCat.Hom.hom]
  change x b - x a = 0
  rw [hxb, hxa]
  simp

name: bk_h1Conts_linearEquiv_cycles1
statement:
theorem bk_h1Conts_linearEquiv_cycles1 (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] :
    ∃ e : ErdosUnitDistance.H1ContsTrivial p G N ≃ₗ[ZMod p] (BKHomogeneousComplex p G N).cycles 1,
      ∀ (g : G) (x : ErdosUnitDistance.H1ContsTrivial p G N),
        e ((ErdosUnitDistance.h1ConjMap p G N g).hom x) =
          (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap
            (ContinuousCohomology.cochainsMapTrivial (ZMod p)
              ((MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom)
              (bk_conjNormal_continuous G N g⁻¹)
              (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))) 1).hom (e x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K := BKHomogeneousComplex p G N
  have hd : K.d 0 1 = 0 := by
    simpa [K] using bk_homogeneousComplex_d01_zero p G N
  have hprev : (ComplexShape.up ℕ).prev 1 = 0 := by
    simpa using (CochainComplex.prev_nat_succ 0)
  let e0 : K.cycles 1 ≅ K.homology 1 :=
    HomologicalComplex.isoHomologyπ K 0 1 hprev hd
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [K, ErdosUnitDistance.H1ContsTrivial, e0] using
      (e0.symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toLinearEquiv)
  · intro g x
    let φg : K ⟶ K :=
      ContinuousCohomology.cochainsMapTrivial (ZMod p)
        ((MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom)
        (bk_conjNormal_continuous G N g⁻¹)
        (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))
    let ψg : K.homology 1 ⟶ K.homology 1 :=
      ContinuousCohomology.cohomologyMapTrivial (ZMod p)
        ((MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom)
        (bk_conjNormal_continuous G N g⁻¹)
        (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)) 1
    have hnat0 :
        CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (K.homologyπ 1) ψg =
          CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap φg 1) (K.homologyπ 1) := by
      exact HomologicalComplex.homologyπ_naturality (φ := φg) (i := 1)
    have hnat :
        CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ψg e0.symm.hom =
          CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp e0.symm.hom (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap φg 1) := by
      apply (CategoryTheory.cancel_epi (K.homologyπ 1)).1
      have hcomp := congrArg (fun t => CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp t e0.symm.hom) hnat0
      simpa [e0, CategoryTheory.Category.assoc] using hcomp
    have hnatx := congrArg (fun f => f x) hnat
    exact hnatx

name: bk_iobjMap_trivial_conj_apply
statement:
theorem bk_iobjMap_trivial_conj_apply (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (g : G)
    (M : Type) [AddCommGroup M] [Module (ZMod p) M] [TopologicalSpace M]
    [ContinuousAdd M] [ContinuousSMul (ZMod p) M]
    (d : C(↥N, M)) (x : ↥N) :
    ((ContinuousCohomology.iobjMap (ZMod p)
        ((MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom)
        (bk_conjNormal_continuous G N g⁻¹)
        (Action.trivial ↥N (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) M))).hom.hom d) x =
      d ⟨g⁻¹ * (x : G) * g, by
        simpa using (‹N.Normal›.conj_mem (x : G) x.2 g⁻¹)⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [ContinuousCohomology.iobjMap_hom_hom_apply (R := ZMod p) (G := ↥N) (H := ↥N)
    (f := ((MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom))
    (hf := bk_conjNormal_continuous G N g⁻¹)
    (X := Action.trivial ↥N (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) M))
    (c := d) (x := x)]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  simpa using (MulAut.conjNormal_apply (H := N) g⁻¹ x)

name: bk_cycles1_eval_conj
statement:
theorem bk_cycles1_eval_conj (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]
    (g : G) (z : (BKHomogeneousComplex p G N).cycles 1) (y : ↥N) :
    bk_cycles1_eval p G N
      ((HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap
        (ContinuousCohomology.cochainsMapTrivial (ZMod p)
          ((MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom)
          (bk_conjNormal_continuous G N g⁻¹)
          (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))) 1).hom z) y =
      bk_cycles1_eval p G N z ⟨g⁻¹ * (y : G) * g, by
        simpa using (‹N.Normal›.conj_mem (y : G) y.2 g⁻¹)⟩
proof:
:= by
  let X0 := Action.trivial ↥N (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))
  have h1val (d : C(↥N, ZMod p)) :
      ((ContinuousCohomology.multiIndMap (ZMod p)
          ((MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom)
          (bk_conjNormal_continuous G N g⁻¹)
          1 X0).hom.hom d : C(↥N, ZMod p)) =
        (ContinuousCohomology.iobjMap (ZMod p)
          ((MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom)
          (bk_conjNormal_continuous G N g⁻¹)
          X0).hom.hom d := by
    rfl
  have h1 (d : C(↥N, ZMod p)) (x : ↥N) :
      (show C(↥N, ZMod p) from
        (ContinuousCohomology.multiIndMap (ZMod p)
          ((MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom)
          (bk_conjNormal_continuous G N g⁻¹)
          1 X0).hom.hom d) x =
      d ⟨g⁻¹ * (x : G) * g, by
        simpa using (‹N.Normal›.conj_mem (x : G) x.2 g⁻¹)⟩ := by
    rw [h1val]
    exact bk_iobjMap_trivial_conj_apply p G N g (ZMod p) d x
  have hI (d : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p))) (x : ↥N) :
      let e : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) :=
        ((ContinuousCohomology.I (ZMod p) ↥N).map
          (ContinuousCohomology.iobjMap (ZMod p)
            ((MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom)
            (bk_conjNormal_continuous G N g⁻¹)
            X0)).hom.hom d
      e x =
        (ContinuousCohomology.iobjMap (ZMod p)
            ((MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom)
            (bk_conjNormal_continuous G N g⁻¹)
            X0).hom.hom (d x) := by
    rfl
  have h2val (c : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p))) :
      ((ContinuousCohomology.multiIndMap (ZMod p)
          ((MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom)
          (bk_conjNormal_continuous G N g⁻¹)
          2 X0).hom.hom c : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p))) =
        ((ContinuousCohomology.I (ZMod p) ↥N).map
          (ContinuousCohomology.iobjMap (ZMod p)
            ((MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom)
            (bk_conjNormal_continuous G N g⁻¹)
            X0)).hom.hom
          ((ContinuousCohomology.iobjMap (ZMod p)
            ((MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom)
            (bk_conjNormal_continuous G N g⁻¹)
            (ContinuousCohomology.Iobj X0)).hom.hom c) := by
    rfl
  have h2 (c : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p))) (x y : ↥N) :
      (show C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) from
        (ContinuousCohomology.multiIndMap (ZMod p)
          ((MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom)
          (bk_conjNormal_continuous G N g⁻¹)
          2 X0).hom.hom c) x y =
      c ⟨g⁻¹ * (x : G) * g, by
          simpa using (‹N.Normal›.conj_mem (x : G) x.2 g⁻¹)⟩
        ⟨g⁻¹ * (y : G) * g, by
          simpa using (‹N.Normal›.conj_mem (y : G) y.2 g⁻¹)⟩ := by
    rw [h2val]
    rw [hI]
    have houter :
        ((ContinuousCohomology.iobjMap (ZMod p)
            ((MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom)
            (bk_conjNormal_continuous G N g⁻¹)
            (ContinuousCohomology.Iobj X0)).hom.hom c) x =
          c ⟨g⁻¹ * (x : G) * g, by
            simpa using (‹N.Normal›.conj_mem (x : G) x.2 g⁻¹)⟩ := by
      exact bk_iobjMap_trivial_conj_apply p G N g (C(↥N, ZMod p)) c x
    have houter' :
        ((ContinuousCohomology.iobjMap (ZMod p)
            ((MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom)
            (bk_conjNormal_continuous G N g⁻¹)
            X0).hom.hom
          (((ContinuousCohomology.iobjMap (ZMod p)
              ((MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom)
              (bk_conjNormal_continuous G N g⁻¹)
              (ContinuousCohomology.Iobj X0)).hom.hom c) x)) y =
        ((ContinuousCohomology.iobjMap (ZMod p)
            ((MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom)
            (bk_conjNormal_continuous G N g⁻¹)
            X0).hom.hom
          (c ⟨g⁻¹ * (x : G) * g, by
            simpa using (‹N.Normal›.conj_mem (x : G) x.2 g⁻¹)⟩)) y := by
      exact congrArg (fun d : C(↥N, ZMod p) =>
        ((ContinuousCohomology.iobjMap (ZMod p)
            ((MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom)
            (bk_conjNormal_continuous G N g⁻¹)
            X0).hom.hom d) y) houter
    exact houter'.trans (h1 (c ⟨g⁻¹ * (x : G) * g, by
          simpa using (‹N.Normal›.conj_mem (x : G) x.2 g⁻¹)⟩) y)
  let φ := ContinuousCohomology.cochainsMapTrivial (ZMod p)
    ((MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom)
    (bk_conjNormal_continuous G N g⁻¹)
    (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))
  let c : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) := (((BKHomogeneousComplex p G N).iCycles 1).hom z).1
  have hcyc : bk_cycles1_cochain p G N ((HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap φ 1).hom z) =
      (((φ.f 1).hom (((BKHomogeneousComplex p G N).iCycles 1).hom z)).1) := by
    exact congrArg (fun w => w.1) (congrArg (fun f => f.hom z) (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap_i φ 1))
  have hφ :
      ((((φ.f 1).hom (((BKHomogeneousComplex p G N).iCycles 1).hom z)).1) :
        C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p))) =
        (ContinuousCohomology.multiIndMap (ZMod p)
          ((MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom)
          (bk_conjNormal_continuous G N g⁻¹)
          2 X0).hom.hom c := by
    rfl
  have hone :
      ⟨g⁻¹ * (((1 : ↥N) : ↥N) : G) * g, by
        simpa using (‹N.Normal›.conj_mem (((1 : ↥N) : ↥N) : G) (1 : ↥N).2 g⁻¹)⟩ = (1 : ↥N) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp
  change bk_cycles1_cochain p G N ((HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap φ 1).hom z) 1 y =
    bk_cycles1_cochain p G N z 1
      ⟨g⁻¹ * (y : G) * g, by
        simpa using (‹N.Normal›.conj_mem (y : G) y.2 g⁻¹)⟩
  rw [hcyc, hφ]
  rw [show bk_cycles1_cochain p G N z = c by rfl]
  have h2' := h2 c 1 y
  rw [hone] at h2'
  simpa using h2'

name: bk_cycles1_linearEquiv_BKContsHom
statement:
theorem bk_cycles1_linearEquiv_BKContsHom (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] :
    ∃ e : (BKHomogeneousComplex p G N).cycles 1 ≃ₗ[ZMod p] BKContsHomSubmodule p G N,
      ∀ (g : G) (z : (BKHomogeneousComplex p G N).cycles 1) (y : ↥N),
        (e ((HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap
          (ContinuousCohomology.cochainsMapTrivial (ZMod p)
            ((MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom)
            (bk_conjNormal_continuous G N g⁻¹)
            (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))) 1).hom z)).1 y =
          (e z).1 ⟨g⁻¹ * (y : G) * g, by
            simpa using (‹N.Normal›.conj_mem (y : G) y.2 g⁻¹)⟩
proof:
:= by
  let toFun : (BKHomogeneousComplex p G N).cycles 1 →ₗ[ZMod p] BKContsHomSubmodule p G N :=
    { toFun := fun z => ⟨bk_cycles1_eval p G N z, bk_cycles1_eval_mem_BKContsHom p G N z⟩
      map_add' := by
        intro z w
        apply Subtype.ext
        ext y
        simpa using bk_cycles1_eval_add p G N z w y
      map_smul' := by
        intro c z
        apply Subtype.ext
        ext y
        simpa using bk_cycles1_eval_smul p G N c z y }
  rcases bk_BKContsHom_to_cycles1 p G N with ⟨invFun, hinv_eval⟩
  have hcomp_left : invFun.comp toFun = LinearMap.id := by
    ext z
    apply bk_cycles1_cochain_injective p G N
    ext x y
    calc
      bk_cycles1_cochain p G N ((invFun.comp toFun) z) x y
          = (toFun z).1 ⟨(x : G)⁻¹ * y, by
              simpa using N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem x.2) y.2⟩ := by
            simpa [LinearMap.comp_apply] using hinv_eval (toFun z) x y
      _ = bk_cycles1_eval p G N z ⟨(x : G)⁻¹ * y, by
            simpa using N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem x.2) y.2⟩ := rfl
      _ = bk_cycles1_cochain p G N z 1
            ⟨(x : G)⁻¹ * y, by
              simpa using N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem x.2) y.2⟩ := rfl
      _ = bk_cycles1_cochain p G N z x y := by
            symm
            exact bk_cycles1_reconstruct p G N z x y
  have hcomp_right : toFun.comp invFun = LinearMap.id := by
    ext f y
    calc
      ((toFun.comp invFun) f).1 y = bk_cycles1_eval p G N (invFun f) y := rfl
      _ = bk_cycles1_cochain p G N (invFun f) 1 y := rfl
      _ = f.1 ⟨((1 : ↥N) : G)⁻¹ * y, by
            simpa using y.2⟩ := by
        simpa using hinv_eval f 1 y
      _ = f.1 y := by
        simp
  refine ⟨LinearEquiv.ofLinear toFun invFun hcomp_right hcomp_left, ?_⟩
  intro g z y
  change bk_cycles1_eval p G N
      ((HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap
        (ContinuousCohomology.cochainsMapTrivial (ZMod p)
          ((MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom)
          (bk_conjNormal_continuous G N g⁻¹)
          (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))) 1).hom z) y =
    bk_cycles1_eval p G N z ⟨g⁻¹ * (y : G) * g, by
      simpa using (‹N.Normal›.conj_mem (y : G) y.2 g⁻¹)⟩
  exact bk_cycles1_eval_conj p G N g z y

name: bk_h1Conts_exists_linearEquiv_ContsHom
statement:
theorem bk_h1Conts_exists_linearEquiv_ContsHom (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] :
    ∃ e : ErdosUnitDistance.H1ContsTrivial p G N ≃ₗ[ZMod p] BKContsHomSubmodule p G N,
      ∀ (g : G) (x : ErdosUnitDistance.H1ContsTrivial p G N) (y : ↥N),
        (e ((ErdosUnitDistance.h1ConjMap p G N g).hom x)).1 y =
          (e x).1 ⟨g⁻¹ * (y : G) * g, by
            simpa using (‹N.Normal›.conj_mem (y : G) y.2 g⁻¹)⟩
proof:
:= by
  rcases bk_h1Conts_linearEquiv_cycles1 p G N with ⟨e1, he1⟩
  rcases bk_cycles1_linearEquiv_BKContsHom p G N with ⟨e2, he2⟩
  refine ⟨e1.trans e2, ?_⟩
  intro g x y
  simp only [LinearEquiv.trans_apply]
  rw [he1 g x]
  exact he2 g (e1 x) y

name: bk_h1Invariant_exists_linearEquiv_GInvariantContsHom
statement:
theorem bk_h1Invariant_exists_linearEquiv_GInvariantContsHom (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] :
    Nonempty (↥(ErdosUnitDistance.h1NormalInvariantSubmodule p G N) ≃ₗ[ZMod p]
      ↥(BKGInvariantContsHomSubmodule p G N))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases bk_h1Conts_exists_linearEquiv_ContsHom p G N with ⟨e, he⟩
  let toBK : ↥(BKGInvariantContsHomSubmodule p G N) → BKContsHomSubmodule p G N :=
    fun f => ⟨f.1, ⟨f.2.1, f.2.2.1, f.2.2.2.1⟩⟩
  refine ⟨
    { toLinearMap :=
        { toFun := fun x => ?_
          map_add' := ?_
          map_smul' := ?_ }
      invFun := fun f => ?_
      left_inv := ?_
      right_inv := ?_ }⟩
  · refine ⟨(e x.1 : BKContsHomSubmodule p G N), ?_⟩
    refine ⟨(e x.1).2.1, (e x.1).2.2.1, (e x.1).2.2.2, ?_⟩
    intro g y
    have hx : (ErdosUnitDistance.h1ConjMap p G N g⁻¹).hom x.1 = x.1 := x.2 g⁻¹
    simpa [hx] using (he g⁻¹ x.1 y).symm
  · intro x y
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext z
    simpa using
      congrArg (fun w : BKContsHomSubmodule p G N => ((w : ↥N → ZMod p) z)) (e.map_add x.1 y.1)
  · intro c x
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext z
    simpa using
      congrArg (fun w : BKContsHomSubmodule p G N => ((w : ↥N → ZMod p) z)) (e.map_smul c x.1)
  · refine ⟨e.symm (toBK f), ?_⟩
    intro g
    apply e.injective
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext y
    calc
      (((e ((ErdosUnitDistance.h1ConjMap p G N g).hom (e.symm (toBK f))) :
          BKContsHomSubmodule p G N) : ↥N → ZMod p) y)
          = (((e (e.symm (toBK f)) : BKContsHomSubmodule p G N) : ↥N → ZMod p)
              ⟨g⁻¹ * (y : G) * g, by
                simpa using (‹N.Normal›.conj_mem (y : G) y.2 g⁻¹)⟩) := by
              exact he g (e.symm (toBK f)) y
      _ = (((e (e.symm (toBK f)) : BKContsHomSubmodule p G N) : ↥N → ZMod p) y) := by
            rw [e.apply_symm_apply]
            simpa [toBK] using f.2.2.2.2 g⁻¹ y
  · intro x
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply e.injective
    rw [e.apply_symm_apply]
  · intro f
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (((e (e.symm (toBK f)) : BKContsHomSubmodule p G N) : ↥N → ZMod p)) = f.1
    rw [e.apply_symm_apply]

name: h1NormalInvariantRank_le_normalGenerators
statement:
theorem h1NormalInvariantRank_le_normalGenerators (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (_hG : ErdosUnitDistance.IsFinitelyGeneratedProPGroup p G)
    {k : ℕ} (g : Fin k → G) :
    haveI : (Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g)).topologicalClosure.Normal
proof:
:=
      Subgroup.is_normal_topologicalClosure (Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g))
    ErdosUnitDistance.H1NormalInvariantFinite p G
        ((Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g)).topologicalClosure) ∧
      ErdosUnitDistance.h1NormalInvariantRank p G
        ((Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g)).topologicalClosure) ≤ k := by
  let N : Subgroup G := ((Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g)).topologicalClosure)
  letI : N.Normal := Subgroup.is_normal_topologicalClosure (Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g))
  rcases bk_h1Invariant_exists_linearEquiv_GInvariantContsHom p G N with ⟨e⟩
  rcases bk_GInvariantContsHom_finite_and_rank_le p G g N rfl with ⟨hfinB, hrankB⟩
  have hfinH : FiniteDimensional (ZMod p) ↥(ErdosUnitDistance.h1NormalInvariantSubmodule p G N) := by
    exact FiniteDimensional.of_injective e.toLinearMap e.injective
  constructor
  · simpa [ErdosUnitDistance.H1NormalInvariantFinite, N] using hfinH
  · letI := hfinH
    letI := hfinB
    simpa [ErdosUnitDistance.h1NormalInvariantRank, N] using (e.finrank_eq.trans_le hrankB)

name: relationRank_le_normalGen
statement:
theorem relationRank_le_normalGen
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type)
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (hG : IsFinitelyGeneratedProPGroup p G)
    (hH2G : H2Finite p G)
    {k : ℕ} (g : Fin k → G) :
    haveI : ((Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g)).topologicalClosure).Normal
proof:
:=
      Subgroup.is_normal_topologicalClosure (Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g))
    H2Finite p (G ⧸ (Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g)).topologicalClosure) ∧
      relationRank p (G ⧸ (Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g)).topologicalClosure)
        ≤ relationRank p G + k := by

  set N : Subgroup G :=
    (Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g)).topologicalClosure with hN_def
  haveI _hN_normal : N.Normal :=
    Subgroup.is_normal_topologicalClosure (Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g))

  have hN_closed : IsClosed (N : Set G) :=
    Subgroup.isClosed_topologicalClosure _

  obtain ⟨hH1Fin, hH1le⟩ :=
    BrumerKoch.h1NormalInvariantRank_le_normalGenerators p G hG g

  haveI : SecondCountableTopology G :=
    hG.secondCountableTopology

  obtain ⟨hH2Q, hrQ⟩ :=
    FiveTerm.relationRankBound_of_five_term p G N hG hH2G hN_closed hH1Fin
  refine ⟨hH2Q, ?_⟩

  exact hrQ.trans (Nat.add_le_add_left hH1le _)

name: conjNormalContinuous
statement: theorem conjNormalContinuous (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (g : G) : Continuous ((MulAut.conjNormal g : ↥N ≃* ↥N) : ↥N → ↥N)
proof:

name: continuousMonoidHom_innerConj_eq_self
statement: theorem continuousMonoidHom_innerConj_eq_self (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (n : G) (hn : n ∈ N) (f : ↥N →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod p)) (x : ↥N) : f ((MulAut.conjNormal n⁻¹) x) = f x
proof:
:= by

  have hconj : (MulAut.conjNormal n⁻¹) x = nN⁻¹ * x * nN := by
    ext
    simp [nN, MulAut.conjNormal_apply, mul_assoc]
  rw [hconj, map_mul, map_mul, map_inv]
  simp [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]

name: h1ConjMap_mul
statement: theorem h1ConjMap_mul (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (g h : G) : h1ConjMap p G N (g * h) = h1ConjMap p G N h ≫ h1ConjMap p G N g
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp :
      ((MulAut.conjNormal h⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom.comp
        (MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom) =
      (MulAut.conjNormal (g * h)⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom := by
    ext x
    simp [MulAut.conjNormal_apply, mul_assoc]
  simpa only [h1ConjMap, hcomp] using
    (ContinuousCohomology.cohomologyMapTrivial_comp
      (R := ZMod p)
      (f := (MulAut.conjNormal g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom)
      (g := (MulAut.conjNormal h⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom)
      (hf := conjNormalContinuous p G N g⁻¹)
      (hg := conjNormalContinuous p G N h⁻¹)
      (X := TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))
      (n := 1))

name: h1ConjMap_one
statement: theorem h1ConjMap_one (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] : h1ConjMap p G N (1 : G) = 𝟙 (H1ContsTrivial p G N)
proof:
:= by

      ((MulAut.conjNormal (1⁻¹ : G) : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom) = MonoidHom.id _ := by
    ext x
    simp [MulAut.conjNormal_apply]
  simpa [hconj] using
    (ContinuousCohomology.cohomologyMapTrivial_id
      (R := ZMod p)
      (G := ↥N)
      (X := TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))
      (n := 1))

name: h1ConjMap_comp_inv
statement: theorem h1ConjMap_comp_inv (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (g : G) : h1ConjMap p G N g ≫ h1ConjMap p G N g⁻¹ = 𝟙 (H1ContsTrivial p G N)

name: h1ConjMap_inv_comp

name: h1ConjCochainsMap_f1_apply
statement: theorem h1ConjCochainsMap_f1_apply (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (n : G) (z : (h1TrivialHomogeneousCochains p G N).X 1) (y : ↥N) : (let u : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) := (((h1ConjCochainsMap p G N n).f 1).hom z).1; let v : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) := z.1; (u 1) y = (v 1) ((MulAut.conjNormal n⁻¹) y))
proof:
:= by
  let f : ↥N →* ↥N := (MulAut.conjNormal n⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N).toMonoidHom
  let hf : Continuous f := by
    simpa [f] using (conjNormalContinuous p G N (n⁻¹))
  dsimp [h1ConjCochainsMap, h1TrivialHomogeneousCochains,
    ContinuousCohomology.cochainsMapTrivial, ContinuousCohomology.cochainsMap]
  change
    (let u : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) :=
        (((ContinuousCohomology.multiIndMap (ZMod p) f hf 2
            (Action.trivial (↥N) (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)))).hom).hom z.1)
      let v : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) := z.1
      (u 1) y = (v 1) (f y))
  rw [ContinuousCohomology.multiIndMap_succ, ContinuousCohomology.multiIndMap_succ,
    ContinuousCohomology.multiIndMap_zero]
  dsimp [ContinuousCohomology.I, ContinuousCohomology.iobjMap, ContinuousMap.precompCLM,
    ContinuousLinearMap.compLeftContinuous, AddMonoidHom.compLeftContinuous]
  change (let v : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) := z.1
    (v (f 1)) (f y) = (v 1) (f y))
  simpa [f, MulAut.conjNormal_apply, MulAut.conjNormal_symm_apply]

name: h1TrivialCyclesEval_injective
statement: theorem h1TrivialCyclesEval_injective (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] : Function.Injective (h1TrivialCyclesEval p G N)
proof:
:= by
  intro x x' h
  let K := h1TrivialHomogeneousCochains p G N
  let Fx := (TopModuleCat.Hom.hom (HomologicalComplex.iCycles K 1)) x
  let Fx' := (TopModuleCat.Hom.hom (HomologicalComplex.iCycles K 1)) x'
  let F : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) := Fx.1
  let F' : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) := Fx'.1
  have hslice : ∀ y : ↥N, F 1 y = F' 1 y := by
    intro y
    have hy := congrArg (fun m : C(↥N, ZMod p) => m y) h
    simpa [h1TrivialCyclesEval, K, Fx, Fx', F, F'] using hy
  have hF : ∀ g y : ↥N, F g y = F 1 (g⁻¹ * y) := by
    intro g y
    have hg := congrArg (fun H : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) => (H 1) (g⁻¹ * y)) (Fx.2 g⁻¹)
    change (((((ContinuousCohomology.Iobj (ContinuousCohomology.Iobj
      (Action.trivial (G := ↥N) (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))))).ρ g⁻¹).hom F) 1)
        (g⁻¹ * y) = (F 1) (g⁻¹ * y)) at hg
    rw [ContinuousCohomology.Iobj_ρ_apply, ContinuousCohomology.Iobj_ρ_apply] at hg
    simpa [mul_assoc] using hg
  have hF' : ∀ g y : ↥N, F' g y = F' 1 (g⁻¹ * y) := by
    intro g y
    have hg := congrArg (fun H : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) => (H 1) (g⁻¹ * y)) (Fx'.2 g⁻¹)
    change (((((ContinuousCohomology.Iobj (ContinuousCohomology.Iobj
      (Action.trivial (G := ↥N) (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))))).ρ g⁻¹).hom F') 1)
        (g⁻¹ * y) = (F' 1) (g⁻¹ * y)) at hg
    rw [ContinuousCohomology.Iobj_ρ_apply, ContinuousCohomology.Iobj_ρ_apply] at hg
    simpa [mul_assoc] using hg
  have hx : (TopModuleCat.Hom.hom (HomologicalComplex.iCycles K 1)) x =
      (TopModuleCat.Hom.hom (HomologicalComplex.iCycles K 1)) x' := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply ContinuousMap.ext
    intro g
    apply ContinuousMap.ext
    intro y
    change F g y = F' g y
    rw [hF g y, hslice (g⁻¹ * y), hF' g y]
  let i := ((forget₂ (TopModuleCat (ZMod p)) (ModuleCat (ZMod p))).map
    (HomologicalComplex.iCycles K 1))
  have hiCycles_inj : Function.Injective i := by
    exact ((ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective i).1 inferInstance)
  have hx' : i x = i x' := by
    simpa [i] using hx
  exact hiCycles_inj hx'

name: h1TrivialCyclesEval_natural
statement: theorem h1TrivialCyclesEval_natural (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (n : G) (x : (h1TrivialHomogeneousCochains p G N).cycles 1) (y : ↥N) : h1TrivialCyclesEval p G N ((HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap (h1ConjCochainsMap p G N n) 1) x) y = h1TrivialCyclesEval p G N x ((MulAut.conjNormal n⁻¹) y)
proof:
:= by
  let K := h1TrivialHomogeneousCochains p G N
  change
    (let F : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) :=
      ((HomologicalComplex.iCycles K 1).hom ((HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap (h1ConjCochainsMap p G N n) 1) x)).1
     ; (F 1) y) =
    (let F : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) :=
      ((HomologicalComplex.iCycles K 1).hom x).1
     ; (F 1) ((MulAut.conjNormal n⁻¹) y))
  have hmap :
      (let F : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) :=
        ((HomologicalComplex.iCycles K 1).hom ((HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap (h1ConjCochainsMap p G N n) 1) x)).1
       ; (F 1) y) =
      (let F : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) :=
        (((h1ConjCochainsMap p G N n).f 1).hom ((HomologicalComplex.iCycles K 1).hom x)).1
       ; (F 1) y) := by
    exact congrArg
      (fun f : K.cycles 1 ⟶ K.X 1 =>
        let F : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) := ((TopModuleCat.Hom.hom f) x).1
        (F 1) y)
      (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap_i (φ := h1ConjCochainsMap p G N n) (i := 1))
  have hright := h1ConjCochainsMap_f1_apply p G N n ((HomologicalComplex.iCycles K 1).hom x) y
  exact hmap.trans hright

name: h1TrivialCyclesLift_apply_eq_eval
statement: theorem h1TrivialCyclesLift_apply_eq_eval (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (x : (h1TrivialHomogeneousCochains p G N).cycles 1) (g y : ↥N) : h1TrivialCyclesLift p G N x g y = h1TrivialCyclesEval p G N x (g⁻¹ * y)
proof:
:= by
  let K := h1TrivialHomogeneousCochains p G N
  let F : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) := h1TrivialCyclesLift p G N x
  have hF := ((HomologicalComplex.iCycles K 1).hom x).2
  have h := congrArg
    (fun H : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) => (H 1) (g⁻¹ * y))
    (hF g⁻¹)
  change
    ((((ContinuousCohomology.Iobj
          (ContinuousCohomology.Iobj
            (Action.trivial (G := ↥N) (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))))).ρ g⁻¹).hom F)
        1)
      (g⁻¹ * y) = (F 1) (g⁻¹ * y) at h
  rw [ContinuousCohomology.Iobj_ρ_apply, ContinuousCohomology.Iobj_ρ_apply] at h
  simpa [h1TrivialCyclesLift, h1TrivialCyclesEval, K, F, mul_assoc] using h

name: h1TrivialHomogeneous_d01_eq_zero
statement: theorem h1TrivialHomogeneous_d01_eq_zero (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] : (h1TrivialHomogeneousCochains p G N).d 0 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  rcases f with ⟨f, hf⟩
  change C(↥N, ZMod p) at f
  change ∀ g : ↥N,
    (((ContinuousCohomology.Iobj (Action.trivial (G := ↥N)
      (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)))).ρ g).hom f = f) at hf
  have hconst : ∀ x : ↥N, f x = f 1 := by
    intro x
    have h := congrArg (fun h : C(↥N, ZMod p) => h 1) (hf x⁻¹)
    change ((TopModuleCat.Hom.hom
      ((ContinuousCohomology.Iobj (Action.trivial (G := ↥N)
        (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)))).ρ x⁻¹)) f) 1 = f 1 at h
    rw [ContinuousCohomology.Iobj_ρ_apply] at h
    simp at h
    simpa using h
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  change ((show C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) from
      (ConcreteCategory.hom
        (((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.complex (ZMod p) ↥N).d 1 2).app
          (Action.trivial (G := ↥N) (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))))) f) = 0)
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro a
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro b
  change (((show C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) from
      (((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d (ZMod p) ↥N 1).app
          (Action.trivial (G := ↥N) (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)))).hom f)) a) b = 0)
  rw [ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d_succ, ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d_zero]
  change f b - f a = 0
  rw [hconst a, hconst b]
  simp

name: h1TrivialMultiInd_d1_apply
statement: theorem h1TrivialMultiInd_d1_apply (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (f : C(↥N, ZMod p)) (a b : ↥N) : (let u : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) := (((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d (ZMod p) ↥N 1).app (Action.trivial (↥N) (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)))).hom f); (u a) b = f b - f a)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp
  rw [ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d_succ, ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d_zero]
  change f b - f a = f b - f a
  rfl

name: h1TrivialMultiInd_d2_apply
statement: theorem h1TrivialMultiInd_d2_apply (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (v : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p))) (a b c : ↥N) : (let u : C(↥N, C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p))) := (((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d (ZMod p) ↥N 2).app (Action.trivial (↥N) (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)))).hom v); ((u a) b) c = v b c - v a c + v a b)
proof:
:= by
  change (((show C(↥N, C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p))) from
      (((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d (ZMod p) ↥N 2).app
          (Action.trivial (G := ↥N) (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)))).hom v)) a) b) c =
    v b c - v a c + v a b
  dsimp
  rw [ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d_succ]
  change v b c - (((show C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) from
      (((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d (ZMod p) ↥N 1).app
          (Action.trivial (G := ↥N) (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)))).hom (v a))) b) c) =
    v b c - v a c + v a b
  rw [h1TrivialMultiInd_d1_apply p G N (v a) b c]
  abel_nf

name: h1TrivialHomogeneous_d12_apply
statement: theorem h1TrivialHomogeneous_d12_apply (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (z : (h1TrivialHomogeneousCochains p G N).X 1) (a b c : ↥N) : (let u : C(↥N, C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p))) := (((h1TrivialHomogeneousCochains p G N).d 1 2).hom z).1; let v : C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) := z.1; ((u a) b) c = v b c - v a c + v a b)
proof:
:= by
  rcases z with ⟨v, hv⟩
  change C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p)) at v
  dsimp
  dsimp [h1TrivialHomogeneousCochains, ContinuousCohomology.homogeneousCochains,
    ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.complex]
  dsimp [ContinuousCohomology.invariants]
  change (((show C(↥N, C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p))) from
      ((((CochainComplex.of (ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.functor (ZMod p) ↥N)
          (ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d (ZMod p) ↥N)
          (ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d_comp_d (ZMod p) ↥N)).d 2 3).app
          (Action.trivial (↥N) (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)))).hom v)) a) b) c =
    (v b) c - (v a) c + (v a) b
  rw [show ((CochainComplex.of (ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.functor (ZMod p) ↥N)
      (ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d (ZMod p) ↥N)
      (ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d_comp_d (ZMod p) ↥N)).d 2 3) =
      ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d (ZMod p) ↥N 2 by
    simpa using
      (CochainComplex.of_d
        (X := ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.functor (ZMod p) ↥N)
        (d := ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d (ZMod p) ↥N)
        (sq := ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d_comp_d (ZMod p) ↥N) 2)]
  simpa using h1TrivialMultiInd_d2_apply p G N v a b c

name: h1TrivialCyclesLift_cocycle
statement: theorem h1TrivialCyclesLift_cocycle (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (x : (h1TrivialHomogeneousCochains p G N).cycles 1) (a b c : ↥N) : h1TrivialCyclesLift p G N x b c - h1TrivialCyclesLift p G N x a c + h1TrivialCyclesLift p G N x a b = 0
proof:
:= by
  let K := h1TrivialHomogeneousCochains p G N
  have hd := congrArg
    (fun f : K.cycles 1 ⟶ K.X 2 =>
      let u : C(↥N, C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p))) := ((TopModuleCat.Hom.hom f) x).1
      ((u a) b) c)
    (HomologicalComplex.iCycles_d (K := K) (i := 1) (j := 2))
  change
    (let u : C(↥N, C(↥N, C(↥N, ZMod p))) :=
      (((h1TrivialHomogeneousCochains p G N).d 1 2).hom
        ((HomologicalComplex.iCycles (h1TrivialHomogeneousCochains p G N) 1).hom x)).1;
      ((u a) b) c) = 0 at hd
  rw [h1TrivialHomogeneous_d12_apply p G N ((HomologicalComplex.iCycles K 1).hom x) a b c] at hd
  simpa [h1TrivialCyclesLift, K] using hd

name: h1TrivialCyclesEval_hom
statement: theorem h1TrivialCyclesEval_hom (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (x : (h1TrivialHomogeneousCochains p G N).cycles 1) : (h1TrivialCyclesEval p G N x) 1 = 0 ∧ ∀ g h : ↥N, h1TrivialCyclesEval p G N x (g * h) = h1TrivialCyclesEval p G N x g + h1TrivialCyclesEval p G N x h
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have h1 := h1TrivialCyclesLift_cocycle p G N x (1 : ↥N) (1 : ↥N) (1 : ↥N)
    simpa [h1TrivialCyclesLift_apply_eq_eval] using h1
  · intro g h
    have hgh :
        (h1TrivialCyclesEval p G N x) h - (h1TrivialCyclesEval p G N x) (g * h) +
            (h1TrivialCyclesEval p G N x) g = 0 := by
      simpa [h1TrivialCyclesLift_apply_eq_eval, mul_assoc] using
        h1TrivialCyclesLift_cocycle p G N x (1 : ↥N) g (g * h)
    have hgh' :
        ((h1TrivialCyclesEval p G N x) h + (h1TrivialCyclesEval p G N x) g) -
            (h1TrivialCyclesEval p G N x) (g * h) = 0 := by
      simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using hgh
    have hgh'' :
        (h1TrivialCyclesEval p G N x) h + (h1TrivialCyclesEval p G N x) g =
            (h1TrivialCyclesEval p G N x) (g * h) := sub_eq_zero.mp hgh'
    simpa [add_comm] using hgh''.symm

name: h1TrivialCyclesEquiv_exists
statement: theorem h1TrivialCyclesEquiv_exists (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] : ∃ e_cycles : (h1TrivialHomogeneousCochains p G N).cycles 1 → (↥N →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod p)), Function.Injective e_cycles ∧ ∀ (n : G) (x : (h1TrivialHomogeneousCochains p G N).cycles 1) (y : ↥N), e_cycles ((HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap (h1ConjCochainsMap p G N n) 1) x) y = e_cycles x ((MulAut.conjNormal n⁻¹) y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e_cycles : (h1TrivialHomogeneousCochains p G N).cycles 1 → (↥N →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod p)) := fun x =>
    { toFun := fun y => Multiplicative.ofAdd (h1TrivialCyclesEval p G N x y)
      map_one' := by
        simpa using (h1TrivialCyclesEval_hom p G N x).1
      map_mul' := by
        intro g h
        simpa using (h1TrivialCyclesEval_hom p G N x).2 g h
      continuous_toFun := (h1TrivialCyclesEval p G N x).continuous_toFun }
  refine ⟨e_cycles, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x x' h
    apply h1TrivialCyclesEval_injective p G N
    ext y
    have hy := congrArg (fun f : ↥N →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod p) => f y) h
    exact congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd hy
  · intro n x y
    change Multiplicative.ofAdd
        (h1TrivialCyclesEval p G N ((HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap (h1ConjCochainsMap p G N n) 1) x) y) =
      Multiplicative.ofAdd (h1TrivialCyclesEval p G N x ((MulAut.conjNormal n⁻¹) y))
    simpa using h1TrivialCyclesEval_natural p G N n x y

name: h1TrivialEquiv_natural
statement: theorem h1TrivialEquiv_natural (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] : ∃ e : H1ContsTrivial p G N → (↥N →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod p)), Function.Injective e ∧ ∀ (n : G) (x : H1ContsTrivial p G N) (y : ↥N), e ((h1ConjMap p G N n).hom x) y = e x ((MulAut.conjNormal n⁻¹) y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K := h1TrivialHomogeneousCochains p G N
  rcases h1TrivialCyclesEquiv_exists p G N with ⟨e_cycles, heinj_cycles, he_cycles⟩
  let e_homology : H1ContsTrivial p G N ≃ K.cycles 1 :=
    (CategoryTheory.Iso.toContinuousLinearEquiv
      ((HomologicalComplex.isoHomologyπ K 0 1 (CochainComplex.prev_nat_succ 0)
        (h1TrivialHomogeneous_d01_eq_zero p G N)).symm)).toLinearEquiv.toEquiv
  refine ⟨fun x => e_cycles (e_homology x), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x x' h
    apply e_homology.injective
    exact heinj_cycles h
  · intro n x y
    have hnat : HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (h1ConjCochainsMap p G N n) 1 ≫
        (HomologicalComplex.isoHomologyπ (h1TrivialHomogeneousCochains p G N) 0 1
          (CochainComplex.prev_nat_succ 0)
          (h1TrivialHomogeneous_d01_eq_zero p G N)).inv =
      (HomologicalComplex.isoHomologyπ (h1TrivialHomogeneousCochains p G N) 0 1
          (CochainComplex.prev_nat_succ 0)
          (h1TrivialHomogeneous_d01_eq_zero p G N)).inv ≫
        HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap (h1ConjCochainsMap p G N n) 1 := by
      simp only [← cancel_epi ((h1TrivialHomogeneousCochains p G N).homologyπ 1),
        HomologicalComplex.homologyπ_naturality_assoc,
        HomologicalComplex.isoHomologyπ_hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id,
        HomologicalComplex.isoHomologyπ_hom_inv_id_assoc]
    have hmap := congrArg (fun f => (TopModuleCat.Hom.hom f) x) hnat
    change e_cycles (e_homology ((h1ConjMap p G N n).hom x)) y = e_cycles (e_homology x) ((MulAut.conjNormal n⁻¹) y)
    rw [show e_homology ((h1ConjMap p G N n).hom x) =
        (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap (h1ConjCochainsMap p G N n) 1).hom (e_homology x) by
      simpa [e_homology, K, h1ConjMap, h1ConjCochainsMap] using hmap]
    exact he_cycles n (e_homology x) y

name: h1ConjMap_eq_id_of_mem
statement: theorem h1ConjMap_eq_id_of_mem (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (n : G) (hn : n ∈ N) : h1ConjMap p G N n = 𝟙 (H1ContsTrivial p G N)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h1TrivialEquiv_natural p G N with ⟨e, heinj, he⟩
  ext x
  apply heinj
  ext y
  rw [he n x y]
  exact continuousMonoidHom_innerConj_eq_self p G N n hn (e x) y

name: N_acts_trivially
statement: theorem N_acts_trivially (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (n : G) (hn : n ∈ N) : h1ConjAction p G N n = LinearEquiv.refl (ZMod p) (H1ContsTrivial p G N)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change h1ConjAction p G N n x = x
  rw [h1ConjAction_apply]
  simpa using
    congrArg
      (fun f : H1ContsTrivial p G N ⟶ H1ContsTrivial p G N => f.hom x)
      (h1ConjMap_eq_id_of_mem p G N n hn)
