name: superquotient_map_has_continuous_section
statement:
theorem superquotient_map_has_continuous_section {G : Type*}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (V : OpenNormalSubgroup G) :
    ∃ s : ContinuousMap (G ⧸ (N ⊔ V.toSubgroup)) (G ⧸ V.toSubgroup),
      ∀ y : G ⧸ (N ⊔ V.toSubgroup),
        QuotientGroup.map V.toSubgroup (N ⊔ V.toSubgroup) (MonoidHom.id G)
          (show V.toSubgroup ≤ N ⊔ V.toSubgroup from le_sup_right) (s y) = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let q : G ⧸ V.toSubgroup →* G ⧸ (N ⊔ V.toSubgroup) :=
    QuotientGroup.map V.toSubgroup (N ⊔ V.toSubgroup) (MonoidHom.id G)
      (show V.toSubgroup ≤ N ⊔ V.toSubgroup from le_sup_right)
  have hopen : IsOpen (((N ⊔ V.toSubgroup : Subgroup G) : Set G)) := by
    exact Subgroup.isOpen_mono (H₁ := V.toSubgroup) (H₂ := N ⊔ V.toSubgroup)
      le_sup_right V.isOpen
  letI : DiscreteTopology (G ⧸ (N ⊔ V.toSubgroup)) :=
    QuotientGroup.discreteTopology (N := N ⊔ V.toSubgroup) hopen
  have hq : Function.Surjective q := by
    intro y
    refine QuotientGroup.induction_on y ?_
    intro g
    refine ⟨QuotientGroup.mk g, ?_⟩
    rfl
  let s0 : G ⧸ (N ⊔ V.toSubgroup) → G ⧸ V.toSubgroup := Function.surjInv hq
  refine ⟨⟨s0, continuous_of_discreteTopology⟩, ?_⟩
  intro y
  exact Function.surjInv_eq hq y

name: quotient_fiber_lift_exists
statement:
theorem quotient_fiber_lift_exists {G : Type*}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] {V W : OpenNormalSubgroup G} (hVW : V ≤ W)
    (x : G ⧸ N) (b : G ⧸ W.toSubgroup)
    (hb : QuotientGroup.map W.toSubgroup (N ⊔ W.toSubgroup) (MonoidHom.id G)
      (show W.toSubgroup ≤ N ⊔ W.toSubgroup from le_sup_right) b =
      QuotientGroup.map N (N ⊔ W.toSubgroup) (MonoidHom.id G)
        (show N ≤ N ⊔ W.toSubgroup from le_sup_left) x) :
    ∃ a : G ⧸ V.toSubgroup,
      QuotientGroup.map V.toSubgroup W.toSubgroup (MonoidHom.id G)
          (show V.toSubgroup ≤ W.toSubgroup from hVW) a = b ∧
        QuotientGroup.map V.toSubgroup (N ⊔ V.toSubgroup) (MonoidHom.id G)
          (show V.toSubgroup ≤ N ⊔ V.toSubgroup from le_sup_right) a =
        QuotientGroup.map N (N ⊔ V.toSubgroup) (MonoidHom.id G)
          (show N ≤ N ⊔ V.toSubgroup from le_sup_left) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  revert b hb
  refine Quotient.inductionOn x ?_
  intro g b hb
  revert hb
  refine Quotient.inductionOn b ?_
  intro h hb
  have h_eq : QuotientGroup.mk' (N ⊔ W.toSubgroup) h = QuotientGroup.mk' (N ⊔ W.toSubgroup) g := by
    simpa [QuotientGroup.map_mk'] using hb
  have hz : ∃ z ∈ N ⊔ W.toSubgroup, g * z = h := by
    exact (QuotientGroup.mk'_eq_mk' (N := N ⊔ W.toSubgroup)).1 h_eq.symm
  rcases hz with ⟨z, hzmem, hz_eq⟩
  rcases (Subgroup.mem_sup_of_normal_left.mp hzmem) with ⟨n, hnN, w, hwW, hnw⟩
  refine ⟨QuotientGroup.mk' V.toSubgroup (g * n), ?_⟩
  constructor
  · rw [QuotientGroup.map_mk']
    apply (QuotientGroup.mk'_eq_mk' (N := W.toSubgroup)).2
    refine ⟨w, hwW, ?_⟩
    calc
      (g * n) * w = g * (n * w) := by simp [mul_assoc]
      _ = g * z := by rw [hnw]
      _ = h := hz_eq
  · simp only [QuotientGroup.map_mk']
    apply (QuotientGroup.mk'_eq_mk' (N := N ⊔ V.toSubgroup)).2
    refine ⟨n⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (show N ≤ N ⊔ V.toSubgroup from le_sup_left)
        (show n⁻¹ ∈ N from N.inv_mem hnN)
    · simp [mul_assoc]

name: quotient_eq_of_all_open_superquotients_eq
statement:
theorem quotient_eq_of_all_open_superquotients_eq {G : Type*}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G)) {g : G} {x : G ⧸ N}
    (h : ∀ V : OpenNormalSubgroup G,
      QuotientGroup.map N (N ⊔ V.toSubgroup) (MonoidHom.id G)
        (show N ≤ N ⊔ V.toSubgroup from le_sup_left) x
      = QuotientGroup.mk' (N ⊔ V.toSubgroup) g) :
    QuotientGroup.mk' N g = x
proof:
:= by
  rcases QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective N x with ⟨a, rfl⟩
  have hN_eq : N = sInf {M : Subgroup G | IsOpen (M : Set G) ∧ N ≤ M} := by
    simpa using
      (ProfiniteGrp.closedSubgroup_eq_sInf_open (G := G) (⟨N, hN⟩ : ClosedSubgroup G))
  have hdiff : a⁻¹ * g ∈ N := by
    rw [hN_eq]
    rw [Subgroup.mem_sInf]
    intro M hM
    obtain ⟨V, hVsub⟩ :=
      ProfiniteGrp.exist_openNormalSubgroup_sub_open_nhds_of_one (G := G) hM.1 M.one_mem
    have hVle : V.toSubgroup ≤ M := by
      intro y hy
      exact hVsub hy
    have hNV : N ⊔ V.toSubgroup ≤ M := sup_le hM.2 hVle
    have hVeq := h V
    rw [QuotientGroup.map_mk', MonoidHom.id_apply, QuotientGroup.mk'_apply,
      QuotientGroup.eq] at hVeq
    exact hNV hVeq
  exact (QuotientGroup.eq).2 (by simpa using N.inv_mem hdiff)

name: compatible_pointwise_lift
statement:
theorem compatible_pointwise_lift {G : Type*}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] {W0 : OpenNormalSubgroup G}
    (y : G ⧸ (N ⊔ W0.toSubgroup))
    (b : ∀ U : OpenNormalSubgroup G, W0 ≤ U → G ⧸ U.toSubgroup)
    (hb_compat : ∀ {U1 U2 : OpenNormalSubgroup G}
      (h01 : W0 ≤ U1) (h02 : W0 ≤ U2) (h12 : U1 ≤ U2),
      QuotientGroup.map U1.toSubgroup U2.toSubgroup (MonoidHom.id G)
        (show U1.toSubgroup ≤ U2.toSubgroup from h12) (b U1 h01) = b U2 h02)
    (hb_fiber : ∀ U (h0U : W0 ≤ U),
      QuotientGroup.map U.toSubgroup (N ⊔ U.toSubgroup) (MonoidHom.id G)
        (show U.toSubgroup ≤ N ⊔ U.toSubgroup from le_sup_right) (b U h0U) =
      QuotientGroup.map (N ⊔ W0.toSubgroup) (N ⊔ U.toSubgroup) (MonoidHom.id G)
        (show N ⊔ W0.toSubgroup ≤ N ⊔ U.toSubgroup from
          sup_le_sup_left (show W0.toSubgroup ≤ U.toSubgroup from h0U) N) y) :
    ∃ a : G ⧸ W0.toSubgroup,
      QuotientGroup.map W0.toSubgroup (N ⊔ W0.toSubgroup) (MonoidHom.id G)
        (show W0.toSubgroup ≤ N ⊔ W0.toSubgroup from le_sup_right) a = y ∧
      ∀ U (h0U : W0 ≤ U),
        QuotientGroup.map W0.toSubgroup U.toSubgroup (MonoidHom.id G)
          (show W0.toSubgroup ≤ U.toSubgroup from h0U) a = b U h0U
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨b W0 le_rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using hb_fiber W0 le_rfl
  · intro U h0U
    simpa using hb_compat (U1 := W0) (U2 := U) le_rfl h0U h0U

name: open_normal_quotient_surj_hom_has_section
statement:
theorem open_normal_quotient_surj_hom_has_section
    {G H : Type} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [Group H] [TopologicalSpace H] [IsTopologicalGroup H]
    (N : Subgroup H) [N.Normal] (hN : IsOpen (N : Set H))
    (f : G →ₜ* H) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    ∃ s : ContinuousMap (H ⧸ N) (G ⧸ N.comap f.toMonoidHom),
      ∀ y : H ⧸ N,
        QuotientGroup.map (N.comap f.toMonoidHom) N f.toMonoidHom (le_rfl) (s y) = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : DiscreteTopology (H ⧸ N) := QuotientGroup.discreteTopology (N := N) hN
  let q : G ⧸ N.comap f.toMonoidHom →* H ⧸ N :=
    QuotientGroup.map (N.comap f.toMonoidHom) N f.toMonoidHom le_rfl
  have hqf : Function.Surjective ((QuotientGroup.mk : H → H ⧸ N) ∘ f) := by
    intro y
    rcases QuotientGroup.mk_surjective y with ⟨h, rfl⟩
    rcases hf h with ⟨g, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨g, rfl⟩
  have hq : Function.Surjective q :=
    QuotientGroup.map_surjective_of_surjective
      (N := N.comap f.toMonoidHom) (M := N) (f := f.toMonoidHom) hqf le_rfl
  refine ⟨⟨Function.surjInv hq, continuous_of_discreteTopology⟩, ?_⟩
  intro y
  exact Function.surjInv_eq hq y

name: diagram_superquotient_map_has_continuous_section
statement:
theorem diagram_superquotient_map_has_continuous_section {G : Type*}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (V : OpenNormalSubgroup G) :
    ∃ s : ContinuousMap (G ⧸ (N ⊔ V.toSubgroup))
        ((ProfiniteGrp.diagram (ProfiniteGrp.of G)).obj V),
      ∀ y : G ⧸ (N ⊔ V.toSubgroup),
        QuotientGroup.map V.toSubgroup (N ⊔ V.toSubgroup) (MonoidHom.id G)
          (show V.toSubgroup ≤ N ⊔ V.toSubgroup from le_sup_right) (s y) = y
proof:
:= by
  rcases superquotient_map_has_continuous_section (G := G) N V with ⟨s, hs⟩
  have hNV_open : IsOpen (↑(N ⊔ V.toSubgroup) : Set G) :=
    Subgroup.isOpen_mono (show V.toSubgroup ≤ N ⊔ V.toSubgroup from le_sup_right) V.isOpen
  letI : DiscreteTopology (G ⧸ (N ⊔ V.toSubgroup)) :=
    QuotientGroup.discreteTopology (N := N ⊔ V.toSubgroup) hNV_open
  refine ⟨
    { toFun := fun y => s y
      continuous_toFun := continuous_of_discreteTopology },
    ?_⟩
  intro y
  simpa [ProfiniteGrp.diagram, ProfiniteGrp.toFiniteQuotientFunctor] using hs y

name: countable_openNormalSubgroup_of_secondCountable
statement:
theorem countable_openNormalSubgroup_of_secondCountable {G : Type*} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    [SecondCountableTopology G] :
    Countable (OpenNormalSubgroup G)
proof:
:= by
  let f : OpenNormalSubgroup G → TopologicalSpace.Clopens G := fun H =>
    ⟨(H : Set G), OpenSubgroup.isClopen H.toOpenSubgroup⟩
  have hclopen : Countable (TopologicalSpace.Clopens G) := by
    simpa using (TopologicalSpace.Clopens.countable_iff_secondCountable (X := G)).2 inferInstance
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro H K h
    apply OpenNormalSubgroup.toSubgroup_injective
    ext x
    change x ∈ ((f H : TopologicalSpace.Clopens G) : Set G) ↔ x ∈ ((f K : TopologicalSpace.Clopens G) : Set G)
    simpa [f] using congrArg (fun s : TopologicalSpace.Clopens G => x ∈ (s : Set G)) h
  letI := hclopen
  exact hf.countable

name: exists_descending_cofinal_openNormalSequence_above
statement:
theorem exists_descending_cofinal_openNormalSequence_above {G : Type*} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    [SecondCountableTopology G] (N : Subgroup G) :
    ∃ V : ℕ → OpenNormalSubgroup G,
      (∀ n, N ≤ (V n : Subgroup G)) ∧
      (∀ n, V (n + 1) ≤ V n) ∧
      (∀ U : OpenNormalSubgroup G, N ≤ (U : Subgroup G) → ∃ n, V n ≤ U)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : Type _ := {V : OpenNormalSubgroup G // N ≤ (V : Subgroup G)}
  letI : Countable (OpenNormalSubgroup G) := countable_openNormalSubgroup_of_secondCountable
  letI : Countable S := by
    dsimp [S]
    infer_instance
  let topON : OpenNormalSubgroup G := ⟨(⊤ : OpenSubgroup G), by
    simpa using (Subgroup.normal_top : (⊤ : Subgroup G).Normal)
  ⟩
  letI : Nonempty S := ⟨⟨topON, by
    change N ≤ (⊤ : Subgroup G)
    exact le_top
  ⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨e, hsurj⟩ := exists_surjective_nat S
  let V : ℕ → OpenNormalSubgroup G := fun n =>
    Nat.rec (e 0).1 (fun n W => W ⊓ (e (n + 1)).1) n
  refine ⟨V, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        exact (e 0).2
    | succ n ihn =>
        intro x hx
        change x ∈ (V n ⊓ (e (n + 1)).1 : OpenNormalSubgroup G)
        exact ⟨ihn hx, (e (n + 1)).2 hx⟩
  · intro n
    change V n ⊓ (e (n + 1)).1 ≤ V n
    exact inf_le_left
  · intro U hNU
    rcases hsurj ⟨U, hNU⟩ with ⟨n, hn⟩
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    have hVn : ∀ n, V n ≤ (e n).1 := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
          exact le_rfl
      | succ n ihn =>
          change V n ⊓ (e (n + 1)).1 ≤ (e (n + 1)).1
          exact inf_le_right
    simpa [hn] using hVn n

name: cofinal_openNormalSequence_compatible_family_lift
statement:
theorem cofinal_openNormalSequence_compatible_family_lift {G X : Type*}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    [TopologicalSpace X]
    (W : ℕ → OpenNormalSubgroup G)
    (hWdesc : ∀ n, W (n + 1) ≤ W n)
    (hWcof : ∀ U : OpenNormalSubgroup G, ∃ n, W n ≤ U)
    (a : ∀ n, C(X, G ⧸ (W n).toSubgroup))
    (ha : ∀ n (x : X),
      QuotientGroup.map (W (n + 1)).toSubgroup (W n).toSubgroup (MonoidHom.id G)
        (show (W (n + 1)).toSubgroup ≤ (W n).toSubgroup from hWdesc n)
        (a (n + 1) x) = a n x) :
    ∃ s : C(X, G), ∀ n (x : X),
      QuotientGroup.mk' (W n).toSubgroup (s x) = a n x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hWle_add : ∀ n k : ℕ, (W (n + k)).toSubgroup ≤ (W n).toSubgroup := by
    intro n k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
        simpa using (le_rfl : (W n).toSubgroup ≤ (W n).toSubgroup)
    | succ k ih =>
        have hstep : (W (n + k + 1)).toSubgroup ≤ (W (n + k)).toSubgroup := by
          simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using (hWdesc (n + k))
        simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using le_trans hstep ih
  have hcompat_add : ∀ n k (x : X),
      QuotientGroup.map (W (n + k)).toSubgroup (W n).toSubgroup (MonoidHom.id G)
        (show (W (n + k)).toSubgroup ≤ (W n).toSubgroup from hWle_add n k) (a (n + k) x) = a n x := by
    intro n k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
        intro x
        simpa using (QuotientGroup.map_id_apply (N := (W n).toSubgroup)
          (x := a n x))
    | succ k ih =>
        intro x
        calc
          QuotientGroup.map (W (n + (k + 1))).toSubgroup (W n).toSubgroup (MonoidHom.id G)
              (show (W (n + (k + 1))).toSubgroup ≤ (W n).toSubgroup from hWle_add n (k + 1))
              (a (n + (k + 1)) x)
            = QuotientGroup.map (W (n + k)).toSubgroup (W n).toSubgroup (MonoidHom.id G)
                (show (W (n + k)).toSubgroup ≤ (W n).toSubgroup from hWle_add n k)
                (QuotientGroup.map (W (n + (k + 1))).toSubgroup (W (n + k)).toSubgroup (MonoidHom.id G)
                  (show (W (n + (k + 1))).toSubgroup ≤ (W (n + k)).toSubgroup from by
                    simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using (hWdesc (n + k)))
                  (a (n + (k + 1)) x)) := by
                    symm
                    exact QuotientGroup.map_map (N := (W (n + (k + 1))).toSubgroup)
                      (M := (W (n + k)).toSubgroup) (O := (W n).toSubgroup)
                      (f := MonoidHom.id G) (g := MonoidHom.id G)
                      (hf := show (W (n + (k + 1))).toSubgroup ≤ Subgroup.comap (MonoidHom.id G) (W (n + k)).toSubgroup from by
                        simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using (hWdesc (n + k)))
                      (hg := show (W (n + k)).toSubgroup ≤ Subgroup.comap (MonoidHom.id G) (W n).toSubgroup from hWle_add n k)
                      (x := a (n + (k + 1)) x)
          _ = QuotientGroup.map (W (n + k)).toSubgroup (W n).toSubgroup (MonoidHom.id G)
                (show (W (n + k)).toSubgroup ≤ (W n).toSubgroup from hWle_add n k)
                (a (n + k) x) := by
                  simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using congrArg
                    (QuotientGroup.map (W (n + k)).toSubgroup (W n).toSubgroup (MonoidHom.id G)
                      (show (W (n + k)).toSubgroup ≤ (W n).toSubgroup from hWle_add n k))
                    (ha (n + k) x)
          _ = a n x := ih x
  have hWle : ∀ {n m : ℕ}, n ≤ m → (W m).toSubgroup ≤ (W n).toSubgroup := by
    intro n m hnm
    rcases Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hnm with ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact hWle_add n k
  have hcompat_nat : ∀ {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) (x : X),
      QuotientGroup.map (W m).toSubgroup (W n).toSubgroup (MonoidHom.id G)
        (show (W m).toSubgroup ≤ (W n).toSubgroup from hWle hnm) (a m x) = a n x := by
    intro n m hnm x
    rcases Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hnm with ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact hcompat_add n k x
  let P : ProfiniteGrp := ProfiniteGrp.of G
  let aP : ∀ n : ℕ, C(X, (ProfiniteGrp.diagram P).obj (W n)) := by
    intro n
    refine { toFun := fun x => a n x, continuous_toFun := ?_ }
    convert (a n).continuous using 1
    · change (⊥ : TopologicalSpace (G ⧸ (W n).toSubgroup)) = QuotientGroup.instTopologicalSpace (W n).toSubgroup
      symm
      simpa using (show QuotientGroup.instTopologicalSpace (W n).toSubgroup = (⊥ : TopologicalSpace (G ⧸ (W n).toSubgroup)) from DiscreteTopology.eq_bot (α := (G ⧸ (W n).toSubgroup)))
  have haP_val : ∀ n x, aP n x = a n x := by
    intro n x
    rfl
  have hcompat_natP : ∀ {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) (x : X),
      (ProfiniteGrp.diagram P).map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE (hWle hnm)) (aP m x) = aP n x := by
    intro n m hnm x
    change QuotientGroup.map (W m).toSubgroup (W n).toSubgroup (MonoidHom.id G)
      (show (W m).toSubgroup ≤ (W n).toSubgroup from hWle hnm) (a m x) = a n x
    exact hcompat_nat hnm x
  let nU : OpenNormalSubgroup G → ℕ := fun U => Classical.choose (hWcof U)
  have hnU : ∀ U, (W (nU U)).toSubgroup ≤ U.toSubgroup := by
    intro U
    exact Classical.choose_spec (hWcof U)
  let coordP : ∀ U : OpenNormalSubgroup G, C(X, (ProfiniteGrp.diagram P).obj U) := fun U =>
    (((ProfiniteGrp.diagram P).map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE (hnU U))).hom.toContinuousMap).comp (aP (nU U))
  have hcoordP_from_stage : ∀ (U : OpenNormalSubgroup G) {m : ℕ} (hm : nU U ≤ m) (x : X),
      (ProfiniteGrp.diagram P).map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE ((hWle hm).trans (hnU U))) (aP m x) = coordP U x := by
    intro U m hm x
    calc
      (ProfiniteGrp.diagram P).map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE ((hWle hm).trans (hnU U))) (aP m x)
        = ((ProfiniteGrp.diagram P).map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE (hnU U)))
            ((ProfiniteGrp.diagram P).map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE (hWle hm)) (aP m x)) := by
              change QuotientGroup.map (W m).toSubgroup U.toSubgroup (MonoidHom.id G)
                (show (W m).toSubgroup ≤ U.toSubgroup from (hWle hm).trans (hnU U)) (a m x)
                = QuotientGroup.map (W (nU U)).toSubgroup U.toSubgroup (MonoidHom.id G)
                    (show (W (nU U)).toSubgroup ≤ U.toSubgroup from hnU U)
                    (QuotientGroup.map (W m).toSubgroup (W (nU U)).toSubgroup (MonoidHom.id G)
                      (show (W m).toSubgroup ≤ (W (nU U)).toSubgroup from hWle hm) (a m x))
              symm
              exact QuotientGroup.map_map (N := (W m).toSubgroup)
                (M := (W (nU U)).toSubgroup) (O := U.toSubgroup)
                (f := MonoidHom.id G) (g := MonoidHom.id G)
                (hf := show (W m).toSubgroup ≤ Subgroup.comap (MonoidHom.id G) (W (nU U)).toSubgroup from hWle hm)
                (hg := show (W (nU U)).toSubgroup ≤ Subgroup.comap (MonoidHom.id G) U.toSubgroup from hnU U)
                (x := a m x)
      _ = ((ProfiniteGrp.diagram P).map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE (hnU U))) (aP (nU U) x) := by
            rw [hcompat_natP hm x]
      _ = coordP U x := by rfl
  have hcoord_compat : ∀ x : X, ∀ {U1 U2 : OpenNormalSubgroup G} (f : U1 ⟶ U2),
      (ProfiniteGrp.diagram P).map f (coordP U1 x) = coordP U2 x := by
    intro x U1 U2 f
    let m := max (nU U1) (nU U2)
    have hm1 : nU U1 ≤ m := le_max_left _ _
    have hm2 : nU U2 ≤ m := le_max_right _ _
    calc
      (ProfiniteGrp.diagram P).map f (coordP U1 x)
          = (ProfiniteGrp.diagram P).map f
              ((ProfiniteGrp.diagram P).map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE ((hWle hm1).trans (hnU U1))) (aP m x)) := by
                rw [← hcoordP_from_stage U1 hm1 x]
      _ = (ProfiniteGrp.diagram P).map
            (CategoryTheory.homOfLE (((hWle hm1).trans (hnU U1)).trans (CategoryTheory.leOfHom f)))
            (aP m x) := by
              change QuotientGroup.map U1.toSubgroup U2.toSubgroup (MonoidHom.id G)
                (show U1.toSubgroup ≤ U2.toSubgroup from CategoryTheory.leOfHom f)
                (QuotientGroup.map (W m).toSubgroup U1.toSubgroup (MonoidHom.id G)
                  (show (W m).toSubgroup ≤ U1.toSubgroup from (hWle hm1).trans (hnU U1)) (a m x))
                = QuotientGroup.map (W m).toSubgroup U2.toSubgroup (MonoidHom.id G)
                    (show (W m).toSubgroup ≤ U2.toSubgroup from
                      ((hWle hm1).trans (hnU U1)).trans (CategoryTheory.leOfHom f)) (a m x)
              exact QuotientGroup.map_map (N := (W m).toSubgroup)
                (M := U1.toSubgroup) (O := U2.toSubgroup)
                (f := MonoidHom.id G) (g := MonoidHom.id G)
                (hf := show (W m).toSubgroup ≤ Subgroup.comap (MonoidHom.id G) U1.toSubgroup from (hWle hm1).trans (hnU U1))
                (hg := show U1.toSubgroup ≤ Subgroup.comap (MonoidHom.id G) U2.toSubgroup from CategoryTheory.leOfHom f)
                (x := a m x)
      _ = coordP U2 x := by
            simpa using hcoordP_from_stage U2 hm2 x
  let Lfun : X → ProfiniteGrp.limit (ProfiniteGrp.diagram P) := fun x =>
    ⟨fun U => coordP U x, by
      intro U1 U2 f
      exact hcoord_compat x f⟩
  have hLfun : Continuous Lfun := by
    apply Continuous.subtype_mk
    simpa using (continuous_pi fun U : OpenNormalSubgroup G => (coordP U).continuous)
  let L : C(X, ProfiniteGrp.limit (ProfiniteGrp.diagram P)) := ⟨Lfun, hLfun⟩
  let e := ProfiniteGrp.continuousMulEquivLimittoFiniteQuotientFunctor P
  let s : C(X, G) := ⟨fun x => e.symm (L x), e.symm.continuous_toFun.comp L.continuous⟩
  have hs_eq : ∀ x, e (s x) = L x := by
    intro x
    exact e.apply_symm_apply (L x)
  have hcoord_W : ∀ n x, coordP (W n) x = aP n x := by
    intro n x
    let m := max (nU (W n)) n
    have hm1 : nU (W n) ≤ m := le_max_left _ _
    have hm2 : n ≤ m := le_max_right _ _
    have h1 := hcoordP_from_stage (W n) hm1 x
    have h2 := hcompat_natP hm2 x
    exact h1.symm.trans h2
  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
  intro n x
  have hproj := congrArg (fun y => y.val (W n)) (hs_eq x)
  change QuotientGroup.mk' (W n).toSubgroup (s x) = coordP (W n) x at hproj
  rw [hcoord_W n x] at hproj
  simpa [haP_val n x] using hproj

name: quotient_eq_of_cofinal_openNormalSequence_sup_eq
statement:
theorem quotient_eq_of_cofinal_openNormalSequence_sup_eq {G : Type*}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G))
    (V : ℕ → OpenNormalSubgroup G)
    (hcofinal : ∀ U : OpenNormalSubgroup G, ∃ n, V n ≤ U)
    {g : G} {x : G ⧸ N}
    (h : ∀ n,
      QuotientGroup.map N (N ⊔ (V n).toSubgroup) (MonoidHom.id G)
        (show N ≤ N ⊔ (V n).toSubgroup from le_sup_left) x =
      QuotientGroup.mk' (N ⊔ (V n).toSubgroup) g) :
    QuotientGroup.mk' N g = x
proof:
:= by
  apply quotient_eq_of_all_open_superquotients_eq N hN
  intro U
  rcases hcofinal U with ⟨n, hn⟩
  have hvu : (V n).toSubgroup ≤ U.toSubgroup := hn
  have hsup : N ⊔ (V n).toSubgroup ≤ N ⊔ U.toSubgroup := sup_le_sup_left hvu N
  have h' := congrArg
    (QuotientGroup.map (N ⊔ (V n).toSubgroup) (N ⊔ U.toSubgroup) (MonoidHom.id G) hsup)
    (h n)
  simpa using h'

name: profinite_quotient_has_continuous_section
statement:
theorem profinite_quotient_has_continuous_section (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    [SecondCountableTopology G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (_hN : IsClosed (N : Set G)) :
    ∃ s : C(G ⧸ N, G), ∀ x : G ⧸ N, QuotientGroup.mk' N (s x) = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hN : IsClosed (N : Set G) := _hN
  obtain ⟨W, hWbot, hWdesc, hWcof⟩ :=
    exists_descending_cofinal_openNormalSequence_above (G := G) (N := (⊥ : Subgroup G))
  have hWcof' : ∀ U : OpenNormalSubgroup G, ∃ n, W n ≤ U := by
    intro U
    simpa using hWcof U bot_le
  let R : ℕ → Subgroup G := fun n => N ⊔ (W n).toSubgroup
  have hWle : ∀ {n m : ℕ}, n ≤ m → W m ≤ W n := by
    intro n m h
    induction h with
    | refl => exact le_rfl
    | @step m h ih => exact le_trans (hWdesc m) ih
  have hRle : ∀ n, R (n + 1) ≤ R n := by
    intro n
    exact sup_le_sup_left (show (W (n + 1)).toSubgroup ≤ (W n).toSubgroup from hWdesc n) N
  have hT0 : Σ' s : C(G ⧸ R 0, G ⧸ (W 0).toSubgroup),
      ∀ y : G ⧸ R 0,
        QuotientGroup.map (W 0).toSubgroup (R 0) (MonoidHom.id G)
          (show (W 0).toSubgroup ≤ R 0 from le_sup_right) (s y) = y := by
    refine ⟨Classical.choose (superquotient_map_has_continuous_section (G := G) N (W 0)), ?_⟩
    exact Classical.choose_spec (superquotient_map_has_continuous_section (G := G) N (W 0))
  let T : ℕ → Type _ := fun n =>
    Σ' s : C(G ⧸ R n, G ⧸ (W n).toSubgroup),
      ∀ y : G ⧸ R n,
        QuotientGroup.map (W n).toSubgroup (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
          (show (W n).toSubgroup ≤ R n from le_sup_right) (s y) = y
  have hT0' : T 0 := hT0
  have hTstep : ∀ n (tn : T n), { tnext : T (n + 1) //
      ∀ y : G ⧸ R (n + 1),
        QuotientGroup.map (W (n + 1)).toSubgroup (W n).toSubgroup (MonoidHom.id G)
          (show (W (n + 1)).toSubgroup ≤ (W n).toSubgroup from hWdesc n)
          (tnext.1 y) =
        tn.1
          (QuotientGroup.map (R (n + 1)) (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
            (show R (n + 1) ≤ R n from hRle n) y) } := by
    intro n tn
    rcases tn with ⟨sn, hsn⟩
    let f : G ⧸ R (n + 1) → G ⧸ (W (n + 1)).toSubgroup := fun y =>
      let g : G := Classical.choose (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (N := R (n + 1)) y)
      let hx : QuotientGroup.map N (R (n + 1)) (MonoidHom.id G)
          (show N ≤ R (n + 1) from le_sup_left) (QuotientGroup.mk' N g) = y := by
            simpa [g] using Classical.choose_spec (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (N := R (n + 1)) y)
      let y' : G ⧸ R n :=
        QuotientGroup.map (R (n + 1)) (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
          (show R (n + 1) ≤ R n from hRle n) y
      let b : G ⧸ (W n).toSubgroup := sn y'
      let hb : QuotientGroup.map (W n).toSubgroup (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
          (show (W n).toSubgroup ≤ R n from le_sup_right) b =
          QuotientGroup.map N (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
            (show N ≤ R n from le_sup_left) (QuotientGroup.mk' N g) := by
              have hy' : y' = QuotientGroup.map N (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
                  (show N ≤ R n from le_sup_left) (QuotientGroup.mk' N g) := by
                calc
                  y' = QuotientGroup.map (R (n + 1)) (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
                      (show R (n + 1) ≤ R n from hRle n) y := by rfl
                  _ = QuotientGroup.map (R (n + 1)) (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
                      (show R (n + 1) ≤ R n from hRle n)
                      (QuotientGroup.map N (R (n + 1)) (MonoidHom.id G)
                        (show N ≤ R (n + 1) from le_sup_left) (QuotientGroup.mk' N g)) := by
                        rw [← hx]
                  _ = QuotientGroup.map N (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
                      (show N ≤ R n from le_sup_left) (QuotientGroup.mk' N g) := by
                        simpa using congrArg (fun h => h (QuotientGroup.mk' N g))
                          (QuotientGroup.map_comp_map
                            (N := N) (M := R (n + 1)) (O := R n)
                            (f := MonoidHom.id G) (g := MonoidHom.id G)
                            (hf := show N ≤ (R (n + 1)).comap (MonoidHom.id G) by
                              simpa using (show N ≤ R (n + 1) from le_sup_left))
                            (hg := show R (n + 1) ≤ (R n).comap (MonoidHom.id G) by
                              simpa using (hRle n)))
              calc
                QuotientGroup.map (W n).toSubgroup (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
                    (show (W n).toSubgroup ≤ R n from le_sup_right) b = y' := hsn y'
                _ = QuotientGroup.map N (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
                    (show N ≤ R n from le_sup_left) (QuotientGroup.mk' N g) := hy'
      Classical.choose (quotient_fiber_lift_exists (G := G) N (V := W (n + 1)) (W := W n)
        (hWdesc n) (QuotientGroup.mk' N g) b hb)
    refine ⟨⟨⟨f, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · have hRopen : IsOpen ((R (n + 1) : Subgroup G) : Set G) := by
        apply Subgroup.isOpen_mono (H₁ := (W (n + 1)).toSubgroup)
        · exact le_sup_right
        · simpa using (W (n + 1)).isOpen
      letI : DiscreteTopology (G ⧸ R (n + 1)) :=
        QuotientGroup.discreteTopology (G := G) (N := R (n + 1)) (hN := hRopen)
      exact continuous_of_discreteTopology
    · intro y
      dsimp [f]
      let g : G := Classical.choose (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (N := R (n + 1)) y)
      let hx : QuotientGroup.map N (R (n + 1)) (MonoidHom.id G)
          (show N ≤ R (n + 1) from le_sup_left) (QuotientGroup.mk' N g) = y := by
            simpa [g] using Classical.choose_spec (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (N := R (n + 1)) y)
      let y' : G ⧸ R n :=
        QuotientGroup.map (R (n + 1)) (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
          (show R (n + 1) ≤ R n from hRle n) y
      let b : G ⧸ (W n).toSubgroup := sn y'
      let hb : QuotientGroup.map (W n).toSubgroup (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
          (show (W n).toSubgroup ≤ R n from le_sup_right) b =
          QuotientGroup.map N (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
            (show N ≤ R n from le_sup_left) (QuotientGroup.mk' N g) := by
              have hy' : y' = QuotientGroup.map N (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
                  (show N ≤ R n from le_sup_left) (QuotientGroup.mk' N g) := by
                calc
                  y' = QuotientGroup.map (R (n + 1)) (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
                      (show R (n + 1) ≤ R n from hRle n) y := by rfl
                  _ = QuotientGroup.map (R (n + 1)) (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
                      (show R (n + 1) ≤ R n from hRle n)
                      (QuotientGroup.map N (R (n + 1)) (MonoidHom.id G)
                        (show N ≤ R (n + 1) from le_sup_left) (QuotientGroup.mk' N g)) := by
                        rw [← hx]
                  _ = QuotientGroup.map N (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
                      (show N ≤ R n from le_sup_left) (QuotientGroup.mk' N g) := by
                        simpa using congrArg (fun h => h (QuotientGroup.mk' N g))
                          (QuotientGroup.map_comp_map
                            (N := N) (M := R (n + 1)) (O := R n)
                            (f := MonoidHom.id G) (g := MonoidHom.id G)
                            (hf := show N ≤ (R (n + 1)).comap (MonoidHom.id G) by
                              simpa using (show N ≤ R (n + 1) from le_sup_left))
                            (hg := show R (n + 1) ≤ (R n).comap (MonoidHom.id G) by
                              simpa using (hRle n)))
              calc
                QuotientGroup.map (W n).toSubgroup (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
                    (show (W n).toSubgroup ≤ R n from le_sup_right) b = y' := hsn y'
                _ = QuotientGroup.map N (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
                    (show N ≤ R n from le_sup_left) (QuotientGroup.mk' N g) := hy'
      exact (Classical.choose_spec (quotient_fiber_lift_exists (G := G) N (V := W (n + 1))
        (W := W n) (hWdesc n) (QuotientGroup.mk' N g) b hb)).2.trans hx
    · intro y
      dsimp [f]
      let g : G := Classical.choose (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (N := R (n + 1)) y)
      let hx : QuotientGroup.map N (R (n + 1)) (MonoidHom.id G)
          (show N ≤ R (n + 1) from le_sup_left) (QuotientGroup.mk' N g) = y := by
            simpa [g] using Classical.choose_spec (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (N := R (n + 1)) y)
      let y' : G ⧸ R n :=
        QuotientGroup.map (R (n + 1)) (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
          (show R (n + 1) ≤ R n from hRle n) y
      let b : G ⧸ (W n).toSubgroup := sn y'
      let hb : QuotientGroup.map (W n).toSubgroup (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
          (show (W n).toSubgroup ≤ R n from le_sup_right) b =
          QuotientGroup.map N (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
            (show N ≤ R n from le_sup_left) (QuotientGroup.mk' N g) := by
              have hy' : y' = QuotientGroup.map N (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
                  (show N ≤ R n from le_sup_left) (QuotientGroup.mk' N g) := by
                calc
                  y' = QuotientGroup.map (R (n + 1)) (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
                      (show R (n + 1) ≤ R n from hRle n) y := by rfl
                  _ = QuotientGroup.map (R (n + 1)) (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
                      (show R (n + 1) ≤ R n from hRle n)
                      (QuotientGroup.map N (R (n + 1)) (MonoidHom.id G)
                        (show N ≤ R (n + 1) from le_sup_left) (QuotientGroup.mk' N g)) := by
                        rw [← hx]
                  _ = QuotientGroup.map N (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
                      (show N ≤ R n from le_sup_left) (QuotientGroup.mk' N g) := by
                        simpa using congrArg (fun h => h (QuotientGroup.mk' N g))
                          (QuotientGroup.map_comp_map
                            (N := N) (M := R (n + 1)) (O := R n)
                            (f := MonoidHom.id G) (g := MonoidHom.id G)
                            (hf := show N ≤ (R (n + 1)).comap (MonoidHom.id G) by
                              simpa using (show N ≤ R (n + 1) from le_sup_left))
                            (hg := show R (n + 1) ≤ (R n).comap (MonoidHom.id G) by
                              simpa using (hRle n)))
              calc
                QuotientGroup.map (W n).toSubgroup (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
                    (show (W n).toSubgroup ≤ R n from le_sup_right) b = y' := hsn y'
                _ = QuotientGroup.map N (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
                    (show N ≤ R n from le_sup_left) (QuotientGroup.mk' N g) := hy'
      simpa [b, y'] using (Classical.choose_spec (quotient_fiber_lift_exists (G := G) N (V := W (n + 1))
        (W := W n) (hWdesc n) (QuotientGroup.mk' N g) b hb)).1
  let t : ∀ n, T n := Nat.rec hT0' (fun n tn => (hTstep n tn).1)
  have hstep : ∀ n (y : G ⧸ R (n + 1)),
      QuotientGroup.map (W (n + 1)).toSubgroup (W n).toSubgroup (MonoidHom.id G)
        (show (W (n + 1)).toSubgroup ≤ (W n).toSubgroup from hWdesc n)
        ((t (n + 1)).1 y) =
      (t n).1
        (QuotientGroup.map (R (n + 1)) (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
          (show R (n + 1) ≤ R n from hRle n) y) := by
    intro n y
    simpa [t] using (hTstep n (t n)).2 y
  have hqcont : ∀ n,
      Continuous (QuotientGroup.map N (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
        (show N ≤ R n from le_sup_left) : G ⧸ N → G ⧸ R n) := by
    intro n
    rw [← QuotientGroup.isOpenQuotientMap_mk.continuous_comp_iff]
    simpa [Function.comp, QuotientGroup.map_mk'] using
      (QuotientGroup.continuous_mk (N := R n))
  let q : ∀ n, C(G ⧸ N, G ⧸ R n) := fun n =>
    ⟨QuotientGroup.map N (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
      (show N ≤ R n from le_sup_left), hqcont n⟩
  let aSeq : ∀ n, C(G ⧸ N, G ⧸ (W n).toSubgroup) := fun n => (t n).1.comp (q n)
  have hstepA : ∀ n (x : G ⧸ N),
      QuotientGroup.map (W (n + 1)).toSubgroup (W n).toSubgroup (MonoidHom.id G)
        (show (W (n + 1)).toSubgroup ≤ (W n).toSubgroup from hWdesc n)
        (aSeq (n + 1) x) = aSeq n x := by
    intro n x
    dsimp [aSeq]
    calc
      QuotientGroup.map (W (n + 1)).toSubgroup (W n).toSubgroup (MonoidHom.id G)
          (show (W (n + 1)).toSubgroup ≤ (W n).toSubgroup from hWdesc n)
          ((t (n + 1)).1 ((q (n + 1)) x)) =
        (t n).1
          (QuotientGroup.map (R (n + 1)) (R n) (MonoidHom.id G)
            (show R (n + 1) ≤ R n from hRle n) ((q (n + 1)) x)) := hstep n ((q (n + 1)) x)
      _ = (t n).1 ((q n) x) := by
        congr 1
        dsimp [q]
        simpa using congrArg (fun h => h x)
          (QuotientGroup.map_comp_map
            (N := N) (M := R (n + 1)) (O := R n)
            (f := MonoidHom.id G) (g := MonoidHom.id G)
            (hf := show N ≤ (R (n + 1)).comap (MonoidHom.id G) by
              simpa using (show N ≤ R (n + 1) from le_sup_left))
            (hg := show R (n + 1) ≤ (R n).comap (MonoidHom.id G) by
              simpa using (hRle n)))
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ :=
    cofinal_openNormalSequence_compatible_family_lift
      (G := G) (X := G ⧸ N) W hWdesc hWcof' aSeq hstepA
  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
  intro x
  apply quotient_eq_of_cofinal_openNormalSequence_sup_eq
    (G := G) (N := N) hN W hWcof'
  intro n
  have ht := (t n).2 ((q n) x)
  calc
    QuotientGroup.map N (N ⊔ (W n).toSubgroup) (MonoidHom.id G)
        (show N ≤ N ⊔ (W n).toSubgroup from le_sup_left) x
      = QuotientGroup.map (W n).toSubgroup (N ⊔ (W n).toSubgroup) (MonoidHom.id G)
          (show (W n).toSubgroup ≤ N ⊔ (W n).toSubgroup from le_sup_right)
          (aSeq n x) := by
            simpa [R, aSeq, q] using ht.symm
    _ = QuotientGroup.map (W n).toSubgroup (N ⊔ (W n).toSubgroup) (MonoidHom.id G)
          (show (W n).toSubgroup ≤ N ⊔ (W n).toSubgroup from le_sup_right)
          (QuotientGroup.mk' (W n).toSubgroup (s x)) := by
            rw [show aSeq n x = QuotientGroup.mk' (W n).toSubgroup (s x) from (hs n x).symm]
    _ = QuotientGroup.mk' (N ⊔ (W n).toSubgroup) (s x) := by
          simpa [QuotientGroup.map_mk']

name: chosenSection_spec
statement:
theorem chosenSection_spec
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    [SecondCountableTopology G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G))
    (x : G ⧸ N) :
    QuotientGroup.mk' N (chosenSection G N hN x) = x
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (profinite_quotient_has_continuous_section G N hN)) x

name: profinite_group_surj_hom_has_section
statement:
theorem profinite_group_surj_hom_has_section
    {G H : Type} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [T2Space G]
    [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    [SecondCountableTopology G]
    [Group H] [TopologicalSpace H] [IsTopologicalGroup H] [T2Space H]
    [CompactSpace H] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace H]
    (f : G →ₜ* H) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    ∃ s : ContinuousMap H G, ∀ y : H, f (s y) = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K : Subgroup G := f.toMonoidHom.ker
  haveI : K.Normal := by
    dsimp [K]
    infer_instance
  have hK : IsClosed (K : Set G) := by
    dsimp [K]
    change IsClosed (f ⁻¹' ({1} : Set H))
    simpa [MonoidHom.mem_ker, Subgroup.mem_carrier] using
      (isClosed_singleton.preimage f.continuous_toFun)
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := profinite_quotient_has_continuous_section (G := G) (N := K) hK
  let eMul : G ⧸ K ≃* H := QuotientGroup.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective f.toMonoidHom hf
  have hecont : Continuous eMul := by
    exact (QuotientGroup.isQuotientMap_mk K).continuous_iff.2 (by
      simpa [eMul, K] using f.continuous_toFun)
  let e : (G ⧸ K) ≃ₜ H := Continuous.homeoOfEquivCompactToT2 (f := eMul.toEquiv) hecont
  let eInv : ContinuousMap H (G ⧸ K) := ⟨e.symm, e.symm.continuous_toFun⟩
  refine ⟨t.comp eInv, ?_⟩
  intro y
  have h1 : QuotientGroup.mk' K (t (e.symm y)) = e.symm y := ht (e.symm y)
  have h2 : e (QuotientGroup.mk' K (t (e.symm y))) = e (e.symm y) := congrArg e h1
  have h3 : e (QuotientGroup.mk' K (t (e.symm y))) = y := by
    simpa using h2
  change eMul (QuotientGroup.mk' K (t (e.symm y))) = y
  simpa [e, eMul, K] using h3

name: schreierDefect_mem
statement:
theorem schreierDefect_mem
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]
    (s : ContinuousMap (G ⧸ N) G)
    (hs : ∀ x : G ⧸ N, QuotientGroup.mk' N (s x) = x) (x y : G ⧸ N) :
    s x * s y * (s (x * y))⁻¹ ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  let π : G →* G ⧸ N := QuotientGroup.mk' N
  have hπ : π (s x * s y * (s (x * y))⁻¹) = 1 := by
    calc
      π (s x * s y * (s (x * y))⁻¹)
          = π (s x) * π (s y) * (π (s (x * y)))⁻¹ := by simp [map_mul]
      _ = x * y * (x * y)⁻¹ := by simp [π, hs]
      _ = 1 := by simp
  have hker : s x * s y * (s (x * y))⁻¹ ∈ π.ker := by
    rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker]; exact hπ
  simpa [π, QuotientGroup.ker_mk' N] using hker

name: continuous_schreierDefect
statement:
theorem continuous_schreierDefect
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]
    (s : ContinuousMap (G ⧸ N) G)
    (hs : ∀ x : G ⧸ N, QuotientGroup.mk' N (s x) = x) :
    Continuous (fun xy : (G ⧸ N) × (G ⧸ N) =>
      Additive.ofMul (schreierDefect G N s hs xy.1 xy.2))
proof:
:= by
  change Continuous (fun xy : (G ⧸ N) × (G ⧸ N) => schreierDefect G N s hs xy.1 xy.2)
  unfold schreierDefect
  refine Continuous.subtype_mk ?_ ?_
  exact
    ((s.continuous.comp continuous_fst).mul (s.continuous.comp continuous_snd)).mul
      ((s.continuous.comp (continuous_fst.mul continuous_snd)).inv)

name: schreierDefect_relation
statement:
theorem schreierDefect_relation
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]
    (s : ContinuousMap (G ⧸ N) G)
    (hs : ∀ x : G ⧸ N, QuotientGroup.mk' N (s x) = x)
    (x y z : G ⧸ N) :
    schreierDefect G N s hs x y * schreierDefect G N s hs (x * y) z =
      (MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) (s x)) (schreierDefect G N s hs y z) *
        schreierDefect G N s hs x (y * z)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [schreierDefect, MulAut.conjNormal_apply, mul_assoc]

name: schreier_isCocycle
statement:
theorem schreier_isCocycle (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]
    (s : ContinuousMap (G ⧸ N) G)
    (hs : ∀ x : G ⧸ N, QuotientGroup.mk' N (s x) = x)
    (χ : Additive ↥N →+ ZMod p)
    (_hχ : ∀ g : G, χ.comp (MonoidHom.toAdditive
      ((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g).toMonoidHom)) = χ) :
    ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.IsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N)
      (schreier2Cocycle p G N s hs χ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hχ : Continuous χ
  · intro x y z
    let c : G ⧸ N → G ⧸ N → ↥N := schreierDefect G N s hs
    have hrel := schreierDefect_relation G N s hs x y z
    have hχrel :
        χ (Additive.ofMul (c x y)) + χ (Additive.ofMul (c (x * y) z)) =
          χ (Additive.ofMul ((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) (s x)) (c y z))) +
            χ (Additive.ofMul (c x (y * z))) := by
      simpa [c, map_mul] using (congrArg (fun n : ↥N => χ (Additive.ofMul n)) hrel)
    have hconj :
        χ (Additive.ofMul ((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) (s x)) (c y z))) =
          χ (Additive.ofMul (c y z)) := by
      let n : Additive ↥N := Additive.ofMul (c y z)
      have hEq := congrArg (fun f : Additive ↥N →+ ZMod p => f n) (_hχ (s x))
      simpa [n, c, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply] using hEq
    have hχrel' :
        χ (Additive.ofMul (c x y)) + χ (Additive.ofMul (c (x * y) z)) =
          χ (Additive.ofMul (c y z)) + χ (Additive.ofMul (c x (y * z))) := by
      rw [hconj] at hχrel
      exact hχrel
    have hzero :
        χ (Additive.ofMul (c y z)) - χ (Additive.ofMul (c (x * y) z)) +
            χ (Additive.ofMul (c x (y * z))) - χ (Additive.ofMul (c x y)) = 0 := by
      calc
        χ (Additive.ofMul (c y z)) - χ (Additive.ofMul (c (x * y) z)) +
            χ (Additive.ofMul (c x (y * z))) - χ (Additive.ofMul (c x y)) =
            (χ (Additive.ofMul (c y z)) + χ (Additive.ofMul (c x (y * z)))) -
              (χ (Additive.ofMul (c x y)) + χ (Additive.ofMul (c (x * y) z))) := by
                abel
        _ = 0 := by rw [← hχrel']; simp
    simpa [ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.IsCocycle2, schreier2Cocycle, hχ, c] using hzero
  · intro x y z
    simp [ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.IsCocycle2, schreier2Cocycle, hχ]

name: schreier2Cocycle_add_of_continuous
statement:
theorem schreier2Cocycle_add_of_continuous (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]
    (s : ContinuousMap (G ⧸ N) G)
    (hs : ∀ x : G ⧸ N, QuotientGroup.mk' N (s x) = x)
    (χ ψ : Additive ↥N →+ ZMod p)
    (hχ : Continuous χ) (hψ : Continuous ψ) :
    schreier2Cocycle p G N s hs (χ + ψ) =
      schreier2Cocycle p G N s hs χ + schreier2Cocycle p G N s hs ψ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hχψ : Continuous ⇑(χ + ψ) := hχ.add hψ
  ext xy
  simpa [schreier2Cocycle, hχ, hψ, hχψ]

name: schreier2Cocycle_smul_of_continuous
statement:
theorem schreier2Cocycle_smul_of_continuous (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]
    (s : ContinuousMap (G ⧸ N) G)
    (hs : ∀ x : G ⧸ N, QuotientGroup.mk' N (s x) = x)
    (a : ZMod p) (χ : Additive ↥N →+ ZMod p)
    (hχ : Continuous χ) :
    schreier2Cocycle p G N s hs (a • χ) =
      a • schreier2Cocycle p G N s hs χ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have haχ : Continuous (a • χ) := hχ.const_smul a
  ext xy
  simp [schreier2Cocycle, hχ, haχ, smul_eq_mul]

name: ofIsCocycle2_add
statement:
theorem ofIsCocycle2_add (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (f g : ContinuousMap (G × G) (ZMod p))

name: homogeneous_d01_zero_aux
statement:
theorem homogeneous_d01_zero_aux (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (H : Type) [Group H] [TopologicalSpace H] [IsTopologicalGroup H] :
    (HomogComplexAux p H).d 0 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  change (ContinuousCohomology.invariants (ZMod p) H).map
      ((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d (ZMod p) H 1).app
        (Action.trivial H (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)))) = 0
  rw [ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d_succ, ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d_zero]
  ext f
  cases f with
  | mk f hf =>
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply ContinuousMap.ext
      intro x
      apply ContinuousMap.ext
      intro y
      change ((DFunLike.coe (F := C(H, ZMod p)) f y : ZMod p)
        - DFunLike.coe (F := C(H, ZMod p)) f x) = 0
      have hxy := congr(DFunLike.coe (F := C(H, ZMod p)) $(hf (y * x⁻¹)) y)
      have hxy0 : ((TopModuleCat.Hom.hom
            (((ContinuousCohomology.Iobj (Action.trivial H (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)))).ρ
                (y * x⁻¹))) f) y : ZMod p) = DFunLike.coe (F := C(H, ZMod p)) f y := by
        simpa [ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.functor, ContinuousCohomology.I] using hxy
      rw [ContinuousCohomology.Iobj_ρ_apply] at hxy0
      have hxy' : (DFunLike.coe (F := C(H, ZMod p)) f x : ZMod p)
          = DFunLike.coe (F := C(H, ZMod p)) f y := by
        simpa [Action.trivial, TopModuleCat.hom_id, mul_assoc] using hxy0
      rw [hxy']
      simp

name: cocycleOne_eval_mul
statement:
theorem cocycleOne_eval_mul (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (z : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Cocycles p G 1) (g h : G) :
    (z : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p G 1)
        (fun _ : Fin 1 => g * h) =
      (z : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p G 1)
          (fun _ : Fin 1 => g) +
      (z : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p G 1)
          (fun _ : Fin 1 => h)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let v : Fin 2 → G := ![g, h]
  have hz : ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.d p G 1)
      (z : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p G 1)) v = 0 := by
    exact congrArg
      (fun f : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p G 2 => f v)
      (show (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.d p G 1)
          (z : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p G 1) = 0 from z.2)
  rw [ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.d_apply,
    ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.dAux.toFun] at hz
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hz
  simp [v] at hz
  have hcontract0 :
      Fin.contractNth (0 : Fin 2) (· * ·) ![g, h] = (fun _ : Fin 1 => g * h) := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    rw [Fin.contractNth_apply_of_eq]
    · simp
    · rfl
  have hcontract1 :
      Fin.contractNth (1 : Fin 2) (· * ·) ![g, h] = (fun _ : Fin 1 => g) := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    rw [Fin.contractNth_apply_of_lt]
    · simp
    · decide
  rw [hcontract0, hcontract1] at hz
  linear_combination -hz

name: cocycleOne_eval_one
statement:
theorem cocycleOne_eval_one (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]

proof:
:= by
  let a := (z : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p G 1)
    (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1 : G))
  have h : a = a + a := by
    dsimp [a]
    simpa [one_mul] using (cocycleOne_eval_mul p G z (1 : G) (1 : G))
  have h' : a = 0 := by
    have h'' := congrArg (fun t => t - a) h
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc] using h''.symm
  simpa [a] using h'

name: inhomogCohomology_complexHomologyEquiv_natural_classMap_ofCocycle1
statement:
theorem inhomogCohomology_complexHomologyEquiv_natural_classMap_ofCocycle1 (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]

    [Group G2] [TopologicalSpace G2] [IsTopologicalGroup G2]

proof:

name: inhomogToHomog_natural_one
statement:
theorem inhomogToHomog_natural_one (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G1 G2 : Type) [Group G1] [TopologicalSpace G1] [IsTopologicalGroup G1]
    [Group G2] [TopologicalSpace G2] [IsTopologicalGroup G2]
    (f : G1 →* G2) (hf : Continuous f)
    (φ : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p G2 1)
    (g : Fin 2 → G1) :
    ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIsoInternal.towerEval p G1 2
      ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.inhomogToHomog p G1 1
        (φ.comp ⟨fun gs : Fin 1 → G1 => fun i : Fin 1 => f (gs i), by continuity⟩)).1) g =
    ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIsoInternal.towerEval p G2 2
      ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.inhomogToHomog p G2 1 φ).1)
      (fun i => f (g i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.inhomogToHomog,
    ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.inhomogToHomog,
    ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIsoInternal.selectedInhomogToHomog_aux_apply,
    ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIsoInternal.selectedInhomogToHomog_aux_apply]
  change
    φ (fun i : Fin 1 =>
      f ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIsoInternal.consecutiveDifferencesTuple G1 1 g) i)) =
      φ (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIsoInternal.consecutiveDifferencesTuple G2 1
        (fun i => f (g i)))
  have htuple :
      (fun i : Fin 1 =>
        f ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIsoInternal.consecutiveDifferencesTuple G1 1 g) i)) =
        ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIsoInternal.consecutiveDifferencesTuple G2 1
          (fun i => f (g i)) := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    simp [ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIsoInternal.consecutiveDifferencesTuple, map_mul, map_inv]
  rw [htuple]

name: inhomogHomogComplexIso_degree1_component_natural
statement:
theorem inhomogHomogComplexIso_degree1_component_natural (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G1 G2 : Type) [Group G1] [TopologicalSpace G1] [IsTopologicalGroup G1]
    [T2Space G1] [CompactSpace G1] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G1]
    [Group G2] [TopologicalSpace G2] [IsTopologicalGroup G2]
    [T2Space G2] [CompactSpace G2] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G2]
    (f : G1 →* G2) (hf : Continuous f)
    (z : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Cocycles p G2 1) :
    let F
proof:
:= CategoryTheory.forget₂ (TopModuleCat (ZMod p)) (ModuleCat (ZMod p))
    let φhom :=
      (F.mapHomologicalComplex _).map
        (ContinuousCohomology.cochainsMapTrivial (ZMod p) f hf
          (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)))
    φhom.f 1
      (((inhomogHomogComplexIso p G2).hom.f 1)
        (z : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p G2 1)) =
    ((inhomogHomogComplexIso p G1).hom.f 1)
      (inhomogCochainsPullback p G1 G2 f hf 1
        (z : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p G2 1)) := by
  dsimp [inhomogCochainsPullback]
  have hG2 :
      ((inhomogHomogComplexIso p G2).hom.f 1) =
        ModuleCat.ofHom (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.inhomogToHomog p G2 1) := by
    unfold inhomogHomogComplexIso
    simp
  have hG1 :
      ((inhomogHomogComplexIso p G1).hom.f 1) =
        ModuleCat.ofHom (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.inhomogToHomog p G1 1) := by
    unfold inhomogHomogComplexIso
    simp
  rw [hG2, hG1]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro a
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro b
  let g : Fin 2 → G1 := ![a, b]
  change
    ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIsoInternal.towerEval p G1 2
      (((CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom
            ((CategoryTheory.forget₂ (TopModuleCat (ZMod p)) (ModuleCat (ZMod p))).map
              ((ContinuousCohomology.cochainsMapTrivial (ZMod p) f hf
                  (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))).f 1)))
          ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.inhomogToHomog p G2 1)
            (z : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p G2 1))).1)
      g =
    ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIsoInternal.towerEval p G1 2
      (((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.inhomogToHomog p G1 1)
          (ContinuousMap.comp (z : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p G2 1)
            ⟨fun gs : Fin 1 → G1 => fun i : Fin 1 => f (gs i), by continuity⟩)).1)
      g
  calc
    ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIsoInternal.towerEval p G1 2
        (((CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom
              ((CategoryTheory.forget₂ (TopModuleCat (ZMod p)) (ModuleCat (ZMod p))).map
                ((ContinuousCohomology.cochainsMapTrivial (ZMod p) f hf
                    (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))).f 1)))
            ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.inhomogToHomog p G2 1)
              (z : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p G2 1))).1)
        g =
      ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIsoInternal.towerEval p G2 2
        (((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.inhomogToHomog p G2 1)
            (z : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p G2 1)).1)
        (fun i => f (g i)) := by
          simpa [g, ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIsoInternal.towerEval] using
            (cochainsMapTrivial_degree1_towerEval p G1 G2 f hf
              ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.inhomogToHomog p G2 1)
                (z : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p G2 1)) g)
    _ =
      ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIsoInternal.towerEval p G1 2
        (((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.inhomogToHomog p G1 1)
            ((z : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p G2 1).comp
              ⟨fun gs : Fin 1 → G1 => fun i : Fin 1 => f (gs i), by continuity⟩)).1)
        g := by
          simpa [g, ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIsoInternal.towerEval] using
            (inhomogToHomog_natural_one p G1 G2 f hf
              (z : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p G2 1) g).symm

name: inhomogHomogComplexIso_natural_at_classMap_ofCocycle1
statement:
theorem inhomogHomogComplexIso_natural_at_classMap_ofCocycle1 (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G1 G2 : Type) [Group G1] [TopologicalSpace G1] [IsTopologicalGroup G1]
    [T2Space G1] [CompactSpace G1] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G1]
    [Group G2] [TopologicalSpace G2] [IsTopologicalGroup G2]
    [T2Space G2] [CompactSpace G2] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G2]
    (f : G1 →* G2) (hf : Continuous f)
    (z : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Cocycles p G2 1) :
    let F
proof:
:= CategoryTheory.forget₂ (TopModuleCat (ZMod p)) (ModuleCat (ZMod p))
    let φhom :=
      (F.mapHomologicalComplex _).map
        (ContinuousCohomology.cochainsMapTrivial (ZMod p) f hf
          (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)))
    (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φhom 1)
      ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMapIso (inhomogHomogComplexIso p G2) 1).hom
        ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIsoInternal.inhomogCohomology_complexHomologyEquiv p G2 1)
          (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p G2 1 z))) =
    ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMapIso (inhomogHomogComplexIso p G1) 1).hom
      ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIsoInternal.inhomogCohomology_complexHomologyEquiv p G1 1)
        (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p G1 1
          (groupHomPullbackCocyclesOne p G1 G2 f hf z)))) := by
  classical
  dsimp
  let F := CategoryTheory.forget₂ (TopModuleCat (ZMod p)) (ModuleCat (ZMod p))
  let φinh := inhomogCochainsPullbackChainMap p G1 G2 f hf
  let φhom :=
    (F.mapHomologicalComplex _).map
      (ContinuousCohomology.cochainsMapTrivial (ZMod p) f hf
        (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)))
  let lhsChain := CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ((inhomogHomogComplexIso p G2).hom) φhom
  let rhsChain := CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp φinh ((inhomogHomogComplexIso p G1).hom)
  let rep := inhomogCycleRepresentativeOfCocycle1 p G2 z
  let Kinh2 := ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.complex p G2
  let Khom1 := ((F.mapHomologicalComplex _).obj
    ((ContinuousCohomology.homogeneousCochains (ZMod p) G1).obj
      (Action.trivial G1 (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)))))
  rw [← inhomogCohomology_complexHomologyEquiv_natural_classMap_ofCocycle1 p G1 G2 f hf z]
  rw [inhomogCohomology_complexHomologyEquiv_classMap_ofCocycle1 p G2 z]
  change
    (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φhom 1)
        ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ((inhomogHomogComplexIso p G2).hom) 1)
          ((Kinh2.homologyπ 1) rep)) =
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ((inhomogHomogComplexIso p G1).hom) 1)
        ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φinh 1)
          ((Kinh2.homologyπ 1) rep))
  have hlhs :
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φhom 1)
          ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ((inhomogHomogComplexIso p G2).hom) 1)
            ((Kinh2.homologyπ 1) rep)) =
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap lhsChain 1)
          ((Kinh2.homologyπ 1) rep) := by
    simpa [ModuleCat.comp_apply, lhsChain] using
      (congrArg
        (fun ψ => ψ ((Kinh2.homologyπ 1) rep))
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_comp ((inhomogHomogComplexIso p G2).hom) φhom 1)).symm
  have hrhs :
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ((inhomogHomogComplexIso p G1).hom) 1)
          ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φinh 1)
            ((Kinh2.homologyπ 1) rep)) =
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap rhsChain 1)
          ((Kinh2.homologyπ 1) rep) := by
    simpa [ModuleCat.comp_apply, rhsChain] using
      (congrArg
        (fun ψ => ψ ((Kinh2.homologyπ 1) rep))
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_comp φinh ((inhomogHomogComplexIso p G1).hom) 1)).symm
  rw [hlhs, hrhs]
  have hnatL := congrArg (fun ψ => ψ rep)
    (HomologicalComplex.homologyπ_naturality (φ := lhsChain) (i := 1))
  have hnatR := congrArg (fun ψ => ψ rep)
    (HomologicalComplex.homologyπ_naturality (φ := rhsChain) (i := 1))
  simp only [ModuleCat.comp_apply] at hnatL hnatR
  have hcycles :
      (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap lhsChain 1) rep =
        (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap rhsChain 1) rep := by
    apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective (Khom1.iCycles 1)).1 inferInstance
    have hLi := congrArg (fun ψ => ψ rep)
      (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap_i (φ := lhsChain) (i := 1))
    have hRi := congrArg (fun ψ => ψ rep)
      (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap_i (φ := rhsChain) (i := 1))
    simp only [ModuleCat.comp_apply] at hLi hRi
    rw [hLi, hRi, inhomogCycleRepresentativeOfCocycle1_iCycles p G2 z]
    simpa [lhsChain, rhsChain, φinh, φhom, F, Khom1] using
      inhomogHomogComplexIso_degree1_component_natural p G1 G2 f hf z
  rw [hnatL, hnatR, hcycles]

name: cohomologyIso_natural_at_classMap_ofCocycle1
statement:
theorem cohomologyIso_natural_at_classMap_ofCocycle1 (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G1 G2 : Type) [Group G1] [TopologicalSpace G1] [IsTopologicalGroup G1]
    [T2Space G1] [CompactSpace G1] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G1]
    [Group G2] [TopologicalSpace G2] [IsTopologicalGroup G2]
    [T2Space G2] [CompactSpace G2] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G2]
    (f : G1 →* G2) (hf : Continuous f)
    (z : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Cocycles p G2 1) :
    (ContinuousCohomology.cohomologyMapTrivial (ZMod p) f hf
      (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)) 1).hom
      ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p G2 1)
        (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p G2 1 z)) =
    (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p G1 1)
      (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p G1 1
        (groupHomPullbackCocyclesOne p G1 G2 f hf z))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := CategoryTheory.forget₂ (TopModuleCat (ZMod p)) (ModuleCat (ZMod p))
  let X1 : Action (TopModuleCat (ZMod p)) G1 :=
    Action.trivial G1 (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))
  let X2 : Action (TopModuleCat (ZMod p)) G2 :=
    Action.trivial G2 (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))
  let KhomTop1 : CochainComplex (TopModuleCat (ZMod p)) ℕ :=
    (ContinuousCohomology.homogeneousCochains (ZMod p) G1).obj X1
  let KhomTop2 : CochainComplex (TopModuleCat (ZMod p)) ℕ :=
    (ContinuousCohomology.homogeneousCochains (ZMod p) G2).obj X2
  let Khom1 : CochainComplex (ModuleCat (ZMod p)) ℕ :=
    (F.mapHomologicalComplex _).obj KhomTop1
  let Khom2 : CochainComplex (ModuleCat (ZMod p)) ℕ :=
    (F.mapHomologicalComplex _).obj KhomTop2
  let φhomTop : KhomTop2 ⟶ KhomTop1 :=
    ContinuousCohomology.cochainsMapTrivial (ZMod p) f hf (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))
  let φhom : Khom2 ⟶ Khom1 :=
    (F.mapHomologicalComplex _).map φhomTop
  let e31 : (Khom1.homology 1 : Type) ≃ₗ[ZMod p]
      (((continuousCohomology (ZMod p) G1 1).obj X1 : Type)) :=
    (((HomologicalComplex.sc (K := KhomTop1) 1).mapHomologyIso F).toLinearEquiv)
  let e32 : (Khom2.homology 1 : Type) ≃ₗ[ZMod p]
      (((continuousCohomology (ZMod p) G2 1).obj X2 : Type)) :=
    (((HomologicalComplex.sc (K := KhomTop2) 1).mapHomologyIso F).toLinearEquiv)
  have hE3 (x : Khom2.homology 1) :
      (ContinuousCohomology.cohomologyMapTrivial (ZMod p) f hf
        (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)) 1).hom (e32 x) =
      e31 (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φhom 1 x) := by
    let φshort :=
      ((HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor (TopModuleCat (ZMod p))
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 1).map φhomTop)
    have hraw :=
      congrArg (fun ψ => (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom ψ) x)
        (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso_hom_naturality
          (φ := φshort) (F := F))
    dsimp [e31, e32, ContinuousCohomology.cohomologyMapTrivial, φshort, φhom] at hraw ⊢
    exact hraw.symm
  let y : Khom2.homology 1 :=
    ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMapIso (inhomogHomogComplexIso p G2) 1).hom
      ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIsoInternal.inhomogCohomology_complexHomologyEquiv p G2 1)
        (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p G2 1 z)))
  have hy := hE3 y
  have hmid :
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φhom 1 y =
        ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMapIso (inhomogHomogComplexIso p G1) 1).hom
          ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIsoInternal.inhomogCohomology_complexHomologyEquiv p G1 1)
            (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p G1 1
              (groupHomPullbackCocyclesOne p G1 G2 f hf z)))) := by
    dsimp [y]
    simpa [F, φhom] using
      inhomogHomogComplexIso_natural_at_classMap_ofCocycle1 p G1 G2 f hf z
  have hy' :
      (ContinuousCohomology.cohomologyMapTrivial (ZMod p) f hf
        (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)) 1).hom (e32 y) =
      e31
        ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMapIso (inhomogHomogComplexIso p G1) 1).hom
          ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIsoInternal.inhomogCohomology_complexHomologyEquiv p G1 1)
            (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p G1 1
              (groupHomPullbackCocyclesOne p G1 G2 f hf z)))) := by
    exact hy.trans (congrArg e31 hmid)
  simpa [ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso,
    ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIsoInternal.cohomologyIso,
    ContinuousCohomology.cohomologyMapTrivial,
    F, X1, X2, KhomTop1, KhomTop2, Khom1, Khom2, φhomTop, φhom, e31, e32, y] using
    hy'

name: cohomologyOneEquivCocycles_explicit_natural_classMap
statement:
theorem cohomologyOneEquivCocycles_explicit_natural_classMap (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G1 G2 : Type) [Group G1] [TopologicalSpace G1] [IsTopologicalGroup G1]
    [T2Space G1] [CompactSpace G1] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G1]
    [Group G2] [TopologicalSpace G2] [IsTopologicalGroup G2]
    [T2Space G2] [CompactSpace G2] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G2]
    (f : G1 →* G2) (hf : Continuous f)
    (z : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Cocycles p G2 1) :
    (cohomologyOneEquivCocycles_explicit p G1)
      ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p G1 1).symm
        ((ContinuousCohomology.cohomologyMapTrivial (ZMod p) f hf
          (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)) 1).hom
          ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p G2 1)
            (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p G2 1 z)))) =
      groupHomPullbackCocyclesOne p G1 G2 f hf z
proof:
:= by

  have h1 :=
    congrArg ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p G1 1).symm) hcoh
  have h2 := congrArg (cohomologyOneEquivCocycles_explicit p G1) h1
  simpa only [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, cohomologyOneEquivCocycles_explicit_classMap] using h2

name: cohomologyOneEquivCocycles_explicit_natural
statement:
theorem cohomologyOneEquivCocycles_explicit_natural (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G1 G2 : Type) [Group G1] [TopologicalSpace G1] [IsTopologicalGroup G1]
    [T2Space G1] [CompactSpace G1] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G1]
    [Group G2] [TopologicalSpace G2] [IsTopologicalGroup G2]
    [T2Space G2] [CompactSpace G2] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G2]
    (f : G1 →* G2) (hf : Continuous f)
    (x : (((continuousCohomology (ZMod p) G2 1).obj
      (Action.trivial G2 (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))) : Type))) :
    (cohomologyOneEquivCocycles_explicit p G1)
      ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p G1 1).symm
        ((ContinuousCohomology.cohomologyMapTrivial (ZMod p) f hf
          (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)) 1).hom x)) =
      groupHomPullbackCocyclesOne p G1 G2 f hf
        ((cohomologyOneEquivCocycles_explicit p G2)
          ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p G2 1).symm x))
proof:
:= by
  let z₂ : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Cocycles p G2 1 :=
    (cohomologyOneEquivCocycles_explicit p G2)
      ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p G2 1).symm x)
  have hx :
      x = (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p G2 1)
        (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p G2 1 z₂) := by
    apply (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p G2 1).symm.injective
    apply (cohomologyOneEquivCocycles_explicit p G2).injective
    simpa only [z₂, (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p G2 1).symm_apply_apply] using
      (cohomologyOneEquivCocycles_explicit_classMap p G2 z₂).symm
  rw [hx]
  simpa only [z₂,
    (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p G2 1).symm_apply_apply,
    cohomologyOneEquivCocycles_explicit_classMap p G2 z₂] using
    cohomologyOneEquivCocycles_explicit_natural_classMap p G1 G2 f hf z₂

name: continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom_inhomog_naturality
statement:
theorem continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom_inhomog_naturality
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G1 G2 : Type) [Group G1] [TopologicalSpace G1] [IsTopologicalGroup G1]
    [T2Space G1] [CompactSpace G1] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G1]
    [Group G2] [TopologicalSpace G2] [IsTopologicalGroup G2]
    [T2Space G2] [CompactSpace G2] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G2]
    (f : G1 →* G2) (hf : Continuous f)
    (x : (((continuousCohomology (ZMod p) G2 1).obj
      (Action.trivial G2 (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))) : Type))) :
    continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom_inhomog (p := p) (K := G1)
        ((ContinuousCohomology.cohomologyMapTrivial (ZMod p) f hf
          (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)) 1).hom x) =
      (continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom_inhomog (p := p) (K := G2) x).comp
        ({ toFun := fun g => Additive.ofMul (f g.toMul)
           map_zero' := by simp
           map_add' := by intro a b; simp
           continuous_toFun := by simpa using hf } : Additive G1 →ₜ+ Additive G2)
proof:
:= by

  apply ContinuousAddMonoidHom.toAddMonoidHom_injective
  ext g
  let φ : Additive G1 →+ Additive G2 :=
    { toFun := fun h => Additive.ofMul (f h.toMul)
      map_zero' := by simp
      map_add' := by intro a b; simp }
  change
    cocyclesOneToHom p G1
        ((cohomologyOneEquivCocycles_explicit p G1)
          ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p G1 1).symm
            ((ContinuousCohomology.cohomologyMapTrivial (ZMod p) f hf
              (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)) 1).hom x))) g
      =
    ((cocyclesOneToHom p G2
        ((cohomologyOneEquivCocycles_explicit p G2)
          ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p G2 1).symm x))).comp φ) g
  rw [cohomologyOneEquivCocycles_explicit_natural]
  rw [cocyclesOneToHom_pullback_naturality]

name: h1ToHom_explicit_continuous
statement:
theorem h1ToHom_explicit_continuous (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G))
    (x : ErdosUnitDistance.H1ContsTrivial p G N) :
    Continuous (h1ToHom_explicit p G N hN x)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : CompactSpace ↥N := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hN.isCompact
  exact h1ToHom_explicit_general_continuous p ↥N x

name: h1ToHom_explicit_eq_inhomog_toAddMonoidHom
statement:
theorem h1ToHom_explicit_eq_inhomog_toAddMonoidHom (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G))
    (x : ErdosUnitDistance.H1ContsTrivial p G N) :
    haveI : CompactSpace ↥N
proof:
:= isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hN.isCompact
    h1ToHom_explicit p G N hN x =
      (continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom_inhomog p ↥N x).toAddMonoidHom := by
  haveI : CompactSpace ↥N := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hN.isCompact
  rfl

name: h1ToHom_explicit_conjugation_invariant
statement:
theorem h1ToHom_explicit_conjugation_invariant
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G))
    (χ : ↥(ErdosUnitDistance.h1NormalInvariantSubmodule p G N)) :
    ∀ g : G, (h1ToHom_explicit p G N hN χ.1).comp
        (MonoidHom.toAdditive
          ((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g).toMonoidHom)) =
      h1ToHom_explicit p G N hN χ.1
proof:
:= by

  intro g
  haveI : CompactSpace ↥N := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hN.isCompact
  let f : ↥N →* ↥N := (MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g).toMonoidHom
  have hcont : Continuous f := by
    refine continuous_induced_rng.2 ?_
    change Continuous (fun x : ↥N => g * (x : G) * g⁻¹)
    simpa [f, MulAut.conjNormal_apply, mul_assoc] using
      (continuous_const.mul continuous_subtype_val).mul
        (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : ↥N => (g⁻¹ : G))
  have hχ :
      ((ContinuousCohomology.cohomologyMapTrivial (ZMod p) f hcont
        (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)) 1).hom χ.1) = χ.1 := by
    simpa [f, ErdosUnitDistance.h1ConjMap] using χ.2 (g⁻¹)
  let F : Additive ↥N →ₜ+ Additive ↥N :=
    { toFun := fun a => Additive.ofMul (f a.toMul)
      map_zero' := by simp [f]
      map_add' := by
        intro a b
        simp [f]
      continuous_toFun := by simpa [f] using hcont }
  have hnat :=
    continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom_inhomog_naturality p ↥N ↥N f hcont χ.1
  have hχ' :
      continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom_inhomog p ↥N
          (((ContinuousCohomology.cohomologyMapTrivial (ZMod p) f hcont
            (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)) 1).hom χ.1)) =
        continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom_inhomog p ↥N χ.1 :=
    congrArg (continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom_inhomog p ↥N) hχ
  have hnat' :
      continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom_inhomog p ↥N χ.1 =
        (continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom_inhomog p ↥N χ.1).comp F := by
    calc
      continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom_inhomog p ↥N χ.1 =
          continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom_inhomog p ↥N
            (((ContinuousCohomology.cohomologyMapTrivial (ZMod p) f hcont
              (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)) 1).hom χ.1)) := by
            symm
            exact hχ'
      _ = (continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom_inhomog p ↥N χ.1).comp F := by
            simpa [F, f] using hnat
  simpa [h1ToHom_explicit_eq_inhomog_toAddMonoidHom, F, f] using
    congrArg ContinuousAddMonoidHom.toAddMonoidHom hnat'.symm
