            (restriction (p := p) (G := G) (N := N) 1).hom.toLinearMap).comap
        (h1NormalInvariantSubmodule p G N).subtype) ∧
    LinearMap.ker (inflation (p := p) (G := G) (N := N) 2).hom.toLinearMap =
      LinearMap.range (transgression (p := p) (G := G) (N := N) hN)
proof:
:=
  ⟨inflation_H1_injective (p := p) (G := G) (N := N),
   exact_at_H1G (p := p) (G := G) (N := N) hN,
   exact_at_H1N_invariants (p := p) (G := G) (N := N) hN,
   exact_at_H2GN (p := p) (G := G) (N := N) hN⟩

name: relationRankBound_of_five_term
statement:
theorem relationRankBound_of_five_term [SecondCountableTopology G]
    (_hG : IsFinitelyGeneratedProPGroup p G)
    (hH2 : H2Finite p G)
    (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G))
    (hH1Fin : H1NormalInvariantFinite p G N) :
    H2Finite p (G ⧸ N) ∧
      relationRank p (G ⧸ N) ≤ relationRank p G + h1NormalInvariantRank p G N
proof:
:= by

  let inf : (H p 2 (G ⧸ N) : Type) →ₗ[ZMod p] (H p 2 G : Type) :=
    (inflation (p := p) (G := G) (N := N) 2).hom.toLinearMap

  let tg : ↥(h1NormalInvariantSubmodule p G N) →ₗ[ZMod p] (H p 2 (G ⧸ N) : Type) :=
    transgression (p := p) (G := G) (N := N) hN

  have hM' : FiniteDimensional (ZMod p) (H p 2 G : Type) := hH2
  have _hInvFin : FiniteDimensional (ZMod p) ↥(h1NormalInvariantSubmodule p G N) :=
    hH1Fin

  have hExact : LinearMap.ker inf ≤ LinearMap.range tg :=
    (exact_at_H2GN (p := p) (G := G) (N := N) hN).le

  have hKerLe : Module.finrank (ZMod p) ↥(LinearMap.ker inf) ≤
      h1NormalInvariantRank p G N := by
    calc Module.finrank (ZMod p) ↥(LinearMap.ker inf)
        ≤ Module.finrank (ZMod p) ↥(LinearMap.range tg) :=
          Submodule.finrank_mono hExact
      _ ≤ Module.finrank (ZMod p) ↥(h1NormalInvariantSubmodule p G N) :=
          LinearMap.finrank_range_le tg
      _ = h1NormalInvariantRank p G N := rfl

  have hRangeLe : Module.finrank (ZMod p) ↥(LinearMap.range inf) ≤
      relationRank p G := Submodule.finrank_le _

  have hKerFin : FiniteDimensional (ZMod p) ↥(LinearMap.ker inf) :=
    Module.Finite.of_injective ((LinearMap.ker inf).inclusion hExact)
      (Submodule.inclusion_injective hExact)

  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (LinearMap.ker inf).exists_isCompl
  have hCEquivQuot :
      ↥C ≃ₗ[ZMod p] ((H p 2 (G ⧸ N) : Type) ⧸ LinearMap.ker inf) :=
    ((LinearMap.ker inf).quotientEquivOfIsCompl C hC).symm
  have hQuotRange :
      ((H p 2 (G ⧸ N) : Type) ⧸ LinearMap.ker inf) ≃ₗ[ZMod p]
        ↥(LinearMap.range inf) :=
    inf.quotKerEquivRange
  have hCFin : FiniteDimensional (ZMod p) ↥C :=
    Module.Finite.equiv (hCEquivQuot.trans hQuotRange).symm
  have hMEquiv :
      (↥(LinearMap.ker inf) × ↥C) ≃ₗ[ZMod p] (H p 2 (G ⧸ N) : Type) :=
    Submodule.prodEquivOfIsCompl _ _ hC
  have hMFin : FiniteDimensional (ZMod p) (H p 2 (G ⧸ N) : Type) :=
    Module.Finite.equiv hMEquiv
  refine ⟨hMFin, ?_⟩

  have hFinrankM : Module.finrank (ZMod p) (H p 2 (G ⧸ N) : Type) =
      Module.finrank (ZMod p) ↥(LinearMap.ker inf) +
        Module.finrank (ZMod p) ↥(LinearMap.range inf) := by
    rw [← hMEquiv.finrank_eq, Module.finrank_prod, hCEquivQuot.finrank_eq,
      hQuotRange.finrank_eq]
  change relationRank p (G ⧸ N) ≤ relationRank p G + h1NormalInvariantRank p G N
  calc relationRank p (G ⧸ N)
      = Module.finrank (ZMod p) (H p 2 (G ⧸ N) : Type) := rfl
    _ = Module.finrank (ZMod p) ↥(LinearMap.ker inf) +
          Module.finrank (ZMod p) ↥(LinearMap.range inf) := hFinrankM
    _ ≤ h1NormalInvariantRank p G N + relationRank p G :=
          Nat.add_le_add hKerLe hRangeLe
    _ = relationRank p G + h1NormalInvariantRank p G N := by ring

name: conjInvariantHom_eval_injective_normalClosure
statement:
theorem conjInvariantHom_eval_injective_normalClosure (A : Type*) (G : Type*) [CommGroup A] [Group G] (n : ℕ) (gens : Fin n → G) :
    let N : Subgroup G
proof:
:= Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range gens)
    let eval : {φ : N →* A // ∀ g : G, φ.comp ((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g).toMonoidHom) = φ} → Fin n → A := fun φ i => φ.1 ⟨gens i, Subgroup.subset_normalClosure ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩
    Function.Injective eval := by
  classical
  dsimp
  intro φ ψ h
  rcases φ with ⟨φ, hφ⟩
  rcases ψ with ⟨ψ, hψ⟩
  have hgen_eq (i : Fin n) :
      φ ⟨gens i, Subgroup.subset_normalClosure (s := Set.range gens) ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩ =
        ψ ⟨gens i, Subgroup.subset_normalClosure (s := Set.range gens) ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩ := by
    exact congrFun h i
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext x
  have hx : x.1 ∈ Subgroup.closure (Group.conjugatesOfSet (Set.range gens)) := by
    simpa [Subgroup.normalClosure] using x.2
  have hEq :
      ∀ g (hg : g ∈ Subgroup.closure (Group.conjugatesOfSet (Set.range gens))),
        ∀ hgN : g ∈ Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range gens),
          φ ⟨g, hgN⟩ = ψ ⟨g, hgN⟩ := by
    intro g hg
    refine Subgroup.closure_induction
      (k := Group.conjugatesOfSet (Set.range gens))
      (p := fun g _ =>
        ∀ hgN : g ∈ Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range gens),
          φ ⟨g, hgN⟩ = ψ ⟨g, hgN⟩) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hg
    · intro y hy hyN
      rcases (Group.mem_conjugatesOfSet_iff.mp hy) with ⟨a, ha, hconj⟩
      rcases ha with ⟨i, rfl⟩
      rcases (isConj_iff.mp hconj) with ⟨c, rfl⟩
      have hconjElt :
          ((MulAut.conjNormal (H := Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range gens)) c)
            ⟨gens i, Subgroup.subset_normalClosure (s := Set.range gens) ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩) =
            ⟨c * gens i * c⁻¹, hyN⟩ := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        simp [MulAut.conjNormal_apply]
      have hφc :=
        congrArg
          (fun f =>
            f ⟨gens i, Subgroup.subset_normalClosure (s := Set.range gens) ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩)
          (hφ c)
      have hψc :=
        congrArg
          (fun f =>
            f ⟨gens i, Subgroup.subset_normalClosure (s := Set.range gens) ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩)
          (hψ c)
      have hφc' :
          φ ⟨c * gens i * c⁻¹, hyN⟩ =
            φ ⟨gens i, Subgroup.subset_normalClosure (s := Set.range gens) ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩ := by
        simpa [MonoidHom.comp_apply, hconjElt] using hφc
      have hψc' :
          ψ ⟨c * gens i * c⁻¹, hyN⟩ =
            ψ ⟨gens i, Subgroup.subset_normalClosure (s := Set.range gens) ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩ := by
        simpa [MonoidHom.comp_apply, hconjElt] using hψc
      calc
        φ ⟨c * gens i * c⁻¹, hyN⟩ = φ ⟨gens i, Subgroup.subset_normalClosure (s := Set.range gens) ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩ := hφc'
        _ = ψ ⟨gens i, Subgroup.subset_normalClosure (s := Set.range gens) ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩ := hgen_eq i
        _ = ψ ⟨c * gens i * c⁻¹, hyN⟩ := hψc'.symm
    · intro h1N
      have hone : (⟨1, h1N⟩ : Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range gens)) = 1 := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        rfl
      calc
        φ ⟨1, h1N⟩ = φ 1 := by rw [hone]
        _ = 1 := φ.map_one
        _ = ψ 1 := by symm; exact ψ.map_one
        _ = ψ ⟨1, h1N⟩ := by rw [hone]
    · intro a b ha hb hPa hPb habN
      have haN : a ∈ Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range gens) := by
        simpa [Subgroup.normalClosure] using ha
      have hbN : b ∈ Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range gens) := by
        simpa [Subgroup.normalClosure] using hb
      have hmul :
          (⟨a * b, habN⟩ : Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range gens)) =
            ⟨a, haN⟩ * ⟨b, hbN⟩ := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        rfl
      calc
        φ ⟨a * b, habN⟩ = φ (⟨a, haN⟩ * ⟨b, hbN⟩) := by rw [hmul]
        _ = φ ⟨a, haN⟩ * φ ⟨b, hbN⟩ := by
          simpa using MonoidHom.map_mul φ ⟨a, haN⟩ ⟨b, hbN⟩
        _ = ψ ⟨a, haN⟩ * ψ ⟨b, hbN⟩ := by rw [hPa haN, hPb hbN]
        _ = ψ (⟨a, haN⟩ * ⟨b, hbN⟩) := by
          symm
          simpa using MonoidHom.map_mul ψ ⟨a, haN⟩ ⟨b, hbN⟩
        _ = ψ ⟨a * b, habN⟩ := by rw [hmul]
    · intro a ha hPa haInvN
      have haN : a ∈ Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range gens) := by
        simpa [Subgroup.normalClosure] using ha
      have hinv :
          (⟨a⁻¹, haInvN⟩ : Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range gens)) =
            (⟨a, haN⟩)⁻¹ := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        rfl
      calc
        φ ⟨a⁻¹, haInvN⟩ = φ ((⟨a, haN⟩ : Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range gens))⁻¹) := by
          rw [hinv]
        _ = (φ ⟨a, haN⟩)⁻¹ := by
          simpa using MonoidHom.map_inv φ ⟨a, haN⟩
        _ = (ψ ⟨a, haN⟩)⁻¹ := by rw [hPa haN]
        _ = ψ ((⟨a, haN⟩ : Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range gens))⁻¹) := by
          symm
          simpa using MonoidHom.map_inv ψ ⟨a, haN⟩
        _ = ψ ⟨a⁻¹, haInvN⟩ := by rw [hinv]
  exact hEq x.1 hx x.2

name: finrank_middle_le_left_add_right_of_exact
statement: theorem finrank_middle_le_left_add_right_of_exact (k : Type*) [Field k] {V₁ V₂ V₃ : Type*} [AddCommGroup V₁] [Module k V₁] [FiniteDimensional k V₁] [AddCommGroup V₂] [Module k V₂] [FiniteDimensional k V₂] [AddCommGroup V₃] [Module k V₃] [FiniteDimensional k V₃] (f : V₁ →ₗ[k] V₂) (g : V₂ →ₗ[k] V₃) (hfg : Function.Exact f g) : Module.finrank k V₂ ≤ Module.finrank k V₁ + Module.finrank k V₃
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker g]
  rw [Function.Exact.linearMap_ker_eq hfg]
  have hf : Module.finrank k ↥(LinearMap.range f) ≤ Module.finrank k V₁ := LinearMap.finrank_range_le f
  have hg : Module.finrank k ↥(LinearMap.range g) ≤ Module.finrank k V₃ := Submodule.finrank_le _
  omega

name: quotientGroupExtension_conjAct_eq_conjNormal
statement: theorem quotientGroupExtension_conjAct_eq_conjNormal (G : Type*) [Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (g : G) : (quotientGroupExtension G N).conjAct g = MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simpa [quotientGroupExtension, MulAut.conjNormal_apply] using
    ((quotientGroupExtension G N).inl_conjAct_comm (e := g) (n := n))

name: quotientSectionDefect_spec
statement: theorem quotientSectionDefect_spec (G : Type*) [Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (x y : G ⧸ N) : ↑(quotientSectionDefect G N (x, y)) = quotientGroupSection G N x * quotientGroupSection G N y * (quotientGroupSection G N (x * y))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold quotientSectionDefect
  simpa [quotientGroupSection, quotientGroupExtension] using
    (Classical.choose_spec
      (show ∃ n : N,
          (quotientGroupExtension G N).inl n =
            quotientGroupSection G N x * quotientGroupSection G N y *
              (quotientGroupSection G N (x * y))⁻¹ from by
        simpa [MonoidHom.mem_range, quotientGroupSection, quotientGroupExtension] using
          (GroupExtension.Section.mul_mul_mul_inv_mem_range_inl
            (S := quotientGroupExtension G N)
            (σ := quotientGroupSection G N) (g₁ := x) (g₂ := y))))

name: quotientSectionRemainder_mul
statement: theorem quotientSectionRemainder_mul (G : Type*) [Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (g h : G) : quotientSectionRemainder G N (g * h) = quotientSectionRemainder G N g * (MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) (quotientGroupSection G N ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g)) (quotientSectionRemainder G N h)) * quotientSectionDefect G N (((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g), ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) h))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Subtype.ext
  change
    ((g * h) * (quotientGroupSection G N ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) (g * h)))⁻¹ : G) =
      ((g * (quotientGroupSection G N ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g))⁻¹) *
          ↑(MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) (quotientGroupSection G N ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g))
            (quotientSectionRemainder G N h)) *
          ↑(quotientSectionDefect G N
            ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g, (QuotientGroup.mk' N) h)) : G)
  rw [MulAut.conjNormal_apply]
  rw [quotientSectionDefect_spec]
  change
    (g * h) * (quotientGroupSection G N ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) (g * h)))⁻¹ =
      (g * (quotientGroupSection G N ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g))⁻¹) *
        (quotientGroupSection G N ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g) *
          ↑(quotientSectionRemainder G N h) *
          (quotientGroupSection G N ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g))⁻¹) *
        (quotientGroupSection G N ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g) *
          quotientGroupSection G N ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) h) *
          (quotientGroupSection G N ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g * (QuotientGroup.mk' N) h))⁻¹)
  change
    (g * h) * (quotientGroupSection G N ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) (g * h)))⁻¹ =
      (g * (quotientGroupSection G N ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g))⁻¹) *
        (quotientGroupSection G N ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g) *
          (h * (quotientGroupSection G N ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) h))⁻¹) *
          (quotientGroupSection G N ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g))⁻¹) *
        (quotientGroupSection G N ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g) *
          quotientGroupSection G N ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) h) *
          (quotientGroupSection G N ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g * (QuotientGroup.mk' N) h))⁻¹)
  rw [map_mul]
  group

name: inflation_restriction_H1_exact
statement: theorem inflation_restriction_H1_exact (k G : Type) [CommRing k] [Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] : (groupCohomology.H1InfRes (trivialCoeffRep k G) N).Exact
proof:
:= by
  simpa [trivialCoeffRep] using groupCohomology.H1InfRes_exact (A := trivialCoeffRep k G) (S := N)

name: inflation_restriction_H1_exact_zmod
statement: theorem inflation_restriction_H1_exact_zmod (p : ℕ) (G : Type) [Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] : (groupCohomology.H1InfRes (trivialCoeffRep (ZMod p) G) N).Exact

name: inflation_restriction_H1_injective_zmod
statement: theorem inflation_restriction_H1_injective_zmod (p : ℕ) (G : Type) [Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] : Function.Injective ((groupCohomology.H1InfRes (trivialCoeffRep (ZMod p) G) N).f)
proof:

name: exists_lift_of_transgressionFactor_isMulCoboundary
statement: theorem exists_lift_of_transgressionFactor_isMulCoboundary (A : Type*) (G : Type*) [CommGroup A] [Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (χ : N →* A) (hχ : ∀ g : G, χ.comp ((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g).toMonoidHom) = χ) : (letI := trivialMulDistribMulAction (G ⧸ N) A; groupCohomology.IsMulCoboundary₂ (quotientTransgressionFactor A G N χ)) → ∃ ψ : G →* A, ψ.comp N.subtype = χ
proof:
:= by
  intro hcb
  classical
  letI := trivialMulDistribMulAction (G ⧸ N) A
  rcases hcb with ⟨b, hb⟩
  have hb1 : b 1 = χ (quotientSectionDefect G N (1, 1)) := by
    simpa [quotientTransgressionFactor, div_eq_mul_inv] using hb 1 1
  have hb_mul : ∀ x y : G ⧸ N,
      χ (quotientSectionDefect G N (x, y)) * b (x * y) = b x * b y := by
    intro x y
    have hxy := congrArg (fun a : A => a * b (x * y)) (hb x y)
    simpa [quotientTransgressionFactor, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using hxy.symm
  have hdef11 : ↑(quotientSectionDefect G N (1, 1)) = quotientGroupSection G N 1 := by
    simpa using quotientSectionDefect_spec G N (1 : G ⧸ N) 1
  have h_ext_aux : ∀ n : N, χ (quotientSectionRemainder G N (n : G)) * b 1 = χ n := by
    intro n
    have hqn : (QuotientGroup.mk' N) (n : G) = 1 := by
      exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := N) (x := (n : G))).mpr n.property
    have hmul : quotientSectionRemainder G N (n : G) * quotientSectionDefect G N (1, 1) = n := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (((n : G) * (quotientGroupSection G N ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) (n : G)))⁻¹) *
          quotientSectionDefect G N (1, 1) : G) = (n : G)
      rw [hqn, hdef11]
      simp [mul_assoc]
    calc
      χ (quotientSectionRemainder G N (n : G)) * b 1
          = χ (quotientSectionRemainder G N (n : G)) * χ (quotientSectionDefect G N (1, 1)) := by
              rw [hb1]
      _ = χ (quotientSectionRemainder G N (n : G) * quotientSectionDefect G N (1, 1)) := by
            rw [← χ.map_mul]
      _ = χ n := by rw [hmul]
  let ψ : G →* A :=
    { toFun := fun g => χ (quotientSectionRemainder G N g) * b ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g)
      map_one' := by
        simpa using h_ext_aux (1 : N)
      map_mul' := by
        intro g h
        have hconj :
            χ
                (MulAut.conjNormal (H := N)
                  (quotientGroupSection G N ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g))
                  (quotientSectionRemainder G N h)) =
              χ (quotientSectionRemainder G N h) := by
          have hcomp := congrArg (fun f : N →* A => f (quotientSectionRemainder G N h))
            (hχ (quotientGroupSection G N ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g)))
          simpa using hcomp
        have hrχ :
            χ (quotientSectionRemainder G N (g * h)) =
              χ (quotientSectionRemainder G N g) * χ (quotientSectionRemainder G N h) *
                χ (quotientSectionDefect G N (((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g), ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) h))) := by
          rw [quotientSectionRemainder_mul, χ.map_mul, χ.map_mul, hconj]
        have hbxy :
            χ (quotientSectionDefect G N (((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g), ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) h))) *
                b ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g * (QuotientGroup.mk' N) h) =
              b ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g) * b ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) h) :=
          hb_mul ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g) ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) h)
        rw [map_mul]
        calc
          χ (quotientSectionRemainder G N (g * h)) * b ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g * (QuotientGroup.mk' N) h)
              = (χ (quotientSectionRemainder G N g) * χ (quotientSectionRemainder G N h) *
                  χ (quotientSectionDefect G N (((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g), ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) h)))) *
                  b ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g * (QuotientGroup.mk' N) h) := by
                  rw [hrχ]
          _ = χ (quotientSectionRemainder G N g) * χ (quotientSectionRemainder G N h) *
                (χ (quotientSectionDefect G N (((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g), ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) h))) *
                  b ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g * (QuotientGroup.mk' N) h)) := by
                simp [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]
          _ = χ (quotientSectionRemainder G N g) * χ (quotientSectionRemainder G N h) *
                (b ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g) * b ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) h)) := by
                rw [hbxy]
          _ = (χ (quotientSectionRemainder G N g) * b ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g)) *
                (χ (quotientSectionRemainder G N h) * b ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) h)) := by
                simp [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] }
  refine ⟨ψ, ?_⟩
  ext n
  change χ (quotientSectionRemainder G N ↑n) * b ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) ↑n) = χ n
  have hqn : (QuotientGroup.mk' N) (↑n) = 1 := by
    exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := N) (x := (n : G))).mpr n.property
  rw [hqn]
  exact h_ext_aux n

name: inflatedQuotientTransgressionFactor_isMulCoboundary
statement: theorem inflatedQuotientTransgressionFactor_isMulCoboundary (A G : Type) [CommGroup A] [Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (χ : N →* A) (hχ : ∀ g : G, χ.comp ((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g).toMonoidHom) = χ) : letI
proof:
:= trivialMulDistribMulAction G A; groupCohomology.IsMulCoboundary₂ (inflatedQuotientTransgressionFactor A G N χ) := by
  letI := trivialMulDistribMulAction G A
  refine ⟨fun g => (χ (quotientSectionRemainder G N g))⁻¹, ?_⟩
  intro g h
  dsimp [inflatedQuotientTransgressionFactor, quotientTransgressionFactor]
  change (χ (quotientSectionRemainder G N h))⁻¹ / (χ (quotientSectionRemainder G N (g * h)))⁻¹ * (χ (quotientSectionRemainder G N g))⁻¹ = _
  have hmul := quotientSectionRemainder_mul G N g h
  have hmulχ := by
    simpa [map_mul, mul_assoc] using congrArg χ hmul
  have hχconj :
      χ (MulAut.conjNormal (H := N)
          (quotientGroupSection G N ((g : G ⧸ N)))
          (quotientSectionRemainder G N h)) =
        χ (quotientSectionRemainder G N h) := by
    simpa using congrArg
      (fun f : N →* A => f (quotientSectionRemainder G N h))
      (hχ (quotientGroupSection G N ((g : G ⧸ N))))
  rw [hmulχ, hχconj]
  simp [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]

name: exists_conjInvariantHom_and_sectionCochain_of_normalized_inflated_coboundary
statement:
theorem exists_conjInvariantHom_and_sectionCochain_of_normalized_inflated_coboundary (A G : Type) [CommGroup A] [Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]
    (f : groupCohomology.cocycles₂ (quotientTrivialMulRep A G N))
    (hf1 : ∀ q : G ⧸ N, f (1, q) = 0)
    (hf2 : ∀ q : G ⧸ N, f (q, 1) = 0)
    (hinfl : letI := trivialMulDistribMulAction G A;
      groupCohomology.IsMulCoboundary₂
        (fun gh : G × G =>
          Additive.toMul
            (show Additive A from f ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) gh.1, (QuotientGroup.mk' N) gh.2)))) :
    ∃ χ : ConjInvariantHom A G N, ∃ u : G ⧸ N → A,
      ∀ x y : G ⧸ N,
        Additive.toMul (show Additive A from f (x, y)) =
          u y / u (x * y) * u x * quotientTransgressionFactor A G N χ.1 (x, y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI := trivialMulDistribMulAction G A
  rcases hinfl with ⟨b, hb⟩
  have hb' :
      ∀ g h : G,
        b h / b (g * h) * b g =
          Additive.toMul
            (show Additive A from f ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g, (QuotientGroup.mk' N) h)) := by
    intro g h
    simpa using hb g h
  have hnq : ∀ n : N, QuotientGroup.mk' N (n : G) = 1 := by
    intro n
    simpa using DFunLike.congr_fun (QuotientGroup.mk'_comp_subtype (N := N)) n
  have hf1mul : ∀ q : G ⧸ N, Additive.toMul (show Additive A from f (1, q)) = (1 : A) := by
    intro q
    simpa [hf1 q]
  have hf2mul : ∀ q : G ⧸ N, Additive.toMul (show Additive A from f (q, 1)) = (1 : A) := by
    intro q
    simpa [hf2 q]
  have hb_one : b 1 = 1 := by
    have h := hb' (1 : G) 1
    simpa using h.trans (hf1mul (1 : G ⧸ N))
  have hb_leftN : ∀ n : N, ∀ g : G, b ((n : G) * g) = b n * b g := by
    intro n g
    have h : b g / b ((n : G) * g) * b n = 1 := by
      have h0 := hb' (n : G) g
      rw [hnq n] at h0
      exact h0.trans (hf1mul ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g))
    have h' := congrArg (fun z : A => z * b ((n : G) * g)) h
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using h'.symm
  have hb_rightN : ∀ g : G, ∀ n : N, b (g * n) = b g * b n := by
    intro g n
    have h : b n / b (g * (n : G)) * b g = 1 := by
      have h0 := hb' g (n : G)
      rw [hnq n] at h0
      exact h0.trans (hf2mul ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g))
    have h' := congrArg (fun z : A => z * b (g * (n : G))) h
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using h'.symm
  have hb_mulN : ∀ n1 n2 : N, b ((n1 : G) * n2) = b n1 * b n2 := by
    intro n1 n2
    simpa using hb_leftN n1 (n2 : G)
  let χ0 : N →* A :=
    { toFun := fun n => (b n)⁻¹
      map_one' := by
        change (b (1 : G))⁻¹ = 1
        simp [hb_one]
      map_mul' := by
        intro n1 n2
        change (b ((n1 : G) * n2))⁻¹ = (b n1)⁻¹ * (b n2)⁻¹
        rw [hb_mulN n1 n2]
        simp [mul_comm] }
  let σ := quotientGroupSection G N
  let u : G ⧸ N → A := fun q => b (σ q)
  refine ⟨⟨χ0, ?_⟩, u, ?_⟩
  · intro g
    ext n
    change (b ((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g) n))⁻¹ = (b n)⁻¹
    have hleft : b (g * (n : G)) = b ((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g) n) * b g := by
      simpa [MulAut.conjNormal_apply, mul_assoc] using
        (hb_leftN ((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g) n) g)
    have hright : b (g * (n : G)) = b g * b n := by
      simpa using hb_rightN g n
    have hcomp : b ((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g) n) * b g = b n * b g := by
      exact hleft.symm.trans (by simpa [mul_comm] using hright)
    have hEq' := congrArg (fun z : A => z * (b g)⁻¹) hcomp
    have hEq : b ((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g) n) = b n := by
      simpa [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using hEq'
    simpa using congrArg Inv.inv hEq
  · intro x y
    have hsecx : QuotientGroup.mk' N (σ x) = x := by
      simpa [σ, quotientGroupSection, quotientGroupExtension] using
        (GroupExtension.Section.rightHom_section
          (S := quotientGroupExtension G N) (σ := quotientGroupSection G N) x)
    have hsecy : QuotientGroup.mk' N (σ y) = y := by
      simpa [σ, quotientGroupSection, quotientGroupExtension] using
        (GroupExtension.Section.rightHom_section
          (S := quotientGroupExtension G N) (σ := quotientGroupSection G N) y)
    have hmain : u y / b (σ x * σ y) * u x =
        Additive.toMul (show Additive A from f (x, y)) := by
      simpa [u, σ, hsecx, hsecy] using hb' (σ x) (σ y)
    have hdefmul : σ x * σ y = (quotientSectionDefect G N (x, y) : G) * σ (x * y) := by
      have h := congrArg (fun z : G => z * σ (x * y)) (quotientSectionDefect_spec G N x y)
      simpa [σ, mul_assoc] using h.symm
    have hbdef : b (σ x * σ y) = b (quotientSectionDefect G N (x, y)) * u (x * y) := by
      rw [hdefmul]
      simpa [u, σ] using hb_leftN (quotientSectionDefect G N (x, y)) (σ (x * y))
    calc
      Additive.toMul (show Additive A from f (x, y))
          = u y / b (σ x * σ y) * u x := by
            simpa using hmain.symm
      _ = u y / (b (quotientSectionDefect G N (x, y)) * u (x * y)) * u x := by
            rw [hbdef]
      _ = u y / u (x * y) * u x * quotientTransgressionFactor A G N χ0 (x, y) := by
            simp [u, σ, χ0, quotientTransgressionFactor, div_eq_mul_inv,
              mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]

name: quotientH2_exists_normalized_cocycle
statement:
theorem quotientH2_exists_normalized_cocycle (A G : Type) [CommGroup A] [Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]
    (x : groupCohomology.H2 (quotientTrivialMulRep A G N)) :
    ∃ f : groupCohomology.cocycles₂ (quotientTrivialMulRep A G N),
      groupCohomology.H2π (quotientTrivialMulRep A G N) f = x ∧
        (∀ q : G ⧸ N, f (1, q) = 0) ∧
        (∀ q : G ⧸ N, f (q, 1) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI := trivialMulDistribMulAction (G ⧸ N) A
  change groupCohomology.H2 (Rep.ofMulDistribMulAction (G ⧸ N) A) at x
  change
    ∃ f : groupCohomology.cocycles₂ (Rep.ofMulDistribMulAction (G ⧸ N) A),
      groupCohomology.H2π (Rep.ofMulDistribMulAction (G ⧸ N) A) f = x ∧
        (∀ q : G ⧸ N, f (1, q) = 0) ∧
        (∀ q : G ⧸ N, f (q, 1) = 0)
  refine groupCohomology.H2_induction_on x ?_
  intro z
  let c : A := Additive.toMul (z (1, 1))
  have hcob : groupCohomology.IsMulCoboundary₂ (fun _ : (G ⧸ N) × (G ⧸ N) => c⁻¹) := by
    refine ⟨fun _ : G ⧸ N => c⁻¹, ?_⟩
    intro g h
    change c⁻¹ / c⁻¹ * c⁻¹ = c⁻¹
    simp
  let b : groupCohomology.coboundaries₂ (Rep.ofMulDistribMulAction (G ⧸ N) A) :=
    groupCohomology.coboundariesOfIsMulCoboundary₂ hcob
  let f : groupCohomology.cocycles₂ (Rep.ofMulDistribMulAction (G ⧸ N) A) :=
    z + groupCohomology.coboundariesToCocycles₂ _ b
  refine ⟨f, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [groupCohomology.H2π_eq_iff]
    have hdiff : ⇑f - ⇑z = ⇑b := by
      ext p
      change z p + b p - z p = b p
      abel
    rw [hdiff]
    exact b.2
  · intro q
    have hz : z (1, q) = z (1, 1) := groupCohomology.cocycles₂_map_one_fst z q
    have hb : b (1, q) = - z (1, 1) := by
      rfl
    change z (1, q) + b (1, q) = 0
    rw [hz, hb]
    abel
  · intro q
    have hz : z (q, 1) = z (1, 1) := by
      simpa [Rep.ofMulDistribMulAction_ρ_apply_apply, c] using
        groupCohomology.cocycles₂_map_one_snd z q
    have hb : b (q, 1) = - z (1, 1) := by
      rfl
    change z (q, 1) + b (q, 1) = 0
    rw [hz, hb]
    abel

name: normalized_quotientCocycle_class_eq_transgressionMap_of_inflated_coboundary
statement:
theorem normalized_quotientCocycle_class_eq_transgressionMap_of_inflated_coboundary (A G : Type) [CommGroup A] [Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]
    (f : groupCohomology.cocycles₂ (quotientTrivialMulRep A G N))
    (hf1 : ∀ q : G ⧸ N, f (1, q) = 0)
    (hf2 : ∀ q : G ⧸ N, f (q, 1) = 0)
    (hinfl : letI := trivialMulDistribMulAction G A;
      groupCohomology.IsMulCoboundary₂
        (fun gh : G × G =>
          Additive.toMul
            (show Additive A from f ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) gh.1, (QuotientGroup.mk' N) gh.2)))) :
    ∃ χ : ConjInvariantHom A G N,
      groupCohomology.H2π (quotientTrivialMulRep A G N) f = quotientTransgressionMap A G N χ
proof:
:= by
  rcases
      exists_conjInvariantHom_and_sectionCochain_of_normalized_inflated_coboundary
        A G N f hf1 hf2 hinfl with ⟨χ, u, hu⟩
  refine ⟨χ, ?_⟩
  rw [quotientTransgressionMap, quotientTransgressionClass]
  apply
    (groupCohomology.H2π_eq_iff (A := quotientTrivialMulRep A G N) f
      (quotientTransgressionCocycle A G N χ.1 χ.2)).2
  letI := trivialMulDistribMulAction (G ⧸ N) A
  change
    (Additive.ofMul ∘ fun xy : (G ⧸ N) × (G ⧸ N) =>
      Additive.toMul
        (show Additive A from
          f xy - quotientTransgressionCocycle A G N χ.1 χ.2 xy)) ∈
      groupCohomology.coboundaries₂ (Rep.ofMulDistribMulAction (G ⧸ N) A)
  refine
    (groupCohomology.coboundariesOfIsMulCoboundary₂
      (f := fun xy : (G ⧸ N) × (G ⧸ N) =>
        Additive.toMul
          (show Additive A from
            f xy - quotientTransgressionCocycle A G N χ.1 χ.2 xy)) ?_).property
  refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
  intro x y
  have htrans :
      Additive.toMul
          (show Additive A from
            quotientTransgressionCocycle A G N χ.1 χ.2 (x, y)) =
        quotientTransgressionFactor A G N χ.1 (x, y) := by
    unfold quotientTransgressionCocycle
    rfl
  calc
    u y / u (x * y) * u x =
        (u y / u (x * y) * u x * quotientTransgressionFactor A G N χ.1 (x, y)) /
          quotientTransgressionFactor A G N χ.1 (x, y) := by
      simp [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]
    _ =
        Additive.toMul (show Additive A from f (x, y)) /
          quotientTransgressionFactor A G N χ.1 (x, y) := by
      rw [hu x y]
    _ =
        Additive.toMul (show Additive A from f (x, y)) /
          Additive.toMul
            (show Additive A from
              quotientTransgressionCocycle A G N χ.1 χ.2 (x, y)) := by
      rw [htrans]
    _ =
        Additive.toMul
          (show Additive A from
            f (x, y) - quotientTransgressionCocycle A G N χ.1 χ.2 (x, y)) := by
      rfl

name: transgressionFactor_isMulCoboundary_of_exists_lift
statement: theorem transgressionFactor_isMulCoboundary_of_exists_lift (A : Type*) (G : Type*) [CommGroup A] [Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (χ : N →* A) : (∃ ψ : G →* A, ψ.comp N.subtype = χ) → letI
proof:
:= trivialMulDistribMulAction (G ⧸ N) A; groupCohomology.IsMulCoboundary₂ (quotientTransgressionFactor A G N χ) := by
  intro hχ
  classical
  letI := trivialMulDistribMulAction (G ⧸ N) A
  rcases hχ with ⟨ψ, hψ⟩
  refine ⟨fun q => ψ (quotientGroupSection G N q), ?_⟩
  intro x y
  dsimp [quotientTransgressionFactor]
  have hdef := quotientSectionDefect_spec G N x y
  have hcomp := congrArg (fun f => f (quotientSectionDefect G N (x, y))) hψ
  dsimp [MonoidHom.comp] at hcomp
  change ψ ((quotientGroupSection G N) y) / ψ ((quotientGroupSection G N) (x * y)) *
      ψ ((quotientGroupSection G N) x) = χ (quotientSectionDefect G N (x, y))
  rw [← hcomp, hdef]
  simp [map_mul, map_inv, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]

name: transgressionFactor_isMulCoboundary_iff_exists_lift
statement: theorem transgressionFactor_isMulCoboundary_iff_exists_lift (A : Type*) (G : Type*) [CommGroup A] [Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (χ : N →* A) (hχ : ∀ g : G, χ.comp ((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g).toMonoidHom) = χ) : letI
proof:
:= trivialMulDistribMulAction (G ⧸ N) A; groupCohomology.IsMulCoboundary₂ (quotientTransgressionFactor A G N χ) ↔ ∃ ψ : G →* A, ψ.comp N.subtype = χ := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact exists_lift_of_transgressionFactor_isMulCoboundary A G N χ hχ h
  · intro h
    exact transgressionFactor_isMulCoboundary_of_exists_lift A G N χ h

name: quotientTransgressionClass_eq_zero_iff_exists_lift
statement: theorem quotientTransgressionClass_eq_zero_iff_exists_lift (A G : Type) [CommGroup A] [Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (χ : N →* A) (hχ : ∀ g : G, χ.comp ((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g).toMonoidHom) = χ) : quotientTransgressionClass A G N χ hχ = 0 ↔ ∃ ψ : G →* A, ψ.comp N.subtype = χ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h0
    letI := trivialMulDistribMulAction (G ⧸ N) A
    have hmem :
        ⇑(quotientTransgressionCocycle A G N χ hχ) ∈
          groupCohomology.coboundaries₂ (quotientTrivialMulRep A G N) := by
      exact
        (groupCohomology.H2π_eq_zero_iff
          (A := quotientTrivialMulRep A G N)
          (x := quotientTransgressionCocycle A G N χ hχ)).1 (by
            simpa [quotientTransgressionClass] using h0)
    have hcb : groupCohomology.IsMulCoboundary₂ (quotientTransgressionFactor A G N χ) := by
      simpa [Function.comp_def] using
        (groupCohomology.isMulCoboundary₂_of_mem_coboundaries₂
          (f := quotientTransgressionFactor A G N χ) (by
            simpa [quotientTransgressionCocycle, quotientTrivialMulRep,
              Rep.ofMulDistribMulAction, Function.comp_def] using hmem))
    exact (transgressionFactor_isMulCoboundary_iff_exists_lift A G N χ hχ).1 hcb
  · rintro ⟨ψ, hψ⟩
    letI := trivialMulDistribMulAction (G ⧸ N) A
    have hcb : groupCohomology.IsMulCoboundary₂ (quotientTransgressionFactor A G N χ) := by
      exact (transgressionFactor_isMulCoboundary_iff_exists_lift A G N χ hχ).2 ⟨ψ, hψ⟩
    have hmem :
        ⇑(quotientTransgressionCocycle A G N χ hχ) ∈
          groupCohomology.coboundaries₂ (quotientTrivialMulRep A G N) := by
      simpa [quotientTransgressionCocycle, quotientTrivialMulRep,
        Rep.ofMulDistribMulAction, Function.comp_def] using
          (groupCohomology.coboundariesOfIsMulCoboundary₂ hcb).2
    exact
      (groupCohomology.H2π_eq_zero_iff
        (A := quotientTrivialMulRep A G N)
        (x := quotientTransgressionCocycle A G N χ hχ)).2 (by
          simpa [quotientTransgressionClass] using hmem)

name: quotientTransgressionMap_eq_zero_iff_mem_range_restrictToConjInvariantHom
statement: theorem quotientTransgressionMap_eq_zero_iff_mem_range_restrictToConjInvariantHom (A G : Type) [CommGroup A] [Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (χ : ConjInvariantHom A G N) : quotientTransgressionMap A G N χ = 0 ↔ χ ∈ Set.range (restrictToConjInvariantHom A G N)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hzero
    rcases
      (quotientTransgressionClass_eq_zero_iff_exists_lift A G N χ.1 χ.2).1
        (by simpa [quotientTransgressionMap] using hzero) with ⟨ψ, hψ⟩
    exact ⟨ψ, Subtype.ext hψ⟩
  · rintro ⟨ψ, rfl⟩
    simpa [quotientTransgressionMap, restrictToConjInvariantHom] using
      (quotientTransgressionClass_eq_zero_iff_exists_lift A G N
        (ψ.comp N.subtype) ((restrictToConjInvariantHom A G N ψ).2)).2 ⟨ψ, rfl⟩

name: quotientTransgressionMap_inflates_to_zero
statement:
theorem quotientTransgressionMap_inflates_to_zero (A G : Type) [CommGroup A] [Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]
    (χ : ConjInvariantHom A G N) :
    quotientH2Inflation A G N (quotientTransgressionMap A G N χ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change (groupCohomology.map (QuotientGroup.mk' N) (quotientTrivialToTrivialHom A G N) 2)
      (groupCohomology.H2π (quotientTrivialMulRep A G N)
        (quotientTransgressionCocycle A G N χ.1 χ.2)) = 0
  rw [show (groupCohomology.map (QuotientGroup.mk' N) (quotientTrivialToTrivialHom A G N) 2)
      (groupCohomology.H2π (quotientTrivialMulRep A G N)
        (quotientTransgressionCocycle A G N χ.1 χ.2)) =
      groupCohomology.H2π (trivialMulRep A G)
        (groupCohomology.mapCocycles₂ (QuotientGroup.mk' N) (quotientTrivialToTrivialHom A G N)
          (quotientTransgressionCocycle A G N χ.1 χ.2)) by
      simpa using congrArg
        (fun m => m (quotientTransgressionCocycle A G N χ.1 χ.2))
        (groupCohomology.H2π_comp_map (f := QuotientGroup.mk' N)
          (φ := quotientTrivialToTrivialHom A G N))]
  apply (groupCohomology.H2π_eq_zero_iff _).2
  letI := trivialMulDistribMulAction G A
  simpa [groupCohomology.coe_mapCocycles₂, inflatedQuotientTransgressionFactor,
    quotientTransgressionFactor, quotientTrivialToTrivialHom, quotientTrivialMulRep, trivialMulRep,
    trivialMulDistribMulAction] using
    (groupCohomology.coboundariesOfIsMulCoboundary₂
      (G := G) (M := A) (f := inflatedQuotientTransgressionFactor A G N χ.1)
      (inflatedQuotientTransgressionFactor_isMulCoboundary A G N χ.1 χ.2)).2

name: quotientH2Inflation_eq_zero_iff_mem_range_quotientTransgressionMap
statement:
theorem quotientH2Inflation_eq_zero_iff_mem_range_quotientTransgressionMap (A G : Type) [CommGroup A] [Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]
    (x : groupCohomology.H2 (quotientTrivialMulRep A G N)) :
    quotientH2Inflation A G N x = 0 ↔ x ∈ Set.range (quotientTransgressionMap A G N)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rcases quotientH2_exists_normalized_cocycle A G N x with ⟨f, hfclass, hf1, hf2⟩
    rw [← hfclass] at hx
    have hcomp :
        quotientH2Inflation A G N ((groupCohomology.H2π (quotientTrivialMulRep A G N)) f) =
          groupCohomology.H2π (trivialMulRep A G)
            (groupCohomology.mapCocycles₂ (QuotientGroup.mk' N)
              (quotientTrivialToTrivialHom A G N) f) := by
      simpa [quotientH2Inflation] using
        CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
          (groupCohomology.H2π_comp_map
            (A := quotientTrivialMulRep A G N) (B := trivialMulRep A G)
            (f := QuotientGroup.mk' N) (φ := quotientTrivialToTrivialHom A G N)) f
    rw [hcomp] at hx
    have hmem :
        ⇑(groupCohomology.mapCocycles₂ (QuotientGroup.mk' N)
          (quotientTrivialToTrivialHom A G N) f) ∈
          groupCohomology.coboundaries₂ (trivialMulRep A G) := by
      exact (groupCohomology.H2π_eq_zero_iff _).mp hx
    letI := trivialMulDistribMulAction G A
    have hmem' :
        (fun gh : G × G =>
          Additive.toMul
            (show Additive A from
              (groupCohomology.mapCocycles₂ (QuotientGroup.mk' N)
                (quotientTrivialToTrivialHom A G N) f) gh)) ∈
          groupCohomology.coboundaries₂ (Rep.of (Representation.ofMulDistribMulAction (M := G) (G := A))) := by
      simpa [trivialMulRep, quotientTrivialToTrivialHom, quotientTrivialMulRep,
        trivialMulDistribMulAction] using hmem
    have hinfl :
        groupCohomology.IsMulCoboundary₂
          (fun gh : G × G =>
            Additive.toMul
              (show Additive A from f ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) gh.1, (QuotientGroup.mk' N) gh.2))) := by
      simpa [trivialMulRep, quotientTrivialToTrivialHom, quotientTrivialMulRep,
        trivialMulDistribMulAction] using
        (groupCohomology.isMulCoboundary₂_of_mem_coboundaries₂ (M := A)
          (f := fun gh : G × G =>
            Additive.toMul
              (show Additive A from
                (groupCohomology.mapCocycles₂ (QuotientGroup.mk' N)
                  (quotientTrivialToTrivialHom A G N) f) gh)) hmem')
    rcases normalized_quotientCocycle_class_eq_transgressionMap_of_inflated_coboundary
        A G N f hf1 hf2 hinfl with ⟨χ, hχ⟩
    refine ⟨χ, ?_⟩
    rw [← hfclass]
    exact hχ.symm
  · rintro ⟨χ, rfl⟩
    exact quotientTransgressionMap_inflates_to_zero A G N χ

name: inflation_restriction_five_term_zmod_abstract
statement: theorem inflation_restriction_five_term_zmod_abstract (p : ℕ) (G : Type) [Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] : Function.Injective ((groupCohomology.H1InfRes (trivialCoeffRep (ZMod p) G) N).f) ∧ (groupCohomology.H1InfRes (trivialCoeffRep (ZMod p) G) N).Exact ∧ (∀ χ : ConjInvariantHom (Multiplicative (ZMod p)) G N, quotientTransgressionMap (Multiplicative (ZMod p)) G N χ = 0 ↔ χ ∈ Set.range (restrictToConjInvariantHom (Multiplicative (ZMod p)) G N)) ∧ (∀ x : groupCohomology.H2 (quotientTrivialMulRep (Multiplicative (ZMod p)) G N), quotientH2Inflation (Multiplicative (ZMod p)) G N x = 0 ↔ x ∈ Set.range (quotientTransgressionMap (Multiplicative (ZMod p)) G N))

name: continuous_contractNth
statement:
theorem continuous_contractNth (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Continuous (fun g : Fin (n + 1) → G => Fin.contractNth j (· * ·) g)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine continuous_pi ?_
  intro k
  rcases lt_trichotomy (k : ℕ) j with h | h | h
  · have hk : (fun g : Fin (n + 1) → G => Fin.contractNth j (· * ·) g k)
        = fun g => g (Fin.castSucc k) := by
      funext g
      exact Fin.contractNth_apply_of_lt j (· * ·) g k h
    rw [hk]
    exact continuous_apply (i := Fin.castSucc k)
  · have hk : (fun g : Fin (n + 1) → G => Fin.contractNth j (· * ·) g k)
        = fun g => g (Fin.castSucc k) * g k.succ := by
      funext g
      exact Fin.contractNth_apply_of_eq j (· * ·) g k h
    rw [hk]
    exact (continuous_apply (i := Fin.castSucc k)).mul (continuous_apply (i := k.succ))
  · have hk : (fun g : Fin (n + 1) → G => Fin.contractNth j (· * ·) g k)
        = fun g => g k.succ := by
      funext g
      exact Fin.contractNth_apply_of_gt j (· * ·) g k h
    rw [hk]
    exact continuous_apply (i := k.succ)

name: continuous_toFun
statement:
theorem continuous_toFun (n : ℕ) (f : Cochain p G n) :
    Continuous (toFun n f)
proof:
:= by

  have h0 : Continuous fun g : Fin (n + 1) → G => f (fun i => g i.succ) :=
    f.continuous.comp (Pi.continuous_precomp fun i : Fin n => i.succ)
  have h1 : ∀ j : Fin (n + 1),
      Continuous fun g : Fin (n + 1) → G =>
        (-1 : ZMod p) ^ ((j : ℕ) + 1) • f (Fin.contractNth j (· * ·) g) := by
    intro j
    exact continuous_const.smul
      (f.continuous.comp (continuous_contractNth n j))
  have hsum : Continuous fun g : Fin (n + 1) → G =>
      (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))).sum
        (fun j : Fin (n + 1) =>
          (-1 : ZMod p) ^ ((j : ℕ) + 1) • f (Fin.contractNth j (· * ·) g)) := by
    simpa [Finset.sum_apply] using
      (continuous_finset_sum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) fun j _ => h1 j)
  simpa [toFun] using h0.add hsum

name: d_comp_d
statement: theorem d_comp_d (n : ℕ) : (d p G (n + 1)).comp (d p G n) = 0
proof:
:= by

  classical
  let A := _root_.Rep.trivial (ZMod p) G (ZMod p)
  refine LinearMap.ext (fun f => ?_)
  refine Cochain.ext _ _ (fun g => ?_)
  change (d p G (n + 1) (d p G n f)) g = 0
  rw [d_apply_eq_inhomogeneousCochains_d p G (n + 1) (d p G n f) g]
  have hf : d p G n f = _root_.inhomogeneousCochains.d A n f := by
    funext x
    exact d_apply_eq_inhomogeneousCochains_d p G n f x
  rw [hf]
  simpa [ModuleCat.comp_apply] using
    congrArg (fun φ => φ f g)
      (groupCohomology.inhomogeneousCochains.d_comp_d (A := A) (n := n))

name: cochainsMapTrivial_cyclesMap_one_eq_zero
statement:
theorem cochainsMapTrivial_cyclesMap_one_eq_zero (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (A : Type) [Group A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalGroup A]
    (B : Type) [Group B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalGroup B]
    (hf : Continuous ((1 : A →* B))) :
    HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap
      (ContinuousCohomology.cochainsMapTrivial (ZMod p) (1 : A →* B) hf
        (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))) 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← CategoryTheory.cancel_mono (((ContinuousCohomology.homogeneousCochains (ZMod p) A).obj
      (Action.trivial A (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)))).iCycles 1)]
  rw [HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap_i]
  ext x
  let K : CochainComplex (TopModuleCat (ZMod p)) ℕ :=
    (ContinuousCohomology.homogeneousCochains (ZMod p) B).obj
      (Action.trivial B (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)))
  let X : Action (TopModuleCat (ZMod p)) B :=
    Action.trivial B (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))
  let z : K.X 1 := (TopModuleCat.Hom.hom (K.iCycles 1)) x
  let zz : C(B, C(B, ZMod p)) := z.1
  have hz : ((K.d 1 2).hom) z = 0 := by
    change (TopModuleCat.Hom.hom (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (K.iCycles 1) (K.d 1 2)) x = 0)
    simpa using congrArg (fun f => (TopModuleCat.Hom.hom f) x)
      (HomologicalComplex.iCycles_d (K := K) (i := 1) (j := 2))
  let d1zz : C(B, C(B, ZMod p)) :=
    ((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d (ZMod p) B 1).app X).hom.hom (zz 1)
  have hd1_formula : d1zz 1 1 = 0 := by
    unfold d1zz
    rw [ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d_succ]
    change (zz 1 1 - zz 1 1 = 0)
    simp
  let d2z : K.X 2 := ((K.d 1 2).hom z)
  let d2zz : C(B, C(B, C(B, ZMod p))) := d2z.1
  have hd2_formula : d2zz 1 1 1 = zz 1 1 := by
    unfold d2zz d2z
    change (zz 1 1 - d1zz 1 1 = zz 1 1)
    rw [hd1_formula]
    simp
  have hd2_zero : d2zz = 0 := by
    simpa [d2zz, d2z] using congrArg Subtype.val hz
  have hz_eval : zz 1 1 = 0 := by
    rw [← hd2_formula]
    have h := congrArg (fun w : C(B, C(B, C(B, ZMod p))) => w 1 1 1) hd2_zero
    simpa using h
  simp [z]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro a
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro b
  change zz 1 1 = 0
  exact hz_eval

name: cochainsMapTrivial_f1_mono_of_surjective
statement:
theorem cochainsMapTrivial_f1_mono_of_surjective (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (A : Type) [Group A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalGroup A]
    (B : Type) [Group B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalGroup B]

      ((ContinuousCohomology.cochainsMapTrivial (ZMod p) f hf
        (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))).f 1)
proof:
:= by

  exact CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.mono_of_injective
    ((ContinuousCohomology.cochainsMapTrivial (ZMod p) f hf
      (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))).f 1)
    (by
      rintro ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ h
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply ContinuousMap.ext
      intro b1
      apply ContinuousMap.ext
      intro b2
      rcases hsurj b1 with ⟨a1, rfl⟩
      rcases hsurj b2 with ⟨a2, rfl⟩
      exact congrArg (fun z => ((show C(A, C(A, ZMod p)) from z.1) a1) a2) h)

name: cohomologyIso_natural_map_ofIsCocycle2
statement:
theorem cohomologyIso_natural_map_ofIsCocycle2 (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G H : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]

      (ω.comp ⟨fun gh : G × G => (f gh.1, f gh.2), by continuity⟩)) :
    (ContinuousCohomology.cohomologyMapTrivial (ZMod p) f hf
      (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)) 2).hom.toLinearMap

      (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p G 2)
        (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p G 2
          (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p G
            (ω.comp ⟨fun gh : G × G => (f gh.1, f gh.2), by continuity⟩) hωG))
proof:

name: cohomologyMapTrivial_eq_zero_of_eq_one
statement:
theorem cohomologyMapTrivial_eq_zero_of_eq_one (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (A : Type) [Group A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalGroup A]
    (B : Type) [Group B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalGroup B]
    (f : A →* B) (hf : Continuous f) (h1 : f = 1) :
    ContinuousCohomology.cohomologyMapTrivial (ZMod p) f hf
      (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)) 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  subst h1
  let K : CochainComplex (TopModuleCat (ZMod p)) ℕ :=
    (ContinuousCohomology.homogeneousCochains (ZMod p) B).obj
      (Action.trivial B (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)))
  let φ := ContinuousCohomology.cochainsMapTrivial (ZMod p) (1 : A →* B) hf
    (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))
  change HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ 1 = 0
  rw [← CategoryTheory.cancel_epi (K.homologyπ 1)]
  rw [HomologicalComplex.homologyπ_naturality]
  rw [cochainsMapTrivial_cyclesMap_one_eq_zero p A B hf]

name: continuousCoboundariesInCocycles_one_eq_bot
statement:
theorem continuousCoboundariesInCocycles_one_eq_bot (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (K : Type) [Group K] [TopologicalSpace K] [IsTopologicalGroup K] :
    ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.coboundariesInCocycles p K 1 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have hd : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.d p K 0 = 0 := by
    ext f g
    change ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.dAux.toFun 0 f g = 0
    have harg : (fun i : Fin 0 => g i.succ) = Fin.contractNth 0 (fun x y => x * y) g := by
      ext i
      exact Fin.elim0 i
    rw [ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.dAux.toFun, harg]
    simp
  have hB : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Coboundaries p K 1 = ⊥ := by
    rw [ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Coboundaries]
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_bot]
    exact hd
  rw [ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.coboundariesInCocycles, hB,
    Submodule.comap_bot, Submodule.ker_subtype]

name: continuousCocycles1AddEquivContinuousAddHom_nonempty
statement:
theorem continuousCocycles1AddEquivContinuousAddHom_nonempty (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (K : Type) [Group K] [TopologicalSpace K] [IsTopologicalGroup K] :
    Nonempty (((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Cocycles p K 1 : Type) ≃+
      (Additive K →ₜ+ ZMod p)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F : (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Cocycles p K 1 : Type) → (Additive K →ₜ+ ZMod p) :=
    fun c =>
      let f : C(Additive K, ZMod p) :=
        c.1.comp ⟨fun g : Additive K => fun _ : Fin 1 => Additive.toMul g, by
          simpa using continuous_pi fun _ => (continuous_id : Continuous fun g : Additive K => g)⟩
      have hmul : ∀ g h : K, f (Additive.ofMul (g * h)) = f (Additive.ofMul g) + f (Additive.ofMul h) := by
        intro g h
        have hc := congrArg (fun z => z ![g, h]) c.2
        simp only [ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.d_apply,
          ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.dAux.toFun] at hc
        rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hc
        have htail : (fun i : Fin 1 => ![g, h] i.succ) = fun _ : Fin 1 => h := by
          ext i
          fin_cases i <;> rfl
        have h0 : Fin.contractNth (0 : Fin 2) (fun x1 x2 : K => x1 * x2) ![g, h] =
            fun _ : Fin 1 => g * h := by
          ext i
          fin_cases i
          simpa using (Fin.contractNth_apply_of_eq (j := (0 : Fin 2))
            (op := fun x1 x2 : K => x1 * x2) (g := ![g, h]) (k := (0 : Fin 1)) rfl)
        have h1 : Fin.contractNth (1 : Fin 2) (fun x1 x2 : K => x1 * x2) ![g, h] =
            fun _ : Fin 1 => g := by
          ext i
          fin_cases i
          simpa using (Fin.contractNth_apply_of_lt (j := (1 : Fin 2))
            (op := fun x1 x2 : K => x1 * x2) (g := ![g, h]) (k := (0 : Fin 1)) (by decide))
        rw [htail, h0, h1] at hc
        norm_num at hc
        have hneg : -c.1 (fun _ : Fin 1 => g * h) =
            -(c.1 (fun _ : Fin 1 => h) + c.1 (fun _ : Fin 1 => g)) := by
          apply eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left
          simpa [add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using hc
        simpa [f, add_comm] using neg_injective hneg
      { toFun := f
        map_zero' := by
          have h := hmul (1 : K) (1 : K)
          have h' : f 0 + 0 = f 0 + f 0 := by simpa using h
          simpa using (add_left_cancel h').symm
        map_add' := by
          intro x y
          simpa using hmul x.toMul y.toMul
        continuous_toFun := f.continuous }
  let G : (Additive K →ₜ+ ZMod p) → (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Cocycles p K 1 : Type) :=
    fun ψ =>
      let f : C(K, ZMod p) :=
        ψ.toContinuousMap.comp ⟨Additive.ofMul, by
          simpa using (continuous_id : Continuous fun x : K => x)⟩
      have hf : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.IsCocycle1 p K f := by
        intro g h
        change ψ (Additive.ofMul (g * h)) = ψ (Additive.ofMul g) + ψ (Additive.ofMul h)
        simpa using ψ.map_add (Additive.ofMul g) (Additive.ofMul h)
      ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle1 p K f hf
  refine ⟨{ toFun := F, invFun := G, left_inv := ?_, right_inv := ?_, map_add' := ?_ }⟩
  · intro c
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply ContinuousMap.ext
    intro x
    dsimp [G, F]
    have hx : x = fun _ : Fin 1 => x 0 := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl
    rw [hx]
    rfl
  · intro ψ
    ext x
    dsimp [F, G]
    rfl
  · intro a b
    ext x
    dsimp [F]
    rfl

name: continuousQuotientSectionRemainder_mul
statement:
theorem continuousQuotientSectionRemainder_mul (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    [SecondCountableTopology G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G))
    (g h : G) :
    continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN (g * h) =
      continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN g *
        (MulAut.conjNormal (H := N)
          (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN
            ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g))
          (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN h)) *
        (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.schreierDefect G N
          (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN)
          (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection_spec G N hN)
          ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g) ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) h))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Subtype.ext
  change
    ((g * h) * (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) (g * h)))⁻¹ : G) =
      ((g * (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g))⁻¹) *
          ↑(MulAut.conjNormal (H := N)
            (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g))
            (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN h)) *
          ↑(ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.schreierDefect G N
            (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN)
            (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection_spec G N hN)
            ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g) ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) h)) : G)
  rw [MulAut.conjNormal_apply]
  change
    ((g * h) * (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN
      ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) (g * h)))⁻¹ : G) =
      ((g * (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g))⁻¹) *
          ((ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g) *
            ↑(continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN h) *
            (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g))⁻¹)) *
          ↑(ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.schreierDefect G N
            (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN)
            (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection_spec G N hN)
            ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g) ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) h)) : G)
  change
    (g * h) * (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) (g * h)))⁻¹ =
      (g * (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g))⁻¹) *
        (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g) *
          (h * (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) h))⁻¹) *
          (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g))⁻¹) *
        (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g) *
          ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) h) *
          (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN
            ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g * (QuotientGroup.mk' N) h))⁻¹)
  rw [map_mul]
  group

name: h1ToHom_continuous
statement:

name: exists_homogeneous1_cycle_of_continuousAddHom
statement:
theorem exists_homogeneous1_cycle_of_continuousAddHom (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (K : Type) [Group K] [TopologicalSpace K] [IsTopologicalGroup K]
    (χ : Additive K →ₜ+ ZMod p) :
    ∃ x : homogeneous1TrivialCycles p K,
      ∀ g h : K,
        homogeneous1TrivialCyclesValue p K x g h =
          χ (Additive.ofMul (g⁻¹ * h))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let rep : Action (TopModuleCat (ZMod p)) K :=
    Action.trivial K (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))
  let Cx := ((ContinuousCohomology.homogeneousCochains (ZMod p) K).obj rep)
  let φ : C(K × K, ZMod p) :=
    { toFun := fun gh => χ (Additive.ofMul (gh.1⁻¹ * gh.2))
      continuous_toFun := by
        have h1 : Continuous fun gh : K × K => χ (Additive.ofMul gh.1) :=
          χ.continuous.comp (continuous_ofMul.comp continuous_fst)
        have h2 : Continuous fun gh : K × K => χ (Additive.ofMul gh.2) :=
          χ.continuous.comp (continuous_ofMul.comp continuous_snd)
        simpa [ofMul_inv, ofMul_mul, map_add] using h1.neg.add h2 }
  let zχ0 : C(K, C(K, ZMod p)) := ContinuousMap.curry φ
  have hzχ0 : ∀ g h : K, zχ0 g h = χ (Additive.ofMul (g⁻¹ * h)) := by
    intro g h
    simp [zχ0, φ, ContinuousMap.curry_apply]
  let zχ : { z : C(K, C(K, ZMod p)) //
      ∀ a : K, (((ContinuousCohomology.Iobj (ContinuousCohomology.Iobj rep)).ρ a).hom z = z) } := by
    refine ⟨zχ0, ?_⟩
    intro a
    ext g h
    change zχ0 (a⁻¹ * g) (a⁻¹ * h) = zχ0 g h
    have hmul : (a⁻¹ * g)⁻¹ * (a⁻¹ * h) = g⁻¹ * h := by
      group
    simpa [hzχ0, hmul]
  let zχX : Cx.X 1 := zχ
  let left2Map (u : C(K, ZMod p)) : C(K, C(K, ZMod p)) := by
    change ((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.functor (ZMod p) K 2).obj rep).V
    exact (((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.functor (ZMod p) K 1).whiskerLeft
      (ContinuousCohomology.const (ZMod p) K)).app rep).hom u
  let right2Map (u : C(K, ZMod p)) : C(K, C(K, ZMod p)) := by
    change ((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.functor (ZMod p) K 2).obj rep).V
    exact ((CategoryTheory.Functor.whiskerRight (ContinuousCohomology.const (ZMod p) K)
      (ContinuousCohomology.I (ZMod p) K)).app rep).hom u
  let d1u (u : C(K, ZMod p)) : C(K, C(K, ZMod p)) := by
    change ((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.functor (ZMod p) K 2).obj rep).V
    exact ((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d (ZMod p) K 1).app rep).hom u
  have hd1_apply (u : C(K, ZMod p)) (h k : K) :
      d1u u h k = u k - u h := by
    change left2Map u h k - right2Map u h k = u k - u h
    rfl
  let left3Map (f : C(K, C(K, ZMod p))) : C(K, C(K, C(K, ZMod p))) := by
    change ((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.functor (ZMod p) K 3).obj rep).V
    exact (((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.functor (ZMod p) K 2).whiskerLeft
      (ContinuousCohomology.const (ZMod p) K)).app rep).hom f
  let right3Map (f : C(K, C(K, ZMod p))) : C(K, C(K, C(K, ZMod p))) := by
    change ((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.functor (ZMod p) K 3).obj rep).V
    exact ((CategoryTheory.Functor.whiskerRight (ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d (ZMod p) K 1)
      (ContinuousCohomology.I (ZMod p) K)).app rep).hom f
  let d2f (f : C(K, C(K, ZMod p))) : C(K, C(K, C(K, ZMod p))) := by
    change ((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.functor (ZMod p) K 3).obj rep).V
    exact ((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d (ZMod p) K 2).app rep).hom f
  have hd2_apply (f : C(K, C(K, ZMod p))) (g h k : K) :
      d2f f g h k = f h k - f g k + f g h := by
    change left3Map f g h k - right3Map f g h k = f h k - f g k + f g h
    rw [show right3Map f g h k = d1u (f g) h k by rfl]
    rw [show left3Map f g h k = f h k by rfl]
    rw [hd1_apply]
    abel
  let z3 : { z : C(K, C(K, C(K, ZMod p))) //
    ∀ a : K, (((ContinuousCohomology.Iobj (ContinuousCohomology.Iobj (ContinuousCohomology.Iobj rep))).ρ a).hom z = z) } := by
    change Cx.X 2
    exact (Cx.d 1 2).hom zχX
  have hz3_zero : z3.1 = 0 := by
    ext g h k
    change d2f zχ0 g h k = 0
    rw [hd2_apply]
    change χ (Additive.ofMul (h⁻¹ * k)) - χ (Additive.ofMul (g⁻¹ * k)) + χ (Additive.ofMul (g⁻¹ * h)) = 0
    have hmul : g⁻¹ * k = (g⁻¹ * h) * (h⁻¹ * k) := by
      group
    have hmap : χ (Additive.ofMul (g⁻¹ * k)) =
        χ (Additive.ofMul (g⁻¹ * h)) + χ (Additive.ofMul (h⁻¹ * k)) := by
      rw [hmul, ofMul_mul]
      simpa using χ.map_add (Additive.ofMul (g⁻¹ * h)) (Additive.ofMul (h⁻¹ * k))
    rw [hmap]
    abel
  have hzcycle : (Cx.d 1 2).hom zχX = 0 := by
    change z3 = (0 : Cx.X 2)
    exact Subtype.ext hz3_zero
  let kz : TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p) ⟶ Cx.X 1 :=
    TopModuleCat.ofHom ((1 : ZMod p →L[ZMod p] ZMod p).smulRight zχX)
  have hkz_hom : (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp kz (Cx.d 1 2)).hom = 0 := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext_ring
    rw [TopModuleCat.hom_comp, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
    have hkz_eval : (TopModuleCat.Hom.hom kz) 1 = zχX := by
      change ((1 : ZMod p →L[ZMod p] ZMod p).smulRight zχX) 1 = zχX
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.one_apply, one_smul]
    rw [hkz_eval, hzcycle]
    rfl
  have hkz : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp kz (Cx.d 1 2) = 0 := by
    apply CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.ext
    exact hkz_hom
  let mx : TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p) ⟶ Cx.cycles 1 :=
    Cx.liftCycles kz 2 (by simpa using (CochainComplex.next ℕ 1)) hkz
  let x : homogeneous1TrivialCycles p K := mx 1
  have hmx : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp mx (Cx.iCycles 1) = kz := by
    change CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (Cx.liftCycles kz 2 (by simpa using (CochainComplex.next ℕ 1)) hkz) (Cx.iCycles 1) = kz
    simpa using Cx.liftCycles_i kz 2 (by simpa using (CochainComplex.next ℕ 1)) hkz
  have hxeval : (Cx.iCycles 1) x = zχX := by
    change (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp mx (Cx.iCycles 1)) 1 = zχX
    rw [hmx]
    change ((1 : ZMod p →L[ZMod p] ZMod p).smulRight zχX) 1 = zχX
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.one_apply, one_smul]
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  intro g h
  unfold homogeneous1TrivialCyclesValue
  dsimp [x]
  rw [hxeval]
  simpa [zχX, zχ] using hzχ0 g h

name: homogeneous1_cycle_relation
statement:
theorem homogeneous1_cycle_relation (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (K : Type) [Group K] [TopologicalSpace K] [IsTopologicalGroup K]
    (x : homogeneous1TrivialCycles p K) (g h : K) :
    homogeneous1TrivialCyclesValue p K x g (g * h) -
      homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval p K x (g * h) +
      homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval p K x g = 0
proof:
:= by
  let X := Action.trivial K (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))
  let Cx := (ContinuousCohomology.homogeneousCochains (ZMod p) K).obj X
  let x' : Cx.cycles 1 := x
  let z := (Cx.iCycles 1) x'
  let w : C(K, C(K, ZMod p)) := z.1
  let d1 := ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d (ZMod p) K 1
  let a : ((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.functor (ZMod p) K 1).comp
      (ContinuousCohomology.I (ZMod p) K)).obj X ⟶
      ((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.functor (ZMod p) K 2).comp
        (ContinuousCohomology.I (ZMod p) K)).obj X :=
    ((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.functor (ZMod p) K 2).whiskerLeft
      (ContinuousCohomology.const (ZMod p) K)).app X
  let b : ((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.functor (ZMod p) K 1).comp
      (ContinuousCohomology.I (ZMod p) K)).obj X ⟶
      ((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.functor (ZMod p) K 2).comp
        (ContinuousCohomology.I (ZMod p) K)).obj X :=
    (CategoryTheory.Functor.whiskerRight d1 (ContinuousCohomology.I (ZMod p) K)).app X
  have hab : DFunLike.coe (F := C(K, C(K, C(K, ZMod p))))
      ((a - b).hom.hom w) 1 g (g * h)
      = w g (g * h) - (w 1 (g * h) - w 1 g) := by
    dsimp [a, b, d1, CategoryTheory.Functor.whiskerLeft, CategoryTheory.Functor.whiskerRight,
      ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.functor,
      ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d,
      ContinuousCohomology.const, ContinuousCohomology.I]
    rfl
  have h0 : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (Cx.iCycles 1) (Cx.d 1 2) = 0 :=
    HomologicalComplex.iCycles_d (K := Cx) (i := 1) (j := 2)
  have hz : (Cx.d 1 2) z = 0 := by
    change (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (Cx.iCycles 1) (Cx.d 1 2)) x' = 0
    rw [h0]
    rfl
  have hz_eval := congrArg
    (fun t => DFunLike.coe (F := C(K, C(K, C(K, ZMod p)))) t.1 1 g (g * h)) hz
  dsimp [Cx, X, ContinuousCohomology.homogeneousCochains,
    ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.complex,
    ContinuousCohomology.invariants] at hz_eval
  change DFunLike.coe (F := C(K, C(K, C(K, ZMod p))))
      (((ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d (ZMod p) K 2).app X).hom.hom z.1) 1 g
      (g * h) = 0 at hz_eval
  rw [ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.d_succ (R := ZMod p) (G := K) 1] at hz_eval
  change DFunLike.coe (F := C(K, C(K, C(K, ZMod p))))
      ((a - b).hom.hom w) 1 g (g * h) = 0 at hz_eval
  rw [hab] at hz_eval
  have hz_formula' : w g (g * h) - (w 1 (g * h) - w 1 g) = 0 := hz_eval
  have hz_formula : w g (g * h) - w 1 (g * h) + w 1 g = 0 := by
    convert hz_formula' using 1 <;> ring
  simpa [homogeneous1TrivialCyclesValue, homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval, w, z] using hz_formula

name: homogeneous1_cyclesMap_eval
statement:
theorem homogeneous1_cyclesMap_eval (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    {G1 G2 : Type} [Group G1] [TopologicalSpace G1] [IsTopologicalGroup G1]
    [Group G2] [TopologicalSpace G2] [IsTopologicalGroup G2]
    (f : G1 →* G2) (hf : Continuous f)
    (x : homogeneous1TrivialCycles p G2) (g : G1) :
    homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval p G1
      (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap
        (ContinuousCohomology.cochainsMapTrivial (ZMod p) f hf
          (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))) 1 x) g =
      homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval p G2 x (f g)
proof:
:= by
  let φ := ContinuousCohomology.cochainsMapTrivial (ZMod p) f hf
    (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))
  let X : Action (TopModuleCat (ZMod p)) G2 :=
    Action.trivial G2 (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))
  have hm_eval (c : C(G2, C(G2, ZMod p))) :
      DFunLike.coe (F := C(G1, ZMod p))
        (DFunLike.coe (F := C(G1, C(G1, ZMod p)))
          ((ContinuousCohomology.multiIndMap (ZMod p) f hf 2 X).hom.hom c) 1) g =
      DFunLike.coe (F := C(G2, ZMod p))
        (DFunLike.coe (F := C(G2, C(G2, ZMod p))) c (f 1)) (f g) := by
    rw [ContinuousCohomology.multiIndMap_succ, ContinuousCohomology.multiIndMap_succ,
      ContinuousCohomology.multiIndMap_zero]
    rfl
  unfold homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval homogeneous1TrivialCyclesValue
  have h := congrArg
    (fun k =>
      DFunLike.coe (F := C(G1, ZMod p))
        (DFunLike.coe (F := C(G1, C(G1, ZMod p))) ((k x).1) 1) g)
    (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap_i (φ := φ) (i := 1))
  convert h using 1
  · let Cx := ((ContinuousCohomology.homogeneousCochains (ZMod p) G2).obj X)
    let z := (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (HomologicalComplex.iCycles Cx 1)) x
    change DFunLike.coe (F := C(G2, ZMod p))
      (DFunLike.coe (F := C(G2, C(G2, ZMod p))) z.1 1) (f g) =
      DFunLike.coe (F := C(G1, ZMod p))
        (DFunLike.coe (F := C(G1, C(G1, ZMod p)))
          ((ContinuousCohomology.multiIndMap (ZMod p) f hf 2 X).hom.hom z.1) 1) g
    simpa [X, map_one] using (hm_eval z.1).symm

name: homogeneous1_eval_continuous
statement:
theorem homogeneous1_eval_continuous (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (K : Type) [Group K] [TopologicalSpace K] [IsTopologicalGroup K]
    (x : homogeneous1TrivialCycles p K) :
    Continuous fun g : K => homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval p K x g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let X := Action.trivial K (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))
  let Cx := ((ContinuousCohomology.homogeneousCochains (ZMod p) K).obj X)
  let z := (Cx.iCycles 1) x
  change Continuous fun g : K =>
    DFunLike.coe (F := C(K, ZMod p))
      (DFunLike.coe (F := C(K, C(K, ZMod p))) z.1 1) g
  exact (DFunLike.coe (F := C(K, C(K, ZMod p))) z.1 1).continuous

name: homogeneous1_invariant_eval
statement:
theorem homogeneous1_invariant_eval (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (K : Type) [Group K] [TopologicalSpace K] [IsTopologicalGroup K]
    (x : homogeneous1TrivialCycles p K) (g h : K) :
    homogeneous1TrivialCyclesValue p K x 1 h =
      homogeneous1TrivialCyclesValue p K x g (g * h)
proof:
:= by
  let X := Action.trivial K (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))
  let Cx := ((ContinuousCohomology.homogeneousCochains (ZMod p) K).obj X)
  let z := (Cx.iCycles 1) x
  change
      DFunLike.coe (F := C(K, ZMod p))
        (DFunLike.coe (F := C(K, C(K, ZMod p))) z.1 1) h =
      DFunLike.coe (F := C(K, ZMod p))
        (DFunLike.coe (F := C(K, C(K, ZMod p))) z.1 g) (g * h)
  have hz : (((ContinuousCohomology.Iobj (ContinuousCohomology.Iobj X)).ρ g).hom z.1 = z.1) := z.2 g
  have hz' := congrArg
    (fun f => DFunLike.coe (F := C(K, ZMod p))
      (DFunLike.coe (F := C(K, C(K, ZMod p))) f g) (g * h)) hz
  dsimp [ContinuousCohomology.Iobj, X, Action.trivial] at hz'
  change
      DFunLike.coe (F := C(K, ZMod p))
        (DFunLike.coe (F := C(K, C(K, ZMod p))) z.1 (g⁻¹ * g))
        (g⁻¹ * (g * h)) =
      DFunLike.coe (F := C(K, ZMod p))
        (DFunLike.coe (F := C(K, C(K, ZMod p))) z.1 g) (g * h) at hz'
  simpa [mul_assoc] using hz'

name: homogeneous1_cycle_eval_mul
statement:
theorem homogeneous1_cycle_eval_mul (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (K : Type) [Group K] [TopologicalSpace K] [IsTopologicalGroup K]
    (x : homogeneous1TrivialCycles p K) (g h : K) :
    homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval p K x (g * h) =
      homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval p K x g + homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval p K x h
proof:
:= by
  have hrel := homogeneous1_cycle_relation p K x g h
  rw [← homogeneous1_invariant_eval p K x g h] at hrel
  dsimp [homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval] at hrel
  have h1 := congrArg (fun t => t + homogeneous1TrivialCyclesValue p K x 1 (g * h)) hrel
  abel_nf at h1
  simpa [homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using h1.symm

name: homogeneous1_recover_from_eval
statement:
theorem homogeneous1_recover_from_eval (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (K : Type) [Group K] [TopologicalSpace K] [IsTopologicalGroup K]
    (x : homogeneous1TrivialCycles p K) (g h : K) :
    homogeneous1TrivialCyclesValue p K x g h =
      homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval p K x (g⁻¹ * h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval]
  symm
  calc
    homogeneous1TrivialCyclesValue p K x 1 (g⁻¹ * h) =
        homogeneous1TrivialCyclesValue p K x g (g * (g⁻¹ * h)) :=
      homogeneous1_invariant_eval p K x g (g⁻¹ * h)
    _ = homogeneous1TrivialCyclesValue p K x g h := by
      simp [mul_assoc]

name: homogeneous1TrivialCycles_ext_eval
statement:
theorem homogeneous1TrivialCycles_ext_eval (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (K : Type) [Group K] [TopologicalSpace K] [IsTopologicalGroup K]
    {x y : homogeneous1TrivialCycles p K}
    (hxy : ∀ g : K,
      homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval p K x g = homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval p K y g) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let X := Action.trivial K (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))
  let Cx := (ContinuousCohomology.homogeneousCochains (ZMod p) K).obj X
  have hix : Function.Injective (((CategoryTheory.forget₂ (TopModuleCat (ZMod p)) TopCat).map
      (Cx.iCycles 1)).hom) :=
    (TopCat.mono_iff_injective _).1 inferInstance
  apply hix
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro g
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro h
  change homogeneous1TrivialCyclesValue p K x g h = homogeneous1TrivialCyclesValue p K y g h
  rw [homogeneous1_recover_from_eval, homogeneous1_recover_from_eval]
  exact hxy (g⁻¹ * h)

name: continuousH1TrivialCyclesAddEquiv_package
statement:
theorem continuousH1TrivialCyclesAddEquiv_package (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    ∃ e : ∀ (K : Type) [Group K] [TopologicalSpace K] [IsTopologicalGroup K],
        ((((ContinuousCohomology.homogeneousCochains (ZMod p) K).obj
            (Action.trivial K (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)))).cycles 1 :
            TopModuleCat (ZMod p)) : Type) ≃+
          (Additive K →ₜ+ ZMod p),
      ∀ {G1 G2 : Type} [Group G1] [TopologicalSpace G1] [IsTopologicalGroup G1]
        [Group G2] [TopologicalSpace G2] [IsTopologicalGroup G2]
        (f : G1 →* G2) (hf : Continuous f)
        (x : ((((ContinuousCohomology.homogeneousCochains (ZMod p) G2).obj
            (Action.trivial G2 (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)))).cycles 1 :
            TopModuleCat (ZMod p)) : Type)),
        e G1 (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap
          (ContinuousCohomology.cochainsMapTrivial (ZMod p) f hf
            (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))) 1 x) =
          (e G2 x).comp
            ({ toFun := fun g => Additive.ofMul (f g.toMul)
               map_zero' := by simp
               map_add' := by intro a b; simp
               continuous_toFun := by simpa using hf } : Additive G1 →ₜ+ Additive G2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro K _ _ _
    let Cx := ((ContinuousCohomology.homogeneousCochains (ZMod p) K).obj
      (Action.trivial K (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))))
    have h_eval_add (x y : homogeneous1TrivialCycles p K) (g : K) :
        homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval p K (x + y) g =
          homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval p K x g + homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval p K y g := by
      simp [homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval, homogeneous1TrivialCyclesValue, Cx]
      rfl
    let forward : homogeneous1TrivialCycles p K → (Additive K →ₜ+ ZMod p) :=
      fun x =>
        { toFun := fun g => homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval p K x g.toMul
          map_zero' := by
            have h : homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval p K x 1 =
                homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval p K x 1 + homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval p K x 1 := by
              simpa using homogeneous1_cycle_eval_mul p K x (1 : K) 1
            have h' := congrArg (fun t => t - homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval p K x 1) h
            simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using h'.symm
          map_add' := by
            intro a b
            exact homogeneous1_cycle_eval_mul p K x a.toMul b.toMul
          continuous_toFun := by
            simpa using homogeneous1_eval_continuous p K x }
    let inverse : (Additive K →ₜ+ ZMod p) → homogeneous1TrivialCycles p K :=
      fun χ => Classical.choose (exists_homogeneous1_cycle_of_continuousAddHom p K χ)
    have hleft : ∀ x : homogeneous1TrivialCycles p K, inverse (forward x) = x := by
      intro x
      apply homogeneous1TrivialCycles_ext_eval p K
      intro g
      have hspec := Classical.choose_spec (exists_homogeneous1_cycle_of_continuousAddHom p K (forward x))
      simpa [forward, inverse, homogeneous1TrivialCyclesEval, inv_one, one_mul] using hspec 1 g
    have hright : ∀ χ : Additive K →ₜ+ ZMod p, forward (inverse χ) = χ := by
      intro χ
      ext g
      have hspec := Classical.choose_spec (exists_homogeneous1_cycle_of_continuousAddHom p K χ)
      simpa [forward, inverse, inv_one, one_mul] using hspec 1 g.toMul
    refine
      { toFun := forward
        invFun := inverse
        left_inv := hleft
        right_inv := hright
        map_add' := ?_ }
    intro x y
    ext g
    simpa [forward] using h_eval_add x y g.toMul
  · intro G1 G2 _ _ _ _ _ _ f hf x
    ext g
    exact homogeneous1_cyclesMap_eval p f hf x g.toMul

name: homogeneousCochains_d01_trivial_zero
statement:
theorem homogeneousCochains_d01_trivial_zero (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (K : Type) [Group K] [TopologicalSpace K] [IsTopologicalGroup K] :
    (((ContinuousCohomology.homogeneousCochains (ZMod p) K).obj
      (Action.trivial K (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)))).d 0 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := f
  have hf' : ∀ g : K,
      (((ContinuousCohomology.Iobj
        (Action.trivial K (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)))).ρ g).hom f) = f := by
    simpa [ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.complex, ContinuousCohomology.MultiInd.functor] using hf
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro a
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro b
  change (show C(K, ZMod p) from f) b - (show C(K, ZMod p) from f) a = 0
  rw [sub_eq_zero]
  have h := congr(DFunLike.coe (F := C(K, ZMod p)) $(hf' (a * b⁻¹)) a)
  change (show C(K, ZMod p) from f) ((a * b⁻¹)⁻¹ * a) = (show C(K, ZMod p) from f) a at h
  simpa [mul_assoc] using h

name: continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom_package
statement:
theorem continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom_package (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    ∃ e : ∀ (K : Type) [Group K] [TopologicalSpace K] [IsTopologicalGroup K]
        [T2Space K] [CompactSpace K] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace K],
        ((H p 1 K : Type) ≃+ (Additive K →ₜ+ ZMod p)),
      ∀ {G1 G2 : Type} [Group G1] [TopologicalSpace G1] [IsTopologicalGroup G1]
        [T2Space G1] [CompactSpace G1] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G1]
        [Group G2] [TopologicalSpace G2] [IsTopologicalGroup G2]
        [T2Space G2] [CompactSpace G2] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G2]
        (f : G1 →* G2) (hf : Continuous f) (x : (H p 1 G2 : Type)),
        e G1 ((ContinuousCohomology.cohomologyMapTrivial (ZMod p) f hf
          (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)) 1).hom x) =
          (e G2 x).comp
            ({ toFun := fun g => Additive.ofMul (f g.toMul)
               map_zero' := by simp
               map_add' := by intro a b; simp
               continuous_toFun := by simpa using hf } : Additive G1 →ₜ+ Additive G2)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom (p := p), ?_⟩
  intros G1 G2 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ φ hφ x

  exact ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom_inhomog_naturality
    p G1 G2 φ hφ x

name: h1ToHom_eq_package
statement:
theorem h1ToHom_eq_package (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G))
    (x : (H p 1 N : Type)) :
    haveI : CompactSpace ↥N
proof:
:= isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hN.isCompact
    ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.h1ToHom p G N hN x =
      ((continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom (p := p) (K := ↥N) x)).toAddMonoidHom := by
  haveI : CompactSpace ↥N := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hN.isCompact
  rfl

name: inflatedSchreier2Cocycle_isCoboundary
statement:
theorem inflatedSchreier2Cocycle_isCoboundary (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    [SecondCountableTopology G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G))
    (χ : ↥(ErdosUnitDistance.h1NormalInvariantSubmodule p G N)) :
    ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.IsCoboundary2 p G
      (inflatedSchreier2Cocycle p G N hN χ)
proof:
:= by
  let χh := ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.h1ToHom_explicit p G N hN χ.1
  let r := continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN
  let σ := ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN
  have hχcont : Continuous fun n : Additive ↥N => χh n := by
    simpa [χh] using h1ToHom_continuous p G N hN χ.1
  have hrcont : Continuous fun g : G => (Additive.ofMul (r g) : Additive ↥N) := by
    simpa [r] using (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN).continuous
  refine ⟨
    { toFun := fun g => - χh (Additive.ofMul (r g))
      continuous_toFun := by
        exact (hχcont.comp hrcont).neg }, ?_⟩
  intro g h
  let δ :=
    ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.schreierDefect G N
      (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN)
      (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection_spec G N hN)
      ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g) ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) h)
  have hmul :
      χh (Additive.ofMul (r (g * h))) =
        χh (Additive.ofMul (r g)) +
          χh (Additive.ofMul
            ((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N)
              (σ ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g)) (r h)))) +
          χh (Additive.ofMul δ) := by
    have hmul0 :=
      congrArg (fun n : ↥N => χh (Additive.ofMul n))
        (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder_mul G N hN g h)
    simpa [r, σ, δ, map_add, add_assoc] using hmul0
  have hconj :
      χh (Additive.ofMul
        ((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N)
          (σ ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g)) (r h)))) =
      χh (Additive.ofMul (r h)) := by
    have hconj0 :=
      congrArg
        (fun f : Additive ↥N →+ ZMod p => f (Additive.ofMul (r h)))
        (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.h1ToHom_explicit_conjugation_invariant
          (p := p) (G := G) (N := N) (hN := hN) χ (σ ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g)))
    simpa [χh, σ] using hconj0
  have hmul' :
      χh (Additive.ofMul (r (g * h))) =
        χh (Additive.ofMul (r g)) +
          χh (Additive.ofMul (r h)) +
          χh (Additive.ofMul δ) := by
    rw [hmul, hconj]
  have hω :
      χh (Additive.ofMul δ) =
        χh (Additive.ofMul (r (g * h))) -
          χh (Additive.ofMul (r g)) -
          χh (Additive.ofMul (r h)) := by
    have hω0 :=
      congrArg
        (fun x : ZMod p =>
          x - χh (Additive.ofMul (r g)) - χh (Additive.ofMul (r h))) hmul'
    abel_nf at hω0
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using hω0.symm

  have hχcont' : Continuous (χh : Additive ↥N → ZMod p) := hχcont
  simpa [inflatedSchreier2Cocycle, χh, r, δ,
    ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier2Cocycle, hχcont',
    sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using hω

name: inflation_H1_injective
statement:
theorem inflation_H1_injective (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] :
    Function.Injective (inflation p G N 1).hom
proof:
:= by
  let φ := ContinuousCohomology.cochainsMapTrivial (ZMod p)
    (QuotientGroup.mk' N) QuotientGroup.continuous_mk
    (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))
  let CQ := ((ContinuousCohomology.homogeneousCochains (ZMod p) (G ⧸ N)).obj
    (Action.trivial (G ⧸ N) (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))))
  let CG := ((ContinuousCohomology.homogeneousCochains (ZMod p) G).obj
    (Action.trivial G (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p))))
  have hCQ : CQ.d 0 1 = 0 := by
