    simpa [CQ] using homogeneousCochains_d01_trivial_zero (p := p) (K := G ⧸ N)
  have hCG : CG.d 0 1 = 0 := by
    simpa [CG] using homogeneousCochains_d01_trivial_zero (p := p) (K := G)
  have hprev : (ComplexShape.up ℕ).prev 1 = 0 := by
    simpa using (CochainComplex.prev_nat_succ 0)
  letI : CategoryTheory.IsIso (CQ.homologyπ 1) :=
    HomologicalComplex.isIso_homologyπ CQ 0 1 hprev hCQ
  letI : CategoryTheory.IsIso (CG.homologyπ 1) :=
    HomologicalComplex.isIso_homologyπ CG 0 1 hprev hCG
  haveI : CategoryTheory.Mono (φ.f 1) :=
    cochainsMapTrivial_f1_mono_of_surjective (p := p)
      (A := G) (B := G ⧸ N)
      (f := QuotientGroup.mk' N) (hf := QuotientGroup.continuous_mk)
      (hsurj := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective N)
  haveI : CategoryTheory.Mono (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap φ 1) := inferInstance
  have hmono_comp : CategoryTheory.Mono
      (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CQ.homologyπ 1) (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ 1)) := by
    rw [HomologicalComplex.homologyπ_naturality (φ := φ) (i := 1)]
    infer_instance
  have hmono_homologyMap : CategoryTheory.Mono (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ 1) :=
    (CategoryTheory.mono_comp_iff_of_isIso (CQ.homologyπ 1)
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ 1)).1 hmono_comp
  have hmono_infl : CategoryTheory.Mono (inflation p G N 1) := by
    simpa [inflation, H, φ] using hmono_homologyMap
  letI : CategoryTheory.Mono (inflation p G N 1) := hmono_infl
  have hmono_module : CategoryTheory.Mono
      (((CategoryTheory.forget₂ (TopModuleCat (ZMod p)) (ModuleCat (ZMod p))).map
        (inflation p G N 1))) :=
    CategoryTheory.preserves_mono_of_preservesLimit
      (CategoryTheory.forget₂ (TopModuleCat (ZMod p)) (ModuleCat (ZMod p)))
      (inflation p G N 1)
  simpa using
    (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective
      (((CategoryTheory.forget₂ (TopModuleCat (ZMod p)) (ModuleCat (ZMod p))).map
        (inflation p G N 1)))).1 hmono_module

name: isCocycle2_map_one_fst
statement:
theorem isCocycle2_map_one_fst (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (ω : C(G × G, ZMod p))
    (hω : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.IsCocycle2 p G ω)
    (q : G) :
    ω (1, q) = ω (1, 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hω 1 1 q
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (by simpa using h)

name: isCocycle2_map_one_snd
statement:
theorem isCocycle2_map_one_snd (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (ω : C(G × G, ZMod p))
    (hω : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.IsCocycle2 p G ω)
    (q : G) :
    ω (q, 1) = ω (1, 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ω (1, 1) = ω (q, 1) := by
    simpa using (sub_eq_zero.mp (hω q 1 1))
  exact h.symm

name: continuousH2_exists_normalized_cocycle
statement:
theorem continuousH2_exists_normalized_cocycle (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G))
    (x : H p 2 (G ⧸ N)) :
    ∃ ω : {ω : C((G ⧸ N) × (G ⧸ N), ZMod p) //
        ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.IsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) ω},
      QClass p G N hN ω = x ∧
      (∀ q : G ⧸ N, ω.1 (1, q) = 0) ∧
      (∀ q : G ⧸ N, ω.1 (q, 1) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : TotallyDisconnectedSpace (G ⧸ N) :=
    ErdosUnitDistance.QuotientGroup.totallyDisconnectedSpace N hN
  let e := ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p (G ⧸ N) 2
  let y : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Cohomology p (G ⧸ N) 2 := e.symm x
  have hx : e y = x := by
    simp [y, e]
  rw [← hx]
  unfold ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Cohomology at y ⊢
  refine Submodule.Quotient.induction_on
    (p := ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.coboundariesInCocycles p (G ⧸ N) 2)
    (x := y) ?_
  intro z
  have hz : (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.d p (G ⧸ N) 2) z.1 = 0 := by
    simpa [ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Cocycles] using z.2
  have hcontract0 (g h k : G ⧸ N) :
      Fin.contractNth 0 (fun x y : G ⧸ N => x * y) ![g, h, k] = ![g * h, k] := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [Fin.contractNth_apply_of_eq, Fin.contractNth_apply_of_gt,
      Fin.contractNth_apply_of_lt]
  have hcontract1 (g h k : G ⧸ N) :
      Fin.contractNth 1 (fun x y : G ⧸ N => x * y) ![g, h, k] = ![g, h * k] := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [Fin.contractNth_apply_of_eq, Fin.contractNth_apply_of_gt,
      Fin.contractNth_apply_of_lt]
  have hcontract2 (g h k : G ⧸ N) :
      Fin.contractNth 2 (fun x y : G ⧸ N => x * y) ![g, h, k] = ![g, h] := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [Fin.contractNth_apply_of_eq, Fin.contractNth_apply_of_gt,
      Fin.contractNth_apply_of_lt]
  have hpow : ((-1 : ZMod p) ^ 3) = -1 := by
    norm_num
  have hz' (g h k : G ⧸ N) :
      z.1 ![h, k] - z.1 ![g * h, k] + z.1 ![g, h * k] - z.1 ![g, h] = 0 := by
    have hz'' := congrArg (fun F => F ![g, h, k]) hz
    change ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.dAux.toFun 2 z.1 ![g, h, k] = 0 at hz''
    simp [ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.dAux.toFun, Fin.sum_univ_three,
      hcontract0, hcontract1, hcontract2] at hz''
    have hpair : (fun i : Fin 2 => ![h, k] i) = ![h, k] := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl
    rw [hpair] at hz''
    simpa [hpow, sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc] using hz''
  let f : C((G ⧸ N) × (G ⧸ N), ZMod p) :=
    z.1.comp ⟨fun gh => ![gh.1, gh.2], by
      exact continuous_pi (fun i => by
        fin_cases i
        · simpa using (continuous_fst : Continuous fun gh : (G ⧸ N) × (G ⧸ N) => gh.1)
        · simpa using (continuous_snd : Continuous fun gh : (G ⧸ N) × (G ⧸ N) => gh.2))⟩
  have hf : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.IsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) f := by
    intro g h k
    simpa [f] using hz' g h k
  let c : ZMod p := f (1, 1)
  let b : C(G ⧸ N, ZMod p) :=
    ⟨fun _ => -c, continuous_const⟩
  let corr : C((G ⧸ N) × (G ⧸ N), ZMod p) :=
    ⟨fun _ => -c, continuous_const⟩
  have hcorr : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.IsCoboundary2 p (G ⧸ N) corr := by
    refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
    intro g h
    simp [corr, b, c]
  let ωfun : C((G ⧸ N) × (G ⧸ N), ZMod p) :=
    ⟨fun gh => f gh - c, by
      exact f.continuous.sub continuous_const⟩
  have hω : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.IsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) ωfun := by
    intro g h k
    have hf' := hf g h k
    change (f (h, k) - c) - (f (g * h, k) - c) + (f (g, h * k) - c) - (f (g, h) - c) = 0
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, sub_eq_add_neg, sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg] at hf'
    abel_nf at hf' ⊢
    exact hf'
  have hof : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) f hf = z := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext g
    change z.1 ![g 0, g 1] = z.1 g
    congr 1
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hzero :
      ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p (G ⧸ N) 2
        (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) ωfun hω -
          ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) f hf) = 0 := by
    rw [ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap_eq_zero_iff]
    change
      (((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) ωfun hω :
            ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Cocycles p (G ⧸ N) 2) :
          ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p (G ⧸ N) 2) -
        ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) f hf :
            ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Cocycles p (G ⧸ N) 2) :
          ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p (G ⧸ N) 2)) ∈
      ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Coboundaries p (G ⧸ N) 2
    have hdiff :
        (((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) ωfun hω :
              ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Cocycles p (G ⧸ N) 2) :
            ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p (G ⧸ N) 2) -
          ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) f hf :
              ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Cocycles p (G ⧸ N) 2) :
            ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p (G ⧸ N) 2)) =
          ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofProd p (G ⧸ N) corr := by
      ext g
      change (ωfun (g 0, g 1) - f (g 0, g 1)) = corr (g 0, g 1)
      simp [ωfun, corr, c]
    rw [hdiff]
    exact ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofProd_mem_coboundaries_of_isCoboundary2 p (G ⧸ N) corr hcorr
  have hclass :
      ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p (G ⧸ N) 2
        (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) ωfun hω) =
      ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p (G ⧸ N) 2
        (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) f hf) := by
    rw [← sub_eq_zero]
    rw [← LinearMap.map_sub]
    exact hzero
  let ω : {ω : C((G ⧸ N) × (G ⧸ N), ZMod p) //
      ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.IsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) ω} := ⟨ωfun, hω⟩
  refine ⟨ω, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp [QClass, ω]
    rw [hclass, hof]
    rfl
  · intro q
    change ωfun (1, q) = 0
    change f (1, q) - c = 0
    have hf1 : f (1, q) = c := by
      simpa [c] using isCocycle2_map_one_fst p (G ⧸ N) f hf q
    rw [hf1]
    simp
  · intro q
    change ωfun (q, 1) = 0
    change f (q, 1) - c = 0
    have hf1 : f (q, 1) = c := by
      simpa [c] using isCocycle2_map_one_snd p (G ⧸ N) f hf q
    rw [hf1]
    simp

name: exists_continuous_h1ToHom_lift_of_restriction
statement:
theorem exists_continuous_h1ToHom_lift_of_restriction (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G))
    (y : (H p 1 G : Type)) :
    ∃ ψ : Additive G →+ ZMod p,
      Continuous ψ ∧
      ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.h1ToHom p G N hN
        ((restriction p G N 1).hom y) =
        ψ.comp (MonoidHom.toAdditive N.subtype)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : CompactSpace ↥N := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hN.isCompact
  let e := continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom (p := p)
  refine ⟨(e G y).toAddMonoidHom, (e G y).continuous_toFun, ?_⟩
  have hx :
      ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.h1ToHom p G N hN
        ((restriction p G N 1).hom y) =
      ((e ↥N ((restriction p G N 1).hom y)).toAddMonoidHom) := by
    simpa [e] using h1ToHom_eq_package (p := p) (G := G) (N := N) (hN := hN)
      ((restriction p G N 1).hom y)
  rw [hx]
  have hnat :=
    ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom_inhomog_naturality
      p ↥N G N.subtype continuous_subtype_val y
  have hnat' := congrArg ContinuousAddMonoidHom.toAddMonoidHom hnat
  simpa [e, restriction,
    continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom] using hnat'

name: h1ClassOfContinuousHom_package
statement:
theorem h1ClassOfContinuousHom_package (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    ∃ c : ∀ (K : Type) [Group K] [TopologicalSpace K] [IsTopologicalGroup K]
        [T2Space K] [CompactSpace K] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace K],
        (Additive K →ₜ+ ZMod p) → (H p 1 K : Type),
      (∀ (K : Type) [Group K] [TopologicalSpace K] [IsTopologicalGroup K]
          [T2Space K] [CompactSpace K] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace K]
          (x : (H p 1 K : Type)),
          c K ((continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom (p := p) (K := K) x)) = x) ∧
      (∀ (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
          [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
          (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G))
          (ψ : Additive G →ₜ+ ZMod p),
          haveI : CompactSpace ↥N := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hN.isCompact
          (restriction p G N 1).hom (c G ψ) =
            c ↥N (ψ.comp (additiveSubtypeContinuousHom G N)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom (p := p)
  refine ⟨fun K _ _ _ _ _ _ => (e K).symm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro K _ _ _ _ _ _ x
    exact (e K).symm_apply_apply x
  · intro G _ _ _ _ _ _ N _ hN ψ
    haveI : CompactSpace ↥N := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hN.isCompact
    have hnat :=
      ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom_inhomog_naturality
        p ↥N G N.subtype continuous_subtype_val ((e G).symm ψ)
    refine (e ↥N).injective ?_
    simpa [restriction, additiveSubtypeContinuousHom, e,
      continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom] using hnat

name: inflation_range_le_restriction_ker_H1
statement:
theorem inflation_range_le_restriction_ker_H1 (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] :
    LinearMap.range (inflation p G N 1).hom.toLinearMap ≤
      LinearMap.ker (restriction p G N 1).hom.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.range_le_ker_iff]
  have hcomp := by
    simpa [inflation, restriction] using
      (ContinuousCohomology.cohomologyMapTrivial_comp (R := ZMod p)
        (f := N.subtype) (g := QuotientGroup.mk' N)
        (hf := continuous_subtype_val) (hg := QuotientGroup.continuous_mk)
        (X := TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)) (n := 1))
  have hzero :=
    cohomologyMapTrivial_eq_zero_of_eq_one (p := p)
      (A := N) (B := G ⧸ N)
      (1 : N →* G ⧸ N) continuous_one rfl
  have hcat := hcomp.symm.trans hzero
  ext x
  have hx := congrArg (fun f => f.hom x) hcat
  simpa using hx

name: restriction_ker_le_inflation_range_H1
statement:
theorem restriction_ker_le_inflation_range_H1 (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G)) :
    LinearMap.ker (restriction p G N 1).hom.toLinearMap ≤
      LinearMap.range (inflation p G N 1).hom.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hx
  haveI : CompactSpace ↥N := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hN.isCompact
  haveI : TotallyDisconnectedSpace (G ⧸ N) :=
    ErdosUnitDistance.QuotientGroup.totallyDisconnectedSpace N hN
  haveI hClosed : IsClosed ((N : Set G)) := hN
  haveI : T2Space (G ⧸ N) :=
    have : T1Space (G ⧸ N) := QuotientGroup.instT1Space
    inferInstance
  rcases continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom_package (p := p) with ⟨e, he_nat⟩
  let ψcts : Additive G →ₜ+ ZMod p := e G x
  have hxr : (restriction p G N 1).hom x = 0 := by simpa using hx
  have hvanish : ∀ n : N, ψcts (Additive.ofMul (n : G)) = 0 := by
    intro n
    have hnatRes := he_nat (G1 := N) (G2 := G) N.subtype continuous_subtype_val x
    have hnatRes_n := congrArg (fun f : Additive N →ₜ+ ZMod p => f (Additive.ofMul n)) hnatRes
    have hxr' :
        (TopModuleCat.Hom.hom
          (ContinuousCohomology.cohomologyMapTrivial (ZMod p) N.subtype continuous_subtype_val
            (TopModuleCat.of (ZMod p) (ZMod p)) 1)) x = 0 := by
      simpa [restriction] using hxr
    dsimp [ψcts] at hnatRes_n ⊢
    rw [hxr'] at hnatRes_n
    simpa using hnatRes_n.symm
  let φcts : G →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod p) :=
    { toFun := fun g => Multiplicative.ofAdd (ψcts (Additive.ofMul g))
      map_one' := by simp [ψcts]
      map_mul' := by
        intro a b
        simp [ψcts.map_add]
      continuous_toFun := by
        simpa [ψcts] using ψcts.continuous_toFun }
  have hNker : N ≤ φcts.toMonoidHom.ker := by
    intro n hn
    change Multiplicative.ofAdd (ψcts (Additive.ofMul n)) = 1
    simpa [hvanish ⟨n, hn⟩]
  let φq : G ⧸ N →* Multiplicative (ZMod p) := QuotientGroup.lift N φcts.toMonoidHom hNker
  have hcont_comp : Continuous (φq ∘ QuotientGroup.mk) := by
    simpa [φq, Function.comp] using φcts.continuous_toFun
  have hcont_q : Continuous φq := by
    exact (QuotientGroup.isOpenQuotientMap_mk (N := N)).continuous_comp_iff.mp hcont_comp
  let ψbar : Additive (G ⧸ N) →ₜ+ ZMod p :=
    { toFun := fun q => (φq q.toMul).toAdd
      map_zero' := by simp [φq]
      map_add' := by
        intro a b
        simp [φq.map_mul]
      continuous_toFun := by
        simpa using hcont_q }
  let y : (H p 1 (G ⧸ N) : Type) := (e (G ⧸ N)).symm ψbar
  let qAdd : Additive G →ₜ+ Additive (G ⧸ N) :=
    { toFun := fun g => Additive.ofMul ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g.toMul)
      map_zero' := by simp
      map_add' := by intro a b; simp
      continuous_toFun := by
        change Continuous (fun g : G => Additive.ofMul ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g))
        simpa using QuotientGroup.continuous_mk }
  have hcompq : ψbar.comp qAdd = ψcts := by
    ext g
    change (φq ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g.toMul)).toAdd = ψcts g
    simp [φq, QuotientGroup.lift_mk, φcts]
  have hE : e G ((inflation p G N 1).hom y) = ψcts := by
    have hnatInf :=
      he_nat (G1 := G) (G2 := G ⧸ N) (QuotientGroup.mk' N) QuotientGroup.continuous_mk y
    rw [show e (G ⧸ N) y = ψbar by simp [y]] at hnatInf
    simpa [inflation, qAdd] using hnatInf.trans hcompq
  have hy : (inflation p G N 1).hom y = x := by
    exact (e G).injective (by simpa [ψcts] using hE)
  simp only [LinearMap.mem_range]
  exact ⟨y, hy⟩

name: exact_at_H1G
statement:
theorem exact_at_H1G (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G)) :
    LinearMap.range (inflation p G N 1).hom.toLinearMap =
      LinearMap.ker (restriction p G N 1).hom.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  exact le_antisymm
    (inflation_range_le_restriction_ker_H1 (p := p) (G := G) (N := N))
    (restriction_ker_le_inflation_range_H1 (p := p) (G := G) (N := N) hN)

name: inflation_transgression_apply_eq
statement:
theorem inflation_transgression_apply_eq (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    [SecondCountableTopology G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G))
    (χ : ↥(ErdosUnitDistance.h1NormalInvariantSubmodule p G N))
    (hω : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.IsCocycle2 p G
      (inflatedSchreier2Cocycle p G N hN χ)) :
    (inflation p G N 2).hom.toLinearMap (transgression p G N hN χ) =
      (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p G 2)
        (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p G 2
          (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p G
            (inflatedSchreier2Cocycle p G N hN χ) hω))
proof:
:= by
  let ω :=
    ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier2Cocycle p G N
      (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN)
      (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection_spec G N hN)
      (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.h1ToHom_explicit p G N hN χ.1)
  have hq : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.IsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) ω := by
    simpa [ω] using
      (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier_isCocycle p G N
        (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN)
        (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection_spec G N hN)
        (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.h1ToHom_explicit p G N hN χ.1)
        (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.h1ToHom_explicit_conjugation_invariant
          p G N hN χ))
  haveI : TotallyDisconnectedSpace (G ⧸ N) :=
    ErdosUnitDistance.QuotientGroup.totallyDisconnectedSpace N hN
  change
    (inflation p G N 2).hom.toLinearMap
      ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p (G ⧸ N) 2)
        (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p (G ⧸ N) 2
          (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) ω hq))) =
      (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p G 2)
        (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p G 2
          (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p G
            (inflatedSchreier2Cocycle p G N hN χ) hω))
  simpa [inflation, inflatedSchreier2Cocycle, ω] using
    (cohomologyIso_natural_map_ofIsCocycle2 p G (G ⧸ N) (QuotientGroup.mk' N)
      QuotientGroup.continuous_mk ω hq hω)

name: exists_continuousConjInvariantHom_and_sectionCochain_of_normalized_inflated_coboundary
statement:
theorem exists_continuousConjInvariantHom_and_sectionCochain_of_normalized_inflated_coboundary
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    [SecondCountableTopology G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G))
    (ω : {ω : C((G ⧸ N) × (G ⧸ N), ZMod p) //
        ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.IsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) ω})
    (h1 : ∀ q : G ⧸ N, ω.1 (1, q) = 0)
    (h2 : ∀ q : G ⧸ N, ω.1 (q, 1) = 0)
    (hinfl : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.IsCoboundary2 p G (QPull p G N ω)) :
    ∃ χh : Additive ↥N →ₜ+ ZMod p, ∃ u : C(G ⧸ N, ZMod p),
      (∀ g : G, ∀ n : ↥N,
        χh (Additive.ofMul (MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g n)) = χh (Additive.ofMul n)) ∧
      (∀ x y : G ⧸ N,
        ω.1 (x, y) =
          u y - u (x * y) + u x +
            (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier2Cocycle p G N
              (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN)
              (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection_spec G N hN)
              χh.toAddMonoidHom) (x, y))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases hinfl with ⟨b, hb⟩
  have hb_one : b 1 = 0 := by
    have h := hb 1 1
    simpa [QPull, h2 (1 : G ⧸ N)] using h.symm
  have hb_rightN : ∀ g : G, ∀ n : ↥N, b (g * n) = b n + b g := by
    intro g n
    have hqn : (n : G ⧸ N) = 1 := by
      simpa using DFunLike.congr_fun (QuotientGroup.mk'_comp_subtype (N := N)) n
    have hq0 : ω.1 ((g : G ⧸ N), 1) = b n - b (g * n) + b g := by
      simpa [QPull, hqn] using hb g n
    have h0 : 0 = b n - b (g * n) + b g := by
      rw [h2 (g : G ⧸ N)] at hq0
      exact hq0
    have h' := congrArg (fun a => a + b (g * n)) h0
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using h'
  have hb_leftN : ∀ n : ↥N, ∀ g : G, b ((n : G) * g) = b g + b n := by
    intro n g
    have hqn : (n : G ⧸ N) = 1 := by
      simpa using DFunLike.congr_fun (QuotientGroup.mk'_comp_subtype (N := N)) n
    have hq0 : ω.1 (1, (g : G ⧸ N)) = b g - b ((n : G) * g) + b n := by
      simpa [QPull, hqn] using hb n g
    have h0 : 0 = b g - b ((n : G) * g) + b n := by
      rw [h1 (g : G ⧸ N)] at hq0
      exact hq0
    have h' := congrArg (fun a => a + b ((n : G) * g)) h0
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using h'
  let χh : Additive ↥N →ₜ+ ZMod p :=
    { toAddMonoidHom :=
        { toFun := fun n => -b (((@Additive.toMul ↥N) n : ↥N) : G)
          map_zero' := by
            simp [hb_one]
          map_add' := by
            intro n₁ n₂
            have hmul :
                b (((((@Additive.toMul ↥N) n₁ : ↥N) : G) * (((@Additive.toMul ↥N) n₂ : ↥N) : G))) =
                  b (((@Additive.toMul ↥N) n₂ : ↥N) : G) + b (((@Additive.toMul ↥N) n₁ : ↥N) : G) := by
              simpa using
                (hb_leftN (n := ((@Additive.toMul ↥N) n₁ : ↥N))
                  (g := (((@Additive.toMul ↥N) n₂ : ↥N) : G)))
            have hneg := congrArg (fun a : ZMod p => -a) hmul
            simpa [toMul_add, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using hneg }
      continuous_toFun := by
        change Continuous (fun n : Additive ↥N => -b (((@Additive.toMul ↥N) n : ↥N) : G))
        simpa using (b.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val).neg }
  let s := ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN
  let hs := ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection_spec G N hN
  let u : C(G ⧸ N, ZMod p) := b.comp s
  refine ⟨χh, u, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro g n
    have hgn : b (g * n) = b n + b g := hb_rightN g n
    have hconj : b (g * n) = b g + b (((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g n : ↥N) : G)) := by
      simpa [MulAut.conjNormal_apply, mul_assoc] using
        (hb_leftN (n := (MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g n)) (g := g))
    have hEq : b (n : G) + b g = b (((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g n : ↥N) : G)) + b g := by
      calc
        b (n : G) + b g = b (g * n) := by simpa using hgn.symm
        _ = b g + b (((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g n : ↥N) : G)) := hconj
        _ = b (((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g n : ↥N) : G)) + b g := by abel
    have hbn : b (((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g n : ↥N) : G)) = b (n : G) := by
      exact (add_right_cancel hEq).symm
    change -b (((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g n : ↥N) : G)) = -b (n : G)
    exact congrArg (fun a : ZMod p => -a) hbn
  · intro x y
    change
      ω.1 (x, y) =
        u y - u (x * y) + u x +
          (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier2Cocycle p G N s hs
            χh.toAddMonoidHom) (x, y)
    let d := ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreierDefect G N s hs x y
    have hx : QuotientGroup.mk' N (s x) = x := hs x
    have hy : QuotientGroup.mk' N (s y) = y := hs y
    have hxy := hb (s x) (s y)
    have hxy0 :
        ω.1 ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) (s x), (QuotientGroup.mk' N) (s y)) =
          b (s y) - b (s x * s y) + b (s x) := by
      simpa [QPull] using hxy
    have hxy' : ω.1 (x, y) = b (s y) - b (s x * s y) + b (s x) := by
      simpa [hx, hy] using hxy0
    have hd : (d : G) * s (x * y) = s x * s y := by
      change (s x * s y * (s (x * y))⁻¹) * s (x * y) = s x * s y
      group
    have hmul : b (s x * s y) = b (s (x * y)) + b d := by
      simpa [d, hd] using hb_leftN (n := d) (g := s (x * y))
    have hcont : Continuous (χh.toAddMonoidHom : Additive ↥N → ZMod p) := χh.continuous_toFun
    have hcont' : Continuous (fun n : Additive ↥N => -b (((@Additive.toMul ↥N) n : ↥N) : G)) := by
      simpa [χh] using hcont
    have hsch :
        (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier2Cocycle p G N s hs
          χh.toAddMonoidHom) (x, y) = -b d := by
      simpa [ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier2Cocycle, d, χh, hcont']
    calc
      ω.1 (x, y) = b (s y) - b (s x * s y) + b (s x) := hxy'
      _ = b (s y) - (b (s (x * y)) + b d) + b (s x) := by rw [hmul]
      _ = b (s y) - b (s (x * y)) + b (s x) - b d := by abel
      _ = b (s y) - b (s (x * y)) + b (s x) +
            (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier2Cocycle p G N s hs
              χh.toAddMonoidHom) (x, y) := by
            rw [hsch]
            abel
      _ = u y - u (x * y) + u x +
            (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier2Cocycle p G N s hs
              χh.toAddMonoidHom) (x, y) := by
            rfl

name: exists_h1NormalInvariantClass_of_continuousConjInvariantHom
statement:
theorem exists_h1NormalInvariantClass_of_continuousConjInvariantHom (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G))
    (χh : Additive ↥N →ₜ+ ZMod p)
    (hχinv : ∀ g : G, ∀ n : ↥N,
      χh (Additive.ofMul (MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g n)) = χh (Additive.ofMul n)) :
    ∃ χ : ↥(ErdosUnitDistance.h1NormalInvariantSubmodule p G N),
      ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.h1ToHom_explicit p G N hN χ.1 =
        χh.toAddMonoidHom
proof:
:= by
  haveI : CompactSpace ↥N := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hN.isCompact
  let eN :=
    ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom_inhomog
      (p := p) (K := ↥N)
  let x : ErdosUnitDistance.H1ContsTrivial p G N := eN.symm χh
  have hx : eN x = χh := by
    simpa [x] using eN.apply_symm_apply χh
  have hxhom :
      ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.h1ToHom_explicit p G N hN x =
        χh.toAddMonoidHom := by
    change (eN x).toAddMonoidHom = χh.toAddMonoidHom
    exact congrArg (fun f : Additive ↥N →ₜ+ ZMod p => f.toAddMonoidHom) hx
  have hxinv : ∀ g : G,
      (ErdosUnitDistance.h1ConjMap p G N g).hom x = x := by
    intro g
    have hcont :
        Continuous ((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g⁻¹ : ↥N ≃* ↥N) : ↥N → ↥N) := by
      refine continuous_induced_rng.2 ?_
      have hval : ∀ n : ↥N,
          ((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g⁻¹ n : ↥N) : G) = g⁻¹ * (n : G) * (g⁻¹)⁻¹ :=
        fun n => MulAut.conjNormal_apply g⁻¹ n
      simp only [Function.comp_def, hval]
      exact (continuous_const.mul continuous_subtype_val).mul continuous_const
    let c : Additive ↥N →ₜ+ Additive ↥N :=
      { toFun := fun n => Additive.ofMul (((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g⁻¹).toMonoidHom) n.toMul)
        map_zero' := by simp
        map_add' := by
          intro a b
          simp
        continuous_toFun := by
          simpa using hcont }
    have hnat :
        eN ((ErdosUnitDistance.h1ConjMap p G N g).hom x) = (eN x).comp c := by
      simpa [ErdosUnitDistance.h1ConjMap, eN, c] using
        ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom_inhomog_naturality
          (p := p) (G1 := ↥N) (G2 := ↥N)
          (f := (MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g⁻¹).toMonoidHom)
          (hf := hcont) x
    have hcomp : χh.comp c = χh := by
      ext n
      change
        χh (Additive.ofMul ((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g⁻¹) n.toMul)) =
          χh (Additive.ofMul n.toMul)
      exact hχinv g⁻¹ n.toMul
    rw [hx] at hnat
    apply eN.injective
    calc
      eN ((ErdosUnitDistance.h1ConjMap p G N g).hom x) = χh.comp c := hnat
      _ = χh := hcomp
      _ = eN x := hx.symm
  refine ⟨⟨x, hxinv⟩, ?_⟩
  exact hxhom

name: quotientCocycle_class_eq_transgression_of_sectionCochain_formula
statement:
theorem quotientCocycle_class_eq_transgression_of_sectionCochain_formula (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    [SecondCountableTopology G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G))
    (ω : {ω : C((G ⧸ N) × (G ⧸ N), ZMod p) //
        ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.IsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) ω})
    (χ : ↥(ErdosUnitDistance.h1NormalInvariantSubmodule p G N))
    (u : C(G ⧸ N, ZMod p))
    (hωu : ∀ x y : G ⧸ N,
      ω.1 (x, y) =
        u y - u (x * y) + u x +
          (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier2Cocycle p G N
            (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN)
            (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection_spec G N hN)
            (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.h1ToHom_explicit p G N hN χ.1)) (x, y)) :
    QClass p G N hN ω = transgression p G N hN χ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : TotallyDisconnectedSpace (G ⧸ N) :=
    ErdosUnitDistance.QuotientGroup.totallyDisconnectedSpace N hN
  let s : C(G ⧸ N, G) :=
    ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN
  let hs : ∀ x : G ⧸ N, QuotientGroup.mk' N (s x) = x :=
    ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection_spec G N hN
  let χh : Additive ↥N →+ ZMod p :=
    ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.h1ToHom_explicit p G N hN χ.1
  let ωχ : C((G ⧸ N) × (G ⧸ N), ZMod p) :=
    ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier2Cocycle p G N s hs χh
  let hωχ : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.IsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) ωχ :=
    ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier_isCocycle p G N s hs χh
      (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.h1ToHom_explicit_conjugation_invariant
        p G N hN χ)
  let corr : C((G ⧸ N) × (G ⧸ N), ZMod p) :=
    (u.comp ⟨fun xy : (G ⧸ N) × (G ⧸ N) => xy.2, continuous_snd⟩) -
      (u.comp ⟨fun xy : (G ⧸ N) × (G ⧸ N) => xy.1 * xy.2, continuous_fst.mul continuous_snd⟩) +
      (u.comp ⟨fun xy : (G ⧸ N) × (G ⧸ N) => xy.1, continuous_fst⟩)
  have hcorr : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.IsCoboundary2 p (G ⧸ N) corr := by
    refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
    intro x y
    rfl
  let zω : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Cocycles p (G ⧸ N) 2 :=
    ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) ω.1 ω.2
  let zχ : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Cocycles p (G ⧸ N) 2 :=
    ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) ωχ hωχ
  have hsub : (((zω - zχ : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Cocycles p (G ⧸ N) 2) :
      ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p (G ⧸ N) 2) =
      ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofProd p (G ⧸ N) corr) := by
    ext g
    change ω.1 (g 0, g 1) - ωχ (g 0, g 1) = corr (g 0, g 1)
    rw [hωu (g 0) (g 1)]
    simpa [corr, ωχ, χh, s, hs]
  have hmem :
      (((zω - zχ : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Cocycles p (G ⧸ N) 2) :
        ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p (G ⧸ N) 2) ∈
        ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Coboundaries p (G ⧸ N) 2) := by
    rw [hsub]
    exact ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofProd_mem_coboundaries_of_isCoboundary2
      p (G ⧸ N) corr hcorr
  have hclass_sub :
      ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p (G ⧸ N) 2 (zω - zχ) = 0 := by
    exact (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap_eq_zero_iff p (G ⧸ N) 2 (zω - zχ)).2 hmem
  have hclass_eq :
      ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p (G ⧸ N) 2 zω =
        ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p (G ⧸ N) 2 zχ := by
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    simpa [map_sub] using hclass_sub
  have hpack := congrArg ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p (G ⧸ N) 2)) hclass_eq
  simpa [QClass, transgression, ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.transgressionContinuous,
    ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.transgressionContinuous,
    zω, zχ, ωχ, hωχ, s, hs, χh] using hpack

name: normalized_quotientCocycle_class_eq_transgression_of_inflated_coboundary
statement:
theorem normalized_quotientCocycle_class_eq_transgression_of_inflated_coboundary (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    [SecondCountableTopology G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G))
    (ω : {ω : C((G ⧸ N) × (G ⧸ N), ZMod p) //
        ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.IsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) ω})
    (h1 : ∀ q : G ⧸ N, ω.1 (1, q) = 0)
    (h2 : ∀ q : G ⧸ N, ω.1 (q, 1) = 0)
    (hinfl : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.IsCoboundary2 p G (QPull p G N ω)) :
    ∃ χ : ↥(ErdosUnitDistance.h1NormalInvariantSubmodule p G N),
      QClass p G N hN ω = transgression p G N hN χ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases
      exists_continuousConjInvariantHom_and_sectionCochain_of_normalized_inflated_coboundary
        p G N hN ω h1 h2 hinfl with
    ⟨χh, u, hχinv, hω⟩
  rcases
      exists_h1NormalInvariantClass_of_continuousConjInvariantHom
        p G N hN χh hχinv with
    ⟨χ, hχ⟩
  refine ⟨χ, ?_⟩
  apply quotientCocycle_class_eq_transgression_of_sectionCochain_formula p G N hN ω χ u
  intro x y
  rw [hχ]
  exact hω x y

name: inflation_ker_le_transgression_range_H2
statement:
theorem inflation_ker_le_transgression_range_H2 (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    [SecondCountableTopology G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G)) :
    LinearMap.ker (inflation p G N 2).hom.toLinearMap ≤
      LinearMap.range (transgression p G N hN)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hx
  rcases continuousH2_exists_normalized_cocycle p G N hN x with ⟨ω, hωx, h1, h2⟩
  have hωG : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.IsCocycle2 p G (QPull p G N ω) := by
    intro g h k
    simpa [QPull] using ω.2 ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g) ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) h) ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) k)
  haveI : TotallyDisconnectedSpace (G ⧸ N) :=
    ErdosUnitDistance.QuotientGroup.totallyDisconnectedSpace N hN
  have hnat := cohomologyIso_natural_map_ofIsCocycle2 p G (G ⧸ N)
    (QuotientGroup.mk' N) QuotientGroup.continuous_mk ω.1 ω.2 hωG
  have hnat' :
      (inflation p G N 2).hom.toLinearMap (QClass p G N hN ω) =
        (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p G 2)
          (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p G 2
            (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p G (QPull p G N ω) hωG)) := by
    simpa [inflation, QClass, QPull] using hnat
  have hpullzero :
      (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p G 2)
        (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p G 2
          (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p G (QPull p G N ω) hωG)) = 0 := by
    rw [← hnat', hωx]
    exact hx
  have hclasszero :
      ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p G 2
        (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p G (QPull p G N ω) hωG) = 0 := by
    apply (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p G 2).injective
    simpa using hpullzero
  have hmem :
      (((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p G (QPull p G N ω) hωG :
        ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Cocycles p G 2) :
        ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p G 2) ∈
        ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Coboundaries p G 2) := by
    exact (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap_eq_zero_iff p G 2
      (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p G (QPull p G N ω) hωG)).mp hclasszero
  have hinfl : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.IsCoboundary2 p G (QPull p G N ω) := by
    have hmem' :
        ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofProd p G (QPull p G N ω) ∈
          LinearMap.range (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.d p G 1) := by
      simpa [ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Coboundaries] using hmem
    rw [LinearMap.mem_range] at hmem'
    rcases hmem' with ⟨b, hb⟩
    let b0 : C(G, ZMod p) :=
      b.comp ⟨fun g : G => ![g], by continuity⟩
    refine ⟨b0, ?_⟩
    intro g h
    have hbh' : ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.d p G 1) b) ![g, h] = (QPull p G N ω) (g, h) := by
      simpa [QPull, ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofProd] using
        congrArg (fun f : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p G 2 => f ![g, h]) hb
    have hc0 : Fin.contractNth (0 : Fin 2) (· * ·) ![g, h] = ![g * h] := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i
      simpa using (Fin.contractNth_apply_of_eq (j := (0 : Fin 2)) (op := (· * ·))
        (g := ![g, h]) (k := 0) rfl)
    have hc1 : Fin.contractNth (1 : Fin 2) (· * ·) ![g, h] = ![g] := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i
      simpa using (Fin.contractNth_apply_of_lt (j := (1 : Fin 2)) (op := (· * ·))
        (g := ![g, h]) (k := 0) (by decide))
    have hd_eval : ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.d p G 1) b) ![g, h] =
        b0 h - b0 (g * h) + b0 g := by
      change b (fun i => ![g, h] i.succ) +
          ∑ j : Fin 2, (-1 : ZMod p) ^ ((j : ℕ) + 1) • b (Fin.contractNth j (· * ·) ![g, h]) =
        b0 h - b0 (g * h) + b0 g
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp only [hc0, hc1, b0, sub_eq_add_neg]
      have hs : (fun i : Fin 1 => ![g, h] i.succ) = ![h] := by
        ext i
        fin_cases i
        rfl
      rw [hs]
      norm_num
      rw [← add_assoc]
      rfl
    calc
      (QPull p G N ω) (g, h) = ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.d p G 1) b) ![g, h] := by
        symm
        exact hbh'
      _ = b0 h - b0 (g * h) + b0 g := hd_eval
  rcases normalized_quotientCocycle_class_eq_transgression_of_inflated_coboundary p G N hN ω h1 h2 hinfl with ⟨χ, hχ⟩
  rw [LinearMap.mem_range]
  refine ⟨χ, ?_⟩
  rw [← hωx]
  symm
  exact hχ

name: restriction_range_comap_le_ker_transgression
statement:
theorem restriction_range_comap_le_ker_transgression (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    [SecondCountableTopology G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G)) :
    ((LinearMap.range (restriction p G N 1).hom.toLinearMap).comap
      (ErdosUnitDistance.h1NormalInvariantSubmodule p G N).subtype) ≤
      LinearMap.ker (transgression p G N hN)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  change transgression p G N hN x = 0
  have hx_range : x.1 ∈ LinearMap.range (restriction p G N 1).hom.toLinearMap := by
    simpa [Submodule.mem_comap] using hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx_range
  let x' : ↥(ErdosUnitDistance.h1NormalInvariantSubmodule p G N) :=
    ⟨(restriction p G N 1).hom y, by
      simpa using (hy.symm ▸ x.2)⟩
  have hx' : x = x' := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa [x'] using hy.symm
  rw [hx']
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψcont, hψ⟩ :=
    exists_continuous_h1ToHom_lift_of_restriction
      (p := p) (G := G) (N := N) (hN := hN) y
  let s := ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN
  have hs : ∀ q : G ⧸ N, QuotientGroup.mk' N (s q) = q :=
    ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection_spec G N hN
  haveI : TotallyDisconnectedSpace (G ⧸ N) :=
    ErdosUnitDistance.QuotientGroup.totallyDisconnectedSpace N hN
  let b : C(G ⧸ N, ZMod p) := by
    refine ⟨fun q => ψ (s q), ?_⟩
    simpa using hψcont.comp s.continuous
  let χN :=
    ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.h1ToHom p G N hN ((restriction p G N 1).hom y)
  have hχNcont : Continuous (χN : Additive ↥N → ZMod p) := by
    simpa [χN] using
      ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.h1ToHom_continuous p G N hN
        ((restriction p G N 1).hom y)
  let ω := ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier2Cocycle p G N s hs χN
  have hb : ∀ g h : G ⧸ N, ω (g, h) = b h - b (g * h) + b g := by
    intro g h
    show ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier2Cocycle p G N s hs χN
        (g, h) = b h - b (g * h) + b g
    simp only [ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier2Cocycle,
      hχNcont, dif_pos]
    have hχN_eval : ∀ n : Additive ↥N,
        χN n = (ψ.comp (MonoidHom.toAdditive N.subtype)) n := by
      intro n; exact congrArg (fun f : Additive ↥N →+ ZMod p => f n) hψ
    show χN (Additive.ofMul
        (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreierDefect G N s hs g h)) =
      b h - b (g * h) + b g
    rw [hχN_eval]
    show ψ (Additive.ofMul (s g) + Additive.ofMul (s h) + -Additive.ofMul (s (g * h))) =
      ψ (Additive.ofMul (s h)) - ψ (Additive.ofMul (s (g * h))) + ψ (Additive.ofMul (s g))
    rw [map_add, map_add, map_neg]
    abel
  have hω :=
    ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier_isCocycle p G N s hs χN
      (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.h1ToHom_explicit_conjugation_invariant
        p G N hN x')
  have hclass :
      ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p (G ⧸ N) 2
        (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) ω hω) = 0 := by
    exact (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap_eq_zero_iff (p := p) (G := (G ⧸ N))
      (n := 2)
      (c := ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) ω hω)).2
      (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofProd_mem_coboundaries_of_isCoboundary2
        (p := p) (G := (G ⧸ N)) (f := ω) ⟨b, hb⟩)
  have htrans : (transgression p G N hN) x' =
      ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p (G ⧸ N) 2
        (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p (G ⧸ N) 2
          (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) ω hω)) := by

    show ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.transgressionContinuous p G N hN x' =
      ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p (G ⧸ N) 2
        (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p (G ⧸ N) 2
          (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) ω hω))
    unfold ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.transgressionContinuous
    rfl
  rw [htrans]
  simpa [hclass]

name: transgression_range_le_inflation_ker_H2
statement:
theorem transgression_range_le_inflation_ker_H2 (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    [SecondCountableTopology G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G)) :
    LinearMap.range (transgression p G N hN) ≤
      LinearMap.ker (inflation p G N 2).hom.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.range_le_ker_iff]
  ext χ
  change (inflation p G N 2).hom.toLinearMap (transgression p G N hN χ) = 0
  have hω :
      ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.IsCocycle2 p G
        (inflatedSchreier2Cocycle p G N hN χ) := by
    let s := ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN
    let hs := ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection_spec G N hN
    let χh := (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.h1ToHom p G N hN) χ.1
    have hq :
        ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.IsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N)
          (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier2Cocycle p G N s hs χh) :=
      ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier_isCocycle p G N s hs χh
        (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.h1ToHom_explicit_conjugation_invariant p G N hN χ)
    intro g h k
    simpa [inflatedSchreier2Cocycle, s, hs, χh, map_mul] using
      hq ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g) ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) h) ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) k)
  rw [inflation_transgression_apply_eq p G N hN χ hω]
  have hzero :
      ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p G 2
        (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p G
          (inflatedSchreier2Cocycle p G N hN χ) hω) = 0 := by
    exact (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap_eq_zero_iff
      (p := p) (G := G) 2
      (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p G
        (inflatedSchreier2Cocycle p G N hN χ) hω)).2
      (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofProd_mem_coboundaries_of_isCoboundary2
        (p := p) (G := G) (inflatedSchreier2Cocycle p G N hN χ)
        (inflatedSchreier2Cocycle_isCoboundary p G N hN χ))
  simp [hzero]

name: exact_at_H2GN
statement:
theorem exact_at_H2GN (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    [SecondCountableTopology G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G)) :
    LinearMap.ker (inflation p G N 2).hom.toLinearMap =
      LinearMap.range (transgression p G N hN)
proof:
:= by
  exact le_antisymm
    (inflation_ker_le_transgression_range_H2 p G N hN)
    (transgression_range_le_inflation_ker_H2 p G N hN)

name: zero_transgression_exists_continuous_hom_lift
statement:
theorem zero_transgression_exists_continuous_hom_lift (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    [SecondCountableTopology G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G))
    (χ : ↥(ErdosUnitDistance.h1NormalInvariantSubmodule p G N)) :
    transgression p G N hN χ = 0 →
      ∃ ψ : Additive G →ₜ+ ZMod p,
        ψ.toAddMonoidHom.comp (MonoidHom.toAdditive N.subtype) =
          ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.h1ToHom_explicit p G N hN χ.1
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  classical
  haveI : TotallyDisconnectedSpace (G ⧸ N) :=
    ErdosUnitDistance.QuotientGroup.totallyDisconnectedSpace N hN
  let s := ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection G N hN
  let hs : ∀ x : G ⧸ N, QuotientGroup.mk' N (s x) = x :=
    ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.chosenSection_spec G N hN
  let χh := ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.h1ToHom_explicit p G N hN χ.1
  let ω := ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier2Cocycle p G N s hs χh
  let c : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Cocycles p (G ⧸ N) 2 :=
    ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofIsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) ω
      (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier_isCocycle p G N s hs χh
        (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.h1ToHom_explicit_conjugation_invariant p G N hN χ))
  have himg0 :
      (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p (G ⧸ N) 2)
        ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p (G ⧸ N) 2) c) = 0 := by
    dsimp [transgression, ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.transgressionContinuous,
      s, hs, χh, ω, c] at hzero ⊢
    exact hzero
  have hclass0 :
      (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap p (G ⧸ N) 2 c) = 0 := by
    apply (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogHomogIso.cohomologyIso p (G ⧸ N) 2).injective
    simpa using himg0
  have hmem :
      ((c : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p (G ⧸ N) 2)) ∈
        ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Coboundaries p (G ⧸ N) 2 := by
    exact (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.classMap_eq_zero_iff p (G ⧸ N) 2 c).1 hclass0
  rw [ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.Coboundaries] at hmem
  rcases LinearMap.mem_range.mp hmem with ⟨b, hb⟩
  let b0 : G ⧸ N → ZMod p := fun x => b (fun _ => x)
  have hb0cont : Continuous b0 := by
    refine b.continuous.comp ?_
    exact continuous_pi fun _ => (continuous_id : Continuous fun a : G ⧸ N => a)
  have hb0x : ∀ x : G ⧸ N, b ![x] = b0 x := by
    intro x
    change b ![x] = b (fun _ => x)
    congr 1
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    rfl
  have hb0fun : ∀ x : G ⧸ N, b (fun _ : Fin 1 => x) = b0 x := by
    intro x
    rfl
  have hb_eq_raw :
      ∀ x y : G ⧸ N,
        ω (x, y) = b ![x] + (b (fun _ : Fin 1 => y) - b ![x * y]) := by
    intro x y
    have hxy0 := congrArg (fun f : ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.Cochain p (G ⧸ N) 2 =>
      f ![x, y]) hb
    change ((ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.d p (G ⧸ N) 1) b) ![x, y] =
      (ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofProd p (G ⧸ N) ω) ![x, y] at hxy0
    change
      (b (fun i : Fin 1 => ![x, y] i.succ) +
        ∑ j : Fin 2,
          (-1 : ZMod p) ^ ((j : ℕ) + 1) • b (j.contractNth (· * ·) ![x, y])) =
        ω (x, y) at hxy0
    have hcontract0 : (0 : Fin 2).contractNth (· * ·) ![x, y] = ![x * y] := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i
      simp [Fin.contractNth_apply_of_eq]
    have hcontract1 : (1 : Fin 2).contractNth (· * ·) ![x, y] = ![x] := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i
      simp [Fin.contractNth_apply_of_lt]
    simpa [ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.d_apply,
      ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogContsCochains.dAux.toFun,
      ErdosUnitDistance.InhomogClassAPI.ofProd, Fin.sum_univ_two,
      hcontract0, hcontract1, sub_eq_add_neg,
      add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using hxy0.symm
  have hb_eq : ∀ x y : G ⧸ N, ω (x, y) = b0 x + (b0 y - b0 (x * y)) := by
    intro x y
    have h := hb_eq_raw x y
    rw [hb0x x, hb0fun y, hb0x (x * y)] at h
    exact h
  have hb_mul : ∀ x y : G ⧸ N, ω (x, y) + b0 (x * y) = b0 x + b0 y := by
    intro x y
    calc
      ω (x, y) + b0 (x * y) = (b0 x + (b0 y - b0 (x * y))) + b0 (x * y) := by
        rw [hb_eq]
      _ = b0 x + b0 y := by
        abel
  have hb1' : ω (1, 1) = b0 1 + (b0 1 - b0 1) := by
    simpa using hb_eq (1 : G ⧸ N) 1
  have hb1 : b0 1 = ω (1, 1) := by
    calc
      b0 1 = b0 1 + (b0 1 - b0 1) := by
        abel
      _ = ω (1, 1) := by
        simpa using hb1'.symm
  have h_ext_aux : ∀ n : N,
      χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN (n : G))) + b0 1 =
        χh (Additive.ofMul n) := by
    intro n
    have hqn : (QuotientGroup.mk' N) (n : G) = 1 := by
      exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := N) (x := (n : G))).mpr n.property
    have hmul :
        continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN (n : G) *
            ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.schreierDefect G N s hs 1 1 = n := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (((n : G) * (s ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) (n : G)))⁻¹) *
          (s 1 * s 1 * (s (1 * 1))⁻¹) : G) = (n : G)
      rw [hqn]
      simp [mul_assoc]
    calc
      χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN (n : G))) + b0 1
          = χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN (n : G))) + ω (1, 1) := by
              rw [hb1]
      _ = χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN (n : G))) +
            χh (Additive.ofMul
              (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.schreierDefect G N s hs 1 1)) := by

            have hχcont :
                Continuous (χh : Additive ↥N → ZMod p) := by
              simpa [χh] using
                ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.h1ToHom_explicit_continuous
                  p G N hN χ.1
            have hdefect :
                ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.schreierDefect G N s hs 1 1 =
                ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreierDefect
                  G N s hs 1 1 := by
              apply Subtype.ext; rfl
            have hω11 :
                ω (1, 1) = χh (Additive.ofMul
                  (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.schreierDefect G N s hs 1 1)) := by
              rw [hdefect]
              simp [ω,
                ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier2Cocycle,
                hχcont]
            rw [hω11]
      _ = χh (Additive.ofMul
            (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN (n : G) *
              ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.schreierDefect G N s hs 1 1)) := by
            simpa using
              (χh.map_add (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN (n : G)))
                (Additive.ofMul
                  (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.schreierDefect G N s hs 1 1))).symm
      _ = χh (Additive.ofMul n) := by rw [hmul]
  let ψ : Additive G →ₜ+ ZMod p := by
    refine
      { toFun := fun g =>
          χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN g.toMul)) +
            b0 ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g.toMul)
        map_zero' := by
          simpa using h_ext_aux (1 : N)
        map_add' := by
          intro g h
          let qg : G ⧸ N := (QuotientGroup.mk' N) g.toMul
          let qh : G ⧸ N := (QuotientGroup.mk' N) h.toMul
          have hconj :
              χh
                  (Additive.ofMul
                    (MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) (s qg)
                      (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN h.toMul))) =
                χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN h.toMul)) := by
            have hcomp := congrArg
              (fun f : Additive ↥N →+ ZMod p =>
                f (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN h.toMul)))
              (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.h1ToHom_explicit_conjugation_invariant p G N hN χ (s qg))
            simpa [χh, qg] using hcomp
          have hrχ :
              χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN (g.toMul * h.toMul))) =
                χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN g.toMul)) +
                  χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN h.toMul)) +
                    ω (qg, qh) := by
            rw [continuousQuotientSectionRemainder_mul]
            calc
              χh (Additive.ofMul
                  (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN g.toMul *
                    MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) (s qg)
                      (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN h.toMul) *
                    ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.schreierDefect G N s hs qg qh))
                  = χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN g.toMul)) +
                      χh
                        (Additive.ofMul
                          (MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) (s qg)
                            (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN h.toMul))) +
                      χh (Additive.ofMul
                        (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.schreierDefect G N s hs qg qh)) := by
                    simp [add_assoc]
              _ = χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN g.toMul)) +
                    χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN h.toMul)) +
                      χh (Additive.ofMul
                        (ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.schreierDefect G N s hs qg qh)) := by
                    rw [hconj]
              _ = χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN g.toMul)) +
                    χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN h.toMul)) +
                      ω (qg, qh) := by

                    have hχcont :
                        Continuous (χh : Additive ↥N → ZMod p) := by
                      simpa [χh] using
                        ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.h1ToHom_explicit_continuous
                          p G N hN χ.1
                    have hdefect :
                        ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuous.schreierDefect G N s hs qg qh =
                        ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreierDefect
                          G N s hs qg qh := by
                      apply Subtype.ext; rfl
                    rw [hdefect]
                    show _ = _ + ω (qg, qh)
                    simp [ω,
                      ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier2Cocycle,
                      hχcont]
          calc
            χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN (g.toMul * h.toMul))) +
                b0 ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) (g.toMul * h.toMul))
                = (χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN g.toMul)) +
                    χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN h.toMul)) +
                      ω (qg, qh)) + b0 (qg * qh) := by
                    rw [hrχ, map_mul]
            _ = χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN g.toMul)) +
                  χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN h.toMul)) +
                    (ω (qg, qh) + b0 (qg * qh)) := by
                  abel
            _ = χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN g.toMul)) +
                  χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN h.toMul)) +
                    (b0 qg + b0 qh) := by
                  rw [hb_mul]
            _ =
                (χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN g.toMul)) + b0 qg) +
                  (χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN h.toMul)) + b0 qh) := by
                  abel
        continuous_toFun := by
          have hχcont :
              Continuous fun g : G =>
                χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN g)) := by
            simpa using
              (h1ToHom_continuous p G N hN χ.1).comp
                (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN).continuous_toFun
          have hbcont : Continuous fun g : G => b0 ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g) := by
            exact hb0cont.comp QuotientGroup.continuous_mk
          have hcont :
              Continuous fun g : G =>
                χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN g)) +
                  b0 ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) g) := by
            exact hχcont.add hbcont
          simpa using hcont }
  refine ⟨ψ, ?_⟩
  ext n
  change χh (Additive.ofMul (continuousQuotientSectionRemainder G N hN (n : G))) +
      b0 ((QuotientGroup.mk' N) (n : G)) = χh (Additive.ofMul n)
  have hqn : (QuotientGroup.mk' N) (n : G) = 1 := by
    exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := N) (x := (n : G))).mpr n.property
  rw [hqn]
  exact h_ext_aux n

name: ker_transgression_le_restriction_range_comap
statement:
theorem ker_transgression_le_restriction_range_comap (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    [SecondCountableTopology G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G)) :
    LinearMap.ker (transgression p G N hN) ≤
      ((LinearMap.range (restriction p G N 1).hom.toLinearMap).comap
        (ErdosUnitDistance.h1NormalInvariantSubmodule p G N).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  intro χ hχ
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hχ
  change χ.1 ∈ LinearMap.range (restriction p G N 1).hom.toLinearMap
  classical
  haveI : CompactSpace ↥N := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hN.isCompact
  let e := continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom (p := p)
  rcases zero_transgression_exists_continuous_hom_lift (p := p) (G := G) (N := N) hN χ hχ with ⟨ψ, hψ⟩
  refine ⟨(e G).symm ψ, ?_⟩
  apply (e ↥N).injective
  have henat :=
    ErdosUnitDistance.TransgressionContinuousInternal.continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom_inhomog_naturality
      (p := p) (G1 := ↥N) (G2 := G) N.subtype continuous_subtype_val ((e G).symm ψ)
  have hleft :
      (e ↥N) ((restriction p G N 1).hom ((e G).symm ψ)) =
        ψ.comp (additiveSubtypeContinuousHom G N) := by
    simpa [e, restriction, additiveSubtypeContinuousHom,
      continuousH1TrivialAddEquivContinuousAddHom] using henat
  have hψ_add :
      (ψ.comp (additiveSubtypeContinuousHom G N)).toAddMonoidHom =
        ((e ↥N) χ.1).toAddMonoidHom := by
    rw [← h1ToHom_eq_package (p := p) (G := G) (N := N) (hN := hN) (x := χ.1)]
    simpa [additiveSubtypeContinuousHom] using hψ
  have hψ' :
      ψ.comp (additiveSubtypeContinuousHom G N) = (e ↥N) χ.1 := by
    ext n
    change (ψ.comp (additiveSubtypeContinuousHom G N)).toAddMonoidHom n =
      ((e ↥N) χ.1).toAddMonoidHom n
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun hψ_add n
  exact hleft.trans hψ'

name: exact_at_H1N_invariants
statement:
theorem exact_at_H1N_invariants (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [T2Space G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    [SecondCountableTopology G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G)) :
    LinearMap.ker (transgression p G N hN) =
      ((LinearMap.range (restriction p G N 1).hom.toLinearMap).comap
        (ErdosUnitDistance.h1NormalInvariantSubmodule p G N).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  exact le_antisymm
    (ker_transgression_le_restriction_range_comap p G N hN)
    (restriction_range_comap_le_ker_transgression p G N hN)

name: coboundaries_le_cocycles
statement:
theorem coboundaries_le_cocycles (n : ℕ) :
    Coboundaries p G n ≤ Cocycles p G n
proof:
:= by

  cases n with
  | zero =>
      simpa [Coboundaries, Cocycles] using
        (bot_le : (⊥ : Submodule (ZMod p) (Cochain p G 0)) ≤ Cocycles p G 0)
  | succ k =>
      simpa [Coboundaries, Cocycles] using
        (LinearMap.range_le_ker_iff.mpr (d_comp_d p G k))

name: classMap_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem classMap_eq_zero_iff (n : ℕ) (c : Cocycles p G n) :
    classMap p G n c = 0 ↔ (c : Cochain p G n) ∈ Coboundaries p G n
proof:
:= by

  simpa [classMap, coboundariesInCocycles, Submodule.mem_comap] using
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (p := coboundariesInCocycles p G n) (x := c))

name: ofProd_apply
statement:
theorem ofProd_apply (f : C(G × G, ZMod p)) (g : Fin 2 → G) :
    ofProd p G f g = f (g 0, g 1)
proof: := rfl

name: d_two_ofProd_apply
statement:
theorem d_two_ofProd_apply (f : C(G × G, ZMod p)) (g : Fin 3 → G) :
    (d p G 2 (ofProd p G f)) g
      = f (g 1, g 2) - f (g 0 * g 1, g 2) + f (g 0, g 1 * g 2) - f (g 0, g 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_apply, dAux.toFun, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  rw [ofProd_apply, ofProd_apply, ofProd_apply, ofProd_apply]
  have h00 : Fin.contractNth 0 (· * ·) g 0 = g 0 * g 1 := by
    rw [Fin.contractNth_apply_of_eq _ _ _ _ rfl]
    simp [Fin.castSucc_zero', Fin.succ_zero_eq_one']
  have h01 : Fin.contractNth 0 (· * ·) g 1 = g 2 := by
    rw [Fin.contractNth_apply_of_gt _ _ _ _ (by decide)]
    simp [Fin.succ_one_eq_two']
  have h10 : Fin.contractNth 1 (· * ·) g 0 = g 0 := by
    rw [Fin.contractNth_apply_of_lt _ _ _ _ (by decide)]
    simp [Fin.castSucc_zero']
  have h11 : Fin.contractNth 1 (· * ·) g 1 = g 1 * g 2 := by
    rw [Fin.contractNth_apply_of_eq _ _ _ _ rfl]
    simp [Fin.succ_one_eq_two']
  have h20 : Fin.contractNth 2 (· * ·) g 0 = g 0 := by
    rw [Fin.contractNth_apply_of_lt _ _ _ _ (by decide)]
    simp [Fin.castSucc_zero']
  have h21 : Fin.contractNth 2 (· * ·) g 1 = g 1 := by
    rw [Fin.contractNth_apply_of_lt _ _ _ _ (by decide)]
    simp
  rw [h00, h01, h10, h11, h20, h21]
  simp [sub_eq_add_neg, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one', Fin.succ_one_eq_two',
    pow_succ' (-1 : ZMod p) 2, neg_sq]
  ac_rfl

name: ofSingle_apply
statement:
theorem ofSingle_apply (f : C(G, ZMod p)) (g : Fin 1 → G) :
    ofSingle p G f g = f (g 0)
proof: := rfl

name: d_one_ofSingle_apply
statement:
theorem d_one_ofSingle_apply (f : C(G, ZMod p)) (g : Fin 2 → G) :
    (d p G 1 (ofSingle p G f)) g = f (g 1) - f (g 0 * g 1) + f (g 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_apply, dAux.toFun, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  have hfirst : (ofSingle p G f) (fun i => g i.succ) = f (g 1) := by
    rw [ofSingle_apply]
    rfl
  have h0' : Fin.contractNth 0 (· * ·) g 0 = g 0 * g 1 := by
    rw [Fin.contractNth_apply_of_eq]
    · rfl
    · rfl
  have h0 : (ofSingle p G f) (Fin.contractNth 0 (· * ·) g) = f (g 0 * g 1) := by
    rw [ofSingle_apply, h0']
  have h1' : Fin.contractNth 1 (· * ·) g 0 = g 0 := by
    rw [Fin.contractNth_apply_of_lt]
    · rfl
    · decide
  have h1 : (ofSingle p G f) (Fin.contractNth 1 (· * ·) g) = f (g 0) := by
    rw [ofSingle_apply, h1']
  rw [hfirst, h0, h1]
  simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc]

name: ofProd_mem_coboundaries_of_isCoboundary2
statement:
theorem ofProd_mem_coboundaries_of_isCoboundary2 (f : C(G × G, ZMod p))
    (hf : IsCoboundary2 p G f) :
    ofProd p G f ∈ Coboundaries p G 2
proof:
:= by

  rcases hf with ⟨b, hb⟩
  simpa [Coboundaries] using
    (show ofProd p G f ∈ LinearMap.range (d p G 1) from by
      refine ⟨ofSingle p G b, ?_⟩
      ext g
      rw [d_one_ofSingle_apply (p := p) (G := G) (f := b) (g := g)]
      change b (g 1) - b (g 0 * g 1) + b (g 0) = f (g 0, g 1)
      simpa using (hb (g 0) (g 1)).symm)

name: vanish_conj
statement:
theorem vanish_conj
    {N : Subgroup G} [N.Normal] (χ : GInvariantHom p G N)
    (g : G) (x : ↥N) (hx : χ.hom x = 1) :
    χ.hom ⟨g * (x : G) * g⁻¹, ‹N.Normal›.conj_mem (x : G) x.2 g⟩ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [χ.ginv g x, hx]

name: evaluation_injective_of_normal_generators
statement:
theorem evaluation_injective_of_normal_generators
    {k : ℕ} (g : Fin k → G)
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]
    (_hN : N = (Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g)).topologicalClosure)
    (χ : GInvariantHom p G N)
    (hχ_zero : ∀ i : Fin k,
      ∃ (hmem : (g i : G) ∈ N),
        χ.hom ⟨g i, hmem⟩ = 1) :
    ∀ x : ↥N, χ.hom x = 1
proof:
:= by

  set K : Subgroup ↥N := χ.hom.ker with hK_def

  set K' : Subgroup G := K.map N.subtype with hK'_def

  have hK'_iff : ∀ x : G, x ∈ K' ↔
      ∃ (hmem : x ∈ N), χ.hom ⟨x, hmem⟩ = 1 := by
    intro x
    simp only [hK'_def, hK_def, Subgroup.mem_map, MonoidHom.mem_ker, Subgroup.coe_subtype]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨y.2, hy⟩
    · rintro ⟨hmem, hχ⟩
      exact ⟨⟨x, hmem⟩, hχ, rfl⟩

  have hK'_normal : K'.Normal := by
    refine ⟨fun n hn h => ?_⟩
    rcases (hK'_iff n).mp hn with ⟨hn_mem, hχn⟩
    refine (hK'_iff _).mpr ?_
    refine ⟨‹N.Normal›.conj_mem n hn_mem h, ?_⟩
    exact χ.vanish_conj h ⟨n, hn_mem⟩ hχn

  have h_gen_le : Set.range g ⊆ (K' : Set G) := by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rcases hχ_zero i with ⟨hmem, hχ⟩
    exact (hK'_iff (g i)).mpr ⟨hmem, hχ⟩

  have h_normalClosure_le : Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g) ≤ K' :=
    Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal h_gen_le

  have hN_closed : IsClosed (N : Set G) := by
    rw [_hN]
    exact Subgroup.isClosed_topologicalClosure _

  have hK_closed : IsClosed (K : Set ↥N) := by
    have : (K : Set ↥N) = χ.hom ⁻¹' {1} := rfl
    rw [this]
    exact (isClosed_singleton).preimage χ.continuous

  have hN_closedMap : IsClosedMap ((↑) : ↥N → G) :=
    hN_closed.isClosedMap_subtype_val

  have hK'_closed : IsClosed (K' : Set G) := by
    have h_eq : (K' : Set G) = ((↑) : ↥N → G) '' (K : Set ↥N) := by
      simp [hK'_def, Subgroup.coe_map]
    rw [h_eq]
    exact hN_closedMap _ hK_closed

  have h_topClosure_le : (Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g)).topologicalClosure ≤ K' :=
    Subgroup.topologicalClosure_minimal _ h_normalClosure_le hK'_closed

  have hN_le_K' : N ≤ K' := by rw [_hN]; exact h_topClosure_le

  intro x
  have hxG : (x : G) ∈ K' := hN_le_K' x.2
  rcases (hK'_iff (x : G)).mp hxG with ⟨_, hχ⟩

  exact hχ

name: dim_GInvariantHom_le
statement:
theorem dim_GInvariantHom_le
    {k : ℕ} (g : Fin k → G)
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]
    (_hN : N = (Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g)).topologicalClosure) :
    Module.finrank (ZMod p) (GInvariantContsHomSubmodule p G N) ≤ k
proof:
:= by

  have hg_mem : ∀ i : Fin k, (g i : G) ∈ N := by
    intro i
    have h1 : (g i : G) ∈ Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g) :=
      Subgroup.subset_normalClosure ⟨i, rfl⟩
    have h2 : Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g) ≤
        (Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g)).topologicalClosure :=
      Subgroup.le_topologicalClosure _
    have : (g i : G) ∈ (Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g)).topologicalClosure := h2 h1
    rwa [← _hN] at this

  let eval : GInvariantContsHomSubmodule p G N →ₗ[ZMod p] (Fin k → ZMod p) :=
    { toFun := fun f i => (f : ↥N → ZMod p) ⟨g i, hg_mem i⟩
      map_add' := by
        intro f f'
        funext i
        rfl
      map_smul' := by
        intro c f
        funext i
        rfl }

  have heval_inj : Function.Injective eval := by
    intro f f' hff'

    obtain ⟨f, hf_hom, hf_one, hf_c, hf_g⟩ := f
    obtain ⟨f', hf'_hom, hf'_one, hf'_c, hf'_g⟩ := f'

    set d : ↥N → ZMod p := f - f' with hd_def
    have hd_hom : ∀ x y : ↥N, d (x * y) = d x + d y := by
      intro x y
      simp [hd_def, hf_hom, hf'_hom]; ring
    have hd_one : d 1 = 0 := by simp [hd_def, hf_one, hf'_one]
    have hd_c : Continuous d := hf_c.sub hf'_c
    have hd_g : ∀ (h : G) (x : ↥N),
        d ⟨h * (x : G) * h⁻¹, ‹N.Normal›.conj_mem (x : G) x.2 h⟩ = d x := by
      intro h x
      simp [hd_def, hf_g h x, hf'_g h x]

    let dhom : ↥N →* Multiplicative (ZMod p) :=
      { toFun := fun x => Multiplicative.ofAdd (d x)
        map_one' := by simp [hd_one]
        map_mul' := by intro x y; simp [hd_hom] }
    have hdhom_c : Continuous dhom := by

      change Continuous (fun x => Multiplicative.ofAdd (d x))
      exact hd_c
    have hdhom_ginv : ∀ (h : G) (x : ↥N),
        dhom ⟨h * (x : G) * h⁻¹, ‹N.Normal›.conj_mem (x : G) x.2 h⟩ = dhom x := by
      intro h x
      change Multiplicative.ofAdd _ = Multiplicative.ofAdd _
      exact congrArg Multiplicative.ofAdd (hd_g h x)
    let χ : GInvariantHom p G N :=
      { hom := dhom, continuous := hdhom_c, ginv := hdhom_ginv }

    have hχ_zero : ∀ i : Fin k,
        ∃ (hmem : (g i : G) ∈ N), χ.hom ⟨g i, hmem⟩ = 1 := by
      intro i
      refine ⟨hg_mem i, ?_⟩
      change Multiplicative.ofAdd (d ⟨g i, hg_mem i⟩) = Multiplicative.ofAdd 0
      apply congrArg
      have hi := congrFun hff' i

      change d ⟨g i, hg_mem i⟩ = 0
      simp only [hd_def, Pi.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero]
      exact hi

    have hd_zero : ∀ x : ↥N, d x = 0 := by
      intro x
      have hχx : χ.hom x = 1 :=
        evaluation_injective_of_normal_generators p G g N _hN χ hχ_zero x

      have : Multiplicative.ofAdd (d x) = Multiplicative.ofAdd (0 : ZMod p) := hχx
      simpa using this

    apply Subtype.ext
    funext x
    have hx : d x = 0 := hd_zero x
    have : (f - f') x = 0 := by simpa [hd_def] using hx
    simpa [Pi.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero] using this

  have h := LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective heval_inj
  simpa [Module.finrank_fin_fun] using h

name: h1NormalInvariantRank_le_normalGenerators
statement:
theorem h1NormalInvariantRank_le_normalGenerators
    (_hG : IsFinitelyGeneratedProPGroup p G)
    {k : ℕ} (g : Fin k → G) :
    haveI : (Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g)).topologicalClosure.Normal
proof:
:=
      Subgroup.is_normal_topologicalClosure (Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g))
    H1NormalInvariantFinite p G
        ((Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g)).topologicalClosure) ∧
      h1NormalInvariantRank p G
        ((Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g)).topologicalClosure) ≤ k := by

  exact BrumerKochInternal.h1NormalInvariantRank_le_normalGenerators p G _hG g

name: schreier_isCocycle
statement:
theorem schreier_isCocycle (s : C(G ⧸ N, G))
    (hs : ∀ x : G ⧸ N, QuotientGroup.mk' N (s x) = x)
    (χ : ContinuousAddMonoidHom (Additive ↥N) (ZMod p))
    (_hχ : ∀ (g : G) (n : ↥N),
      χ (Additive.ofMul (MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g n)) =
        χ (Additive.ofMul n)) :
    IsCocycle2 p (G ⧸ N) (schreier2Cocycle p G N s hs χ)
proof:
:= by

  have hχ_comp : ∀ g : G, (χ : Additive ↥N →+ ZMod p).comp
      (MonoidHom.toAdditive
        ((MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g).toMonoidHom)) =
      (χ : Additive ↥N →+ ZMod p) := by
    intro g
    ext n
    exact _hχ g n
  have hcocycle :=
    TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier_isCocycle p G N s hs
      (χ : Additive ↥N →+ ZMod p) hχ_comp

  intro x y z
  have hχcont : Continuous (χ : Additive ↥N →+ ZMod p) := χ.continuous_toFun
  have heq :
      TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier2Cocycle p G N s hs
          (χ : Additive ↥N →+ ZMod p) =
        schreier2Cocycle p G N s hs χ := by
    ext xy
    show TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier2Cocycle p G N s hs
        (χ : Additive ↥N →+ ZMod p) xy = _
    rw [TransgressionContinuousInternal.schreier2Cocycle]
    simp only [hχcont, dif_pos]
    rfl
  have := hcocycle x y z
  simpa [heq] using this

name: h1ToHom_conjugation_invariant
statement:
theorem h1ToHom_conjugation_invariant (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G))
    (χ : ↥(h1NormalInvariantSubmodule p G N)) :
    ∀ (g : G) (n : ↥N),
      h1ToHom p G N hN χ.1 (Additive.ofMul (MulAut.conjNormal (H := N) g n)) =
        h1ToHom p G N hN χ.1 (Additive.ofMul n)
proof:

  intro g n
  have hcomp := TransgressionContinuousInternal.h1ToHom_explicit_conjugation_invariant
    p G N hN χ g

  have := congrArg (fun f : Additive ↥N →+ ZMod p =>
    f (Additive.ofMul n)) hcomp
  simpa [h1ToHom, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply,
    MonoidHom.toAdditive, AddMonoidHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk,
    Additive.ofMul] using this

      symm

    _ = AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟 * 2 := by

name: admissibleDatum_iO_field_minpoly_eq
statement:
theorem admissibleDatum_iO_field_minpoly_eq (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) :
  minpoly 𝒟.L (((admissibleDatum_iO 𝒟 : NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.K) : 𝒟.K)) =
    Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C (1 : 𝒟.L)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let x : 𝒟.K := ((admissibleDatum_iO 𝒟 : NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.K) : 𝒟.K)
  change minpoly 𝒟.L x = Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C (1 : 𝒟.L)
  have hx : x = 𝒟.i_K := by
    rfl
  have hx_int : IsIntegral 𝒟.L x := by
    letI : Algebra.IsIntegral 𝒟.L 𝒟.K := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite 𝒟.L 𝒟.K
    exact (Algebra.isIntegral_def.mp inferInstance) x
  have hnat : (minpoly 𝒟.L x).natDegree = 2 := by
    have hadjoin : Algebra.adjoin 𝒟.L ({x} : Set 𝒟.K) = ⊤ := by
      simpa [admissibleDatum_iO] using 𝒟.adjoin_i_K_eq_top
    have hprim : IntermediateField.adjoin 𝒟.L ({x} : Set 𝒟.K) = ⊤ :=
      IntermediateField.adjoin_eq_top_of_algebra (F := 𝒟.L) (S := ({x} : Set 𝒟.K)) hadjoin
    simpa [Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension.finrank_eq_two 𝒟.L 𝒟.K] using
      (Field.primitive_element_iff_minpoly_natDegree_eq (F := 𝒟.L) (E := 𝒟.K) x).1 (by simpa using hprim)
  have hdiv : minpoly 𝒟.L x ∣ Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C (1 : 𝒟.L) := by
    refine minpoly.dvd (A := 𝒟.L) (x := x) ?_
    rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, Polynomial.eval₂_add, Polynomial.eval₂_X_pow, Polynomial.eval₂_C]
    have hsq : x ^ 2 = (-1 : 𝒟.K) := by
      simpa [hx, pow_two] using 𝒟.i_K_sq
    rw [hsq]
    simpa
  have hmonic_min : (minpoly 𝒟.L x).Monic := minpoly.monic hx_int
  have hmonic_poly : (Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C (1 : 𝒟.L)).Monic := by
    simpa using (Polynomial.monic_X_pow_add_C (a := (1 : 𝒟.L)) (n := 2) (by decide))
  have hdeg_poly : (Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C (1 : 𝒟.L)).natDegree = 2 := by
    simpa using (Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow_add_C (R := 𝒟.L) (n := 2) (r := (1 : 𝒟.L)))
  have hne_poly : (Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C (1 : 𝒟.L)) ≠ 0 := by
    exact hmonic_poly.ne_zero
  have hassoc : Associated (minpoly 𝒟.L x) (Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C (1 : 𝒟.L)) := by
    apply Polynomial.associated_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le hdiv hne_poly
    rw [hdeg_poly, hnat]
  have hnorm : normalize (minpoly 𝒟.L x) = normalize (Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C (1 : 𝒟.L)) :=
    (normalize_eq_normalize_iff_associated).2 hassoc
  rw [hmonic_min.normalize_eq_self] at hnorm
  rw [hmonic_poly.normalize_eq_self] at hnorm
  exact hnorm

name: admissibleDatum_iO_minpoly_eq
statement:
theorem admissibleDatum_iO_minpoly_eq (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) :
  minpoly (NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.L) (admissibleDatum_iO 𝒟) =
    Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C (1 : NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.L)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let x : NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.K := admissibleDatum_iO 𝒟
  change minpoly (NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.L) x =
    Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C (1 : NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.L)
  have hx_field :
      minpoly 𝒟.L ((x : NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.K) : 𝒟.K) =
        Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C (1 : 𝒟.L) := by
    simpa [x] using admissibleDatum_iO_field_minpoly_eq 𝒟
  have hfrac :=
    minpoly.isIntegrallyClosed_eq_field_fractions
      (R := NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.L)
      (S := NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.K)
      (K := 𝒟.L)
      (L := 𝒟.K)
      (s := x)
      (hs := by
        exact (Algebra.isIntegral_def.mp
          (NumberField.RingOfIntegers.extension_algebra_isIntegral
            (K := 𝒟.L) (L := 𝒟.K))) x)
  have hmap_rhs :
      (Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C (1 : NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.L)).map
          (algebraMap (NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.L) 𝒟.L) =
        Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C (1 : 𝒟.L) := by
    simp only [Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.map_C,
      RingHom.map_one, Polynomial.map_one]
  apply (Polynomial.map_injective
    (f := algebraMap (NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.L) 𝒟.L)
    (hf := IsFractionRing.injective (NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.L) 𝒟.L))
  exact hfrac.symm.trans (hx_field.trans hmap_rhs.symm)

name: admissibleDatum_two_iO_mem_differentIdeal
statement:
theorem admissibleDatum_two_iO_mem_differentIdeal (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) :
  2 * admissibleDatum_iO 𝒟 ∈
    differentIdeal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.L) (NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.K)
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    aeval_derivative_mem_differentIdeal
      (A := NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.L)
      (K := 𝒟.L)
      (L := 𝒟.K)
      (B := NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.K)
      (x := admissibleDatum_iO 𝒟)
      (by
        simpa [admissibleDatum_iO] using (𝒟.adjoin_i_K_eq_top))
  simpa [admissibleDatum_iO_minpoly_eq,
    show (1 + 1 : NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.K) = 2 by norm_num] using h

name: admissibleDatum_differentIdeal_absNorm_le_four_pow_f
statement:
theorem admissibleDatum_differentIdeal_absNorm_le_four_pow_f (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) :
  Ideal.absNorm
      (differentIdeal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.L) (NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.K))
    ≤ 4 ^ (AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟)
proof:
:= by
  let A := NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.K
  let I : Ideal A :=
    differentIdeal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.L) A
  have hiO_unit : IsUnit (admissibleDatum_iO 𝒟) := by
    refine ⟨⟨admissibleDatum_iO 𝒟, -admissibleDatum_iO 𝒟, ?_, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    · ext
      change 𝒟.i_K * (-𝒟.i_K) = 1
      calc
        𝒟.i_K * (-𝒟.i_K) = -(𝒟.i_K * 𝒟.i_K) := by ring
        _ = -(-1) := by rw [𝒟.i_K_sq]
        _ = 1 := by norm_num
    · ext
      change (-𝒟.i_K) * 𝒟.i_K = 1
      calc
        (-𝒟.i_K) * 𝒟.i_K = -(𝒟.i_K * 𝒟.i_K) := by ring
        _ = -(-1) := by rw [𝒟.i_K_sq]
        _ = 1 := by norm_num
  have hspan_le : Ideal.span ({2 * admissibleDatum_iO 𝒟} : Set A) ≤ I := by
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
    simpa [I, A] using admissibleDatum_two_iO_mem_differentIdeal 𝒟
  have hdiv : Ideal.absNorm I ∣ Ideal.absNorm (Ideal.span ({2 * admissibleDatum_iO 𝒟} : Set A)) := by
    exact Ideal.absNorm_dvd_absNorm_of_le hspan_le
  have hspan_eq : Ideal.span ({2 * admissibleDatum_iO 𝒟} : Set A) = Ideal.span ({(2 : A)} : Set A) := by
    simpa [A, mul_comm] using
