      (Ideal.span_singleton_mul_right_unit (a := admissibleDatum_iO 𝒟) hiO_unit (x := (2 : A)))
  have hrank0 : Module.finrank ℤ A = Module.finrank ℚ 𝒟.K := by
    simpa [A] using (IsIntegralClosure.rank ℤ ℚ 𝒟.K A)
  have hfinrankK : Module.finrank ℚ 𝒟.K = 2 * AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟 := by
    calc
      Module.finrank ℚ 𝒟.K = Module.finrank ℚ 𝒟.L * Module.finrank 𝒟.L 𝒟.K := by
        symm
        exact Module.finrank_mul_finrank ℚ 𝒟.L 𝒟.K
      _ = AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟 * 2 := by
        rw [AdmissibleDatum.f, Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension.finrank_eq_two 𝒟.L 𝒟.K]
      _ = 2 * AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟 := by ring
  have hrank : Module.finrank ℤ A = 2 * AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟 := by
    rw [hrank0, hfinrankK]
  have hnorm2Q : ((Algebra.norm ℤ (2 : A) : ℤ) : ℚ) = ((2 : ℚ) ^ (2 * AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟)) := by
    calc
      ((Algebra.norm ℤ (2 : A) : ℤ) : ℚ) = algebraMap ℤ ℚ (Algebra.intNorm ℤ A (2 : A)) := by
        rw [Algebra.intNorm_eq_norm]
        rfl
      _ = Algebra.norm ℚ (((2 : A) : 𝒟.K)) := by
        simpa [A] using (Algebra.algebraMap_intNorm (A := ℤ) (K := ℚ) (L := 𝒟.K) (B := A) (x := (2 : A)))
      _ = Algebra.norm ℚ (2 : 𝒟.K) := by rfl
      _ = (2 : ℚ) ^ Module.finrank ℚ 𝒟.K := by
        simpa using (Algebra.norm_algebraMap (K := ℚ) (L := 𝒟.K) (x := (2 : ℚ)))
      _ = ((2 : ℚ) ^ (2 * AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟)) := by rw [hfinrankK]
  have hnorm2 : Algebra.norm ℤ (2 : A) = (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 * AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟) := by
    apply Int.cast_injective (α := ℚ)
    calc
      ((Algebra.norm ℤ (2 : A) : ℤ) : ℚ) = (2 : ℚ) ^ (2 * AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟) := hnorm2Q
      _ = (((2 : ℤ) ^ (2 * AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟) : ℤ) : ℚ) := by norm_num
  have hspan_norm : Ideal.absNorm (Ideal.span ({(2 : A)} : Set A)) = 4 ^ AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟 := by
    rw [Ideal.absNorm_span_singleton, hnorm2]
    norm_num [pow_mul]
  have hdiv' : Ideal.absNorm I ∣ 4 ^ AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟 := by
    rw [hspan_eq, hspan_norm] at hdiv
    exact hdiv
  exact Nat.le_of_dvd (by positivity) hdiv'

name: admissibleDatum_natAbs_discr_K_le_four_pow_f_mul_natAbs_discr_L_sq
statement:
theorem admissibleDatum_natAbs_discr_K_le_four_pow_f_mul_natAbs_discr_L_sq (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) :
  (NumberField.discr 𝒟.K).natAbs ≤
    4 ^ (AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟) * (NumberField.discr 𝒟.L).natAbs ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let D := Ideal.absNorm
    (differentIdeal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.L) (NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.K))
  have hD : D ≤ 4 ^ (AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟) := by
    simpa [D] using admissibleDatum_differentIdeal_absNorm_le_four_pow_f 𝒟
  have hdisc_nat : (NumberField.discr 𝒟.K).natAbs =
      D * (NumberField.discr 𝒟.L).natAbs ^ 2 := by
    simpa [D, Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension.finrank_eq_two 𝒟.L 𝒟.K] using
      (NumberField.natAbs_discr_eq_absNorm_differentIdeal_mul_natAbs_discr_pow
        𝒟.L (NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.L) 𝒟.K (NumberField.RingOfIntegers 𝒟.K))
  calc
    (NumberField.discr 𝒟.K).natAbs = D * (NumberField.discr 𝒟.L).natAbs ^ 2 := hdisc_nat
    _ ≤ 4 ^ (AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟) * (NumberField.discr 𝒟.L).natAbs ^ 2 :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right ((NumberField.discr 𝒟.L).natAbs ^ 2) hD

name: rootDiscr_adjoin_i_bound
statement:
theorem rootDiscr_adjoin_i_bound (𝒟 : AdmissibleDatum) :
  NumberField.rootDiscr 𝒟.K ≤ 2 * NumberField.rootDiscr 𝒟.L
proof:
:= by
  have hdisc : ((NumberField.discr 𝒟.K).natAbs : ℝ) ≤ (4 : ℝ) ^ (AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟) *
      ((NumberField.discr 𝒟.L).natAbs : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    exact_mod_cast admissibleDatum_natAbs_discr_K_le_four_pow_f_mul_natAbs_discr_L_sq 𝒟
  let n : ℕ := 2 * AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟
  have hfinrankK' := by
    letI : Algebra ℚ 𝒟.K := DivisionRing.toRatAlgebra
    show ((Module.finrank ℚ 𝒟.K : ℕ) : ℝ) = (n : ℝ)
    exact_mod_cast admissibleDatum_finrankK_eq_two_mul_f_anyAlg (𝒟 := 𝒟)
  have hfinrankK_inv := by
    letI : Algebra ℚ 𝒟.K := DivisionRing.toRatAlgebra
    show (((Module.finrank ℚ 𝒟.K : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) = ((n : ℝ)⁻¹)
    simpa using congrArg Inv.inv hfinrankK'
  have hrootK : NumberField.rootDiscr 𝒟.K = ((NumberField.discr 𝒟.K).natAbs : ℝ) ^ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    rw [NumberField.rootDiscr_def, ← Nat.cast_natAbs]
    exact congrArg (fun t : ℝ => ((NumberField.discr 𝒟.K).natAbs : ℝ) ^ t) hfinrankK_inv
  have hrootL : NumberField.rootDiscr 𝒟.L =
      ((NumberField.discr 𝒟.L).natAbs : ℝ) ^ ((AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟 : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    rw [NumberField.rootDiscr_def, AdmissibleDatum.f, ← Nat.cast_natAbs]
  have hn : n ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [n]
    exact Nat.mul_ne_zero (by decide) (Nat.ne_of_gt 𝒟.f_pos)
  have hexp_nonneg : 0 ≤ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    positivity
  have hpow := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) hdisc hexp_nonneg
  have hpow4 : (4 : ℝ) ^ (AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟) = (2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
    dsimp [n]
    rw [pow_mul]
    norm_num
  have hfour : ((4 : ℝ) ^ (AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟)) ^ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹) = 2 := by
    rw [hpow4]
    exact Real.pow_rpow_inv_natCast (by positivity) hn
  have hf_ne : (AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt 𝒟.f_pos)
  have hn_cast : (n : ℝ) = 2 * (AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟 : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [n]
    norm_num [Nat.cast_mul]
  have hLfactor : ((((NumberField.discr 𝒟.L).natAbs : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹)) =
      ((NumberField.discr 𝒟.L).natAbs : ℝ) ^ ((AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟 : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast_mul
      (show 0 ≤ ((NumberField.discr 𝒟.L).natAbs : ℝ) by positivity) 2 ((n : ℝ)⁻¹)]
    have hmul : (2 : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ)⁻¹) = (AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟 : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      rw [hn_cast]
      field_simp [hf_ne]
    simpa using congrArg (fun t : ℝ => ((NumberField.discr 𝒟.L).natAbs : ℝ) ^ t) hmul
  calc
    NumberField.rootDiscr 𝒟.K = ((NumberField.discr 𝒟.K).natAbs : ℝ) ^ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹) := hrootK
    _ ≤ ((4 : ℝ) ^ (AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟) * ((NumberField.discr 𝒟.L).natAbs : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹) := hpow
    _ = ((4 : ℝ) ^ (AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟)) ^ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹) *
          ((((NumberField.discr 𝒟.L).natAbs : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹)) := by
          rw [Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    _ = 2 * ((NumberField.discr 𝒟.L).natAbs : ℝ) ^ ((AdmissibleDatum.f 𝒟 : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
          rw [hfour, hLfactor]
    _ = 2 * NumberField.rootDiscr 𝒟.L := by rw [hrootL]

name: overlapLensIntegral_eq_formula
statement:
theorem overlapLensIntegral_eq_formula (R : ℝ) (hR : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ R) :
  overlapLensIntegral R =
    2 * R ^ 2 * Real.arccos (1 / (2 * R)) -
      ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * Real.sqrt (4 * R ^ 2 - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hR0 : 0 < R := by
    linarith
  have hscale0 :=
      intervalIntegral.mul_integral_comp_mul_right
        (f := fun x : ℝ => Real.sqrt (R ^ 2 - x ^ 2))
        (a := (1 : ℝ) / (2 * R)) (b := 1) (c := R)
  have hscale1 :
      ∫ x in ((1 : ℝ) / 2)..R, Real.sqrt (R ^ 2 - x ^ 2) =
        R * ∫ u in ((1 : ℝ) / (2 * R))..1, Real.sqrt (R ^ 2 - (u * R) ^ 2) := by
    simpa [hR0.ne', div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using hscale0.symm
  have hscale2 :
      ∫ x in ((1 : ℝ) / 2)..R, Real.sqrt (R ^ 2 - x ^ 2) =
        R ^ 2 * ∫ u in ((1 : ℝ) / (2 * R))..1, Real.sqrt (1 - u ^ 2) := by
    rw [hscale1]
    have hfun :
        (fun u : ℝ => Real.sqrt (R ^ 2 - (u * R) ^ 2)) =
          fun u : ℝ => R * Real.sqrt (1 - u ^ 2) := by
      funext u
      have hRnonneg : 0 ≤ R := le_of_lt hR0
      have hEq : R ^ 2 - (u * R) ^ 2 = R ^ 2 * (1 - u ^ 2) := by
        ring
      rw [hEq, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg R)]
      have : Real.sqrt (R ^ 2) = R := by
        simpa [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hRnonneg]
      rw [this]
    rw [hfun, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    ring
  set a : ℝ := (1 : ℝ) / (2 * R)
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => (u * Real.sqrt (1 - u ^ 2) + Real.arcsin u) / 2
  have ha_le_one : a ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [a]
    have h2R_pos : 0 < 2 * R := by positivity
    exact (div_le_iff₀ h2R_pos).2 (by nlinarith)
  have ha_pos : 0 < a := by
    dsimp [a]
    positivity
  have hF_cont : Continuous F := by
    unfold F
    continuity
  have hInt : ∫ u in a..1, Real.sqrt (1 - u ^ 2) = F 1 - F a := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDeriv_right_of_le ha_le_one
    · exact hF_cont.continuousOn
    · intro x hx
      have hx0 : 0 < x := lt_trans ha_pos hx.1
      have hne : 1 - x ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
        nlinarith [hx0, hx.2]
      have hsqrt_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 - x ^ 2) := by
        apply Real.sqrt_pos.2
        nlinarith [hx0, hx.2]
      have hsqrt_ne : Real.sqrt (1 - x ^ 2) ≠ 0 := hsqrt_pos.ne'
      have hinner : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => 1 - y ^ 2) (-(2 * x)) x := by
        convert ((hasDerivAt_const x (1 : ℝ)).sub ((hasDerivAt_id x).pow 2)) using 1 <;>
          simp [pow_two]
      have hsqrt :
          HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => Real.sqrt (1 - y ^ 2)) (-(2 * x) / (2 * Real.sqrt (1 - x ^ 2))) x := by
        exact hinner.sqrt hne
      have harcsin : HasDerivAt Real.arcsin (1 / Real.sqrt (1 - x ^ 2)) x := by
        apply Real.hasDerivAt_arcsin
        · linarith
        · exact ne_of_lt hx.2
      have hprod :
          HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y * Real.sqrt (1 - y ^ 2))
            (Real.sqrt (1 - x ^ 2) + x * (-(2 * x) / (2 * Real.sqrt (1 - x ^ 2)))) x := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id x).mul hsqrt
      have hsum :
          HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y * Real.sqrt (1 - y ^ 2) + Real.arcsin y)
            (Real.sqrt (1 - x ^ 2) + x * (-(2 * x) / (2 * Real.sqrt (1 - x ^ 2))) + 1 / Real.sqrt (1 - x ^ 2)) x := by
        simpa [add_assoc] using hprod.add harcsin
      have hhalf :
          HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (y * Real.sqrt (1 - y ^ 2) + Real.arcsin y) / 2)
            (((Real.sqrt (1 - x ^ 2) + x * (-(2 * x) / (2 * Real.sqrt (1 - x ^ 2))) + 1 / Real.sqrt (1 - x ^ 2))) / 2) x := by
        simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hsum.mul_const ((1 : ℝ) / 2)
      have hsqr : (Real.sqrt (1 - x ^ 2)) ^ 2 = 1 - x ^ 2 := by
        apply Real.sq_sqrt
        nlinarith [hx0, hx.2]
      convert hhalf.hasDerivWithinAt using 1
      field_simp [hsqrt_ne]
      nlinarith
    · exact (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (continuous_const.sub (continuous_id.pow 2))).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have hnonneg2 : 0 ≤ 4 * R ^ 2 - 1 := by
    nlinarith [hR]
  have hsqrt_term :
      R * Real.sqrt (1 - (1 / (2 * R)) ^ 2) = ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * Real.sqrt (4 * R ^ 2 - 1) := by
    have hEq : 1 - (1 / (2 * R)) ^ 2 = (4 * R ^ 2 - 1) / (4 * R ^ 2) := by
      field_simp [hR0.ne']
      ring
    rw [hEq, Real.sqrt_div hnonneg2]
    have hsqrt4 : Real.sqrt (4 * R ^ 2) = 2 * R := by
      have h2R_nonneg : 0 ≤ 2 * R := by positivity
      have : 4 * R ^ 2 = (2 * R) ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [this, Real.sqrt_sq h2R_nonneg]
    rw [hsqrt4]
    field_simp [hR0.ne']
  unfold overlapLensIntegral
  rw [hscale2, hInt]
  simp [F, a]
  rw [Real.arcsin_eq_pi_div_two_sub_arccos]
  ring_nf
  have hrew1 :
      R ^ 2 * R⁻¹ * Real.sqrt (1 + R⁻¹ ^ 2 * (-1 / 4)) = R * Real.sqrt (1 - (1 / (2 * R)) ^ 2) := by
    have hEq : 1 + R⁻¹ ^ 2 * (-1 / 4) = 1 - (1 / (2 * R)) ^ 2 := by
      field_simp [hR0.ne']
      ring
    rw [hEq]
    field_simp [hR0.ne']
  have hrew2 : Real.sqrt (-1 + R ^ 2 * 4) = Real.sqrt (4 * R ^ 2 - 1) := by
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hrew1, hrew2, hsqrt_term]
  ring

name: overlapArea_eq_volume_rotate
statement:
theorem overlapArea_eq_volume_rotate (R : ℝ) (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) :
  (MeasureTheory.volume
    (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R ∩ Metric.ball (-z) R)).toReal =
  (MeasureTheory.volume (overlapSymmetricLens R)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  let a : Circle := ⟨star z, by
    simpa [Submonoid.unitSphere] using hz⟩
  let e : ℂ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] ℂ := rotation a
  have hzmul : star z * z = (1 : ℂ) := by
    simpa [Complex.star_def, hz] using Complex.conj_mul' z
  have hzmul' : (starRingEnd ℂ) z * z = (1 : ℂ) := by
    simpa using hzmul
  have hpos : e (z / 2) = ((1 : ℂ) / 2) := by
    change (a : ℂ) * (z / 2) = ((1 : ℂ) / 2)
    dsimp [a]
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← mul_assoc, hzmul', one_mul, div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul]
  have hneg : e (-(z / 2)) = -((1 : ℂ) / 2) := by
    simpa using congrArg Neg.neg hpos
  have hmp : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving e := by
    simpa [e] using (LinearIsometryEquiv.measurePreserving e)
  have hnegHalf : -(z / 2) - z / 2 = -z := by
    ring
  have hpreRot :
      e ⁻¹' overlapSymmetricLens R = Metric.ball (-(z / 2)) R ∩ Metric.ball (z / 2) R := by
    rw [overlapSymmetricLens, ← hneg, ← hpos, Set.preimage_inter,
      Isometry.preimage_ball e.isometry (-(z / 2)) R,
      Isometry.preimage_ball e.isometry (z / 2) R]
  have hmeasLens : MeasurableSet (overlapSymmetricLens R) := by
    rw [overlapSymmetricLens]
    exact (Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet).inter Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet
  have hvol1 :
      MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R ∩ Metric.ball (-z) R) =
        MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball (z / 2) R ∩ Metric.ball (-(z / 2)) R) := by
    simpa [hnegHalf] using
      (MeasureTheory.measure_preimage_add (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure ℂ)
        (z / 2) (Metric.ball (z / 2) R ∩ Metric.ball (-(z / 2)) R))
  have hvol2 :
      MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball (z / 2) R ∩ Metric.ball (-(z / 2)) R) =
        MeasureTheory.volume (overlapSymmetricLens R) := by
    simpa [hpreRot, Set.inter_comm] using hmp.measure_preimage hmeasLens.nullMeasurableSet
  have hvol :
      MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R ∩ Metric.ball (-z) R) =
        MeasureTheory.volume (overlapSymmetricLens R) := by
    exact hvol1.trans hvol2
  simpa using congrArg ENNReal.toReal hvol

name: overlapSymmetricLensRight_volume
statement:
theorem overlapSymmetricLensRight_volume (R : ℝ) (hR : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ R) :
  (MeasureTheory.volume (overlapSymmetricLensRight R)).toReal =
    2 * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(R - (1 : ℝ) / 2),
      Real.sqrt (R ^ 2 - (x + (1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let b : ℝ := R - (1 : ℝ) / 2
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => -Real.sqrt (R ^ 2 - (x + (1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2)
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => Real.sqrt (R ^ 2 - (x + (1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2)
  let e : ℂ ≃ᵐ ℝ × ℝ := Complex.measurableEquivRealProd
  let s : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := e.symm ⁻¹' overlapSymmetricLensRight R
  have hR0 : 0 ≤ R := by linarith
  have hb0 : 0 ≤ b := by
    dsimp [b]
    linarith
  have hdist_left (x y : ℝ) :
      dist ({ re := x, im := y } : ℂ) (-((1 : ℂ) / 2)) < R ↔
        (x + (1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 < R ^ 2 := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    rw [← sq_lt_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hR0]
    have hnorm : ‖({ re := x, im := y } : ℂ) - -((1 : ℂ) / 2)‖ ^ 2 =
        (x + (1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 := by
      simpa [pow_two] using
        (RCLike.norm_sq_eq_def (z := ({ re := x, im := y } : ℂ) - -((1 : ℂ) / 2)))
    rw [hnorm]
  have hdist_right (x y : ℝ) :
      dist ({ re := x, im := y } : ℂ) (((1 : ℂ) / 2)) < R ↔
        (x - (1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 < R ^ 2 := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    rw [← sq_lt_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hR0]
    have hnorm : ‖({ re := x, im := y } : ℂ) - ((1 : ℂ) / 2)‖ ^ 2 =
        (x - (1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 := by
      simpa [pow_two] using
        (RCLike.norm_sq_eq_def (z := ({ re := x, im := y } : ℂ) - ((1 : ℂ) / 2)))
    rw [hnorm]
  have hauto (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x)
      (hleft : (x + (1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 < R ^ 2) :
      (x - (1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 < R ^ 2 := by
    have hcomp : (x - (1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ (x + (1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith
    nlinarith
  have hs : s = regionBetween f g (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) b) := by
    ext p
    constructor
    · intro hp
      rcases hp with ⟨hp, hx⟩
      rcases hp with ⟨hleft, hright⟩
      have hleft' := (hdist_left p.1 p.2).1 hleft
      have hxb : p.1 ≤ b := by
        dsimp [b]
        nlinarith [hleft', sq_nonneg p.2]
      have hy2 : p.2 ^ 2 < R ^ 2 - (p.1 + (1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [hleft']
      have hy := (Real.sq_lt).1 hy2
      exact ⟨⟨hx, hxb⟩, hy⟩
    · intro hp
      rcases hp with ⟨⟨hx, hxb⟩, hy⟩
      have hy2 : p.2 ^ 2 < R ^ 2 - (p.1 + (1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 := by
        exact (Real.sq_lt).2 hy
      have hleft' : (p.1 + (1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 < R ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith
      have hleft := (hdist_left p.1 p.2).2 hleft'
      have hright' := hauto p.1 p.2 hx hleft'
      have hright := (hdist_right p.1 p.2).2 hright'
      exact ⟨⟨hleft, hright⟩, hx⟩
  have hvol : MeasureTheory.volume s = MeasureTheory.volume (overlapSymmetricLensRight R) := by
    simpa [s, e] using
      (MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving.measure_preimage_equiv
        (MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving.symm Complex.measurableEquivRealProd
          Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod)
        (overlapSymmetricLensRight R))
  have hfcont : Continuous f := by
    dsimp [f]
    continuity
  have hgcont : Continuous g := by
    dsimp [g]
    continuity
  have hfint : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn f (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) b) :=
    hfcont.integrableOn_Ioc
  have hgint : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn g (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) b) :=
    hgcont.integrableOn_Ioc
  have hfg : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) b, f x ≤ g x := by
    intro x hx
    dsimp [f, g]
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (R ^ 2 - (x + (1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2)]
  have hregion : MeasureTheory.volume (regionBetween f g (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) b)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..b, Real.sqrt (R ^ 2 - (x + (1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2)) := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod]
    rw [volume_regionBetween_eq_integral hfint hgint measurableSet_Ioc hfg]
    congr 1
    calc
      ∫ x in Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) b, (g - f) x =
          ∫ x in Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) b, (2 * Real.sqrt (R ^ 2 - (x + (1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2)) := by
            apply MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae
            filter_upwards with x
            simp [f, g, two_mul]
      _ = ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..b, (2 * Real.sqrt (R ^ 2 - (x + (1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2)) := by
            symm
            exact intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hb0
      _ = 2 * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..b, Real.sqrt (R ^ 2 - (x + (1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2) := by
            rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  have hmain : MeasureTheory.volume (overlapSymmetricLensRight R) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..b, Real.sqrt (R ^ 2 - (x + (1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2)) := by
    calc
      MeasureTheory.volume (overlapSymmetricLensRight R) = MeasureTheory.volume s := by
        symm
        exact hvol
      _ = MeasureTheory.volume (regionBetween f g (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) b)) := by rw [hs]
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..b, Real.sqrt (R ^ 2 - (x + (1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2)) :=
        hregion
  have hint_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..b, Real.sqrt (R ^ 2 - (x + (1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hb0
    intro x hx
    exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hmain_real := congrArg ENNReal.toReal hmain
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by nlinarith [hint_nonneg])] at hmain_real
  simpa [b] using hmain_real

name: overlapSymmetricLens_midline_volume_zero
statement:
theorem overlapSymmetricLens_midline_volume_zero (R : ℝ) :
  MeasureTheory.volume (overlapSymmetricLens R ∩ {w : ℂ | w.re = 0}) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h_axis : MeasureTheory.volume ({w : ℂ | w.re = 0} : Set ℂ) = 0 := by
    let s : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ) := {p | p 0 = 0}
    have hs : MeasureTheory.volume s = 0 := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.volume_pi]
      simpa [s] using
        (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi_hyperplane
          (μ := fun _ : Fin 2 => (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ))
          (i := (0 : Fin 2)) (x := (0 : ℝ)))
    have hpre :
        Complex.measurableEquivPi ⁻¹' s = ({w : ℂ | w.re = 0} : Set ℂ) := by
      ext w
      simp [s, Complex.measurableEquivPi_apply]
    calc
      MeasureTheory.volume ({w : ℂ | w.re = 0} : Set ℂ)
          = MeasureTheory.volume (Complex.measurableEquivPi ⁻¹' s) := by rw [hpre.symm]
      _ = MeasureTheory.volume s := by
        simpa using
          (MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving.measure_preimage_equiv
            (hf := Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_pi) s)
      _ = 0 := hs
  refine MeasureTheory.measure_mono_null (s := overlapSymmetricLens R ∩ {w : ℂ | w.re = 0}) (t := {w : ℂ | w.re = 0}) ?_ h_axis
  intro w hw
  exact hw.2

name: overlapSymmetricLens_volume_eq_two_right
statement:
theorem overlapSymmetricLens_volume_eq_two_right (R : ℝ) :
  (MeasureTheory.volume (overlapSymmetricLens R)).toReal =
    2 * (MeasureTheory.volume (overlapSymmetricLensRight R)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L : Set ℂ := overlapSymmetricLens R
  let Lp : Set ℂ := overlapSymmetricLensRight R
  let Lm : Set ℂ := L ∩ {w : ℂ | w.re < 0}
  let L0 : Set ℂ := L ∩ {w : ℂ | w.re = 0}
  have hmeas_ball_left : MeasurableSet (Metric.ball (-((1 : ℂ) / 2)) R) :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet
  have hmeas_ball_right : MeasurableSet (Metric.ball (((1 : ℂ) / 2)) R) :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet
  have hmeasL : MeasurableSet L := by
    simpa [L, overlapSymmetricLens] using hmeas_ball_left.inter hmeas_ball_right
  have hmeas_pos : MeasurableSet {w : ℂ | 0 < w.re} := by
    simpa using measurableSet_lt measurable_const Complex.measurable_re
  have hmeas_neg : MeasurableSet {w : ℂ | w.re < 0} := by
    simpa using measurableSet_lt Complex.measurable_re measurable_const
  have hmeas_zero : MeasurableSet {w : ℂ | w.re = 0} := by
    simpa using
      (measurableSet_eq_fun
        (f := fun w : ℂ => w.re) (g := fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℝ))
        Complex.measurable_re measurable_const)
  have hmeasLp : MeasurableSet Lp := by
    simpa [Lp, overlapSymmetricLensRight] using hmeasL.inter hmeas_pos
  have hmeasLm : MeasurableSet Lm := by
    simpa [Lm] using hmeasL.inter hmeas_neg
  have hmeasL0 : MeasurableSet L0 := by
    simpa [L0] using hmeasL.inter hmeas_zero
  have hsplit : L = Lp ∪ (Lm ∪ L0) := by
    ext w
    constructor
    · intro hw
      rcases lt_trichotomy w.re 0 with hneg | hzero | hpos
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hw, hneg⟩)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨hw, hzero⟩)
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hw, hpos⟩
    · intro hw
      rcases hw with hw | hw
      · exact hw.1
      · rcases hw with hw | hw
        · exact hw.1
        · exact hw.1
  have hdisj_p_rest : Disjoint Lp (Lm ∪ L0) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro w hw1 hw2
    rcases hw2 with hw2 | hw2
    · have hpos : 0 < w.re := by
        simpa [Lp, overlapSymmetricLensRight] using hw1.2
      have hneg : w.re < 0 := by
        simpa [Lm] using hw2.2
      linarith
    · have hpos : 0 < w.re := by
        simpa [Lp, overlapSymmetricLensRight] using hw1.2
      have hzero : w.re = 0 := by
        simpa [L0] using hw2.2
      linarith
  have hdisj_m0 : Disjoint Lm L0 := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro w hw1 hw2
    have hneg : w.re < 0 := by
      simpa [Lm] using hw1.2
    have hzero : w.re = 0 := by
      simpa [L0] using hw2.2
    linarith
  have hneg_mem_L : ∀ w : ℂ, -w ∈ L ↔ w ∈ L := by
    intro w
    constructor <;> intro hw
    · have hw' : ‖-w + (1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ < R ∧ ‖-w + (-(1 / 2 : ℂ))‖ < R := by
        simpa [L, overlapSymmetricLens, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, sub_eq_add_neg] using hw
      have hEq1 : -w + (-(1 / 2 : ℂ)) = -(w + (1 / 2 : ℂ)) := by
        ring
      have hEq2 : -w + (1 / 2 : ℂ) = -(w + (-(1 / 2 : ℂ))) := by
        ring
      have htmp1 := hw'.2
      have htmp2 := hw'.1
      have h1 : ‖w + (1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ < R := by
        rwa [hEq1, norm_neg] at htmp1
      have h2 : ‖w + (-(1 / 2 : ℂ))‖ < R := by
        rwa [hEq2, norm_neg] at htmp2
      simpa [L, overlapSymmetricLens, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, sub_eq_add_neg] using And.intro h1 h2
    · have hw' : ‖w + (1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ < R ∧ ‖w + (-(1 / 2 : ℂ))‖ < R := by
        simpa [L, overlapSymmetricLens, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, sub_eq_add_neg] using hw
      have hEq1 : w + (-(1 / 2 : ℂ)) = -(-w + (1 / 2 : ℂ)) := by
        ring
      have hEq2 : w + (1 / 2 : ℂ) = -(-w + (-(1 / 2 : ℂ))) := by
        ring
      have htmp1 := hw'.2
      have htmp2 := hw'.1
      have h1 : ‖-w + (1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ < R := by
        rwa [hEq1, norm_neg] at htmp1
      have h2 : ‖-w + (-(1 / 2 : ℂ))‖ < R := by
        rwa [hEq2, norm_neg] at htmp2
      simpa [L, overlapSymmetricLens, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, sub_eq_add_neg] using And.intro h1 h2
  have hpreLm : (fun w : ℂ => -w) ⁻¹' Lm = Lp := by
    ext w
    constructor
    · intro hw
      have hwL : w ∈ L := (hneg_mem_L w).1 hw.1
      have hneg' : (-w).re < 0 := hw.2
      have hpos : 0 < w.re := by
        have : -w.re < 0 := by simpa [Complex.neg_re] using hneg'
        linarith
      exact ⟨hwL, hpos⟩
    · intro hw
      have hwL : -w ∈ L := (hneg_mem_L w).2 hw.1
      have hpos : 0 < w.re := hw.2
      have hneg' : (-w).re < 0 := by
        have : -w.re < 0 := by linarith
        simpa [Complex.neg_re] using this
      exact ⟨hwL, hneg'⟩
  have hneg_pres : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving (fun w : ℂ => -w) MeasureTheory.volume MeasureTheory.volume := by
    simpa using (LinearIsometryEquiv.neg ℝ : ℂ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] ℂ).measurePreserving
  have hvol_eq : MeasureTheory.volume Lp = MeasureTheory.volume Lm := by
    calc
      MeasureTheory.volume Lp = MeasureTheory.volume ((fun w : ℂ => -w) ⁻¹' Lm) := by
        rw [hpreLm]
      _ = MeasureTheory.volume Lm := by
        simpa using hneg_pres.measure_preimage hmeasLm.nullMeasurableSet
  have hzero_null : MeasureTheory.volume L0 = 0 := by
    simpa [L0, L] using overlapSymmetricLens_midline_volume_zero R
  have hvol_split : MeasureTheory.volume L = MeasureTheory.volume Lp + MeasureTheory.volume Lm := by
    calc
      MeasureTheory.volume L = MeasureTheory.volume (Lp ∪ (Lm ∪ L0)) := by rw [hsplit]
      _ = MeasureTheory.volume Lp + MeasureTheory.volume (Lm ∪ L0) := by
        rw [MeasureTheory.measure_union hdisj_p_rest (hmeasLm.union hmeasL0)]
      _ = MeasureTheory.volume Lp + (MeasureTheory.volume Lm + MeasureTheory.volume L0) := by
        rw [MeasureTheory.measure_union hdisj_m0 hmeasL0]
      _ = MeasureTheory.volume Lp + MeasureTheory.volume Lm := by rw [hzero_null, add_zero]
  have hsub_ball : Lp ⊆ Metric.ball (((1 : ℂ) / 2)) R := by
    intro w hw
    exact hw.1.2
  have hfinp : MeasureTheory.volume Lp ≠ ⊤ := by
    exact ne_of_lt <|
      lt_of_le_of_lt
        (MeasureTheory.measure_mono hsub_ball)
        (MeasureTheory.measure_ball_lt_top (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (x := ((1 : ℂ) / 2)) (r := R))
  change (MeasureTheory.volume L).toReal = 2 * (MeasureTheory.volume Lp).toReal
  calc
    (MeasureTheory.volume L).toReal = (MeasureTheory.volume Lp + MeasureTheory.volume Lm).toReal := by
      rw [hvol_split]
    _ = (MeasureTheory.volume Lp + MeasureTheory.volume Lp).toReal := by rw [hvol_eq]
    _ = (MeasureTheory.volume Lp).toReal + (MeasureTheory.volume Lp).toReal := by
      rw [ENNReal.toReal_add hfinp hfinp]
    _ = 2 * (MeasureTheory.volume Lp).toReal := by ring

name: overlapSymmetricLens_volume_ge_half
statement:
theorem overlapSymmetricLens_volume_ge_half (R : ℝ) (hR : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ R) :
  (MeasureTheory.volume (overlapSymmetricLens R)).toReal =
  overlapLensIntegral R
proof:
:= by
  rw [overlapSymmetricLens_volume_eq_two_right]
  rw [overlapSymmetricLensRight_volume R hR]
  unfold overlapLensIntegral
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => Real.sqrt (R ^ 2 - u ^ 2)
  have hshift :
      ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(R - (1 : ℝ) / 2), f (x + (1 : ℝ) / 2)
        = ∫ u in ((1 : ℝ) / 2)..R, f u := by
      simpa [f, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using
        (intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right (f := f) (a := (0 : ℝ))
          (b := R - (1 : ℝ) / 2) ((1 : ℝ) / 2))
  rw [hshift]
  ring

name: overlapSymmetricLens_volume_lt_half
statement:
theorem overlapSymmetricLens_volume_lt_half (R : ℝ) (hR : R < (1 : ℝ) / 2) :
  (MeasureTheory.volume (overlapSymmetricLens R)).toReal = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h_empty : overlapSymmetricLens R = ∅ := by
    ext z
    simp only [overlapSymmetricLens, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, Metric.mem_ball]
    constructor
    · intro hz
      rcases hz with ⟨hz1, hz2⟩
      have htri : dist (-((1 : ℂ) / 2)) (((1 : ℂ) / 2)) ≤
          dist (-((1 : ℂ) / 2)) z + dist z (((1 : ℂ) / 2)) := by
        simpa using dist_triangle (-((1 : ℂ) / 2)) z (((1 : ℂ) / 2))
      have hlt : dist (-((1 : ℂ) / 2)) z + dist z (((1 : ℂ) / 2)) < R + R := by
        exact add_lt_add (by simpa [dist_comm] using hz1) hz2
      have hcenter : dist (-((1 : ℂ) / 2)) (((1 : ℂ) / 2)) < R + R := lt_of_le_of_lt htri hlt
      have hdist : dist (-((1 : ℂ) / 2)) (((1 : ℂ) / 2)) = 1 := by
        rw [dist_eq_norm]
        norm_num
      have hR' : R + R < 1 := by linarith
      linarith
    · intro hz
      cases hz
  rw [h_empty]
  simp

name: overlapArea_eq_volume
statement:
theorem overlapArea_eq_volume (R : ℝ) (z : ℂ) (_hz : ‖z‖ = 1) :
  (MeasureTheory.volume
    (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R ∩ Metric.ball (-z) R)).toReal =
  overlapArea R
proof:
:= by
  rw [overlapArea_eq_volume_rotate R z _hz]
  by_cases hR : R < (1 : ℝ) / 2
  · rw [overlapSymmetricLens_volume_lt_half R hR]
    unfold overlapArea
    rw [if_pos hR]
  · have hR' : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ R := not_lt.mp hR
    rw [overlapSymmetricLens_volume_ge_half R hR']
    rw [overlapLensIntegral_eq_formula R hR']
    unfold overlapArea
    rw [if_neg hR]

name: disc_eq_of_unramified
statement:
theorem disc_eq_of_unramified
    (F M : Type) [Field F] [Field M] [NumberField F] [NumberField M]
    [Algebra F M] [FiniteDimensional F M]
    (_h_finite : ∀ (𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 F)) (𝔓 : Ideal (𝓞 M)),
        𝔭.IsPrime → 𝔭 ≠ ⊥ →
        𝔓 ∈ 𝔭.primesOver (𝓞 M) →
        Ideal.ramificationIdx 𝔭 𝔓 = 1) :
    (NumberField.discr M).natAbs =
      (NumberField.discr F).natAbs ^ Module.finrank F M
proof:
:= by

  have h_main :=
    NumberField.natAbs_discr_eq_absNorm_differentIdeal_mul_natAbs_discr_pow
      F (𝓞 F) M (𝓞 M)

  have h_diff_top : differentIdeal (𝓞 F) (𝓞 M) = ⊤ := by
    by_contra h_ne_top

    obtain ⟨P, hPmax, hPle⟩ :=
      Ideal.exists_le_maximal (differentIdeal (𝓞 F) (𝓞 M)) h_ne_top
    have hPdvd : P ∣ differentIdeal (𝓞 F) (𝓞 M) := Ideal.dvd_iff_le.mpr hPle

    have hPprime : P.IsPrime := hPmax.isPrime
    have hPne_bot : P ≠ ⊥ :=
      Ring.ne_bot_of_isMaximal_of_not_isField hPmax (RingOfIntegers.not_isField M)

    have hUne_bot : P.under (𝓞 F) ≠ ⊥ := Ideal.under_ne_bot (𝓞 F) hPne_bot
    have hUprime : (P.under (𝓞 F)).IsPrime := Ideal.IsPrime.under (𝓞 F) P

    have hLies : P.LiesOver (P.under (𝓞 F)) := Ideal.over_under _

    have hPmem : P ∈ (P.under (𝓞 F)).primesOver (𝓞 M) := ⟨hPprime, hLies⟩

    have h_ram_one :
        Ideal.ramificationIdx (P.under (𝓞 F)) P = 1 :=
      _h_finite (P.under (𝓞 F)) P hUprime hUne_bot hPmem

    have h_unram : Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt (𝓞 F) P := by
      rw [Algebra.isUnramifiedAt_iff_of_isDedekindDomain (R := 𝓞 F) hPne_bot]
      exact h_ram_one

    have h_not_dvd : ¬ P ∣ differentIdeal (𝓞 F) (𝓞 M) := by
      rw [not_dvd_differentIdeal_iff]
      exact h_unram
    exact h_not_dvd hPdvd

  rw [h_diff_top, Ideal.absNorm_top, one_mul] at h_main
  exact h_main

name: IsEverywhereUnramified.discr_eq
statement:
theorem IsEverywhereUnramified.discr_eq
    {F M : Type} [Field F] [Field M] [NumberField F] [NumberField M]
    [Algebra F M] [FiniteDimensional F M] (h : IsEverywhereUnramified F M) :
    (NumberField.discr M).natAbs =
      (NumberField.discr F).natAbs ^ Module.finrank F M
proof:
:=
  disc_eq_of_unramified F M h.1

name: classNumber_le_idealsUpToNormCount_minkowskiAuxBound
statement:
theorem classNumber_le_idealsUpToNormCount_minkowskiAuxBound (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] :
    NumberField.classNumber K ≤ idealsUpToNormCount K (minkowskiAuxBound K)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI :
      Finite {I : ↥(nonZeroDivisors (Ideal (𝓞 K))) //
        Ideal.absNorm (I : Ideal (𝓞 K)) ≤ ⌈minkowskiAuxBound K⌉₊} :=
    (Ideal.finite_setOf_absNorm_le₀ (S := 𝓞 K) ⌈minkowskiAuxBound K⌉₊).to_subtype
  let g :
      {I : ↥(nonZeroDivisors (Ideal (𝓞 K))) //
        Ideal.absNorm (I : Ideal (𝓞 K)) ≤ minkowskiAuxBound K} →
      {I : ↥(nonZeroDivisors (Ideal (𝓞 K))) //
        Ideal.absNorm (I : Ideal (𝓞 K)) ≤ ⌈minkowskiAuxBound K⌉₊} :=
    fun I => ⟨I.1, by
      have h' : ((Ideal.absNorm (I.1 : Ideal (𝓞 K))) : ℝ) ≤ (⌈minkowskiAuxBound K⌉₊ : ℝ) := by
        exact le_trans I.2 (Nat.le_ceil _)
      exact_mod_cast h'⟩
  letI :
      Finite {I : ↥(nonZeroDivisors (Ideal (𝓞 K))) //
        Ideal.absNorm (I : Ideal (𝓞 K)) ≤ minkowskiAuxBound K} :=
    Finite.of_injective g (by
      intro I J h
      exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun x => x.1) h))
  let f :
      {I : ↥(nonZeroDivisors (Ideal (𝓞 K))) //
        Ideal.absNorm (I : Ideal (𝓞 K)) ≤ minkowskiAuxBound K} →
      ClassGroup (𝓞 K) := fun I => ClassGroup.mk0 I.1
  have hf : Function.Surjective f := by
    intro C
    rcases NumberField.exists_ideal_in_class_of_norm_le (K := K) C with ⟨I, hIC, hInorm⟩
    refine ⟨⟨I, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · simpa [minkowskiAuxBound] using hInorm
    · simpa [f] using hIC
  simpa [NumberField.classNumber, idealsUpToNormCount] using Nat.card_le_card_of_surjective f hf

name: idealsUpToNormCount_eq_floor
statement:
theorem idealsUpToNormCount_eq_floor (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    idealsUpToNormCount K x = idealsUpToNormCount K (⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold idealsUpToNormCount
  refine Nat.card_congr ?_
  refine Equiv.subtypeEquivRight ?_
  intro I
  constructor
  · intro hI
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.le_floor hI)
  · intro hI
    exact le_trans hI (Nat.floor_le hx)

name: idealsUpToNormCount_nat_eq_sum_normFibers
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h_zero : Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = 0} = 1 := by
    simpa [Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff]
  rw [← add_left_inj 1]
  calc
    idealsUpToNormCount K (n : ℝ) + 1
        = Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I ≤ n} := by
            simpa [idealsUpToNormCount] using
              (Ideal.card_norm_le_eq_card_norm_le_add_one (S := 𝓞 K) n).symm
    _ = Nat.card ↑((fun I : Ideal (𝓞 K) => Ideal.absNorm I) ⁻¹' (↑(Finset.Icc 0 n) : Set ℕ)) := by
            simp [Set.coe_eq_subtype, Finset.mem_Icc]
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = k} := by
            rw [Finset.card_preimage_eq_sum_card_image_eq
              (f := fun I : Ideal (𝓞 K) => Ideal.absNorm I)
              (s := Finset.Icc 0 n)
              (fun k _ => Ideal.finite_setOf_absNorm_eq (S := 𝓞 K) k)]
    _ = Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = 0} +
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 n, Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = k} := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_Ioc_add_eq_sum_Icc (a := 0) (b := n)
              (f := fun k => Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = k}) n.zero_le,
              Nat.add_comm]
    _ = 1 + ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 n, Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = k} := by
            rw [h_zero]
    _ = 1 + ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = k} := by
            rw [← Finset.Icc_succ_left_eq_Ioc (a := 0) (b := n)]
            simp
    _ = (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = k}) + 1 := by
            rw [Nat.add_comm]

name: idealsUpToNormCount_le_dedekindZetaTwoReal_mul_sq
statement:
theorem idealsUpToNormCount_le_dedekindZetaTwoReal_mul_sq (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    (idealsUpToNormCount K x : ℝ) ≤ dedekindZetaTwoReal K * x ^ (2 : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun n ↦ Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n}
  let N : ℕ := ⌊x⌋₊
  have hcount_sum :
      (idealsUpToNormCount K x : ℝ) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, a k := by
    rw [show idealsUpToNormCount K x = idealsUpToNormCount K (N : ℝ) by
      simpa [N] using idealsUpToNormCount_eq_floor K x hx]
    rw [idealsUpToNormCount_nat_eq_sum_normFibers]
    simp [a]
  have hBigO :
      (fun n ↦ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, a k) =O[Filter.atTop] fun n ↦ (n : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) := by
    apply Asymptotics.isBigO_atTop_natCast_rpow_of_tendsto_div_rpow
    refine ((NumberField.Ideal.tendsto_norm_le_div_atTop₀ K).comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop).congr
      (fun n ↦ ?_)
    change (idealsUpToNormCount K (n : ℝ) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) =
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, a k) / ((n : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ))
    rw [idealsUpToNormCount_nat_eq_sum_normFibers]
    simp [a, Real.rpow_natCast]
  have hL : LSeriesSummable (fun n ↦ a n) (((3 : ℝ) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    refine LSeriesSummable_of_sum_norm_bigO_and_nonneg hBigO (fun n ↦ ?_) ?_ ?_
    · exact Nat.cast_nonneg _
    · norm_num
    · norm_num
  have habs : LSeries.abscissaOfAbsConv (fun n ↦ (a n : ℂ)) ≤ (3 : ℝ) / 2 :=
    hL.abscissaOfAbsConv_le
  have hsumm : Summable (fun n : ℕ ↦ a n / (n : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)) := by
    have hsumm' : Summable (fun n : ℕ ↦ a n / (n : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℝ)) := by
      refine LSeries.summable_real_of_abscissaOfAbsConv_lt ?_
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt habs (by
        norm_num : (((3 : ℝ) / 2 : ℝ) : EReal) < ((2 : ℝ) : EReal))
    simpa [Real.rpow_natCast] using hsumm'
  let g : ℕ → ℝ := fun n ↦ a n / (n : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)
  have hg_nonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ g n := by
    intro n
    exact div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by positivity)
  have hsum_tsum :
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, g k ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, g n := by
    have htsum_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, g n := by
      exact tsum_nonneg hg_nonneg
    refine (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff htsum_nonneg).mp ?_
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun k hk ↦ hg_nonneg k)]
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg hg_nonneg (by simpa [g] using hsumm)]
    simpa using ENNReal.sum_le_tsum (s := Finset.Icc 1 N) (f := fun n ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (g n))
  have hterm :
      ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, a k ≤ x ^ (2 : ℕ) * g k := by
    intro k hk
    rcases Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk with ⟨hk1, hkN⟩
    have hkpos : 0 < (k : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hk1
    have hkx : (k : ℝ) ≤ x := by
      have hkN' : (k : ℝ) ≤ N := by
        exact_mod_cast hkN
      exact hkN'.trans (by simpa [N] using (Nat.floor_le hx))
    have hsq : (k : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ) ≤ x ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
      nlinarith
    have hratio : (1 : ℝ) ≤ x ^ (2 : ℕ) / (k : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
      have hk_sq_pos : 0 < (k : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
        positivity
      exact (le_div_iff₀ hk_sq_pos).2 (by simpa using hsq)
    calc
      a k = a k * 1 := by ring
      _ ≤ a k * (x ^ (2 : ℕ) / (k : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)) := by
        gcongr
      _ = x ^ (2 : ℕ) * g k := by
        simp [g]
        ring
  have hx2_nonneg : 0 ≤ x ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
    positivity
  calc
    (idealsUpToNormCount K x : ℝ) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, a k := hcount_sum
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, x ^ (2 : ℕ) * g k := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun k hk ↦ hterm k hk
    _ = x ^ (2 : ℕ) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, g k := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ x ^ (2 : ℕ) * ∑' n : ℕ, g n := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum_tsum hx2_nonneg
    _ = dedekindZetaTwoReal K * x ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
      rw [dedekindZetaTwoReal, mul_comm]

name: dedekindZetaTwoAF_summable
statement:
theorem dedekindZetaTwoAF_summable (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => dedekindZetaTwoAF K n)
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun n ↦ Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n}
  let c : ℝ :=
    (2 ^ nrRealPlaces K * (2 * Real.pi) ^ nrComplexPlaces K * NumberField.Units.regulator K *
        NumberField.classNumber K) /
      (NumberField.Units.torsionOrder K * Real.sqrt |NumberField.discr K|)
  have hlim₁ :
      Filter.Tendsto ((fun s : ℝ ↦ (idealsUpToNormCount K s : ℝ) / s) ∘ Nat.cast)
        Filter.atTop (nhds c) := by
    simpa [c, idealsUpToNormCount] using
      (NumberField.Ideal.tendsto_norm_le_div_atTop₀ K).comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hlim₁' :
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ (idealsUpToNormCount K (n : ℝ) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ))
        Filter.atTop (nhds c) := by
    simpa [Function.comp] using hlim₁
  have hEq :
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ (idealsUpToNormCount K (n : ℝ) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ)) =
        fun n : ℕ ↦ (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, a k) / (n : ℝ) := by
    funext n
    rw [idealsUpToNormCount_nat_eq_sum_normFibers]
    simp [a]
  have hlim₂ :
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, a k) / (n : ℝ))
        Filter.atTop (nhds c) := by
    rw [← hEq]
    exact hlim₁'
  have hBigO :
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, a k) =O[Filter.atTop] fun n ↦ (n : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) := by
    exact Asymptotics.isBigO_atTop_natCast_rpow_of_tendsto_div_rpow <| by
      simpa [Real.rpow_natCast] using hlim₂
  have hnonneg : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ a n := fun n ↦ Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hL : LSeriesSummable (fun n ↦ a n) ((((3 : ℝ) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    refine LSeriesSummable_of_sum_norm_bigO_and_nonneg hBigO hnonneg ?_ ?_
    · norm_num
    · norm_num
  have hsumm' : Summable (fun n : ℕ ↦ a n / (n : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℝ)) := by
    refine LSeries.summable_real_of_abscissaOfAbsConv_lt ?_
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hL.abscissaOfAbsConv_le (by norm_num)
  have hsumm : Summable (fun n : ℕ ↦ a n / (n : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)) := by
    simpa [Real.rpow_natCast] using hsumm'
  simpa [dedekindZetaTwoAF, a] using hsumm

name: ideal_normFiber_mul_equiv
statement:
theorem ideal_normFiber_mul_equiv (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] (m n : ℕ) (hcop : m.Coprime n) :
    Nonempty ({I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = m * n} ≃
      ({J : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm J = m} ×
        {L : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm L = n}))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hm0 : m = 0
  · have hn1 : n = 1 := by
      simpa [hm0] using hcop
    subst hm0
    subst hn1
    let F : {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = 0 * 1} →
        ({J : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm J = 0} × {L : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm L = 1}) :=
      fun I => ⟨⟨I.1, by simpa using I.2⟩, ⟨⊤, by simp⟩⟩
    let G : ({J : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm J = 0} × {L : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm L = 1}) →
        {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = 0 * 1} :=
      fun JL => ⟨JL.1.1, by simpa using JL.1.2⟩
    have hFG : Function.LeftInverse G F := by
      intro I
      apply Subtype.ext
      rfl
    have hGF : Function.RightInverse G F := by
      rintro ⟨J, L⟩
      apply Prod.ext
      · apply Subtype.ext
        rfl
      · apply Subtype.ext
        exact (Ideal.absNorm_eq_one_iff.mp L.2).symm
    exact ⟨⟨F, G, hFG, hGF⟩⟩
  · by_cases hn0 : n = 0
    · have hm1 : m = 1 := by
        simpa [hn0] using hcop
      subst hn0
      subst hm1
      let F : {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = 1 * 0} →
          ({J : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm J = 1} × {L : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm L = 0}) :=
        fun I => ⟨⟨⊤, by simp⟩, ⟨I.1, by simpa using I.2⟩⟩
      let G : ({J : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm J = 1} × {L : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm L = 0}) →
          {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = 1 * 0} :=
        fun JL => ⟨JL.2.1, by simpa using JL.2.2⟩
      have hFG : Function.LeftInverse G F := by
        intro I
        apply Subtype.ext
        rfl
      have hGF : Function.RightInverse G F := by
        rintro ⟨J, L⟩
        apply Prod.ext
        · apply Subtype.ext
          exact (Ideal.absNorm_eq_one_iff.mp J.2).symm
        · apply Subtype.ext
          rfl
      exact ⟨⟨F, G, hFG, hGF⟩⟩
    · have helper {A : Ideal (𝓞 K)} (hA0 : Ideal.absNorm A ≠ 0) {t u : ℕ}
          (ht : (t : 𝓞 K) ∈ A) (hcop_tu : t.Coprime u) : (Ideal.absNorm A).Coprime u := by
          have hAfinite : Finite ((𝓞 K) ⧸ A) := (Ideal.absNorm_ne_zero_iff A).mp hA0
          let _ : Fintype ((𝓞 K) ⧸ A) := Fintype.ofFinite ((𝓞 K) ⧸ A)
          refine Nat.coprime_of_dvd fun p hp hpA hpU => ?_
          obtain ⟨x, hxord⟩ := by
            let _ : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
            simpa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Ideal.absNorm_apply] using
              (exists_prime_addOrderOf_dvd_card' (G := (𝓞 K) ⧸ A) p hpA)
          rcases (Nat.Coprime.cast (R := 𝓞 K) hcop_tu) with ⟨a, b, hab⟩
          have ht0 : Ideal.Quotient.mk A (t : 𝓞 K) = 0 := Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr ht
          have hu_inv : Ideal.Quotient.mk A b * (u : (𝓞 K ⧸ A)) = 1 := by
            have hbez := congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk A) hab
            simpa [map_add, map_mul, ht0, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hbez
          have hu_zero : u • x = 0 := by
            rw [← addOrderOf_dvd_iff_nsmul_eq_zero, hxord]
            exact hpU
          have hx_zero : x = 0 := by
            have hux : (u : (𝓞 K ⧸ A)) * x = 0 := by
              simpa [nsmul_eq_mul] using hu_zero
            have h1 := congrArg (fun z => Ideal.Quotient.mk A b * z) hux
            have h2 : ((Ideal.Quotient.mk A b * (u : (𝓞 K ⧸ A))) * x) = 0 := by
              simpa [mul_assoc] using h1
            have h3 : (1 : (𝓞 K ⧸ A)) * x = 0 := by simpa [hu_inv] using h2
            simpa using h3
          have : p = 1 := by
            simpa [hx_zero] using hxord.symm
          exact hp.ne_one this
      let M : Ideal (𝓞 K) := Ideal.span ({(m : 𝓞 K)} : Set (𝓞 K))
      let N : Ideal (𝓞 K) := Ideal.span ({(n : 𝓞 K)} : Set (𝓞 K))
      have hMNcop : IsCoprime M N := by
        rw [Ideal.isCoprime_iff_exists]
        rcases (Nat.Coprime.cast (R := 𝓞 K) hcop) with ⟨a, b, hab⟩
        refine ⟨a * m, ?_, b * n, ?_, ?_⟩
        · exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span (by simp))
        · exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span (by simp))
        · simpa [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hab
      let F : {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = m * n} →
          ({J : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm J = m} ×
            {L : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm L = n}) := fun I => by
        let I0 : Ideal (𝓞 K) := I.1
        let J : Ideal (𝓞 K) := I0 ⊔ M
        let L : Ideal (𝓞 K) := I0 ⊔ N
        have hMNtop : M ⊔ N = ⊤ := hMNcop.sup_eq
        have hsup : J ⊔ L = ⊤ := by
          calc
            J ⊔ L = I0 ⊔ (M ⊔ N) := by
              simp [J, L, sup_assoc, sup_left_comm, sup_comm]
            _ = ⊤ := by simp [hMNtop]
        have hmnem : ((m * n : ℕ) : 𝓞 K) ∈ I0 := by
          have hmem : ↑(Ideal.absNorm I0) ∈ I0 := Ideal.absNorm_mem I0
          rw [I.2] at hmem
          simpa [Nat.cast_mul] using hmem
        have hmulle : M * N ≤ I0 := by
          rw [Ideal.span_singleton_mul_span_singleton]
          exact (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem I0).2 (by simpa [Nat.cast_mul] using hmnem)
        have hmul_le : J * L ≤ I0 := by
          change (I0 ⊔ M) * (I0 ⊔ N) ≤ I0
          rw [Ideal.mul_sup, Ideal.sup_mul, Ideal.sup_mul]
          refine sup_le ?_ ?_
          · refine sup_le ?_ ?_
            · exact Ideal.mul_le_left
            · exact Ideal.mul_le_left
          · refine sup_le ?_ ?_
            · exact Ideal.mul_le_right
            · exact hmulle
        have hIle : I0 ≤ J * L := by
          calc
            I0 = I0 * ⊤ := by rw [Ideal.mul_top]
            _ = I0 * (J ⊔ L) := by rw [hsup]
            _ = I0 * J ⊔ I0 * L := by rw [Ideal.mul_sup]
            _ ≤ J * L := by
              refine sup_le ?_ ?_
              · have h1 : I0 * J ≤ L * J := Ideal.mul_mono_left (K := J) (show I0 ≤ L by exact le_sup_left)
                simpa [Ideal.mul_comm] using h1
              · have h2 : I0 * L ≤ J * L := Ideal.mul_mono_left (K := L) (show I0 ≤ J by exact le_sup_left)
                simpa using h2
        have hmul : J * L = I0 := le_antisymm hmul_le hIle
        have hnorm_mul : Ideal.absNorm J * Ideal.absNorm L = m * n := by
          calc
            Ideal.absNorm J * Ideal.absNorm L = Ideal.absNorm (J * L) := by rw [map_mul]
            _ = m * n := by rw [hmul, I.2]
        have hJ0 : Ideal.absNorm J ≠ 0 := by
          intro h0
          rw [h0, zero_mul] at hnorm_mul
          exact (Nat.mul_ne_zero hm0 hn0) hnorm_mul.symm
        have hL0 : Ideal.absNorm L ≠ 0 := by
          intro h0
          rw [h0, mul_zero] at hnorm_mul
          exact (Nat.mul_ne_zero hm0 hn0) hnorm_mul.symm
        have hm_mem_J : (m : 𝓞 K) ∈ J := by
          exact (show M ≤ J from le_sup_right) (Ideal.subset_span (by simp))
        have hn_mem_L : (n : 𝓞 K) ∈ L := by
          exact (show N ≤ L from le_sup_right) (Ideal.subset_span (by simp))
        have hJcop : (Ideal.absNorm J).Coprime n := helper hJ0 hm_mem_J hcop
        have hLcop : (Ideal.absNorm L).Coprime m := helper hL0 hn_mem_L hcop.symm
        have hJdvdm : Ideal.absNorm J ∣ m := by
          apply hJcop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
          rw [← hnorm_mul]
          exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (dvd_refl _) _
        have hLdvdn : Ideal.absNorm L ∣ n := by
          apply hLcop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left
          rw [← hnorm_mul]
          exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (dvd_refl _) _
        have hJle : Ideal.absNorm J ≤ m := Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm0) hJdvdm
        have hLle : Ideal.absNorm L ≤ n := Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn0) hLdvdn
        have hJL : Ideal.absNorm J = m ∧ Ideal.absNorm L = n :=
          (mul_eq_mul_iff_eq_and_eq_of_pos' hJle hLle (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm0) (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hL0)).mp hnorm_mul
        exact ⟨⟨J, hJL.1⟩, ⟨L, hJL.2⟩⟩
      let G : ({J : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm J = m} × {L : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm L = n}) →
          {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = m * n} := fun JL => by
        exact ⟨JL.1.1 * JL.2.1, by rw [map_mul, JL.1.2, JL.2.2]⟩
      have hFG : Function.LeftInverse G F := by
        intro I
        let I0 : Ideal (𝓞 K) := I.1
        let J : Ideal (𝓞 K) := I0 ⊔ M
        let L : Ideal (𝓞 K) := I0 ⊔ N
        have hMNtop : M ⊔ N = ⊤ := hMNcop.sup_eq
        have hsup : J ⊔ L = ⊤ := by
          calc
            J ⊔ L = I0 ⊔ (M ⊔ N) := by
              simp [J, L, sup_assoc, sup_left_comm, sup_comm]
            _ = ⊤ := by simp [hMNtop]
        have hmnem : ((m * n : ℕ) : 𝓞 K) ∈ I0 := by
          have hmem : ↑(Ideal.absNorm I0) ∈ I0 := Ideal.absNorm_mem I0
          rw [I.2] at hmem
          simpa [Nat.cast_mul] using hmem
        have hmulle : M * N ≤ I0 := by
          rw [Ideal.span_singleton_mul_span_singleton]
          exact (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem I0).2 (by simpa [Nat.cast_mul] using hmnem)
        have hmul_le : J * L ≤ I0 := by
          change (I0 ⊔ M) * (I0 ⊔ N) ≤ I0
          rw [Ideal.mul_sup, Ideal.sup_mul, Ideal.sup_mul]
          refine sup_le ?_ ?_
          · refine sup_le ?_ ?_
            · exact Ideal.mul_le_left
            · exact Ideal.mul_le_left
          · refine sup_le ?_ ?_
            · exact Ideal.mul_le_right
            · exact hmulle
        have hIle : I0 ≤ J * L := by
          calc
            I0 = I0 * ⊤ := by rw [Ideal.mul_top]
            _ = I0 * (J ⊔ L) := by rw [hsup]
            _ = I0 * J ⊔ I0 * L := by rw [Ideal.mul_sup]
            _ ≤ J * L := by
              refine sup_le ?_ ?_
              · have h1 : I0 * J ≤ L * J := Ideal.mul_mono_left (K := J) (show I0 ≤ L by exact le_sup_left)
                simpa [Ideal.mul_comm] using h1
              · have h2 : I0 * L ≤ J * L := Ideal.mul_mono_left (K := L) (show I0 ≤ J by exact le_sup_left)
                simpa using h2
        have hmul : J * L = I0 := le_antisymm hmul_le hIle
        apply Subtype.ext
        simpa [F, G, I0, J, L]
      have hGF : Function.RightInverse G F := by
        intro JL
        rcases JL with ⟨⟨J0, hJ0n⟩, ⟨L0, hL0n⟩⟩
        have hm_mem_J0 : (m : 𝓞 K) ∈ J0 := by
          have hmem : ↑(Ideal.absNorm J0) ∈ J0 := Ideal.absNorm_mem J0
          rw [hJ0n] at hmem
          simpa using hmem
        have hn_mem_L0 : (n : 𝓞 K) ∈ L0 := by
          have hmem : ↑(Ideal.absNorm L0) ∈ L0 := Ideal.absNorm_mem L0
          rw [hL0n] at hmem
          simpa using hmem
        have hsupnorm : Ideal.absNorm (J0 ⊔ L0) = 1 := by
          have hdivm : Ideal.absNorm (J0 ⊔ L0) ∣ m := by
            simpa [hJ0n] using Ideal.absNorm_dvd_absNorm_of_le (show J0 ≤ J0 ⊔ L0 by exact le_sup_left)
          have hdivn : Ideal.absNorm (J0 ⊔ L0) ∣ n := by
            simpa [hL0n] using Ideal.absNorm_dvd_absNorm_of_le (show L0 ≤ J0 ⊔ L0 by exact le_sup_right)
          have hdiv1 : Ideal.absNorm (J0 ⊔ L0) ∣ 1 := by
            rw [← hcop.gcd_eq_one]
            exact Nat.dvd_gcd hdivm hdivn
          exact Nat.dvd_one.mp hdiv1
        have hJLcop : IsCoprime J0 L0 := Ideal.isCoprime_iff_sup_eq.mpr (Ideal.absNorm_eq_one_iff.mp hsupnorm)
        have hMleJ0 : M ≤ J0 := (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem J0).2 hm_mem_J0
        have hNleL0 : N ≤ L0 := (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem L0).2 hn_mem_L0
        have hLM0 : Ideal.absNorm (L0 ⊔ M) ≠ 0 := by
          intro h0
          have hdiv : Ideal.absNorm (L0 ⊔ M) ∣ n := by
            simpa [hL0n] using Ideal.absNorm_dvd_absNorm_of_le (show L0 ≤ L0 ⊔ M by exact le_sup_left)
          rw [h0] at hdiv
          exact hn0 (Nat.zero_dvd.mp hdiv)
        have hJN0 : Ideal.absNorm (J0 ⊔ N) ≠ 0 := by
          intro h0
          have hdiv : Ideal.absNorm (J0 ⊔ N) ∣ m := by
            simpa [hJ0n] using Ideal.absNorm_dvd_absNorm_of_le (show J0 ≤ J0 ⊔ N by exact le_sup_left)
          rw [h0] at hdiv
          exact hm0 (Nat.zero_dvd.mp hdiv)
        have hLMcop : (Ideal.absNorm (L0 ⊔ M)).Coprime n := by
          have hm_mem : (m : 𝓞 K) ∈ L0 ⊔ M := (show M ≤ L0 ⊔ M from le_sup_right) (Ideal.subset_span (by simp))
          exact helper hLM0 hm_mem hcop
        have hJNcop : (Ideal.absNorm (J0 ⊔ N)).Coprime m := by
          have hn_mem : (n : 𝓞 K) ∈ J0 ⊔ N := (show N ≤ J0 ⊔ N from le_sup_right) (Ideal.subset_span (by simp))
          exact helper hJN0 hn_mem hcop.symm
        have hLMtop : L0 ⊔ M = ⊤ := by
          have hdiv : Ideal.absNorm (L0 ⊔ M) ∣ n := by
            simpa [hL0n] using Ideal.absNorm_dvd_absNorm_of_le (show L0 ≤ L0 ⊔ M by exact le_sup_left)
          have hdiv1 : Ideal.absNorm (L0 ⊔ M) ∣ 1 := by
            rw [← hLMcop.gcd_eq_one]
            exact Nat.dvd_gcd dvd_rfl hdiv
          exact Ideal.absNorm_eq_one_iff.mp (Nat.dvd_one.mp hdiv1)
        have hJNtop : J0 ⊔ N = ⊤ := by
          have hdiv : Ideal.absNorm (J0 ⊔ N) ∣ m := by
            simpa [hJ0n] using Ideal.absNorm_dvd_absNorm_of_le (show J0 ≤ J0 ⊔ N by exact le_sup_left)
          have hdiv1 : Ideal.absNorm (J0 ⊔ N) ∣ 1 := by
            rw [← hJNcop.gcd_eq_one]
            exact Nat.dvd_gcd dvd_rfl hdiv
          exact Ideal.absNorm_eq_one_iff.mp (Nat.dvd_one.mp hdiv1)
        have hJM : (J0 * L0) ⊔ M = J0 := by
          calc
            (J0 * L0) ⊔ M = M ⊔ J0 * L0 := by rw [sup_comm]
            _ = M ⊔ J0 := by
              simpa [Ideal.mul_comm] using (Ideal.sup_mul_eq_of_coprime_right (I := M) (J := J0) (K := L0) (by simpa [sup_comm] using hLMtop))
            _ = J0 := sup_eq_right.mpr hMleJ0
        have hLN : (J0 * L0) ⊔ N = L0 := by
          calc
            (J0 * L0) ⊔ N = N ⊔ J0 * L0 := by rw [sup_comm]
            _ = N ⊔ L0 := by
              simpa [Ideal.mul_comm] using (Ideal.sup_mul_eq_of_coprime_left (I := N) (J := J0) (K := L0) (by simpa [sup_comm] using hJNtop))
            _ = L0 := sup_eq_right.mpr hNleL0
        apply Prod.ext
        · apply Subtype.ext
          simpa [F, G, M, N] using hJM
        · apply Subtype.ext
          simpa [F, G, M, N] using hLN
      exact ⟨⟨F, G, hFG, hGF⟩⟩

name: dedekindZetaTwoAF_isMultiplicative
statement:
theorem dedekindZetaTwoAF_isMultiplicative (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] :
    (dedekindZetaTwoAF K).IsMultiplicative
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ArithmeticFunction.IsMultiplicative.iff_ne_zero.2 ?_
  constructor
  · simp [dedekindZetaTwoAF, Ideal.absNorm_eq_one_iff]
  · intro m n hm hn hcop
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := ideal_normFiber_mul_equiv K m n hcop
    have hcard := Nat.card_congr e
    rw [Nat.card_prod] at hcard
    dsimp [dedekindZetaTwoAF]
    rw [hcard, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_mul]
    have hpow : ((m : ℝ) * (n : ℝ)) ^ (2 : ℕ) = (m : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
      simpa using (mul_pow (m : ℝ) (n : ℝ) (2 : ℕ))
    rw [hpow]
    have hmR : (m : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by
      exact pow_ne_zero 2 (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hm)
    have hnR : (n : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by
      exact pow_ne_zero 2 (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn)
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv]
    field_simp [hmR, hnR]

name: normalizedFactor_mem_primesOverFinset_of_absNorm_eq_primePow
statement:
theorem normalizedFactor_mem_primesOverFinset_of_absNorm_eq_primePow (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    {I P : Ideal (𝓞 K)} {e : ℕ}
    (hI : Ideal.absNorm I = p ^ e) (hP : P ∈ normalizedFactors I) :
    P ∈ primesOverFinset (Ideal.span ({(p : ℤ)} : Set ℤ)) (𝓞 K)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let pp : Ideal ℤ := Ideal.span ({(p : ℤ)} : Set ℤ)
  have hIabs0 : Ideal.absNorm I ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hI]
    exact pow_ne_zero _ hp.ne_zero
  have hI0 : I ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hbot
    apply hIabs0
    simpa [hbot] using (Ideal.absNorm_bot : Ideal.absNorm (⊥ : Ideal (𝓞 K)) = 0)
  rcases (Ideal.mem_normalizedFactors_iff hI0).1 hP with ⟨hPprime, hIP⟩
  have hP0 : P ≠ (0 : Ideal (𝓞 K)) := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.ne_zero_of_mem_normalizedFactors hP
  let q : ℕ := Ideal.absNorm (Ideal.under ℤ P)
  have hqprime : q.Prime := by
    letI : P.IsPrime := hPprime
    letI : NeZero P := ⟨hP0⟩
    dsimp [q]
    simpa using Nat.absNorm_under_prime P
  have hqdvdIunder : q ∣ Ideal.absNorm (Ideal.under ℤ I) := by
    dsimp [q]
    exact Ideal.absNorm_dvd_absNorm_of_le (Ideal.comap_mono hIP)
  have hIunderdvd : Ideal.absNorm (Ideal.under ℤ I) ∣ Ideal.absNorm I :=
    Int.absNorm_under_dvd_absNorm I
  have hqdpowe : q ∣ p ^ e := by
    have hqdnormI : q ∣ Ideal.absNorm I := dvd_trans hqdvdIunder hIunderdvd
    simpa [hI] using hqdnormI
  have hqp : q = p := Nat.prime_eq_prime_of_dvd_pow hqprime hp hqdpowe
  have hL : P.LiesOver pp := by
    letI : P.LiesOver (Ideal.span ({(q : ℤ)} : Set ℤ)) := by
      simpa [q] using (Int.liesOver_span_absNorm (I := P))
    have hUnder : Ideal.span ({(q : ℤ)} : Set ℤ) = Ideal.under ℤ P :=
      Ideal.over_def (A := ℤ) (P := P) (p := Ideal.span ({(q : ℤ)} : Set ℤ))
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    simpa [pp, hqp] using hUnder
  have hpp_ne_bot : pp ≠ ⊥ := by
    dsimp [pp]
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]
    exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  haveI : pp.IsMaximal := by
    simpa [pp] using (Int.ideal_span_isMaximal_of_prime p)
  rw [mem_primesOverFinset_iff (B := 𝓞 K) hpp_ne_bot]
  change P.IsPrime ∧ P.LiesOver pp
  exact ⟨hPprime, hL⟩

name: summable_pi_inverse_square_prime
statement:
theorem summable_pi_inverse_square_prime {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    Summable (fun ν : (s → ℕ) => (∏ i, ((((p : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)) ^ ν i)))⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let a : ℝ := ((p : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ))⁻¹
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by
    dsimp [a]
    positivity
  have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) < p := by
    exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt
  have hpow : 1 < (p : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
    nlinarith
  have ha1 : a < 1 := by
    dsimp [a]
    simpa using (inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ hpow)
  let f : (s → ℕ) → ℝ := fun ν => ∏ i, a ^ ν i
  have hf_eq : (fun ν : (s → ℕ) => (∏ i, ((((p : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)) ^ ν i)))⁻¹) = f := by
    funext ν
    simp [f, a, inv_pow]
  rw [hf_eq]
  have hf_nonneg : ∀ ν : s → ℕ, 0 ≤ f ν := by
    intro ν
    exact Finset.prod_nonneg fun i hi => pow_nonneg ha0 _
  refine summable_of_sum_le (c := ∏ i : s, (1 - a)⁻¹) hf_nonneg ?_
  intro u
  let t : s → Finset ℕ := fun i => u.image fun ν : s → ℕ => ν i
  have hsubset : u ⊆ Fintype.piFinset t := by
    intro ν hν
    rw [Fintype.mem_piFinset]
    intro i
    exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem (fun ν : s → ℕ => ν i) hν
  have hsum_le : ∀ i : s, ∑ k ∈ t i, a ^ k ≤ (1 - a)⁻¹ := by
    intro i
    exact sum_le_hasSum (t i) (fun k hk => pow_nonneg ha0 k) (hasSum_geometric_of_lt_one ha0 ha1)
  calc
    ∑ ν ∈ u, f ν ≤ ∑ ν ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, f ν := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset (fun ν hν1 hν2 => hf_nonneg ν)
    _ = ∏ i, ∑ k ∈ t i, a ^ k := by
      simp [f]
      symm
      exact Finset.prod_univ_sum t (fun i k => a ^ k)
    _ ≤ ∏ i : s, (1 - a)⁻¹ := by
      refine Finset.prod_le_prod ?_ ?_
      · intro i hi
        exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun k hk => pow_nonneg ha0 _
      · intro i hi
        exact hsum_le i

name: sigma_weight_summable_le_tuple
statement:
theorem sigma_weight_summable_le_tuple (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    let pp : Ideal ℤ
proof:
:= Ideal.span ({(p : ℤ)} : Set ℤ)
    let β : ℕ → Type := fun e => { I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = p ^ e }
    let s : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K)) := primesOverFinset pp (𝓞 K)
    Summable (fun x : Sigma β => 1 / ((Ideal.absNorm x.2.1 : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ))) ∧
      ∑' x : Sigma β, 1 / ((Ideal.absNorm x.2.1 : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)) ≤
        ∑' ν : (s → ℕ), (∏ P, ((((p : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)) ^ ν P)))⁻¹ := by
  classical
  dsimp
  let pp : Ideal ℤ := Ideal.span ({(p : ℤ)} : Set ℤ)
  let β : ℕ → Type := fun e => { I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = p ^ e }
  let s : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K)) := primesOverFinset pp (𝓞 K)
  let weight : Sigma β → ℝ := fun x => 1 / ((Ideal.absNorm x.2.1 : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ))
  let g : (s → ℕ) → ℝ := fun ν => (∏ P, ((((p : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)) ^ ν P)))⁻¹
  let encode : Sigma β → (s → ℕ) := fun x P => Multiset.count P.1 (normalizedFactors x.2.1)
  have hsigma_of_ideal_eq : ∀ {x y : Sigma β}, x.2.1 = y.2.1 → x = y := by
    intro x y hI
    refine Sigma.subtype_ext ?_ ?_
    · exact (Nat.pow_right_injective hp.two_le) (by simpa [x.2.2, y.2.2] using congrArg Ideal.absNorm hI)
    · exact hI
  have hweight_nonneg : ∀ x : Sigma β, 0 ≤ weight x := by
    intro x
    positivity
  have hg_nonneg : ∀ ν : (s → ℕ), 0 ≤ g ν := by
    intro ν
    positivity
  have hg : Summable g := by
    simpa [g] using summable_pi_inverse_square_prime s p hp
  have hencode_support : ∀ (x : Sigma β) {P : Ideal (𝓞 K)}, P ∈ normalizedFactors x.2.1 → P ∈ s := by
    intro x P hP
    exact normalizedFactor_mem_primesOverFinset_of_absNorm_eq_primePow K p hp x.2.2 hP
  have hnot_bot : ∀ x : Sigma β, x.2.1 ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro x
    have hpos : 0 < Ideal.absNorm x.2.1 := by simpa [x.2.2] using pow_pos hp.pos x.1
    intro hxbot
    simpa [hxbot] using hpos.ne'
  have hpp0 : pp ≠ ⊥ := by
    refine mt (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.mp) ?_
    exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  letI : pp.IsMaximal := by
    simpa [pp] using (Int.ideal_span_isMaximal_of_prime p)
  have hnorm_ge_p : ∀ {P : Ideal (𝓞 K)}, P ∈ s → (p : ℝ) ≤ Ideal.absNorm P := by
    intro P hP
    have hP' : P ∈ Ideal.primesOver pp (𝓞 K) := (mem_primesOverFinset_iff (p := pp) (hpb := hpp0) (B := 𝓞 K)).1 hP
    let Q : Ideal.primesOver pp (𝓞 K) := ⟨P, hP'⟩
    letI : P.LiesOver pp := Q.2.2
    have hpow : Ideal.absNorm P = p ^ (pp.inertiaDeg P) := Ideal.absNorm_eq_pow_inertiaDeg' (P := P) hp
    have hpos : 0 < pp.inertiaDeg P := Ideal.inertiaDeg_pos (p := pp) (P := P)
    have hone : 1 ≤ pp.inertiaDeg P := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hpos
    have hge_nat : p ≤ Ideal.absNorm P := by
      rw [hpow]
      simpa [pow_one] using (pow_le_pow_right' hp.one_lt.le hone)
    exact_mod_cast hge_nat
  have hencode_inj : Function.Injective encode := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply hsigma_of_ideal_eq
    have hnf : normalizedFactors x.2.1 = normalizedFactors y.2.1 := by
      apply (Multiset.ext).2
      intro P
      by_cases hP : P ∈ s
      · have := congrArg (fun ν => ν ⟨P, hP⟩) hxy
        simpa [encode] using this
      · have hx0 : Multiset.count P (normalizedFactors x.2.1) = 0 := by
          apply Multiset.count_eq_zero_of_notMem
          intro hxP
          exact hP (hencode_support x hxP)
        have hy0 : Multiset.count P (normalizedFactors y.2.1) = 0 := by
          apply Multiset.count_eq_zero_of_notMem
          intro hyP
          exact hP (hencode_support y hyP)
        rw [hx0, hy0]
    calc
      x.2.1 = (normalizedFactors x.2.1).prod := (prod_normalizedFactors_eq_self (hnot_bot x)).symm
      _ = (normalizedFactors y.2.1).prod := by simpa [hnf]
      _ = y.2.1 := prod_normalizedFactors_eq_self (hnot_bot y)
  have hcomp : Summable (g ∘ encode) := by
    exact hg.comp_injective hencode_inj
  have hpoint : ∀ x : Sigma β, weight x ≤ g (encode x) := by
    intro x
    let m : Multiset (Ideal (𝓞 K)) := normalizedFactors x.2.1
    have hs : m.toFinset ⊆ s := by
      intro P hP
      exact hencode_support x (by simpa [m] using hP)
    have hnorm_prod : (Ideal.absNorm x.2.1 : ℝ) = ∏ P ∈ s, (Ideal.absNorm P : ℝ) ^ m.count P := by
      calc
        (Ideal.absNorm x.2.1 : ℝ) = (Ideal.absNorm m.prod : ℝ) := by
          simpa [m] using congrArg (fun I : Ideal (𝓞 K) => (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ)) ((prod_normalizedFactors_eq_self (hnot_bot x)).symm)
        _ = ∏ P ∈ s, (Ideal.absNorm P : ℝ) ^ m.count P := by
          rw [show m.prod = ∏ P ∈ s, P ^ m.count P by exact Finset.prod_multiset_count_of_subset m s hs]
          simp
    have hprod_le : ∏ P ∈ s, (p : ℝ) ^ m.count P ≤ (Ideal.absNorm x.2.1 : ℝ) := by
      rw [hnorm_prod]
      refine Finset.prod_le_prod ?_ ?_
      · intro P hP
        positivity
      · intro P hP
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (hnorm_ge_p hP) _
    have h1 :
        ∏ P : s, (((p : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)) ^ encode x P) = ∏ P ∈ s.attach, (((p : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)) ^ m.count P.1) := by
      simpa [encode, m] using (Finset.prod_coe_sort_eq_attach (s := s)
        (f := fun P : s => (((p : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)) ^ encode x P)))
    have hmid :
        ∏ P ∈ s.attach, (((p : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)) ^ m.count P.1) = ∏ P ∈ s.attach, (((p : ℝ) ^ m.count P.1) ^ (2 : ℕ)) := by
      refine Finset.prod_congr rfl ?_
      intro P hP
      rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm]
    have h2 :
        (∏ P ∈ s.attach, ((p : ℝ) ^ m.count P.1)) ^ (2 : ℕ) = (∏ P ∈ s, (p : ℝ) ^ m.count P) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
      have hattach : ∏ P ∈ s.attach, ((p : ℝ) ^ m.count P.1) = ∏ P ∈ s, (p : ℝ) ^ m.count P := by
        simpa using (Finset.prod_attach (s := s) (f := fun P => ((p : ℝ) ^ m.count P)))
      exact congrArg (fun t : ℝ => t ^ (2 : ℕ)) hattach
    have hg_den : ∏ P : s, (((p : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)) ^ encode x P) = (∏ P ∈ s, (p : ℝ) ^ m.count P) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
      calc
        ∏ P : s, (((p : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)) ^ encode x P) = ∏ P ∈ s.attach, (((p : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)) ^ m.count P.1) := h1
        _ = ∏ P ∈ s.attach, (((p : ℝ) ^ m.count P.1) ^ (2 : ℕ)) := hmid
        _ = (∏ P ∈ s.attach, ((p : ℝ) ^ m.count P.1)) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
          simpa using (Finset.prod_pow s.attach (2 : ℕ) (fun P => (p : ℝ) ^ m.count P.1))
        _ = (∏ P ∈ s, (p : ℝ) ^ m.count P) ^ (2 : ℕ) := h2
    have hg_eq : g (encode x) = 1 / (∏ P ∈ s, (p : ℝ) ^ m.count P) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
      simpa [g, one_div] using congrArg Inv.inv hg_den
    have hsq : (∏ P ∈ s, (p : ℝ) ^ m.count P) ^ (2 : ℕ) ≤ ((Ideal.absNorm x.2.1 : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)) := by
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hprod_le _
    have hprod_pos : 0 < ∏ P ∈ s, (p : ℝ) ^ m.count P := by
      refine Finset.prod_pos ?_
      intro P hP
      exact pow_pos (by exact_mod_cast hp.pos) _
    have hpos : 0 < (∏ P ∈ s, (p : ℝ) ^ m.count P) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
      exact pow_pos hprod_pos _
    calc
      weight x = 1 / ((Ideal.absNorm x.2.1 : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)) := by rfl
      _ ≤ 1 / (∏ P ∈ s, (p : ℝ) ^ m.count P) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
        exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hpos hsq
      _ = g (encode x) := by rw [hg_eq]
  have hweight : Summable weight := by
    exact Summable.of_nonneg_of_le hweight_nonneg hpoint hcomp
  have htsum_le_comp : ∑' x : Sigma β, weight x ≤ ∑' x : Sigma β, g (encode x) := by
    refine Real.tsum_le_of_sum_le hweight_nonneg ?_
    intro u
    refine le_trans (show ∑ x ∈ u, weight x ≤ ∑ x ∈ u, g (encode x) by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x hx => hpoint x)) ?_
    exact hcomp.sum_le_tsum u (by
      intro x hx
      exact hg_nonneg _)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [weight] using hweight
  · exact le_trans htsum_le_comp (by
      simpa [Function.comp, g] using (tsum_comp_le_tsum_of_inj hg hg_nonneg hencode_inj))

name: tsum_pi_inverse_square_prime_le
statement:
theorem tsum_pi_inverse_square_prime_le {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (n : ℕ) (hcard : s.card ≤ n) :
    ∑' ν : (s → ℕ), (∏ i, ((((p : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)) ^ ν i)))⁻¹ ≤
      ((1 - (p : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)))⁻¹) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let a : ℝ := ((p : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ))⁻¹
  let B : ℝ := (1 - (p : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)))⁻¹
  have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) < p := by
    exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt
  have ha_nonneg : 0 ≤ a := by
    dsimp [a]
    positivity
  have hp_sq_gt_one : (1 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
    nlinarith [hp1]
  have ha_lt_one : a < 1 := by
    dsimp [a]
    simpa using (inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ hp_sq_gt_one)
  have hB_eq : (1 - a)⁻¹ = B := by
    dsimp [B, a]
    simp [Real.rpow_natCast]
    rfl
  have hgeom : ∑' k : ℕ, a ^ k = B := by
    exact (tsum_geometric_of_lt_one ha_nonneg ha_lt_one).trans hB_eq
  have hB_ge_one : 1 ≤ B := by
    rw [← hB_eq, one_le_inv_iff₀]
    constructor
    · exact sub_pos.mpr ha_lt_one
    · linarith
  have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ fun ν : s → ℕ => (∏ i, ((((p : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)) ^ ν i)))⁻¹ := by
    intro ν
    positivity
  have hscard :
      ∑' ν : s → ℕ, (∏ i, ((((p : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)) ^ ν i)))⁻¹ ≤ B ^ s.card := by
    refine Real.tsum_le_of_sum_le h_nonneg ?_
    intro u
    let t : s → Finset ℕ := fun i => u.image fun ν : s → ℕ => ν i
    have hu : u ⊆ Fintype.piFinset t := by
      intro ν hν
      rw [Fintype.mem_piFinset]
      intro i
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨ν, hν, rfl⟩
    calc
      ∑ ν ∈ u, (∏ i, ((((p : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)) ^ ν i)))⁻¹
          = ∑ ν ∈ u, ∏ i, a ^ ν i := by
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
              intro ν hν
              simp [a, inv_pow]
      _ ≤ ∑ ν ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, ∏ i, a ^ ν i := by
            exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hu (by
              intro ν hν hnu
              positivity)
      _ = ∏ i, ∑ k ∈ t i, a ^ k := by
            symm
            exact Finset.prod_univ_sum t (fun i k => a ^ k)
      _ ≤ ∏ i : s, B := by
            simpa using Finset.prod_le_prod
              (s := Finset.univ)
              (f := fun i : s => ∑ k ∈ t i, a ^ k)
              (g := fun _ : s => B)
              (fun i hi => Finset.sum_nonneg fun k hk => by positivity)
              (fun i hi => by
                exact (sum_le_hasSum (t i) (fun k hk => by positivity)
                  (hasSum_geometric_of_lt_one ha_nonneg ha_lt_one)).trans_eq hB_eq)
      _ = B ^ s.card := by
            simp [B]
  calc
    ∑' ν : s → ℕ, (∏ i, ((((p : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)) ^ ν i)))⁻¹ ≤ B ^ s.card := hscard
    _ ≤ B ^ n := pow_le_pow_right₀ hB_ge_one hcard
    _ = ((1 - (p : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)))⁻¹) ^ n := by rfl

name: dedekindZetaTwoAF_prime_localFactor_le
statement:
theorem dedekindZetaTwoAF_prime_localFactor_le (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    ∑' e : ℕ, dedekindZetaTwoAF K (p ^ e) ≤
      ((1 - (p : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)))⁻¹) ^ Module.finrank ℚ K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let pp : Ideal ℤ := Ideal.span ({(p : ℤ)} : Set ℤ)
  let β : ℕ → Type := fun e => { I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = p ^ e }
  let w : Sigma β → ℝ := fun x => 1 / ((Ideal.absNorm x.2.1 : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ))
  let s : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K)) := primesOverFinset pp (𝓞 K)
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  letI : pp.IsMaximal := by
    dsimp [pp]
    infer_instance
  have hpp0 : pp ≠ ⊥ := by
    dsimp [pp]
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]
    exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero
  have hfiber (e : ℕ) : HasSum (fun I : β e => w ⟨e, I⟩) (dedekindZetaTwoAF K (p ^ e)) := by
    classical
    letI : Fintype (β e) := (Ideal.finite_setOf_absNorm_eq (S := 𝓞 K) (p ^ e)).fintype
    have hsum : ∑ I : β e, w ⟨e, I⟩ = dedekindZetaTwoAF K (p ^ e) := by
      calc
        ∑ I : β e, w ⟨e, I⟩ = ∑ I : β e, 1 / (((p ^ e : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
          intro I hI
          dsimp [w, β]
          rw [I.2]
        _ = (Fintype.card (β e) : ℝ) * (1 / (((p ^ e : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ))) := by
          simp
        _ = dedekindZetaTwoAF K (p ^ e) := by
          dsimp [dedekindZetaTwoAF, β]
          rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
          simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
    simpa [hsum] using (hasSum_fintype (fun I : β e => w ⟨e, I⟩))
  rcases sigma_weight_summable_le_tuple K p hp with ⟨hw, hle⟩
  have htsum : ∑' e : ℕ, dedekindZetaTwoAF K (p ^ e) = ∑' x : Sigma β, w x := by
    exact (hw.hasSum.sigma hfiber).tsum_eq
  rw [htsum]
  refine le_trans hle ?_
  have hcard : s.card ≤ Module.finrank ℚ K := by
    simpa only [s] using
      (Ideal.card_primesOverFinset_le_finrank (S := 𝓞 K) (K := ℚ) (L := K) (p := pp) hpp0)
  exact tsum_pi_inverse_square_prime_le s p hp (Module.finrank ℚ K) hcard

name: prime_geometric_tprod_eq_pi_sq_div_six
statement: theorem prime_geometric_tprod_eq_pi_sq_div_six : ∏' p : Nat.Primes, (1 - (p : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)))⁻¹ = (Real.pi ^ (2 : ℕ)) / 6
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ →*₀ ℝ :=
    { toFun := fun n => 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)
      map_zero' := by simp
      map_one' := by simp
      map_mul' := by
        intro m n
        by_cases hm : m = 0
        · simp [hm]
        · by_cases hn : n = 0
          · simp [hn]
          · simp [hm, hn, Nat.cast_mul, mul_pow, one_div, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] }
  have hs : Summable (fun n : ℕ => f n) := by
    simpa [f] using hasSum_zeta_two.summable
  have hf_nonneg : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ f n := by
    intro n
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · simp [f, hn]
    · have : 0 ≤ 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by positivity
      simpa [f]
  have hf_summable : Summable fun n : ℕ => ‖f n‖ := by
    change Summable fun n : ℕ => |f n|
    simpa [abs_of_nonneg, hf_nonneg] using hs
  have hEuler : ∏' p : Nat.Primes, (1 - f p)⁻¹ = ∑' n : ℕ, f n :=
    EulerProduct.eulerProduct_completely_multiplicative_tprod (f := f) hf_summable
  have hzeta : ∑' n : ℕ, f n = (Real.pi ^ (2 : ℕ)) / 6 := by
    simpa [f] using hasSum_zeta_two.tsum_eq
  calc
    ∏' p : Nat.Primes, (1 - (p : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)))⁻¹
        = ∏' p : Nat.Primes, (1 - f p)⁻¹ := by
            refine tprod_congr ?_
            intro p
            have hp_eq : f p = (p : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)) := by
              change 1 / (p : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ) = (p : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ))
              rw [Real.rpow_neg]
              · simp [one_div]
              · positivity
            rw [hp_eq]
    _ = ∑' n : ℕ, f n := hEuler
    _ = (Real.pi ^ (2 : ℕ)) / 6 := hzeta

name: pi_sq_div_six_lt_two
statement: theorem pi_sq_div_six_lt_two : (Real.pi ^ (2 : ℕ)) / (6 : ℝ) < 2
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt3_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt 3 := by
    positivity
  have hpi_div_six_lt : Real.pi / 6 < 1 / Real.sqrt 3 := by
    have h1 : 0 < Real.pi / 6 := by
      nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
    have h2 : Real.pi / 6 < Real.pi / 2 := by
      nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
    simpa only [Real.tan_pi_div_six] using (Real.lt_tan h1 h2)
  have hmul : Real.pi * Real.sqrt 3 < 6 := by
    have htmp : (Real.pi / 6) * Real.sqrt 3 < 1 := by
      exact (lt_div_iff₀ hsqrt3_pos).mp hpi_div_six_lt
    nlinarith
  have hsq : (Real.pi * Real.sqrt 3) ^ (2 : ℕ) < (6 : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
    rw [sq_lt_sq]
    have hpos : 0 < Real.pi * Real.sqrt 3 := by
      positivity
    rw [abs_of_pos hpos, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 6)]
    exact hmul
  have hsq3 : (Real.sqrt 3) ^ (2 : ℕ) = (3 : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [pow_two] using (Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 by positivity))
  have hpi_sq_lt_twelve : Real.pi ^ (2 : ℕ) < 12 := by
    have h6sq : (6 : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ) = (36 : ℝ) := by
      norm_num
    rw [mul_pow, hsq3, h6sq] at hsq
    nlinarith
  nlinarith

name: dedekindZetaTwoReal_le_two_pow_finrank
statement:
theorem dedekindZetaTwoReal_le_two_pow_finrank (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] :
    dedekindZetaTwoReal K ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ Module.finrank ℚ K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let d := Module.finrank ℚ K
  let g : Nat.Primes → ℝ := fun p => (1 - (p : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)))⁻¹
  let loc : Nat.Primes → ℝ := fun p => ∑' e : ℕ, dedekindZetaTwoAF K (p ^ e)
  have hnonneg : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ dedekindZetaTwoAF K n := by
    intro n
    dsimp [dedekindZetaTwoAF, ArithmeticFunction.coe_mk]
    positivity
  have hsum_norm : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖dedekindZetaTwoAF K n‖) := by
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ ↦ norm_nonneg _) ?_ (dedekindZetaTwoAF_summable K)
    intro n
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hnonneg n)]
  have hAF_hasProd : HasProd loc (dedekindZetaTwoReal K) := by
    simpa [loc, dedekindZetaTwoReal] using
      (ArithmeticFunction.IsMultiplicative.eulerProduct_hasProd
        (dedekindZetaTwoAF_isMultiplicative K) hsum_norm)
  have hloc_nonneg : ∀ p : Nat.Primes, 0 ≤ loc p := by
    intro p
    dsimp [loc]
    exact tsum_nonneg (fun e => hnonneg (p ^ e))
  have hzeta_nonneg : 0 ≤ dedekindZetaTwoReal K := by
    unfold dedekindZetaTwoReal
    exact tsum_nonneg hnonneg
  have hInducing : Topology.IsInducing ((Complex.ofRealHom) : ℝ →* ℂ) := by
    simpa using Complex.isUniformEmbedding_ofReal.isUniformInducing.isInducing
  have hpoint (p : Nat.Primes) : ((g p : ℝ) : ℂ) = (1 - (p : ℂ) ^ (-(2 : ℂ)))⁻¹ := by
    have hp : 0 ≤ (p : ℝ) := by positivity
    simp [g, Real.rpow_neg hp, Complex.cpow_neg, Complex.cpow_natCast, Complex.ofReal_cpow hp,
      Complex.ofReal_inv, Complex.ofReal_sub]
    rfl
  have hbase_hasProd_complex :
      HasProd (fun p : Nat.Primes => ((g p : ℝ) : ℂ)) (((Real.pi ^ 2) / 6 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    have hs : 1 < ((2 : ℂ)).re := by norm_num
    rw [show (fun p : Nat.Primes => ((g p : ℝ) : ℂ)) = fun p : Nat.Primes => (1 - (p : ℂ) ^ (-(2 : ℂ)))⁻¹ from funext hpoint]
    simpa [riemannZeta_two] using (riemannZeta_eulerProduct_hasProd (s := (2 : ℂ)) hs)
  have hbase_hasProd : HasProd g (Real.pi ^ 2 / 6) := by
    exact (hInducing.hasProd_iff g (Real.pi ^ 2 / 6)).mp hbase_hasProd_complex
  have hpow_hasProd : ∀ n : ℕ, HasProd (fun p : Nat.Primes => g p ^ n) ((Real.pi ^ 2 / 6) ^ n) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        simpa using (hasProd_one : HasProd (fun _ : Nat.Primes => (1 : ℝ)) 1)
    | succ n ih =>
        have hmul :
            HasProd (fun p : Nat.Primes => (g p ^ n) * g p)
              (((Real.pi ^ 2 / 6) ^ n) * (Real.pi ^ 2 / 6)) :=
          ih.mul hbase_hasProd
        simpa [pow_succ] using hmul
  have h_one_le_g : ∀ p : Nat.Primes, 1 ≤ g p := by
    intro p
    have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) < p := by
      exact_mod_cast p.2.one_lt
    have hpow_lt : (p : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)) < 1 := by
      exact Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg hp1 (by norm_num)
    have hpow_nonneg : 0 ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)) := by
      positivity
    have hden_pos : 0 < 1 - (p : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)) := by
      linarith
    have hden_le : 1 - (p : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
      linarith
    exact (one_le_inv₀ hden_pos).2 hden_le
  have hgpow_nonneg : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ p : Nat.Primes, 0 ≤ g p ^ n := by
    intro n p
    exact pow_nonneg (le_trans zero_le_one (h_one_le_g p)) _
  have hbase_pow_nonneg : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ (Real.pi ^ 2 / 6) ^ n := by
    intro n
    positivity
  have hNNInducing : Topology.IsInducing (NNReal.toRealHom : NNReal →* ℝ) := by
    simpa [NNReal.coe_toRealHom] using NNReal.isEmbedding_coe.isInducing
  have hAF_hasProd_nn :
      HasProd (fun p : Nat.Primes => Real.toNNReal (loc p))
        (Real.toNNReal (dedekindZetaTwoReal K)) := by
    have hreal :
        HasProd (fun p : Nat.Primes => (NNReal.toRealHom (Real.toNNReal (loc p)) : ℝ))
          (NNReal.toRealHom (Real.toNNReal (dedekindZetaTwoReal K))) := by
      simpa [NNReal.coe_toRealHom, Real.coe_toNNReal, hloc_nonneg, hzeta_nonneg] using hAF_hasProd
    exact (hNNInducing.hasProd_iff (fun p : Nat.Primes => Real.toNNReal (loc p))
      (Real.toNNReal (dedekindZetaTwoReal K))).mp hreal
  have hpow_hasProd_d_nn :
      HasProd (fun p : Nat.Primes => Real.toNNReal (g p ^ d))
        (Real.toNNReal ((Real.pi ^ 2 / 6) ^ d)) := by
    have hreal :
        HasProd (fun p : Nat.Primes => (NNReal.toRealHom (Real.toNNReal (g p ^ d)) : ℝ))
          (NNReal.toRealHom (Real.toNNReal ((Real.pi ^ 2 / 6) ^ d))) := by
      simpa [NNReal.coe_toRealHom, Real.coe_toNNReal, hgpow_nonneg, hbase_pow_nonneg] using hpow_hasProd d
    exact (hNNInducing.hasProd_iff (fun p : Nat.Primes => Real.toNNReal (g p ^ d))
      (Real.toNNReal ((Real.pi ^ 2 / 6) ^ d))).mp hreal
  have hle_local_nn :
      ∏' p : Nat.Primes, Real.toNNReal (loc p) ≤
        ∏' p : Nat.Primes, Real.toNNReal (g p ^ d) := by
    exact Multipliable.tprod_le_tprod
      (fun p => Real.toNNReal_le_toNNReal (by
        simpa [loc, g, d] using dedekindZetaTwoAF_prime_localFactor_le K p p.2))
      hAF_hasProd_nn.multipliable
      hpow_hasProd_d_nn.multipliable
  have hloc_tprod_coe :
      ((∏' p : Nat.Primes, Real.toNNReal (loc p) : NNReal) : ℝ) =
        ∏' p : Nat.Primes, loc p := by
    calc
      ((∏' p : Nat.Primes, Real.toNNReal (loc p) : NNReal) : ℝ)
          = ∏' p : Nat.Primes, (((Real.toNNReal (loc p) : NNReal) : ℝ)) := by
              simpa [NNReal.coe_toRealHom] using
                ((hAF_hasProd_nn.multipliable).map_tprod NNReal.toRealHom NNReal.continuous_coe)
      _ = ∏' p : Nat.Primes, loc p := by
