            congr with p
            exact Real.coe_toNNReal (loc p) (hloc_nonneg p)
  have hgpow_tprod_coe :
      ((∏' p : Nat.Primes, Real.toNNReal (g p ^ d) : NNReal) : ℝ) =
        ∏' p : Nat.Primes, g p ^ d := by
    calc
      ((∏' p : Nat.Primes, Real.toNNReal (g p ^ d) : NNReal) : ℝ)
          = ∏' p : Nat.Primes, (((Real.toNNReal (g p ^ d) : NNReal) : ℝ)) := by
              simpa [NNReal.coe_toRealHom] using
                ((hpow_hasProd_d_nn.multipliable).map_tprod NNReal.toRealHom NNReal.continuous_coe)
      _ = ∏' p : Nat.Primes, g p ^ d := by
            congr with p
            exact Real.coe_toNNReal (g p ^ d) (hgpow_nonneg d p)
  have hle_local :
      ∏' p : Nat.Primes, loc p ≤ ∏' p : Nat.Primes, g p ^ d := by
    have hle_local_real :
        ((∏' p : Nat.Primes, Real.toNNReal (loc p) : NNReal) : ℝ) ≤
          ((∏' p : Nat.Primes, Real.toNNReal (g p ^ d) : NNReal) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hle_local_nn
    calc
      ∏' p : Nat.Primes, loc p = ((∏' p : Nat.Primes, Real.toNNReal (loc p) : NNReal) : ℝ) := by
        symm
        exact hloc_tprod_coe
      _ ≤ ((∏' p : Nat.Primes, Real.toNNReal (g p ^ d) : NNReal) : ℝ) := hle_local_real
      _ = ∏' p : Nat.Primes, g p ^ d := hgpow_tprod_coe
  calc
    dedekindZetaTwoReal K = ∏' p : Nat.Primes, loc p := hAF_hasProd.tprod_eq.symm
    _ ≤ ∏' p : Nat.Primes, g p ^ d := hle_local
    _ = (Real.pi ^ 2 / 6) ^ d := (hpow_hasProd d).tprod_eq
    _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ d := by
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) pi_sq_div_six_lt_two.le d

name: two_pow_mul_minkowskiAuxBound_sq_le_rootDiscr_pow_four
statement:
theorem two_pow_mul_minkowskiAuxBound_sq_le_rootDiscr_pow_four (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ Module.finrank ℚ K * (minkowskiAuxBound K) ^ (2 : ℕ) ≤
      max 2 (NumberField.rootDiscr K) ^ ((4 : ℝ) * Module.finrank ℚ K)
proof:
:= by
  set n : ℕ := Module.finrank ℚ K
  set D : ℝ := |(NumberField.discr K : ℝ)|
  have hn : 0 < n := by
    simpa [n] using (Module.finrank_pos (R := ℚ) (M := K))
  have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hn)
  have hD_nonneg : 0 ≤ D := by
    simp [D]
  have hrd_def : NumberField.rootDiscr K = D ^ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    rw [NumberField.rootDiscr_def]
    simp [D, n]
  have hrd_nonneg : 0 ≤ NumberField.rootDiscr K := by
    rw [hrd_def]
    positivity
  have hrd_pow : (NumberField.rootDiscr K) ^ (n : ℝ) = D := by
    rw [hrd_def]
    calc
      (D ^ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹)) ^ (n : ℝ) = D ^ (((n : ℝ)⁻¹) * (n : ℝ)) := by
        symm
        exact Real.rpow_mul hD_nonneg ((n : ℝ)⁻¹) (n : ℝ)
      _ = D := by
        rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hn0, Real.rpow_one]
  have hsig : NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrRealPlaces K
      + 2 * NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K = n := by
    simpa [n] using NumberField.InfinitePlace.card_add_two_mul_card_eq_rank (K := K)
  have hcomplex_le_n : NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K ≤ n := by
    omega
  have hpi : (4 / Real.pi : ℝ) ≤ 2 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ Real.pi_pos]
    nlinarith [Real.pi_gt_three]
  have hpow_complex : (4 / Real.pi : ℝ) ^ NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
    calc
      (4 / Real.pi : ℝ) ^ NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K
          ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K := by
            exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hpi _
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
            exact pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hcomplex_le_n
  have hfac_le : ((n.factorial : ℝ)) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ n := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le_pow n
  have hpow_n_pos : 0 < (n : ℝ) ^ n := by
    positivity
  have hfac_div_le : ((n.factorial : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ n) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hpow_n_pos]
    simpa using hfac_le
  have hmink_le : minkowskiAuxBound K ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n * Real.sqrt D := by
    unfold minkowskiAuxBound
    calc
      (4 / Real.pi) ^ NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K *
          (((Module.finrank ℚ K).factorial : ℝ) / (Module.finrank ℚ K : ℝ) ^ Module.finrank ℚ K *
            Real.sqrt |(NumberField.discr K : ℝ)|)
          ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n *
              (((Module.finrank ℚ K).factorial : ℝ) / (Module.finrank ℚ K : ℝ) ^ Module.finrank ℚ K *
                Real.sqrt |(NumberField.discr K : ℝ)|) := by
            gcongr
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n * (1 * Real.sqrt D) := by
            gcongr
      _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ n * Real.sqrt D := by ring
  have hmink_nonneg : 0 ≤ minkowskiAuxBound K := by
    unfold minkowskiAuxBound
    positivity
  have hmink_sq' : (minkowskiAuxBound K) ^ (2 : ℕ) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ n * Real.sqrt D) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
    nlinarith [hmink_nonneg, hmink_le]
  have hsq_eq : ((2 : ℝ) ^ n * Real.sqrt D) ^ (2 : ℕ) = ((2 : ℝ) ^ n) ^ (2 : ℕ) * D := by
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hD_nonneg]
  have hmink_sq : (minkowskiAuxBound K) ^ (2 : ℕ) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ n) ^ (2 : ℕ) * D := by
    calc
      (minkowskiAuxBound K) ^ (2 : ℕ) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ n * Real.sqrt D) ^ (2 : ℕ) := hmink_sq'
      _ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ n) ^ (2 : ℕ) * D := hsq_eq
  by_cases hroot : NumberField.rootDiscr K ≤ 2
  · rw [max_eq_left hroot]
    have hD_le : D ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
      calc
        D = (NumberField.rootDiscr K) ^ (n : ℝ) := by symm; exact hrd_pow
        _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (n : ℝ) := by
          exact Real.rpow_le_rpow hrd_nonneg hroot (by positivity)
        _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ n := by rw [Real.rpow_natCast]
    have hpow_four : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((4 : ℝ) * n) = ((2 : ℝ) ^ n) ^ (4 : ℕ) := by
      calc
        (2 : ℝ) ^ ((4 : ℝ) * n) = (2 : ℝ) ^ ((n : ℝ) * 4) := by congr 1; ring
        _ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ (n : ℝ)) ^ (4 : ℝ) := by
              exact Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) (n : ℝ) 4
        _ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ (n : ℝ)) ^ (4 : ℕ) := by
              simpa using (Real.rpow_natCast (((2 : ℝ) ^ (n : ℝ))) 4)
        _ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ n) ^ (4 : ℕ) := by rw [Real.rpow_natCast]
    let a : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ n
    have ha_nonneg : 0 ≤ a := by
      positivity
    have hD_le_a : D ≤ a := by
      simpa [a] using hD_le
    have hmink_sq_a : (minkowskiAuxBound K) ^ (2 : ℕ) ≤ a ^ (2 : ℕ) * D := by
      simpa [a] using hmink_sq
    have hmul1 : a * (minkowskiAuxBound K) ^ (2 : ℕ) ≤ a * (a ^ (2 : ℕ) * D) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmink_sq_a ha_nonneg
    have hmul2 : a * (a ^ (2 : ℕ) * D) ≤ a ^ (4 : ℕ) := by
      calc
        a * (a ^ (2 : ℕ) * D) = a ^ (3 : ℕ) * D := by ring
        _ ≤ a ^ (3 : ℕ) * a := by
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hD_le_a (by positivity : 0 ≤ a ^ (3 : ℕ))
        _ = a ^ (4 : ℕ) := by ring
    calc
      (2 : ℝ) ^ n * (minkowskiAuxBound K) ^ (2 : ℕ) = a * (minkowskiAuxBound K) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
        simp [a]
      _ ≤ a * (a ^ (2 : ℕ) * D) := hmul1
      _ ≤ a ^ (4 : ℕ) := hmul2
      _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ ((4 : ℝ) * n) := by
        symm
        exact hpow_four
  · have hroot' : 2 ≤ NumberField.rootDiscr K := le_of_not_ge hroot
    rw [max_eq_right hroot']
    have hpow_le_D : (2 : ℝ) ^ n ≤ D := by
      calc
        (2 : ℝ) ^ n = (2 : ℝ) ^ (n : ℝ) := by
          symm
          exact Real.rpow_natCast (2 : ℝ) n
        _ ≤ (NumberField.rootDiscr K) ^ (n : ℝ) := by
          exact Real.rpow_le_rpow (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hroot' (by positivity)
        _ = D := hrd_pow
    have hpow_four : (NumberField.rootDiscr K) ^ ((4 : ℝ) * n) = D ^ (4 : ℕ) := by
      calc
        (NumberField.rootDiscr K) ^ ((4 : ℝ) * n)
            = (NumberField.rootDiscr K) ^ ((n : ℝ) * 4) := by congr 1; ring
        _ = ((NumberField.rootDiscr K) ^ (n : ℝ)) ^ (4 : ℝ) := by
              exact Real.rpow_mul hrd_nonneg (n : ℝ) 4
        _ = ((NumberField.rootDiscr K) ^ (n : ℝ)) ^ (4 : ℕ) := by
              simpa using (Real.rpow_natCast (((NumberField.rootDiscr K) ^ (n : ℝ))) 4)
        _ = D ^ (4 : ℕ) := by rw [hrd_pow]
    let a : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ n
    have ha_nonneg : 0 ≤ a := by
      positivity
    have ha_le_D : a ≤ D := by
      simpa [a] using hpow_le_D
    have hmink_sq_a : (minkowskiAuxBound K) ^ (2 : ℕ) ≤ a ^ (2 : ℕ) * D := by
      simpa [a] using hmink_sq
    have hmul1 : a * (minkowskiAuxBound K) ^ (2 : ℕ) ≤ a * (a ^ (2 : ℕ) * D) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmink_sq_a ha_nonneg
    have hpow3 : a ^ (3 : ℕ) ≤ D ^ (3 : ℕ) := by
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ ha_nonneg ha_le_D _
    have hmul2 : a * (a ^ (2 : ℕ) * D) ≤ D ^ (4 : ℕ) := by
      calc
        a * (a ^ (2 : ℕ) * D) = a ^ (3 : ℕ) * D := by ring
        _ ≤ D ^ (3 : ℕ) * D := by
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow3 hD_nonneg
        _ = D ^ (4 : ℕ) := by ring
    calc
      (2 : ℝ) ^ n * (minkowskiAuxBound K) ^ (2 : ℕ) = a * (minkowskiAuxBound K) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
        simp [a]
      _ ≤ a * (a ^ (2 : ℕ) * D) := hmul1
      _ ≤ D ^ (4 : ℕ) := hmul2
      _ = (NumberField.rootDiscr K) ^ ((4 : ℝ) * n) := by
        symm
        exact hpow_four

name: minkowski_class_number_bound_explicit
statement:
theorem minkowski_class_number_bound_explicit (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] :
    (NumberField.classNumber K : ℝ) ≤
      max 2 (NumberField.rootDiscr K) ^ ((4 : ℝ) * Module.finrank ℚ K)
proof:
:= by
  have hclass : (NumberField.classNumber K : ℝ) ≤ idealsUpToNormCount K (minkowskiAuxBound K) := by
    exact_mod_cast classNumber_le_idealsUpToNormCount_minkowskiAuxBound K
  have hfin_nat : 0 < Module.finrank ℚ K := Module.finrank_pos (R := ℚ) (M := K)
  have hfin : 0 < (Module.finrank ℚ K : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hfin_nat
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ minkowskiAuxBound K := by
    unfold minkowskiAuxBound
    positivity
  have hideals : (idealsUpToNormCount K (minkowskiAuxBound K) : ℝ) ≤
      dedekindZetaTwoReal K * (minkowskiAuxBound K) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
    exact idealsUpToNormCount_le_dedekindZetaTwoReal_mul_sq K (minkowskiAuxBound K) hnonneg
  have hzeta : dedekindZetaTwoReal K * (minkowskiAuxBound K) ^ (2 : ℕ) ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ Module.finrank ℚ K * (minkowskiAuxBound K) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
    gcongr
    exact dedekindZetaTwoReal_le_two_pow_finrank K
  calc
    (NumberField.classNumber K : ℝ) ≤ idealsUpToNormCount K (minkowskiAuxBound K) := hclass
    _ ≤ dedekindZetaTwoReal K * (minkowskiAuxBound K) ^ (2 : ℕ) := hideals
    _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ Module.finrank ℚ K * (minkowskiAuxBound K) ^ (2 : ℕ) := hzeta
    _ ≤ max 2 (NumberField.rootDiscr K) ^ ((4 : ℝ) * Module.finrank ℚ K) :=
      two_pow_mul_minkowskiAuxBound_sq_le_rootDiscr_pow_four K

name: minkowski_class_number_bound_exists_proved
statement:
theorem minkowski_class_number_bound_exists_proved :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K],
      (NumberField.classNumber K : ℝ) ≤
        max 2 (NumberField.rootDiscr K) ^ (C * Module.finrank ℚ K)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(4 : ℝ), by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro K _ _
  simpa using minkowski_class_number_bound_explicit K

statement:
theorem proposition_3_7
    (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] :

name: no_primitive_cubeRoot_of_cubic
statement:
lemma no_primitive_cubeRoot_of_cubic
    (F : Type) [Field F] [CharZero F] [NumberField F]
    (h_cubic : Module.finrank ℚ F = 3) :
    ¬ ∃ ζ : F, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ 3
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨ζ, hζ⟩
  have hint : IsIntegral ℚ ζ := Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral ζ
  have hirr : Irreducible (Polynomial.cyclotomic 3 ℚ) :=
    Polynomial.cyclotomic.irreducible_rat (by decide)
  have hcyc : minpoly ℚ ζ = Polynomial.cyclotomic 3 ℚ :=
    (hζ.minpoly_eq_cyclotomic_of_irreducible hirr).symm
  have hdeg : (minpoly ℚ ζ).natDegree = 2 := by
    rw [hcyc, Polynomial.natDegree_cyclotomic]; decide
  have hdvd : (minpoly ℚ ζ).natDegree ∣ Module.finrank ℚ F :=
    minpoly.degree_dvd hint
  rw [hdeg, h_cubic] at hdvd
  exact absurd hdvd (by decide)

name: shafarevich_bound_cubic_TR
statement:
lemma shafarevich_bound_cubic_TR
    (hSRR : Hyp_ShafarevichRelationRankBound)
    (F : Type) [Field F] [CharZero F] [NumberField F]
    [IsTotallyReal F] (h_cubic : Module.finrank ℚ F = 3) :
    relationRank 3 (MaxUnramifiedProPGaloisGroup F 3) ≤
      generatorRank (MaxUnramifiedProPGaloisGroup F 3) + 2
proof:
:= by
  have hnr_real : NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrRealPlaces F = 3 := by
    have h₁ : Module.finrank ℚ F = NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrRealPlaces F :=
      IsTotallyReal.finrank (K := F)
    rw [h_cubic] at h₁
    exact h₁.symm
  have hnr_cplx : NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces F = 0 :=
    IsTotallyReal.nrComplexPlaces_eq_zero F
  have hδ : ¬ ∃ ζ : F, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ 3 :=
    no_primitive_cubeRoot_of_cubic F h_cubic
  have h3Odd : Odd (3 : ℕ) := by norm_num
  have h := (hSRR F 3 h3Odd).2
  simp only [hnr_real, hnr_cplx, if_neg hδ] at h

  exact h

name: gsd_numeric_threshold
statement:
lemma gsd_numeric_threshold (ℓ n : ℕ) (hℓ : 8 ≤ ℓ) (hn : ℓ - 1 ≤ n) :
    4 * (n + 2 + 3 * ((ℓ - 1) ^ 2 / 100)) ≤ n ^ 2
proof:
:= by

  have hn7 : 7 ≤ n := by omega

  have hflr : 100 * ((ℓ - 1) ^ 2 / 100) ≤ n ^ 2 := by
    have h1 : 100 * ((ℓ - 1) ^ 2 / 100) ≤ (ℓ - 1) ^ 2 := Nat.mul_div_le _ 100
    have h2 : (ℓ - 1) ^ 2 ≤ n ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hn 2
    exact h1.trans h2

  nlinarith [hflr, sq_nonneg n, sq_nonneg (n - 7), hn7]

name: hyp_GS_of_textbook
statement:
theorem hyp_GS_of_textbook
    (hFG : Hyp_FiniteTopologicalRank)
    (hGSI : Hyp_GolodShafarevichInequality)
    (hSRR : Hyp_ShafarevichRelationRankBound)
    (h5term : Hyp_FiveTermRelationBound)
    (hBurnside : Hyp_NormallyGenH1InvariantBound) :
    ∃ ℓ₁ : ℕ, ∀ ℓ ≥ ℓ₁,
      ∀ (F : Type) [Field F] [CharZero F] [NumberField F]
        [IsTotallyReal F] [IsGalois ℚ F],
        Module.finrank ℚ F = 3 →
        ℓ - 1 ≤ generatorRank (MaxUnramifiedProPGaloisGroup F 3) →
        ∃ q : Fin ((ℓ - 1) ^ 2 / 100) → ℕ,
          Function.Injective q ∧
          (∀ b, (q b).Prime) ∧
          (∀ b, q b % 4 = 1) ∧
          (∀ b,
            (∀ 𝔭 ∈ (Ideal.span {(q b : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 F),
                Ideal.ramificationIdx (Ideal.span {(q b : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) 𝔭 = 1 ∧
                Ideal.inertiaDeg (Ideal.span {(q b : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) 𝔭 = 1) ∧
              ((Ideal.span {(q b : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 F)).ncard =
                Module.finrank ℚ F) ∧
          ∃ Q : ProPQuotient 3 (MaxUnramifiedProPGaloisGroup F 3),
            Infinite Q.Q ∧
            (∀ b (𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 F)) (hp : 𝔭.IsPrime) (hne : 𝔭 ≠ ⊥),
                𝔭 ∈ (Ideal.span {(q b : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 F) →
                Q.map (splittingDetectorAt F 3 𝔭 hp hne) = 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨8, ?_⟩
  intro ℓ hℓ F _ _ _ _ _ h_cubic hgen
  let G := MaxUnramifiedProPGaloisGroup F 3
  let t : ℕ := (ℓ - 1) ^ 2 / 100
  have hGfg : IsFinitelyGeneratedProPGroup 3 G := hFG F 3
  obtain ⟨q, hqinj, hqprime, _hqbad, hqmod4, hqsplit, hqfrat⟩ :=
    proposition_3_6 hFG F h_cubic t ∅
  have hfiber3 : ∀ b : Fin t,
      Nat.card (((Ideal.span {(q b : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 F))) = 3 := by
    intro b
    rw [Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
    simpa [h_cubic] using (hqsplit b).2
  have hfiber_fin : ∀ b : Fin t,
      Finite (((Ideal.span {(q b : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 F))) := by
    intro b
    apply Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero
    rw [hfiber3 b]; decide
  letI (b : Fin t) :
      Finite (((Ideal.span {(q b : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 F))) := hfiber_fin b
  let S : Type := Sigma fun b : Fin t =>
    ((Ideal.span {(q b : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 F))
  haveI : Finite S := by dsimp [S]; infer_instance
  have hcardS : Nat.card S = 3 * t := by
    dsimp [S]
    rw [Nat.card_sigma]
    calc
      ∑ b : Fin t, Nat.card ↑((Ideal.span {(q b : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ).primesOver (𝓞 F))
          = ∑ b : Fin t, 3 := by
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
              intro b _
              rw [hfiber3 b]
      _ = t * 3 := by simp [Finset.card_univ]
      _ = 3 * t := by omega
  have hcardS' : Fintype.card S = 3 * t := by
    simpa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hcardS
  let primeProof : ∀ x : S, x.2.1.IsPrime := fun x => by infer_instance
  let neBotProof : ∀ x : S, x.2.1 ≠ ⊥ := fun x => by
    have hp0 : (Ideal.span {(q x.1 : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) ≠ ⊥ := by
      rw [ne_eq, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (hqprime x.1))
    exact Ideal.ne_bot_of_mem_primesOver hp0 x.2.2
  let g : Fin (Nat.card S) → G := fun i =>
    let x : S := (Finite.equivFin S).symm i
    splittingDetectorAt F 3 x.2.1 (primeProof x) (neBotProof x)
  have hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ closedFrattini 3 G := by
    intro i
    let x : S := (Finite.equivFin S).symm i
    exact hqfrat x.1 x.2.1 (primeProof x) (neBotProof x) x.2.2
  have h3Odd : Odd (3 : ℕ) := by norm_num
  have hH2G : H2Finite 3 G := (hSRR F 3 h3Odd).1
  obtain ⟨Q, hkillg, hgenQ, _hH2Q, hrelQ⟩ :=
    frattini_quotient_lemma h5term hBurnside G 3 hGfg hH2G (Nat.card S) g hg
  refine ⟨q, hqinj, hqprime, hqmod4, hqsplit, Q, ?_, ?_⟩
  ·
    rw [← not_finite_iff_infinite]
    intro hQfin

    haveI : T2Space Q.Q := Q.t2
    haveI : Finite Q.Q := hQfin
    haveI : DiscreteTopology Q.Q := Finite.instDiscreteTopology
    haveI : IsPGroup 3 Q.Q := by
      have h := Q.isProP (⊥ : Subgroup Q.Q) (isOpen_discrete _)

      exact h.of_equiv (QuotientGroup.quotientBot)
    have hd_ge : ℓ - 1 ≤ generatorRank Q.Q := hgenQ ▸ hgen
    have hd_pos : 0 < generatorRank Q.Q := by omega
    haveI : Nontrivial Q.Q := by
      by_contra hnon
      rw [not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton] at hnon
      have hzero : generatorRank Q.Q = 0 := by
        change sInf _ = 0
        apply Nat.sInf_eq_zero.mpr
        refine Or.inl ⟨(∅ : Finset Q.Q), Finset.card_empty, ?_⟩
        haveI := hnon
        exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
      omega

    have hgsi := hGSI 3 Q.Q ‹IsPGroup 3 Q.Q› ‹Nontrivial Q.Q›

    have hshaf := shafarevich_bound_cubic_TR hSRR F h_cubic

    have hr_le : relationRank 3 Q.Q ≤ generatorRank Q.Q + 2 + 3 * t := by
      have h1 : relationRank 3 Q.Q ≤ relationRank 3 G + Nat.card S := hrelQ
      rw [hcardS] at h1
      have h2 : relationRank 3 G ≤ generatorRank G + 2 := hshaf
      rw [← hgenQ] at h2
      omega
    have hthresh : 4 * (generatorRank Q.Q + 2 + 3 * t) ≤ generatorRank Q.Q ^ 2 :=
      gsd_numeric_threshold ℓ (generatorRank Q.Q) hℓ hd_ge
    have hineq : (generatorRank Q.Q : ℝ) ^ 2 ≥ 4 * (relationRank 3 Q.Q : ℝ) := by
      have hr_le' : (relationRank 3 Q.Q : ℝ) ≤ (generatorRank Q.Q + 2 + 3 * t : ℕ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hr_le
      have hthresh' : (4 * (generatorRank Q.Q + 2 + 3 * t) : ℕ) ≤ (generatorRank Q.Q ^ 2 : ℕ) := hthresh
      have hthresh'' : (4 * (generatorRank Q.Q + 2 + 3 * t) : ℝ) ≤ (generatorRank Q.Q ^ 2 : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hthresh'
      push_cast at hr_le' hthresh''
      linarith
    linarith
  ·
    intro b 𝔭 hp hne hmem
    let x : S := ⟨b, ⟨𝔭, hmem⟩⟩
    have hi0 := hkillg ((Finite.equivFin S) x)
    dsimp [g] at hi0
    have hxeq : (Finite.equivFin S).symm ((Finite.equivFin S) x) = x := by simp
    rw [hxeq] at hi0
    have hi : Q.map (splittingDetectorAt F 3 x.2.1 (primeProof x) (neBotProof x)) = 1 := by
      simpa using hi0
    have hfrob : splittingDetectorAt F 3 x.2.1 (primeProof x) (neBotProof x) =
        splittingDetectorAt F 3 𝔭 hp hne := by
      change splittingDetectorAt F 3 𝔭 (primeProof x) (neBotProof x) = splittingDetectorAt F 3 𝔭 hp hne
      cases Subsingleton.elim (primeProof x) hp
      cases Subsingleton.elim (neBotProof x) hne
      rfl
    simpa [hfrob] using hi

name: countable_clopens_of_countable_openNormalSubgroup
statement:
theorem countable_clopens_of_countable_openNormalSubgroup
    {G : Type*} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (hON : Countable (OpenNormalSubgroup G)) :
    Countable (TopologicalSpace.Clopens G)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let basisFun : (Σ H : OpenNormalSubgroup G, G ⧸ H.toSubgroup) → Set G :=
    fun p => (QuotientGroup.mk : G → G ⧸ p.1.toSubgroup) ⁻¹'
      ({p.2} : Set (G ⧸ p.1.toSubgroup))
  let B : Set (Set G) := Set.range basisFun
  have hBasis : TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis B := by
    refine TopologicalSpace.isTopologicalBasis_of_isOpen_of_nhds ?_ ?_
    · intro s hs
      rcases hs with ⟨⟨H, q⟩, rfl⟩
      simpa using (isOpen_discrete ({q} : Set (G ⧸ H.toSubgroup))).preimage
        (QuotientGroup.continuous_mk :
          Continuous (QuotientGroup.mk : G → G ⧸ H.toSubgroup))
    · intro x U hxU UOpen
      let V : Set G := (fun y : G => x * y) ⁻¹' U
      have hVOpen : IsOpen V := by
        simpa [V] using UOpen.preimage (Homeomorph.mulLeft x).continuous
      have h1V : (1 : G) ∈ V := by
        simpa [V] using hxU
      obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ :=
        ProfiniteGrp.exist_openNormalSubgroup_sub_open_nhds_of_one hVOpen h1V
      refine ⟨basisFun ⟨H, (x : G ⧸ H.toSubgroup)⟩,
        ⟨⟨H, (x : G ⧸ H.toSubgroup)⟩, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [basisFun]
      · intro y hy
        have hxy : (y : G ⧸ H.toSubgroup) = x := by
          simpa [basisFun] using hy
        have hmem : x⁻¹ * y ∈ H := QuotientGroup.eq.mp hxy.symm
        simpa [V, mul_assoc] using hH hmem
  have hBCount : B.Countable := by
    letI : Countable (OpenNormalSubgroup G) := hON
    simpa [B] using Set.countable_range basisFun
  letI : SecondCountableTopology G := hBasis.secondCountableTopology hBCount
  exact (TopologicalSpace.Clopens.countable_iff_secondCountable (X := G)).2
    inferInstance

name: countable_monoidHomToFinite_of_fg
statement:
theorem countable_monoidHomToFinite_of_fg
    (Γ K : Type*) [Group Γ] [Group K] [Group.FG Γ] [Finite K] :
    Countable (Γ →* K)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfg : Group.FG Γ := inferInstance
  rcases Group.fg_iff_exists_freeGroup_hom_surjective.mp hfg with
    ⟨S, hSfin, φ, hφsurj⟩
  let enc : (Γ →* K) → (S → K) := fun ψ =>
    (FreeGroup.lift : (S → K) ≃ (FreeGroup S →* K)).symm (ψ.comp φ)
  have henc : Function.Injective enc := by
    intro ψ₁ ψ₂ h
    have h' : ψ₁.comp φ = ψ₂.comp φ := by
      have h'' := congrArg
        (fun f : S → K => (FreeGroup.lift : (S → K) ≃ (FreeGroup S →* K)) f) h
      simpa [enc] using h''
    ext γ
    rcases hφsurj γ with ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun h' x
  letI : Finite S := hSfin.to_subtype
  letI : Countable (S → K) := Finite.to_countable
  exact Function.Injective.countable henc

name: countable_finiteIndexNormalSubgroup_of_fg
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S := Σ n : ℕ, (Γ →* Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
  let g : S → {N : Subgroup Γ // N.Normal ∧ N.FiniteIndex} := fun s =>
    ⟨s.2.ker, MonoidHom.normal_ker s.2, by
      letI : Finite s.2.range := inferInstance
      exact Subgroup.finiteIndex_ker s.2⟩
  have hS : Countable S := by
    letI (n : ℕ) : Countable (Γ →* Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :=
      countable_monoidHomToFinite_of_fg Γ (Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    infer_instance
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective g := by
    intro N
    letI : N.1.Normal := N.2.1
    letI : N.1.FiniteIndex := N.2.2
    let Q := Γ ⧸ N.1
    letI : Fintype Q := by
      dsimp [Q]
      exact Subgroup.fintypeQuotientOfFiniteIndex (H := N.1)
    let e : Q ≃ Fin (Fintype.card Q) := Fintype.equivFin Q
    let ρ0 : Γ →* Equiv.Perm Q := MulAction.toPermHom Γ Q
    let ρ : Γ →* Equiv.Perm (Fin (Fintype.card Q)) :=
      (e.permCongrHom.toMonoidHom).comp ρ0
    refine ⟨⟨Fintype.card Q, ρ⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    change ρ.ker = N.1
    have hker0 : ρ0.ker = N.1 := by
      dsimp [ρ0, Q]
      exact (Subgroup.normalCore_eq_ker N.1).symm.trans
        (Subgroup.normalCore_eq_self N.1)
    ext x
    simpa [ρ, hker0, MonoidHom.comp_apply]
  exact Function.Surjective.countable hsurj

name: countable_openNormalSubgroup_of_dense_fg_subgroup
statement:
theorem countable_openNormalSubgroup_of_dense_fg_subgroup
    {G : Type*} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] (Γ : Subgroup G) [Group.FG Γ]
    (hΓdense : Dense (Γ : Set G)) :
    Countable (OpenNormalSubgroup G)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let enc : OpenNormalSubgroup G →
      {N : Subgroup Γ // N.Normal ∧ N.FiniteIndex} := fun H => by
    refine ⟨H.toSubgroup.subgroupOf Γ, inferInstance, ?_⟩
    letI : Finite ((⊤ : Subgroup G) ⧸
        H.toSubgroup.subgroupOf (⊤ : Subgroup G)) :=
      Subgroup.quotient_finite_of_isOpen' (U := (⊤ : Subgroup G))
        (K := H.toSubgroup.subgroupOf (⊤ : Subgroup G))
        (by simpa using isOpen_univ)
        (Subgroup.subgroupOf_isOpen (⊤ : Subgroup G) H.toSubgroup
          H.toOpenSubgroup.isOpen)
    let e : Γ ⧸ H.toSubgroup.subgroupOf Γ ↪
        (⊤ : Subgroup G) ⧸ H.toSubgroup.subgroupOf (⊤ : Subgroup G) :=
      Subgroup.quotientSubgroupOfEmbeddingOfLE H.toSubgroup (by
        intro g hg
        simp)
    letI : Finite (Γ ⧸ H.toSubgroup.subgroupOf Γ) :=
      Finite.of_injective e e.injective
    exact Subgroup.finiteIndex_of_finite_quotient
      (G := Γ) (H := H.toSubgroup.subgroupOf Γ)
  have henc : Function.Injective enc := by
    intro H K h
    apply OpenNormalSubgroup.toSubgroup_injective
    ext g
    change g ∈ (H : Set G) ↔ g ∈ (K : Set G)
    constructor
    · intro hg
      have hEqSub : H.toSubgroup.subgroupOf Γ = K.toSubgroup.subgroupOf Γ :=
        congrArg Subtype.val h
      have hHK : ((H : Set G) ∩ (Γ : Set G)) ⊆ (K : Set G) := by
        intro x hx
        have hxH : (⟨x, hx.2⟩ : Γ) ∈ H.toSubgroup.subgroupOf Γ := by
          simpa using hx.1
        have hxK : (⟨x, hx.2⟩ : Γ) ∈ K.toSubgroup.subgroupOf Γ := by
          simpa [hEqSub] using hxH
        simpa using hxK
      have hg' : g ∈ closure ((H : Set G) ∩ (Γ : Set G)) :=
        (Dense.open_subset_closure_inter hΓdense
          H.toOpenSubgroup.isOpen) hg
      exact closure_minimal hHK
        (OpenSubgroup.isClosed K.toOpenSubgroup) hg'
    · intro hg
      have hEqSub : K.toSubgroup.subgroupOf Γ = H.toSubgroup.subgroupOf Γ :=
        (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
      have hKH : ((K : Set G) ∩ (Γ : Set G)) ⊆ (H : Set G) := by
        intro x hx
        have hxK : (⟨x, hx.2⟩ : Γ) ∈ K.toSubgroup.subgroupOf Γ := by
          simpa using hx.1
        have hxH : (⟨x, hx.2⟩ : Γ) ∈ H.toSubgroup.subgroupOf Γ := by
          simpa [hEqSub] using hxK
        simpa using hxH
      have hg' : g ∈ closure ((K : Set G) ∩ (Γ : Set G)) :=
        (Dense.open_subset_closure_inter hΓdense
          K.toOpenSubgroup.isOpen) hg
      exact closure_minimal hKH
        (OpenSubgroup.isClosed H.toOpenSubgroup) hg'
  letI : Countable {N : Subgroup Γ // N.Normal ∧ N.FiniteIndex} :=
    countable_finiteIndexNormalSubgroup_of_fg Γ
  exact Function.Injective.countable henc

name: secondCountableTopology_of_fg_profinite
statement:
theorem secondCountableTopology_of_fg_profinite
    {G : Type} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    {S : Finset G}
    (hS : (Subgroup.closure (S : Set G)).topologicalClosure = ⊤) :
    SecondCountableTopology G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Γ : Subgroup G := Subgroup.closure (S : Set G)
  have hΓdense : Dense (Γ : Set G) := by
    rw [dense_iff_closure_eq]
    rw [show closure (Γ : Set G) = (Γ.topologicalClosure : Set G) by
      rw [Subgroup.topologicalClosure_coe]]
    simpa [Γ] using congrArg (fun H : Subgroup G => (H : Set G)) hS
  have hΓfg_subgroup : Γ.FG := by
    rw [Subgroup.fg_iff]
    refine ⟨S, ?_⟩
    simp [Γ]
  have hΓfg : Group.FG Γ := by
    rw [Group.fg_iff_subgroup_fg]
    exact hΓfg_subgroup
  have hON : Countable (OpenNormalSubgroup G) :=
    countable_openNormalSubgroup_of_dense_fg_subgroup Γ hΓdense
  have hClopen : Countable (TopologicalSpace.Clopens G) :=
    countable_clopens_of_countable_openNormalSubgroup hON
  rw [← TopologicalSpace.Clopens.countable_iff_secondCountable]
  exact hClopen

statement:

name: compactSpace_of_frattini_quotient
statement:
theorem compactSpace_of_frattini_quotient
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]

    (_hG : IsFinitelyGeneratedProPGroup p G)
    {k : ℕ} (g : Fin k → G) (_hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ closedFrattini p G) :

name: QuotientGroup.totallyDisconnectedSpace
statement:
theorem QuotientGroup.totallyDisconnectedSpace
    {G : Type*} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G)) :
    TotallyDisconnectedSpace (G ⧸ N)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : T2Space (G ⧸ N) := by
    haveI : T1Space (G ⧸ N) := QuotientGroup.instT1Space
    infer_instance
  refine ⟨fun S _ hScon => ?_⟩

  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨x, hxS, y, hyS, hxy⟩ := Set.not_subsingleton_iff.mp hne

  obtain ⟨x₀, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk_surjective x
  obtain ⟨y₀, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk_surjective y

  set yN : Set G := { g | y₀⁻¹ * g ∈ N } with hyN_def
  have hyN_closed : IsClosed yN := by
    have hcont : Continuous (fun g : G => y₀⁻¹ * g) := continuous_const.mul continuous_id
    exact hN.preimage hcont
  have hx_notin : x₀ ∉ yN := by
    intro hin
    apply hxy
    show QuotientGroup.mk x₀ = QuotientGroup.mk y₀
    rw [QuotientGroup.eq]

    have hinv : (y₀⁻¹ * x₀)⁻¹ ∈ N := N.inv_mem hin
    have heq : (y₀⁻¹ * x₀)⁻¹ = x₀⁻¹ * y₀ := by group
    rw [heq] at hinv
    exact hinv

  obtain ⟨W, hWclopen, hxW, hWdisj⟩ :=
    exists_clopen_of_closed_subset_open
      (Z := ({x₀} : Set G)) (U := (yN)ᶜ)
      isClosed_singleton hyN_closed.isOpen_compl
      (by intro z hz; rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz; subst hz; exact hx_notin)

  have hUopen : IsOpen (QuotientGroup.mk '' W : Set (G ⧸ N)) :=
    QuotientGroup.isOpenQuotientMap_mk.isOpenMap _ hWclopen.isOpen
  have hUclosed : IsClosed (QuotientGroup.mk '' W : Set (G ⧸ N)) :=
    (hWclopen.isClosed.isCompact.image continuous_quotient_mk').isClosed

  have hx_in : (QuotientGroup.mk x₀ : G ⧸ N) ∈ (QuotientGroup.mk '' W) :=
    ⟨x₀, hxW rfl, rfl⟩
  have hy_notin : (QuotientGroup.mk y₀ : G ⧸ N) ∉ (QuotientGroup.mk '' W) := by
    rintro ⟨w, hw, hwy⟩
    apply hWdisj hw

    rw [QuotientGroup.eq] at hwy
    show y₀⁻¹ * w ∈ N

    have : (y₀⁻¹ * w) = (w⁻¹ * y₀)⁻¹ := by group
    rw [this]
    exact N.inv_mem hwy

  have hSU_inter : (S ∩ (QuotientGroup.mk '' W)).Nonempty := ⟨_, hxS, hx_in⟩
  have hSUc_inter : (S ∩ (QuotientGroup.mk '' W)ᶜ).Nonempty := ⟨_, hyS, hy_notin⟩
  have hSU_nempty : (S ∩ ((QuotientGroup.mk '' W) ∩ (QuotientGroup.mk '' W)ᶜ)).Nonempty :=
    hScon (QuotientGroup.mk '' W) ((QuotientGroup.mk '' W)ᶜ) hUopen hUclosed.isOpen_compl
      (fun z _ => (em _).imp_right (fun h => h)) hSU_inter hSUc_inter
  obtain ⟨z, _, hz1, hz2⟩ := hSU_nempty
  exact hz2 hz1

name: totallyDisconnected_of_frattini_quotient
statement:
theorem totallyDisconnected_of_frattini_quotient
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
    (hG : IsFinitelyGeneratedProPGroup p G)
    {k : ℕ} (g : Fin k → G) (_hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ closedFrattini p G) :
    TotallyDisconnectedSpace (G ⧸ closedNormalClosureRange g)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hG.compactSpace
  haveI := hG.t2Space
  haveI := hG.totallyDisconnectedSpace
  exact QuotientGroup.totallyDisconnectedSpace _
    (closedNormalClosureRange.isClosed g)

name: isProP_of_frattini_quotient
statement:
theorem isProP_of_frattini_quotient
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
    (hG : IsFinitelyGeneratedProPGroup p G)
    {k : ℕ} (g : Fin k → G) (_hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ closedFrattini p G) :
    ∀ (H : Subgroup (G ⧸ closedNormalClosureRange g)) [H.Normal],
      IsOpen (H : Set (G ⧸ closedNormalClosureRange g)) →
        IsPGroup p ((G ⧸ closedNormalClosureRange g) ⧸ H)
proof:
:= by
  intro H _ hH
  set N : Subgroup G := closedNormalClosureRange g with hN_def
  set π : G →* G ⧸ N := QuotientGroup.mk' N with hπ_def
  set M : Subgroup G := H.comap π with hM_def
  haveI : M.Normal := H.normal_comap π
  have hN_le_M : N ≤ M := by
    intro x hx
    change π x ∈ H
    have hπx : π x = 1 := (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff x).mpr hx
    simp [hπx]
  have hM_open : IsOpen (M : Set G) := by
    change IsOpen (π ⁻¹' (H : Set _))
    exact QuotientGroup.continuous_mk.isOpen_preimage _ hH
  have hM_pgrp : IsPGroup p (G ⧸ M) := hG.isPGroup_quotient M hM_open
  have hMmap : M.map (QuotientGroup.mk' N) = H :=
    Subgroup.map_comap_eq_self_of_surjective (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective _) H
  haveI : (M.map (QuotientGroup.mk' N)).Normal := inferInstance
  have iso : ((G ⧸ N) ⧸ H) ≃* (G ⧸ M) :=
    (QuotientGroup.quotientMulEquivOfEq hMmap.symm).trans
      (QuotientGroup.quotientQuotientEquivQuotient N M hN_le_M)
  exact IsPGroup.of_equiv hM_pgrp iso.symm

name: closedFrattini_normal
statement: theorem closedFrattini_normal (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (p : ℕ) : (closedFrattini p G).Normal
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : Set G := (Set.range fun g : G => g ^ p) ∪ (commutator G : Set G)
  have hnormal_closure : (Subgroup.closure S).Normal := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    intro x hx a
    refine Subgroup.closure_induction
      (p := fun y _ => a * y * a⁻¹ ∈ Subgroup.closure S)
      ?hmem ?hone ?hmul ?hinv hx
    · intro y hy
      rcases hy with hy | hy
      · rcases hy with ⟨g, rfl⟩
        exact Subgroup.subset_closure <| Or.inl <| ⟨a * g * a⁻¹, by
          simpa using (conj_pow (a := a) (b := g) (i := p))
        ⟩
      · exact Subgroup.subset_closure <| Or.inr <| (inferInstance : (commutator G).Normal).conj_mem y hy a
    · simpa using (Subgroup.one_mem (Subgroup.closure S))
    · intro y z hy hz hy' hz'
      have hm : (a * y * a⁻¹) * (a * z * a⁻¹) ∈ Subgroup.closure S :=
        Subgroup.mul_mem (Subgroup.closure S) hy' hz'
      simpa [mul_assoc] using hm
    · intro y hy hy'
      have hi : (a * y * a⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ Subgroup.closure S :=
        Subgroup.inv_mem (Subgroup.closure S) hy'
      simpa [mul_assoc] using hi
  letI : (Subgroup.closure S).Normal := hnormal_closure
  simpa [closedFrattini, S] using (Subgroup.is_normal_topologicalClosure (N := Subgroup.closure S))

name: closedNormalClosureRange_le_closedFrattini
statement: theorem closedNormalClosureRange_le_closedFrattini (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (p : ℕ) {k : ℕ} (g : Fin k → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ closedFrattini p G) : closedNormalClosureRange g ≤ closedFrattini p G
proof:
:= by
  letI : (closedFrattini p G).Normal := closedFrattini_normal G p
  refine Subgroup.topologicalClosure_minimal (s := Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g)) ?_ ?_
  · exact Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal (by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact hg i)
  · simpa [closedFrattini] using
      (Subgroup.isClosed_topologicalClosure
        (Subgroup.closure ((Set.range (fun x : G => x ^ p)) ∪ (commutator G : Set G))))

name: generatorRank_le_of_generating_finset
statement: theorem generatorRank_le_of_generating_finset (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (S : Finset G) (hS : (Subgroup.closure (S : Set G)).topologicalClosure = ⊤) : generatorRank G ≤ S.card
proof:
:= by
  unfold generatorRank
  apply Nat.sInf_le
  exact ⟨S, rfl, hS⟩

name: generatorRank_quotient_le_of_closed_normal
statement: theorem generatorRank_quotient_le_of_closed_normal (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (hG : IsFinitelyGeneratedProPGroup p G) (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] : generatorRank (G ⧸ N) ≤ generatorRank G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases generatorRank_spec hG with ⟨S, hS_card, hS_top⟩
  let π : G →* G ⧸ N := QuotientGroup.mk' N
  let T : Finset (G ⧸ N) := S.image π
  have hT_top : (Subgroup.closure ((T : Finset (G ⧸ N)) : Set (G ⧸ N))).topologicalClosure = ⊤ := by
    have htop : ((Subgroup.closure (S : Set G)).map π).topologicalClosure = (⊤ : Subgroup (G ⧸ N)) := by
      simpa using
        (DenseRange.topologicalClosure_map_subgroup (f := π)
          continuous_quotient_mk' (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective N).denseRange hS_top :
          ((Subgroup.closure (S : Set G)).map π).topologicalClosure =
            (⊤ : Subgroup (G ⧸ N)))
    rw [MonoidHom.map_closure] at htop
    simpa [T, π, Finset.coe_image] using htop
  calc
    generatorRank (G ⧸ N) ≤ T.card := generatorRank_le_of_generating_finset (G := G ⧸ N) T hT_top
    _ ≤ S.card := Finset.card_image_le
    _ = generatorRank G := hS_card

name: generatorRank_spec_of_exists_generating_finset
statement: theorem generatorRank_spec_of_exists_generating_finset (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (hex : ∃ S : Finset G, (Subgroup.closure (S : Set G)).topologicalClosure = ⊤) : ∃ S : Finset G, S.card = generatorRank G ∧ (Subgroup.closure (S : Set G)).topologicalClosure = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold generatorRank
  let A : Set ℕ := {k : ℕ | ∃ S : Finset G, S.card = k ∧ (Subgroup.closure (S : Set G)).topologicalClosure = ⊤}
  have hA_nonempty : A.Nonempty := by
    rcases hex with ⟨S, hS⟩
    exact ⟨S.card, ⟨S, rfl, hS⟩⟩
  have hsInf_mem : sInf A ∈ A := Nat.sInf_mem hA_nonempty
  rcases hsInf_mem with ⟨S, hcard, hS⟩
  refine ⟨S, ?_, hS⟩
  simpa [A] using hcard

name: powers_commutator_le_frattini_of_finite_pgroup
statement: theorem powers_commutator_le_frattini_of_finite_pgroup (Q : Type) [Group Q] [Finite Q] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (hQ : IsPGroup p Q) : Subgroup.closure ((Set.range (fun q : Q => q ^ p)) ∪ (commutator Q : Set Q)) ≤ frattini Q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [frattini, Order.radical]
  refine le_iInf ?_
  intro M
  refine le_iInf ?_
  intro hM
  have hp : Nat.Prime p := Fact.out
  letI : Group.IsNilpotent Q := hQ.isNilpotent
  have hnc : NormalizerCondition Q := normalizerCondition_of_isNilpotent (G := Q)
  letI : M.Normal := Subgroup.NormalizerCondition.normal_of_coatom (H := M) hnc hM
  have hquot_bot_or_top : ∀ H : Subgroup (Q ⧸ M), H = ⊥ ∨ H = ⊤ := by
    intro H
    by_cases hH : H = ⊥
    · exact Or.inl hH
    · right
      obtain ⟨x, hxH, hx1⟩ := (Subgroup.bot_or_exists_ne_one H).resolve_left hH
      obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective M x
      have hq_not_mem : q ∉ M := by
        intro hqM
        apply hx1
        exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff q).2 hqM
      have hM_le_comap : M ≤ H.comap (QuotientGroup.mk' M) := by
        intro y hy
        change QuotientGroup.mk' M y ∈ H
        simpa [(QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff y).2 hy] using H.one_mem
      have hne : M ≠ H.comap (QuotientGroup.mk' M) := by
        intro hEq
        apply hq_not_mem
        have hq : q ∈ H.comap (QuotientGroup.mk' M) := by
          change QuotientGroup.mk' M q ∈ H
          exact hxH
        simpa [hEq] using hq
      have hcomap_top : H.comap (QuotientGroup.mk' M) = ⊤ :=
        hM.2 _ (lt_iff_le_and_ne.2 ⟨hM_le_comap, hne⟩)
      have hEq : H.comap (QuotientGroup.mk' M) = (⊤ : Subgroup (Q ⧸ M)).comap (QuotientGroup.mk' M) := by
        simpa using hcomap_top
      exact (Subgroup.comap_injective (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective M)) hEq
  haveI : Nontrivial (Q ⧸ M) := (QuotientGroup.nontrivial_iff).2 hM.1
  have hcenter_ne_bot : (Subgroup.center (Q ⧸ M)) ≠ ⊥ := by
    haveI : Nontrivial (Subgroup.center (Q ⧸ M)) := (hQ.to_quotient M).center_nontrivial
    exact (Subgroup.nontrivial_iff_ne_bot _).1 inferInstance
  have hcenter_top : Subgroup.center (Q ⧸ M) = ⊤ := (hquot_bot_or_top _).resolve_left hcenter_ne_bot
  letI : CommGroup (Q ⧸ M) := Group.commGroupOfCenterEqTop hcenter_top
  have hsimple : IsSimpleGroup (Q ⧸ M) := by
    rw [isSimpleGroup_iff]
    constructor
    · infer_instance
    · intro H hH
      exact hquot_bot_or_top H
  have hprimecard : Nat.Prime (Nat.card (Q ⧸ M)) := (CommGroup.is_simple_iff_prime_card).1 hsimple
  have hcard_ne_one : Nat.card (Q ⧸ M) ≠ 1 := by
    exact ne_of_gt (Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.mpr inferInstance)
  have hdiv : p ∣ Nat.card (Q ⧸ M) := (hQ.to_quotient M).card_eq_or_dvd.resolve_left hcard_ne_one
  have hcard_eq_p : Nat.card (Q ⧸ M) = p := ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp hprimecard).1 hdiv).symm
  have hcomm : commutator Q ≤ M := by
    have hmulComm : Std.Commutative (fun a b : Q ⧸ M => a * b) := by
      refine ⟨?_⟩
      intro a b
      exact mul_comm a b
    exact (Subgroup.Normal.quotient_commutative_iff_commutator_le (N := M)).1 hmulComm
  exact (Subgroup.closure_le (K := M)).2 <| by
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · rcases hx with ⟨q, rfl⟩
      have hpowindex : q ^ M.index ∈ M := Subgroup.pow_index_mem M q
      simpa [Subgroup.index_eq_card, hcard_eq_p] using hpowindex
    · exact hcomm hx

name: closedFrattini_le_comap_frattini_of_open_normal
statement: theorem closedFrattini_le_comap_frattini_of_open_normal (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (hG : IsFinitelyGeneratedProPGroup p G) (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hNopen : IsOpen (N : Set G)) : closedFrattini p G ≤ (frattini (G ⧸ N)).comap (QuotientGroup.mk' N)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let π : G →* G ⧸ N := QuotientGroup.mk' N
  haveI : CompactSpace G := hG.compactSpace
  haveI : Finite (G ⧸ N) := Subgroup.quotient_finite_of_isOpen N hNopen
  haveI : DiscreteTopology (G ⧸ N) := QuotientGroup.discreteTopology (N := N) hNopen
  have hQp : IsPGroup p (G ⧸ N) := hG.isPGroup_quotient N hNopen
  have hpowcomm :
      Subgroup.closure ((Set.range (fun q : G ⧸ N => q ^ p)) ∪
        (commutator (G ⧸ N) : Set (G ⧸ N))) ≤ frattini (G ⧸ N) :=
    powers_commutator_le_frattini_of_finite_pgroup (G ⧸ N) p hQp
  have hcomm_map : (commutator G).map π = commutator (G ⧸ N) := by
    rw [map_commutator_eq,
      MonoidHom.range_eq_top_of_surjective π (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective N)]
    rfl
  have halg :
      Subgroup.closure ((Set.range (fun g : G => g ^ p)) ∪ (commutator G : Set G)) ≤
        (frattini (G ⧸ N)).comap π := by
    refine (Subgroup.closure_le ((frattini (G ⧸ N)).comap π)).2 ?_
    intro x hx
    change x ∈ (frattini (G ⧸ N)).comap π
    rw [Subgroup.mem_comap]
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · rcases hx with ⟨g, rfl⟩
      rw [MonoidHom.map_pow]
      exact hpowcomm (Subgroup.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨π g, rfl⟩))
    · have hxmap : π x ∈ (commutator G).map π :=
        Subgroup.mem_map_of_mem π hx
      rw [hcomm_map] at hxmap
      exact hpowcomm (Subgroup.subset_closure (Or.inr hxmap))
  have hclosed : IsClosed (((frattini (G ⧸ N)).comap π : Subgroup G) : Set G) := by
    change IsClosed (π ⁻¹' (frattini (G ⧸ N) : Set (G ⧸ N)))
    have hfrclosed : IsClosed (frattini (G ⧸ N) : Set (G ⧸ N)) :=
      isClosed_discrete _
    exact hfrclosed.preimage (by
      simpa only [π, QuotientGroup.coe_mk' N] using (QuotientGroup.continuous_mk (N := N)))
  simpa only [closedFrattini] using
    (Subgroup.topologicalClosure_minimal
      (Subgroup.closure ((Set.range (fun g : G => g ^ p)) ∪ (commutator G : Set G)))
      halg hclosed)

name: closedFrattini_nongenerating
statement: theorem closedFrattini_nongenerating (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (hG : IsFinitelyGeneratedProPGroup p G) (K : Subgroup G) (hKclosed : IsClosed (K : Set G)) (hK : K ⊔ closedFrattini p G = ⊤) : K = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI := hG.compactSpace
  haveI := hG.t2Space
  haveI := hG.totallyDisconnectedSpace
  by_contra hKtop
  have hnotall : ¬ ∀ x : G, x ∈ K := by
    intro hAll
    apply hKtop
    ext y
    constructor
    · intro _
      trivial
    · intro _
      exact hAll y
  obtain ⟨x, hxK⟩ : ∃ x : G, x ∉ K := not_forall.mp hnotall
  let U : Set G := ((Homeomorph.mulLeft x) '' (K : Set G))ᶜ
  have hUopen : IsOpen U := by
    dsimp [U]
    exact ((Homeomorph.mulLeft x).isClosedMap _ hKclosed).isOpen_compl
  have hU1 : (1 : G) ∈ U := by
    refine Set.mem_compl ?_
    rintro ⟨l, hl, hxl⟩
    have hxl' : x * l = 1 := by simpa using hxl
    rw [← inv_eq_iff_mul_eq_one] at hxl'
    exact hxK <| inv_mem_iff.mp (hxl' ▸ hl)
  obtain ⟨N, hNsubU⟩ :=
    ProfiniteGrp.exist_openNormalSubgroup_sub_open_nhds_of_one (G := G) hUopen hU1
  have hxNK : x ∉ (N : Subgroup G) ⊔ K := by
    intro hxNK
    rcases Subgroup.mem_sup_of_normal_left.mp hxNK with ⟨y, hy, z, hz, hyz⟩
    rw [← eq_mul_inv_iff_mul_eq] at hyz
    have hximage : x * z⁻¹ ∈ (Homeomorph.mulLeft x) '' (K : Set G) := by
      refine ⟨z⁻¹, inv_mem_iff.mpr hz, rfl⟩
    exact hNsubU (hyz ▸ hy) hximage
  let π : G →* G ⧸ (N : Subgroup G) := QuotientGroup.mk' (N : Subgroup G)
  let H : Subgroup (G ⧸ (N : Subgroup G)) := K.map π
  haveI : Finite (G ⧸ (N : Subgroup G)) :=
    Subgroup.quotient_finite_of_isOpen (U := (N : Subgroup G)) N.isOpen
  haveI : IsCoatomic (Subgroup (G ⧸ (N : Subgroup G))) := Finite.to_isCoatomic
  have hcf : closedFrattini p G ≤ (frattini (G ⧸ (N : Subgroup G))).comap π :=
    closedFrattini_le_comap_frattini_of_open_normal (G := G) (p := p) hG (N := (N : Subgroup G))
      (hNopen := N.isOpen)
  have hcfmap : (closedFrattini p G).map π ≤ frattini (G ⧸ (N : Subgroup G)) :=
    (Subgroup.map_le_iff_le_comap).2 hcf
  have hHsup : H ⊔ frattini (G ⧸ (N : Subgroup G)) = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    calc
      (⊤ : Subgroup (G ⧸ (N : Subgroup G))) = (K ⊔ closedFrattini p G).map π := by
        rw [hK, Subgroup.map_top_of_surjective π QuotientGroup.mk_surjective]
      _ = H ⊔ (closedFrattini p G).map π := by
        rw [Subgroup.map_sup]
      _ ≤ H ⊔ frattini (G ⧸ (N : Subgroup G)) := by
        exact sup_le_sup le_rfl hcfmap
  have hHtop : H = ⊤ := frattini_nongenerating (K := H) hHsup
  have hKNtop : K ⊔ (N : Subgroup G) = ⊤ := by
    have hmap_eq : K.map π = (⊤ : Subgroup G).map π := by
      calc
        K.map π = H := by rfl
        _ = ⊤ := hHtop
        _ = (⊤ : Subgroup G).map π := by
          symm
          exact Subgroup.map_top_of_surjective π QuotientGroup.mk_surjective
    have hsupker : K ⊔ π.ker = ⊤ ⊔ π.ker :=
      (Subgroup.map_eq_map_iff (f := π) (H := K) (K := ⊤)).mp hmap_eq
    simpa [π, QuotientGroup.ker_mk'] using hsupker
  have hxTop : x ∈ (⊤ : Subgroup G) := by trivial
  have hxKN' : x ∈ K ⊔ (N : Subgroup G) := by
    simpa [hKNtop] using hxTop
  exact hxNK (by simpa [sup_comm] using hxKN')

name: generatorRank_eq_of_closed_normal_le_closedFrattini
statement: theorem generatorRank_eq_of_closed_normal_le_closedFrattini (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (hG : IsFinitelyGeneratedProPGroup p G) (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hNclosed : IsClosed (N : Set G)) (hNphi : N ≤ closedFrattini p G) : generatorRank (G ⧸ N) = generatorRank G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact generatorRank_quotient_le_of_closed_normal G p hG N
  · rcases generatorRank_spec hG with ⟨S₀, hS₀_card, hS₀_top⟩
    let T₀ : Finset (G ⧸ N) := S₀.image (QuotientGroup.mk' N)
    have hT₀_top : (Subgroup.closure (T₀ : Set (G ⧸ N))).topologicalClosure = ⊤ := by
      have htop : ((Subgroup.closure (S₀ : Set G)).map (QuotientGroup.mk' N)).topologicalClosure =
          (⊤ : Subgroup (G ⧸ N)) := by
        simpa using
          (DenseRange.topologicalClosure_map_subgroup
            (f := QuotientGroup.mk' N) continuous_quotient_mk'
            (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective N).denseRange hS₀_top)
      rw [MonoidHom.map_closure] at htop
      simpa [T₀, Finset.coe_image] using htop
    rcases generatorRank_spec_of_exists_generating_finset (G := G ⧸ N) ⟨T₀, hT₀_top⟩ with
      ⟨T, hT_card, hT_top⟩
    let lift : G ⧸ N → G := fun q => Classical.choose (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective N q)
    have hlift : ∀ q : G ⧸ N, QuotientGroup.mk' N (lift q) = q := by
      intro q
      exact Classical.choose_spec (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective N q)
    let S : Finset G := T.image lift
    let K : Subgroup G := (Subgroup.closure (S : Set G)).topologicalClosure
    have hKclosed : IsClosed (K : Set G) := by
      dsimp [K]
      exact Subgroup.isClosed_topologicalClosure _
    haveI : CompactSpace G := hG.compactSpace
    haveI : IsClosed (N : Set G) := hNclosed
    haveI : T2Space (G ⧸ N) := by
      haveI : T1Space (G ⧸ N) := QuotientGroup.instT1Space
      infer_instance
    have hKmap_closed : IsClosed (K.map (QuotientGroup.mk' N) : Set (G ⧸ N)) := by
      have hKcompact : IsCompact (K : Set G) := hKclosed.isCompact
      have hcompact : IsCompact (K.map (QuotientGroup.mk' N) : Set (G ⧸ N)) := by
        simpa [Subgroup.coe_map] using hKcompact.image continuous_quotient_mk'
      exact hcompact.isClosed
    have hTsub : (T : Set (G ⧸ N)) ⊆ K.map (QuotientGroup.mk' N) := by
      intro t ht
      have hmemS : lift t ∈ S := by
        exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
      have hmemClosure : lift t ∈ Subgroup.closure (S : Set G) :=
        Subgroup.subset_closure hmemS
      have hmemK : lift t ∈ K :=
        Subgroup.le_topologicalClosure _ hmemClosure
      have hmapmem : QuotientGroup.mk' N (lift t) ∈ K.map (QuotientGroup.mk' N) :=
        Subgroup.mem_map_of_mem (QuotientGroup.mk' N) hmemK
      simpa [hlift t] using hmapmem
    have hTclosure_le : (Subgroup.closure (T : Set (G ⧸ N))).topologicalClosure ≤
        K.map (QuotientGroup.mk' N) := by
      apply Subgroup.topologicalClosure_minimal
      · exact (Subgroup.closure_le (K := K.map (QuotientGroup.mk' N))).2 hTsub
      · exact hKmap_closed
    have hKmap_top : K.map (QuotientGroup.mk' N) = ⊤ := by
      apply top_unique
      rw [← hT_top]
      exact hTclosure_le
    have hKN_top : K ⊔ N = ⊤ := by
      rw [sup_comm, ← QuotientGroup.comap_map_mk' N K, hKmap_top, Subgroup.comap_top]
    have hKphi : K ⊔ closedFrattini p G = ⊤ := by
      apply top_unique
      calc
        ⊤ = K ⊔ N := by symm; exact hKN_top
        _ ≤ K ⊔ closedFrattini p G := sup_le_sup le_rfl hNphi
    have hKtop : K = ⊤ :=
      closedFrattini_nongenerating G p hG K hKclosed hKphi
    have hGle : generatorRank G ≤ S.card := by
      exact generatorRank_le_of_generating_finset G S (by simpa [K] using hKtop)
    have hScard : S.card ≤ T.card := by
      simpa [S] using (Finset.card_image_le (s := T) (f := lift))
    calc
      generatorRank G ≤ S.card := hGle
      _ ≤ T.card := hScard
      _ = generatorRank (G ⧸ N) := hT_card

name: frattini_quotient_generator_rank
statement:
theorem frattini_quotient_generator_rank (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
    (hG : IsFinitelyGeneratedProPGroup p G)
    {k : ℕ} (g : Fin k → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ closedFrattini p G) :
    generatorRank (proPQuotientOfFrattiniElements G p hG g hg).Q
      = generatorRank G
proof:
:= by
  simpa [proPQuotientOfFrattiniElements] using
    (generatorRank_eq_of_closed_normal_le_closedFrattini G p hG (closedNormalClosureRange g)
      (closedNormalClosureRange.isClosed g)
      (closedNormalClosureRange_le_closedFrattini G p g hg))

name: proPQuotientOfFrattiniElements_relationRank_bound
statement:
theorem proPQuotientOfFrattiniElements_relationRank_bound
    (h5term : ErdosUnitDistance.Hyp_FiveTermRelationBound)
    (hBurnside : ErdosUnitDistance.Hyp_NormallyGenH1InvariantBound)
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
    (hG : IsFinitelyGeneratedProPGroup p G)
    (hH2G : ErdosUnitDistance.H2Finite p G)
    {k : ℕ} (g : Fin k → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ closedFrattini p G) :
    ErdosUnitDistance.H2Finite p (proPQuotientOfFrattiniElements G p hG g hg).Q ∧
      relationRank p (proPQuotientOfFrattiniElements G p hG g hg).Q
        ≤ relationRank p G + k
proof:
:= by
  haveI : T2Space G := hG.t2Space
  haveI : CompactSpace G := hG.compactSpace
  haveI : TotallyDisconnectedSpace G := hG.totallyDisconnectedSpace
  let N : Subgroup G := (Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g)).topologicalClosure
  haveI : N.Normal :=
    Subgroup.is_normal_topologicalClosure (N := Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range g))
  have hClosed : IsClosed (N : Set G) := Subgroup.isClosed_topologicalClosure _
  obtain ⟨hH1Fin, hh1⟩ := hBurnside p G hG k g

  obtain ⟨hH2quot, hrel⟩ := h5term p G hG hH2G N hClosed hH1Fin
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [proPQuotientOfFrattiniElements, closedNormalClosureRange, N] using hH2quot
  · have hh1' : ErdosUnitDistance.h1NormalInvariantRank p G N ≤ k := hh1
    have hcombine : relationRank p (G ⧸ N) ≤ relationRank p G + k := by
      refine le_trans hrel ?_; omega
    simpa [proPQuotientOfFrattiniElements, closedNormalClosureRange, N] using hcombine

name: frattini_quotient_lemma
statement:
theorem frattini_quotient_lemma
    (h5term : ErdosUnitDistance.Hyp_FiveTermRelationBound)
    (hBurnside : ErdosUnitDistance.Hyp_NormallyGenH1InvariantBound)
    (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
    (hG : IsFinitelyGeneratedProPGroup p G)
    (hH2G : ErdosUnitDistance.H2Finite p G)
    (k : ℕ) (g : Fin k → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ closedFrattini p G) :
    ∃ Q : ProPQuotient p G,
      (∀ i, Q.map (g i) = 1) ∧
      generatorRank Q.Q = generatorRank G ∧
      ErdosUnitDistance.H2Finite p Q.Q ∧
      relationRank p Q.Q ≤ relationRank p G + k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hH2Q, hrelQ⟩ :=
    proPQuotientOfFrattiniElements_relationRank_bound h5term hBurnside G p hG hH2G g hg
  refine ⟨proPQuotientOfFrattiniElements G p hG g hg, ?_, ?_, hH2Q, hrelQ⟩
  · intro i
    change QuotientGroup.mk' (closedNormalClosureRange g) (g i) = 1
    rw [QuotientGroup.mk'_apply, QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff]
    exact closedNormalClosureRange.mem g i
  · exact frattini_quotient_generator_rank G p hG g hg

name: burnside_image_generates
statement:
theorem burnside_image_generates (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (Q : Type) [AddCommGroup Q] [TopologicalSpace Q] [DiscreteTopology Q]
    (φ : G →* Multiplicative Q)
    (_hφ_surj : Function.Surjective φ)
    (_hφ_cont : Continuous φ)
    (S : Finset G)
    (hS : (Subgroup.closure (S : Set G)).topologicalClosure = ⊤) :
    Subgroup.closure (φ '' (S : Set G)) = (⊤ : Subgroup (Multiplicative Q))
proof:
:= by
  have htop : ((Subgroup.closure (S : Set G)).map φ).topologicalClosure =
      (⊤ : Subgroup (Multiplicative Q)) := by
    simpa using
      (DenseRange.topologicalClosure_map_subgroup _hφ_cont _hφ_surj.denseRange hS :
        ((Subgroup.closure (S : Set G)).map φ).topologicalClosure =
          (⊤ : Subgroup (Multiplicative Q)))
  rw [MonoidHom.map_closure] at htop
  have hself : (Subgroup.closure (φ '' (S : Set G))).topologicalClosure =
      Subgroup.closure (φ '' (S : Set G)) := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact Subgroup.topologicalClosure_minimal _ le_rfl (isClosed_discrete _)
    · exact Subgroup.le_topologicalClosure _
  simpa [hself] using htop

name: burnside_span_top_of_group_generators
statement:
theorem burnside_span_top_of_group_generators (p : ℕ)
    (Q : Type) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module (ZMod p) Q]
    (T : Finset Q)
    (hT : Subgroup.closure (Multiplicative.ofAdd '' (T : Set Q)) =
      (⊤ : Subgroup (Multiplicative Q))) :
    Submodule.span (ZMod p) (T : Set Q) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let A : AddSubgroup Q := AddSubgroup.closure (T : Set Q)
  have hA : A = ⊤ := by
    have hT' := congrArg Subgroup.toAddSubgroup' hT
    simpa [A, Subgroup.toAddSubgroup'_closure] using hT'
  let U : Submodule (ZMod p) Q := Submodule.span (ZMod p) (T : Set Q)
  have hTU : (T : Set Q) ⊆ U.toAddSubgroup := by
    intro x hx
    exact Submodule.subset_span hx
  have hAleU : A ≤ U.toAddSubgroup := by
    exact (AddSubgroup.closure_le (K := U.toAddSubgroup)).2 hTU
  have hUtop_add : U.toAddSubgroup = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    rw [← hA]
    exact hAleU
  exact Submodule.toAddSubgroup_injective hUtop_add

name: burnside_finrank_le_of_generating_finset
statement:
theorem burnside_finrank_le_of_generating_finset (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
    (Q : Type) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module (ZMod p) Q]
    (T : Finset Q)
    (hT : Subgroup.closure (Multiplicative.ofAdd '' (T : Set Q)) =
      (⊤ : Subgroup (Multiplicative Q))) :
    Module.finrank (ZMod p) Q ≤ T.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hspan : Submodule.span (ZMod p) (T : Set Q) = ⊤ :=
    burnside_span_top_of_group_generators p Q T hT
  have hle : Module.finrank (ZMod p) (Submodule.span (ZMod p) (T : Set Q)) ≤ T.card := by
    simpa [Set.finrank] using (finrank_span_finset_le_card (R := ZMod p) T)
  rw [hspan, finrank_top] at hle
  exact hle

name: burnside_basis
statement:
theorem burnside_basis (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
    (_hG : ErdosUnitDistance.IsFinitelyGeneratedProPGroup p G)
    (k : ℕ)
    (Q : Type) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module (ZMod p) Q]
    [TopologicalSpace Q] [DiscreteTopology Q]
    (_hQrank : Module.finrank (ZMod p) Q = k)
    (φ : G →* Multiplicative Q)
    (_hφ_surj : Function.Surjective φ)
    (_hφ_cont : Continuous φ)
    : k ≤ ErdosUnitDistance.generatorRank G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← _hQrank]
  rcases ErdosUnitDistance.generatorRank_spec _hG with ⟨S, hS_card, hS_top⟩
  let T : Finset Q := S.image (fun g => (φ g).toAdd)
  have hTgen : Subgroup.closure (Multiplicative.ofAdd '' (T : Set Q)) = (⊤ : Subgroup (Multiplicative Q)) := by
    simpa [T, Finset.coe_image, Set.image_image, ofAdd_toAdd]
      using burnside_image_generates G Q φ _hφ_surj _hφ_cont S hS_top
  have hfin : Module.finrank (ZMod p) Q ≤ T.card :=
    burnside_finrank_le_of_generating_finset p Q T hTgen
  have hcard : T.card ≤ S.card := by
    simpa [T] using (Finset.card_image_le (s := S) (f := fun g => (φ g).toAdd))
  have hfin' : Module.finrank (ZMod p) Q ≤ S.card := le_trans hfin hcard
  simpa [hS_card] using hfin'
